definition:
-- sp_AccountsLedger

/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_AccountsLedger    Script Date: 4/23/02 4:29:59 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_AccountsLedger    Script Date: 4/8/02 6:26:06 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_AccountsLedger    Script Date: 3/6/02 3:39:36 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_AccountsLedger    Script Date: 7/20/01 6:52:01 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_AccountsLedger    Script Date: 4/19/00 1:21:26 PM ******/
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_AccountsLedger @ad_StartDate datetime,
				   @ad_EndDate   datetime AS

/* Declaration of local Variables to be used in the script later */

DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0)

/* Fetching local Variables values to be used in the script later */

SELECT @ln_purchaseacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseAccount')
SELECT @ln_cashacc         = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SELECT @ln_equityacc	   = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_EquityACC')
SELECT @ln_salesacc        = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesACC')
SELECT @ln_salesretacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesReturnACC')
SELECT @ln_purchaseretacc  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseReturnsAccount')
SELECT @ln_revfromservice  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_RevenueFromServices')
SELECT @ln_salestaxacc	   = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')


/**********************Computation of Opening Balance***************************/

exec sp_accountsBalance @ad_StartDate

/**********************Initial HouseKeeping ***************************/
/* Declaration of Temporary Table to be used for records to be returned by this script */

create table #lt_Accounts
(
	acccode      numeric (5,  0) NOT NULL,
	accname      varchar (100)       NULL,
	subaccname   varchar (100)       NULL,
	openbalance  numeric (15, 2) NOT NULL 
)

create table #lt_accountsledger
(
	acccode      numeric (5,  0) NOT NULL,
	Type         varchar (100)   NOT NULL,
	Date         DateTime        NOT NULL,
	debit        numeric (12, 2) NOT NULL, 
	credit       numeric (12, 2) NOT NULL,
	Remarks      varchar (100)   	 NULL, 
)


Insert #lt_Accounts
Select code1, name1, name2, value1
from   ReportData

/**********************************************************************/
/**************************** Accounting Vouchers ************************/
/**********************************************************************/

insert #lt_accountsledger
Select  acccode = gldetail.acccode, 
	type    = Case VochCatCode When 1 Then 'CP-'
				   When 2 Then 'CR-'
				   When 3 Then 'BP-'
				   When 4 Then 'BR-'
				   When 5 Then 'JV-'
				   Else        'OV-'
		  End + Ltrim(str(glheader.glvochcode)),
	date    = glheader.Date, 
	debit   = gldetail.debit, 
	credit  = gldetail.credit,
	remarks = glheader.remarks


from    glheader,
	gldetail 

where    glheader.date between @ad_StartDate and @ad_EndDate and
	 glheader.posted = 'Y'	 and 
	 glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode

/**********************************************************************/
/********************* Bills Receivables/Payables **********************/
/**********************************************************************/

/************************* Receivables/Payables **********************/

insert #lt_accountsledger
Select  acccode= Notes.acccode, 
	Type   = Case Notes.NoteCatCode  
			When 1 Then 'NR-'
			Else        'NP-'
		 End + Ltrim(str(Notes.NoteCode)), 
	Date   = Notes.PostDate, 
	debit  = Case Notes.NoteCatCode  
			When 2 Then Notes.Amount
			Else        0
		 End,
	credit = Case Notes.NoteCatCode  
			When 1 Then Notes.Amount
			Else        0
		 End,
	remarks= notes.remarks

from    Notes

where   Notes.Postdate between @ad_StartDate and @ad_EndDate and
	Notes.posted = 'Y'	

/*********************   Bank **********************/

insert #lt_accountsledger
Select  acccode= Notes.Bankacccode, 
	Type   = Case Notes.NoteCatCode  
			When 1 Then 'NR-'
			Else        'NP-'
		 End + Ltrim(str(Notes.NoteCode)), 
	Date   = Notes.PostDate, 
	debit  = Case Notes.NoteCatCode  
			When 1 Then Notes.Amount
			Else        0
		 End,
	credit = Case Notes.NoteCatCode  
			When 2 Then Notes.Amount
			Else        0
		 End,
	remarks= notes.remarks

from    Notes

where    Notes.Postdate between @ad_StartDate and @ad_EndDate and
	 Notes.posted = 'Y'	 

/**************************Final Housing Keeping *********************/
delete  reportdata

insert  reportdata(name1, name4, value3, name2, date1, value1, value2, name3)
select 	RTrim(#lt_accounts.accname), 
	RTrim(#lt_accounts.subaccname), 
	#lt_accounts.openbalance, 
	#lt_accountsledger.type,
	#lt_accountsledger.date,
	#lt_accountsledger.debit,
	#lt_accountsledger.credit,
	#lt_accountsledger.remarks
from   	#lt_accounts, 
	#lt_accountsledger
where   #lt_accounts.acccode = #lt_accountsledger.acccode 
order  by accname

/*-------------by shahzad-----------*/

update reportdata
set reportdata.code1=accounts.acccode
from accounts,reportdata
where reportdata.name1=accounts.name

/*-------------end-----------*/
Drop Table #lt_accounts
Drop Table #lt_accountsledger

name: sp_AccountsLedger1
definition:
-- sp_AccountsLedger1
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_AccountsLedger1 @ai_AccCode int,@ad_Sdate datetime,@ad_Ldate datetime AS
/*****************************************************************/
/* Declaration of local Variables to be used in the script later */
/*****************************************************************/

DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0)

DECLARE @ln_OpeningBalance NUMERIC(15,2)

/*****************************************************************/
/* Fetching local Variables values to be used in the script later*/
/*****************************************************************/

SELECT @ln_purchaseacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseAccount')
SELECT @ln_cashacc         = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SELECT @ln_equityacc	   = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_EquityACC')
SELECT @ln_salesacc        = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesACC')
SELECT @ln_salesretacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesReturnACC')
SELECT @ln_purchaseretacc  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseReturnsAccount')
SELECT @ln_revfromservice  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_RevenueFromServices')
SELECT @ln_salestaxacc	   = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')

/*****************************************************************/
/* Declaration of Temporary Table to be used for records to be returned by this script */
/*****************************************************************/
CREATE TABLE #lt_virtualgl
(
	documentcode int not null,
	documenttype varchar(5) not null,
	catcode      tinyint NOT NULL,
	dr_acccode      smallint NOT NULL,
	cr_acccode      smallint NOT NULL,
	AlternateAccCode smallint NULL,
	date datetime not null,
	amount numeric (15, 2) NOT NULL,
	remarks varchar (100) NULL,
	checkNo varchar (20) NULL,
	usercode smallint NULL
)

/*****************************************************************/
/*-------------------------- CASH ACCOUNT -----------------------*/
/*****************************************************************/

IF @ai_AccCode =@ln_cashacc
BEGIN

	/*******************************/
	/*OPENING BALANCE CALCULATIONS */
	/*******************************/

	SELECT  @ln_OpeningBalance=
	(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(S.amount),0) 
	FROM 	(SELECT Amount = Isnull(Round(SUM(saledetail.looseqty*saledetail.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * 
				(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))*saledetail.gstperc * .01,2))+
			Round( (sum( (saledetail.looseqty * 
				(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) - saleledger.flatdisc) * 
				(saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
			Round( sum( (saledetail.looseqty * 
				(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + saleledger.misccharges + 
				saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)
		FROM	saleledger, saledetail		
		WHERE	saleledger.salecatcode IN ( 1,3 )and 
	                SaleLedger.Date < @ad_Sdate and
			/*saleledger.posted = 'Y' and */
			saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode
		GROUP BY saleledger.saleinvcode,
			saleledger.custcode, 
			saleledger.salecatcode,
			saleledger.date,
			saleledger.discperc,
			saleledger.misccharges,
			saleledger.salestax,
			saleledger.invgstperc1,
			saleledger.flatdisc,
			saleledger.salesmancode) as S)
	-
	(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(SR.amount),0) 
	FROM	(SELECT Amount  = Isnull(Round(SUM(srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.unitsalestax)+ 
				  SUM(ROUND( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
					(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc)) * 
					srdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				  Round( (sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
					(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * 
					(1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) - srledger.flatdisc) * 
					(srledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
				  Round( sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
					(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * 
					(1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) + srledger.misccharges +
					srledger.salestax - srledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)
		FROM    srledger, srdetail
		WHERE   srledger.srcatcode in (8,6) AND
			srledger.date  < @ad_Sdate and 
			srledger.posted = 'Y' and 
			srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode 
		GROUP BY srledger.srinvcode,
			srledger.custcode, 
			srledger.srcatcode,
			srledger.date,
			srledger.discperc,
			srledger.misccharges,
			srledger.salestax,
			srledger.invgstperc1,
			srledger.flatdisc,
			srledger.salesmancode) as SR)
	+
	(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(SER.amount) ,0)
	FROM	(SELECT Amount	= IsNull(Round(sum( (isnull(d.price, 0) * 
				  (1 - (.01 * isnull(d.discperc, 0)))) * 
				  (1- (.01 * ISNULL(h.discperc, 0))) + isnull(h.misccharges,0)- 
				  isnull(h.flatdisc, 0)), 0), 0)
		FROM    serviceheader h,
			servicedetail d

		WHERE	h.serviceCatCode IN (10,12) AND
			h.date < @ad_Sdate  and
			/* h.posted = 'Y'	 and */
			h.serviceinvcode = d.serviceinvcode 
		GROUP BY h.serviceinvcode,
			 h.custcode, 
			 h.ServiceCatCode,
			 h.date,
			 h.discperc,
			 h.misccharges,
			 h.flatdisc,
			 h.salesmancode)as SER)
	- 
        (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(SERR.amount) ,0)
	FROM    (SELECT	Amount   = IsNull(Round(sum( (isnull(d.ServicePrice, 0) * 
				  (1 - (.01 * isnull(d.discperc, 0)))) * 
				  (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) + isnull(h.misccharges,0) - 
				  isnull(h.flatdisc, 0)), 0), 0)
		FROM    serviceRheader h,
			serviceRdetail d

		WHERE	h.servicercatcode IN (13,15) AND
			h.date < @ad_Sdate and 
			h.posted = 'Y'	 and 
			h.serviceRinvcode = d.serviceRinvcode 
		GROUP BY h.serviceRinvcode,
			 h.custcode, 
			 h.ServiceRCatCode,
			 h.date,
			 h.discperc,
			 h.misccharges,
			 h.flatdisc,
			 h.salesmancode  ) as SERR)
	+
	(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(GL.debit - GL.credit),0)
	FROM	(SELECT debit,credit,gldetail.glvochcode,glheader.postdate
		FROM  	gldetail, glheader
		WHERE 	glheader.postdate < @ad_Sdate and 
	      		glheader.posted='Y' and
	      		glheader.glvochcode=gldetail.glvochcode and
      			gldetail.acccode=@ai_AccCode ) AS GL)

	/*******************************/
	/*TRANSACTIONS DURING PERIOD */
	/*******************************/

	INSERT INTO #lt_VirtualGL
	SELECT  documentcode = saleledger.saleinvcode,
		documenttype    = 'SV',
		catcode = saleledger.SaleCatCode,
		dr_acccode = CASE saleledger.saleCatCode
				WHEN 1 THEN @ln_cashacc     /* Cash Sale */
				WHEN 3 THEN @ln_cashacc     /* Cash Sale */
				ELSE   saleledger.custcode  /* Credit Sale */
				END,
		cr_acccode = @ln_salesacc,
		AlternateAccCode = CASE saleledger.saleCatCode
				WHEN 1 THEN saleledger.custcode  /* Cash Sale */
				WHEN 3 THEN saleledger.custcode  /* Cash Sale */
				ELSE Null
				END,
		Date    = saleledger.date,
		Amount  = Isnull(Round(SUM(saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
			  SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * 
				(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))*saledetail.gstperc * .01,2)) +
			  Round( (sum( (saledetail.looseqty * 
				(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) - saleledger.flatdisc) * 
				(saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
			  Round( sum( (saledetail.looseqty * 
				(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + saleledger.misccharges + 
				saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
		remarks = MAX(saleledger.remarks),
		CheckNo = NULL, 
		UserCode=saleledger.salesmancode
	FROM    saleledger, saledetail
	WHERE   saleledger.salecatcode IN ( 1,3 )and 
                SaleLedger.Date between @ad_Sdate and @ad_ldate and
		/*saleledger.posted = 'Y'	 and */
		saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode  
	GROUP BY saleledger.saleinvcode,
		 saleledger.custcode, 
		 saleledger.salecatcode,
		 saleledger.date,
		 saleledger.discperc,
		 saleledger.misccharges,
		 saleledger.salestax,
		 saleledger.invgstperc1,
		 saleledger.flatdisc,
		 saleledger.salesmancode

	INSERT INTO #lt_VirtualGL
	SELECT  documentcode = srledger.srinvcode,
		documenttype = 'SRV',
		catcode = SRledger.SRCatCode,
		dr_acccode = @ln_salesretacc,
		cr_acccode = CASE srledger.srCatCode
			WHEN 6 THEN @ln_cashacc     /* Cash Sale Return*/
			WHEN 8 THEN @ln_cashacc     /* Cash Sale Return*/
			ELSE   srledger.custcode     /* Credit Sale Return*/
		END,
		AlternateAccCode = CASE srledger.srCatCode
			WHEN 6 THEN srledger.custcode     /* Cash Sale Return*/
			WHEN 8 THEN srledger.custcode     /* Cash Sale Return*/
			ELSE   NULL     /* Credit Sale Return*/
		END,
		Date    = srledger.date,
		Amount  = Isnull(Round(SUM(srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.unitsalestax)+ 
				  SUM(ROUND( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
					(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc)) * 
					srdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				  Round( (sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
					(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * 
					(1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) - srledger.flatdisc) * 
					(srledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
				  Round( sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
					(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * 
					(1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) + srledger.misccharges +
					srledger.salestax - srledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
		remarks = max(srledger.remarks),
		CheckNo = NULL, 
		UserCode= ISNULL(srledger.salesmancode, 0)
	FROM    srledger, srdetail		
	WHERE   srledger.srcatcode in (8,6) AND
		srledger.date between @ad_Sdate and @ad_ldate and
		srledger.posted = 'Y'	 and 
		srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode 

	GROUP BY srledger.srinvcode,
		 srledger.custcode, 
		 srledger.srcatcode,
		 srledger.date,
		 srledger.discperc,
		 srledger.misccharges,

	(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(S.amount),0) * (- 1)
	FROM	(SELECT	Amount = Isnull(Round(SUM(saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))*saledetail.gstperc * .01,2))+
			Round( (sum( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc))*
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) - saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
			Round( sum( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)
		FROM	saleledger, saledetail

		cr_acccode = purledger.suppcode,
		AlternateAccCode =purledger.suppcode,
		date    = purledger.postdate,
		Amount 	= ISNULL(
			 	ROUND(SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) *
					purdetail.purprice * (1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)))* 
					(1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + purledger.misccharges+ 
					purledger.salestax - purledger.flatdisc, 0) +
				ROUND(SUM(((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) + 
					purdetail.bonusqty) * purdetail.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM(ROUND((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * 
					purdetail.purprice * (1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)) *
					purdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				ROUND((SUM(((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * 
					purdetail.purprice) * (1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)))* 
					(1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) - purledger.flatdisc)* 
					(purledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0), 0),
		remarks = MAX(purledger.remarks),
		CheckNo = NULL,
		usercode= purledger.salesmancode
	FROM    purledger, purdetail
	WHERE   purledger.postdate between @ad_Sdate and @ad_ldate and
		purledger.purcatcode IN (1,2,3,7,8) AND 
		purledger.posted = 'Y'	 AND	 
		purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode 
	GROUP BY purledger.purinvcode,
		 purledger.suppcode, 
		 purledger.purcatcode,
		 purledger.postdate,
		 purledger.discperc,
		 purledger.misccharges,
		 purledger.salestax,
		 purledger.invgstperc1,
		 purledger.flatdisc,
		 purledger.salesmancode

	DELETE FROM reportdata

	INSERT INTO reportdata(code1,value1,value2,date1,name2,name3)
	SELECT @ai_AccCode,amount,0,date,remarks,Convert(varchar(12),DocumentCode) + DocumentType
	FROM #lt_VirtualGL
	WHERE DocumentType IN ('PV')

END

/*****************************************************************/
/*------------------------CAPITAL ACCOUNT -----------------------*/
/*****************************************************************/

IF @ai_AccCode = @ln_equityacc
BEGIN

	/*******************************/
	/*OPENING BALANCE CALCULATIONS */
	/*******************************/
  
	SELECT  @ln_OpeningBalance= 
	(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(PL.AMOUNT),0)  * (- 1)
	FROM	(SELECT Amount= ISNULL(
			 	ROUND(SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) *
					purdetail.purprice * (1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)))* 
					(1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + purledger.misccharges+ 
					purledger.salestax - purledger.flatdisc, 0) +
				ROUND(SUM(((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) + 
					purdetail.bonusqty) * purdetail.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM(ROUND((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * 
					purdetail.purprice * (1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)) *
					purdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				ROUND((SUM(((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * 
					purdetail.purprice) * (1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)))* 
					(1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) - purledger.flatdisc)* 
					(purledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0), 0)
		FROM     purledger, purdetail
		WHERE    purledger.postdate<@ad_Sdate and
			 purledger.purcatcode IN (3)AND 
			 purledger.posted = 'Y'	 AND	 
			 purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode 
		GROUP BY purledger.purinvcode,
			 purledger.suppcode, 
			 purledger.purcatcode,
			 purledger.postdate,
			 purledger.discperc,
			 purledger.misccharges,
			 purledger.salestax,
			 purledger.invgstperc1,
			 purledger.flatdisc,
			 purledger.salesmancode) AS PL)
	+
	(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(GL.debit - GL.credit),0)
	FROM    (SELECT debit,credit,gldetail.glvochcode,glheader.postdate
		FROM 	gldetail, glheader
		WHERE 	glheader.postdate < @ad_Sdate and 
      			glheader.posted='Y' and
      			glheader.glvochcode=gldetail.glvochcode and
      			gldetail.acccode=@ai_AccCode) AS GL)

	/*******************************/
	/*TRANSACTIONS DURING PERIOD */
	/*******************************/

	INSERT INTO #lt_VirtualGL
	SELECT  documentcode = purledger.purinvcode,
		documenttype='PV',
		catcode = purledger.PurCatCode,
		dr_acccode = purledger.suppcode,
		cr_acccode = purledger.suppcode,
		AlternateAccCode =purledger.suppcode,
		date    = purledger.postdate,
		Amount 	= ISNULL( ROUND(SUM(( (purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty ) * purdetail.purprice) * (1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + purledger.misccharges + purledger.salestax - purledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
		remarks = MAX(purledger.remarks),
		CheckNo = NULL,
		usercode= purledger.salesmancode

	FROM     purledger,	 
		 purdetail

	WHERE    purledger.postdate between @ad_Sdate and @ad_ldate and
		 purledger.purcatcode IN (3) AND 
		 purledger.posted = 'Y'	 AND	 
		 purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode 
	GROUP BY purledger.purinvcode,
		 purledger.suppcode, 
		 purledger.purcatcode,
		 purledger.postdate,
		 purledger.discperc,
		 purledger.misccharges,
		 purledger.salestax,
		 purledger.invgstperc1,
		 purledger.flatdisc,
		 purledger.salesmancode

	DELETE	FROM reportdata

	INSERT INTO reportdata(code1,value1,value2,date1,name2,name3)
	SELECT @ai_AccCode,0,amount,date,remarks,Convert(varchar(12),DocumentCode) + DocumentType
	FROM #lt_VirtualGL
	WHERE DocumentType IN ('PV')

END


/*****************************************************************/
/*------------------ PURCHASE RETURN ACCOUNT --------------------*/
/*****************************************************************/

IF @ai_AccCode=@ln_purchaseretacc
BEGIN

	/*******************************/
	/*OPENING BALANCE CALCULATIONS */
	/*******************************/
	
	SELECT  @ln_OpeningBalance=
	(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(PR.amount),0) * (- 1)
	FROM	(SELECT	Amount = ISNULL(ROUND(SUM((( prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.packqty * prdetail.packunits) * prdetail.prprice) * (1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * prledger.discperc)) + prledger.misccharges + prledger.salestax - prledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)
		FROM prledger, prdetail
	WHERE   prledger.date < @ad_Sdate and
 		prledger.posted = 'Y'	 and 
		prledger.prcatcode IN (4,5) AND
	 	prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode

	GROUP BY prledger.prinvcode,
	 	 prledger.suppcode, 
 		 prledger.prcatcode,
	 	 prledger.date,
 		 prledger.discperc,
	 	 prledger.misccharges,
	 	 prledger.salestax,
	 	 prledger.flatdisc,
 		 prledger.salesmancode) AS PR)
	+
	(SELECT  ISNULL(SUM(GL.debit - GL.credit),0)
	FROM    (SELECT debit,credit,gldetail.glvochcode,glheader.postdate
		FROM  	gldetail, glheader
		WHERE	glheader.postdate < @ad_Sdate and 
      			glheader.posted='Y' and
      			glheader.glvochcode=gldetail.glvochcode and
      			gldetail.acccode=@ai_AccCode) AS GL)

	/*******************************/
	/* TRANSACTIONS DURING PERIOD  */
	/*******************************/

	INSERT INTO #lt_VirtualGL
	SELECT  documentcode = prledger.prinvcode,
	 	documenttype    = 'PRV',
		catcode = prledger.PRCatCode,
 		dr_acccode = prledger.suppcode,
	 	cr_acccode = prledger.suppcode, 
		AlternateAccCode = prledger.suppcode,
	 	date    = prledger.date,
 		Amount = ISNULL(ROUND(SUM((( prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.packqty * prdetail.packunits) * prdetail.prprice) * (1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * prledger.discperc)) + prledger.misccharges + prledger.salestax - prledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
	 	remarks = MAX(prledger.remarks),
		CheckNo = NULL,
	 	UserCode = prledger.salesmancode

	FROM     prledger,	 
	 	 prdetail		
 	WHERE	 prledger.date between @ad_Sdate and @ad_ldate AND
 		 prledger.posted = 'Y'	 and 
		 prledger.prcatcode IN(4,5) and
	 	 prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode

	GROUP BY prledger.prinvcode,
	 	 prledger.suppcode, 
 		 prledger.prcatcode,
	 	 prledger.date,
 		 prledger.discperc,
	 	 prledger.misccharges,
	 	 prledger.salestax,
	 	 prledger.flatdisc,
 		 prledger.salesmancode


	DELETE FROM reportdata

	INSERT INTO reportdata(code1,value1,value2,date1,name2,name3)
	SELECT @ai_AccCode,0,amount,date,remarks,Convert(varchar(12),DocumentCode) + DocumentType
	FROM #lt_VirtualGL
	WHERE DocumentType IN ('PRV')

END

/*****************************************************************/
/*--------------------- ANY OTHER ACCOUNT -----------------------*/
/*****************************************************************/

IF  @ai_AccCode > 100

BEGIN

	/*******************************/
	/*OPENING BALANCE CALCULATIONS */
	/*******************************/

	SELECT	@ln_OpeningBalance=
	 	(select ISNULL(sum(gldetail.debit - gldetail.credit),0)
			from  	gldetail, glheader
			where 	glheader.postdate <@ad_Sdate and 
      				glheader.posted='Y' and
      				glheader.glvochcode=gldetail.glvochcode and
		      		gldetail.acccode=@ai_AccCode)
	DELETE FROM reportdata
END

INSERT INTO reportdata (code1,name1,value1,value2,date1,name2,name3)
SELECT  gldetail.acccode,'cash',debit,credit,glheader.postdate,gldetail.remarks,
	CASE glheader.vochcatcode
		When 1 Then convert(varchar(14),glheader.glvochcode) + 'CPV'
		When 2 Then convert(varchar(14),glheader.glvochcode) + 'CRV'
		When 3 Then convert(varchar(14),glheader.glvochcode) + 'BPV'
		When 4 Then convert(varchar(14),glheader.glvochcode) + 'BRV'
		When 5 Then convert(varchar(14),glheader.glvochcode) + 'JV'
	ELSE
		 convert(varchar(14),glheader.glvochcode) + 'OPEN'
	END											
FROM  gldetail, glheader
WHERE glheader.postdate between @ad_Sdate and @ad_Ldate and
      glheader.posted='Y' and
      glheader.glvochcode=gldetail.glvochcode and
      gldetail.acccode=@ai_AccCode


UPDATE reportdata 
SET value3=(SELECT @ln_OpeningBalance)
DROP TABLE #lt_VirtualGL

CREATE Procedure DBO.sp_Admit_Patient_Emergency
	@PatientCode Int,

As

Declare @Code Int, @rt_code INT

/*
Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Purpose: This Stored Procedure admits a patient in emergency mode w/o caring about 
sanity checks like bed availability etc
*/
Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'PatientAdmission' , @Code Output
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
Begin
	RaisError( 'Error occured in generating patient admission' ,16,1)
	RETURN -1
End

Insert Into PatientAdmission (AdmissionCode, PatientCode, LocationCode,	Date, UserCode, DoctorCode, Discharged1, Discharged, DiseaseCode, CashAccCode, CashTendered, CashCharged, CashBack, Diagnosis)

IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@RowCount = 0 
Begin 
	RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Patient Admission' ,16,1)
	RETURN -1
End

SET @AdmissionCode = @Code
Return 0

-- SP_Admit_Student
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_Admit_Student @ClassCode INT, @StudentCode INT, @RollNo VARCHAR(40) OUT
AS
DECLARE @NewRollNo VARCHAR(40)

DELETE DBO.StudentClass WHERE StudentCode = @StudentCode AND ClassCode=@ClassCode

SET @NewRollNo = ISNULL(
	(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST(RollNo AS INT)),0) + 1 
	FROM StudentClass 
	WHERE ClassCode=@ClassCode), 1)
IF @NewRollNo IS NULL 
	SET @NewRollNo = ''

INSERT INTO DBO.StudentClass (ClassCode, StudentCode, RollNo, AdmissionDate)
VALUES (@ClassCode, @StudentCode, @NewRollNo, GETDATE())

IF @@RowCount = 0 AND @@Error <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Can Not Admit student in the specified class', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END
SET @RollNo = @NewRollNo

UPDATE Student SET CurrentClass = @ClassCode, Status='A' WHERE StudentCode = @StudentCode
IF @@RowCount = 0 AND @@Error <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Can Not Update Current Student Class in student regisration', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

RETURN 0

definition:
-- sp_Aging
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_Aging] @Type Char(1), @l_date DATETIME, @interval INT, @limit INT 
AS

DECLARE @OldAccCode INT
DECLARE @AccCode INT
DECLARE @TDate DateTime
DECLARE @Amt Numeric(15,5)
DECLARE @Paid Numeric(15,5)
DECLARE @RowID INT
DECLARE @Pmt Numeric(15,5)
DECLARE @DaysOld INT
DECLARE @StartLimit INT
DECLARE @EndLimit INT

DELETE REPORTDATA

CREATE TABLE #lt_amt (
	AccCode INT NOT NULL,
	Date DateTime Not Null,
	Amount Numeric(15,5) Not Null Default 0,
	Paid Numeric(15,5) Not Null Default 0,
	RowID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
	DaysOld INT Not Null Default 0
)

CREATE TABLE #lt_pmt (
	AccCode INT NOT NULL,
	Amount Numeric(15,5) Not Null Default 0
)

CREATE TABLE #lt_interval (
	IntervalID INT IDENTITY (0,1) NOT NULL,
	LowerLimit INT Not Null Default 0,
	UpperLimit INT Not Null Default 0
)

SELECT @StartLimit = 0
WHILE @StartLimit <= @limit
BEGIN
	SELECT @EndLimit = @StartLimit + CASE @StartLimit WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE @interval - 1 END
	SELECT @EndLimit = CASE WHEN @EndLimit > @limit THEN @limit ELSE @EndLimit END

	INSERT INTO #lt_interval (LowerLimit, UpperLimit) 
	VALUES (@StartLimit, @EndLimit)

	SELECT @StartLimit = @EndLimit + 1
END

INSERT INTO #lt_interval (LowerLimit, UpperLimit) 
VALUES (@StartLimit, 99999999)

IF @type = 'C'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #lt_amt
	SELECT AccCode, Date, Amount=Debit, Paid=0, DaysOld=DATEDIFF(day, date, @l_date)
	FROM VirtualGL 
	WHERE	Date <= @l_Date AND 
		Debit > 0 AND 
		AccCode IN (SELECT CUSTCODE FROM CUSTOMER)
	ORDER BY AccCode, Date, Debit

	INSERT INTO #lt_pmt
	SELECT AccCode, Amount=SUM(Credit)
	FROM VirtualGL 
	WHERE	Date <= @l_Date AND 
		Credit > 0 AND 
		AccCode IN (SELECT CUSTCODE FROM CUSTOMER)
	GROUP BY AccCode
	ORDER BY AccCode
END
IF @type = 'S'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #lt_amt
	SELECT AccCode, Date, Amount=Credit, Paid=0, DaysOld=DATEDIFF(day, date, @l_date)
	FROM VirtualGL 
	WHERE 	Date <= @l_Date AND 
		Credit > 0 AND AccCode IN (SELECT SUPPCODE FROM SUPPLIER)
	ORDER BY AccCode, Date, Credit

	INSERT INTO #lt_pmt
	SELECT AccCode, Amount=SUM(Debit)
	FROM VirtualGL 
	WHERE 	Date <= @l_Date AND 
		Debit > 0 AND AccCode IN (SELECT SUPPCODE FROM SUPPLIER)
	GROUP BY AccCode
	ORDER BY AccCode
END

DECLARE C1 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM #lt_amt ORDER BY AccCode, Date, Amount
OPEN C1

FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @AccCode, @TDate, @Amt, @Paid, @RowID, @DaysOld
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SELECT @Pmt=ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(Amount, 0) FROM #lt_pmt WHERE AccCode = @AccCode), 0)

	IF @Pmt <> 0
	BEGIN
		UPDATE #lt_amt
		SET Paid = Paid + CASE WHEN @Amt >= @Pmt THEN @Pmt ELSE @Amt END
		WHERE RowID = @RowID
	
		SELECT @Pmt = @Pmt - (SELECT CASE WHEN @Amt >= @Pmt THEN @Pmt ELSE @Amt END)
	
		UPDATE #lt_Pmt
		SET Amount = @Pmt 
		WHERE AccCode = @AccCode
	END

	FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @AccCode, @TDate, @Amt, @Paid, @RowID, @DaysOld

END
CLOSE C1
DEALLOCATE C1

DELETE #lt_amt WHERE Amount - Paid = 0

IF @type = 'C'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO ReportData (Code1, Name1, Name2, Name3, Name4, Name5, Value1, Code2)
	SELECT  
		Code1=Ar.AreaCode,
		Name1=Ar.Name,
		Name2=Ac.AliasName,
		Name3=Ac.Name,
		Name4=LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.Address1)) + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(C.Address2)), 60),
		Name5=C.Phone,
		Value1 = SUM(Amount-Paid),
		Code2 = (SELECT MAX(LowerLimit) FROM #lt_interval 
			WHERE	l.daysold >= lowerlimit AND
				l.daysold <= upperlimit)
	FROM #lt_amt l, Accounts Ac, Area Ar, Customer C
	WHERE 	l.AccCode = Ac.AccCode AND 
		Ac.AccCode = C.CustCode AND
		C.AreaCode = Ar.AreaCode
	GROUP BY
		Ar.AreaCode,
		Ar.Name,
		Ac.AccCode,
		Ac.Name,
		Ac.AliasName,
		C.Address1,
		C.Address2,
		C.Phone,
		l.DaysOld
END

IF @type = 'S'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO ReportData (Code1, Name1, Name2, Name3, Name4, Name5, Value1, Code2)
	SELECT  
		Code1=0,
		Name1='All Supplier(s)',
		Name2=Ac.AliasName,
		Name3=Ac.Name,
		Name4=LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(S.Address1)) + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(S.Address2)), 60),
		Name5=S.Phone,
		Value1 = SUM(Amount-Paid),
		Code2 = (SELECT MAX(LowerLimit) FROM #lt_interval 
			WHERE	l.daysold >= lowerlimit AND
				l.daysold <= upperlimit)
	FROM #lt_amt l, Accounts Ac, Supplier S
	WHERE 	l.AccCode = Ac.AccCode AND 
		Ac.AccCode = S.SuppCode
	GROUP BY
		Ac.AccCode,
		Ac.Name,
		Ac.AliasName,
		S.Address1,
		S.Address2,
		S.Phone,
		l.DaysOld
END

/*
UPDATE ReportData 
SET Name6 = 
	case 
		when cast(code2 as int) = 0 then 'Current (0)' 
		when cast(code2 as int) = 1 then '1-' + ltrim(rtrim(str(@interval))) 
		when cast(code2 as int) >= 2 AND cast(code2 as int) <= @limit then ltrim(rtrim(str(code2))) + '-' + 
			case 
				when cast(code2 as int) + @interval - 1 > @limit then ltrim(rtrim(str(@limit)))
				else ltrim(rtrim(str(code2 + @interval - 1))) 
			end
		ELSE '> ' + ltrim(rtrim(str(@limit)))
	end + ' Days Old'
*/
DROP TABLE #lt_amt
DROP TABLE #lt_pmt
DROP TABLE #lt_interval

-- sp_Aging_Account
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_Aging_Account @Type Char(1), @AccCode INT, @l_date DATETIME, @interval INT, @limit INT 
AS

EXECUTE SP_VirtualGL 'A'

DECLARE @OldAccCode INT
DECLARE @TDate DateTime, @DocumentCode VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @Amt Numeric(15,5)
DECLARE @Paid Numeric(15,5)
DECLARE @RowID INT
DECLARE @Pmt Numeric(15,5)
DECLARE @DaysOld INT
DECLARE @StartLimit INT
DECLARE @EndLimit INT

DELETE REPORTDATA

CREATE TABLE #lt_amt (
	AccCode INT NOT NULL,
	DocumentCode VARCHAR(100),
	Date DateTime Not Null,
	Amount Numeric(15,5) Not Null Default 0,
	Paid Numeric(15,5) Not Null Default 0,
	RowID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
	DaysOld INT Not Null Default 0
)

CREATE TABLE #lt_pmt (
	AccCode INT NOT NULL,
	Amount Numeric(15,5) Not Null Default 0
)

CREATE TABLE #lt_interval (
	IntervalID INT IDENTITY (0,1) NOT NULL,
	LowerLimit INT Not Null Default 0,
	UpperLimit INT Not Null Default 0
)

SELECT @StartLimit = 0
WHILE @StartLimit <= @limit
BEGIN
	SELECT @EndLimit = @StartLimit + CASE @StartLimit WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE @interval - 1 END
	SELECT @EndLimit = CASE WHEN @EndLimit > @limit THEN @limit ELSE @EndLimit END

	INSERT INTO #lt_interval (LowerLimit, UpperLimit) 
	VALUES (@StartLimit, @EndLimit)

	SELECT @StartLimit = @EndLimit + 1
END

INSERT INTO #lt_interval (LowerLimit, UpperLimit) 
VALUES (@StartLimit, 99999999)

IF @type = 'C'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #lt_amt
	SELECT AccCode, 
		DocumentCode = DocumentType + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(DocumentCode,10))),
		Date, Amount=Debit, Paid=0, DaysOld=DATEDIFF(day, date, @l_date)
	FROM VirtualGL 
	WHERE	Date <= @l_Date AND 
		Debit > 0 AND 
		AccCode = @AccCode
	ORDER BY AccCode, Date, Debit

	INSERT INTO #lt_pmt
	SELECT AccCode, Amount=SUM(Credit)
	FROM VirtualGL 
	WHERE	Date <= @l_Date AND 
		Credit > 0 AND 
		AccCode = @AccCode
	GROUP BY AccCode
	ORDER BY AccCode
END
IF @type = 'S'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #lt_amt
	SELECT AccCode, 
		DocumentCode = DocumentType + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(DocumentCode,10))),
		Date, Amount=Credit, Paid=0, DaysOld=DATEDIFF(day, date, @l_date)
	FROM VirtualGL 
	WHERE 	Date <= @l_Date AND 
		Credit > 0 AND AccCode = @AccCode
	ORDER BY AccCode, Date, Credit

	INSERT INTO #lt_pmt
	SELECT AccCode, Amount=SUM(Debit)
	FROM VirtualGL 
	WHERE 	Date <= @l_Date AND 
		Debit > 0 AND AccCode = @AccCode
	GROUP BY AccCode
	ORDER BY AccCode
END

DECLARE C1 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM #lt_amt ORDER BY AccCode, Date, Amount
OPEN C1

FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @AccCode, @DocumentCode, @TDate, @Amt, @Paid, @RowID, @DaysOld
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SELECT @Pmt=ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(Amount, 0) FROM #lt_pmt WHERE AccCode = @AccCode), 0)

	AccCode INT NOT NULL,

)

	AccCode INT NOT NULL,
	Amount Numeric(15,5) Not Null Default 0
)

CREATE TABLE #lt_interval (
	IntervalID INT IDENTITY (0,1) NOT NULL,
	LowerLimit INT Not Null Default 0,
	UpperLimit INT Not Null Default 0
)

SELECT @StartLimit = 0
WHILE @StartLimit <= @limit
BEGIN
	SELECT @EndLimit = @StartLimit + CASE @StartLimit WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE @interval - 1 END
	SELECT @EndLimit = CASE WHEN @EndLimit > @limit THEN @limit ELSE @EndLimit END

	INSERT INTO #lt_interval (LowerLimit, UpperLimit) 
	VALUES (@StartLimit, @EndLimit)

	SELECT @StartLimit = @EndLimit + 1
END

INSERT INTO #lt_interval (LowerLimit, UpperLimit) 
VALUES (@StartLimit, 99999999)

IF @type = 'C'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #lt_amt
	SELECT AccCode, Date, Amount=Debit, Paid=0, DaysOld=DATEDIFF(day, date, @l_date)
	FROM VirtualGL 
	WHERE	Date <= @l_Date AND 
		Debit > 0 AND 
		AccCode IN (SELECT CUSTCODE FROM CUSTOMER)
	ORDER BY AccCode, Date, Debit

	INSERT INTO #lt_pmt
	SELECT AccCode, Amount=SUM(Credit)
	FROM VirtualGL 
	WHERE	Date <= @l_Date AND 
		Credit > 0 AND 
		AccCode IN (SELECT CUSTCODE FROM CUSTOMER)
	GROUP BY AccCode
	ORDER BY AccCode
END
IF @type = 'S'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #lt_amt
	SELECT AccCode, Date, Amount=Credit, Paid=0, DaysOld=DATEDIFF(day, date, @l_date)
	FROM VirtualGL 
	WHERE 	Date <= @l_Date AND 
		Credit > 0 AND AccCode IN (SELECT SUPPCODE FROM SUPPLIER)
	ORDER BY AccCode, Date, Credit

	INSERT INTO #lt_pmt
	SELECT AccCode, Amount=SUM(Debit)
	FROM VirtualGL 
	WHERE 	Date <= @l_Date AND

	ORDER BY AccCode

BEGIN

	BEGIN

		Code1, Name1, Name2, Name3, Name4, Name5, Value1 = SUM(Value1), Code2
	FROM 
		(SELECT  
			Code1=Ar.AreaCode,
			Name1=Ar.Name,
			Name2=Ac.AliasName,
			Name3=Ac.Name,

		FROM Accounts Ac, Area Ar, Customer C, #lt_interval T
		WHERE 	Ac.AccCode = C.CustCode AND
			C.AreaCode = Ar.AreaCode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT  
			Code1=Ar.AreaCode,
			Name1=Ar.Name,
			Name2=Ac.AliasName,
			Name3=Ac.Name,
			Name4=LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.Address1)) + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(C.Address2)), 60),
			Name5=C.Phone,
			Value1 = SUM(Amount-Paid),
			Code2 = (SELECT MAX(LowerLimit) FROM #lt_interval 
				WHERE	l.daysold >= lowerlimit AND
					l.daysold <= upperlimit)
		FROM #lt_amt l, Accounts Ac, Area Ar, Customer C
		WHERE 	l.AccCode = Ac.AccCode AND 
			Ac.AccCode = C.CustCode AND
			C.AreaCode = Ar.AreaCode
		GROUP BY
			Ar.AreaCode,
			Ar.Name,
			Ac.AccCode,
			Ac.Name,
			Ac.AliasName,
			C.Address1,
			C.Address2,
			C.Phone,
			l.DaysOld) T
	GROUP BY Code1, Name1, Name2, Name3, Name4, Name5, Code2
END

IF @type = 'S'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO ReportData (Code1, Name1, Name2, Name3, Name4, Name5, Value1, Code2)
	SELECT  
		Code1,
		Name1,
		Name2,
		Name3,
		Name4,
		Name5,
		Value1=SUM(Value1),
		Code2
	FROM 
		(SELECT  
			Code1=0,
			Name1='All Supplier(s)',
			Name2=Ac.AliasName,
			Name3=Ac.Name,
			Name4=LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(S.Address1)) + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(S.Address2)), 60),
			Name5=S.Phone,
			Value1 = 0.00,
			Code2 = T.Lowerlimit
		FROM Accounts Ac, Supplier S, #lt_interval T
		WHERE 	Ac.AccCode = S.SuppCode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT  
			Code1=0,
			Name1='All Supplier(s)',
			Name2=Ac.AliasName,
			Name3=Ac.Name,
			Name4=LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(S.Address1)) + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(S.Address2)), 60),
			Name5=S.Phone,
			Value1 = SUM(Amount-Paid),
			Code2 = (SELECT MAX(LowerLimit) FROM #lt_interval 
				WHERE	l.daysold >= lowerlimit AND
					l.daysold <= upperlimit)
		FROM #lt_amt l, Accounts Ac, Supplier S
		WHERE 	l.AccCode = Ac.AccCode AND 
			Ac.AccCode = S.SuppCode
		GROUP BY
			Ac.AccCode,
			Ac.Name,
			Ac.AliasName,
			S.Address1,
			S.Address2,
			S.Phone,
			l.DaysOld) T
	GROUP BY Code1, Name1, Name2, Name3, Name4, Name5, Code2
END

UPDATE ReportData 
SET Value1 = ISNULL(
	(SELECT SUM(ISNULL(T.Value1,0)) 
	FROM ReportData T 
	WHERE T.Code2 >= R.Code2 AND T.Code1 = R.Code1 AND 
		T.Name2 = R.Name2 AND
		T.Name3 = R.Name3),0)
FROM ReportData R

DELETE ReportData WHERE Value1 = 0

DROP TABLE #lt_amt
DROP TABLE #lt_pmt
DROP TABLE #lt_interval

-- sp_AgingBasedEPI
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_AgingBasedEPI
	@AreaCode INT,
	@AgeDate DATETIME,
	@AgeLimit INT,
	@CollectionSDate DATETIME,
	@CollectionEDate DATETIME,
	@VochCatList VARCHAR(1000),
	@EPIPerc NUMERIC(10,2) 
AS

/*

Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat

Title:
	Aging Based Early Payment Incentive (EPI)

Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'reportdata' table to be used for 
	an area's customer who have no overdue balance and 
	current balance age is according to @AgeLimit parameter.
	These customer's will be elligible for Early Payment Incentive (EPI)
	determined by the collection amount @discallowed parameter

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@AreaCode INT = Customer Area for which report is required
	@AgeDate DateTime = Cut-off date upto which age is relevent
	@AgeLimit INT = (in days) e.g 30 days 
	@CollectionSDate DATETIME = start date for Collection period under consideration,
	@CollectionEDate DATETIME = end date for Collection period under consideration,,
	@VochCatList VARCHAR(1000) = Comma Separated voucher category list to be considered for EPI,
	@EPIPerc NUMERIC(10,2) = EPI Percentage 
*/


DECLARE @OldAccCode INT
DECLARE @AccCode INT
DECLARE @TDate DateTime
DECLARE @Amt Numeric(15,5)
DECLARE @Paid Numeric(15,5)
DECLARE @RowID INT
DECLARE @Pmt Numeric(15,5)
DECLARE @DaysOld INT
DECLARE @StartLimit INT
DECLARE @EndLimit INT
DECLARE @Tab_VouchCatList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_VouchCatList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@VochCatList, ',')

DELETE REPORTDATA

CREATE TABLE #lt_amt (
	AccCode INT NOT NULL,
	Date DateTime Not Null,
	Amount Numeric(15,5) Not Null Default 0,
	Paid Numeric(15,5) Not Null Default 0,
	RowID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
	DaysOld INT Not Null Default 0
)

CREATE TABLE #lt_pmt (
	AccCode INT NOT NULL,
	Amount Numeric(15,5) Not Null Default 0
)

INSERT INTO #lt_amt
SELECT AccCode, Date, Amount=Debit, Paid=0, DaysOld=DATEDIFF(day, date, @AgeDate)
FROM VirtualGL 
WHERE 
	Date <= @AgeDate AND Debit > 0 AND 
	AccCode IN (SELECT CUSTCODE FROM CUSTOMER WHERE AreaCode = @AreaCode)
ORDER BY AccCode, Date, Debit

INSERT INTO #lt_pmt
SELECT AccCode, Amount=SUM(Credit)
FROM VirtualGL 
WHERE
	Date <= @AgeDate AND Credit > 0 AND 
	AccCode IN (SELECT CUSTCODE FROM CUSTOMER WHERE AreaCode = @AreaCode)
GROUP BY AccCode
ORDER BY AccCode

DECLARE C1 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM #lt_amt
OPEN C1

FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @AccCode, @TDate, @Amt, @Paid, @RowID, @DaysOld
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SELECT @Pmt=ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(Amount, 0) FROM #lt_pmt WHERE AccCode = @AccCode), 0)

	IF @Pmt <> 0
	BEGIN
		UPDATE #lt_amt
		SET Paid = Paid + CASE WHEN @Amt >= @Pmt THEN @Pmt ELSE @Amt END
		WHERE RowID = @RowID
	
		SELECT @Pmt = @Pmt - (SELECT CASE WHEN @Amt >= @Pmt THEN @Pmt ELSE @Amt END)
	
		UPDATE #lt_Pmt
		SET Amount = @Pmt 
		WHERE AccCode = @AccCode
	END

	FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @AccCode, @TDate, @Amt, @Paid, @RowID, @DaysOld

END
CLOSE C1
DEALLOCATE C1

DELETE #lt_amt WHERE Amount - Paid = 0

INSERT INTO ReportData (Code1, Name1, Name2, Name3, Name4, Name5, Value1, Value2, Value3, Value4)
SELECT
	Code1=Ar.AreaCode,
	Name1=Ar.Name,
	Name2=Ac.AliasName,
	Name3=Ac.Name,
	Name4=LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.Address1)) + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(C.Address2)), 60),
	Name5=C.Phone,
	Value1 = AGB.Balance,
	Value2 = AGB.TotBalance,
	Value3 = AGB.Collection,
	Value4 = ROUND(AGB.Collection * @EPIPerc * 0.01, 2)
FROM 
	Accounts Ac, 
	Area Ar, 
	Customer C,
	(SELECT 
		t.AccCode, 
		Balance = ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN t.DaysOld <= @AgeLimit THEN t.Amount - t.Paid ELSE 0 END), 0), 
		TotBalance = ISNULL(SUM(t.Amount - t.Paid), 0),
		Collection = ISNULL(
			(SELECT Collection = ISNULL(SUM(GD.Credit), 0)
			FROM GLDETAIL GD, GLHeader GH
			WHERE GH.Date BETWEEN @CollectionSDate AND @CollectionEDate AND
				GH.VochCatCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_VouchCatList) AND
				GH.GLVochCode = GD.GLVochCode AND
				GD.AccCode = t.AccCode), 0)
	FROM #lt_amt t
	GROUP BY t.AccCode) AGB
WHERE 
	Ac.AccCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.AreaCode = Ar.AreaCode AND
	Ar.AreaCode = @AreaCode AND
	Ac.AccCode = AGB.AccCode AND
	AGB.Balance = AGB.TotBalance AND
	AGB.Balance <> 0 AND
	AGB.TotBalance <> 0 AND
	AGB.Collection <> 0
	
DROP TABLE #lt_amt
DROP TABLE #lt_pmt

-- sp_AgingDetail
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_AgingDetail 
	@Type Char(1), @l_date DATETIME, @interval INT, @limit INT, @Code INT AS

DECLARE @DocCode VARCHAR(15), @Remarks Varchar(100)
DECLARE @OldAccCode INT, @AccCode INT, @RowID INT, @DaysOld INT, @StartLimit INT
DECLARE @EndLimit INT, @CollectionID INT
DECLARE @TDate DateTime, @LastPaymentDate DateTime
DECLARE @Amt Numeric(15,5), @Paid Numeric(15,5), @Pmt Numeric(15,5)

DELETE REPORTDATA

CREATE TABLE #lt_amt (
	DocCode Varchar(15) NOT NULL,
	AccCode INT NOT NULL,
	Date DateTime Not Null,
	Amount Numeric(15,5) Not Null Default 0,
	Paid Numeric(15,5) Not Null Default 0,
	RowID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
	DaysOld INT Not Null Default 0,
	Remarks Varchar(100) NULL,
	LastPaymentDate DateTime Null
)

CREATE TABLE #lt_pmt (
	AccCode INT NOT NULL,
	Date DateTime NOT NULL,
	CollectionID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
	Amount Numeric(15,5) Not Null Default 0
)

CREATE TABLE #lt_interval (
	IntervalID INT IDENTITY (0,1) NOT NULL,
	LowerLimit INT Not Null Default 0,
	UpperLimit INT Not Null Default 0
)

SELECT @StartLimit = 0
WHILE @StartLimit <= @limit
BEGIN
	
	SELECT @EndLimit = @StartLimit + CASE @StartLimit WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE @interval - 1 END
	SELECT @EndLimit = CASE WHEN @EndLimit > @limit THEN @limit ELSE @EndLimit END

	INSERT INTO #lt_interval (LowerLimit, UpperLimit) 
	VALUES (@StartLimit, @EndLimit)

	SELECT @StartLimit = @EndLimit + 1
END

INSERT INTO #lt_interval (LowerLimit, UpperLimit) 
VALUES (@StartLimit, 99999999)

IF @type = 'C'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #lt_amt
	SELECT DocCode=RTRIM(LTRIM(DocumentType)) + '-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DocumentCode))), 
		AccCode, Date, Amount=Debit, Paid=0, DaysOld=DATEDIFF(day, date, @l_date), Remarks,
		LastPaymentDate=NULL
	FROM VirtualGL 
	WHERE	Date <= @l_Date AND 
		Debit > 0 AND 
		AccCode = @Code
	ORDER BY AccCode, Date, DaysOld DESC, Debit

	INSERT INTO #lt_pmt (AccCode, Date, Amount)
	SELECT AccCode, Date, Amount=Credit
	FROM VirtualGL 
	WHERE
		Date <= @l_Date AND 
		Credit > 0 AND 
		AccCode = @Code
	ORDER BY AccCode, Date
END
IF @type = 'S'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #lt_amt
	SELECT DocCode=RTRIM(LTRIM(DocumentType)) + '-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DocumentCode))), 
		AccCode, Date, Amount=Credit, Paid=0, DaysOld=DATEDIFF(day, date, @l_date), Remarks,
		LastPaymentDate=NULL
	FROM VirtualGL 
	WHERE 	Date <= @l_Date AND 
		Credit > 0 AND AccCode  = @Code
	ORDER BY AccCode, Date, DaysOld DESC, Credit

	INSERT INTO #lt_pmt (AccCode, Date, Amount)
	SELECT AccCode, Date, Amount=Debit
	FROM VirtualGL 
	WHERE 	Date <= @l_Date AND 
		Debit > 0 AND AccCode  = @Code
	ORDER BY AccCode, Date
END

DECLARE c_pay CURSOR FOR SELECT CollectionId, Amount FROM #lt_pmt
OPEN c_pay

FETCH NEXT FROM c_pay INTO @CollectionID, @pmt
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	DECLARE c_topay CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM #lt_amt WHERE Amount - Paid <> 0
	OPEN c_topay

	FETCH NEXT FROM c_topay INTO @DocCode, @AccCode, @TDate, @Amt, @Paid, @RowID, @DaysOld, @Remarks, @LastPaymentDate
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SELECT @Pmt=ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(Amount, 0) FROM #lt_pmt WHERE CollectionID = @CollectionID), 0)
		SELECT @LastPaymentDate=(SELECT Date FROM #lt_pmt WHERE CollectionID = @CollectionID)
	
		IF @Pmt <> 0
		BEGIN
			UPDATE #lt_amt
			SET Paid = Paid + CASE WHEN (@Amt - @Paid) >= @Pmt THEN @Pmt ELSE @Amt - @Paid END
			WHERE RowID = @RowID
		
			SELECT @Pmt = @Pmt - (SELECT CASE WHEN (@Amt - @Paid) >= @Pmt THEN @Pmt ELSE @Amt - @Paid END)
		
			UPDATE #lt_Pmt
			SET Amount = @Pmt 
			WHERE AccCode = @AccCode AND CollectionID = @CollectionID
	
			UPDATE #lt_amt
			SET LastPaymentDate = @LastPaymentDate
			WHERE RowID = @RowID AND Paid > 0

			UPDATE #lt_amt
			SET DaysOld=DATEDIFF(day, date, @LastPaymentDate)
			WHERE RowID = @RowID AND Amount - Paid = 0

			IF @Pmt = 0 BREAK
		END
		ELSE BREAK
		FETCH NEXT FROM c_topay INTO @DocCode, @AccCode, @TDate, @Amt, @Paid, @RowID, @DaysOld, @Remarks, @LastPaymentDate
	END
	CLOSE c_topay
	DEALLOCATE c_topay

	FETCH NEXT FROM c_pay INTO @CollectionID, @pmt
END
CLOSE c_pay
DEALLOCATE c_pay

/*DELETE #lt_amt WHERE Amount - Paid = 0*/

IF @type = 'C'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO ReportData (Name1, Name2, Name3, Date1, Value1, Value2, Value3, Code2, Code3, Name4, Name5, Name6, Date2)
	SELECT  
		Name1=Ac.AliasName,
		Name2=Ac.Name,
		Name3=l.DocCode,
		Date1=l.Date,
		Value1 = Amount,
		Value2 = Paid,
		Value3 = Amount-Paid,
		Code2 = l.daysold/*CASE Amount-Paid WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE l.daysold END*/,
		Code3 = (SELECT MAX(LowerLimit) FROM #lt_interval 
				WHERE	l.daysold >= lowerlimit AND
					l.daysold <= upperlimit),
		Name4=l.Remarks,
		Name5=LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.Address1)) + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(C.Address2)), 60),
		Name6=C.Phone,
		Date2 = l.LastPaymentDate
	FROM #lt_amt l, Accounts Ac, Area Ar, Customer C
	WHERE 	l.AccCode = Ac.AccCode AND 
		Ac.AccCode = C.CustCode AND
		C.AreaCode = Ar.AreaCode
END

IF @type = 'S'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO ReportData (Name1, Name2, Name3, Date1, Value1, Value2, Value3, Code2, Code3, Name4, Name5, Name6, Date2)
	SELECT  
		Name1='',
		Name2=Ac.Name,
		Name3=l.DocCode,
		Date=l.Date,
		Value1 = Amount,
		Value2 = Paid,
		Value3 = Amount-Paid,
		Code2 = l.daysold/*CASE Amount-Paid WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE l.daysold END*/,
		Code3 = (SELECT MAX(LowerLimit) FROM #lt_interval 
				WHERE	l.daysold >= lowerlimit AND
					l.daysold <= upperlimit),
		Name4=l.Remarks,
		Name5=LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(S.Address1)) + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(S.Address2)), 60),
		Name6=S.Phone,
		Date2 = l.LastPaymentDate
	FROM #lt_amt l, Accounts Ac, Supplier S
	WHERE 	l.AccCode = Ac.AccCode AND 
		Ac.AccCode = S.SuppCode
END

DROP TABLE #lt_amt
DROP TABLE #lt_pmt
DROP TABLE #lt_interval

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SELECT @Pmt=ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(Amount, 0) FROM #lt_pmt WHERE AccCode = @AccCode AND CollectionID = @CollectionID), 0)
		SELECT @LastPaymentDate=(SELECT Date FROM #lt_pmt WHERE AccCode = @AccCode AND CollectionID = @CollectionID)
	
		IF @Pmt <> 0
		BEGIN
			UPDATE #lt_amt
			SET Paid = Paid + CASE WHEN (@Amt - @Paid) >= @Pmt THEN @Pmt ELSE @Amt - @Paid END
			WHERE RowID = @RowID
		
			SELECT @Pmt = @Pmt - (SELECT CASE WHEN (@Amt - @Paid) >= @Pmt THEN @Pmt ELSE @Amt - @Paid END)
		
			UPDATE #lt_Pmt
			SET Amount = @Pmt 
			WHERE AccCode = @AccCode AND CollectionID = @CollectionID
	
			UPDATE #lt_amt
			SET LastPaymentDate = @LastPaymentDate
			WHERE RowID = @RowID AND Paid > 0

			UPDATE #lt_amt
			SET DaysOld=DATEDIFF(day, date, @LastPaymentDate)
			WHERE RowID = @RowID AND Amount - Paid = 0

			IF @Pmt = 0 BREAK
		END
		ELSE BREAK
		FETCH NEXT FROM c_topay INTO @DocCode, @AccCode2, @TDate, @Amt, @Paid, @RowID, @DaysOld, @Remarks, @LastPaymentDate
	END
	CLOSE c_topay
	DEALLOCATE c_topay

	FETCH NEXT FROM c_pay INTO @AccCode, @CollectionID, @pmt
END
CLOSE c_pay
DEALLOCATE c_pay

/*DELETE #lt_amt WHERE Amount - Paid = 0*/

INSERT INTO ReportData (Name1, Name2, Name3, Date1, Value1, Value2, Value3, Code2, Code3, Name4, Name5, Name6, Date2, Name7)
SELECT  
	Name1=Ac.AliasName,
	Name2=Ac.Name,
	Name3=l.DocCode,
	Date1=l.Date,
	Value1 = Amount,
	Value2 = Paid,
	Value3 = Amount-Paid,
	Code2 = l.daysold/*CASE Amount-Paid WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE l.daysold END*/,
	Code3 = (SELECT MAX(LowerLimit) FROM #lt_interval 
			WHERE	l.daysold >= lowerlimit AND
				l.daysold <= upperlimit),
	Name4=l.Remarks,
	Name5=LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.Address1)) + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(C.Address2)), 60),
	Name6=C.Phone,
	Date2 = l.LastPaymentDate,
	Name7 = (SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesManCode = C.SalesManCode)
FROM #lt_amt l, Accounts Ac, Area Ar, Customer C
WHERE 	l.AccCode = Ac.AccCode AND 
	Ac.AccCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.AreaCode = Ar.AreaCode


DROP TABLE #lt_amt
DROP TABLE #lt_pmt
DROP TABLE #lt_interval

-- SP_AllocateSaleReturn
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_AllocateSaleReturn @SRInvCode INT, @SaleInvCode INT, @UserCode SMALLINT, @SRAllocationCode INT OUTPUT
AS

DECLARE @retcode INT, @code INT, @unpostedtrans INT, @null INT, @Err Int
DECLARE @Sale_Balance NUMERIC(15, 2), @SR_Balance NUMERIC(15, 2), @amt NUMERIC(15, 2), @New_Sale_Balance NUMERIC(15, 2), @New_SR_Balance NUMERIC(15, 2)
DECLARE @posted char(1)
DECLARE @msg VARCHAR(1000), @title VARCHAR(1000)
DECLARE @date DATETIME

SET @NULL = null
SET @retcode = 0
SET @Date = GETDATE()
SET @retcode = -1
SET @POSTED='Y'
EXEC @retcode = SP_CheckUnpostedSaleInvInTransactions @SaleInvCode, @SRInvCode, 'SR', @unpostedtrans, @msg
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @retcode <> 0 
BEGIN
	RaisError('Error occured while checking unposted transaction for sale invoice : %d',16,1,  @SaleInvCode)
	RETURN -1
END

IF @unpostedtrans <= 0
BEGIN
	RaisError(@msg ,16,1)
	RETURN -1
END

EXEC @retcode = SP_GetSRInvBalance @SRInvCode, @SR_Balance OUTPUT
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @retcode <> 0 
BEGIN
	RaisError('Error occured while fetching balance for sale return invoice : %d',16,1,  @SRInvCode)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @SR_Balance = isnull(@SR_Balance, 0)

IF @SR_Balance < 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('There exists no balance for sale return invoice : %d',16,1,  @SRInvCode)
	RETURN -1
END

IF @SR_Balance = 0
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END

EXEC @retcode = SP_GetSaleInvBalance @SaleInvCode, @Sale_Balance OUTPUT
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @retcode <> 0 
BEGIN
	RaisError('Error occured while fetching balance for sale invoice : %d',16,1,  @SaleInvCode)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @Sale_Balance = isnull(@Sale_Balance, 0)

IF @Sale_Balance < 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('There exists no balance for sale invoice : %d',16,1,  @SaleInvCode)
	RETURN -1
END

IF @Sale_Balance = 0
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END

IF @Sale_Balance <= @SR_Balance
	SET @amt = isnull(@Sale_Balance, 0)
ELSE
	SET @amt = isnull(@SR_Balance, 0)

SET @AMT = ISNULL(@AMT, 0)
SET @New_Sale_Balance = isnull(@Sale_Balance,0) - isnull(@amt,0)
SET @New_SR_Balance = ISNULL(@SR_Balance, 0) - ISNULL(@amt,0)

EXEC @retcode = SP_UpdateSRInvBalance @SRInvCode, @New_SR_Balance OUTPUT
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @retcode <> 0 
BEGIN
	RaisError('Error occured while updating balance for sale return invoice : %d',16,1,  @SRInvCode)
	RETURN -1
END

EXEC @retcode = SP_UpdateSaleInvBalance @SaleInvCode, @New_Sale_Balance OUTPUT
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @retcode <> 0 
BEGIN
	RaisError('Error occured while updating balance for sale invoice : %d',16,1,  @SaleInvCode)
	RETURN -1
END

EXEC @retcode = SP_CreateSRAllocation @srinvcode, @saleinvcode, @date, @usercode, @posted, @date, @sale_balance, @amt, @code OUTPUT
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @retcode <> 0 
BEGIN
	RaisError('Error occured while Creating Sale Return Allocation for sale invoice : %d',16,1,  @SaleInvCode)
	RETURN -1
END

IF @code > 0
	SET @SRAllocationCode  = @code

RETURN 0

-- SP_Apply_SaleAmt_Based_DiscountPolicy
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_Apply_SaleAmt_Based_DiscountPolicy @InvAmount NUMERIC(15, 2), @DiscPerc NUMERIC(5,2) OUTPUT
AS

SET @DiscPerc=0.00

IF @InvAmount IS NULL
	SET @InvAmount=0.00

IF DBO.Fn_GetPreference('ApplySaleInvoiceDiscountPolicyOnSaving') = 'N'
	RETURN 0

SET @DiscPerc = 
	(SELECT D.DiscPerc
	FROM SalesDiscountPolicy D,
		(SELECT SaleLimit=MIN(SaleLimit) 
		FROM SalesDiscountPolicy 
		WHERE SaleLimit >= @InvAmount
		UNION
		SELECT SaleLimit=MAX(SaleLimit) 
		FROM SalesDiscountPolicy 
		WHERE SaleLimit <= @InvAmount) T
	WHERE 
		D.SaleLimit = T.SaleLimit AND
		T.SaleLimit <= @InvAmount)

IF @DiscPerc IS NULL OR @DiscPerc < 0
	SET @DiscPerc = 0
RETURN 0

-- SP_Apply_StudentFine_On_UnpaidInvoices
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_Apply_StudentFine_On_UnpaidInvoices
	@FineAmt NUMERIC(10,2), @StartDate DATETIME, @EndDate DATETIME, @ServiceInvTypeCode SMALLINT, @ExcludePartialPaid CHAR(1)
AS

IF @ExcludePartialPaid='Y'
BEGIN
	DELETE VirtualGL
	WHERE DocumentType = 'RS' AND 
		DocumentCode IN 
			(SELECT ServiceInvCode 
			FROM ServiceHeader 
			WHERE OutstandingAmt = InvTotal AND Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND ServiceInvTypeCode = @ServiceInvTypeCode)

	UPDATE ServiceHeader 
	SET MiscCharges = @FineAmt
	WHERE OutstandingAmt = InvTotal AND Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND ServiceInvTypeCode = @ServiceInvTypeCode

	UPDATE ServiceHeader
	SET InvTotal = ISNULL(dbo.Fn_GetServiceInvTotal(ServiceInvCode), 0),
	OutstandingAmt = ISNULL(dbo.Fn_GetServiceInvTotal(ServiceInvCode), 0) - (InvTotal - OutStandingAmt)
	WHERE OutstandingAmt = InvTotal AND Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND ServiceInvTypeCode = @ServiceInvTypeCode
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	DELETE VirtualGL
	WHERE DocumentType = 'RS' AND 
		DocumentCode IN 
			(SELECT ServiceInvCode 
			FROM ServiceHeader 
			WHERE OutstandingAmt > 0 AND Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND ServiceInvTypeCode = @ServiceInvTypeCode)

	UPDATE ServiceHeader 
	SET MiscCharges = @FineAmt
	WHERE OutstandingAmt > 0 AND Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND ServiceInvTypeCode = @ServiceInvTypeCode

	UPDATE ServiceHeader
	SET InvTotal = ISNULL(dbo.Fn_GetServiceInvTotal(ServiceInvCode), 0),
	OutstandingAmt = ISNULL(dbo.Fn_GetServiceInvTotal(ServiceInvCode), 0) - (InvTotal - OutStandingAmt)
	WHERE OutstandingAmt > 0 AND Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND ServiceInvTypeCode = @ServiceInvTypeCode
END

EXECUTE SP_VirtualGL 'A'

-- SP_ApplySalePromotions
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_ApplySalePromotions
AS

-- Revert To Item Disc % 1 by default
UPDATE Customer SET DefaultItemDiscPerc = 1
WHERE CustCode IN 
	(SELECT DISTINCT D.CustCode 
	FROM SalePromotion SP, CustomerGroupDetail D, Customer C
	WHERE 
		SP.CustomerGroupCode IS NOT NULL AND 
		SP.CustomerGroupCode = D.CustomerGroupCode AND
		D.CustCode = C.CustCode)

-- Now Apply active sale promotions to concerned customers as per date/day of week
UPDATE Customer
SET DefaultItemDiscPerc = SP.DefaultItemDiscPerc
FROM SalePromotion SP, CustomerGroupDetail D, Customer C
WHERE 
	SP.Active = 'Y' AND 
	GetDate() BETWEEN SP.StartDate AND SP.EndDate AND
	SP.CustomerGroupCode IS NOT NULL AND 
	(SP.WeekDayCode = 0 OR SP.WeekDayCode = DATEPART(weekday, GetDate())) AND
	SP.CustomerGroupCode = D.CustomerGroupCode AND
	D.CustCode = C.CustCode

-- Revert To Item Disc % 1 by default if sale promotion is expired
UPDATE Customer
SET DefaultItemDiscPerc = 1
FROM SalePromotion SP, CustomerGroupDetail D, Customer C
WHERE 
	SP.Active = 'Y' AND 
	NOT (GetDate() BETWEEN SP.StartDate AND SP.EndDate) AND
	SP.CustomerGroupCode IS NOT NULL AND 
	SP.CustomerGroupCode = D.CustomerGroupCode AND
	D.CustCode = C.CustCode

		BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE PurOrderDetail
			SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO DBO.' + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @FROM + @TableName + ' WHERE POCode NOT IN (SELECT T.POCode FROM DBO.PurOrderHeader T)' 
		END
		IF @TableName = 'StockLedger'
		BEGIN
			SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO DBO.' + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @FROM + @TableName + ' WHERE UTN NOT IN (SELECT T.UTN FROM DBO.StockLedger T)' 
		END
		IF @TableName = 'ActivityMonitor'
		BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE ActivityMonitor
			SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO DBO.' + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @FROM + @TableName
		END
		IF @TableName = 'CashierJob'
		BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE CashierActivity
			SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO DBO.' + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @FROM + @TableName + ' WHERE CashierJobCode NOT IN (SELECT T.CashierJobCode FROM DBO.CashierJob T)' 
		END
		IF @TableName = 'SaleLedger' OR @TableName = 'SaleLedgerLog'
		BEGIN
			SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO DBO.' + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + REPLACE(@List, 'SRBufferInvCode', 'SRBufferInvCode=NULL') + @FROM + @TableName + ' WHERE SaleInvCode NOT IN (SELECT T.SaleInvCode FROM DBO.SaleLedger T)' 
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF @Synchronize='Y'
		BEGIN
			IF @TableName = 'PurLedger'
			BEGIN
				SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO DBO.' + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @FROM + @TableName + ' WHERE Posted=''Y'''
			END
			IF @TableName = 'PurDetail'
			BEGIN
				SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO DBO.' + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @FROM + @TableName + ' WHERE PurInvCode NOT IN (SELECT PurInvCode ' + @FROM + 'PurLedger WHERE Posted=''N''' + ')'
			END
			IF @TableName = 'PurExp'
			BEGIN
				SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO DBO.' + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @FROM + @TableName + ' WHERE PurInvCode NOT IN (SELECT PurInvCode ' + @FROM + 'PurLedger WHERE Posted=''N''' + ')'
			END
			IF @TableName <> 'PurLedger' AND @TableName <> 'PurDetail' AND @TableName <> 'PurExp'
			BEGIN
				SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO DBO.' + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @FROM + @TableName
			END
			IF @TableName = 'PurPayment'
			BEGIN
				SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO DBO.' + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @FROM + @TableName + ' WHERE Posted=''Y'''
			END
		END
	END
	EXECUTE (@Qry)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @TableName)
		CLOSE C1
		DEALLOCATE C1
		RETURN -1
	END 

	FETCH NEXT FROM C1
	INTO @RowID, @TableName, @Synchronize
END
CLOSE C1
DEALLOCATE C1
SET @TableName = 'VirtualGl'
SET @QRY = 'TRUNCATE TABLE DBO.VirtualGl'
EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Data Truncation: Error Truncating %s ', 16, 1, @TableName)
	RETURN -1
END 

SET @TableName = 'GodownDetail'
SET @QRY = 'TRUNCATE TABLE DBO.GodownDetail'
EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Data Truncation: Error Truncating %s ', 16, 1, @TableName)
	RETURN -1
END 

SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO DBO.GodownDetail SELECT * ' + @FROM + @TableName
EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @TableName)
	RETURN -1
END 
INSERT INTO DataImportLog (LogDate, ImportedBy, ImportType, Remarks)
VALUES (GetDate(), 1, 'Trans. Acquired', 'Data Import')

RETURN 0

name: SP_AreaWise_ComparativeMonthSales
definition:
-- SP_AreaWise_ComparativeMonthSales
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_AreaWise_ComparativeMonthSales
	@StartMonth INT, 
	@StartYear INT, 
	@ReportGrouping CHAR(1), 
	@GroupList VARCHAR(8000) AS
/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of
	months and groups selected depending upon the grouping criteria selected (manfufacture, itemcategory, packing, class wise)

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@StartMonth = Start Month
	@StartYear = Start year
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items in report
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
*/

DELETE ReportData

DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

DECLARE @Tab_DateSlab TABLE (DateID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1), M INT, Date DATETIME, CDate VARCHAR(20))

DECLARE @TempDate DATETIME, @OldDate DATETIME, @NewDate DATETIME, @StartDate DATETIME, @EndDate DATETIME, @MinDate DATETIME, @MaxDate DATETIME, @FirstNewDate DATETIME
DECLARE @Counter INT, @EndMonth INT, @EndYear INT

SET @StartDate =(SELECT MIN(Date) + 10 FROM dbo.udf_DaysOfMonthList(@StartMonth, @StartYear))
SET @EndMonth = MONTH(@StartDate + 360)
SET @EndYear = YEAR(@StartDate + 360)
SET @EndDate   = (SELECT MAX(Date) FROM dbo.udf_DaysOfMonthList(@EndMonth, @EndYear))

SET @Counter = 0
SET @FirstNewDate = CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@StartMonth))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@StartYear))) AS DATETIME)

WHILE @Counter <= 11
BEGIN
	SET @NewDate = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(@StartDate + (30 * @Counter))))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(@StartDate + (30 * @Counter)))))
	SET @OldDate = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(@NewDate - 360)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(@NewDate - 360))))
	INSERT INTO @Tab_DateSlab (M, Date, CDate)
	SELECT MONTH(@OldDate), @OldDate, DATENAME(m, @OldDate) + ' - ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(DATENAME(yyyy, @OldDate))))

	INSERT INTO @Tab_DateSlab (M, Date, CDate)
	SELECT MONTH(@NewDate), @NewDate, DATENAME(m, @NewDate) + ' - ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(DATENAME(yyyy, @NewDate))))
	SET @Counter = @Counter + 1
END

SET @MinDate = (SELECT MIN(Date) FROM @Tab_DateSlab)
SET @MaxDate = (SELECT MAX(Date) FROM @Tab_DateSlab)

--SELECT * FROM @Tab_DateSlab

INSERT INTO ReportData (Name1, Name2, Name3, Name4, Name5, Code1, Name6, Name7, Value1)
SELECT 
	Area = AR.Name, 
	Customer = A.Name,
	Address = C.Address1,
	City = C.City,
	SaleCategory = CASE WHEN S.SaleCatCode = 3 OR S.SaleCatCode = 1 THEN 'CASH' ELSE 'CREDIT' END,
	Month= MONTH(S.Date),
	Date = DATENAME(m, S.Date) + ' - ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(DATENAME(yyyy, S.Date)))),
	Category = (SELECT CC.Name FROM CustomerCategory CC WHERE CC.CustCatCode=C.CustCatCode),
	SaleValue = ISNULL(SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - S.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 0)
FROM SaleLedger S, SaleDetail D, Item I, @Tab_ItemList T, Customer C, Accounts A, Area AR
WHERE 
	S.Date BETWEEN @MinDate AND @MaxDate AND
	S.SaleInvCode=D.SaleInvCode AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode AND
	I.ICode = T.Code AND
	S.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	C.AreaCode = AR.AreaCode
GROUP BY
	S.Date,
	S.SaleCatCode,
	A.Name,
	C.Address1,
	C.City,
	C.CustCatCode,
	AR.Name
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	Area = (SELECT MIN(AR.Name) FROM Area AR), 
	Customer = (SELECT MIN(A.Name) FROM Accounts A), 
	Address = '',
	City = '',
	SaleCategory = 'CASH',
	M = MONTH(Date),
	Date = CDate,
	Category = '',
	SaleValue = 0
FROM @Tab_DateSlab

name: SP_AREAWISESALES
definition:
-- SP_AREAWISESALES
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_AREAWISESALES @StartDate datetime, @EndDate datetime, @RegionCode smallint, @ReportGrouping CHAR(1), @GroupList VARCHAR(8000), @ZeroRows TinyInt, @Pricetype TinyInt, @IncludeBonus INT, @IncludeReturns INT AS
/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of a
	region's all areas (specified by a parameter @regioncode) 
	and items selected depending upon the grouping criteria selected.

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@startdate, @enddate = Determine the period of report
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items in report
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
	@ZeroRows = 1 include rows with zero net sales and 0 for otherwise
	@Pricetype = 1 stands for Actual Price, 2 stands for Sale/Trade Price, 3 stands for Purchase price and 4 stands for Average price
	@IncludeBonus = 0 stands for not to include bonus in saleqty or 1 to include
	@IncludeReturns = 0 stands for not to include returns in saleqty or 1 to include
*/

DELETE ReportData

DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

INSERT INTO ReportData (code1, code2, code3, code4, name1, name2, name3, name4, name5, value1, value2)
SELECT	Code1=S.ICODE,
	Code2=S.AREACODE, 
	Code3=S.REGIONCODE, 
	Code4=CASE @ReportGrouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN I.MANFCODE
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
		ELSE I.PACKCODE END,
	Name1=I.NAME,
	Name2=(SELECT SHORTNAME FROM AREA WHERE AREACODE = S.AREACODE),
	Name3=(SELECT NAME FROM REGION WHERE REGIONCODE = S.REGIONCODE),
	Name4=CASE @ReportGrouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
		WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
		WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
		ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,
	Name5=I.CUSTOMICODE,
	Value1= SUM(S.QTY),
	Value2 = ISNULL(SUM(
		CASE @Pricetype WHEN 1 THEN S.NETAMT 
		WHEN 2 THEN S.QTY * ROUND(I.SALEPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
		WHEN 3 THEN S.QTY * ROUND(I.PURPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
		ELSE S.QTY * ROUND(I.AVGPRICE, 2) END), 0)
FROM 
	(SELECT INVNO=0, 
		I.ICODE, 
		QTY = 0,
		NETAMT=0,
		A.AREACODE,
		A.REGIONCODE
	FROM AREA A, (SELECT ICODE = MIN(Code) FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	WHERE 	
		A.REGIONCODE = @RegionCode AND CASE @ZeroRows WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END = 1
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=0, 
		I.CODE, 
		QTY = 0,
		NETAMT=0,
		A.AREACODE,
		@RegionCode
	FROM (SELECT AREACODE=MIN(AREACODE) FROM AREA WHERE REGIONCODE = @RegionCode) A,
		(SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	WHERE 	
		CASE @ZeroRows WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END = 1
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=SL.SALEINVCODE, 
		SD.ICODE, 
		QTY = Sum(SD.looseqty + CASE @IncludeBonus WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE SD.bonusqty END),
		NETAMT=Round(SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)), 2),
		C.AREACODE,
		A.REGIONCODE
	FROM SALELEDGER SL, SALEDETAIL SD, CUSTOMER C, AREA A
	WHERE 	
		A.REGIONCODE = @RegionCode AND
		A.AREACODE = C.AREACODE AND
		C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND 
		SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND 
		SL.DATE >= @startdate AND SL.DATE <= @enddate AND
		SD.ICode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
	GROUP BY 
		SL.SaleInvCode,
		SD.ICODE,
		SL.CustCode,
		A.REGIONCODE, 
		C.AREACODE,
		SL.DiscPerc
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=SL.SALEINVCODE, 
		SD.ICODE, 
		QTY = Sum(SD.looseqty + CASE @IncludeBonus WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE SD.bonusqty END),
		NETAMT=Round(SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)), 2),
		C.AREACODE,
		A.REGIONCODE
	FROM SALELEDGER SL, SALEINVDETAIL SD, CUSTOMER C, AREA A
	WHERE 	
		SL.ImpactInventory='N' AND
		A.REGIONCODE = @RegionCode AND
		A.AREACODE = C.AREACODE AND
		C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND 
		SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND 
		SL.DATE >= @startdate AND SL.DATE <= @enddate AND
		SD.ICode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
	GROUP BY 
		SL.SaleInvCode,
		SD.ICODE,
		SL.CustCode,
		A.REGIONCODE, 
		C.AREACODE,
		SL.DiscPerc
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 	INVNO=SL.SRINVCODE, 
		SD.ICODE, 
		QTY = -Sum(SD.looseqty + CASE @IncludeBonus WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE SD.bonusqty END),
		- Round( sum( (SD.looseqty * SD.srprice) *
			    (1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * 
			    (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)), 2) AS NETAMT,
		C.AREACODE,
		A.REGIONCODE
	FROM SRLEDGER SL, SRDETAIL SD, CUSTOMER C, AREA A
	WHERE 	
		@IncludeReturns = 1 AND
		A.REGIONCODE = @RegionCode AND
		A.AREACODE = C.AREACODE AND
		C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND 
		SL.SRINVCODE = SD.SRINVCODE AND 
		SL.DATE >= @startdate AND SL.DATE <= @enddate AND
		SD.ICode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
	GROUP BY 
		SL.SRINVCODE,
		SD.ICODE, 
		SL.CustCode,
		SL.DiscPerc,
		A.REGIONCODE, 
		C.AREACODE) S, ITEM I
WHERE S.ICode = I.ICode
GROUP BY 
	S.REGIONCODE, 
	S.AREACODE,
	S.ICODE,
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.ICatCode,
	I.ManfCode,
	I.ICCode,
	I.PackCode

CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_AutoCreateCustomerGodown

	End
	SET @GCode = @Code
END

INSERT INTO DBO.Godown (GCode, Name, Location, GodownGroupCode) VALUES (@GCode, @Name, @Name, 1)

IF @@Error <> 0
Begin
	RaisError( 'Error inserting record into Account Godown. Name : %s' ,16,1,  @Name)
	RETURN -1
End
RETURN 0

-- SP_AutoDataMigration
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_AutoDataMigration
As    
DECLARE @rt_code INT, @errorno int, @rowsaffected int, @inv_posted_age INT
DECLARE @PrevSaleHistory VARCHAR(100), @SaleDump VARCHAR(100), @PurDump VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @StartDate DATETIME, @EndDate DATETIME
DECLARE @dbname VarChar(150), @Svr VARCHAR(100), @PKTFile VARCHAR(4000), @DM_DB VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @dbcount INT

SET @Svr = @@ServerName
SET @DM_DB = 'DataMigrationTempDB'
Select @dbcount = count(*) 
From master..Sysdatabases
Where lower(name) like '%databasev%'

IF @dbcount > 0 
	Begin
	Declare db_cursor SCROLL Cursor For 
		Select name 
		From master..Sysdatabases
		Where lower(name) like '%databasev%'
		order by name
	FOR Read Only 
	OPEN db_cursor

	Fetch Last From db_cursor
	INTO @dbname
	
	IF @@Fetch_Status <> 0 
		Select @dbname = name FROM master..Sysdatabases Where lower(name) like '%database%'
	CLOSE db_cursor
	DEALLOCATE db_cursor
	END		
ELSE
	Select @dbname = name FROM master..Sysdatabases Where lower(name) like '%database%'

SET @PrevSaleHistory = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('SaveSaleHistoryBeforeMigration')
SET @PurDump = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('PreparePurDumpBeforeMigration')
SET @SaleDump = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('PrepareSaleDumpBeforeMigration')
SET @StartDate = GETDATE() - 90
SET @EndDate = GETDATE()

BEGIN TRANSACTION MyTrans
Execute @rt_code = DBO.SP_CopySBufferToSales
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
Begin
	RAISERROR('Error Moving Sale From Buffer to Sale Ledger' ,16, 1)
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION MyTrans
	RETURN -1
End
ELSE
BEGIN
	COMMIT TRANSACTION MyTrans
END

BEGIN TRANSACTION MyTrans
Execute @rt_code = DBO.SP_PostTransactionsBeforeAutoMigration
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
BEGIN
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION MyTrans
	RETURN -1
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	COMMIT TRANSACTION MyTrans
END

IF @PurDump = 'Y'
BEGIN
	BEGIN TRANSACTION MyTrans
	Execute @rt_code = DBO.SP_CopyInvoicesToPurLedgerMod @rowsaffected OUTPUT
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	Begin
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION MyTrans
		RETURN -1
	End
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		COMMIT TRANSACTION MyTrans
	END
END

IF @SaleDump = 'Y'
BEGIN
	BEGIN TRANSACTION MyTrans
	Execute @rt_code = DBO.SP_CopyInvoicesToSaleDump @rowsaffected OUTPUT
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	Begin
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION MyTrans
		RETURN -1
	End
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		COMMIT TRANSACTION MyTrans
	END
END

IF @PrevSaleHistory = 'Y'
BEGIN
	BEGIN TRANSACTION MyTrans
	Execute @rt_code = DBO.SP_Get_PreviousSaleHistory_OnArchival @StartDate, @EndDate
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	Begin
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION MyTrans
		RETURN -1
	End
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		COMMIT TRANSACTION MyTrans
	END
END

Execute @rt_code =DBO.SP_PrepareDataMigrationPacket @Svr, @DBName, @PKTFile OUTPUT
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
Begin
	RAISERROR('Error Preparing Data Migration Packet' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1
End

Execute @rt_code=DBO.SP_VerifyDataMigrationPacket @PKTFile, @DM_DB, @Svr
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
Begin
	RAISERROR('Error Verifying Data Migration Packet' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1
End

BEGIN TRANSACTION MyTrans
Execute @rt_code=DBO.SP_DeletePostedTransactions
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
Begin
	RAISERROR('Error Verifying Data Migration Packet' ,16, 1)
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION MyTrans
	RETURN -1
End
ELSE
BEGIN
	COMMIT TRANSACTION MyTrans
END
RETURN 0

-- SP_AutoDoctorTokenReset
CREATE   PROCEDURE DBO.SP_AutoDoctorTokenReset
AS
-- Author : Muhammad Azhar Inayat
-- Reset All Doctor Tokens to respective counters
UPDATE Doctors 
SET LastTokenNo = ISNULL(T.tokenNo, 0)
FROM
	(SELECT SH.DoctCode, TokenNo=ISNULL(MAX(SH.tokenNo), 0) + 1
	FROM ServiceHeader SH, Doctors D
	WHERE SH.Date BETWEEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) + ' 23:59:59' AS DATETIME)
	GROUP BY SH.DoctCode
	UNION
	SELECT VA.DoctCode, TokenNo=ISNULL(MAX(VA.tokenNo), 0) + 1
	FROM VisitAppointment VA, Doctors D
	WHERE VA.DueDate BETWEEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) + ' 23:59:59' AS DATETIME)
	GROUP BY VA.DoctCode
	UNION
	SELECT D.DoctCode, TokenNo=0
	FROM Doctors D
	WHERE D.DoctCode NOT IN 
		(SELECT VA.DoctCode
		FROM VisitAppointment VA
		WHERE VA.DueDate BETWEEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) + ' 23:59:59' AS DATETIME)
		GROUP BY VA.DoctCode
		UNION
		SELECT SH.DoctCode
		FROM ServiceHeader SH
		WHERE SH.Date BETWEEN CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) + ' 23:59:59' AS DATETIME)
		GROUP BY SH.DoctCode)) T
WHERE Doctors.DoctCode=T.DoctCode
