-- SP_AutoGenerateIssueReqForConsumableItem
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_AutoGenerateIssueReqForConsumableItem @ServiceInvCode INT, @UserCode SMALLINT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
IF @ServiceInvCode IS NULL
	RETURN 0

IF (SELECT DBO.Fn_GetPreference('generate_issuereq_for_consumableitem_onservicepost')) = 'N'
	RETURN 0

DECLARE @Posted CHAR(1), @Price NUMERIC(12,2)

IF @ServiceInvCode IS NULL
	RETURN 0

SET @Posted = ISNULL((SELECT Posted FROM ServiceHeader WHERE ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode), 'N')
IF @Posted = 'N' OR @Posted IS NULL
	RETURN 0

DECLARE @tot_services INT, @ResultCode INT, @ServiceCode INT, @ServiceIssueRequestCode INT, @LastServiceIssueRequestCode INT
DECLARE @errcode INT, @RowId INT, @In_RowID INT, @In_Qty INT, @TmpCode INT, @IssueInvCode INT

SET @errcode = 0
EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'ServiceIssueRequest' , @ServiceIssueRequestCode OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Fetching Service Issue Request Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

IF @UserCode IS NULL
	SET @UserCode = 1

SET @TmpCode = 
	(SELECT COUNT(SCI.ICode)
	FROM ServiceHeader H, ServiceDetail D, ServiceConsumableItem SCI
	WHERE H.ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode AND H.Posted ='Y' AND
		H.ServiceInvCode = D.ServiceInvCode AND
		D.ServiceCode = SCI.ServiceCode)

IF @TmpCode <= 0 OR @TmpCode IS NULL
	RETURN 0

INSERT INTO ServiceIssueRequest (ServiceIssueRequestCode,	DeptCode, Date, 
	OriginalDate, SalesmanCode, ModifiedBy, 
	Posted, PostedBy, Remarks, PostDate, 
	SmanCode, AreaCode, AccCode, ServiceInvCode)
SELECT 
	@ServiceIssueRequestCode, DeptCode = 1, Date = GETDATE(),
	OriginalDate = GETDATE(), SalesmanCode = @UserCode, ModifiedBy = NULL,
	Posted = 'N', PostedBy = NULL, Remarks = NULL, PostDate = NULL,
	SmanCode = NULL, AreaCode = 1, AccCode = NULL, ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@RowCount <=0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Inserting Service Issue Request Header Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

INSERT INTO ServiceIssueRequestDetail (ServiceIssueRequestCode, ServiceRowID, ICode, Qty, ProcessCharge)
SELECT @ServiceIssueRequestCode, D.SRVRowID, SCI.ICode, SCI.Qty, SCI.ProcessCharge
FROM ServiceHeader H, ServiceDetail D, ServiceConsumableItem SCI
WHERE H.ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode AND H.Posted ='Y' AND
	H.ServiceInvCode = D.ServiceInvCode AND
	D.ServiceCode = SCI.ServiceCode
ORDER BY
	D.SRVRowID, SCI.RowID

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT <= 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Inserting Service Issue Request Detail Rows', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @LastServiceIssueRequestCode = @ServiceIssueRequestCode + 1

EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'ServiceIssueRequest' , @LastServiceIssueRequestCode
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Updating Service Issue Request Max Key Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

IF (SELECT DBO.Fn_GetPreference('AutoPost_issuereq_for_consumableitem_onservicepost')) = 'N'
	RETURN 0
ELSE
BEGIN
	Update  ServiceIssueRequest
	Set  posted   = 'Y', postdate = GetDate(), postedby = @UserCode
	Where
		ServiceIssueRequestCode = @ServiceIssueRequestCode AND
		ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode AND
		Posted = 'N'

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT <= 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Updating Posting Status of Service Issue Request', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	EXECUTE @errcode = sp_AutoIssueConsumableItem @ServiceIssueRequestCode, @UserCode, @IssueInvCode OUTPUT
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Auto Generation of Issue against Service Consumable Items.', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
END
RETURN 0

-- SP_AutoGeneratePatientRegNo
CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_AutoGeneratePatientRegNo 
	@PatientCatCode SMALLINT, 
	@Regno VARCHAR(50) OUTPUT
AS

DECLARE @Err AS INT, @RowCount AS INT
DECLARE @counter INT
DECLARE @shortname VARCHAR(12)

SET NOCOUNT ON

SELECT 	@counter = Counter, @shortname = ShortName
FROM	PatientCategory WITH (UPDLOCK HOLDLOCK)
WHERE	PatientCatCode = @PatientCatCode

SELECT @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
IF @Err = 0 AND @rowcount > 0 
BEGIN
	UPDATE PatientCategory
	SET Counter = Counter + 1
	WHERE PatientCatCode = @PatientCatCode

	SELECT @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount	
	IF @Err <> 0 OR @rowcount = 0 	
	BEGIN
		SET NOCOUNT OFF
		RAISERROR('Exception occured in updating counter for patient category %d' ,16, 1, @PatientCatCode)
		RETURN -1		
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @RegNo = ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(@shortname)) + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@counter + 1))), '')
	END
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	RAISERROR('Exception occured in fetching counter for patient category %d' ,16, 1, @PatientCatCode)
	RETURN -1
End 

SET NOCOUNT OFF
RETURN 0

-- SP_AutoGeneratePurchaseOfService
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_AutoGeneratePurchaseOfService @ServiceInvCode INT, @UserCode SMALLINT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @Posted CHAR(1), @Price NUMERIC(12,2)

IF @ServiceInvCode IS NULL
	RETURN 0

SET @Posted = (SELECT Posted FROM ServiceInvPurTempHeader WHERE ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode)
IF @Posted = 'Y' OR @Posted IS NULL
	RETURN 0

DECLARE @tot_services INT, @ResultCode INT, @ServiceCode INT, @start_no INT, @end_no INT
DECLARE @errcode INT, @RowId INT, @In_RowID INT, @In_Qty INT, @TmpCode INT

SET @errcode = 0
EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'ServicePurHeader' , @start_no OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Fetching Service Purchase Header Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

DECLARE @servicepurheader TABLE 
	(ServicePurInvCode INT, SuppCode SMALLINT, RowID INT IDENTITY(1, 1))

IF @UserCode IS NULL
	SET @UserCode = 1

INSERT INTO @servicepurheader (SuppCode)
SELECT DISTINCT SuppCode 
FROM ServiceInvPurTempDetail 
WHERE ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode
IF @@RowCount = 0
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END

SET @tot_services = ISNULL((SELECT Count(*) FROM @servicepurheader), 0)
IF @tot_services <=0 
	RETURN 0

UPDATE @servicepurheader SET ServicePurInvCode = @start_no + RowID

INSERT INTO ServicePurHeader (ServicePurInvCode, Date, SuppCode, UserCode, Remarks, 
	OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, Posted, PostDate, HeaderNo, DiscPerc, 
	FlatDisc, MiscCharges, CashAccCode, CashTendered, CashCharged, 
	CashBack, InvTotal, OutstandingAmt, Marked, Ref1, Ref2, Ref3, Ref4, ServiceInvCode)
SELECT T.ServicePurInvCode, GETDATE(), T.SuppCode, @UserCode, 
	Remarks='Service Purchase Against Service Sale Inv. ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@ServiceInvCode AS VARCHAR(10)))),
	GETDATE(), NULL, NULL, Posted='N', PostDate=NULL, HeaderNo=1, DiscPerc=0,
	FlatDisc=0, MiscCharges=0, CashAccCode=2, CashTendered=0, CashCharged=0, 
	CashBack=0, InvTotal=0, OutstandingAmt=0, Marked='N', Ref1=@ServiceInvCode, Ref2=NULL, Ref3=NULL, Ref4=NULL, @ServiceInvCode
FROM @servicepurheader T

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@RowCount <=0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Inserting Service Purchase Invoice Header Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

INSERT INTO ServicePurDetail 
	(ServicePurInvCode, ServiceCode, Qty, Price, ServiceFlatDisc, DiscPerc, 
	Remarks, SrvRowID)
SELECT T.ServicePurInvCode, STD.ServiceCode, STD.Qty, STD.PurPrice, STD.ServiceFlatDisc, STD.DiscPerc,
	Remarks=NULL, STD.SRVRowID
FROM ServiceInvPurTempDetail STD, @servicepurheader T
WHERE STD.ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode AND
	STD.SuppCode = T.SuppCode
ORDER BY
	STD.SRVRowID, STD.RowID

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT <= 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Inserting Service Purchase Detail Rows', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @end_no = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(ServicePurInvCode) FROM @servicepurheader), 0)

EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'ServicePurHeader' , @end_no
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Updating Service Purchase Key Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

UPDATE ServicePurHeader 
SET InvTotal = 
	ISNULL((SELECT InvTotal=ROUND(SUM(D.Qty * (D.Price - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 0)
	FROM ServicePurDetail D
	WHERE D.ServicePurInvCode = ServicePurHeader.ServicePurInvCode), 0)
WHERE ServicePurInvCode IN (SELECT T.ServicePurInvCode FROM @servicepurheader T)

UPDATE ServicePurHeader 
SET OutStandingAmt = InvTotal
WHERE ServicePurInvCode IN (SELECT T.ServicePurInvCode FROM @servicepurheader T)

UPDATE ServiceInvPurTempHeader SET Posted='Y', PostedBy=@UserCode, PostDate=GETDATE()
WHERE ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode

IF (SELECT DBO.Fn_GetPreference('AutoPostPurOfServiceOnServicePurTemplatePosting')) = 'N'
	RETURN 0
ELSE
BEGIN
	Update  ServicePurHeader
	Set  ServicePurHeader.posted   = 'Y',
		ServicePurHeader.postdate = GetDate(),
		ServicePurHeader.postedby = @UserCode
	Where
		ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode AND
		ServicePurHeader.Posted = 'N'
END

RETURN 0

-- SP_AutoGeneratePurchaseOfService_DoctorShareBased
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_AutoGeneratePurchaseOfService_DoctorShareBased @ServiceInvCode INT, @UserCode SMALLINT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @Posted CHAR(1), @Price NUMERIC(12,2)

IF @ServiceInvCode IS NULL
	RETURN 0

SET @Posted = (SELECT Posted FROM ServiceHeader WHERE ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode)
IF @Posted = 'N' OR @Posted IS NULL
	RETURN 0

DECLARE @tot_services INT, @ResultCode INT, @ServiceCode INT, @start_no INT, @end_no INT
DECLARE @errcode INT, @RowId INT, @In_RowID INT, @In_Qty INT, @TmpCode INT


SET @errcode = 0
EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'ServicePurHeader' , @start_no OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Fetching Service Purchase Header Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

DECLARE @servicepurheader TABLE 
	(ServicePurInvCode INT, SuppCode SMALLINT, HeaderNo SMALLINT, Ref VARCHAR(100), RowID INT IDENTITY(1, 1))

IF @UserCode IS NULL
	SET @UserCode = 1

INSERT INTO @servicepurheader (SuppCode, HeaderNo, Ref)
SELECT DISTINCT DC.AccCode, H.HeaderNo, 
	Ref = CASE WHEN H.AdmissionCode > 0 THEN 
		(SELECT P.Name FROM PatientAdmission PA, Patient P WHERE H.AdmissionCode = PA.AdmissionCode AND PA.PatientCode = P.PatientCode) 
		ELSE CASE WHEN H.PatientCode > 0 THEN 
			(SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = H.PatientCode) 
			ELSE '' END 
		END
FROM ServiceHeader H, ServiceDetail D, Doctors DC 
WHERE H.ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode AND 
	H.ServiceInvCode = D.ServiceInvCode AND 
	(D.Commission > 0 OR D.SharePerc > 0) AND 
	H.DoctCode = DC.DoctCode AND DC.AccCode > 0
IF @@RowCount = 0
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END

SET @tot_services = ISNULL((SELECT Count(*) FROM @servicepurheader), 0)
IF @tot_services <=0 
	RETURN 0

UPDATE @servicepurheader SET ServicePurInvCode = @start_no + RowID

INSERT INTO ServicePurHeader (ServicePurInvCode, Date, SuppCode, UserCode, Remarks, 
	OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, Posted, PostDate, HeaderNo, DiscPerc, 
	FlatDisc, MiscCharges, CashAccCode, CashTendered, CashCharged, 
	CashBack, InvTotal, OutstandingAmt, Marked, Ref1, Ref2, Ref3, Ref4, ServiceInvCode)
SELECT T.ServicePurInvCode, GETDATE(), T.SuppCode, @UserCode, 
	Remarks='Service Purchase Against Service Sale Inv. ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@ServiceInvCode AS VARCHAR(10)))),
	GETDATE(), NULL, NULL, Posted='N', PostDate=NULL, T.HeaderNo, DiscPerc=0,
	FlatDisc=0, MiscCharges=0, CashAccCode=2, CashTendered=0, CashCharged=0, 
	CashBack=0, InvTotal=0, OutstandingAmt=0, Marked='N', Ref1=@ServiceInvCode, Ref2=T.Ref, Ref3=NULL, Ref4=NULL, @ServiceInvCode
FROM @servicepurheader T

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@RowCount <=0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Inserting Service Purchase Invoice Header Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

INSERT INTO ServicePurDetail 
	(ServicePurInvCode, ServiceCode, Qty, 
	Price, 
	ServiceFlatDisc, DiscPerc, Remarks, SrvRowID)
SELECT T.ServicePurInvCode, D.ServiceCode, D.Qty, 
	PurPrice=D.Commission + Round((D.Price - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (D.SharePerc * 0.01), 2), 
	ServiceFlatDisc=0, DiscPerc=0, Remarks=NULL, D.SRVRowID
FROM ServiceHeader H, ServiceDetail D, Doctors DC, @servicepurheader T
WHERE 
	H.ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode AND 
	H.ServiceInvCode = D.ServiceInvCode AND 
	(D.Commission > 0 OR D.SharePerc > 0) AND 
	H.DoctCode = DC.DoctCode AND
	DC.AccCode = T.SuppCode
ORDER BY
	D.SRVRowID

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT <= 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Inserting Service Purchase Detail Rows', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @end_no = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(ServicePurInvCode) FROM @servicepurheader), 0)

EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'ServicePurHeader' , @end_no
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Updating Service Purchase Key Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

UPDATE ServicePurHeader 
SET InvTotal = 
	ISNULL((SELECT InvTotal= ROUND(SUM(D.Qty * (D.Price - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 0)
	FROM ServicePurDetail D
	WHERE D.ServicePurInvCode = ServicePurHeader.ServicePurInvCode), 0)
WHERE ServicePurInvCode IN (SELECT T.ServicePurInvCode FROM @servicepurheader T)

UPDATE ServicePurHeader 
SET OutStandingAmt = InvTotal
WHERE ServicePurInvCode IN (SELECT T.ServicePurInvCode FROM @servicepurheader T)

Update  ServicePurHeader
Set  ServicePurHeader.posted   = 'Y',
	ServicePurHeader.postdate = GetDate(),
	ServicePurHeader.postedby = @UserCode
Where
	ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode AND
	ServicePurHeader.Posted = 'N'

RETURN 0

-- SP_AutoGenerateServiceInvPurTemplate
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_AutoGenerateServiceInvPurTemplate @ServiceInvCode INT, @UserCode SMALLINT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

IF (SELECT DBO.Fn_GetPreference('AutoGenSrvPurTempOnServicePosting')) = 'N'
	RETURN 0

DECLARE @Posted CHAR(1), @Price NUMERIC(12,2)

IF @ServiceInvCode IS NULL
	RETURN 0

SET @Posted = ISNULL((SELECT Posted FROM ServiceHeader WHERE ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode), 'N')
IF @Posted = 'N' OR @Posted IS NULL
	RETURN 0

DECLARE @tot_services INT, @ResultCode INT, @ServiceCode INT, @start_no INT, @end_no INT
DECLARE @errcode INT, @RowId INT, @In_RowID INT, @In_Qty INT, @TmpCode INT

IF @UserCode IS NULL
	SET @UserCode = 1

SET @TmpCode = 
	(SELECT COUNT(PTD.ServiceCode)
	FROM ServiceHeader H, ServiceDetail D, ServicePurTempHeader PT, ServicePurTempDetail PTD
	WHERE H.ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode AND H.Posted ='Y' AND
		H.ServiceInvCode = D.ServiceInvCode AND
		D.ServiceCode = PT.ServiceCode AND 
		PT.ServicePurTempCode = PTD.ServicePurTempCode)

IF @TmpCode <= 0 OR @TmpCode IS NULL
	RETURN 0

SET @TmpCode = 
	(SELECT COUNT(PTD.ServiceCode)
	FROM ServiceDetail D, ServiceInvPurTempDetail PTD
	WHERE D.ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode AND 
		D.SrvRowID = PTD.SRVRowID)

IF @TmpCode > 0
	RETURN 0

INSERT INTO ServiceInvPurTempHeader 
	(ServiceInvCode, Date, UserCode, Posted, PostedBy, PostDate, Remarks)
SELECT @ServiceInvCode, GETDATE(), @UserCode, Posted='N', PostedBy=NULL, PostDate=NULL, Remarks='Auto Generated Service Purchase Template'
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@RowCount <=0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Inserting Service Invoice Purchase Template Header Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

INSERT INTO ServiceInvPurTempDetail (ServiceInvCode, SRVRowID, ServiceCode, SuppCode, Qty,
	PriceRule, SalePrice, SalePricePerc, PurPrice, ServiceFlatDisc, DiscPerc)
SELECT 
	ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode, 
	SRVRowID=D.SrvRowID, 
	ServiceCode=PTD.ServiceCode,
	SuppCode=PTD.SuppCode,
	Qty=PTD.Qty * D.Qty,
	PriceRule=PTD.PriceRule, 
	SalePrice=S.Price, 
	SalePricePerc=PTD.SalePricePerc, 
	PurPrice=CASE WHEN PTD.PriceRule=1 THEN (D.Price - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * PTD.SalePricePerc * 0.01 ELSE PTD.PurPrice END, 
	ServiceFlatDisc=PTD.ServiceFlatDisc, 
	DiscPerc=PTD.DiscPerc
FROM
	ServiceHeader H,
	ServiceDetail D,
	Service S,
	ServicePurTempHeader PT,
	ServicePurTempDetail PTD
WHERE
	H.ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode AND H.Posted ='Y' AND
	H.ServiceInvCode = D.ServiceInvCode AND
	D.ServiceCode = PT.ServiceCode AND 
	PT.ServicePurTempCode = PTD.ServicePurTempCode AND
	PTD.ServiceCode = S.ServiceCode
ORDER BY
	H.ServiceInvCode,
	D.SrvRowID,
	PTD.RowID

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT <= 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Inserting Service Result Detail Rows', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

IF (SELECT DBO.Fn_GetPreference('AutoPostSrvPurTempOnServicePosting')) = 'N'
	RETURN 0
ELSE
BEGIN
	EXECUTE @errcode = DBO.SP_AutoGeneratePurchaseOfService @ServiceInvCode, @UserCode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Generating Purchase of Service Invoices against Service Inv. # = %d', 16, 1, @ServiceInvCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

RETURN 0

-- SP_AutoGenerateServiceResult
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_AutoGenerateServiceResult @ServiceInvCode INT, @UserCode SMALLINT, @ServiceResultCode INT OUTPUT
AS
IF (SELECT DBO.Fn_GetPreference('AutoGenResultOnServicePosting')) = 'N'
	RETURN 0

SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @tot_services INT, @ResultCode INT, @ServiceCode INT, @PatientCode INT, @GestationCode SMALLINT
DECLARE @Posted CHAR(1), @Expiry DateTime, @Price NUMERIC(12,2)

DECLARE @start_ticket INT, @end_ticket INT, @errcode INT, @RowId INT, @In_RowID INT, @In_Qty INT, @TicketCode INT

DECLARE @service_table TABLE 
	(ServiceCode INT, Qty INT, Expiry DateTime, Price NUMERIC(12,2), Rowid INT IDENTITY(1, 1))

IF @ServiceInvCode IS NULL
	RETURN 0

IF @UserCode IS NULL
	SET @UserCode = 1

SET @Posted = ISNULL((SELECT Posted FROM ServiceHeader WHERE ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode), 'N')
IF @Posted = 'N' OR @Posted IS NULL
	RETURN 0

SET @ResultCode = 
	(SELECT ResultCode=(SELECT MAX(SRH.ServiceResultcode) FROM ServiceResultHeader SRH WHERE ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode)
	FROM ServiceHeader
	WHERE ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode AND Posted ='Y' AND
		ServiceInvCode IN (SELECT SRH.ServiceInvCode FROM ServiceResultHeader SRH WHERE SRH.ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode))

IF @ResultCode >= 0
	RETURN 0

SET @tot_services = (SELECT servicecount=(SELECT COUNT(SD.ServiceCode) FROM ServiceDetail SD, Service SV WHERE SD.ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode AND SD.ServiceCode = SV.ServiceCode AND SV.ResultRequired='Y')
	FROM DBO.ServiceHeader
	WHERE ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode AND 
		Posted='Y' AND 
		ServiceInvCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT SRH.ServiceInvCode FROM ServiceResultHeader SRH WHERE SRH.ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode))

IF @tot_services <= 0 OR @tot_services IS NULL
	RETURN 0

SELECT @PatientCode = P.PatientCode , @GestationCode = P.GestationCode
FROM Patient P
WHERE P.PatientCode IN 
	(SELECT PatientCode=SH.PatientCode 
	FROM ServiceHeader SH WHERE SH.ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT PA.PatientCode 
	FROM PatientAdmission PA, ServiceHeader SH 
	WHERE SH.ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode AND SH.AdmissionCode=PA.AdmissionCode)

SET @errcode = 0
EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'ServiceResultHeader', @ServiceResultCode OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Fetching Service Result Key Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @ServiceResultCode = @ServiceResultCode + 1

INSERT INTO ServiceResultHeader (ServiceResultCode, Date, ServiceInvCode, UserCode,
	Posted, PostDate, PostedBy, Remarks, ServiceResultStampCode)
SELECT @ServiceResultCode, GETDATE(), @ServiceInvCode, @UserCode,
	Posted='N', PostDate=NULL, PostedBy=NULL, Remarks=NULL, ServiceResultStampCode=1
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@RowCount <=0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Inserting Service Result Header Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

INSERT INTO ServiceResultDetail (ServiceResultCode, ServiceRowID, RowID, ServiceHead,
	ServiceComponentCode, ServiceComponentUnitCode, TestMachineCode, CostPrice, SalePrice,
	Componentvalue, LowerReferenceValue, UpperReferenceValue, Comments, Remarks, Componentvalue2,
	DeliveryDate, PrintOnReport)
SELECT 
	ServiceResultCode=@ServiceResultCode,
	SrvRowID=D.SrvRowID,
	RowID=SB.ROWID,   
	ServiceHead=SB.ServiceHead,   
	ServiceComponentCode=SB.ServiceComponentCode,   
	ServiceComponentUnitCode= (SELECT S.ServiceComponentUnitCode FROM ServiceComponent S WHERE S.ServiceComponentCode = SB.ServiceComponentCode),
	TestMachineCode=1,
	CostPrice=SB.CostPrice,   
	SalePrice=SB.SalePrice,
	Componentvalue=CASE WHEN S.ServiceResultTemplate IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT MAX(SRD.ComponentValue) FROM ServiceResultDetail SRD WHERE SRD.ServiceResultCode=S.ServiceResultTemplate AND SRD.ServiceComponentCode=SB.ServiceComponentCode) END,
	LowerReferenceValue=CASE WHEN S.ServiceResultTemplate IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT MAX(SRD.LowerReferenceValue) FROM ServiceResultDetail SRD WHERE SRD.ServiceResultCode=S.ServiceResultTemplate AND SRD.ServiceComponentCode=SB.ServiceComponentCode) END,
	UpperReferenceValue=CASE WHEN S.ServiceResultTemplate IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT MAX(SRD.UpperReferenceValue) FROM ServiceResultDetail SRD WHERE SRD.ServiceResultCode=S.ServiceResultTemplate AND SRD.ServiceComponentCode=SB.ServiceComponentCode) END,
	Comments=CASE WHEN S.ServiceResultTemplate IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT MAX(SRD.Comments) FROM ServiceResultDetail SRD WHERE SRD.ServiceResultCode=S.ServiceResultTemplate AND SRD.ServiceComponentCode=SB.ServiceComponentCode) END,
	Remarks=CASE WHEN S.ServiceResultTemplate IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT MAX(SRD.Remarks) FROM ServiceResultDetail SRD WHERE SRD.ServiceResultCode=S.ServiceResultTemplate AND SRD.ServiceComponentCode=SB.ServiceComponentCode) END,
	Componentvalue2=CASE WHEN S.ServiceResultTemplate IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT MAX(SRD.ComponentValue2) FROM ServiceResultDetail SRD WHERE SRD.ServiceResultCode=S.ServiceResultTemplate AND SRD.ServiceComponentCode=SB.ServiceComponentCode) END,
	DeliveryDate=D.DeliveryDate,
	PrintOnReport=SB.PrintOnReport
FROM
	ServiceHeader H,
	ServiceDetail D,
	Service S,
	ServiceBreakUp SB   
WHERE
	H.ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode AND
	H.ServiceInvCode = D.ServiceInvCode AND
	D.ServiceCode = S.ServiceCode AND
	S.ResultRequired='Y' AND
	S.ServiceCode=SB.ServiceCode
ORDER BY 
	D.SrvRowID,
	SB.ServiceHead,
	RowID

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT <= 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Inserting Service Result Detail Rows', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @errcode = 0
EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'ServiceResultHeader', @ServiceResultCode
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Updating Service Result Key Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

-- sp_AutoIssueConsumableItem
CREATE   PROCEDURE DBO.sp_AutoIssueConsumableItem
	@ServiceIssueRequestCode Int, 
	@UserCode Int, 
	@IssueInvCode Int Output 
As
/*
Author : Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Purpose: This Stored Procedure is called from service invoice posting. 
	It takes 3 arguments, i.e.:-
	@ServiceIssueRequestCode ---> ServiceIssueRequestCode 
	@UserCode 		 ---> User who has initiated service posting
	@IssueInvCode	 	 ---> Issue Invoice Code (Auto Posted)
*/

Declare @Code Int, @deptcode Int, @module SmallInt, @utn Int, @HeaderInvNo Int, @HeaderNo Int, @ServiceRowID INT, @ServiceInvCode INT, @category smallint, @IssueCode INT, @dracccode smallint, @AccountFor CHAR(1)
Declare @IssueType SmallInt, @PriceType SmallInt, @GroupCode SmallInt
Declare @ICode Int, @GCode Int, @packunits Int, @AreaCode Int, @TotGodown INT, @RowID INT
Declare @ConsumableQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @TotalQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @CurrQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @DelQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @BatchQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @ReqQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @NewQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @AvailableQty NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @Price Numeric(8,2), @PurPrice Numeric(8,2), @SalePrice Numeric(8,2), @Hold_AvgPrice Numeric(11,5), @RecentPurPrice Numeric(8,2)
Declare @batch VarChar(12), @ItemName VarChar(100), @InvPosted CHAR(1), @total_availablestock NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @Items_Rows Int, @Counter Int, @RowCount Int, @TotalRows Int, @continue Int, @Err Int, @rt_code Int, @consumableitemcount INT
Declare @serverdate DateTime, @expiry DateTime
Declare @godownlist TABLE (Code SMALLINT, GRowID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1))

Set @continue = 0
Set @DeptCode = 1 /* Default Department */
Set @AreaCode = 1 /* Default Area */
SET @serverdate = (SELECT GETDATE())
SET @ServiceInvCode = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(ServiceInvCode) FROM ServiceIssueRequest WHERE ServiceIssueRequestCode = @ServiceIssueRequestCode), 0)
SET @consumableitemcount = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(D.ICode) FROM ServiceIssueRequestDetail D, ServiceIssueRequest H WHERE H.ServiceIssueRequestCode = @ServiceIssueRequestCode AND H.ServiceIssueRequestCode = D.ServiceIssueRequestCode), 0)
IF @consumableitemcount <= 0
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END

Set @module = ( Select Module From Module Where Lower(Name) = 'issue' )
IF @module <= 0 OR @module IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError( 'Error occured While Fetching Issue Module Information' ,16,1)
	RETURN -1
END

Set @pricetype = DBO.Fn_Get_INT_Preference('IssuePriceTypeCode')
IF @pricetype <= 0 OR @pricetype IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError( 'Error occured While Fetching Issue Module Price Ttype Information' ,16,1)
	RETURN -1
END

Set @GroupCode = DBO.fn_GetGroupCode(@UserCode)
IF @GroupCode <= 0 OR @GroupCode IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError( 'Error occured While Fetching Group Information for the user triggered this event' ,16,1)
	RETURN -1
END

Set @GCode = DBO.fn_GetGodown(@GroupCode, @Module)
IF @GCode <= 0 OR @GCode IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError( 'You have No Allowed Godown for Issue Module' ,16,1)
	RETURN -1
END

Set @HeaderNo = DBO.fn_GetHeader(@GroupCode, @Module)
IF @HeaderNo <= 0 OR @HeaderNo IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError( 'You have No Allowed Header for Issue Module' ,16,1)
	RETURN -1
END

INSERT INTO @godownlist (Code)
SELECT Code FROM DBO.fn_GetAvailableGodown(@GroupCode, @Module)
ORDER BY RowID

SET @TotGodown = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(Code) FROM @GodownList), 0)

IF @TotGodown=0 OR @TotGodown IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError( 'You have No Allowed Godown for Issue Module' ,16,1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @Category = 2 -- Production
SET @AccountFor = ISNULL((SELECT AccountFor FROM IssueCategory WHERE IssueCategoryCode=@Category), 'N')
IF @AccountFor = 'Y'
	SET @dracccode = ISNULL((SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name='GT_WIPAcc'), 33) -- cr wor in process a/c
ELSE
	SET @dracccode = NULL

DECLARE Cursor_ConsumableItems CURSOR FORWARD_ONLY STATIC
FOR 
SELECT 
	ServiceRowID=D.ServiceRowID,
	ICode=D.ICode,
	ROWId=D.RowID,
	ConsumeableQty=ISNULL(SUM(D.Qty), 0),
	AvailableQty=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(GD.CurrQty) FROM GodownDetail GD WHERE GD.ICode = D.ICode AND GD.GCode IN (SELECT Code FROM @godownlist)) ,0),
	PackUnits=I.PackUnits,
	Round(I.PurPrice/I.PackUnits , 2) As PurPrice ,
	Round(I.SalePrice/I.PackUnits , 2) As SalePrice ,
	Round(I.RecentPurPrice/I.PackUnits , 2) As RecentPurPrice ,
	CASE @PriceType WHEN 1 THEN Round(I.SalePrice/I.PackUnits , 2) WHEN 2 THEN Round(I.SalePrice2/I.PackUnits , 2) WHEN 3 THEN Round(I.SalePrice3/I.PackUnits, 2) WHEN 4 THEN Round(I.PurPrice/I.PackUnits , 2) WHEN 5 THEN Round(I.RecentPurPrice/I.PackUnits , 2) WHEN 6 THEN Round(I.AvgPrice, 2) WHEN 7 THEN Round(I.SalePrice4/I.PackUnits , 2) WHEN 8 THEN Round(I.SalePrice5/I.PackUnits , 2) END + D.ProcessCharge As Price
FROM
	ServiceIssueRequestDetail D, ServiceIssueRequest H,
	Item I
WHERE 
	H.ServiceIssueRequestCode = @ServiceIssueRequestCode AND
	H.ServiceIssueRequestCode = D.ServiceIssueRequestCode AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode
GROUP BY
	D.ServiceRowID,
	D.ICode,
	D.RowID,
	I.PackUnits,
	I.PurPrice,
	I.SalePrice,
	I.SalePrice2,
	I.SalePrice3,
	I.SalePrice4,
	I.SalePrice5,
	I.RecentPurPrice,
	I.AvgPrice,	
	D.ProcessCharge 
ORDER BY	
	D.RowID

Open Cursor_ConsumableItems
Set @Items_Rows = @@Cursor_Rows
IF @Items_Rows > 0 
Begin
	Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'IssueHeader' , @Code Output
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	Begin
		Set @continue  = -1
	End
	Else
	Begin
		Set @IssueInvCode = @Code
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno , @module,  @headerinvno Output 
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
		Else
		Begin
			Set @IssueCode = NULL
			Execute @rt_code = sp_GetIssueCategoryCounter @Category , @IssueCode Output 
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
			Begin
				Set @continue  = -1
			End
			Else
			Begin
				Insert Into IssueHeader (IssueInvCode, DeptCode, Date, OriginalDate, SalesManCode, Posted, PostDate, PostedBy, AreaCode, HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo, PriceTypeCode, Remarks, ServiceIssueRequestCode, ServiceInvCode, IssueCategoryCode, AccountFor, DrAccCode, IssueCode)
				Values (@Code, @deptcode, @serverdate, @serverdate, @usercode, 'Y', @serverdate, @usercode, @AreaCode, @headerno, @headerinvno, @pricetype, 'SYS. GEN. ISSUE FOR ITEMS CONSUMED AGAINST SVC. INV. #: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@ServiceInvCode, 10))), @ServiceIssueRequestCode, @ServiceInvCode, @Category, @AccountFor, @DrAccCode, @IssueCode)
				Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
				IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
				Begin 
					RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Issue Header : %d' ,16,1,  @Code  )
					Set @continue  = -1
				End 
				Else
				Begin
					Fetch Next From Cursor_ConsumableItems
					Into @ServiceRowID, @ICode, @RowID, @ConsumableQty, @AvailableQty, @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice, @price
					While @@Fetch_Status = 0 AND @continue >= 0
					Begin
						Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
						IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
						Begin
							Set @continue  = -1
						End
						Else
						Begin
							set @total_availablestock = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.icode = @icode)
							IF @total_availablestock < 0 OR @total_availablestock IS NULL
								SET @total_availablestock=0

							Set @packunits = Case When @packunits Is Null Then 1 When @packunits = 0 Then 1 Else @packunits End
							Set @totalqty = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.gcode IN (SELECT Code FROM @GodownList) and godowndetail.icode = @icode  )
							IF @totalqty >= @ConsumableQty 
							Begin 
								Set @reqqty = @ConsumableQty
								Declare ItemBatch_Cursor Cursor Static Forward_Only
								For 
								Select gd.gcode, gd.batch, gd.expiry, gd.Currqty
								From 
									godowndetail gd,
									(SELECT GCode=Code, GRowID 
									FROM @GodownList) G
								Where 
									gd.gcode = G.Gcode and
									gd.icode = @icode 
								Order by 
									g.growid, gd.gcode, gd.priority, gd.expiry, gd.Currqty
	
								Open ItemBatch_Cursor
								Set @totalrows = @@Cursor_Rows
								Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
								Into 	@Gcode, @batch, @expiry, @currqty
								Set @counter = 1	
								While @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @counter <= @totalrows AND @reqqty > 0
								Begin
									Set @batchqty = @currqty
									IF @batchqty >= @ReqQty 
										Set @delqty = @reqqty
									Else
										Set @delqty = @batchqty
									Set @reqqty = @reqqty - @delqty
	
									Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @utn Output
									IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
									Begin
										Set @continue  = -1
									End 
									SET @total_availablestock = @total_availablestock - @delqty
									
									Insert Into IssueDetail (IssueInvCode, GCode, ICode, Batch, Expiry, Qty, SalePrice, PurchasePrice, AvgPrice, PackUnits, MRPP, IssueUtn, Price, ServiceIssueReqRowID, ServiceRowID, BalanceStock)
									Values(@Code, @GCode, @ICode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty, @saleprice, @purprice, @hold_avgprice, @packunits, @recentpurprice, @utn, @price, @RowID, @ServiceRowID, @total_availablestock)
									Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
									IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
									Begin 
										RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Issue Detail for Service Issue Request Code : %d' ,16,1, @Code  )
										Set @continue  = -1
									End 							
									Else
									Begin
										Set @newqty = @currqty - @delqty
										IF @newqty > 0
											Execute @rt_code = sp_SaleUpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty , @currqty
										Else
											Execute @rt_code = sp_DeleteItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty
										IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
										Begin
											Set @continue  = -1								
										End
									End
									Set @counter = @counter + 1
									Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
									Into @gcode, @batch, @expiry, @currqty
								End
								Close ItemBatch_Cursor
								Deallocate ItemBatch_Cursor
							End
							Else
							Begin
								Set @itemname = (Select name from item where icode = @icode )	
								RaisError( 'Not enough stock for item (%s) to decrease for Issue No. : %d' , 16 , 1, @itemname, @Code  )
								Set @continue  = -1
							End
						End
						Fetch Next From Cursor_ConsumableItems
						Into @ServiceRowID, @ICode, @RowID, @ConsumableQty, @AvailableQty, @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice, @price
					End
				End
			End
		End
	End	
End
ELSE
BEGIN
	RaisError( 'Not enough stock exists for some of the consumable items for Issue No. : %d' , 16 , 1, @Code  )
	Set @continue  = -1
END
Close Cursor_ConsumableItems
Deallocate Cursor_ConsumableItems

IF @continue <> 0 
	Return -1
Else
	Return 0

CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_AutoLoyaltyRedemption @AccCode INT, @PointsRedeemed INT, @RedemptionValue NUMERIC(12,2), @DocumentCode INT, @DocumntType VARCHAR(2), @UserCode SMALLINT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @LoyaltyRedemptionCode INT, @errcode INT, @RowId INT, @In_RowID INT, @In_Qty INT, @TmpCode INT, @Remarks VARCHAR(255), @BalanceDate datetime, @LayaltyPointsBalance int, @LayaltyPointsValue numeric(12,2), @loyaltyCardCode INT

SET @errcode = 0
EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'LoyaltyRedemption' , @LoyaltyRedemptionCode OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Fetching Loyalty Redemption Code', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @LoyaltyRedemptionCode = @LoyaltyRedemptionCode + 1

SET @Remarks='Auto Points Redeemed'
IF @DocumntType='SV' 
	SET @Remarks = @Remarks + ' via Sale Inv. Code ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@DocumentCode)))

IF @UserCode IS NULL
	SET @UserCode = 1

SET @loyaltyCardCode = (SELECT MIN(LC.LoyaltyCardCode) FROM  LoyaltyCard LC WHERE LC.AccCode=@AccCode)

SET @BalanceDate = GETDATE()

SET @errcode = 0
EXECUTE @errcode = SP_GetAccountLoyaltyBalance @AccCode, @BalanceDate, @LayaltyPointsBalance OUTPUT , @LayaltyPointsValue OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Fetching Account Loyalty Balance Info.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

INSERT INTO LoyaltyRedemption (LoyaltyRedemptionCode, loyaltyCardCode, Date, UserCode, PointsBalance, PointsRedeemed, PointsValue, Remarks)
SELECT 
	@LoyaltyRedemptionCode, 
	@loyaltyCardCode,
	Date=GETDATE(), 
	@UserCode, 
	@LayaltyPointsBalance, 
	@PointsRedeemed, 
	@RedemptionValue, 
	@Remarks

IF @@RowCount = 0
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END

EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'LoyaltyRedemption' , @LoyaltyRedemptionCode
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Updating Loyalty Redemption Key Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

EXECUTE @errcode = SP_ManageLoyaltyPoints 'RD', @LoyaltyRedemptionCode

RETURN @errcode

-- sp_autopost_visit
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_autopost_visit AS

/*
Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
The purpose of this code is to post visits based on visit age.
The time specified in preferences table attribute (VisitAutoPostTime) used as the invoice age.
Let's suppose VisitAutoPostTime attribute value in preferences table is 5,
so this storedprocedure post visits which are 5 minutes old
*/

DECLARE @age INT

SET @age = DBO.Fn_Get_INT_Preference('VisitAutoPostTime')

UPDATE Visit
SET POSTED = 'Y'
Where DateDiff ( Minute , Date , GetDate() ) >= @age AND Posted = 'N'

RETURN 0

-- sp_autosaleposting
CREATE  Procedure sp_AutoSalePosting @salecategory Int AS

/*
Author: Muhammad Usman
The purpose of this storedprocedure is to post sale invoice based on two things
i.e. salecategory and saleinvoice age.
Salecategory is passed as an argument to this storedprocedure.
The time specified in preferences table attributes(cashsaleautopostingtime,creditsaleautopostingtime)
are used as the invoice age.
Let's suppose cashsaleautopostingtime attribute value in preferences table is 5,
so this storedprocedure post those invoices which are 5 minutes old
and belong to the salecategory mentioned (salecategory passed as an argument).
*/

DECLARE @invoiceage INT, @custcode INT
DECLARE @saleinvcode INT 
DECLARE @balance NUMERIC(15, 5)
DECLARE @dt DATETIME
DECLARE @savebal CHAR(1)

IF @salecategory = 3 
	SET @invoiceage = DBO.Fn_Get_INT_Preference('cashsaleautopostingtime')
ELSE
	SET @invoiceage = DBO.Fn_Get_INT_Preference('creditsaleautopostingtime')

SET @savebal = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('SaveBalanceOnSalePosting')

Begin Transaction

DECLARE saleposting_cursor CURSOR FOR 

SELECT saleinvcode 
FROM SaleLedger WITH (UPDLOCK,ROWLOCK,READPAST) INNER JOIN Customer C On SaleLedger.CustCode = C.CustCode
Where DateDiff ( Minute , OriginalDate , GetDate() ) >= @invoiceage AND Posted = 'N' AND Salecatcode = @salecategory 
		AND C.SchedForPosting = 'Y'

OPEN saleposting_cursor

FETCH NEXT FROM saleposting_cursor
INTO @saleinvcode

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN

	SET @custcode = 0
	SET @balance = 0

	IF @savebal = 'Y' AND @salecategory <> 3
	BEGIN
		SET @custcode = (SELECT custcode FROM SaleLedger WHERE SaleInvCode = @saleinvcode)
		SET @dt = GetDate()
		EXECUTE SP_OPENINGBALANCE @custcode, @dt, @balance OUTPUT
	END

	Update SaleLedger 
	Set Posted = 'Y' , PostDate = GetDate() , PostedBy = 1, Balance = @Balance
	Where saleinvcode = @saleinvcode
	FETCH NEXT FROM saleposting_cursor
	INTO @saleinvcode
END

IF @@ERROR = 0 
	Commit Transaction
ELSE
	Rollback Transaction

CLOSE saleposting_cursor
DEALLOCATE saleposting_cursor

RETURN 0

definition:
-- SP_AutoSatisfyDue
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_AutoSatisfyDue
AS

DECLARE @DueAdjCode INT, @totalrows INT, @Continue INT, @Counter INT
DECLARE @ICode INT, @OldICode INT, @GCode SMALLINT
DECLARE @TotStock NUMERIC(15, 4), @SatisfiableQty NUMERIC(15, 4)
DECLARE @rt_code INT, @err_string VARCHAR(200), @itemname VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @Err INT, @RowCount INT, @serverdate DATETIME, @usercode INT

SET @usercode = 1
SET @serverdate = GETDATE()
SET @continue = 0

DECLARE @temp_table TABLE (
	SaleInvCode INT, ItemName VARCHAR(100), ICode INT, GCode SMALLINT, 
	SaleRowID INT, DueQty NUMERIC(15, 4), SatisfiedQty NUMERIC(15, 4), 
	Stock NUMERIC(15, 4), SatisfiableQty NUMERIC(15, 4), Selected CHAR(1),
	RowID INT IDENTITY(1, 1)
)

INSERT INTO @temp_table (SaleInvCode, ItemName, ICode, GCode, SaleRowID, 
	DueQty, SatisfiedQty, Stock, SatisfiableQty, Selected)
SELECT 
	SaleInvCode, ItemName, ICode, GCode, SaleRowID, DueQty, SatisfiedQty, 
	Stock, SatisfiableQty = ISNULL(DueQty - SatisfiedQty, 0), Selected='N'
FROM
	(SELECT
		SaleInvCode=SL.SaleInvcode, 
		ItemName=I.Name,
		ICode=SD.ICode, 
		GCode=SD.GCode, 
		SaleRowID=SD.RowId, 
		DueQty=SD.LooseQty,
		SatisfiedQty = ISNULL( 
			(SELECT SUM(dsd.DueSatisfyQty) 
			FROM DueSatisfyHeader dsh, DueSatisfyDetail dsd 
			WHERE dsh.SaleInvCode = sl.SaleInvCode AND
				dsh.DueSatisfyCode = dsd.DueSatisfyCode AND
				dsd.ICode = sd.ICode AND dsd.SaleRowID = sd.RowID ), 0),
		Stock = ISNULL(
			(SELECT SUM(GD.CurrQty) FROM GodownDetail GD 
			WHERE GD.ICode = SD.ICode AND SD.GCode = GD.GCode), 0)
	FROM 
		SaleLedger SL, SaleDetail SD, Item I, 
		(SELECT DISTINCT ICode, GCode 
		FROM DBO.GodownDetail 
		WHERE Gcode IN 
			(SELECT G.GCode FROM Godown G WHERE G.AutoSatisfyDue = 'Y')) P
	WHERE 
		SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode And  
		SL.Posted = 'Y'  And
		SD.ICode = I.ICode And
		SD.Due = 'D' AND
		SD.ICode = P.ICode AND
		SD.GCode = P.GCode) T
WHERE 
	(T.DueQty - T.SatisfiedQty) > 0 AND 
	T.Stock > 0
ORDER BY 
	T.ItemName,
	T.SaleInvCode

SET @totalrows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @temp_table), 0)
SET @counter = 1
SET @OldICode = -1
WHILE @totalrows > 0 AND @counter <= @totalrows
BEGIN
	SET @ICode = (SELECT ICode FROM @temp_table WHERE RowID=@counter)
	IF @ICode <> @OldICode
	BEGIN
		SET @OldICode = @ICode
		SET @TotStock = ISNULL((SELECT Stock FROM @temp_table WHERE RowID=@counter), 0)
	END

	IF @TotStock > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @SatisfiableQty = (SELECT SatisfiableQty FROM @temp_table WHERE RowID=@counter)
	
		UPDATE @temp_table SET Stock = @TotStock WHERE RowID = @counter
	
		IF @SatisfiableQty <= @TotStock
		BEGIN
			SET @TotStock = @TotStock - @SatisfiableQty
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE @temp_table SET SatisfiableQty = @TotStock WHERE RowID = @counter
			SET @TotStock = 0
		END
	
		UPDATE @temp_table SET Selected='Y' WHERE RowID = @counter
	END

	SET @counter = @counter + 1
END

DELETE @temp_table WHERE Selected='N'

SET @totalrows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @temp_table), 0)

IF @totalrows > 0
BEGIN
	EXECUTE @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'DueAdjHeader' , @DueAdjCode Output
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	BEGIN
		Set @continue  = -1
		RaisError('Unable to Generate New Due Adjustment code' , 16 , 1)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO DueAdjHeader (DueAdjCode, Date, StartDate, EndDate, Remarks, UserCode)
		VALUES (@DueAdjCode, @serverdate, '01-01-1990 00:00:00', GETDATE(), 'Due Satisfied Via Auto Due Satisfy Job', @usercode)

		INSERT INTO DueAdjDetail (DueAdjCode, SaleInvCode, ICode, GCode, SaleRowId, DueQty, SatisfiedQty, SatisfiableQty, DueDelete)
		SELECT @DueAdjCode, SaleInvCode, ICode, GCode, SaleRowId, DueQty, SatisfiedQty, SatisfiableQty, DueDelete='N'
		FROM @temp_table

		SELECT @Err = @@ERROR, @RowCount = @@ROWCOUNT
		IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
		Begin 
			RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Due Adjustment Detail' ,16,1)
			Set @continue  = -1
		End 							

		IF @continue >= 0
		BEGIN
			EXECUTE @rt_code = sp_SatisfyDueInBulk @DueAdjCode, @UserCode, @ServerDate
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
			BEGIN
				Set @continue  = -1
				RaisError('Unable to Generate New Due Adjustment code' , 16 , 1)
			END
		END
	END
END

RETURN @continue

-- sp_AutoStockVerification
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_AutoStockVerification as
insert into items_corrupted
select 	getdate(),tot.icode, item.name,
	sum(CASE WHEN tot.type = 'ST' THEN tot.netqty ELSE 0 END) as stock, 
	sum(CASE WHEN tot.type <> 'ST' THEN tot.netqty  ELSE 0 END) as netqty 

from 	(select icode, sum( packqty * packunits + bonusqty * packunits ) as netqty, 'PU' as type 
	from purdetail, purledger
	where purledger.purcatcode in (1,2) and purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and posted = upper('Y') 
	group by icode
	union all
	select icode, sum(looseqty +  bonusqty  ) as netqty, 'PU' as type
	from purdetail, purledger
	where purledger.purcatcode in (3,7,8) and purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and posted = upper('Y')
	group by icode
	union  all
        select icode, -sum(looseqty +  bonusqty) as netqty, 'PR' as type
	from prdetail
	group by icode
	union  all
	select icode, -sum(looseqty + bonusqty ) as netqty, 'SL' as type
	from saledetail
	where due is null
	group by icode
	union  all
	select icode, sum(looseqty + bonusqty) as netqty, 'SR' as type
	from srdetail
	group by icode
	union  all
	select icode, -sum(qty) as netqty, 'IS' as type
	from issuedetail, issueheader
	where issueheader.issueinvcode = issuedetail.issueinvcode 
	group by icode
	union  all
	select icode, -sum(duesatisfyqty) as netqty, 'DS' as type
	from duesatisfydetail
	group by icode
	
	union  all
	select icode, sum(qty) as netqty, 'DS' as type
	from receiptheader,receiptdetail
	where receiptheader.posted='Y' and
	   receiptheader.receiptinvcode=receiptdetail.receiptinvcode
	group by icode
	
	union all
	select icode, sum(looseqty) as netqty, 'AI' as type
	from adjheader,adjdetail
	where adjheader.posted='Y' and
	      adjheader.adjcatcode=1 and
	      adjheader.adjcode=adjdetail.adjcode 
	group by icode
	
	union all
	select icode, -sum(looseqty) as netqty, 'AD' as type
	from adjheader,adjdetail
	where adjheader.posted='Y' and
	      adjheader.adjcatcode=2 and
	      adjheader.adjcode=adjdetail.adjcode 
	group by icode




	union  all
	select icode, sum(currqty) as netqty, 'ST' as type
	from godowndetail
	group by icode) tot, item

where tot.icode = item.icode

group by tot.icode, item.name

having 	sum(CASE WHEN tot.type = 'ST' THEN tot.netqty ELSE 0 END) <> 
	sum(CASE WHEN tot.type <> 'ST' THEN tot.netqty ELSE 0 END)

order by item.name

-- SP_AutoTimeOut_Attendance
CREATE   PROCEDURE DBO.SP_AutoTimeOut_Attendance
AS
DECLARE @ApplyDeptTimeSlabs CHAR(1), @AutoMarkAbsents CHAR(1)

SET @ApplyDeptTimeSlabs = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('ApplyDeptTimeSlabsInOnlineAtten')
IF @ApplyDeptTimeSlabs IS NULL
	SET @ApplyDeptTimeSlabs='N'

SET @AutoMarkAbsents = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('MarkAbsentsOnAutoTimeout')
IF @AutoMarkAbsents IS NULL
	SET @AutoMarkAbsents='N'

-- Auto Mark Absent by system to employees not present today
IF @AutoMarkAbsents = 'Y' 
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO EMP_Attendance (EmpCode, FingerCode, TimeIn, TimeOut, FingerCodeOut, AttendanceStatusCode, Payed, Comments)
	SELECT EmpCode, FingerCode=1, TimeIn=GETDATE(), TimeOut=GETDATE(), FingerCodeOut=NULL, AttendanceStatusCode=2, Payed='N', Comments='Absent Marked By System'
	FROM Emp_Employee
	WHERE Active='Y' AND EmpCode NOT IN 
		(SELECT EA.EmpCode
		FROM EMP_Attendance EA
		WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), EA.TIMEIN, 101) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101))
END

IF @ApplyDeptTimeSlabs = 'Y'
BEGIN
	UPDATE EMP_Attendance
	SET TimeOut=ETO.IdealTimeOut, Comments = 'System Timed-Out'
	FROM EMP_Attendance A, EMP_Employee E,
		(SELECT EA.AttendanceCode, 
			IdealTimeOut=CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), EA.TimeIn, 101) + ' ' + 
				CASE 
				WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), ED.SHTimeOut, 114))) > LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), ED.FHTimeOut, 114))) THEN 
					LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), ED.SHTimeOut, 114))) 
				WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), ED.FHTimeOut, 114))) > LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), ED.SHTimeOut, 114))) THEN 
					LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), ED.FHTimeOut, 114))) 
				WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), EA.Timein, 114))) > LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), ED.FHTimeOut, 114))) THEN 
					LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), ED.SHTimeOut, 114))) 
				ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), ED.FHTimeOut, 114))) END AS DATETIME)
		FROM Emp_DepartmentTiming ED, EMP_Attendance EA, EMP_Employee EE
		WHERE EA.TimeOut IS NULL AND EA.EmpCode = EE.EmpCode AND
			DATEPART(dw, EA.TimeIn) = ED.WeekDayCode AND
			ED.DeptCode = EE.DeptCode) ETO
	WHERE A.TimeOut IS NULL AND A.EmpCode = E.EmpCode AND A.AttendanceCode = ETO.AttendanceCode AND
		GETDATE() >= ETO.IdealTimeOut
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	UPDATE EMP_Attendance
	SET TimeOut=DATEADD(hh, CASE WHEN (SELECT MAX(EP.WorkingHours) FROM EMP_Pay EP WHERE EP.EmpCode=E.EmpCode) IS NULL THEN E.MaxTimeInLimitInHrs ELSE (SELECT MAX(EP.WorkingHours) FROM EMP_Pay EP WHERE EP.EmpCode=E.EmpCode) END, A.TimeIN), Comments = 'System Timed-Out'
	FROM EMP_Attendance A, EMP_Employee E
	WHERE A.TimeOut IS NULL AND A.EmpCode = E.EmpCode AND 
		GETDATE() >= DATEADD(hh, CASE WHEN (SELECT MAX(EP.WorkingHours) FROM EMP_Pay EP WHERE EP.EmpCode=E.EmpCode) IS NULL THEN E.MaxTimeInLimitInHrs ELSE (SELECT MAX(EP.WorkingHours) FROM EMP_Pay EP WHERE EP.EmpCode=E.EmpCode) END, A.TimeIN)
END

RETURN 0

definition:
-- SP_CashFlowTotals


/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.SP_CashFlowTotals    Script Date: 9/24/01 5:09:31 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.SP_CashFlowTotals    Script Date: 7/20/01 6:52:00 PM ******/
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_CashFlowTotals @ad_StartDate     datetime,
				   @ad_EndDate       datetime,
				   @af_RetailSale    float out,
			   	   @af_WholeSale     float out,
				   @af_ClinicSale    float out,
				   @af_RetailSaleRet float out,
				   @af_WholeSaleRet  float out,
				   @af_Purchase      float out,
				   @af_PurchaseLoose float out,
				   @af_ClinicSaleRet float out,
				   @af_PurchaseRet   float out,
                                   @af_RetailService float out,
                                   @af_RetailServiceRet float out AS

declare @ln_RetailSale   numeric(12, 2),
	@ln_WholeSale    numeric(12, 2),
	@ln_ClinicSale  numeric(12, 2),
	@ln_ClinicSaleRet numeric(12, 2),
	@ln_RetailSaleRet numeric(12, 2),
	@ln_WholeSaleRet numeric(12, 2),
	@ln_Purchase     numeric(12, 2),
	@ln_PurchaseLoose numeric(12, 2),
	@ln_PurchaseRet   numeric(12, 2),
        @ln_RetailService   numeric(12, 2),
        @ln_RetailServiceRet   numeric(12, 2)



create table #lt_CashAmts 
(
	received  numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,
	payed     numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL

)

/**************Retail/Cash Sales Line for Report of Cash Flows *******************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select   received = ISNULL(
		Round(
			SUM(saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * 
				(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * 
				saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((saledetail.looseqty * 
				(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) -
				saleledger.flatdisc) * 
				(saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
		Round(
			SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - 
				saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + 
				saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - 
				saleledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
	 payed    = 0.0

from     saleledger, saledetail  

where    saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and
	 (saleledger.salecatcode = 3) and
	 saleledger.posted = 'Y' and
	 saleledger.date >= @ad_StartDate and
	 saleledger.date <= @ad_EndDate


group by saleledger.saleinvcode,
	 saleledger.salecatcode, 
	 saleledger.date,
	 saleledger.discperc,
	 saleledger.misccharges,
	 saleledger.salestax,
	 saleledger.InvGSTPerc1,
	 saleledger.flatdisc

select @ln_RetailSale = ( select case 
				  when sum(received) - sum(payed) IS NULL then 0.0
				  else sum(received) - sum(payed)
				 end
			  from   #lt_CashAmts )

Delete #lt_CashAmts

/************** Credit Sales Immediate Cash Line for Report of Cash Flows *******************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select   received = ISNULL(
		Round(
			SUM(saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * 
				(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * 
				saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((saledetail.looseqty * 
				(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) -
				saleledger.flatdisc) * 
				(saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
		Round(
			SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - 
				saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + 
				saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - 
				saleledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
	 payed    = 0.0

from     saleledger, saledetail  

where    saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and
	 (saleledger.salecatcode = 1) and
	 saleledger.posted = 'Y' and
	 saleledger.date >= @ad_StartDate and
	 saleledger.date <= @ad_EndDate

group by saleledger.saleinvcode,
	 saleledger.salecatcode, 
	 saleledger.date,
	 saleledger.discperc,
	 saleledger.misccharges,
	 saleledger.salestax,
	 saleledger.InvGSTPerc1,
	 saleledger.flatdisc

select @ln_WholeSale = ( select case 
				  when sum(received) - sum(payed) IS NULL then 0.0
				  else sum(received) - sum(payed)
				 end
			  from   #lt_CashAmts )


Delete #lt_CashAmts

/**************************Retail/Cash Sale Return *************************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select  received = 0,
	payed    = ISNULL(
		ROUND(
			SUM(srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
				(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc)) * 
				srdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
				(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) - srledger.flatdisc) * 
				(srledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
		Round(
			SUM( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
			(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) + 
			srledger.misccharges + srledger.salestax - srledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)
from     srledger, 		
	 srdetail  		

where    srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode and
	 srledger.srcatcode = 8 and
	 srledger.posted = 'Y' and
	 srledger.date >= @ad_StartDate and
	 srledger.date <= @ad_EndDate

group by srledger.srinvcode, 		
	 srledger.srcatcode,
	 srledger.date,		
	 srledger.discperc,
	 srledger.misccharges,
	 srledger.salestax,
	 srledger.InvGSTPerc1,
	 srledger.flatdisc

select @ln_RetailSaleRet = ( select case 
				  when sum(received) - sum(payed) IS NULL then 0.0
				  else sum(received) - sum(payed)
				 end
			  from   #lt_CashAmts )

Delete #lt_CashAmts


/**************************Whole Sale Return *************************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select  received = 0,
	payed    = ISNULL(
		ROUND(
			SUM(srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
				(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc)) * 
				srdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
				(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) - srledger.flatdisc) * 
				(srledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
		Round(
			SUM( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
			(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) + 
			srledger.misccharges + srledger.salestax - srledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)
from     srledger, 		
	 srdetail  		

where    srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode and		
	 srledger.srcatcode = 6 and
	 srledger.posted = 'Y' and
	 srledger.date >= @ad_StartDate and
	 srledger.date <= @ad_EndDate

group by srledger.srinvcode, 		
	 srledger.srcatcode,
	 srledger.date,		
	 srledger.discperc,
	 srledger.misccharges,
	 srledger.salestax,
	 srledger.InvGSTPerc1,
	 srledger.flatdisc

select @ln_WholeSaleRet = ( select case 
				  when sum(received) - sum(payed) IS NULL then 0.0
				  else sum(received) - sum(payed)
				 end
			  from   #lt_CashAmts )


Delete #lt_CashAmts

/**************************** Services *********************************/
/************************** Cash Services ******************************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select  received = Case 
	  	   When Round(sum((servicedetail.price) * (1 - (.01 * servicedetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * serviceheader.discperc)) + serviceheader.misccharges - serviceheader.flatdisc, 0) IS NULL THEN 0.0
		   Else Round(sum((servicedetail.price) * (1 - (.01 * servicedetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * serviceheader.discperc)) + serviceheader.misccharges - serviceheader.flatdisc, 0)
	 	   End,
	payed    = 0

from     serviceheader, servicedetail

where    serviceheader.serviceinvcode = servicedetail.serviceinvcode and
	 serviceheader.servicecatcode = 12 and 
	 serviceheader.posted = 'Y' and
	 serviceheader.date >= @ad_StartDate and
	 serviceheader.date <= @ad_EndDate 

group by serviceheader.serviceinvcode,
	 serviceheader.servicecatcode,
	 serviceheader.date,
	 serviceheader.discperc,
	 serviceheader.misccharges,
	 serviceheader.flatdisc

select @ln_ClinicSale = ( select case 
				  when sum(received) - sum(payed) IS NULL then 0.0
				  else sum(received) - sum(payed)
				 end
			  from   #lt_CashAmts )

Delete #lt_CashAmts

/**************************** Services Returns *********************************/
/************************** Cash Services Returns only ******************************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select  received = 0,
	payed    = Case 
	  	   When Round(sum((ServiceRDetail.serviceprice) * (1 - (.01 * ServiceRDetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * ServiceRHeader.discperc)) + ServiceRHeader.misccharges - ServiceRHeader.flatdisc, 0) IS NULL THEN 0.0
		   Else Round(sum((ServiceRDetail.serviceprice) * (1 - (.01 * ServiceRDetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * ServiceRHeader.discperc)) + ServiceRHeader.misccharges - ServiceRHeader.flatdisc, 0)
	 	   End

from     ServiceRHeader, ServiceRDetail

where    ServiceRHeader.serviceRinvcode = ServiceRDetail.serviceRinvcode and
	 ServiceRHeader.serviceRcatcode = 15 and 
	 ServiceRHeader.posted = 'Y' and
	 ServiceRHeader.date >= @ad_StartDate and
	 ServiceRHeader.date <= @ad_EndDate 

group by ServiceRHeader.serviceRinvcode,
	 ServiceRHeader.serviceRcatcode,
	 ServiceRHeader.date,
	 ServiceRHeader.discperc,
	 ServiceRHeader.misccharges,
	 ServiceRHeader.flatdisc

select @ln_ClinicSaleRet = ( select case 
				  when sum(received) - sum(payed) IS NULL then 0.0
				  else sum(received) - sum(payed)
				 end
			  from   #lt_CashAmts )

Delete #lt_CashAmts

/**************************** Services *********************************/
/************************** Retail Services ******************************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select  received = Case 
	  	   When Round(sum((servicedetail.price) * (1 - (.01 * servicedetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * serviceheader.discperc)) + serviceheader.misccharges - serviceheader.flatdisc, 0) IS NULL THEN 0.0
		   Else Round(sum((servicedetail.price) * (1 - (.01 * servicedetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * serviceheader.discperc)) + serviceheader.misccharges - serviceheader.flatdisc, 0)
	 	   End,
	payed    = 0

from     serviceheader, servicedetail

where    serviceheader.serviceinvcode = servicedetail.serviceinvcode and
	 serviceheader.servicecatcode = 10 and 
	 serviceheader.posted = 'Y' and
	 serviceheader.date >= @ad_StartDate and
	 serviceheader.date <= @ad_EndDate 

group by serviceheader.serviceinvcode,
	 serviceheader.servicecatcode,
	 serviceheader.date,
	 serviceheader.discperc,
	 serviceheader.misccharges,
	 serviceheader.flatdisc

select @ln_RetailService = ( select case 
				  when sum(received) - sum(payed) IS NULL then 0.0
				  else sum(received) - sum(payed)
				 end
			  from   #lt_CashAmts )

Delete #lt_CashAmts

/**************************** Services Returns *********************************/
/************************** Retail Services Returns only ******************************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select  received = 0,
	payed    = Case 
	  	   When Round(sum((ServiceRDetail.serviceprice) * (1 - (.01 * ServiceRDetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * ServiceRHeader.discperc)) + ServiceRHeader.misccharges - ServiceRHeader.flatdisc, 0) IS NULL THEN 0.0
		   Else Round(sum((ServiceRDetail.serviceprice) * (1 - (.01 * ServiceRDetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * ServiceRHeader.discperc)) + ServiceRHeader.misccharges - ServiceRHeader.flatdisc, 0)
	 	   End

from     ServiceRHeader, ServiceRDetail

where    ServiceRHeader.serviceRinvcode = ServiceRDetail.serviceRinvcode and
	 ServiceRHeader.serviceRcatcode = 13 and 
	 ServiceRHeader.posted = 'Y' and
	 ServiceRHeader.date >= @ad_StartDate and
	 ServiceRHeader.date <= @ad_EndDate 

group by ServiceRHeader.serviceRinvcode,
	 ServiceRHeader.serviceRcatcode,
	 ServiceRHeader.date,
	 ServiceRHeader.discperc,
	 ServiceRHeader.misccharges,
	 ServiceRHeader.flatdisc

select @ln_RetailServiceRet = ( select case 
				  when sum(received) - sum(payed) IS NULL then 0.0
				  else sum(received) - sum(payed)
				 end
			  from   #lt_CashAmts )


Delete #lt_CashAmts

/************************** Purchase Cash *********************************/

/************************** Packs  Purchaes *******************************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select   received = 0,
	 payed    = ISNULL(
		ROUND(
			SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty + purdetail.bonusqty) *
				purdetail.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * 
				purdetail.purprice * (1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)) * 
				purdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM(((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * 
				purdetail.purprice) * (1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) - purledger.flatdisc) * 
				(purledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
		ROUND(
			SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * purdetail.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + 
				purledger.misccharges + purledger.salestax - 
				purledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)
from     purledger,
	 purdetail	

where    purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and
	 purledger.purcatcode = 1 and
	 purledger.posted = 'Y' and
	 purledger.date >= @ad_StartDate and
	 purledger.date <= @ad_EndDate

group by purledger.purinvcode, 
	 purledger.purcatcode,
	 purledger.date,
	 purledger.discperc,
	 purledger.misccharges,
	 purledger.salestax,
	 purledger.InvGSTPerc1,
	 purledger.flatdisc

select @ln_Purchase = ( select case 
				  when sum(received) - sum(payed) IS NULL then 0.0
				  else sum(received) - sum(payed)
				 end
			  from   #lt_CashAmts )


Delete #lt_CashAmts

/************************** Purchase Cash *********************************/

/************************** Loose  Purchaes *******************************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select   received = 0,
	 payed    =  ISNULL(
		ROUND(
			SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty + purdetail.bonusqty) *
				purdetail.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * 
				purdetail.purprice * (1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)) * 
				purdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM(((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * 
				purdetail.purprice) * (1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) - purledger.flatdisc) * 
				(purledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
		ROUND(
			SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * purdetail.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + 
				purledger.misccharges + purledger.salestax - 
				purledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)

from     purledger,
	 purdetail	

where    purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and
	 purledger.purcatcode = 7 and
	 purledger.posted = 'Y' and
	 purledger.date >= @ad_StartDate and
	 purledger.date <= @ad_EndDate

group by purledger.purinvcode, 
	 purledger.purcatcode,
	 purledger.date,
	 purledger.discperc,
	 purledger.misccharges,
	 purledger.salestax,
	 purledger.InvGSTPerc1,
	 purledger.flatdisc


select @ln_PurchaseLoose = ( select case 
				  when sum(received) - sum(payed) IS NULL then 0.0
				  else sum(received) - sum(payed)
				 end
			  from   #lt_CashAmts )


Delete #lt_CashAmts

/*********************** Purchase Cash Return *****************************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select   received = ISNULL(
		ROUND(
			SUM((prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.bonusqty) * prdetail.unitsalestax)+
			SUM(ROUND(prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc)) * 
				prdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM((prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice) * 
				(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * prledger.discperc)) - prledger.flatdisc) * 
				(prledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
		ROUND(
			SUM((prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice) * 
				(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * prledger.discperc)) + prledger.misccharges + 
				prledger.salestax - prledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
	 payed    = 0

from     prledger, 
	 prdetail		

where    prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode and

	 prledger.prcatcode = 4  and
	 prledger.posted = 'Y' and
	 prledger.date >= @ad_StartDate and
	 prledger.date <= @ad_EndDate
group by prledger.prinvcode, 
	 prledger.prcatcode, 
	 prledger.date,
	 prledger.discperc,
	 prledger.misccharges,
	 prledger.salestax,
	 prledger.InvGSTPerc1,
	 prledger.flatdisc

select @ln_PurchaseRet = ( select case

name: SP_CheckDBIntegrity
definition:
-- SP_CheckDBIntegrity
CREATE  PROC DBO.SP_CheckDBIntegrity @DB SYSNAME=NULL
AS
TRUNCATE TABLE DBCC_History

DECLARE @RC int
DECLARE @VersionInfo varchar(4000), @DBVersion VARCHAR(100)
-- Set parameter values
EXEC @RC = SP_DBMS_Version @VersionInfo OUTPUT 
SELECT @VersionInfo 
IF CHARINDEX('Microsoft SQL Server 2012', @VersionInfo, 1) > 0 
	SET @DBVersion = '2012'
ELSE
	SET @DBVersion = '2000'

IF @DB IS NULL -- Run against all databases
BEGIN
	DECLARE database_cursor CURSOR FOR
	SELECT name
	FROM master.dbo.sysdatabases db
	WHERE db.name NOT IN ('master','model','msdb','tempdb')

	OPEN database_cursor
	FETCH next FROM database_cursor INTO @DB
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
	BEGIN
		IF @DBVersion = '2012'
			INSERT INTO DBCC_History (
			ErrorID, LevelID, StateID, MessageText, RepairLevel, StatusID,
			DbId, DBFragID, ObjectId, IndId, PartitionID, AllocUnitID, 
			RidDbId, RidPruId, FileID, PageID, SlotID, RefDBID, RefPruID, 
			RefFileID, RefPageID, RefSlotID, AllocationID)
			EXEC ('dbcc checkdb(''' + @DB + ''') with tableresults, ALL_ERRORMSGS')
		ELSE
			INSERT INTO DBCC_History (
			ErrorID, LevelID, StateID, MessageText, RepairLevel, StatusID,
			DbId, ObjectId, IndId, FileID, PageID, SlotID, RefFileID, 
			RefPageID, RefSlotID, AllocationID)
			EXEC ('dbcc checkdb(''' + @DB + ''') with tableresults, ALL_ERRORMSGS')
		IF @@Error <> 0
		BEGIN
			CLOSE database_cursor
			DEALLOCATE database_cursor
			RETURN @@Error
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM database_cursor INTO @DB
	END
	CLOSE database_cursor
	DEALLOCATE database_cursor
END
ELSE -- run against a specified database (ie: usp_CheckDBIntegrity 'DB Name Here'
BEGIN
	IF @DBVersion = '2012'
		INSERT INTO DBCC_History (
		ErrorID, LevelID, StateID, MessageText, RepairLevel, StatusID,
		DbId, DBFragID, ObjectId, IndId, PartitionID, AllocUnitID, 
		RidDbId, RidPruId, FileID, PageID, SlotID, RefDBID, RefPruID, 
		RefFileID, RefPageID, RefSlotID, AllocationID)
		EXEC ('dbcc checkdb(''' + @DB + ''') with tableresults, ALL_ERRORMSGS')
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO DBCC_History(
		ErrorID, LevelID, StateID, MessageText, RepairLevel, StatusID,
		DbId, ObjectId, IndId, FileID, PageID, SlotID, RefFileID, 
		RefPageID, RefSlotID, AllocationID)
		EXEC ('dbcc checkdb(''' + @DB + ''') with tableresults, ALL_ERRORMSGS')
	IF @@Error <> 0
	BEGIN
		CLOSE database_cursor
		DEALLOCATE database_cursor
		RETURN @@Error
	END
END

UPDATE DBCC_History
SET DB = (SELECT db.name FROM master.dbo.sysdatabases db WHERE db.dbid = DBCC_History.dbid),
	Object = (SELECT o.name FROM sysobjects o WHERE o.id = DBCC_History.objectid)
WHERE DB IS NULL OR Object IS NULL
IF @@Error <> 0
BEGIN
	CLOSE database_cursor
	DEALLOCATE database_cursor
	RETURN @@Error
END
RETURN 0

-- SP_CheckPacketCounters
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CheckPacketCounters @srv VARCHAR(100), @DB VARCHAR(255), @Owner VARCHAR(100)
AS
DECLARE @Qry VARCHAR(4000), @FROM VARCHAR(255), @ArchiveAccountsData CHAR(1)
DECLARE @rtCode INT, @err INT, @SaleDiff INT, @PurDiff INT
DELETE REPORTDATA
SET @FROM = N' FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.'

SET @Qry = 'INSERT INTO ReportData (Name1, Code1) ' + 
	'SELECT ''Sales'', Diff=ISNULL((SELECT MIN(SaleInvCode) ' + 
	@FROM + 'SaleLedger), ISNULL((SELECT MAX(SaleInvCode) FROM SaleLedger), 0)) - ISNULL((SELECT MAX(SaleInvCode) FROM SaleLedger), 0) ' +
/*
	' UNION ALL ' +
	'SELECT ''Purchase'', Diff=ISNULL((SELECT MIN(PurInvCode) ' +
	@FROM + 'PurLedger), ISNULL((SELECT MAX(PurInvCode) FROM PurLedger), 0)) - ISNULL((SELECT MAX(PurInvCode) FROM PurLedger), 0)' +
*/
	' UNION ALL ' +
	'SELECT ''Service Sale'', Diff=ISNULL((SELECT MIN(ServiceInvCode) ' +
	@FROM + 'ServiceHeader), ISNULL((SELECT MAX(ServiceInvCode) FROM ServiceHeader), 0)) - ISNULL((SELECT MAX(ServiceInvCode) FROM ServiceHeader), 0)' +
	' UNION ALL ' +
	'SELECT ''Service Purchase'', Diff=ISNULL((SELECT MIN(ServicePurInvCode) ' +
	@FROM + 'ServicePurHeader), ISNULL((SELECT MAX(ServicePurInvCode) FROM ServicePurHeader), 0)) - ISNULL((SELECT MAX(ServicePurInvCode) FROM ServicePurHeader), 0)' +
	' UNION ALL ' +
	'SELECT ''A/c Voucher'', Diff=ISNULL((SELECT MIN(GLVochCode) ' +
	@FROM + 'GLHeader), ISNULL((SELECT MAX(GLVochCode) FROM GLHeader), 0)) - ISNULL((SELECT MAX(GLVochCode) FROM GLHeader), 0)' +
	' UNION ALL ' +
	'SELECT ''Notes Receiveable/Payable'', Diff=ISNULL((SELECT MIN(NoteCode) ' +
	@FROM + 'Notes), ISNULL((SELECT MAX(NoteCode) FROM Notes), 0)) - ISNULL((SELECT MAX(NoteCode) FROM Notes), 0)' +
	' UNION ALL ' +
	'SELECT ''Transaction Data'', Diff=ISNULL((SELECT MIN(DocumentCode) ' +
	@FROM + 'TransactionHeader ), ISNULL((SELECT MAX(DocumentCode) FROM TransactionHeader), 0)) - ISNULL((SELECT MAX(DocumentCode) FROM TransactionHeader), 0)'

EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@Error
IF @err <> 0 OR @rtCode <> 0 
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Failure to check version difference of Data Migration Packet and Current Database, Error Code = %d', 16, 1, @err)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @SaleDiff = ISNULL((SELECT Code1 FROM ReportData WHERE Name1 = 'Sales'), 0)
IF @SaleDiff < 0 OR @SaleDiff > 1
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('The Data Migration Packet is not the correct version to aquire into current database (sales), Error Code = %d', 16, 1, @SaleDiff)
	RETURN -1
END
/*
SET @PurDiff = ISNULL((SELECT Code1 FROM ReportData WHERE Name1 = 'Purchase'), 0)
IF @PurDiff < 0 OR @PurDiff > 1
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('The Data Migration Packet is not the correct version to aquire into current database (Purchase), Error Code = %d', 16, 1, @PurDiff)
	RETURN -1
END
*/
SET @SaleDiff = ISNULL((SELECT Code1 FROM ReportData WHERE Name1 = 'Service Sale'), 0)
IF @SaleDiff < 0 OR @SaleDiff > 1
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('The Data Migration Packet is not the correct version to aquire into current database (service sales), Error Code = %d', 16, 1, @SaleDiff)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @PurDiff = ISNULL((SELECT Code1 FROM ReportData WHERE Name1 = 'Service Purchase'), 0)
IF @PurDiff < 0 OR @PurDiff > 1
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('The Data Migration Packet is not the correct version to aquire into current database (Service Purchase), Error Code = %d', 16, 1, @PurDiff)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @ArchiveAccountsData = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('archiveaccountingdata')
SET @ArchiveAccountsData = ISNULL(@ArchiveAccountsData,'N')
IF @ArchiveAccountsData= 'Y'
BEGIN
	SET @PurDiff = ISNULL((SELECT Code1 FROM ReportData WHERE Name1 = 'A/c Voucher'), 0)
	IF @PurDiff < 0 OR @PurDiff > 1
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The Data Migration Packet is not the correct version to aquire into current database (A/c Voucher), Error Code = %d', 16, 1, @PurDiff)
		RETURN -1
	END
	
	SET @PurDiff = ISNULL((SELECT Code1 FROM ReportData WHERE Name1 = 'Notes Receiveable/Payable'), 0)
	IF @PurDiff < 0 OR @PurDiff > 1
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The Data Migration Packet is not the correct version to aquire into current database (Notes Receiveable/Payable), Error Code = %d', 16, 1, @PurDiff)
		RETURN -1
	END
	SET @PurDiff = ISNULL((SELECT Code1 FROM ReportData WHERE Name1 = 'Transaction Data'), 0)
	IF @PurDiff < 0 OR @PurDiff > 1
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The Data Migration Packet is not the correct version to aquire into current database (Transaction Data), Error Code = %d', 16, 1, @PurDiff)
		RETURN -1
	END
END
RETURN 0

CREATE PROC DBO.SP_CheckTable @DB VARCHAR(255), @Object VARCHAR(255), @Option INT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @Qry VARCHAR(1000)
IF @DB IS NULL
	RETURN 0

IF @Object IS NULL
	RETURN 0

IF @Option IS NULL
	RETURN 0

SET @Qry = 'dbcc CheckTable(''' + @Object + ''''
IF @Option = 0
	SET @Qry = @Qry + ''
IF @Option = 1
	SET @Qry = @Qry + ', REPAIR_FAST'
IF @Option = 2
	SET @Qry = @Qry + ', REPAIR_REBUILD'
IF @Option = 3
	SET @Qry = @Qry + ', REPAIR_ALLOW_DATA_LOSS'

SET @Qry = @Qry + ') with tableresults, ALL_ERRORMSGS'
EXEC (@Qry)
IF @@Error <> 0
BEGIN
	RETURN @@Error
END
INSERT INTO DBO.DBRepairLog (Date, RepairLevel, ObjectName)
SELECT Date=GETDATE(), 
	RepairLevel=CASE @Option WHEN 1 THEN 'REPAIR_FAST' WHEN 2 THEN 'REPAIR_REBUILD' WHEN 3 THEN 'REPAIR_ALLOW_DATA_LOSS' ELSE '' END, 
	ObjectName=@Object

RETURN 0

Where

	PRALLocationHeader.PRInvCode = @invcode  AND

ELSE

					RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(PRALLocationHeader.PRAllocationCode, 10)))
			FROM   PRALLocationHeader

				PRALLocationHeader.PRInvCode = @invcode  AND

name: SP_CheckUnpostedPurInvInTransactions

-- SP_CheckUnpostedPurInvInTransactions
CREATE   PROCEDURE SP_CheckUnpostedPurInvInTransactions 
	@invcode INT, 
	@code INT, 
	@callermodule VARCHAR(10), 
	@rowscount INT OUTPUT,
	@msg VARCHAR(1000) OUTPUT  
AS    

SELECT @rowscount=SUM(ISNULL(C, 0))  
FROM  (
	SELECT C=0
	UNION ALL
	SELECT    C=Count(NotesDetail.InvoiceCode)
	FROM    NotesDetail, Notes
	Where    Notes.Posted = 'N' AND Notes.Finalized = 'N' AND
	Notes.NoteCatCode = 2 AND
	Notes.NoteCode = NotesDetail.NoteCode AND
	NotesDetail.InvoiceCode = @invcode AND
	NotesDetail.NoteCode <>
		CASE @callermodule WHEN 'NP' THEN
			CASE WHEN @code IS NULL THEN -1
			ELSE @code END ELSE -1 END
	UNION ALL
	SELECT    C=Count(PurPayment.PurInvCode)
	FROM PurPayment
	Where    PurPayment.Posted = 'N' AND   
	PurPayment.PurInvCode = @invcode AND   
	PurPayment.PurPaymentCode <> 
		CASE @callermodule WHEN 'PP' THEN 
			CASE WHEN @code IS NULL THEN -1 ELSE @code END ELSE -1 END  
	UNION ALL
	SELECT    C=Count(GLDetail.InvoiceCode)   
	FROM    GLDetail, GLHeader, VocherCategory  
	Where    GLHeader.Posted = 'N' AND   
	GLHeader.GLVochCode = GLDetail.GLVochCode AND   
	GLDetail.InvoiceCode = @invcode AND   
	VocherCategory.InvoiceType = 2 AND   
	VocherCategory.VochCatCode = GLHeader.VochCatCode AND   
	GLDetail.GLVochCode <> 
		CASE @callermodule WHEN 'V' THEN 
			CASE WHEN @code IS NULL THEN -1 ELSE @code END ELSE -1 END  
	UNION ALL  
	SELECT    C=Count(PRALLocationDetail.PurInvCode)   
	FROM    PRALLocationDetail, PRALLocationHeader   
	Where    PRALLocationHeader.Posted = 'N' AND   
	PRALLocationHeader.PRALLocationCode = PRALLocationDetail.PRALLocationCode AND   
	PRALLocationDetail.PurInvCode = @invcode AND   
	PRALLocationDetail.PRALLocationCode <> 
		CASE @callermodule WHEN 'PRA' THEN 
			CASE WHEN @code IS NULL THEN -1 ELSE @code END ELSE -1 END) P

IF @rowscount = 0
	BEGIN
		SET @Msg = ''
	END
ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT @Msg = MAX(M)
		FROM
		(SELECT M = 'Module: Post-Dated Cheque Payable' + char(13) + char(10) + 'Code: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(Notes.NoteCode, 10)))
		FROM    NotesDetail, Notes
		Where    Notes.Posted = 'N' AND Notes.Finalized = 'N' AND
		Notes.NoteCatCode = 2 AND
		Notes.NoteCode = NotesDetail.NoteCode AND

-- SP_CheckUnpostedTransactionOfAnItem
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_CheckUnpostedTransactionOfAnItem
	@icode INT, 
	@rowscount INT OUTPUT,
	@Msg VARCHAR(1000) OUTPUT
AS

SET @rowscount = 
ISNULL((SELECT C=SUM(ISNULL(C, 0))  
FROM  
	(SELECT C=0
	UNION ALL
	SELECT C=Count(D.ICode)
	FROM PurDetail D, PurLedger H
	Where H.Posted = 'N' AND H.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND D.ICode = @icode
	UNION ALL  
	SELECT C=Count(D.ICode)
	FROM PrDetail D, PrLedger H
	Where H.Posted = 'N' AND H.PrInvCode = D.PrInvCode AND D.ICode = @icode
	UNION ALL  
	SELECT C=Count(D.ICode)
	FROM SaleDetail D, SaleLedger H
	Where H.Posted = 'N' AND H.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND D.ICode = @icode
	UNION ALL  
	SELECT C=Count(D.ICode)
	FROM SRDetail D, SRLedger H
	Where H.Posted = 'N' AND H.SRInvCode = D.SRInvCode AND D.ICode = @icode
	UNION ALL  
	SELECT C=Count(D.ICode)
	FROM SRBufferDetail D, SRBufferLedger H
	Where H.Posted = 'N' AND H.SRBufferInvCode = D.SRBufferInvCode AND D.ICode = @icode
	UNION ALL  
	SELECT C=Count(D.ICode)
	FROM AdjDetail D, AdjHeader H
	Where H.Posted = 'N' AND H.AdjCode = D.AdjCode AND D.ICode = @icode
	UNION ALL  
	SELECT C=Count(D.ICode)
	FROM IssueDetail D, IssueHeader H
	Where H.Posted = 'N' AND H.IssueInvCode = D.IssueInvCode AND D.ICode = @icode
	UNION ALL  
	SELECT C=Count(D.ICode)
	FROM ReceiptDetail D, ReceiptHeader H
	Where H.Posted = 'N' AND H.ReceiptInvCode = D.ReceiptInvCode AND D.ICode = @icode
	UNION ALL  
	SELECT C=Count(D.ICode)
	FROM TDetail D, THeader H
	Where H.Posted = 'N' AND H.TransCode = D.TransCode  AND D.ICode = @icode) S), 0)

IF @rowscount = 0
BEGIN
	SET @Msg = ''
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SET @Msg = 'Some Unposted Transactions Exist for This Item.'
END
RETURN 0
