DECLARE @refund NUMERIC(10, 2), @refundamt NUMERIC(10, 2), @InvTotal NUMERIC(15, 2), @Sale_InvTotal NUMERIC(15, 2), @Ret_InvTotal NUMERIC(15, 2), @InvTotal_Diff NUMERIC(15, 2)
DECLARE @SaleInvCode INT, @SRInvCode INT
Declare @sale_rowcount INT, @continue Int, @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @invcounter Int, @invcode int
DECLARE @sale NUMERIC(15, 4), @salereturn NUMERIC(15, 4)
DECLARE @ThisChildServer VARCHAR(100), @FLAG INT, @invtype INT
DECLARE @dt DATETIME

SET @invtype = 1
WHILE @invtype <= 3
BEGIN
	Create Table #saletemp ( 
		id int not null identity(1,1), 
		ChildServer VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
		InvCode int, 
		Sale NUMERIC(15, 4), 
		SaleReturn NUMERIC(15, 4), 
		RefundAmt NUMERIC(10, 2), 
		InvTotal NUMERIC(15, 2)
	)
	
	Insert Into #saletemp ( ChildServer, InvCode, Sale, SaleReturn, RefundAmt, InvTotal)
	Select H.ChildServer, InvCode=H.SaleInvCode, 
		Sale=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(D.LooseQty) FROM IMP_SaleDetail D WHERE H.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND D.LooseQty > 0), 0), 
		SaleReturn=0,
		RefundAmt=0, H.InvTotal
	From IMP_SaleLedger H WITH (UPDLOCK HOLDLOCK)
	Where 	@invtype = 1 AND
		H.ChildServer = CASE WHEN LEN(@childserver) > 0 THEN @childserver ELSE H.ChildServer END AND
		H.Transmit = 'Y' AND H.Transmited = 'N'
	UNION ALL
	Select H.ChildServer, InvCode=H.SRInvCode, 
		Sale=0.00, 
		SaleReturn=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(D.LooseQty) FROM IMP_SRDetail D WHERE H.SRInvCode = D.SRInvCode AND D.LooseQty > 0), 0),
		RefundAmt=0, H.InvTotal
	From IMP_SRLedger H WITH (UPDLOCK HOLDLOCK)
	Where 	@invtype = 3 AND
		H.ChildServer = CASE WHEN LEN(@childserver) > 0 THEN @childserver ELSE H.ChildServer END AND
		H.Transmit = 'Y' AND H.Transmited = 'N'
	UNION ALL
	Select H.ChildServer, InvCode=H.AdvSaleInvCode, 
		Sale=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(D.LooseQty) FROM IMP_advsaleDetail D WHERE H.AdvSaleInvCode = D.AdvSaleInvCode AND D.LooseQty > 0), 0), 
		SaleReturn=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ABS(D.LooseQty)) FROM IMP_advsaleDetail D WHERE H.AdvSaleInvCode = D.AdvSaleInvCode AND D.LooseQty < 0), 0),
		H.RefundAmt, H.InvTotal
	From IMP_AdvSaleLedger H WITH (UPDLOCK HOLDLOCK)
	Where 	@invtype = 2 AND
		H.ChildServer = CASE WHEN LEN(@childserver) > 0 THEN @childserver ELSE H.ChildServer END AND
		H.Transmit = 'Y' AND H.Transmited = 'N'
	Order By H.ChildServer, InvCode
	
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@RowCount < 0
	BEGIN
		IF @invtype = 1
			RaisError( 'Unable to Fetch Information of Sale Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @invcode)
		IF @invtype = 3
			RaisError( 'Unable to Fetch Information of S/R Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @invcode)
		ELSE
			RaisError( 'Unable to Fetch Information of Advance Sale Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @invcode)
		Set @continue  = -1								
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		Set @sale_rowcount = ISNULL((Select count(*) from #saletemp), 0)
		Set @continue = 0
		Set @invcounter = 1
	END
	
	While (@sale_rowcount > 0) And (@continue >= 0) AND (@invcounter <= @sale_rowcount)
	Begin
		SELECT @invcode = InvCode, 
			@Sale = ISNULL(Sale, 0), 
			@SaleReturn = ISNULL(SaleReturn, 0),
			@refundamt = ISNULL(RefundAmt, 0),
			@ThisChildServer = ChildServer,
			@InvTotal = InvTotal,
			@SaleInvCode = NULL,
			@SRInvCode = NULL
		FROM #saletemp 
		WHERE ID = @invcounter
		
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@RowCount <= 0
		BEGIN
			IF @invtype = 1
				RaisError( 'Unable to Fetch Information of Sale Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @invcode)
			IF @invtype = 3
				RaisError( 'Unable to Fetch Information of S/R Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @invcode)
			ELSE
				RaisError( 'Unable to Fetch Information of Advance Sale Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @invcode)
			Set @continue  = -1								
		END
	
		IF @Sale > 0 AND @continue=0
		BEGIN
			-- IF there is no sale return but refund amt on adv. sale exists then merge it with overall flat discount
			IF @refundamt > 0 AND @SaleReturn = 0 
				SET @refund = @refundamt
			ELSE
				SET @refund = 0
	
			set @continue = 0
	
			Execute @rt_code = sp_Translate_ChildeServer_Sale @ThisChildServer, @invtype, @invcode, @usercode, @refund, @SaleInvCode
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
			Begin
				IF @invtype = 1
					RaisError( 'Unable to Generate Sale Invoice No. %d FROM Sale Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @SaleInvCode, @invcode)
				ELSE
					RaisError( 'Unable to Generate Sale Invoice No. %d FROM Advance Sale Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @SaleInvCode, @invcode)
				Set @continue  = -1								
			End
	
			IF @SaleInvCode > 0
				Set @Sale_InvTotal = dbo.fn_getSaleInvTotal (@SaleInvCode)
			ELSE
				Set @Sale_InvTotal = 0
	
			SET @FLAG = 1
		END
		IF @SaleReturn > 0 AND @continue = 0
		BEGIN
			IF @invtype = 2
			BEGIN
				-- IF refund amt on adv. sale exists then merge it with sales return
				IF @refundamt > 0
					SET @refund = @refundamt
				ELSE
					SET @refund = 0
	
				set @continue = 0
				Execute @rt_code = sp_Translate_ChildeServer_SaleReturn @ThisChildServer, @invcode, @usercode, @refund, @SRInvCode
				IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
				Begin
					RaisError( 'Unable to Generate Sale Return No. %d FROM Advance Sale Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @SRInvCode, @invcode)
					Set @continue  = -1								
				End
			END
			IF @invtype = 3
			BEGIN
				SET @refund = 0
	
				set @continue = 0
				Execute @rt_code = sp_Translate_ChildeServer_SReturn @ThisChildServer, @invcode, @usercode, @SRInvCode OUTPUT
				IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
				Begin
					RaisError( 'Unable to Generate Sale Return No. %d FROM Old S/R No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @SRInvCode, @invcode)
					Set @continue  = -1								
				End
			END
			
	
			IF @SRInvCode > 0
				Set @Ret_InvTotal = dbo.fn_getSRInvTotal (@SRInvCode)
			ELSE
				Set @Ret_InvTotal = 0
	
			SET @FLAG = 1
		END
	
		IF @invtype = 2
			SET @InvTotal_Diff = ISNULL(@InvTotal, 0) - ISNULL(@Sale_InvTotal, 0) - ISNULL(@Ret_InvTotal, 0)
	
		IF @SaleInvCode > 0
		BEGIN
			IF @InvTotal_Diff > 0
				UPDATE Dbo.SaleLedger SET MiscCharges = ISNULL(MiscCharges, 0) + @InvTotal_Diff WHERE SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode
	
			IF @InvTotal_Diff < 0
			BEGIN
				IF @Sale_InvTotal > ABS(@InvTotal_Diff)
					UPDATE Dbo.SaleLedger SET FlatDisc = ISNULL(FlatDisc, 0) + ABS(@InvTotal_Diff) WHERE SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode
				ELSE
					UPDATE Dbo.SaleLedger SET FlatDisc = ISNULL(FlatDisc, 0) + ISNULL(@Sale_InvTotal, 0) WHERE SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode
	
				UPDATE Dbo.SaleLedger SET InvTotal = ISNULL(dbo.fn_getSaleInvTotal (@SaleInvCode), 0) WHERE SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode
			END
	
			Set @Sale_InvTotal = dbo.fn_getSaleInvTotal (@SaleInvCode)
		END
		ELSE
			Set @Sale_InvTotal = 0
	
		SET @InvTotal_Diff = ISNULL(@InvTotal, 0) - ISNULL(@Sale_InvTotal, 0) - ISNULL(@Ret_InvTotal, 0)
	
		IF @SRInvCode > 0
		BEGIN
			-- If No sales but only return exists then swap flatdisc and mischarges to keep totals intact
			IF @sale <= 0 AND @invtype <> 3
				UPDATE Dbo.SRLedger 
				SET FlatDisc = ISNULL(MiscCharges, 0), 
					MiscCharges = ISNULL(FlatDisc, 0) 
				WHERE SRInvCode = @SRInvCode
	
			IF @InvTotal_Diff > 0 AND @SaleInvCode <= 0 AND @invtype <> 3
				IF @Ret_InvTotal > ABS(@InvTotal_Diff)
					UPDATE Dbo.SRLedger SET FlatDisc = ISNULL(FlatDisc, 0) + ABS(@InvTotal_Diff) WHERE SRInvCode = @SRInvCode
				ELSE
					UPDATE Dbo.SRLedger SET FlatDisc = ISNULL(FlatDisc, 0) + ABS(@Ret_InvTotal) WHERE SRInvCode = @SRInvCode
	
			IF @InvTotal_Diff < 0 AND @invtype <> 3
				UPDATE Dbo.SRLedger SET MiscCharges = ISNULL(MiscCharges, 0) + ABS(@InvTotal_Diff) WHERE SRInvCode = @SRInvCode
	
			UPDATE Dbo.SRLedger SET InvTotal = ISNULL(dbo.fn_getSRInvTotal (@SRInvCode), 0) WHERE SRInvCode = @SRInvCode
	
	--		Set @Ret_InvTotal = dbo.fn_getSRInvTotal (@SRInvCode)
		END
	
		Set @invcounter = @invcounter + 1	
	End
	
	IF @continue=0 
	BEGIN
		IF @invtype = 1
			UPDATE IMP_SaleLedger SET Transmited = 'Y'
			WHERE ChildServer = CASE WHEN LEN(@childserver) > 0 THEN @childserver ELSE ChildServer END AND
				Transmit = 'Y' AND Transmited = 'N'
		IF @invtype = 3
			UPDATE IMP_SRLedger SET Transmited = 'Y'
			WHERE ChildServer = CASE WHEN LEN(@childserver) > 0 THEN @childserver ELSE ChildServer END AND
				Transmit = 'Y' AND Transmited = 'N'
		ELSE
			UPDATE IMP_AdvSaleLedger SET Transmited = 'Y'
			WHERE ChildServer = CASE WHEN LEN(@childserver) > 0 THEN @childserver ELSE ChildServer END AND
				Transmit = 'Y' AND Transmited = 'N'
	END
	
	IF @continue=0 AND @FLAG=1
	BEGIN
		SET @dt = GETDATE()
		set @continue = 0
		Execute @rt_code = SP_Set_DateTime_Preference 'LastSaleSynchronized', @dt
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
		Begin
			RaisError( 'Unable to Record Last Sale Synchronization Information in Software Preferences' , 16 , 1)
			Set @continue  = -1								
		End
	END
	
	Drop Table #saletemp
	SET @invtype = @invtype + 1
END
Return @continue

name: sp_ChildServer_Sale_Translation
definition:
-- sp_ChildServer_Sale_Translation
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_ChildServer_Sale_Translation
	@childserver VarChar(100), 
	@invtype int,
	@custcode INT,
	@startdate DateTime, 
	@enddate DateTime,
	@usercode Int
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

DECLARE @refund NUMERIC(10, 2), @refundamt NUMERIC(10, 2), @InvTotal NUMERIC(15, 2), @Sale_InvTotal NUMERIC(15, 2), @Ret_InvTotal NUMERIC(15, 2), @InvTotal_Diff NUMERIC(15, 2)
DECLARE @SaleInvCode INT, @SRInvCode INT
Declare @sale_rowcount INT, @continue Int, @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @invcounter Int, @invcode int
DECLARE @sale NUMERIC(15, 4), @salereturn NUMERIC(15, 4)
DECLARE @ThisChildServer VARCHAR(100), @FLAG INT
DECLARE @dt DATETIME

Create Table #saletemp ( 
	id int not null identity(1,1), 
	ChildServer VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	InvCode int, 
	Sale NUMERIC(15, 4), 
	SaleReturn NUMERIC(15, 4), 
	RefundAmt NUMERIC(10, 2), 
	InvTotal NUMERIC(15, 2)
)

Insert Into #saletemp ( ChildServer, InvCode, Sale, SaleReturn, RefundAmt, InvTotal)
Select H.ChildServer, InvCode=H.SaleInvCode, 
	Sale=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(D.LooseQty) FROM IMP_SaleDetail D WHERE H.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND D.LooseQty > 0), 0), 
	SaleReturn=0,
	RefundAmt=0, H.InvTotal
From IMP_SaleLedger H WITH (UPDLOCK HOLDLOCK)
Where 	@invtype = 1 AND
	H.CustCode = CASE WHEN @CustCode > 0 THEN @CustCode ELSE H.CustCode END AND
	H.ChildServer = CASE WHEN LEN(@childserver) > 0 THEN @childserver ELSE H.ChildServer END AND
	H.Transmit = 'Y' AND H.Transmited = 'N' AND 
	H.Date BETWEEN @startdate AND @enddate
UNION ALL
Select H.ChildServer, InvCode=H.SRInvCode, 
	Sale=0.00, 
	SaleReturn=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(D.LooseQty) FROM IMP_SRDetail D WHERE H.SRInvCode = D.SRInvCode AND D.LooseQty > 0), 0),
	RefundAmt=0, H.InvTotal
From IMP_SRLedger H WITH (UPDLOCK HOLDLOCK)
Where 	@invtype = 3 AND
	H.CustCode = CASE WHEN @CustCode > 0 THEN @CustCode ELSE H.CustCode END AND
	H.ChildServer = CASE WHEN LEN(@childserver) > 0 THEN @childserver ELSE H.ChildServer END AND
	H.Transmit = 'Y' AND H.Transmited = 'N' AND 
	H.Date BETWEEN @startdate AND @enddate
UNION ALL
Select H.ChildServer, InvCode=H.AdvSaleInvCode, 
	Sale=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(D.LooseQty) FROM IMP_advsaleDetail D WHERE H.AdvSaleInvCode = D.AdvSaleInvCode AND D.LooseQty > 0), 0), 
	SaleReturn=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ABS(D.LooseQty)) FROM IMP_advsaleDetail D WHERE H.AdvSaleInvCode = D.AdvSaleInvCode AND D.LooseQty < 0), 0),
	H.RefundAmt, H.InvTotal
From IMP_AdvSaleLedger H WITH (UPDLOCK HOLDLOCK)
Where 	@invtype = 2 AND
	H.CustCode = CASE WHEN @CustCode > 0 THEN @CustCode ELSE H.CustCode END AND
	H.ChildServer = CASE WHEN LEN(@childserver) > 0 THEN @childserver ELSE H.ChildServer END AND
	H.Transmit = 'Y' AND H.Transmited = 'N' AND 
	H.Date BETWEEN @startdate AND @enddate
Order By H.ChildServer, InvCode

IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@RowCount <= 0
BEGIN
	IF @invtype = 1
		RaisError( 'Unable to Fetch Information of Sale Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @invcode)
	IF @invtype = 3
		RaisError( 'Unable to Fetch Information of S/R Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @invcode)
	ELSE
		RaisError( 'Unable to Fetch Information of Advance Sale Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @invcode)
	Set @continue  = -1								
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	Set @sale_rowcount = ISNULL((Select count(*) from #saletemp), 0)
	Set @continue = 0
	Set @invcounter = 1
END

While (@sale_rowcount > 0) And (@continue >= 0) AND (@invcounter <= @sale_rowcount)
Begin
	SELECT @invcode = InvCode, 
		@Sale = ISNULL(Sale, 0), 
		@SaleReturn = ISNULL(SaleReturn, 0),
		@refundamt = ISNULL(RefundAmt, 0),
		@ThisChildServer = ChildServer,
		@InvTotal = InvTotal,
		@SaleInvCode = NULL,
		@SRInvCode = NULL
	FROM #saletemp 
	WHERE ID = @invcounter
	
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@RowCount <= 0
	BEGIN
		IF @invtype = 1
			RaisError( 'Unable to Fetch Information of Sale Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @invcode)
		IF @invtype = 3
			RaisError( 'Unable to Fetch Information of S/R Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @invcode)
		ELSE
			RaisError( 'Unable to Fetch Information of Advance Sale Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @invcode)
		Set @continue  = -1								
	END

	IF @Sale > 0 AND @continue=0
	BEGIN
		-- IF there is no sale return but refund amt on adv. sale exists then merge it with overall flat discount
		IF @refundamt > 0 AND @SaleReturn = 0 
			SET @refund = @refundamt
		ELSE
			SET @refund = 0

		set @continue = 0

		Execute @rt_code = sp_Translate_ChildeServer_Sale @ThisChildServer, @invtype, @invcode, @usercode, @refund, @SaleInvCode
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
		Begin
			IF @invtype = 1
				RaisError( 'Unable to Generate Sale Invoice No. %d FROM Sale Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @SaleInvCode, @invcode)
			ELSE
				RaisError( 'Unable to Generate Sale Invoice No. %d FROM Advance Sale Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @SaleInvCode, @invcode)
			Set @continue  = -1								
		End

		IF @SaleInvCode > 0
			Set @Sale_InvTotal = dbo.fn_getSaleInvTotal (@SaleInvCode)
		ELSE
			Set @Sale_InvTotal = 0

		SET @FLAG = 1
	END
	IF @SaleReturn > 0 AND @continue = 0
	BEGIN
		IF @invtype = 2
		BEGIN
			-- IF refund amt on adv. sale exists then merge it with sales return
			IF @refundamt > 0
				SET @refund = @refundamt
			ELSE
				SET @refund = 0

			set @continue = 0
			Execute @rt_code = sp_Translate_ChildeServer_SaleReturn @ThisChildServer, @invcode, @usercode, @refund, @SRInvCode
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
			Begin
				RaisError( 'Unable to Generate Sale Return No. %d FROM Advance Sale Inv. No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @SRInvCode, @invcode)
				Set @continue  = -1								
			End
		END
		IF @invtype = 3
		BEGIN
			SET @refund = 0

			set @continue = 0
			Execute @rt_code = sp_Translate_ChildeServer_SReturn @ThisChildServer, @invcode, @usercode, @SRInvCode OUTPUT
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
			Begin
				RaisError( 'Unable to Generate Sale Return No. %d FROM Old S/R No. %d ' , 16 , 1 , @SRInvCode, @invcode)
				Set @continue  = -1								
			End
		END
		

		IF @SRInvCode > 0
			Set @Ret_InvTotal = dbo.fn_getSRInvTotal (@SRInvCode)
		ELSE
			Set @Ret_InvTotal = 0

		SET @FLAG = 1
	END

	IF @invtype = 2
		SET @InvTotal_Diff = ISNULL(@InvTotal, 0) - ISNULL(@Sale_InvTotal, 0) - ISNULL(@Ret_InvTotal, 0)

	IF @SaleInvCode > 0
	BEGIN
		IF @InvTotal_Diff > 0
			UPDATE Dbo.SaleLedger SET MiscCharges = ISNULL(MiscCharges, 0) + @InvTotal_Diff WHERE SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode

		IF @InvTotal_Diff < 0
		BEGIN
			IF @Sale_InvTotal > ABS(@InvTotal_Diff)
				UPDATE Dbo.SaleLedger SET FlatDisc = ISNULL(FlatDisc, 0) + ABS(@InvTotal_Diff) WHERE SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode
			ELSE
				UPDATE Dbo.SaleLedger SET FlatDisc = ISNULL(FlatDisc, 0) + ISNULL(@Sale_InvTotal, 0) WHERE SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode

			UPDATE Dbo.SaleLedger SET InvTotal = ISNULL(dbo.fn_getSaleInvTotal (@SaleInvCode), 0) WHERE SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode
		END

		Set @Sale_InvTotal = dbo.fn_getSaleInvTotal (@SaleInvCode)
	END
	ELSE
		Set @Sale_InvTotal = 0

	SET @InvTotal_Diff = ISNULL(@InvTotal, 0) - ISNULL(@Sale_InvTotal, 0) - ISNULL(@Ret_InvTotal, 0)

	IF @SRInvCode > 0
	BEGIN
		-- If No sales but only return exists then swap flatdisc and mischarges to keep totals intact
		IF @sale <= 0 AND @invtype <> 3
			UPDATE Dbo.SRLedger 
			SET FlatDisc = ISNULL(MiscCharges, 0), 
				MiscCharges = ISNULL(FlatDisc, 0) 
			WHERE SRInvCode = @SRInvCode

		IF @InvTotal_Diff > 0 AND @SaleInvCode <= 0 AND @invtype <> 3
			IF @Ret_InvTotal > ABS(@InvTotal_Diff)
				UPDATE Dbo.SRLedger SET FlatDisc = ISNULL(FlatDisc, 0) + ABS(@InvTotal_Diff) WHERE SRInvCode = @SRInvCode
			ELSE
				UPDATE Dbo.SRLedger SET FlatDisc = ISNULL(FlatDisc, 0) + ABS(@Ret_InvTotal) WHERE SRInvCode = @SRInvCode

		IF @InvTotal_Diff < 0 AND @invtype <> 3
			UPDATE Dbo.SRLedger SET MiscCharges = ISNULL(MiscCharges, 0) + ABS(@InvTotal_Diff) WHERE SRInvCode = @SRInvCode

		UPDATE Dbo.SRLedger SET InvTotal = ISNULL(dbo.fn_getSRInvTotal (@SRInvCode), 0) WHERE SRInvCode = @SRInvCode

--		Set @Ret_InvTotal = dbo.fn_getSRInvTotal (@SRInvCode)
	END

	Set @invcounter = @invcounter + 1
End

IF @continue=0 
BEGIN
	IF @invtype = 1
		UPDATE IMP_SaleLedger SET Transmited = 'Y'
		WHERE CustCode = CASE WHEN @CustCode > 0 THEN @CustCode ELSE CustCode END AND
			ChildServer = CASE WHEN LEN(@childserver) > 0 THEN @childserver ELSE ChildServer END AND
			Transmit = 'Y' AND Transmited = 'N' AND 
			Date BETWEEN @startdate AND @enddate
	IF @invtype = 3
		UPDATE IMP_SRLedger SET Transmited = 'Y'
		WHERE CustCode = CASE WHEN @CustCode > 0 THEN @CustCode ELSE CustCode END AND
			ChildServer = CASE WHEN LEN(@childserver) > 0 THEN @childserver ELSE ChildServer END AND
			Transmit = 'Y' AND Transmited = 'N' AND 
			Date BETWEEN @startdate AND @enddate
	ELSE
		UPDATE IMP_AdvSaleLedger SET Transmited = 'Y'
		WHERE CustCode = CASE WHEN @CustCode > 0 THEN @CustCode ELSE CustCode END AND
			ChildServer = CASE WHEN LEN(@childserver) > 0 THEN @childserver ELSE ChildServer END AND
			Transmit = 'Y' AND Transmited = 'N' AND 
			Date BETWEEN @startdate AND @enddate
END

IF @continue=0 AND @FLAG=1
BEGIN
	SET @dt = GETDATE()
	set @continue = 0
	Execute @rt_code = SP_Set_DateTime_Preference 'LastSaleSynchronized', @dt
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
	Begin
		RaisError( 'Unable to Record Last Sale Synchronization Information in Software Preferences' , 16 , 1)
		Set @continue  = -1								
	End
END

Drop Table #saletemp

Return @continue

-- SP_CleanUp_Bad_Session
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CleanUp_Bad_Session @DBName VARCHAR(100)
AS
DELETE Tempdb.dbo.sysisolaation 
WHERE ID IN 
	(SELECT ID
	FROM
		(SELECT ID=S.ID, DatabaseName=S.sys, ComputerName=S.CN, Connection=S.CC, 
			Program=(SELECT MIN(P.Program_Name) FROM master.dbo.sysprocesses P, master.dbo.sysdatabases D WHERE D.Name = @DBName AND P.DBID=D.DBID AND Lower(P.Program_Name) = 'waseela (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.ID))) +')'), 
			StartedOn=(SELECT MIN(P.Login_Time) FROM master.dbo.sysprocesses P, master.dbo.sysdatabases D WHERE D.Name = @DBName AND P.DBID=D.DBID AND Lower(P.Program_Name) = 'waseela (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.ID))) +')'), 
			DomainName=(SELECT MIN(P.NT_Domain) FROM master.dbo.sysprocesses P, master.dbo.sysdatabases D WHERE D.Name = @DBName AND P.DBID=D.DBID AND Lower(P.Program_Name) = 'waseela (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.ID))) +')'), 
			OSUserName=(SELECT MIN(P.NT_UserName) FROM master.dbo.sysprocesses P, master.dbo.sysdatabases D WHERE D.Name = @DBName AND P.DBID=D.DBID AND Lower(P.Program_Name) = 'waseela (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.ID))) +')')
		FROM TempDB.DBO.SysIsolaation S
		WHERE sys = @DBName) F
	WHERE Program IS NULL OR StartedON=NULL)

RETURN 0

-- SP_ClearActivityMonitorHistory
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_ClearActivityMonitorHistory @StartDate DATETIME, @EndDate DATETIME
AS

DECLARE @rowsaffected INTEGER
DECLARE @err INTEGER

DELETE DBO.ActivityMonitor 
WHERE Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Unable to Clear Activity Monitor History' , 16 , 1)
	RETURN -1
END

RETURN 0

-- sp_CLOpeningBalance

/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_CLOpeningBalance    Script Date: 4/23/02 4:29:59 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_CLOpeningBalance    Script Date: 4/8/02 6:26:06 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_CLOpeningBalance    Script Date: 3/6/02 3:39:36 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_CLOpeningBalance    Script Date: 7/20/01 6:52:01 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_CLOpeningBalance    Script Date: 4/19/00 1:21:26 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_CLOpeningBalance    Script Date: 2/11/99 10:33:26 AM ******/
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_CLOpeningBalance  @al_acccode numeric(5, 0), @ad_date datetime, @af_openbalance float out AS

declare @ln_openbalance numeric(12, 2)

create table #lt_pvamts 
(
	debit  numeric (15, 2) NOT NULL,
	credit numeric (15, 2) NOT NULL
)

/***************************** Credit Sales Transactions **********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select	 Debit = Isnull(Round(SUM(saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
	 SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
	    (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
	 Round( (sum( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
	    (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) - saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
	 Round( sum( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
	    (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + saleledger.misccharges  + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
	 Credit = 0
from     saleledger, saledetail
where    saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and
	 saleledger.salecatcode = 2   and 
 	 saleledger.date <= @ad_date  and
	 saleledger.posted = 'Y' and
	 saleledger.custcode = @al_acccode
group by saleledger.saleinvcode,
	 salecatcode, 
	 saleledger.date,
	 saleledger.discperc,
	 saleledger.misccharges,
	 saleledger.salestax,
	 saleledger.flatdisc,
	 saleledger.invgstperc1

/************************** Credit Sales Returns Transactions ******************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select	 Debit = 0,
	 Credit = Isnull(Round(SUM(srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.unitsalestax) + 
	 SUM(ROUND( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
	    (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc)) * srdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
	 Round( (sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
	    (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) - srledger.flatdisc) * (srledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
	 Round( sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
	    (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) + srledger.misccharges + srledger.salestax - srledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)
from     srledger, srdetail
where    srledger.Srinvcode = srdetail.Srinvcode and
	 srledger.srcatcode = 7   and 
 	 srledger.date <= @ad_date  and
	 srledger.posted = 'Y' and
	 srledger.custcode = @al_acccode 
group by srledger.srinvcode,
	 srledger.srcatcode,
	 srledger.date,
	 srledger.discperc,
	 srledger.misccharges,
	 srledger.salestax,
	 srledger.flatdisc,
	 srledger.invgstperc1

/***************************** Credit Services Transactions ********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts

select  debit = IsNull( sum(IsNull(servicedetail.price, 0) * 
	(1 - (.01 * servicedetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * serviceheader.discperc)) +
	serviceheader.misccharges - serviceheader.flatdisc,0),
	credit= 0.0
from     serviceheader, servicedetail
where    serviceheader.serviceinvcode = servicedetail.serviceinvcode and
	 serviceheader.servicecatcode = 11     and 
 	 serviceheader.date <= @ad_date  and
	 serviceheader.posted = 'Y' and
	 serviceheader.custcode = @al_acccode 

group by serviceheader.serviceinvcode,
	 serviceheader.servicecatcode,
	 serviceheader.date,
	 serviceheader.discperc,
	 serviceheader.misccharges,
	 serviceheader.flatdisc

/************************* Credit Services Returns Transactions ***************************/

insert #lt_pvamts

select  debit = 0.0,
	credit= IsNull( sum(IsNull(serviceRdetail.ServicePrice, 0) * 
	(1 - (.01 * serviceRdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * serviceRheader.discperc)) +
	serviceRheader.misccharges - serviceRheader.flatdisc,0)
from     serviceRheader, serviceRdetail
where    serviceRheader.serviceRinvcode = serviceRdetail.serviceRinvcode and
	 serviceRheader.serviceRcatcode = 14 and 
 	 serviceRheader.date <= @ad_date  and
	 serviceRheader.posted = 'Y' and
	 serviceRheader.custcode = @al_acccode 

group by serviceRheader.serviceRinvcode,
	 serviceRheader.serviceRcatcode,
	 serviceRheader.date,
	 serviceRheader.discperc,
	 serviceRheader.misccharges,
	 serviceRheader.flatdisc
/**************************** Any Acccounting Transactions ********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select  IsNull( sum(gldetail.debit), 0),
        IsNull( sum(gldetail.credit), 0)
	 
from     glheader, gldetail  
where    glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode and 
 	 glheader.date <= @ad_date  and
	 glheader.posted = 'Y' and
	 gldetail.acccode = @al_acccode

/******************************* Any Bills Receivables ***********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select  0,
        IsNull( sum(notes.amount), 0)
	 
from     notes
where    notes.notecatcode = 1 and
	 notes.posted = 'Y' and
	 notes.postdate <= @ad_date  and
	 notes.acccode = @al_acccode

/******** Collecting the result and assigning to the relevent reference variable *********/

select @ln_openbalance =( select IsNull(sum(debit) - sum(credit),0)
			  from   #lt_pvamts )

select @af_openbalance = (Select Convert(float, @ln_openbalance))

select @af_openbalance

drop table #lt_pvamts

name: SP_COLUMNLIST
definition:
-- SP_COLUMNLIST
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_COLUMNLIST] @OWNER VARCHAR(20), @TABLE VARCHAR(50), @LIST VARCHAR(3000) OUTPUT AS

DECLARE @table_id INT, @err INT, @RC INT
DECLARE @full_table_name NVARCHAR(255), @ColName NVARCHAR(255), @TypeName NVARCHAR(255)
DECLARE @Position SMALLINT
DECLARE @VersionInfo varchar(4000), @DBVersion VARCHAR(100)

-- Set parameter values
EXEC @RC = SP_DBMS_Version @VersionInfo OUTPUT 
IF CHARINDEX('Microsoft SQL Server 2012', @VersionInfo, 1) > 0 
	SET @DBVersion = '2012'
ELSE
	SET @DBVersion = '2000'

SET @full_table_name = LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@TABLE))
SET @table_id = OBJECT_ID(@full_table_name)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @err <> 0 OR @table_id IS NULL
	BEGIN RAISERROR('Can Not Produce Column List, Invalid Object Refered: Name = %s', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
	RETURN -1
END
IF @DBVersion = '2012'
BEGIN
	DECLARE curs_collist CURSOR 
	FOR
	SELECT 
		COLUMN_NAME = convert(sysname,c.name), 
		convert (sysname,case when t.xusertype > 255 then t.name else t.name end) TYPE_NAME, 
		ORDINAL_POSITION = convert(int, (select count(*) from syscolumns sc where sc.id = c.id AND sc.number = c.number AND sc.colid <= c.colid)) 
	FROM sysobjects o, systypes t, syscolumns c 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN syscomments m on c.cdefault = m.id AND m.colid = 1 
	WHERE o.id = @table_id AND c.id = o.id AND (o.type not in ('P', 'FN', 'TF', 'IF') OR (o.type in ('TF', 'IF') and c.number = 0)) AND ColumnProperty(c.id, c.name, 'IsIdentity')=0 AND c.xusertype = t.xusertype 
	ORDER BY 3
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	DECLARE curs_collist CURSOR 
	FOR
	SELECT 
		COLUMN_NAME = convert(sysname,c.name), 
		convert (sysname,case when t.xusertype > 255 then t.name else d.TYPE_NAME collate database_default end) TYPE_NAME, 
		ORDINAL_POSITION = convert(int, 
		(select count(*) from syscolumns sc 
		where sc.id = c.id AND sc.number = c.number AND sc.colid <= c.colid)) 
	FROM sysobjects o, master.dbo.spt_datatype_info d, systypes t, syscolumns c 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN syscomments m on c.cdefault = m.id AND m.colid = 1 
	WHERE o.id = @table_id AND c.id = o.id AND t.xtype = d.ss_dtype AND c.length = isnull(d.fixlen, c.length) AND (d.ODBCVer is null or d.ODBCVer = 2) AND (o.type not in ('P', 'FN', 'TF', 'IF') OR (o.type in ('TF', 'IF') and c.number = 0)) AND isnull(d.AUTO_INCREMENT,0) = isnull(ColumnProperty (c.id, c.name, 'IsIdentity'),0) AND c.xusertype = t.xusertype 
	ORDER BY 3
END

OPEN curs_collist 

FETCH NEXT FROM curs_collist INTO @ColName, @TypeName, @Position 
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	IF LOWER(RIGHT(RTRIM(LTRIM(@TypeName)), 8)) <> 'identity' AND LOWER(RIGHT(RTRIM(LTRIM(@TypeName)), 5)) <> 'image'
	BEGIN
		IF @LIST <> ''
		BEGIN
			SET @LIST = @LIST + ','
		END
		SET @LIST = @LIST + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName))
	END
	FETCH NEXT FROM curs_collist INTO @ColName, @TypeName, @Position
END
CLOSE curs_collist
DEALLOCATE curs_collist
IF @list = ''
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	RETURN 0

name: SP_Compare_Remote_VersionInfo
definition:
-- SP_Compare_Remote_VersionInfo
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.SP_Compare_Remote_VersionInfo
	@Prefix VARCHAR(1000), 
	@VersionSyn INT OUTPUT
AS
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON
DELETE REPORTDATA
DECLARE @SequenceID INT, @AppVersion INT, @DBStatus INT
DECLARE @qry VARCHAR(1000), @LocalSequenceID INT, @LocalAppVersion INT, @LocalDBStatus INT

SET @qry = 'INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (code1, code2, code3) SELECT * FROM ' + @Prefix + 'Sequence'
EXECUTE (@qry)
SET @SequenceID = (SELECT MAX(Code1) FROM REPORTDATA)
SET @AppVersion = (SELECT MAX(Code2) FROM REPORTDATA)
SET @DBStatus = (SELECT MAX(Code3) FROM REPORTDATA)

SET @LocalSequenceID = ISNULL((SELECT SequenceID FROM Sequence), 0)
SET @LocalAppVersion = ISNULL((SELECT AppVersion FROM Sequence), 0)
SET @LocalDBStatus = ISNULL((SELECT DBStatus FROM Sequence), 0)

IF @SequenceID = @LocalSequenceID AND @AppVersion = @LocalAppVersion AND @DBStatus = @LocalDBStatus
	SET @VersionSyn = 1

IF @VersionSyn = 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Unable to Continue due to Local and Remote version Conflicts.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END
RETURN 0

name: sp_ConsolidatedExpiryIntimation
definition:
-- sp_ConsolidatedExpiryIntimation
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.sp_ConsolidatedExpiryIntimation
	@UserCode SMALLINT,
	@List VARCHAR(4000),
	@AccCode SMALLINT,
	@CustCode SMALLINT,
	@Type SMALLINT,
	@IntimationCode INT OUTPUT
As
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @Intimation TABLE (Code INT)
DECLARE @continue Int, @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @totalrows Int, @rowcount Int, @counter Int, @serialno int

INSERT INTO @Intimation (Code)
SELECT IntimationCode 
FROM ExpiryIntimation 
WHERE IntimationTypeCode=@Type AND 
	IntimationCode IN 
		(SELECT Code FROM DBO.udf_StringToTabl(@List, ','))

SET @rowcount = ISNULL((SELECT Count(*) FROM @Intimation), 0)
IF @rowcount <= 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('No Expiry Intimation Selected' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'ExpiryIntimation', @IntimationCode Output
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
Begin
	RAISERROR('New Expiry Intimation Code Generation Problem' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1
End

SET @serialno = ISNULL((SELECT COUNTER FROM dbo.IntimationType WITH (UPDLOCK HOLDLOCK) WHERE IntimationTypeCode=@Type), 0)
IF @serialno > 0
BEGIN
	SET @serialno = @serialno + 1

	UPDATE dbo.IntimationType
	SET COUNTER = @serialno
	WHERE IntimationTypeCode=@Type
END

INSERT INTO ExpiryIntimation (IntimationCode, IntimationTypeCode, IntimationSerialNo, AccCode, Date, RefNo, Remarks1, Remarks2, UserCode, Posted, PostedBy, PostDate, CustCode)
VALUES (@IntimationCode, @Type, @serialno, @AccCode, GETDATE(), '', 'Consolidated Expiry Intimation', 'Included Intimations are:- ' + @List, @UserCode, 'N', @UserCode, GETDATE(), @CustCode)

IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@rowcount = 0
Begin
	RAISERROR('Expiry Intimation Header Row Insertion Problem for Expiry Intimation Code %d' ,16, 1, @IntimationCode)
	RETURN -1
End

INSERT INTO ExpiryIntimationDetail (IntimationCode, ICode, Batch, Expiry, Qty, Packunits, PackPrice, Price, InvoiceCode, InvoiceDate, RefNo, RefDate, LastAccCode, ManfCode)
SELECT T.IntimationCode, T.ICode, T.Batch, T.Expiry, T.Qty, T.PackUnits, T.PackPrice, T.Price, T.InvoiceCode, T.InvoiceDate, T.RefNo, T.RefDate, T.LastAccCode, T.ManfCode
FROM
	(SELECT IntimationCode=@IntimationCode, D.ICode, D.Batch, D.Expiry, Qty=SUM(D.Qty), PackUnits=MAX(D.Packunits), PackPrice=MAX(D.PackPrice), Price=MAX(D.Price), InvoiceCode=Max(D.InvoiceCode), InvoiceDate=MAX(D.InvoiceDate), RefNo=MAX(D.RefNo), RefDate=MAX(D.RefDate), LastAccCode=MAX(D.LastAccCode), ManfCode=MAX(D.ManfCode)
	FROM ExpiryIntimationDetail D, ExpiryIntimation H
	WHERE H.IntimationCode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Intimation) AND
		H.IntimationCode = D.IntimationCode
	GROUP BY D.ICode, D.Batch, D.Expiry) T,
	Item I
WHERE T.ICode = I.ICode
ORDER BY I.Name

IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@rowcount = 0
Begin
	RAISERROR('Expiry Intimation Detail Row Insertion Problem for Expiry Intimation Code =%d' ,16, 1, @IntimationCode)
	RETURN -1
End

Return 0

name: sp_ConsolidateQuotation_as_SaleOrder
definition:
-- sp_ConsolidateQuotation_as_SaleOrder
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.sp_ConsolidateQuotation_as_SaleOrder
	@UserCode SMALLINT,
	@list VARCHAR(8000), 
	@SaleOrderCode INT OUTPUT
As
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @Quot TABLE (Code INT)
DECLARE @continue Int, @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @totalrows Int, @rowcount Int, @counter Int, @module int, @headerinvno int, @Headerno int

INSERT INTO @Quot (Code)
SELECT Code FROM DBO.udf_StringToTabl(@List, ',')

SET @rowcount = ISNULL((SELECT Count(*) FROM @Quot), 0)
IF @rowcount <= 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('No Quotations Selected' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'SaleOrderHeader', @SaleOrderCode Output
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
Begin
	RAISERROR('New Order Code Generation Problem' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1
End

SET @module=12
SET @Headerno=1
Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno , @module,  @headerinvno Output 
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
Begin
	RAISERROR('New Header Inv Code Generation Problem' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1
End

INSERT INTO SaleOrderHeader (SaleOrderCode, QuotationCode, CustCode, UserCode, 
	Date, OriginalDate, BillingDate, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, InvGSTPerc1, 
	Posted, PostDate, HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo, MessageCode, SManCode, 
	InvoiceSize, GSTNO, InvTotal, SPrice, Remarks, 
	CustRefNo, CustRefno2, CustRefno3, CustRefno4, 
	ItemDiscPercNo, PaymentMode, PaymentAccCode, Amt, AmtBY, AmtDate, 
	Deleted, Finalized, SOCatCode, OrderCode, LateDeliveryCharges)
SELECT @SaleOrderCode, QuotationCode, CustCode, UserCode=@UserCode, 
	GetDate(), GetDate(), GetDate(), DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, InvGSTPerc1, 
	Posted='N', PostDate=GetDate(), HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo=@headerinvno, MessageCode, SManCode, 
	InvoiceSize=PageSize, GSTNO=1, InvTotal=0, SPrice=1, Remarks=LEFT(@List, 100), 
	CustRefNo, CustRefno2=NULL, CustRefno3=NULL, CustRefno4=NULL, 
	ItemDiscPercNo=1, PaymentMode='C', PaymentAccCode=2, Amt=0, AmtBY=NULL, AmtDate=NULL, 
	Deleted='N', Finalized='N', SOCatCode=1, OrderCode=0, LateDeliveryCharges=0
FROM QuotationHeader 
WHERE QuotationCode IN (SELECT Min(Code) FROM @Quot)

IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@rowcount = 0
Begin
	RAISERROR('Sale Order Header Row Insertion Problem for Sale Order Code %d' ,16, 1, @SaleOrderCode)
	RETURN -1
End

INSERT INTO SaleOrderDetail (SaleOrderCode, ICode, GCode, LooseQty, PackUnits, SalePrice, 
	AvgPrice, Rate, DiscPerc, ItemFlatDisc, SaleItemDescription, PackPrice, 
	UnitSalesTax, GSTPerc, BonusQty, RowGroup, PackQtyForSale, BonusPackQtyForSale, 
	Remarks, SaleOrderItemStatusCode, QuotationRowID, PrescriptionRowID, 
	Batch, Expiry, StrengthPerc, ManfDate)
SELECT @SaleOrderCode, T.ICode, T.GCode, T.LooseQty, T.PackUnits, SalePrice=T.SalePrice, 
	I.AvgPrice, Rate=I.SalePrice, T.DiscPerc, T.ItemFlatDisc, SaleItemDescription=I.Remarks, 
	PackPrice=I.SalePrice, T.UnitSalesTax, 
	T.GSTPerc, T.BonusQty, RowGroup=0, 
	PackQtyForSale=0, BonusPackQtyForSale=0, 
	Remarks=I.Remarks, SaleOrderItemStatusCode=NULL, QuotationRowID=T.RowID, PrescriptionRowID=NULL, 
	Batch='.', Expiry=GETDATE()+365, StrengthPerc=0, ManfDate=NULL
FROM
	(SELECT D.ICode, D.GCode, LooseQty=CASE H.LoosePack WHEN 2 THEN (D.Qty * D.PackUnits) ELSE D.Qty END, BonusQty=CASE H.LoosePack WHEN 2 THEN (D.BonusQty * D.PackUnits) ELSE D.BonusQty END, D.PackUnits, 
		SalePrice=CASE H.LoosePack WHEN 2 THEN ROUND(D.SalePrice / CASE WHEN D.PackUnits = 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.PackUnits END, 2) ELSE D.SalePrice END, 
		D.DiscPerc, D.ItemFlatDisc, D.GSTPerc, 
		UnitSalesTax=CASE H.LoosePack WHEN 2 THEN ROUND(D.UnitSalesTax / CASE WHEN D.PackUnits = 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.PackUnits END, 2) ELSE D.UnitSalesTax END, D.RowID
	FROM QuotationDetail D, QuotationHeader H
	WHERE H.QuotationCode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Quot) AND
		H.QuotationCode = D.QuotationCode) T,
	Item I
WHERE T.ICode = I.ICode
ORDER BY I.Name

IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@rowcount = 0
Begin
	RAISERROR('Sale Order Detail Row Insertion Problem for Sale Order Code =%d' ,16, 1, @SaleOrderCode)
	RETURN -1
End

UPDATE QuotationHeader 
SET ConsolidatedSaleOrder = @SaleOrderCode 
WHERE QuotationCode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Quot) 
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@rowcount = 0
Begin
	RAISERROR('Quotation Data Update Problem for Sale Order Code =%d' ,16, 1, @SaleOrderCode)
	RETURN -1
End

UPDATE SaleOrderHeader
SET InvTotal =
	ISNULL((SELECT InvTotal = Round(SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - H.DiscPerc * 0.01)) - H.FlatDisc + MiscCharges, 0) +
		Round(
			Round(SUM(D.LooseQty * D.UnitSalesTax), 2) +
			ROUND(SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.GSTPerc * 0.0), 2) +
			ROUND((SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - H.DiscPerc * 0.01)) - H.FlatDisc) * H.InvGSTPerc1 * 0.01, 2), 0)
	FROM SaleOrderHeader H, SaleOrderDetail D
	WHERE H.SaleOrderCode = @SaleOrderCode AND
		H.SaleOrderCode = D.SaleOrderCode
	GROUP BY
		H.SaleOrderCode, H.FlatDisc, MiscCharges, H.InvGSTPerc1), 0)
WHERE SaleOrderCode=@SaleOrderCode

Return 0

definition:
-- sp_CopyInvoicesToPurLedgerMod
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.sp_CopyInvoicesToPurLedgerMod
	@rowsaffected int Output  
As

Declare @errorno int     
INSERT INTO PurledgerMod WITH (TABLOCKX) 
(PurInvCode, PurCatCode, SuppCode, SuppInvCode, SalesmanCode, Date, POCode, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SalesTax, Posted, postdate,
Remarks, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, SuppInvDate, GRN, PORB, InvGSTPerc1, purtypecode, HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo, 
InvTotal, AccountFor, PaymentMode, PaymentAccCode, Amt, AmtBY, AmtDate, AmtReference,
OutstandingAmt, Marked, Transferable, Transfered, TransferedOn, TransferedBy, Imported,
ImportedBy, PrintBalance, PurInvPageSize, CurrencyCode, ConversionFactor, PrintCounter,
AssociatedSaleOrderCode, AssociatedSaleInvCode, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo,
NewPurchaseOrderNo, LCNO, UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate, ImpactInventory, ImpPurInvCode, 
CreditDays, SuppInvAmount, CRS_Transfered, CRS_TransferedOn, ICatCode, MonthlyCounter,
DailyCounter, CustCode
)
SELECT 
PurInvCode, PurCatCode, SuppCode, SuppInvCode, SalesmanCode, Date, POCode, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SalesTax, Posted, postdate,
Remarks, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, SuppInvDate, GRN, PORB, InvGSTPerc1, purtypecode, HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo, 
InvTotal, AccountFor, PaymentMode, PaymentAccCode, Amt, AmtBY, AmtDate, AmtReference,
OutstandingAmt, Marked, Transferable, Transfered, TransferedOn, TransferedBy, Imported,
ImportedBy, PrintBalance, PurInvPageSize, CurrencyCode, ConversionFactor, PrintCounter,
AssociatedSaleOrderCode, AssociatedSaleInvCode, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo,
NewPurchaseOrderNo, LCNO, UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate, ImpactInventory, ImpPurInvCode, 
CreditDays, SuppInvAmount, CRS_Transfered, CRS_TransferedOn, ICatCode, MonthlyCounter,
DailyCounter, CustCode
FROM purledger 
WHERE Posted='Y' AND Purinvcode NOT IN (select purinvcode from PurledgerMod)

Select @errorno = @@error,  @rowsaffected = @@rowcount      
IF @errorno <> 0     
	Return @errorno    

INSERT INTO PurDetailMod WITH (TABLOCKX) 
(PurInvCode,ICode,Gcode,Batch,Expiry,PackQty,LooseQty,PackUnits,PurPrice,DiscPerc,
AvgPrice,BonusQty,PurRowId,NewAvgPrice,CurrStock,GSTPerc,UnitSalesTax,PurUtn,
SalePrice,itemdescription,rate,SalePriceForItem,ForeignPrice,PurPriceInAdvPur,NetRate,
RecentPurPrice,TotalPieces,PiecesInHand,ReceiptRowID,ManfCodeForItem,DiscountedSalePrice,
FlatDiscForItem,RetailPrice,AlternateCustomICode,ManfDate)
SELECT PurInvCode,ICode,Gcode,Batch,Expiry,PackQty,LooseQty,PackUnits,PurPrice,DiscPerc,
AvgPrice,BonusQty,PurRowId,NewAvgPrice,CurrStock,GSTPerc,UnitSalesTax,PurUtn,
SalePrice,itemdescription,rate,SalePriceForItem,ForeignPrice,PurPriceInAdvPur,NetRate,
RecentPurPrice,TotalPieces,PiecesInHand,ReceiptRowID,ManfCodeForItem,DiscountedSalePrice,
FlatDiscForItem,RetailPrice,AlternateCustomICode,ManfDate
FROM purdetail 
WHERE  Purinvcode  IN 
	(select purinvcode from PurledgerMod 
	where purinvcode not in 
		(select distinct(purinvcode) from purdetailmod))

Select @errorno = @@error    
IF @errorno <> 0     
	Return @errorno

name: sp_CopyInvoicesToSaleDump
definition:
-- sp_CopyInvoicesToSaleDump
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.sp_CopyInvoicesToSaleDump
	@rowsaffected int Output  
As

	Balance, PptCustCode, DELETED, PresCode, ImpactInventory,  SaleOrderCode, SaleComments1, SaleComments2,
	AlterSaleInvCode, RecurringInvoice, RecurringPeriod, LastRecurringInvCode, RecurringAgainst, ConsiderInPO,

	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION MyTrans

END

	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION MyTrans
	Return @errorno

END

DELETE SBuffer WHERE SaleInvCode IN (Select DISTINCT SaleInvcode From SaleLedger)
Select @errorno = @@error,  @rowsaffected = @@rowcount      
IF @errorno <> 0     
BEGIN
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION MyTrans
	Return @errorno
END

COMMIT TRANSACTION MyTrans
RETURN 0

-- SP_CreateAutoTriggerSMS
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CreateAutoTriggerSMS
	@ai_list VARCHAR(8000),
	@ai_moduleid SMALLINT,
	@ai_event VARCHAR(30)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @Err INT, @RowCount INT, @RowID INT, @SMSTemplateCode INT, @SMSGenerated INT, @TotalSMSGen INT

CREATE TABLE #TemplateToSend (RowID INT IDENTITY(1,1), TemplateCode INT)
INSERT INTO #TemplateToSend (TemplateCode)
SELECT 
	SMSTemplateCode
FROM SMS_Template
WHERE ModuleID = @ai_moduleid AND Scheduled = 'N' AND Event = @ai_event AND Enabled='Y' AND Active='Y'

SET @RowCount = ISNULL((SELECT Count(*) FROM #TemplateToSend),0)
IF @RowCount > 0
BEGIN
	SET @TotalSMSGen=0
	SET @RowID=1
	WHILE @RowID <= @RowCount
	BEGIN
		SET @SMSGenerated=0
		SET @SMSTemplateCode = (SELECT TemplateCode FROM #TemplateToSend WHERE RowID=@RowID)
		EXECUTE @Err = DBO.SP_CreateDataSMS @ai_list, @SMSTemplateCode, @SMSGenerated output
		IF @Err <> 0 OR @@ERROR <> 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Auto Triggered SMS Generation Problem, SMS Template Code : %d', 16, 1, @SMSTemplateCode)
			RETURN -1			
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @TotalSMSGen = @TotalSMSGen + @SMSGenerated
		END
		SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
	END
END

RETURN 0

-- SP_CreateDataSMS
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CreateDataSMS
	@as_list VARCHAR(8000), 
	@ai_smstemplatecode int, 
	@ai_totsms int output 
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @SMSTemplate VARCHAR(4000), @TokenValue VARCHAR(1000), @tokenname VARCHAR(100), @FilterOn VARCHAR(255), @ViewName VARCHAR(255), @Qry VARCHAR(4000), @SMSTO VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @SMSType TINYINT, @SMSData INT, @Err INT, @RowCount INT, @strLen INT, @CurrPos INT, @startPos INT, @endPos INT, @TotalRows INT, @sno INT, @totTokens INT, @PhoneNoExists INT, @MinContactCard INT, @Expiry INT

IF LTRIM(RTRIM(@as_list)) = ''
	SET @as_list = '1'

SET @Expiry = DBO.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('defaultsmsexpiry')
IF @Expiry IS NULL
	SET @Expiry = 24

SELECT 
	@SMSType=SMStypeCode, 
	@SMSData=SMSDataCode, 
	@SMSTemplate=SMSTemplate, 
	@ViewName = (SELECT D.ViewName FROM SMS_DataDefinition D WHERE D.SMSDataCode=SMS_Template.SMSDataCode),
	@FilterOn = (SELECT D.FilterOn FROM SMS_DataDefinition D WHERE D.SMSDataCode=SMS_Template.SMSDataCode)
FROM SMS_Template
WHERE SMSTemplateCode=@ai_smstemplatecode AND Enabled='Y' AND Active='Y'

IF LEN(@ViewName) > 0 AND @@RowCount > 0
BEGIN
	CREATE TABLE #InputRows (CardCode INT, Code VARCHAR(100), TokenValue VARCHAR(1000), SMSText VARCHAR(4000), SMSTo VARCHAR(100), RowID INT IDENTITY(1,1))
	CREATE TABLE #token (sno int not null identity(1,1), startpos int not null, endpos int not null, tokenname varchar(255) not null, tokenvalue varchar(255))
	CREATE TABLE #EachSMSTo (SMSTo VARCHAR(100))

	SET @Qry = 'INSERT INTO #InputRows (CardCode, Code, TokenValue, SMSText, SMSTO) SELECT DISTINCT T.ContactCardCode, P.Code, NULL, NULL, T.Mobile FROM ' + @ViewName + ' AS T, (SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl_String(''' + @as_list + ''', '','')) P WHERE P.Code = T.' + @FilterOn
	EXECUTE (@Qry)

	SET @Qry = 'INSERT INTO #InputRows (CardCode, Code, TokenValue, SMSText, SMSTO) SELECT DISTINCT T.ContactCardCode, P.Code, NULL, NULL, T.Mobile FROM GetAssociatedRecipientForSMS AS T, (SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl_String(''' + @as_list + ''', '','')) P WHERE T.SMSTemplateCode = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@ai_smstemplatecode,10))) + ' AND T.ContactCardCode NOT IN (SELECT M.CardCode FROM #InputRows M)'
	EXECUTE (@Qry)

	UPDATE #InputRows SET SMSText = @SMSTemplate
	SET @strLen = LEN(@SMSTemplate)
	SET @CurrPos = 1

	WHILE @CurrPos <= @strLen
	BEGIN
		SET @startPos = CHARINDEX('«', @SMSTemplate, @CurrPos)
		IF @startPos > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @endPos = CHARINDEX('»', @SMSTemplate, @startPos)
			SET @TokenName = SUBSTRING(@SMSTemplate, @startpos + 1, @endPos - @startpos - 1)
			INSERT INTO #Token (StartPOS, EndPOS, TokenName, TokenValue) VALUES (@StartPos, @EndPos, @TokenName, '') 
			SET @CurrPos = @endPos
		END
		ELSE
			SET @CurrPos = @strLen + 1
	END
	SET @TotalRows = ISNULL((SELECT Count(Code) FROM #InputRows), 0)
	SET @totTokens = ISNULL((SELECT Count(*) FROM #Token), 0)
	IF @TotalRows > 0 AND @totTokens > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @MinContactCard = ISNULL((SELECT MIN(CardCode) FROM #InputRows), 0)
		SET @sno = 1
		WHILE @sno <= @totTokens
		BEGIN
			SET @tokenname = (SELECT tokenname from #token WHERE Sno = @sno)

			IF @MINContactCard > 0
				EXECUTE ('UPDATE #InputRows SET TokenValue = (SELECT MAX(' + @tokenname + ') FROM ' + @ViewName + ' WHERE ' + @FilterOn + ' = #InputRows.Code  AND ContactCardCode = #InputRows.CardCode)')
			ELSE
				EXECUTE ('UPDATE #InputRows SET TokenValue = (SELECT MAX(' + @tokenname + ') FROM ' + @ViewName + ' WHERE ' + @FilterOn + ' = #InputRows.Code )')

			UPDATE #InputRows
			SET SMSText = REPLACE(SMSText, '«' + @tokenname + '»', TokenValue)
			WHERE CHARINDEX('«' + @tokenname + '»', SMSText, 1) > 0

			SET @sno = @sno + 1
		END
		SET @sno = 1
		WHILE @sno <= @TotalRows
		BEGIN
			SET @SMSTO = (SELECT Smsto FROM #InputRows WHERE RowID=@sno)

			DELETE #EachSMSTo

			INSERT INTO #EachSMSTo
			SELECT DISTINCT Code FROM udf_StringToTabl_String(@SMSTO, ',')

			DELETE #EachSMSTo WHERE SMSTo IS NULL OR SMSTO=''

			SET @PhoneNoExists = ISNULL((SELECT Count(*) FROM #EachSMSTo), 0)

			SELECT DISTINCT DATE=GETDATE(), S.SMSTo, t.SMSText, SMSTypeCode=@SMSType, SmsStatusCode=1, SMSTemplateCode=@ai_smstemplatecode
			FROM #InputRows t, #EachSMSTo S
			WHERE T.RowID=@sno AND t.SMSText IS NOT NULL


			INSERT INTO SMS_Center (Date, SMSTo, SMSText, SMSTypeCode, SMSStatusCode, SMSTemplateCode, Expiry)
			SELECT DISTINCT DATE=GETDATE(), S.SMSTo, t.SMSText, SMSTypeCode=@SMSType, SmsStatusCode=1, SMSTemplateCode=@ai_smstemplatecode, Expiry=DATEADD(hh, @Expiry, GETDATE())
			FROM #InputRows t, #EachSMSTo S
			WHERE T.RowID=@sno AND t.SMSText IS NOT NULL

			SET @ai_totsms = @ai_totsms + ISNULL(@@Rowcount,0)

			SET @sno = @sno + 1
		END
	END
END
RETURN 0

-- SP_CreatePurchase_From_AdvPurchase
CREATE   PROCEDURE SP_CreatePurchase_From_AdvPurchase
	@ai_AdvPurInvCode INT, 
	@ai_PurInvCode INT OUTPUT
AS

DECLARE @errcode INT
DECLARE @NewNetAmt FLOAT, @NetDiff FLOAT

UPDATE AdvPurDetail 
SET 
	DiscountedSalePrice = (SELECT Item.DiscountedSalePrice FROM Item WHERE Item.ICode = AdvPurDetail.ICode),
	RecentPurPrice = (SELECT Item.RecentPurPrice FROM Item WHERE Item.ICode = AdvPurDetail.ICode)
WHERE AdvPurInvCode = @ai_AdvPurInvCode

EXECUTE @errcode = SP_GetTabMaxkey 'purledger' , @ai_PurInvCode Output
SET @errcode = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in generating new purchase invoice code', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @errcode = 0

INSERT INTO PurLedger 
	(PurInvCode, PurCatCode, SuppCode, SuppInvCode, SalesmanCode, Date,
	POCode, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SalesTax, Posted, PostDate,
	Remarks, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, SuppInvDate, GRN,
	PORB, InvGSTPerc1, PurTypeCode, HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo, InvTotal,
	AccountFor, PaymentMode, PaymentAccCode, Amt,	AmtBY, AmtDate, 
	AmtReference, OutstandingAmt, Marked, Transferable, Transfered, 
	TransferedOn, TransferedBy, Imported, ImportedBy, 
	PrintBalance, PurInvPageSize, CurrencyCode, ConversionFactor)
SELECT 
	@ai_PurInvCode, PurCatCode, SuppCode, SuppInvCode, UserCode, Date, 
	POCode, DiscPerc=0, FlatDisc=0, MiscCharges=0, SalesTax=0, Posted='N', PostDate, 
	Remarks, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, SuppInvDate, GRN, 
	PORB, InvGSTPerc1=0, PurTypeCode, HeaderNo, NULL, InvTotal, 
	AccountFor, PaymentMode, PaymentAccCode, Amt, AmtBY, AmtDate, 
	AmtReference, OutstandingAmt, Marked='N', Transferable='N', Transfered='N',
	TransferedOn = NULL, TransferedBy = NULL, Imported='N', ImportedBy=NULL, 
	PrintBalance, PurInvPageSize, CurrencyCode, ConversionFactor
FROM AdvPurHeader
WHERE AdvPurInvCode=@ai_AdvPurInvCode

SET @errcode = @@ERROR

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in Creation Of Purchase Invoice Header From Advanced Purchase', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @errcode = 0

INSERT INTO PurDetail 
	(PurInvCode, ICode, Gcode, Batch, Expiry, PackQty, 
	LooseQty, PackUnits, PurPrice, DiscPerc, AvgPrice, BonusQty, 
	NewAvgPrice, CurrStock, GSTPerc, UnitSalesTax, PurUtn, SalePrice, 
	ItemDescription, Rate, SalePriceForItem, ForeignPrice, PurPriceInAdvPur, 
	NetRate, RecentPurPrice, AlternateCustomICode, RetailPrice)
SELECT 
	@ai_PurInvCode, D.ICode, D.Gcode, D.Batch, D.Expiry, 
	PackQty= CASE WHEN H.PurCatCode IN (1,2) THEN (D.PackQty + D.BonusQty) ELSE 0 END, 
	LooseQty= CASE WHEN H.PurCatCode IN (1,2) THEN 0 ELSE (D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) END, 
	D.PackUnits, PurPrice=ROUND(D.NetRate, 2), DiscPerc=0, D.AvgPrice, BonusQty=0, 
	D.NewAvgPrice, D.CurrStock, GSTPerc=0, UnitSalesTax=0, D.PurUtn, 
	D.SalePrice, D.ItemDescription, D.Rate, D.SalePriceForItem, D.ForeignPrice, 
	PurPrice = 
		CASE (SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'UpdatePurPrice' )) 
			WHEN 'D' THEN 
				CASE 
					WHEN ROUND((((D.PurPrice + D.PurPrice2 + D.PurPrice3 + D.PurPrice4 - ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) - D.ItemFlatDiscAfterDiscperc), 2) >= 0 THEN
						ROUND((((D.PurPrice + D.PurPrice2 + D.PurPrice3 + D.PurPrice4 - ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) - D.ItemFlatDiscAfterDiscperc), 2)
					ELSE 
						Round(D.PurPrice + D.PurPrice2 + D.PurPrice3 + D.PurPrice4, 2) 
					END 
			WHEN 'R' THEN D.NetRate
			ELSE Round(D.PurPrice + D.PurPrice2 + D.PurPrice3 + D.PurPrice4, 2) END, 
	D.NetRate, 
	RecentPurPrice=ISNULL((SELECT I.RecentPurPrice FROM Item I WHERE I.ICode = D.ICode), 0),
	D.AlternateCustomICode, D.RetailPrice
FROM AdvPurDetail D, AdvPurHeader H
WHERE H.AdvPurInvCode = @ai_AdvPurInvCode AND 
	H.AdvPurInvCode = D.AdvPurInvCode
ORDER BY PurRowID

SET @errcode = @@ERROR

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in Creation Of Purchase Invoice Detail From Advanced Purchase', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @errcode = 0

SET @NewNetAmt = 
	(SELECT ISNULL((MAX(H.InvTotal) - SUM(ROUND(D.PurPrice, 2) * (D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty))), 0)
	FROM PurDetail D, PurLedger H
	WHERE H.PurInvCode = @ai_PurInvCode AND
		H.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode)

IF @NewNetAmt <> 0
BEGIN
	IF @NewNetAmt > 0
		UPDATE PurLedger SET MiscCharges = ABS(@NewNetAmt) WHERE PurInvCode = @ai_PurInvCode
	ELSE
		UPDATE PurLedger SET FlatDisc = ABS(@NewNetAmt) WHERE PurInvCode = @ai_PurInvCode
END

SET @errcode = @@ERROR

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in Updation Of Purchase Invoice Amount From Advanced Purchase', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

RETURN 0

-- SP_CreatePurchase_From_ImpPur
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_CreatePurchase_From_ImpPur 
	@ai_ImpPurInvCode INT, @ai_salesmancode INT
AS

DECLARE @errcode INT, @ai_PurInvCode INT, @SuppCode INT
DECLARE @NewNetAmt FLOAT, @NetDiff FLOAT

DECLARE C1 CURSOR FOR
SELECT DISTINCT SuppCode 
FROM ImpPurDetail 
WHERE ImpPurInvCode=@ai_ImpPurInvCode
ORDER BY SuppCode

OPEN C1

FETCH NEXT FROM C1 
INTO @SuppCode
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @ai_PurInvCode=NULL
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_GetTabMaxkey 'purledger' , @ai_PurInvCode Output
	SET @errcode = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in generating new purchase invoice code', 16, 1)
		CLOSE C1
		DEALLOCATE C1
		RETURN -1
	END
	
	SET @errcode = 0
	
	INSERT INTO PurLedger 
		(PurInvCode, PurCatCode, SuppCode, SuppInvCode, SalesmanCode, Date,
		POCode, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SalesTax, Posted, PostDate,
		Remarks, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, SuppInvDate, GRN,
		PORB, InvGSTPerc1, PurTypeCode, HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo, InvTotal,
		AccountFor, PaymentMode, PaymentAccCode, Amt,	AmtBY, AmtDate, 
		AmtReference, OutstandingAmt, Marked, Transferable, Transfered, 
		TransferedOn, TransferedBy, Imported, ImportedBy, 
		PrintBalance, PurInvPageSize, CurrencyCode, ConversionFactor, ImpPurInvCode, ImpactInventory)
	SELECT 
		@ai_PurInvCode, PurCatCode=2, @SuppCode, SuppInvCode='', UserCode, Date, 
		POCode=NULL, DiscPerc=0, FlatDisc=0, MiscCharges=0, SalesTax=0, Posted='N', PostedDate=GETDATE(), 
		Remarks, OriginalDate=Date, ModifiedBy=NULL, PostedBy=@ai_salesmancode, SuppInvDate=NULL, GRN=NULL, 
		PORB=NULL, InvGSTPerc1=0, PurTypeCode=NULL, HeaderNo, NULL, InvTotal, 
		AccountFor='N', PaymentMode='C', PaymentAccCode=NULL, Amt=0.00, AmtBY=NULL, AmtDate=NULL, 
		AmtReference=NULL, OutstandingAmt=InvTotal, Marked='N', Transferable='N', Transfered='N',
		TransferedOn = NULL, TransferedBy = NULL, Imported='N', ImportedBy=NULL, 
		PrintBalance='N', PurInvPageSize='F', CurrencyCode, ConversionFactor, ImpPurInvCode, ImpactInventory='Y'
	FROM ImpPurHeader
	WHERE ImpPurInvCode=@ai_ImpPurInvCode
	
	SET @errcode = @@ERROR
	
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Creation Of Purchase Invoice Header From Imported Purchase', 16, 1)
		CLOSE C1
		DEALLOCATE C1
		RETURN -1
	END
	
	SET @errcode = 0
	
	INSERT INTO PurDetail 
		(PurInvCode, ICode, Gcode, Batch, Expiry, PackQty, 
		LooseQty, PackUnits, PurPrice, DiscPerc, AvgPrice, BonusQty, 
		NewAvgPrice, CurrStock, GSTPerc, UnitSalesTax, PurUtn, SalePrice, 
		ItemDescription, Rate, SalePriceForItem, ForeignPrice, PurPriceInAdvPur, 
		NetRate, RecentPurPrice)
	SELECT 
		@ai_PurInvCode, D.ICode, D.Gcode, D.Batch, D.Expiry, 
		PackQty= (D.PackQty + D.BonusQty), 
		LooseQty= 0, 
		D.PackUnits, PurPrice=ROUND(D.NetRate, 2), DiscPerc=0, D.AvgPrice, BonusQty=0, 
		D.NewAvgPrice, D.CurrStock, GSTPerc=0, UnitSalesTax=0, D.PurUtn, 
		D.SalePrice, D.ItemDescription, D.Rate, D.SalePriceForItem, D.ForeignPrice, 
		PurPrice = 
			CASE (SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'UpdatePurPrice' )) 
				WHEN 'D' THEN 
					CASE 
						WHEN ROUND((((D.PurPrice + D.PurPrice2 + D.PurPrice3 + D.PurPrice4 - ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) - D.ItemFlatDiscAfterDiscperc), 2) >= 0 THEN
							ROUND((((D.PurPrice + D.PurPrice2 + D.PurPrice3 + D.PurPrice4 - ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) - D.ItemFlatDiscAfterDiscperc), 2)
						ELSE 
							Round(D.PurPrice + D.PurPrice2 + D.PurPrice3 + D.PurPrice4, 2) 
						END 
				WHEN 'R' THEN D.NetRate
				ELSE Round(D.PurPrice + D.PurPrice2 + D.PurPrice3 + D.PurPrice4, 2) END, 
		D.NetRate, 
		RecentPurPrice=ISNULL((SELECT I.RecentPurPrice FROM Item I WHERE I.ICode = D.ICode), 0)
	FROM ImpPurDetail D, ImpPurHeader H
	WHERE H.ImpPurInvCode = @ai_ImpPurInvCode AND 
		D.SuppCode = @SuppCode AND
		H.ImpPurInvCode = D.ImpPurInvCode
	ORDER BY PurRowID
	
	SET @errcode = @@ERROR
	
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Creation Of Purchase Invoice Detail From Imported Purchase', 16, 1)
		CLOSE C1
		DEALLOCATE C1
		RETURN -1
	END
	
	SET @errcode = 0
	
	SET @NewNetAmt = 
		(SELECT ISNULL(ROUND(SUM(D.PurPrice * (D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty)), 0), 0)
		FROM PurDetail D, PurLedger H
		WHERE H.PurInvCode = @ai_PurInvCode AND
			H.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode)
	
	IF @NewNetAmt <> 0
	BEGIN
		UPDATE PurLedger SET InvTotal = @NewNetAmt, OutStandingAmt=@NewNetAmt WHERE PurInvCode = @ai_PurInvCode	END
	
	SET @errcode = @@ERROR
	
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Updation Of Purchase Invoice Amount From Imported Purchase', 16, 1)
		CLOSE C1
		DEALLOCATE C1
		RETURN -1
	END
	FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @SuppCode
END
CLOSE C1
DEALLOCATE C1
RETURN 0

EXECUTE @errcode = SP_GetTabMaxkey 'purledger' , @ai_PurInvCode Output
SET @errcode = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0

	RaisError('Problem in generating new purchase invoice code', 16, 1)

	DiscPerc=0, AvgPrice=I.AvgPrice, BonusQty=0, 
	NewAvgPrice=I.AvgPrice, 
	CurrStock=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(GD.CurrQty) FROM GodownDetail GD WHERE GD.ICode=D.ICode), 0), 
	GSTPerc=0, UnitSalesTax=0, PurUtn=1, 
	I.SalePrice, ItemDescription=NULL, Rate=I.PurPrice, I.SalePrice, ForeignPrice=0, 
	PurPrice = D.PurPrice, NetRate=D.PurPrice, 
	RecentPurPrice=ISNULL((SELECT I.RecentPurPrice FROM Item I WHERE I.ICode = D.ICode), 0),

FROM PurRegisterDetail D, PurRegister H, Item I

	H.PurRegisterCode = D.PurRegisterCode AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode
ORDER BY RowID

SET @errcode = @@ERROR

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in Creation Of Purchase Invoice Detail From Purchase Register Code = %d', 16, 1, @ai_PurRegisterCode)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @errcode = 0

SET @NewNetAmt = 
	(SELECT ISNULL((MAX(H.InvTotal) - SUM(ROUND(D.PurPrice, 2) * (D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty))), 0)
	FROM PurDetail D, PurLedger H
	WHERE H.PurInvCode = @ai_PurInvCode AND
		H.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode)

IF @NewNetAmt <> 0
BEGIN
	IF @NewNetAmt > 0
		UPDATE PurLedger SET MiscCharges = ABS(@NewNetAmt) WHERE PurInvCode = @ai_PurInvCode
	ELSE
		UPDATE PurLedger SET FlatDisc = ABS(@NewNetAmt) WHERE PurInvCode = @ai_PurInvCode
END

SET @errcode = @@ERROR

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in Updation Of Purchase Invoice Amount From Advanced Purchase', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

RETURN 0

-- SP_CreateScheduledSMS
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CreateScheduledSMS 
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @RunParm VARCHAR(4000), @Qry VARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @Err INT, @RowCount INT, @RowID INT, @SMSTemplateCode INT, @SMSGenerated INT, @TotalSMSGen INT

CREATE TABLE #TemplateToSend (RowID INT IDENTITY(1,1), TemplateCode INT, RunParam VARCHAR(100))
INSERT INTO #TemplateToSend (TemplateCode, RunParam)
SELECT 
	SMSTemplateCode,
	RunParameters
FROM SMS_Template
WHERE Enabled='Y' AND Active = 'Y' AND Scheduled = 'Y' AND Executed='N' AND GETDATE() >= ISNULL(NextRunOn, '1900-01-01 00:00:00')

SET @RowCount = ISNULL((SELECT Count(*) FROM #TemplateToSend),0)
IF @RowCount > 0
BEGIN
	SET @TotalSMSGen=0
	SET @RowID=1
	WHILE @RowID <= @RowCount
	BEGIN
		SET @SMSGenerated=0
		SET @RunParm = ISNULL((SELECT RunParam FROM #TemplateToSend WHERE RowID=@RowID), '1')
		IF LTRIM(RTRIM(@RunParm)) = ''
			SET @RunParm = '1'
		SET @SMSTemplateCode = (SELECT TemplateCode FROM #TemplateToSend WHERE RowID=@RowID)
		EXECUTE @Err = DBO.SP_CreateDataSMS @RunParm, @SMSTemplateCode, @SMSGenerated output
		IF @Err <> 0 OR @@ERROR <> 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Scheduled SMS Generation Problem, SMS Template Code : %d', 16, 1, @SMSTemplateCode)
			RETURN -1			
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @TotalSMSGen = @TotalSMSGen + @SMSGenerated

			UPDATE SMS_Template 
			SET 
				ExecutedOn=GETDATE(), NextRunON=
				CASE ScheduleType WHEN 1 THEN 
					CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), RunOnce, 114)
				ELSE
					DATEADD(MS, CASE RunEveryFreq WHEN 1 THEN (RunEvery * 60 * 60 * 1000) ELSE (RunEvery * 60 * 1000) END, GETDATE())
				END
			WHERE SMSTemplateCode = @SMSTemplateCode
		END
		SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
	END
END

RETURN 0

AS

declare @ad_date datetime, @ad_postdate datetime, @ad_originaldate datetime
declare @as_remarks varchar(100), @as_chkno varchar(60), @as_chkno_detail varchar(60)
declare @an_amount numeric(15,2), @as_remarks_detail varchar(100)
declare @an_outstandingamt numeric(15,2), @an_balance numeric(15,2)
declare @as_posted char(1)
Declare @Err As Int , @RowCount As Int, @TABMAXKEY As Int, @ai_vouchercode AS Int

EXECUTE @err = SP_GetTabMaxkey 'GLHeader', @TABMAXKEY Output
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('GL Voucher Code generation problem' ,16, 1)	
	RETURN -1			
END

SET @ai_vochcatcode = 5

EXECUTE @err = SP_GetVoucherCode @ai_vochcatcode, @ai_vouchercode Output
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Voucher Code Generation Problem' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1			
END

SET @ai_acccode = 2
SET @ad_date = GETDATE()
SET @as_posted = 'Y'
SET @ad_postdate = GETDATE()
SET @as_remarks = (SELECT Remarks FROM ImpPurHeader WHERE ImpPurInvCode=@ai_imppurinvcode)
SET @ad_originaldate=GETDATE()
SET @ai_modifiedby=NULL
SET @ai_postedby=@ai_salesmancode
SET @as_chkno= (SELECT Container FROM ImpPurHeader WHERE ImpPurInvCode=@ai_imppurinvcode)

EXECUTE @err = SP_SetGLHeader @TABMAXKEY, @ai_vochcatcode, @ai_acccode, @ad_date, @ai_salesmancode, @as_posted, @ad_postdate, @as_remarks, @ad_originaldate, @ai_modifiedby, @ai_postedby, @as_chkno, @ai_vouchercode
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem Inserting Voucher (Table:GLHeader)' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1			
END

INSERT INTO GLDetail (GLVochCode, AccCode, Debit, Credit, ChkNo, Remarks, GLUTN, PatientCode, InvoiceCode, OutStandingAmt, Balance, GuestCode, StudentCode)
SELECT @TABMAXKEY, AccCode=SuppCode, Debit=0, Credit=Sum(PackQty * NetDiscountedRate), @as_chkno, @as_remarks, GLUTN=NULL, PatientCode=Null, InvoiceCode=Null, OutStandingamt=0, Balance=0, GuestCode=Null, StudentCode=Null
FROM ImpPurDetail 
WHERE ImpPurInvCode=@ai_ImpPurInvCode
GROUP BY SuppCode
HAVING Sum(PackQty * NetDiscountedRate) <> 0
UNION ALL /*Imported Purchase Expenses credited*/
SELECT @TABMAXKEY, AccCode=AccCode, Debit=0, Credit=SUM(LocalAmt), @as_chkno, @as_remarks, GLUTN=NULL, PatientCode=Null, InvoiceCode=Null, OutStandingamt=0, Balance=0, GuestCode=Null, StudentCode=Null
FROM ImpPurExp
WHERE ImpPurInvCode=@ai_ImpPurInvCode AND LocalAmt <> 0
GROUP BY ExpenseType, AccCode
UNION ALL /*PURCHASE ACCOUNT*/
SELECT @TABMAXKEY, AccCode=1, Debit=InvTotal, Credit=0.00, @as_chkno, @as_remarks, GLUTN=NULL, PatientCode=Null, InvoiceCode=Null, OutStandingamt=0, Balance=0, GuestCode=Null, StudentCode=Null
FROM ImpPurHeader
WHERE ImpPurInvCode=@ai_ImpPurInvCode AND InvTotal <> 0
ORDER BY Debit DESC, Credit, AccCode
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0 OR @@RowCount=0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem Inserting Voucher (Table:GLDetail)' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1			
END

SET @GlVochCode = @TABMAXKEY
SET @VochCode   = @ai_vouchercode 
SET @ai_glvochcode=@TABMAXKEY

UPDATE ImpPurHeader SET GLVochCode=@GlVochCode WHERE ImpPurInvCode=@ai_ImpPurInvCode
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0 OR @@RowCount=0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem Updating GL Voucher Code in (Table: ImpPurDetail)' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1			
END

Return 0

definition:
-- SP_CRS_ClientDataTransfer
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CRS_ClientDataTransfer
	@SRV VARCHAR(50), 
	@DB VARCHAR(50), 
	@OWNER VARCHAR(20),
	@UserCode SMALLINT = NULL
AS

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @err int, @VersionSyn TINYINT, @ClientID SMALLINT, @InstanceID SMALLINT, @LogID INT
DECLARE @InstanceName VARCHAR(100), @Remarks VARCHAR(255), @TableName VARCHAR(255), @LastTableName VARCHAR(255), @LocalUPD VARCHAR(1000)
DECLARE @Query VARCHAR(1000), @TablePrefix VARCHAR(255), @TransferType CHAR(1)
DECLARE @ClientID_STR VARCHAR(100), @InstanceID_STR VARCHAR(100), @LogID_STR VARCHAR(100)

SET @TablePrefix=''
IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SRV))) = 0 OR @SRV IS NULL) 
	SET @TablePrefix = ''
ELSE
	SET @TablePrefix = @SRV + '.' 

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DB))) = 0 OR @DB IS NULL)
	SET @TablePrefix = @TablePrefix
ELSE
	SET @TablePrefix = @TablePrefix + @DB + '.'

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@OWNER))) = 0 OR @OWNER IS NULL)
	SET @TablePrefix = @TablePrefix + 'DBO' + '.'
ELSE
	SET @TablePrefix = @TablePrefix + @OWNER + '.'

SET @VersionSyn = 0

EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_Compare_Remote_VersionInfo @TablePrefix, @VersionSyn OUTPUT
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0 OR @VersionSyn = 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Unable to Continue due to Local and Remote version Conflicts.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @InstanceName = ISNULL((SELECT Name FROM ClientInstance) ,'')

EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_GetClientInstanceInfo @SRV, @DB, @OWNER, @InstanceName, @ClientID OUTPUT , @InstanceID OUTPUT
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('CRS Instance Verification: Unable to make CRS Instance Verification From CRS Server.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

IF @ClientID IS NULL OR @ClientID=0 OR @InstanceID IS NULL OR @InstanceID=0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('CRS Instance Validation: Unable to Validate CRS Instance From CRS Server.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 
--Update this clientid and instanceid into current database
UPDATE ClientInstance SET ClientID=@ClientID, ClientInstanceID=@InstanceID

SET @ClientID_STR = LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@ClientID AS VARCHAR(100))))
SET @InstanceID_STR = LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@InstanceID AS VARCHAR(100))))
/*
Get Primary Key value for fresh crs_datatransferlog instance
*/
SET @Query = 'INSERT INTO ' + @TablePrefix + 'CRS_DataTransferLog (ClientInstanceID, UserCode, StartDate, EndDate) VALUES (' + @InstanceID_STR + ', ' + ISNULL(STR(@UserCode), 'NULL') + ', GETDATE(), GETDATE())'
EXECUTE (@Query)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0 OR @@RowCount = 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: Problem in generating data transfer log header row', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @Query = 'INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (Code1, Name1) SELECT LOGID=MAX(LogID), Name1 = ''CRS_DataTransferLog'' FROM ' + @TablePrefix + 'CRS_DataTransferLog WHERE ClientInstanceID = ' + @InstanceID_STR
EXECUTE (@Query)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0 OR @@RowCount = 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: Problem in generating data transfer log header row', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @LOGID = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(Code1) FROM ReportData WHERE Name1='CRS_DataTransferLog'), 0)
SET @LogID_STR = LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@LOGID AS VARCHAR(100))))
IF @LogID <= 0 OR  @LogID IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: Problem in generating data transfer log header row', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

/*Variables to be used in delete, update and insert processes*/
DECLARE TmpCrs1 CURSOR FOR
SELECT SourceTableName, Remarks, TransferType, Priority
FROM CRS_TransferableData 
WHERE Enable='Y'
ORDER BY TransferType, Priority

OPEN TmpCrs1

FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs1 INTO @TableName, @Remarks, @TransferType
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @Query = 'INSERT INTO ' + @TablePrefix + 'CRS_DataTransferLogDetail (LogID, SourceTableName, StartDate, EndDate) VALUES (' + @LogID_STR + ', ''' + @TableName + ''', GETDATE(), GETDATE())'
	EXECUTE (@Query)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: Problem in generating data transfer log detail row', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_TransferClientTable @SRV, @DB, @OWNER, @ClientID, @InstanceID, @TableName
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('CRS Data Transfer Error: Unable to Transfer Object, Name = %s.', 16, 1, @TableName)
		CLOSE TmpCrs1
		DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
		RETURN -1
	END 
	IF @TransferType = 'T' AND RIGHT(UPPER(@TableName), 6) = 'DETAIL' AND UPPER(@TableName) <> 'GODOWNDETAIL'
	BEGIN
		IF UPPER(@LastTableName) = 'DUESATISFYHEADER'
			SET @LocalUPD = 'UPDATE ' + @LastTableName + ' SET CRS_Transfered = ''Y'', CRS_TransferedON = GETDATE() WHERE CRS_Transfered = ''N'''
		ELSE
			SET @LocalUPD = 'UPDATE ' + @LastTableName + ' SET CRS_Transfered = ''Y'', CRS_TransferedON = GETDATE() WHERE CRS_Transfered = ''N'' AND Posted=''Y'' '
		EXECUTE (@LocalUPD)
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('CRS Data Transfer Error: Unable to Update Status of Object, Name = %s.', 16, 1, @LastTableName)
			CLOSE TmpCrs1
			DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
			RETURN -1
		END
	END
	SET @Query = 'UPDATE ' + @TablePrefix + 'CRS_DataTransferLogDetail SET EndDate = GETDATE() WHERE LogID = ' + @LogID_STR  + ' AND SourceTableName = ''' + @TableName + ''''
	EXECUTE (@Query)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: Problem in marking end date for data transfer log detail row', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	SET @LastTableName = @TableName
	FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs1 INTO @TableName, @Remarks, @TransferType
END
CLOSE TmpCrs1
DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1

SET @Query = 'UPDATE ' + @TablePrefix + 'CRS_DataTransferLog SET EndDate = GETDATE() WHERE LogID = ' + @LogID_STR
EXECUTE (@Query)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: Problem in marking end date for data transfer log', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_FetchFinalizedSaleOrders @SRV, @DB, @OWNER, @InstanceID, @UserCode
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Unable To Fetch Sale Orders From CRS Server.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

RETURN 0

-- SP_CRS_CRSClient_MONTHLYSALES
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CRS_CRSClient_MONTHLYSALES @ar_startdate datetime, @ar_enddate datetime
AS

DELETE ReportData

INSERT INTO ReportData (name1, date1, value1)
SELECT	
	T.ClientName, T.Date, NetSales=SUM(T.Value)
FROM
	(SELECT	
		DATE = LTRIM(RTRIM(MONTH(SL.DATE))) + '-01-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(DATENAME(YEAR, SL.DATE))),
		ClientName=CL.Name,
		value = SUM(ISNULL(SL.InvTotal, 0))
	FROM 
		CRS_ClientInstance CI, 
		CRS_ClientList CL,
		CRS_SaleLedger SL
	WHERE
		CL.ClientID = CI.ClientID AND 
		CI.ClientInstanceID = SL.ClientInstanceID AND
		SL.Posted = 'Y' AND 
		SL.Date BETWEEN @ar_startdate and @ar_enddate
	GROUP BY SL.date, CL.Name
	UNION ALL
	SELECT	
		DATE=LTRIM(RTRIM(MONTH(DATE))) + '-01-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(DATENAME(YEAR, DATE))),
		ClientName=CL.Name,
		value = - SUM(ISNULL(SL.InvTotal, 0))
	FROM
		CRS_ClientInstance CI, 
		CRS_ClientList CL,
		CRS_SrLedger SL
	WHERE
		CL.ClientID = CI.ClientID AND 
		CI.ClientInstanceID = SL.ClientInstanceID AND
		SL.posted = 'Y' AND 
		SL.date BETWEEN @ar_startdate and @ar_enddate
	GROUP BY SL.date, CL.Name
	UNION ALL
	SELECT	
		DATE=LTRIM(RTRIM(MONTH(@ar_startdate))) + '-01-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(DATENAME(YEAR, @ar_startdate))),
		ClientName=CL.Name,
		value = 0.00
	FROM
		CRS_ClientList CL) T
GROUP BY T.ClientName, T.Date

-- SP_CRS_FetchFinalizedSaleOrders
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CRS_FetchFinalizedSaleOrders
	@SRV VARCHAR(50), 
	@DB VARCHAR(50), 
	@OWNER VARCHAR(20),
	@ClientInstanceID SMALLINT,
	@UserCode SMALLINT = NULL
AS

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @err int, @LastSOCode INT, @RowID INT, @SOCount INT
DECLARE @Header_Qry VARCHAR(8000), @Detail_Qry VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @InstanceID_STR VARCHAR(100), @LogID_STR VARCHAR(100), @TP VARCHAR(1000)

SET @TP=''
IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SRV))) = 0 OR @SRV IS NULL) 
	SET @TP = ''
ELSE
	SET @TP = @SRV + '.' 

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DB))) = 0 OR @DB IS NULL)
	SET @TP = @TP
ELSE
	SET @TP = @TP + @DB + '.'

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@OWNER))) = 0 OR @OWNER IS NULL)
	SET @TP = @TP + 'DBO' + '.'
ELSE
	SET @TP = @TP + @OWNER + '.'

IF @UserCode IS NULL
	SET @UserCode=1

SET @InstanceID_STR = LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@ClientInstanceID AS VARCHAR(100))))

Execute @err = sp_LockTabMaxkey 'SaleOrderHeader' , @LastSOCode Output
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @err <>  0
Begin
	RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: unable to fetch new sale order code', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
End

CREATE TABLE #SOHeader (
	SaleOrderCode INT, CustCode SMALLINT, Date DATETIME, OriginalDate DATETIME, BillingDate DATETIME, 
	DiscPerc NUMERIC(6,2), FlatDisc NUMERIC(12,2), MiscCharges NUMERIC(12,2), InvGSTPerc1 NUMERIC(6,2), 
	InvTotal NUMERIC(12,2), SPrice SMALLINT, Remarks VARCHAR(100), 
	CustRefNo VARCHAR(100), CustRefNo2 VARCHAR(100), CustRefNo3 VARCHAR(100), CustRefNo4 VARCHAR(100), 
	DeliveryDeadLine DATETIME, NewSOCode INT NOT NULL DEFAULT (0),
	MyRowID INT IDENTITY(1,1)
)

CREATE TABLE #SODetail (
	SaleOrderCode INT, ICode INT, GCode SMALLINT, LooseQty NUMERIC(15,4), 
	PackUnits SMALLINT, SalePrice NUMERIC(12,2), DiscPerc NUMERIC(6,2), ItemFlatDisc NUMERIC(12,2), 
	SaleItemDescription VARCHAR(100), UnitSalesTax NUMERIC(12,2), GSTPerc NUMERIC(6,2), BonusQty NUMERIC(15,4),
	Remarks VARCHAR(100), Batch VARCHAR(100), Expiry DATETIME
)

SET @Header_Qry = 'SELECT SaleOrderCode, CustCode, Date, OriginalDate, BillingDate, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, InvGSTPerc1, InvTotal, SPrice, Remarks, CustRefNo, CustRefNo2, CustRefNo3, CustRefNo4, DeliveryDeadLine FROM ' + @TP + 'SaleOrderHeader WHERE Finalized=''Y'' AND Posted=''N'' AND CRS_Sent=''N'' AND ClientInstanceID=' + @InstanceID_STR

INSERT INTO #SOHeader (SaleOrderCode, CustCode, Date, OriginalDate, BillingDate, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, InvGSTPerc1, InvTotal, SPrice, Remarks, CustRefNo, CustRefNo2, CustRefNo3, CustRefNo4, DeliveryDeadLine) 
EXECUTE (@Header_Qry)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: Fetching Sale Order Header Data From source', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @SOCount = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #SOHeader), 0)
IF @SOCount <= 0
	RETURN 0

SET @Detail_Qry = 'SELECT SaleOrderCode, ICode, GCode=1, LooseQty, PackUnits, SalePrice, DiscPerc, ItemFlatDisc, SaleItemDescription, UnitSalesTax, GSTPerc, BonusQty, Remarks, Batch, Expiry FROM ' + @TP + 'SaleOrderDetail WHERE SaleOrderCode IN (SELECT SaleOrderCode FROM ' + @TP + 'SaleOrderHeader WHERE Finalized=''Y'' AND Posted=''N'' AND CRS_Sent=''N'' AND ClientInstanceID=' + @InstanceID_STR + ')'

INSERT INTO #SODetail (SaleOrderCode, ICode, GCode, LooseQty, PackUnits, SalePrice, DiscPerc, ItemFlatDisc, SaleItemDescription, UnitSalesTax, GSTPerc, BonusQty, Remarks, Batch, Expiry)
EXECUTE (@Detail_Qry)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: Fetching Sale Order Detail Data From source', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

UPDATE #SOHeader SET NewSOCode = @LastSOCode + MyRowID
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: Updating Identity Column in Temporary Sale Order Data', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

UPDATE #SODetail SET SaleOrderCode = H.NewSOCode
FROM #SOHeader H, #SODetail D
WHERE H.SaleOrderCode = D.SaleOrderCode

INSERT INTO SaleOrderHeader (SaleOrderCode, CustCode, UserCode, Date, OriginalDate, BillingDate, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, InvGSTPerc1, InvTotal, SPrice, Remarks, CustRefNo, CustRefNo2, CustRefNo3, CustRefNo4, DeliveryDeadLine, GRN)
SELECT NewSOCode, CustCode, @UserCode, Date, OriginalDate, BillingDate, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, InvGSTPerc1, InvTotal, SPrice, Remarks, CustRefNo, CustRefNo2, CustRefNo3, CustRefNo4, DeliveryDeadLine, GRN=SaleOrderCode 
FROM #SOHeader
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: Error Inseting Sale Order Data', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

INSERT INTO SaleOrderDetail (SaleOrderCode, ICode, GCode, LooseQty, PackUnits, SalePrice, DiscPerc, ItemFlatDisc, SaleItemDescription, UnitSalesTax, GSTPerc, BonusQty, Remarks, Batch, Expiry)
SELECT SaleOrderCode, ICode, GCode, LooseQty, PackUnits, SalePrice, DiscPerc, ItemFlatDisc, SaleItemDescription, UnitSalesTax, GSTPerc, BonusQty, Remarks, Batch, Expiry
FROM #SODetail
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: Error Inseting Sale Order Detail Data', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @LastSOCode = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(NewSOCode) FROM #SOHeader), 0)

Execute @err = sp_UpdateTabMaxkey 'SaleOrderHeader' , @LastSOCode
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @err <>  0
Begin
	RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: unable to update new sale order code', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
End

SET @Header_Qry = 'Update ' + @TP + 'SaleOrderHeader SET CRS_Sent = ''Y'', CRS_SentOn = GETDATE(), Posted=''Y'', PostDate=GETDATE(), PostedBy=' + ltrim(rtrim(str(@userCode))) + ' WHERE Finalized=''Y'' AND Posted=''N'' AND CRS_Sent=''N'' AND ClientInstanceID=' + @InstanceID_STR
EXECUTE (@Header_Qry)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: Error Marking Sale Order On source as Sent', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

RETURN 0

definition:
-- SP_CRS_GetClientInstanceInfo
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CRS_GetClientInstanceInfo
	@SRV VARCHAR(50), 
	@DB VARCHAR(50), 
	@OWNER VARCHAR(20),
	@InstanceName VARCHAR(100),
	@ClientID SMALLINT OUTPUT,
	@InstanceID SMALLINT OUTPUT
AS

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON
DECLARE @TP VARCHAR(1000)
SET @TP=''
IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SRV))) = 0 OR @SRV IS NULL) 
	SET @TP = ''
ELSE
	SET @TP = @SRV + '.' 

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DB))) = 0 OR @DB IS NULL)
	SET @TP = @TP
ELSE
	SET @TP = @TP + @DB + '.'

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@OWNER))) = 0 OR @OWNER IS NULL)
	SET @TP = @TP + 'DBO' + '.'
ELSE

DELETE REPORTDATA
DECLARE @qry VARCHAR(1000)

EXECUTE (@qry)
SET @InstanceID = (SELECT Code1 FROM REPORTDATA)
SET @ClientID = (SELECT Code2 FROM REPORTDATA)
RETURN 0
