CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CRS_GetLastCRSDataSendInfo
	@SRV VARCHAR(50), 
	@DB VARCHAR(50), 
	@OWNER VARCHAR(20),
	@ClientInstanceID SMALLINT OUTPUT,
	@StartDate DATETIME OUTPUT,
	@EndDate DATETIME OUTPUT,
	@UserCode SMALLINT OUTPUT
AS

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON
DECLARE @InstanceName VARCHAR(100), @qry VARCHAR(1000), @ClientID SMALLINT, @InstanceID SMALLINT, @err INT

SET @InstanceName = ISNULL((SELECT Name FROM ClientInstance) ,'')

EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_GetClientInstanceInfo @SRV, @DB, @OWNER, @InstanceName, @ClientID OUTPUT , @InstanceID OUTPUT
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('CRS Instance Verification: Unable to make CRS Instance Verification From CRS Server.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

DELETE REPORTDATA
SET @qry = 'INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (code1, date1, date2, code2) SELECT ClientInstanceID, StartDate, EndDate, UserCode  FROM ' + @SRV + '.' + @DB + '.' + @OWNER + '.CRS_DataTransferLog WHERE ClientInstanceID = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@InstanceID))) + ' AND LogID IN (SELECT LogID=MAX(LogID) FROM ' + @SRV + '.' + @DB + '.' + @OWNER + '.CRS_DataTransferLog WHERE ClientInstanceID = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@InstanceID))) + ')'
EXECUTE (@qry)

SET @ClientInstanceID = (SELECT MAX(Code1) FROM REPORTDATA)
SET @StartDate = (SELECT MAX(Date1) FROM REPORTDATA)
SET @EndDate = (SELECT MAX(Date2) FROM REPORTDATA)
SET @UserCode = (SELECT MAX(Code2) FROM REPORTDATA)

-- SP_CRS_GetTableKey
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CRS_GetTableKey
	@table_id INT,
	@tablename NVARCHAR(255),
	@fulltablename NVARCHAR(255),
	@PKCOND VARCHAR(1000) OUTPUT, 
	@UPD_PKCOND VARCHAR(1000) OUTPUT, 
	@MAXCOL	VARCHAR(1000) OUTPUT
AS
DECLARE @ColName VARCHAR(255), @KeySeq SMALLINT, @CON NVARCHAR(50)
SET @CON = N'CONVERT(VarChar(10),'

DECLARE TmpCrs CURSOR FOR
SELECT
	COLNAME = CONVERT(sysname,c.name),
	KEYSEQ =
		CASE
			when c.name = index_col(@fulltablename, i.indid,  1) then convert (smallint,1)
			when c.name = index_col(@fulltablename, i.indid,  2) then convert (smallint,2)
			when c.name = index_col(@fulltablename, i.indid,  3) then convert (smallint,3)
			when c.name = index_col(@fulltablename, i.indid,  4) then convert (smallint,4)
			when c.name = index_col(@fulltablename, i.indid,  5) then convert (smallint,5)
			when c.name = index_col(@fulltablename, i.indid,  6) then convert (smallint,6)
			when c.name = index_col(@fulltablename, i.indid,  7) then convert (smallint,7)
			when c.name = index_col(@fulltablename, i.indid,  8) then convert (smallint,8)
			when c.name = index_col(@fulltablename, i.indid,  9) then convert (smallint,9)
			when c.name = index_col(@fulltablename, i.indid, 10) then convert (smallint,10)
			when c.name = index_col(@fulltablename, i.indid, 11) then convert (smallint,11)
			when c.name = index_col(@fulltablename, i.indid, 12) then convert (smallint,12)
			when c.name = index_col(@fulltablename, i.indid, 13) then convert (smallint,13)
			when c.name = index_col(@fulltablename, i.indid, 14) then convert (smallint,14)
			when c.name = index_col(@fulltablename, i.indid, 15) then convert (smallint,15)
			when c.name = index_col(@fulltablename, i.indid, 16) then convert (smallint,16)
		end
from
	sysindexes i, syscolumns c, sysobjects o
where
	o.id = @table_id
	and o.id = c.id
	and o.id = i.id
	and (i.status & 0x800) = 0x800
	and (c.name = index_col (@fulltablename, i.indid,  1) or
	     c.name = index_col (@fulltablename, i.indid,  2) or
	     c.name = index_col (@fulltablename, i.indid,  3) or
	     c.name = index_col (@fulltablename, i.indid,  4) or
	     c.name = index_col (@fulltablename, i.indid,  5) or
	     c.name = index_col (@fulltablename, i.indid,  6) or
	     c.name = index_col (@fulltablename, i.indid,  7) or
	     c.name = index_col (@fulltablename, i.indid,  8) or
	     c.name = index_col (@fulltablename, i.indid,  9) or
	     c.name = index_col (@fulltablename, i.indid, 10) or
	     c.name = index_col (@fulltablename, i.indid, 11) or
	     c.name = index_col (@fulltablename, i.indid, 12) or
	     c.name = index_col (@fulltablename, i.indid, 13) or
	     c.name = index_col (@fulltablename, i.indid, 14) or
	     c.name = index_col (@fulltablename, i.indid, 15) or
	     c.name = index_col (@fulltablename, i.indid, 16)
	    )
order by 2

OPEN TmpCrs

FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs INTO @ColName, @KeySeq
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	IF @KeySeq <> 1
	BEGIN
		SET @PKCOND = @PKCOND  + ' + '
		IF @KeySeq = 2
			SET @UPD_PKCOND = @UPD_PKCOND
		ELSE
			SET @UPD_PKCOND = @UPD_PKCOND + ' AND '
	END

	SET @PKCOND = @PKCOND + ' ' + @CON + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + ')'
	IF @KeySeq <> 1
		SET @UPD_PKCOND = @UPD_PKCOND + ' S.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + ' = ' + 'C.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName))
	SET @MAXCOL = 'MAX(' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@ColName)) + ')'	
	FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs INTO @ColName, @KeySeq
END
CLOSE TmpCrs
DEALLOCATE TmpCrs

RETURN 0

-- sp_CRS_IncomeStatement
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_CRS_IncomeStatement] @ad_SDate DateTime, @ad_EDate DateTime, @ac_level Char(1) AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_temp NUMERIC(20, 5), @ln_RevenueFromSalesCat NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_DirectExpensesCat NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_OperatingExpensesCat NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_OtherExpensesCat NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_OtherRevenuesCat NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_invacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cgs NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @InvSys CHAR(1)

SET @InvSys = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'InventorySystemUsed')), 'P')
SET @ln_invacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_InventoryAcc')
SET @ln_cgs = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CostOfGoodsSoldAcc')
SET @ln_purchaseacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseAccount')
SET @ln_cashacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_equityacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_EquityACC')
SET @ln_salesacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesACC')
SET @ln_salesretacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesReturnACC')
SET @ln_purchaseretacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseReturnsAccount')
SET @ln_revfromservice  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_RevenueFromServices')
SET @ln_OtherRevenuesCat= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_OtherRevenuesCat')
SET @ln_RevenueFROMSalesCat=(SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_RevenueFROMSalesCat')
SET @ln_DirectExpensesCat= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_DirectExpensesCat')
SET @ln_OperatingExpensesCat=(SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_OperatingExpensesCat')
SET @ln_OtherExpensesCat=(SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_OtherExpensesCat')
SET @ln_OtherRevenuesCat=(SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_OtherRevenuesCat')

DELETE reportdata

BEGIN TRANSACTION

INSERT INTO reportdata (code4, name3, code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
SELECT	
	code4 = V.ClientInstanceID, 
	client = (SELECT c.name FROM CRS_ClientInstance CI, CRS_ClientList C WHERE C.ClientID = CI.ClientID AND CI.ClientInstanceID = V.ClientInstanceID),
	code1=-1,
	code2=1,
	code3=0,
	name1= (SELECT name 
		FROM categoryaccounts 
		where catacccode = @ln_RevenueFromSalesCat),
	name2='',
	value1= isnull(sum(isnull(v.debit, 0) - isnull(v.credit, 0)), 0),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
FROM crs_virtualgl v
WHERE 
	v.acccode in (SELECT acccode FROM accounts where subcode in 
		(SELECT subacccode 
		FROM subaccounts 
		where catacccode = @ln_RevenueFromSalesCat)) and
	v.date >= @ad_SDate and v.date <= @ad_EDate
GROUP BY V.ClientInstanceID

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (SELECT isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) FROM reportdata where code2=1)

INSERT INTO reportdata (code4, name3, code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
SELECT	
	code4 = ci.ClientInstanceID, 
	client = c.name,
	code1=-1,
	code2=2,
	code3=0,
	name1= 'COST OF SALES',
	name2='',
	value1=(SELECT isnull(sum(isnull(v.debit, 0) - isnull(v.credit,0)), 0) FROM crs_virtualgl v
		where 
			ci.ClientInstanceID = V.ClientInstanceID AND
			v.acccode in (SELECT acccode FROM accounts where subcode in 
				(SELECT subacccode FROM subaccounts where catacccode = @ln_DirectExpensesCat)) and
		v.date BETWEEN @ad_SDate and @ad_EDate),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
FROM CRS_ClientInstance CI, CRS_ClientList C 
WHERE C.ClientID = CI.ClientID

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (SELECT isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) FROM reportdata where code2=2)

INSERT INTO reportdata (code4, name3, code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
SELECT	
	CI.clientinstanceid, 
	client = c.name,
	code1=-1,
	code2=3,
	code3=0,
	name1= 'GROSS PROFIT/LOSS',
	name2='',
	value1=(SELECT isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) FROM reportdata where code4 = CI.clientinstanceid),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
FROM CRS_ClientInstance CI, CRS_ClientList C 
WHERE C.ClientID = CI.ClientID

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (SELECT isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) FROM reportdata where code2=3)

INSERT INTO reportdata (code4, name3, code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
SELECT	
	V.clientinstanceid, 
	client = (SELECT c.name FROM CRS_ClientInstance CI, CRS_ClientList C WHERE C.ClientID = CI.ClientID AND CI.ClientInstanceID = V.ClientInstanceID),
	code1=-1,
	code2=4,
	code3=0,
	name1= (SELECT name 
		FROM categoryaccounts 
		where catacccode = @ln_OperatingExpensesCat),
	name2='',
	value1=isnull(sum(v.debit - v.credit), 0),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
FROM crs_virtualgl v
WHERE 
	v.acccode in (SELECT acccode FROM accounts where subcode in 
		(SELECT subacccode 
		FROM subaccounts 
		where catacccode = @ln_OperatingExpensesCat)) and
	v.date >= @ad_SDate and v.date <= @ad_EDate
GROUP BY V.ClientInstanceID

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (SELECT isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) FROM reportdata where code2=4)

IF @ln_temp <> 0
BEGIN
INSERT INTO reportdata (code4, name3, code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
SELECT	
	CI.clientinstanceid, 
	client = c.name,
	code1=-1,
	code2=5,
	code3=0,
	name1= 'OPERATING PROFIT/LOSS',
	name2='',
	value1= (SELECT sum(isnull(value1, 0)) FROM reportdata where code4 = CI.clientinstanceid and code2 in (3,4)),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
FROM CRS_ClientInstance CI, CRS_ClientList C 
WHERE C.ClientID = CI.ClientID
END

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (SELECT isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) FROM reportdata where code2=5)

INSERT INTO reportdata (code4, name3, code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
SELECT	
	V.clientinstanceid, 
	client = (SELECT c.name FROM CRS_ClientInstance CI, CRS_ClientList C WHERE C.ClientID = CI.ClientID AND CI.ClientInstanceID = V.ClientInstanceID),
	code1=-1,
	code2=6,
	code3=0,
	name1= (SELECT name 
		FROM categoryaccounts 
		where catacccode = @ln_OtherExpensesCat),
	name2='',
	value1=isnull(sum(v.debit - v.credit), 0),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
FROM crs_virtualgl v
where   v.acccode in (SELECT acccode FROM accounts where subcode in 
		(SELECT subacccode 
		FROM subaccounts 
		where catacccode = @ln_OtherExpensesCat)) and
	v.date >= @ad_SDate and v.date <= @ad_EDate
GROUP BY V.ClientInstanceID

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (SELECT isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) FROM reportdata where code2=6)

IF @ln_temp <> 0
BEGIN
INSERT INTO reportdata (code4, name3, code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
SELECT	
	CI.clientinstanceid, 
	client= c.name,	
	code1=-1,
	code2=7,
	code3=0,
	name1= 'PROFIT/LOSS AFTER ' + (SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(NAME)) FROM categoryaccounts 
					where catacccode = @ln_OtherExpensesCat),
	name2='',
	value1= (SELECT isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) FROM reportdata where code4 = CI.clientinstanceid and code2 in ((SELECT max(code2) FROM reportdata where code4 = ci.clientinstanceid and code2 in (3, 5)),6)),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
FROM CRS_ClientInstance CI, CRS_ClientList C 
WHERE C.ClientID = CI.ClientID
END

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (SELECT isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) FROM reportdata where code2=7)

INSERT INTO reportdata (code4, name3, code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
SELECT	
	V.clientinstanceid, 
	client = (SELECT c.name FROM CRS_ClientInstance CI, CRS_ClientList C WHERE C.ClientID = CI.ClientID AND CI.ClientInstanceID = V.ClientInstanceID),
	code1=-1,
	code2=8,
	code3=0,
	name1= (SELECT name 
		FROM categoryaccounts 
		where catacccode = @ln_OtherRevenuesCat),
	name2='',
	value1= isnull(sum(v.debit - v.credit), 0),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
FROM CRS_VirtualGL v
where   v.acccode in (SELECT acccode FROM accounts where subcode in 
		(SELECT subacccode 
		FROM subaccounts 
		where catacccode = @ln_OtherRevenuesCat)) and
	v.date >= @ad_SDate and v.date <= @ad_EDate
GROUP BY V.ClientInstanceID

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (SELECT isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) FROM reportdata where code2=8)

IF @ln_temp <> 0
BEGIN
INSERT INTO reportdata (code4, name3, code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
SELECT	
	CI.clientinstanceid, 
	client=c.name, 
	code1=-1,
	code2=9,
	code3=0,
	name1= 'NET INCOME/LOSS',
	name2='',
	value1= (SELECT isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) FROM reportdata where code4 = CI.clientinstanceid and code2 in ((SELECT max(code2) FROM reportdata  where code4 = CI.clientinstanceid and code2 in (3, 5, 7)),8)),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
FROM CRS_ClientInstance CI, CRS_ClientList C 
WHERE C.ClientID = CI.ClientID
END

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (SELECT isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) FROM reportdata where code2=9)

INSERT INTO reportdata (code4, name3, code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
SELECT	
	V.clientinstanceid, 
	client = (SELECT c.name FROM CRS_ClientInstance CI, CRS_ClientList C WHERE C.ClientID = CI.ClientID AND CI.ClientInstanceID = V.ClientInstanceID),
	code1=-1,
	code2=10,
	code3=0,
	name1= (SELECT name 
		FROM categoryaccounts 
		where catacccode = c.catacccode),
	name2='',
	value1=isnull(sum(v.debit - v.credit), 0),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
FROM crs_virtualgl v, categoryaccounts c, subaccounts s, accounts a
where   v.acccode in (SELECT acccode FROM accounts where subcode in 
		(SELECT subacccode 
		FROM subaccounts 
		where catacccode in 
			(SELECT catacccode 
			FROM categoryaccounts 
			where mainacccode in (4, 5) and catacccode not in 
				(@ln_RevenueFromSalesCat, @ln_DirectExpensesCat, 
				 @ln_OperatingExpensesCat, @ln_OtherExpensesCat, 
				 @ln_OtherRevenuesCat)))) and
	v.date >= @ad_SDate and v.date <= @ad_EDate and
	v.acccode = a.acccode and a.subcode=s.subacccode and s.catacccode = c.catacccode
GROUP BY V.ClientInstanceID, c.catacccode

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (SELECT isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) FROM reportdata where code2=10)

IF @ln_temp <> 0
BEGIN
INSERT INTO reportdata (code4, name3, code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
SELECT	
	CI.clientinstanceid, 
	client=c.name,
	code1=-1,
	code2=11,
	code3=0,
	name1= 'NET INCOME/LOSS FOR THE PERIOD',
	name2='',
	value1= (SELECT isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) 
		FROM reportdata 
		where code4 = CI.clientinstanceid and code2 in ((SELECT max(code2) FROM reportdata where code4 = CI.clientinstanceid and code2 in (3, 5, 7, 9)), 10)),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
FROM CRS_ClientInstance CI, CRS_ClientList C 
WHERE C.ClientID = CI.ClientID
END

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (SELECT isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) FROM reportdata where code2=11)

UPDATE REPORTDATA SET Value1 = 0 WHERE VALUE1 is NULL

IF @ac_level <> '0'
BEGIN
	set @ln_temp= (SELECT isnull(max(code2), 0) FROM reportdata where code2=1)
	IF @ln_temp <> 0
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO reportdata (code4, name3, code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
		SELECT	
			a.clientinstanceid, 
			client = (SELECT c.name FROM CRS_ClientInstance CI, CRS_ClientList C WHERE C.ClientID = CI.ClientID AND CI.ClientInstanceID = a.ClientInstanceID),
			code1=1,
			code2=(SELECT max(code2)+1 FROM reportdata),
			code3=ac.acccode,
			name1= ac.name,
			name2=(SELECT max(name1) FROM reportdata where code4 = a.ClientInstanceID and code2=1),
			value1=a.balance,
			value2=0,
			value3=0,
			value4=1,
			date1 =@ad_SDate,
			date2 =@ad_EDate,
			value5=@ac_level
		FROM 
		(SELECT clientinstanceid, acccode, isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) as balance
		FROM crs_virtualgl where acccode in 
			(SELECT acccode FROM accounts where subcode in 
				(SELECT subacccode 
				FROM subaccounts 
				where catacccode = @ln_RevenueFromSalesCat)) and
			date >= @ad_SDate and date <= @ad_EDate
		GROUP BY clientinstanceid, acccode) a, accounts ac
		where a.acccode=ac.acccode
	END

	set @ln_temp= (SELECT isnull(max(code2), 0) FROM reportdata where code2=2)
	IF @ln_temp <> 0
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO reportdata (code4, name3, code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
		SELECT	
			a.clientinstanceid, 
			client = (SELECT c.name FROM CRS_ClientInstance CI, CRS_ClientList C WHERE C.ClientID = CI.ClientID AND CI.ClientInstanceID = a.ClientInstanceID),
			code1=2,
			code2=(SELECT max(code2)+1 FROM reportdata),
			code3=ac.acccode,
			name1= ac.name,
			name2=(SELECT max(name1) FROM reportdata where code4 = a.ClientInstanceID and code2=2),
			value1=isnull(a.balance, 0),
			value2=0,
			value3=0,
			value4=1,
			date1 =@ad_SDate,
			date2 =@ad_EDate,
			value5=@ac_level
		FROM 
		(SELECT ClientInstanceID, acccode, sum(isnull(debit, 0)-isnull(credit, 0)) as balance
		FROM crs_virtualgl where acccode in 
			(SELECT acccode FROM accounts where subcode in 
				(SELECT subacccode 
				FROM subaccounts 
				where catacccode = @ln_DirectExpensesCat)) and
			date >= @ad_SDate and date <= @ad_EDate
		GROUP BY ClientInstanceID, acccode) a, accounts ac
		where a.acccode=ac.acccode
	END

			value3=0,
			value4=1,

			date2 =@ad_EDate,
			value5=@ac_level
		FROM
		(SELECT v.ClientInstanceID, a.acccode, a.name, sum(isnull(v.debit, 0)-isnull(v.credit, 0)) as balance
		FROM crs_virtualgl v, accounts a
		where v.acccode in

					FROM categoryaccounts 
					where catacccode = @ln_OtherExpensesCat))) and
			v.acccode = a.acccode and 
			v.date >= @ad_SDate and v.date <= @ad_EDate
		GROUP BY v.ClientInstanceID, a.acccode, a.name) a
	END

	set @ln_temp= (SELECT isnull(max(code2), 0) FROM reportdata where code2=8)
	IF @ln_temp <> 0
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO reportdata (code4, name3, code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
		SELECT	
			a.clientinstanceid,

			value1=isnull(balance, 0),

-- SP_CRS_MONTHLYSALES
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CRS_MONTHLYSALES @ar_startdate datetime, @ar_enddate datetime, @ai_pricetype INT , @ai_returns INT, @ai_bonus INT, @ai_allcust INT, @ai_custcode INT
AS

DELETE ReportData

INSERT INTO ReportData (date1, name1, code1, name2, name3, name4, code2, value1, value2, value3, name5, name6)
SELECT	
	st.Date,
	Name = ic.Name,
	Code = i.icatcode,
	Item = i.name,
	AliasName= i.customicode,
	PackingDesc= i.PackingDesc,
	St.Icode,
	Rate = Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2),
	SaleQty	  =SUM(qty),
	SaleValue =SUM(CASE @ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN value ELSE Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2) * qty END),
	Manfname=(SELECT M.Name FROM Manufacturer M WHERE M.ManfCode = I.ManfCode),
	Customer = CASE WHEN @ai_allcust = 0 THEN (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = @ai_custcode) ELSE 'ALL CUSTOMERS' END
FROM
(SELECT	sd.icode,
	DATE= LTRIM(RTRIM(MONTH(SL.DATE))) + '-01-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(DATENAME(YEAR, SL.DATE))),
	qty = sum(sd.looseqty + CASE @ai_bonus WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE sd.bonusqty END + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
	value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
		(sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
FROM 
	CRS_ClientInstance CI, 
	CRS_ClientList CL,
	CRS_SaleLedger SL,
	CRS_SaleDetail SD,
	(select c.custcode from customer c WHERE @ai_allcust = 0 AND C.CustCode = @ai_custcode
	UNION 
	select c.custcode from customer c WHERE @ai_allcust = 1) CS
WHERE
	CL.ClientID = CI.ClientID AND 
	CI.ClientInstanceID = SL.ClientInstanceID AND
	CI.ClientInstanceID = SD.ClientInstanceID AND
	SL.ClientInstanceID = SD.ClientInstanceID AND
	SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND 
	sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
	sl.custcode = CS.CustCode AND
	sl.date BETWEEN @ar_startdate and @ar_enddate
Group By sd.icode, sl.date
UNION ALL
select	sd.icode,
	DATE=LTRIM(RTRIM(MONTH(DATE))) + '-01-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(DATENAME(YEAR, DATE))),
	qty = -sum(sd.looseqty + CASE @ai_bonus WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE sd.bonusqty END + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
	value = -sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
		sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
FROM
	CRS_ClientInstance CI, 
	CRS_ClientList CL,
	CRS_SrLedger SL,
	CRS_SrDetail SD,
	(select c.custcode from customer c WHERE @ai_allcust = 0 AND C.CustCode = @ai_custcode
	UNION 
	select c.custcode from customer c WHERE @ai_allcust = 1) CS
WHERE
	CL.ClientID = CI.ClientID AND 
	CI.ClientInstanceID = SL.ClientInstanceID AND
	CI.ClientInstanceID = SD.ClientInstanceID AND
	SL.ClientInstanceID = SD.ClientInstanceID AND
	SL.SrInvCode = SD.SrInvCode AND 
	sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
	sl.custcode = CS.CustCode AND
	sl.date BETWEEN @ar_startdate and @ar_enddate AND
	@ai_returns = 1
Group By sd.icode, sl.date) St, 
	Item i, itemcategory ic
WHERE st.icode = i.icode and i.icatcode = ic.icatcode
GROUP BY St.icode, i.name, i.customicode, st.date, i.icatcode, ic.Name, i.manfcode, i.saleprice, i.packunits, i.PackingDesc
ORDER BY st.date, ic.name, i.icatcode, i.name, i.customicode, St.icode

CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CRS_Push_AccVouchers
	@TP VARCHAR(1000),
	@CID VARCHAR(100),
	@ID VARCHAR(100),
	@UserCode SMALLINT = NULL
AS

DECLARE @err int, @Query VARCHAR(4000)
CREATE TABLE #lsl (code INT NOT NULL)

--A/c Vouchers
INSERT INTO #lsl 
SELECT GLVochCode 
FROM DBO.GLHeader WITH (ReadPast)
WHERE Posted='Y' AND CRS_Transfered='N' 
ORDER BY GLVochCode DESC

SET @Query = 'DELETE ' + @TP + 'CRS_VocherCategory WHERE ClientInstanceID = ' + @ID

EXECUTE (@Query)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('VoucherCategory Data Deletion Error: Problem in Deleting VoucherCategory Data From CRS Server', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @Query = 'INSERT INTO ' + @TP + 'CRS_VocherCategory (ClientInstanceID, VochCatCode, Name, ShortName, Counter, Posted, SystemType, JournalVoucher, HeaderTreatment, DetailTreatment, InvoiceBased, InvoiceType, AutoPosting, VoucherOrder, UseForSMS) SELECT ' + @ID + ', VochCatCode, Name, ShortName, Counter, Posted, SystemType, JournalVoucher, HeaderTreatment, DetailTreatment, InvoiceBased, InvoiceType, AutoPosting, VoucherOrder, UseForSMS FROM DBO.VocherCategory '
EXECUTE (@Query)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('VoucherCategory Data Transfer Error: Problem in Sending VoucherCategory Data TO CRS Server', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @Query = 'INSERT INTO ' + @TP + 'CRS_GLheader (ClientInstanceID, GLVochCode, VochCatCode, AccCode, Date, salesmancode, Posted, PostDate, Remarks, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, CHKNO, VoucherCode, SManCode, TransferAble, Transfered, TransferedON, TransferedBY, Imported, ImportedBY, BillSummaryCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate, Synced, SyncedOn, SyncedBy) SELECT ' + @ID + ', GLVochCode, VochCatCode, AccCode, Date, salesmancode, Posted, PostDate, Remarks, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, CHKNO, VoucherCode, SManCode, TransferAble, Transfered, TransferedON, TransferedBY, Imported, ImportedBY, BillSummaryCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate, Synced, SyncedOn, SyncedBy FROM DBO.GLHeader WHERE GLVochCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl)'
EXECUTE (@Query)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('A/C Vouchers Transfer Error: Problem in Sending A/C Vouchers Data TO CRS Server', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @Query = 'INSERT INTO ' + @TP + 'CRS_GLDetail (ClientInstanceID, GLVochCode, AccCode, Debit, Credit, ChkNo, Remarks, GLRowID, GLUTN, PatientCode, INVOICECODE, OUTSTANDINGAMT, BALANCE, GuestCode, StudentCode, ForeignAmt) SELECT ' + @ID + ', GLVochCode, AccCode, Debit, Credit, ChkNo, Remarks, GLRowID, GLUTN, PatientCode, INVOICECODE, OUTSTANDINGAMT, BALANCE, GuestCode, StudentCode, ForeignAmt FROM DBO.GLDetail WHERE GLVochCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl)'

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0

	RaisError('Vouchers Detail Data Transfer Error: Problem in Sending Vouchers Detail Data TO CRS Server', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1

UPDATE DBO.GLHeader SET CRS_Transfered='Y', CRS_Transferedon=GETDATE() WHERE GLVochCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl)

TRUNCATE TABLE #lsl

--Notes
INSERT INTO #lsl 
SELECT NoteCode 
FROM DBO.Notes WITH (ReadPast)
WHERE Posted='Y' AND CRS_Transfered='N' 
ORDER BY NoteCode DESC

SET @Query = 'INSERT INTO ' + @TP + 'CRS_Notes (ClientInstanceID, NoteCode, AccCode, BankAccCode, IssueDate, DueDate, Amount, BankName, DocumentNumber, Remarks, NoteCatCode, Posted, PostDate, SalesmanCode, VoucherCode, Modified, ModifiedBY, PostedBY, Finalized, FinalizedDate, FinalizedBy, Synced, SyncedOn, SyncedBy) SELECT ' + @ID + ', NoteCode, AccCode, BankAccCode, IssueDate, DueDate, Amount, BankName, DocumentNumber, Remarks, NoteCatCode, Posted, PostDate, SalesmanCode, VoucherCode, Modified, ModifiedBY, PostedBY, Finalized, FinalizedDate, FinalizedBy, Synced, SyncedOn, SyncedBy FROM DBO.Notes WHERE NoteCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl)'

	RETURN -1

UPDATE DBO.Notes SET CRS_Transfered='Y', CRS_Transferedon=GETDATE() WHERE NoteCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl)

--TransactionWindow
INSERT INTO #lsl

FROM DBO.TransactionHeader WITH (ReadPast)
WHERE Posted='Y' AND CRS_Transfered='N'

EXECUTE (@Query)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('TransactionHeader Data Transfer Error: Problem in Sending TransactionHeader Data TO CRS Server', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @Query = 'INSERT INTO ' + @TP + 'CRS_TransactionDetail (ClientInstanceID, DocumentCode, AccCode, Amount, Remarks, RowID) SELECT ' + @ID + ', DocumentCode, AccCode, Amount, Remarks, RowID FROM DBO.TransactionDetail WHERE DocumentCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl)'

-- SP_CRS_Push_CRSData
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CRS_Push_CRSData
 	@SRV VARCHAR(50),
 	@DB VARCHAR(50),
 	@OWNER VARCHAR(20),
 	@UserCode SMALLINT = NULL 
AS

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @err int, @VersionSyn TINYINT, @ClientID SMALLINT, @InstanceID SMALLINT, @LogID INT
DECLARE @InstanceName VARCHAR(100), @Remarks VARCHAR(255), @TableName VARCHAR(255)
DECLARE @Query VARCHAR(1000), @TP VARCHAR(1000), @TransferType CHAR(1), @TransactionName VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @CID VARCHAR(100), @ID VARCHAR(100), @LogID_STR VARCHAR(100)

SET @TP=''
IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SRV))) = 0 OR @SRV IS NULL) 
	SET @TP = ''
ELSE
	SET @TP = @SRV + '.' 

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DB))) = 0 OR @DB IS NULL)
	SET @TP = @TP
ELSE
	SET @TP = @TP + @DB + '.'

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@OWNER))) = 0 OR @OWNER IS NULL)
	SET @TP = @TP + 'DBO' + '.'
ELSE
	SET @TP = @TP + @OWNER + '.'

SET @VersionSyn = 0

EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_Compare_Remote_VersionInfo @TP, @VersionSyn OUTPUT
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0 OR @VersionSyn = 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Unable to Continue due to Local and Remote version Conflicts.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @InstanceName = ISNULL((SELECT Name FROM ClientInstance) ,'')

EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_GetClientInstanceInfo @SRV, @DB, @OWNER, @InstanceName, @ClientID OUTPUT , @InstanceID OUTPUT
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('CRS Instance Verification: Unable to make CRS Instance Verification From CRS Server.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

IF @ClientID IS NULL OR @ClientID=0 OR @InstanceID IS NULL OR @InstanceID=0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('CRS Instance Validation: Unable to Validate CRS Instance From CRS Server.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 
--Update this clientid and instanceid into current database
UPDATE ClientInstance SET ClientID=@ClientID, ClientInstanceID=@InstanceID

SET @CID = LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@ClientID AS VARCHAR(100))))
SET @ID = LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@InstanceID AS VARCHAR(100))))
/*
Get Primary Key value for fresh crs_datatransferlog instance
*/
SET @Query = 'INSERT INTO ' + @TP + 'CRS_DataTransferLog (ClientInstanceID, UserCode, StartDate, EndDate) VALUES (' + @ID + ', ' + ISNULL(STR(@UserCode), 'NULL') + ', GETDATE(), GETDATE())'
EXECUTE (@Query)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0 OR @@RowCount = 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: Problem in generating data transfer log header row', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @Query = 'INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (Code1, Name1) SELECT LOGID=MAX(LogID), Name1 = ''CRS_DataTransferLog'' FROM ' + @TP + 'CRS_DataTransferLog WHERE ClientInstanceID = ' + @ID
EXECUTE (@Query)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0 OR @@RowCount = 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: Problem in generating data transfer log header row', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @LOGID = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(Code1) FROM ReportData WHERE Name1='CRS_DataTransferLog'), 0)
SET @LogID_STR = LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@LOGID AS VARCHAR(100))))
IF @LogID <= 0 OR  @LogID IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: Problem in generating data transfer log header row', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

/*Variables to be used in delete, update and insert processes*/
DECLARE TmpCrs1 CURSOR FOR
SELECT TransactionName
FROM CRS_Transactions
WHERE Enable='Y'
ORDER BY TransactionName

OPEN TmpCrs1

FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs1 INTO @TransactionName
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @Query = 'INSERT INTO ' + @TP + 'CRS_DataTransferLogDetail (LogID, SourceTableName, StartDate, EndDate) VALUES (' + @LogID_STR + ', ''' + @TableName + ''', GETDATE(), GETDATE())'
	EXECUTE (@Query)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: Problem in generating data transfer log detail row', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF @TransactionName = 'Stock'
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_Push_Stock @TP, @CID, @ID, @UserCode
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Error While Pushing Stock To CRS Server.', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	IF @TransactionName = 'Purchase'
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_Push_Purchase @TP, @CID, @ID, @UserCode
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Error While Pushing Purchases To CRS Server.', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	IF @TransactionName = 'P/R'
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_Push_PR @TP, @CID, @ID, @UserCode
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Error While Pushing Purchase Return To CRS Server.', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	IF @TransactionName = 'Sales'
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_Push_Sales @TP, @CID, @ID, @UserCode
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Error While Pushing Purchase Return To CRS Server.', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	IF @TransactionName = 'S/R'
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_Push_SR @TP, @CID, @ID, @UserCode
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Error While Pushing Sales Return To CRS Server.', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	IF @TransactionName = 'Receipt'
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_Push_Receipt @TP, @CID, @ID, @UserCode
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Error While Pushing Receipt To CRS Server.', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	IF @TransactionName = 'Issue'
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_Push_Issue @TP, @CID, @ID, @UserCode
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Error While Pushing Issue To CRS Server.', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	IF @TransactionName = 'Adjustment'
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_Push_Adjustment @TP, @CID, @ID, @UserCode
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Error While Pushing Adjustments To CRS Server.', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	IF @TransactionName = 'Due Satisfy'
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_Push_DueSatisfy @TP, @CID, @ID, @UserCode
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Error While Pushing Due Satisfy To CRS Server.', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	IF @TransactionName = 'Inter Godown Transfer'
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_Push_Transfers @TP, @CID, @ID, @UserCode
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Error While Pushing Inter Godown Transfer To CRS Server.', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	IF @TransactionName = 'A/c Transactions'
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_Push_AccVouchers @TP, @CID, @ID, @UserCode
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Error While Pushing A/c Vouchers To CRS Server.', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END 
		
	END

	FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs1 INTO @TransactionName
END
CLOSE TmpCrs1
DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1

SET @Query = 'UPDATE ' + @TP + 'CRS_DataTransferLog SET EndDate = GETDATE() WHERE LogID = ' + @LogID_STR
EXECUTE (@Query)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('CRS Data Transfer Error: Problem in marking end date for data transfer log', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_FetchFinalizedSaleOrders @SRV, @DB, @OWNER, @InstanceID, @UserCode
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Unable To Fetch Sale Orders From CRS Server.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

RETURN 0

definition:
-- SP_CRS_SUBAREASALES_CROSSTAB
CREATE   PROCEDURE SP_CRS_SUBAREASALES_CROSSTAB	
	@startdate datetime, 
	@enddate datetime, 
	@ReportGrouping CHAR(1), 
	@GroupList VARCHAR(8000), 
	@Pricetype TinyInt, 
	@TotCol Float,
	@SubAreaList Varchar(8000) ,
	@onlysalearea CHAR(1) AS

/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'crosstab_reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of an
	Area's sales in all aits subareas and items selected depending upon the grouping criteria selected.

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@startdate, @ar_enddate = Determine the period of report
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items in report
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
	@Pricetype = 1 stands for Actual Price, 2 stands for Sale/Trade Price, 3 stands for Purchase price and 4 stands for Average price
	@TotCol = the number of cross tab clolumns for the report (area shortname columns)
	@SubAreaList = A comma separated SubArea List of values to be filtered for which report is required
*/



DELETE CrossTab_ReportData

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @coltable TABLE (code int, shortname varchar(100), rowid INT identity(1,1))
DECLARE @saleareastable TABLE (code int)
DECLARE @UPD VARCHAR(4000), @Col VARCHAR(10), @RowID INT, @colname VARCHAR(100), @colcode VARCHAR(100), @str_col VARCHAR(10)
DECLARE @totareas FLOAT, @curriter int, @iterations int, @i int, @tot int
DECLARE @ICODE INTEGER, @SUBAREACODE INTEGER, @QTY INT, @VAL NUMERIC(15, 5), @err INT

INSERT INTO @saleareastable 
SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@SubAreaList, ',')

DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

IF @onlysalearea='Y' 
	delete from @saleareastable 
	where code not in 
		(select distinct(customer.Subareacode)
		from CRS_SaleLedger, customer,item, CRS_SaleDetail
		where 	CRS_SaleDetail.ClientInstanceID = CRS_SaleLedger.ClientInstanceID AND
			CRS_SaleLedger.saleinvcode=CRS_SaleDetail.saleinvcode and
			CRS_SaleLedger.posted='Y' and 
			CRS_SaleLedger.date BETWEEN @startdate and @enddate and 
			CRS_SaleLedger.custcode=customer.custcode and
			CRS_SaleDetail.icode=item.icode and
			CASE @ReportGrouping 
				WHEN 'M' THEN item.MANFCODE 
				WHEN 'C' THEN item.ICatCode 
				WHEN 'L' THEN item.ICCode 
				ELSE item.PACKCODE END IN (select code from @Tab_GroupList)
		union
		select distinct(customer.Subareacode)
		from 	crs_srledger, customer, crs_srdetail, item
		where 	crs_srdetail.ClientInstanceID = crs_srledger.ClientInstanceID AND
			crs_srledger.srinvcode=crs_srdetail.srinvcode and
			crs_srledger.posted='Y' and 
			crs_srledger.date BETWEEN @startdate and @enddate and 
			crs_srledger.custcode=customer.custcode and
			crs_srdetail.icode=item.icode and
			CASE @ReportGrouping 
				WHEN 'M' THEN item.MANFCODE 
				WHEN 'C' THEN item.ICatCode 
				WHEN 'L' THEN item.ICCode 
				ELSE item.PACKCODE END IN (select code from @Tab_GroupList))

SELECT @totareas = ISNULL((SELECT Count(Code) FROM @saleareastable), 0)

IF @totareas > 0 and @TotCol > 0
BEGIN

	SELECT @tot = (SELECT MIN(A) FROM (SELECT A=@TotCol UNION SELECT A=@TotAreas) T)

	INSERT @coltable
	SELECT S.SubAreaCode, S.Name
	FROM @saleareastable A, SubArea S
	WHERE A.Code = S.SubAreaCode
	ORDER BY S.Name

	SET @iterations = CEILING(@totareas/@TotCol)
	SET @curriter = 1
	SET @RowID = 0
	WHILE @curriter <= @iterations
	BEGIN
		
		INSERT INTO CrossTab_ReportData (Code1, Code2, Code3)
		SELECT Code, @curriter, NULL FROM @Tab_ItemList

		SET @i = 1
		WHILE @i <= @tot
		BEGIN
			SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
			SELECT @colname = RTRIM(LTRIM(ISNULL((SELECT shortname FROM @coltable WHERE ROWID = @RowID), '')))
			SELECT @colcode = RTRIM(LTRIM(STR((SELECT CODE FROM @coltable WHERE ROWID = @RowID), 7)))
			IF @colcode IS NULL
			BEGIN
				BREAK
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @str_col = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@i, 7)))
				SELECT @UPD = 	'UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData SET C_Name' + @str_col + 
								' = ''' + @colname + ''', C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colcode +
								' WHERE CODE2 = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@curriter, 7)))
				EXECUTE (@UPD)
				SET @err = @@ERROR
				IF @err <> 0
				BEGIN
					SET @UPD = 'UPDATION ERROR, DETAILS: ' + @UPD
					RAISERROR(@UPD, 16, 1, @UPD)
					RETURN -1
				END 
				SET @i = @i + 1
			END
		END
		SET @curriter = @curriter + 1
	END

	DECLARE C1 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT S.ICODE, QTY = ISNULL(Sum(S.QTY), 0),
		VAL= ROUND(SUM(
			CASE @Pricetype WHEN 1 THEN S.NETAMT 
			WHEN 2 THEN S.QTY * ROUND(I.SALEPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			WHEN 3 THEN S.QTY * ROUND(I.PURPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			ELSE S.QTY * ROUND(I.AVGPRICE, 2) END), 0), 
		S.SUBAREACODE
	FROM
		(SELECT SD.ICODE,
			C.SUBAREACODE,
			CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
			QTY = ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
			NETAMT=Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc))), 0), 2)
		FROM	CRS_SaleLedger SL, CRS_SaleDetail SD, CUSTOMER C
		WHERE	SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND
			SD.ClientInstanceID = SL.ClientInstanceID AND
			SL.POSTED='Y' AND 
			C.SubAreaCode in (SELECT CODE FROM @saleareastable) AND
			C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
			SL.DATE BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		GROUP BY
			SD.ICODE,
			SL.CustCode,
			C.SUBAREACODE
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 	SD.ICODE,
			C.SUBAREACODE,
			CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
			QTY = - ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
			NETAMT= - Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty * SD.SRPrice) *
					(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc))), 0), 2)
		FROM	CRS_SRLEDGER SL, CRS_SRDETAIL SD, CUSTOMER C
		WHERE	SD.ClientInstanceID = SL.ClientInstanceID AND
			SL.SRINVCODE = SD.SRINVCODE AND
			C.SubAreaCode in (SELECT CODE FROM @saleareastable) AND
			C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
			SL.POSTED='Y' AND 
			SL.DATE BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		GROUP BY
			SD.ICODE,
			SL.CustCode,
			C.SUBAREACODE) S, ITEM I
	WHERE I.ICODE = S.ICODE AND I.ICODE IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
	GROUP BY 
		S.SUBAREACODE,
		S.ICODE
	ORDER BY S.SUBAREACODE, S.ICODE

	OPEN C1
	FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @ICODE, @QTY, @VAL, @SUBAREACODE
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SET @i = 1
		WHILE @i <= @tot
		BEGIN
			SELECT @colcode = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@ICODE, 7)))
			SELECT @colname = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@SUBAREACODE, 7)))
			SET @str_col = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@i, 7)))

			SELECT @UPD = 	'UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData SET ' + 
							'QTY' + @str_col + ' = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@QTY, 7))) + 
							', VAL' + @str_col + ' = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@VAL, 15, 5))) + 
							', C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colname +
							' WHERE CODE1 = ' + @colcode + ' AND ' + 
							' C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colname
			EXECUTE (@UPD)
			SET @err = @@ERROR
			IF @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @UPD = 'CROSSTAB PLOTING ERROR, DETAILS: ' + @UPD
				RAISERROR(@UPD, 16, 1, @UPD)
				CLOSE C1
				DEALLOCATE C1
				RETURN -1
			END 
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @ICODE, @QTY, @VAL, @SUBAREACODE
	END
	CLOSE C1
	DEALLOCATE C1

	UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData 
	SET NAME1 = I.NAME,
		NAME2 = I.CustomICode,
		Name3 = I.PackingDesc,
		Name4 = NULL,   
		Code5=CASE @ReportGrouping 
			WHEN 'M' THEN I.MANFCODE
			WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
			WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
			ELSE I.PACKCODE END,
		Name5 = CASE @ReportGrouping 
			WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
			WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
			WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
			ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,
		Value1= CASE @Pricetype WHEN 1 THEN ROUND(I.SALEPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			WHEN 2 THEN ROUND(I.SALEPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			WHEN 3 THEN ROUND(I.PURPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			ELSE ROUND(I.AVGPRICE, 2) END
	FROM ITEM I, CrossTab_ReportData C
	WHERE I.ICODE = C.CODE1

	EXECUTE SP_UPDATE_TOTAL_CrossTab_ReportData
END

RETURN 0

-- SP_CRS_TransferClientTable
CREATE    PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CRS_TransferClientTable
	@SRV VARCHAR(50), 
	@DB VARCHAR(50), 
	@OWNER VARCHAR(20),
	@ClientID SMALLINT,
	@InstanceID SMALLINT,
	@SourceTableName NVARCHAR(100)
AS

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON
SET NOCOUNT ON
/*Variables to be used in delete, update and insert processes*/
DECLARE @TransferType CHAR(1), @CRS_TableName NVARCHAR(50), @full_crs_table_name NVARCHAR(255)
DECLARE @WHR VARCHAR(50), @full_table_name NVARCHAR(255)
DECLARE @FROM NVARCHAR(1000), @PKCOND NVARCHAR(1000)
DECLARE @NOTIN NVARCHAR(50), @ENDD NVARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @MAXCOL NVARCHAR(255), @Str_ClientID VARCHAR(255), @Str_InstanceID VARCHAR(255)
DECLARE @TABMAXSQL NVARCHAR(3000), @SQL NVARCHAR(4000), @LIST NVARCHAR(4000), @SRCLIST NVARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @AutoInsert CHAR(1), @AutoUpdate Char(1), @AutoDelete Char(1)
DECLARE @table_id INT, @source_table_id INT, @err INT, @flag TINYINT
DECLARE @Priority INT, @Position SMALLINT
DECLARE @ColName NVARCHAR(255), @TblPrfix NVARCHAR(255)
/*Variables to be used in delete process*/
DECLARE @DEL NVARCHAR(1000), @DEL_QRY NVARCHAR(4000)
/*Variables to be used in Insert process*/ 
DECLARE @INS NVARCHAR(1000), @INS_QRY NVARCHAR(4000), @PKCOND_SRC NVARCHAR(1000)

/*Variables to be used in Update process*/
DECLARE @UPD NVARCHAR(1000), @SETPART NVARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @UPD_PKCOND NVARCHAR(1000), @UPD_QRY NVARCHAR(4000)

/*'FROM' clause of SQL used in INSERT/DELETE*/
SET @TblPrfix=''
IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SRV))) = 0 OR @SRV IS NULL) 
	SET @TblPrfix = ''
ELSE
	SET @TblPrfix = @SRV + '.' 

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DB))) = 0 OR @DB IS NULL)
	SET @TblPrfix = @TblPrfix
ELSE
	SET @TblPrfix = @TblPrfix + @DB + '.'

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@OWNER))) = 0 OR @OWNER IS NULL)
	SET @TblPrfix = @TblPrfix + 'DBO' + '.'
ELSE
	SET @TblPrfix = @TblPrfix + @OWNER + '.'

SET @FROM = N' FROM ' + @TblPrfix
SET @NOTIN = N' NOT IN (SELECT '
--SET @CON = N'CONVERT(VarChar(10),'
SET @SQL = N'SELECT '
SET @WHR = N' WHERE '
SET @ENDD = N' AS C WHERE '

/*BasicData Deletion Variables (initializing variables)*/
SET @DEL = N'DELETE '

/*BasicData Updation Variables (initializing variables)*/
SET @UPD = N'UPDATE S '
SET @SETPART = N' SET '

/*BasicData Updation Variables (initializing variables)*/
SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO '

SELECT @TransferType=TransferType, @CRS_TABLENAME=LTRIM(RTRIM(CRS_TABLENAME)), @PRIORITY=PRIORITY, @AUTOINSERT=AUTOINSERT, @AUTOUPDATE=AUTOUPDATE, @AUTODELETE=AUTODELETE
FROM CRS_TransferableData 
WHERE Enable='Y' AND SourceTableName = @SourceTableName

IF @@RowCount = 0 AND @CRS_TABLENAME IS NULL
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('CRS Data Transfer: Unable to find data tranfer specification for an Object: Name = %s', 16, 1, @SourceTableName)
	RETURN -1
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SET @full_table_name = 'DBO.' + @SourceTableName
	SET @full_crs_table_name = LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.' + @CRS_TableName
	SET @table_id = OBJECT_ID(@full_crs_table_name)
	SET @source_table_id = OBJECT_ID(@full_table_name)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0 OR @table_id IS NULL OR @source_table_id IS NULL 
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('CRS Data Transfer: Invalid Object Refered: Name = %s', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
		RETURN -1
	END 

	SET @PKCOND = ''
	SET @MAXCOL = ''
	SET @UPD_PKCOND = ''

	EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_CRS_GetTableKey @table_id, @CRS_TableName, @full_crs_table_name, @PKCOND OUTPUT, @UPD_PKCOND OUTPUT, @MAXCOL OUTPUT
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('CRS Data Transfer: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
		RETURN -1
	END 

	SET @Str_ClientID = LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@ClientID AS VARCHAR(100))))
	SET @Str_InstanceID = LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@InstanceID AS VARCHAR(100))))
	
	IF @AutoDelete='Y'
	BEGIN
		IF @TransferType = 'B'	
			SET @DEL_QRY = @DEL + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + ' ' + @WHR + ' ' + 'ClientID = ' + @Str_ClientID
		ELSE
			SET @DEL_QRY = @DEL + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + ' ' + @WHR + ' ' + 'ClientInstanceID = ' + @Str_InstanceID 
		EXECUTE (@DEL_QRY)
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('CRS Data Deletion: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	IF @AutoUpdate='Y'
	BEGIN
		SET @flag = 0
		SET @SETPART = N' SET '
	
		DECLARE TmpCrs3 CURSOR FOR
		SELECT
			COLUMNNAME = convert(sysname,c.name),
			POSITION = convert(int,
					   (
						select count(*)
						from syscolumns sc
						where sc.id     =  c.id
						  AND sc.number =  c.number
						  AND sc.colid  <= c.colid
					    ))
		FROM
			sysobjects o,
			syscolumns c
		WHERE
			o.id = @table_id AND c.id = o.id
		ORDER BY 2
	
		OPEN TmpCrs3
	
		FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs3 INTO @ColName, @Position
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			IF ColumnProperty (@table_id, @ColName, 'IsIdentity') <> 1
			BEGIN
--				IF @ColName = (SELECT columnname FROM TransferableData_RestrictedColumns WHERE columnname = @ColName and tablename = @CRS_TableName)
--				BEGIN
--					SET @ColName = @ColName
--				END
--				ELSE
--				BEGIN
					IF @SETPART <> ' SET ' AND RIGHT(@SETPART, 1) <> ','
					BEGIN
						SET @SETPART = @SETPART + ','
					END

					IF @TransferType = 'B' AND @Position = 1
					BEGIN
						SET @SETPART = @SETPART + 'S.ClientID = ' + @Str_ClientID + ','
						SET @flag = 1
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						IF @TransferType = 'T' AND @Position = 1
						BEGIN
							SET @SETPART = @SETPART + 'S.ClientInstanceID=' + @Str_InstanceID + ','
							SET @flag = 1
						END
						ELSE
							SET @flag = 0
					END

					IF @flag = 0
						SET @SETPART = @SETPART + ' S.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + '=' + 'C.' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName))
--				END
			END
			
			FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs3 INTO @ColName, @Position
		END
		CLOSE TmpCrs3
		DEALLOCATE TmpCrs3

		IF @SETPART <> ' SET '
		BEGIN
			IF @TransferType = 'B'
				SET @UPD_QRY = @UPD + @SETPART + ' ' + @FROM + @CRS_TableName + ' AS S, '+ @SourceTableName + @ENDD + ' S.ClientID=' + @Str_ClientID + ' AND ' + @UPD_PKCOND
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF UPPER(@CRS_TableName) <> 'CRS_GodownDetail'
					SET @UPD_QRY = @UPD + @SETPART + ' ' + @FROM + @CRS_TableName + ' AS S, '+ @SourceTableName + @ENDD + ' S.ClientInstanceID=' + @Str_InstanceID + ' AND ' + @UPD_PKCOND + ' AND C.Posted = ''Y'' AND C.CRS_Transfered = ''N'''
			END
			EXECUTE (@UPD_QRY)
			SET @err = @@ERROR
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR('CRS Data Updation: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
				RETURN -1
			END 
			
		END
	END 

	IF @AutoInsert='Y'
	BEGIN
		SET @SQL = N' SELECT '
		SET @LIST=''
		EXECUTE @err = SP_COLUMNLIST @OWNER, @CRS_TableName, @LIST OUTPUT
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RETURN -1
		END
		SET @PKCOND_SRC = SUBSTRING(@PKCOND, ISNULL(CHARINDEX('+', @PKCOND, 1),0) + 1, LEN(@PKCOND))
		IF @TransferType = 'B'
		BEGIN
			SET @SRCLIST = SUBSTRING(@LIST, 10, LEN(@LIST))
			SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @Str_ClientID + ' AS CID, ' + @SRCLIST + ' FROM ' + @SourceTableName + @ENDD + @PKCOND_SRC + @NOTIN + @PKCOND_SRC + ' FROM ' + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + ' WHERE ClientID = ' + @Str_ClientID + ')'
		END 
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @SRCLIST = SUBSTRING(@LIST, 18, LEN(@LIST))
			IF UPPER(@CRS_TableName)='CRS_PURDETAIL'
				SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @Str_InstanceID + ' AS CID, ' + @SRCLIST + ' FROM ' + @SourceTableName + @ENDD + ' C.PurInvCode IN (SELECT M.PurInvCode FROM Purledger M WHERE M.Posted=''Y'' AND M.CRS_Transfered=''N'' AND M.PurInvCode NOT IN (SELECT PurInvCode FROM ' + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + @WHR + ' ClientInstanceID = ' + @Str_InstanceID + '))'
			ELSE
			IF UPPER(@CRS_TableName)='CRS_PRDETAIL'
				SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @Str_InstanceID + ' AS CID, ' + @SRCLIST + ' FROM ' + @SourceTableName + @ENDD + ' C.PrInvCode IN (SELECT M.PrInvCode FROM Prledger M WHERE M.Posted=''Y'' AND M.CRS_Transfered=''N'' AND M.PrInvCode NOT IN (SELECT PrInvCode FROM ' + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + @WHR + ' ClientInstanceID = ' + @Str_InstanceID + '))'
			ELSE
			IF UPPER(@CRS_TableName)='CRS_SALEDETAIL'
				SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @Str_InstanceID + ' AS CID, ' + @SRCLIST + ' FROM ' + @SourceTableName + @ENDD + ' C.SaleInvCode IN (SELECT M.SaleInvCode FROM Saleledger M WHERE M.Posted=''Y'' AND M.CRS_Transfered=''N'' AND M.SaleInvCode NOT IN (SELECT SaleInvCode FROM ' + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + @WHR + ' ClientInstanceID = ' + @Str_InstanceID + '))'
			ELSE
			IF UPPER(@CRS_TableName)='CRS_SRDETAIL'
				SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @Str_InstanceID + ' AS CID, ' + @SRCLIST + ' FROM ' + @SourceTableName + @ENDD + ' C.SRInvCode IN (SELECT M.SRInvCode FROM SRledger M WHERE M.Posted=''Y'' AND M.CRS_Transfered=''N'' AND M.SRInvCode NOT IN (SELECT SRInvCode FROM ' + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + @WHR + ' ClientInstanceID = ' + @Str_InstanceID + '))'
			ELSE
			IF UPPER(@CRS_TableName)='CRS_RECEIPTDETAIL'
				SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @Str_InstanceID + ' AS CID, ' + @SRCLIST + ' FROM ' + @SourceTableName + @ENDD + ' C.ReceiptInvCode IN (SELECT M.ReceiptInvCode FROM ReceiptHeader M WHERE M.Posted=''Y'' AND M.CRS_Transfered=''N'' AND M.ReceiptInvCode NOT IN (SELECT ReceiptInvCode FROM ' + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + @WHR + ' ClientInstanceID = ' + @Str_InstanceID + '))'
			ELSE
			IF UPPER(@CRS_TableName)='CRS_ISSUEDETAIL'
				SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @Str_InstanceID + ' AS CID, ' + @SRCLIST + ' FROM ' + @SourceTableName + @ENDD + ' C.IssueInvCode IN (SELECT M.IssueInvCode FROM IssueHeader M WHERE M.Posted=''Y'' AND M.CRS_Transfered=''N'' AND M.IssueInvCode NOT IN (SELECT IssueInvCode FROM ' + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + @WHR + ' ClientInstanceID = ' + @Str_InstanceID + '))'
			ELSE
			IF UPPER(@CRS_TableName)='CRS_ADJDETAIL'
				SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @Str_InstanceID + ' AS CID, ' + @SRCLIST + ' FROM ' + @SourceTableName + @ENDD + ' C.AdjCode IN (SELECT M.AdjCode FROM AdjHeader M WHERE M.Posted=''Y'' AND M.CRS_Transfered=''N'' AND M.AdjCode NOT IN (SELECT AdjCode FROM ' + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + @WHR + ' ClientInstanceID = ' + @Str_InstanceID + '))'
			ELSE
			IF UPPER(@CRS_TableName)='CRS_TDETAIL'
				SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @Str_InstanceID + ' AS CID, ' + @SRCLIST + ' FROM ' + @SourceTableName + @ENDD + ' C.TransCode IN (SELECT M.TransCode FROM THeader M WHERE M.Posted=''Y'' AND M.CRS_Transfered=''N'' AND M.TransCode NOT IN (SELECT TransCode FROM ' + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + @WHR + ' ClientInstanceID = ' + @Str_InstanceID + '))'
			ELSE
			IF UPPER(@CRS_TableName)='CRS_DUESATISFYDETAIL'
				SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @Str_InstanceID + ' AS CID, ' + @SRCLIST + ' FROM ' + @SourceTableName + @ENDD + ' C.DueSatisfyCode IN (SELECT M.DueSatisfyCode FROM DueSatisfyHeader M WHERE M.CRS_Transfered=''N'' AND M.DueSatisfyCode NOT IN (SELECT DueSatisfyCode FROM ' + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + @WHR + ' ClientInstanceID = ' + @Str_InstanceID + '))'
			ELSE
			IF UPPER(@CRS_TableName)='CRS_DUESATISFYHEADER'
				SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @Str_InstanceID + ' AS CID, ' + @SRCLIST + ' FROM ' + @SourceTableName + @ENDD + ' C.CRS_Transfered=''N'''
			ELSE
			IF UPPER(@CRS_TableName)='CRS_GODOWNDETAIL'
				SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @Str_InstanceID + ' AS CID, ' + @SRCLIST + ' FROM ' + @SourceTableName + ' AS C '
			ELSE
				SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @Str_InstanceID + ' AS CID, ' + @SRCLIST + ' FROM ' + @SourceTableName + @ENDD + ' C.Posted=''Y'' AND C.CRS_Transfered = ''N'' AND ' + @PKCOND_SRC + ' NOT IN (SELECT ' + @PKCOND_SRC + ' FROM ' + @TblPrfix + @CRS_TableName + @WHR + ' ClientInstanceID = ' + @Str_InstanceID + ')'
		END
		EXECUTE (@INS_QRY)
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_crs_table_name)
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END
END

RETURN 0

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.SP_CRS_TransmitClientSale

DECLARE @ClientID INT, @ClientInstanceID INT, @Name VARCHAR(100), @LastSynced DATETIME, @err INT

	SELECT @Name = RTRIM(LTRIM(Name)), @ClientID = ClientID, @ClientInstanceID = ClientInstanceID

	IF @ClientID IS NULL OR @ClientInstanceID IS NULL

	END
	ELSE

SELECT @ClientInstanceID,SaleInvCode,SaleCatCode,CustCode,SalesManCode,Date,DiscPerc,FlatDisc,MiscCharges,SalesTax,Posted,PostDate,Remarks,CustRefNo,HeaderNo,HeaderInvNo,OriginalDate,ModifiedBy,PostedBy,SPrice,QuotationNo,DoctCode,PatientCode,ReprintingCounter,CashReceived,InvGSTPerc1,PrintWaranty,PrintBatch,MessageCode,SManCode,InvoiceSize,CustRefNo2,CustRefNo3,CustRefNo4,GSTNO,InvTotal,MachineName,ModifyCounter,ItemDiscPercNo,DiseaseCode,ReturnCounter,Paid,BillingDate,UnReceivedBalance,TotalOfSaleReturns,ListOfSRInvoices,PrintBalance,AccountFor,PaymentMode,PaymentAccCode,Amt,AmtBY,AmtDate,AmtReference,OutStandingAmt,Marked,DeliveredBy,SaleTypeCode,Balance,PPTCustCode,Deleted,PresCode,ImpactInventory,SaleOrderCode,SaleComments1,SaleComments2,AlterSaleInvCode,ConsiderInPO,DueDate,SRBufferInvCode,CustRefNo5,GCCode,GRN,SuppInvCode,Vehicle,ShipTo,GuaranteePersonCode,CashTendered,CashCharged,CashBack,CashAccCode,CustLicNo,CustLicExpiry,ModuleID,DocCode,SaleTypeInvNo,CurrencyCode,ConversionRate,MiscCharges1,MiscCharges2,MiscCharges3,MiscCharges4,MiscCharges5,SourceSaleInvCode,Fiscalized,FiscalizedOn,FiscalInvoiceNo,AdvanceTax,AdvanceTaxAmt,FBRPOSFee,CashierShiftCode
FROM SaleLedger
WHERE SaleInvCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl)

SET @err = @@ERROR

BEGIN

	RETURN -1

-- SP_CRS_VirtualGL
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CRS_VirtualGL
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON
TRUNCATE TABLE CRS_VirtualGLTemp
DECLARE @rc int
SET @rc = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CRS_VirtualGL (TABLOCKX))

DECLARE @goodsacc smallint, @goodsissueacc smallint, @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), 
	@ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_invacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cgs NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxonsvc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_AdvIncomeTaxPur NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_AdvIncomeTaxSale NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_fbrposfeeacc NUMERIC(5,0)
DECLARE @InvSys CHAR(1)

SET @goodsacc = ISNULL((SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_GoodsReceiptAcc'), 31)
SET @goodsissueacc = ISNULL((SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_GoodsIssuedAcc'), 31)
SET @InvSys = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'InventorySystemUsed')), 'P')
SET @ln_invacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_InventoryAcc')
SET @ln_cgs = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CostOfGoodsSoldAcc')
SET @ln_purchaseacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseAccount')
SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_equityacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_EquityACC')
SET @ln_salesacc    = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesACC')
SET @ln_salesretacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesReturnACC')
SET @ln_purchaseretacc  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseReturnsAccount')
SET @ln_revfromservice  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_RevenueFromServices')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')
SET @ln_salestaxonsvc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesTaxPayableOnServices')
SET @ln_AdvIncomeTaxPur = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvIncomeTaxPur')
SET @ln_AdvIncomeTaxSale = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvIncomeTaxSale')
SET @ln_fbrposfeeacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_FBRPOSFeeAcc')

BEGIN TRANSACTION T1

EXECUTE DBO.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Purchase
EXECUTE DBO.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_PurchaseReturn
EXECUTE DBO.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Sales
EXECUTE DBO.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_SalesReturn
EXECUTE DBO.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Receipt
EXECUTE DBO.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Issue
EXECUTE DBO.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Adjustment
EXECUTE DBO.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Vouchers
EXECUTE DBO.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Notes
EXECUTE DBO.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_TransactionWindow

INSERT INTO CRS_VirtualGL
	(ClientInstanceID, DocumentCode, DocumentType, CatCode, AccCode, AlternateAccCode, date, Debit, Credit, Remarks, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate)
SELECT	ClientInstanceID, 
	DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	dr_AccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = CASE WHEN dr_AccCode IN (SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) THEN AlternateAccCode ELSE NULL END,
	date, 
	Debit = CASE
		WHEN dr_AccCode IN 
			(SELECT acccode FROM accounts 
			WHERE acccode IN 
				(@ln_invacc, @goodsacc, @goodsissueacc, @ln_purchaseacc, @ln_salesacc, @ln_salesretacc, 
				@ln_purchaseretacc, @ln_revfromservice)) THEN Gross - ISNULL(AdvIncomeTax, 0) - ISNULL(FBRPosFee, 0)
		ELSE ISNULL(Gross, 0) + ISNULL(SaleTax, 0)
		END, 
	Credit = 0, Dr_Remarks, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, 
	OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow=0, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From CRS_VirtualGLTemp
UNION ALL /*Credit part of all transactions*/
SELECT 	ClientInstanceID, 
	DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	cr_AccCode, 
	AlternateAccCode = CASE WHEN cr_AccCode IN (SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) THEN AlternateAccCode ELSE NULL END,
	date, 
	Debit = 0, 
	Credit = CASE WHEN cr_AccCode IN
		(SELECT acccode FROM accounts 
			WHERE acccode IN (@ln_invacc, @goodsacc, @goodsissueacc, @ln_purchaseacc, @ln_salesacc, @ln_salesretacc, @ln_purchaseretacc, @ln_revfromservice)) THEN Gross - ISNULL(AdvIncomeTax, 0) - ISNULL(FBRPosFee, 0)
		ELSE ISNULL(Gross, 0) + ISNULL(SaleTax, 0) END, 
	Cr_Remarks, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, 
	OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow=1, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From CRS_VirtualGLTemp
UNION ALL /*  Sales Tax For all the transactions either debit or credit */
SELECT 	ClientInstanceID, 
	DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	AccCode = CASE WHEN DocumentType = 'RS' OR DocumentType = 'RR' THEN @ln_salestaxonsvc ELSE @ln_salestaxacc END, 
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	date, 
	Debit = CASE DocumentType WHEN 'PV' THEN SaleTax WHEN 'SR' THEN SaleTax WHEN 'RR' THEN SaleTax ELSE 0 END, 
	Credit= CASE DocumentType WHEN 'SV' THEN SaleTax WHEN 'PR' THEN SaleTax WHEN 'RS' THEN SaleTax ELSE 0 END, 
	SaleTax_Remarks, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, 
	OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow=2, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From CRS_VirtualGLTemp
WHERE 	SaleTax <> 0
UNION ALL /*  Advance Income Tax For all the transactions either debit or credit */
SELECT 	ClientInstanceID, 
	DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	AccCode = CASE WHEN DocumentType = 'SV' OR DocumentType = 'SR' THEN @ln_AdvIncomeTaxSale ELSE @ln_AdvIncomeTaxPur END, 
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	date, 
	Debit = CASE DocumentType WHEN 'PV' THEN AdvIncomeTax WHEN 'SR' THEN AdvIncomeTax ELSE 0 END, 
	Credit= CASE DocumentType WHEN 'SV' THEN AdvIncomeTax WHEN 'PR' THEN AdvIncomeTax ELSE 0 END, 
	SaleTax_Remarks='Adv. Income Tax ' + CASE WHEN DocumentType = 'SR' OR DocumentType = 'PR' THEN 'Reversed' ELSE 'Accounted For' END, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, 
	OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow=2, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From CRS_VirtualGLTemp
WHERE 	(DocumentType = 'SV' OR DocumentType = 'SR' OR DocumentType = 'PV' OR DocumentType = 'PR') AND AdvIncomeTax <> 0
UNION ALL /*  FBR POS FEE For all the transactions either debit or credit */
SELECT 	ClientInstanceID, 
	DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	AccCode = CASE WHEN DocumentType = 'SV' OR DocumentType = 'SR' THEN @ln_fbrposfeeacc ELSE @ln_fbrposfeeacc END, 
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	date, 
	Debit = CASE DocumentType WHEN 'SR' THEN ISNULL(FBRPosFee, 0) ELSE 0 END, 
	Credit= CASE DocumentType WHEN 'SV' THEN ISNULL(FBRPosFee, 0) ELSE 0 END, 
	SaleTax_Remarks='FBR POS Service Fee ' + CASE DocumentType WHEN 'SR' THEN 'Reversed' ELSE 'Accounted For' END, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, 
	OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow=2, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From CRS_VirtualGLTemp
WHERE 	(DocumentType = 'SV' OR DocumentType = 'SR') AND ISNULL(FBRPosFee, 0) <> 0
UNION ALL /*  Accounting Treatement for Amount Received/Paid during the transactions  First Debit Part of amount received/paid */
SELECT 	ClientInstanceID, DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	DrAmtAccCode, 
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	AmtDate, 
	Debit = Amt, 
	Credit= 0, 
	Remarks=CASE DocumentType WHEN 'PV' THEN 'Paid during pur. inv. no.' 
		WHEN 'PR' THEN 	'Received during p/return no.' 
		WHEN 'SV' THEN 	'Received during sale inv. no.' 
		WHEN 'SR' THEN 	'Paid during s/return no.' ELSE DR_Remarks END+ ':'+ LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(INVOICECODE))) + ' (' + ISNULL((SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(A.Name)) FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = CRS_VirtualGLTemp.dr_acccode), '') + ')' , 
	CheckNo=AmtRef, AmtBy, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, OutstandingAmt, 
	Balance, VROW=3, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From CRS_VirtualGLTemp
WHERE 	Amt > 0
UNION ALL  /* Now Credit Part of amount received/paid during invoice */
SELECT 	ClientInstanceID, 
	DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	CrAmtAccCode, 
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	AmtDate, 
	Debit = 0, 
	Credit= Amt, 
	Remarks=CASE DocumentType WHEN 'PV' THEN 'Paid during pur. inv. no.' 
		WHEN 'PR' THEN 'Received during p/return no.' 
		WHEN 'SV' THEN 'Received during sale inv. no.' 
		WHEN 'SR' THEN 'Paid during s/return no.' ELSE CR_Remarks END + ':'+ LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(INVOICECODE))) + ' (' + ISNULL((SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(A.Name)) FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = CRS_VirtualGLTemp.dr_acccode), '') + ')' , 
	CheckNo=AmtRef, AmtBy, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, OutstandingAmt, 
	Balance, VRow=4, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From CRS_VirtualGLTemp
WHERE 	Amt > 0
UNION ALL /*When Perpetual Inv. System then cgs vouchers are used*/
SELECT	ClientInstanceID, 
	DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	dr_AccCode=CASE WHEN DocumentType ='SV' THEN @ln_cgs ELSE @ln_invacc END,
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	date, 
	Debit = CGS, 
	Credit = 0, Remarks=CASE WHEN DocumentType ='SV' THEN 'Cost of Sale charged for Sale Inv. #' ELSE 'Inventory Accounted for S/R  Inv. #' END + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(DocumentCode))), 
	CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, 
	OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow=0, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From CRS_VirtualGLTemp
WHERE @InvSys <> 'P' AND DocumentType IN ('SV', 'SR') AND CGS <> 0
UNION ALL /*When Perpetual Inv. System then cgs vouchers are used*/
SELECT	ClientInstanceID, 
	DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	dr_AccCode=CASE WHEN DocumentType ='SV' THEN @ln_invacc ELSE @ln_cgs END,
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	date, 
	Debit = 0, 
	Credit = CGS, Remarks=CASE WHEN DocumentType ='SV' THEN 'Inventory Accounted for Sale Inv. #' ELSE 'Cost of Sale Reversed for S/R Inv. #' END + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(DocumentCode))), 
	CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, 
	OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow=0, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From CRS_VirtualGLTemp
WHERE @InvSys <> 'P' AND DocumentType IN ('SV', 'SR') AND CGS <> 0

COMMIT TRANSACTION T1
TRUNCATE TABLE CRS_VirtualGLTemp

-- SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Adjustment
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Adjustment
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_invacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cgs NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @SRemks CHAR(1), @InvSys CHAR(1)
SET @InvSys = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'InventorySystemUsed')), 'P')

SET @ln_invacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_InventoryAcc')
SET @ln_cgs = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CostOfGoodsSoldAcc')
SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_salesacc    = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesACC')
SET @ln_salesretacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesReturnACC')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')

CREATE TABLE #lsl (clientinstanceid smallint not null, code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lsl
SELECT A.ClientInstanceid, A.AdjCode 
FROM CRS_AdjHeader A
WHERE A.Posted = 'Y' AND
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT V.ClientInstanceid, V.DocumentCode FROM CRS_VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType IN ('AI','AD') AND V.ClientInstanceID = A.ClientInstanceid AND V.DocumentCode=A.AdjCode)

INSERT INTO CRS_VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for */
SELECT  A.ClientInstanceid,
	documentcode = A.AdjCode, documenttype    = CASE A.AdjCatCode WHEN 1 THEN 'AI' ELSE 'AD' END, catcode = A.AdjCatCode,
	dr_acccode = CASE A.AdjCatCode WHEN 1 THEN @ln_invacc ELSE A.AccCode END,
	cr_acccode = CASE A.AdjCatCode WHEN 1 THEN A.AccCode ELSE @ln_invacc  END,
	AlternateAccCode = Null,
	Date    = A.date,
	SaleTax=0,
	Gross=Round(SUM(D.looseqty * D.Price), 0),
	dr_remarks = CASE A.AdjCatCode WHEN 1 THEN 'Stock Adjustment Increase # ' ELSE 'Stock Adjustment Decrease # ' END + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(A.AdjCode))),
	cr_remarks = CASE A.AdjCatCode WHEN 1 THEN 'Stock Adjustment Increase # ' ELSE 'Stock Adjustment Decrease # ' END + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(A.AdjCode))),
	saletax_remarks= '',
	CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= A.UserCode, vouchercode= A.AdjCode, invoicecode= A.AdjCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0,
	DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, 
	AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL, AmtRef = NULL, 
	OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax = 0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM CRS_AdjHeader A, CRS_AdjDetail D
WHERE A.ClientInstanceid = D.ClientInstanceid AND 
	A.AdjCode = D.AdjCode AND A.AccCode IS NOT NULL AND
	STR(A.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(A.AdjCode,10) IN (SELECT STR(#lsl.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lsl.Code,10) FROM #lsl)
GROUP BY A.ClientInstanceid, A.AdjCode, A.AccCode, A.AdjCatCode, A.Date, A.UserCode, A.Remarks

TRUNCATE TABLE #lsl

CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Issue AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @invacc smallint, @goodsacc smallint
DECLARE @InvSys CHAR(1)
SET @InvSys = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'InventorySystemUsed')), 'P')
SET @invacc = ISNULL((SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_InventoryAcc'), 7)
SET @goodsacc = ISNULL((SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_GoodsIssuedAcc'), 30)

CREATE TABLE #lsl (clientinstanceid smallint not null, code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lsl
SELECT A.ClientInstanceid, A.IssueInvCode 
FROM CRS_IssueHeader A
WHERE A.Posted = 'Y' AND
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT V.ClientInstanceid, V.DocumentCode FROM CRS_VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType IN ('ISU') AND V.ClientInstanceid = A.ClientInstanceid AND V.DocumentCode = A.IssueInvCode)

INSERT INTO CRS_VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for */
SELECT  A.ClientInstanceid, 
	documentcode = A.IssueInvCode, documenttype = 'ISU', catcode = A.IssueCategoryCode,
	dr_acccode = A.DrAccCode,
	cr_acccode = CASE WHEN @InvSys <> 'P' THEN @invacc ELSE @goodsacc END,
	AlternateAccCode = Null,
	Date    = A.date,
	SaleTax=0,
	Gross=Round(SUM(D.qty * D.Price), 0),
	dr_remarks = CASE WHEN A.Remarks is null THEN 'Goods Issue against Issue Inv #' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(A.IssueInvCode))) ELSE A.Remarks END,
	cr_remarks = CASE WHEN A.Remarks is null THEN 'Goods Issue against Issue Inv #' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(A.IssueInvCode))) ELSE A.Remarks END,
	saletax_remarks= '',
	CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= A.SalesmanCode, vouchercode= A.IssueCode, invoicecode= A.IssueInvCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0,
	DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, 
	AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL, AmtRef = NULL, 
	OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM CRS_IssueHeader A, CRS_IssueDetail D
WHERE A.AccountFor = 'Y' AND A.DrAccCode IS NOT NULL AND 
	A.ClientInstanceid = D.ClientInstanceid AND 
	A.IssueInvCode = D.IssueInvCode AND
	STR(A.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(A.IssueInvCode,10) IN (SELECT STR(#lsl.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lsl.Code,10) FROM #lsl)
GROUP BY A.ClientInstanceid, A.IssueInvCode, A.IssueCode, A.DrAccCode, A.IssueCategoryCode, A.Date, A.SalesmanCode, A.Remarks

TRUNCATE TABLE #lsl

-- SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Notes
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Notes
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0)

SET @ln_purchaseacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseAccount')
SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_equityacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_EquityACC')
SET @ln_purchaseretacc  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseReturnsAccount')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')

CREATE TABLE #lt_notes (clientinstanceid smallint not null, code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lt_notes
SELECT  A.ClientInstanceid, A.NoteCode 
FROM    CRS_Notes A
WHERE   A.Posted='Y' AND 
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT V.ClientInstanceid, V.DocumentCode FROM CRS_VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType IN ('NR','NP') AND V.ClientInstanceid = A.ClientInstanceid AND V.DocumentCode = A.NoteCode)

/* Create Accounting Vouchers from Notes Receivables/PAyables that are entered by user But not accounted for yet (depending on VIRTUALGL Table). That is the posted Notes Receivables/PAyables Vouchers not in VIRTUALGL but in Notes table */
INSERT INTO CRS_VirtualGL
	(ClientInstanceid, DocumentCode, DocumentType, CatCode, AccCode, AlternateAccCode, date, Debit, Credit, Remarks, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate)
Select  Notes.ClientInstanceid, 
	DocumentCode = Notes.NoteCode, 
	DocumentType = Case Notes.NoteCatCode When 1 Then 'NR' Else 'NP' End, 
	catcode = Notes.NoteCatCode,
	acccode= Notes.Bankacccode, 
	AlternateAccCode = NULL, 
	Date    = Notes.PostDate, 
	debit   = Case Notes.NoteCatCode When 1 Then Notes.Amount Else 0 End,
	credit  = Case Notes.NoteCatCode When 2 Then Notes.Amount Else 0 End,
	remarks = notes.remarks, CheckNo = LEFT(notes.DocumentNumber, 20),
	UserCode=notes.Salesmancode, VoucherCode = Notes.VoucherCode, 
	InvoiceCode = NULL, InvoiceType=NULL, OutstandingAmt=0, Balance=0,
	VRow = Case Notes.NoteCatCode When 1 Then 0 Else 1 End,
	PatientCode=NULL, GRN=NULL, GCCode=NULL, Vehicle=NULL, ShipTo=NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL
from    CRS_Notes Notes
where 	STR(Notes.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(Notes.NoteCode,10) IN (SELECT STR(#lt_notes.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lt_notes.Code,10) FROM #lt_notes)
UNION ALL
Select  Notes.ClientInstanceid, 
	DocumentCode = Notes.NoteCode, 
	DocumentType = Case Notes.NoteCatCode When 1 Then 'NR' Else 'NP' End,
	catcode = Notes.NoteCatCode,
	acccode= Notes.acccode, 
	AlternateAccCode = NULL, 
	Date   = Notes.PostDate, 
	debit  = Case Notes.NoteCatCode When 2 Then Notes.Amount Else 0 End,
	credit = Case Notes.NoteCatCode When 1 Then Notes.Amount Else 0 End,
	remarks= notes.remarks, CheckNo = LEFT(notes.DocumentNumber, 20),
	UserCode=notes.Salesmancode, VoucherCode = Notes.VoucherCode, InvoiceCode = NULL, 
	InvoiceType=NULL, OutstandingAmt=0, Balance=0,
	VRow = Case Notes.NoteCatCode When 1 Then 0 Else 1 End,
	PatientCode=NULL, GRN=NULL, GCCode=NULL, Vehicle=NULL, ShipTo=NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL
from    CRS_Notes Notes
where 	STR(Notes.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(Notes.NoteCode,10) IN (SELECT STR(#lt_notes.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lt_notes.Code,10) FROM #lt_notes)

TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_notes
