definition:
-- SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Purchase
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Purchase
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_invacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purexpacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_AdvIncomeTaxPur NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @PRemks CHAR(1), @ReportPurOnPostDate CHAR(1), @InvSys CHAR(1), @RoundUpTo TINYINT, @AdvIncomeTax CHAR(1)

SET @AdvIncomeTax = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference('ApplyAdvanceIncomeTaxInPur')), 'N')
SET @RoundUpTo = (SELECT A=dbo.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('roundpurinvon'))
SET @InvSys = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'InventorySystemUsed')), 'P')
SET @ln_invacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_InventoryAcc')
SET @ln_purchaseacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseAccount')
SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_equityacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_EquityACC')
SET @ln_purchaseretacc  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseReturnsAccount')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')
SET @ln_purexpacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurExpPayableAcc')
SET @ln_AdvIncomeTaxPur = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvIncomeTaxPur')
SET @PRemks = (SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'ShowPurRemarksInLedger' ))
SET @ReportPurOnPostDate = (SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'reportpurchaseonpostingdate' ))

IF @ReportPurOnPostDate IS NULL
	SET @ReportPurOnPostDate = 'Y'

CREATE TABLE #lt_pur (clientinstanceid smallint not null, code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lt_pur
SELECT  P.Clientinstanceid, P.PurInvCode FROM CRS_PurLedger P 
WHERE P.Posted = 'Y' and P.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT V.ClientInstanceid, V.DocumentCode FROM CRS_VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType IN ('PV') AND V.ClientInstanceid = P.ClientInstanceid AND V.DocumentCode = P.PurInvCode)

INSERT INTO CRS_VirtualGLTemp 	/*accounting for purchases*/ 
SELECT  P.Clientinstanceid, documentcode = P.purinvcode, documenttype='PV', catcode = P.PurCatCode,
	dr_acccode = CASE WHEN @InvSys = 'P' THEN @ln_purchaseacc ELSE @ln_invacc END,
	cr_acccode = CASE P.PurCatCode
		WHEN 3 THEN @ln_equityacc /*Opening Purchase*/ ELSE CASE WHEN P.CustCode > 0 THEN P.CustCode ELSE P.suppcode END /*Credit Purhase*/ END,
	AlternateAccCode = Null,
	date    = CASE @ReportPurOnPostDate WHEN 'Y' THEN P.postdate ELSE P.Date END,
	SaleTax=CASE P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
		WHEN  'N' THEN 
			ROUND(
			SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice) * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) - P.flatdisc) * 
				(P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpTo) 
		ELSE 0.00 END,
	Gross=  CASE P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
			WHEN 'N' THEN
				ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + 
				P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, @RoundUpTo)
			ELSE
				ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + 
				P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, @RoundUpTo) + 
				ROUND(
				SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) +
				SUM(ROUND((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
					(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				ROUND((SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice) * 
					(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) - P.flatdisc) * 
					(P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpTo) 
			END,
	dr_remarks = 'Stock accounted for ' + CASE P.PurCatCode
				WHEN 3 THEN 'open.' WHEN 7 THEN 'loose' WHEN 8 THEN 'loose'
				ELSE 'pack' END + ' pur. #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.purinvcode))),
	cr_remarks = 
			CASE @PRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN P.Remarks
			ELSE CASE P.suppinvcode WHEN NULL THEN 
				CASE P.PurCatCode
				WHEN 3 THEN 'Opening Purchase #: '
				WHEN 7 THEN 'Payable on loose purchase #: '
				WHEN 8 THEN 'Payable on loose purchase #: '
				ELSE 	    'Payable on pack purchase #: ' END +
				RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.purinvcode))) ELSE 'Supp. Inv. # : ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(P.suppinvcode)) + ', Date : ' + LTRIM(RTRIM( convert(varchar(12), P.suppinvdate, 103))) END
			END,
	saletax_remarks= 'S.Tax payable on ' + 
			CASE P.PurCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'open' WHEN 7 THEN 'loose' WHEN 8 THEN 'loose'
			ELSE 'pack' END + ' pur. #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.purinvcode))),
	CheckNo = NULL,
	usercode= P.salesmancode, vouchercode= P.purinvcode, invoicecode= P.purinvcode,
	invoicetype = 2 /*2 stands for purchase*/,
	Amt = P.Amt, DrAmtAccCode = P.suppcode, CrAmtAccCode = P.PaymentAccCode,
	AmtBy = P.AmtBy, AmtDate = P.AmtDate, AmtRef = P.AmtReference,
	OutstandingAmt = P.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0, PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = P.GRN, GCCode = P.GCCode, Vehicle = P.Vehicle, ShipTo = P.ShipTo, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, P.CurrencyCode, P.ConversionFactor,
	AdvIncomeTax = CASE WHEN @AdvIncomeTax = 'Y' THEN ISNULL(P.AdvanceTaxAmt,0) ELSE 0 END, FBRPosFee=0.0
FROM CRS_purledger P, CRS_purdetail D
WHERE STR(P.Clientinstanceid, 10) + STR(P.purinvcode, 10) IN (SELECT STR(#lt_pur.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lt_pur.Code,10) FROM #lt_pur) AND
	 P.Clientinstanceid = D.Clientinstanceid AND P.purinvcode = D.purinvcode 
GROUP BY P.Clientinstanceid, P.purinvcode, P.suppcode, P.CustCode, P.purcatcode, P.Date, P.postdate, P.discperc, P.misccharges,
	P.salestax, P.flatdisc, P.InvGSTPerc1, P.salesmancode, P.Amt, P.PaymentAccCode,
	P.AmtBy, P.AmtDate, P.AmtReference, P.OutstandingAmt, P.suppinvcode, P.suppinvdate, P.Remarks,
	P.GRN, P.GCCode, P.Vehicle, P.ShipTo, P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate, P.CurrencyCode, P.ConversionFactor, P.AdvanceTaxAmt
UNION ALL				/* ImpactInventory = 'N' i.e. Accounted For Proforma Purcahses  */
SELECT  P.Clientinstanceid, documentcode = P.purinvcode, documenttype='PV', catcode = P.PurCatCode,
	dr_acccode = CASE WHEN @InvSys = 'P' THEN @ln_purchaseacc ELSE @ln_invacc END, 
	cr_acccode = CASE P.PurCatCode
		WHEN 3 THEN @ln_equityacc   /*Opening Purchase*/ ELSE CASE WHEN P.CustCode > 0 THEN P.CustCode ELSE P.suppcode END /*Credit Purhase*/ END,
	AlternateAccCode = Null,
	date    = CASE @ReportPurOnPostDate WHEN 'Y' THEN P.postdate ELSE P.Date END,
	SaleTax=CASE P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
		WHEN  'N' THEN 
			ROUND(
			SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice) * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) - P.flatdisc) * 
				(P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpTo) 
		ELSE 0.00 END,
	Gross=  CASE P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
			WHEN 'N' THEN
				ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + 
				P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, @RoundUpTo)
			ELSE
				ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + 
				P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, @RoundUpTo) + 
				ROUND(
				SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) +
				SUM(ROUND((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
					(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				ROUND((SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice) * 
					(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) - P.flatdisc) * 
					(P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpTo) 
			END,
	dr_remarks = 'Stock accounted for ' + CASE P.PurCatCode
				WHEN 3 THEN 'open.' WHEN 7 THEN 'loose' WHEN 8 THEN 'loose'
				ELSE 'pack' END + ' pur. #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.purinvcode))),
	cr_remarks = 
			CASE @PRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN P.Remarks
			ELSE CASE P.suppinvcode WHEN NULL THEN 
				CASE P.PurCatCode
				WHEN 3 THEN 'Opening Purchase #: '
				WHEN 7 THEN 'Payable on loose purchase #: '
				WHEN 8 THEN 'Payable on loose purchase #: '
				ELSE 	    'Payable on pack purchase #: ' END +
				RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.purinvcode))) ELSE 'Supp. Inv. # : ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(P.suppinvcode)) + ', Date : ' + LTRIM(RTRIM( convert(varchar(12), P.suppinvdate, 103))) END
			END,
	saletax_remarks= 'S.Tax payable on ' + 
			CASE P.PurCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'open' WHEN 7 THEN 'loose' WHEN 8 THEN 'loose'
			ELSE 'pack' END + ' pur. #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.purinvcode))),
	CheckNo = NULL,
	usercode= P.salesmancode, vouchercode= P.purinvcode, invoicecode= P.purinvcode,
	invoicetype = 2 /*2 stands for purchase*/,
	Amt = P.Amt, DrAmtAccCode = P.suppcode, CrAmtAccCode = P.PaymentAccCode,
	AmtBy = P.AmtBy, AmtDate = P.AmtDate, AmtRef = P.AmtReference,
	OutstandingAmt = P.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0, PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = P.GRN, GCCode = P.GCCode, Vehicle = P.Vehicle, ShipTo = P.ShipTo, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, P.CurrencyCode, P.ConversionFactor,
	AdvIncomeTax = CASE WHEN @AdvIncomeTax = 'Y' THEN ISNULL(P.AdvanceTaxAmt,0) ELSE 0 END, FBRPosFee=0.0
FROM CRS_Purledger P, CRS_ProformaPurdetail D
WHERE STR(P.Clientinstanceid, 10) + STR(P.purinvcode, 10) IN (SELECT STR(#lt_pur.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lt_pur.Code,10) FROM #lt_pur) AND
	 P.Clientinstanceid = D.Clientinstanceid AND P.purinvcode = D.purinvcode 
GROUP BY P.Clientinstanceid, P.purinvcode, P.suppcode, P.CustCode, P.purcatcode, P.Date, P.postdate, P.discperc, P.misccharges,
	P.salestax, P.flatdisc, P.InvGSTPerc1, P.salesmancode, P.Amt, P.PaymentAccCode,
	P.AmtBy, P.AmtDate, P.AmtReference, P.OutstandingAmt, P.suppinvcode, P.suppinvdate, P.Remarks,
	P.GRN, P.GCCode, P.Vehicle, P.ShipTo, P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate, P.CurrencyCode, P.ConversionFactor, P.AdvanceTaxAmt
UNION ALL   /*Purchase Expenses treatment*/
SELECT  P.Clientinstanceid, documentcode = P.purinvcode, documenttype='PV', catcode = P.PurCatCode,
	dr_acccode = PE.AccCode,
	cr_acccode = @ln_purexpacc,
	AlternateAccCode = Null,
	date    = CASE @ReportPurOnPostDate WHEN 'Y' THEN P.postdate ELSE P.Date END,
	SaleTax=0.00,
	Gross= PE.Amount,
	dr_remarks = CASE WHEN LEN(PE.Remarks) > 0 THEN PE.Remarks ELSE 'Purchase Expenses on Inv #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.purinvcode))) END,
	cr_remarks = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=PE.AccCode) + ' Payable',
	saletax_remarks= NULL,
	CheckNo = NULL,
	usercode= P.salesmancode, vouchercode= P.purinvcode, invoicecode= P.purinvcode,
	invoicetype = 2 /*2 stands for purchase*/,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL,
	AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL, AmtRef = NULL,
	OutstandingAmt = P.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0, PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = P.GRN, GCCode = P.GCCode, Vehicle = P.Vehicle, ShipTo = P.ShipTo, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, P.CurrencyCode, P.ConversionFactor,
	AdvIncomeTax = 0.00, FBRPosFee=0.0
FROM CRS_PurLedger P, CRS_PurExp PE
WHERE STR(P.Clientinstanceid, 10) + STR(P.purinvcode, 10) IN (SELECT STR(#lt_pur.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lt_pur.Code,10) FROM #lt_pur) AND
	P.Clientinstanceid = PE.Clientinstanceid AND P.PurInvCode = PE.PurInvCode AND PE.Amount > 0
UNION ALL   /*Item Pur Exp*/
SELECT  P.Clientinstanceid, documentcode = P.purinvcode, documenttype='PV', catcode = P.PurCatCode,
	dr_acccode = P.QE1_AccCode,
	cr_acccode = P.QExp1_CrAccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null,
	date    = CASE @ReportPurOnPostDate WHEN 'Y' THEN P.postdate ELSE P.Date END,
	SaleTax=0.00,
	Gross= ISNULL(Round(SUM(D.QE1 * (D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty)), 2), 0),
	dr_remarks = CASE WHEN LEN(P.Remarks) > 0 THEN P.Remarks ELSE 'Item Purchase Exp. on Inv #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.purinvcode))) END,
	cr_remarks = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=P.QE1_AccCode) + ' Payable',
	saletax_remarks= NULL,
	CheckNo = NULL,
	usercode= P.salesmancode, vouchercode= P.purinvcode, invoicecode= P.purinvcode,
	invoicetype = 2 /*2 stands for purchase*/,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL,
	AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL, AmtRef = NULL,
	OutstandingAmt = P.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0, PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = P.GRN, GCCode = P.GCCode, Vehicle = P.Vehicle, ShipTo = P.ShipTo, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, P.CurrencyCode, P.ConversionFactor,
	AdvIncomeTax = 0.00, FBRPosFee=0.0
FROM CRS_PurLedger P, CRS_PurDetail D
WHERE STR(P.Clientinstanceid, 10) + STR(P.purinvcode, 10) IN (SELECT STR(#lt_pur.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lt_pur.Code,10) FROM #lt_pur) AND
	P.Clientinstanceid = D.Clientinstanceid AND P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND 
	D.QE1 > 0 AND P.QE1_AccCode > 0
GROUP BY P.Clientinstanceid, P.purinvcode, P.PurCatCode, P.postdate, P.date, P.QE1_AccCode, P.QExp1_CrAccCode, P.Remarks, P.salesmancode, P.OutstandingAmt, P.GRN, P.GCCode, P.Vehicle, P.ShipTo, P.CurrencyCode, P.ConversionFactor
UNION ALL   /*Item Pur Exp*/
SELECT  P.Clientinstanceid, documentcode = P.purinvcode, documenttype='PV', catcode = P.PurCatCode,
	dr_acccode = P.QE2_AccCode,
	cr_acccode = P.QExp2_CrAccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null,
	date    = CASE @ReportPurOnPostDate WHEN 'Y' THEN P.postdate ELSE P.Date END,
	SaleTax=0.00,
	Gross= ISNULL(Round(SUM(D.QE2 * (D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty)), 2), 0),
	dr_remarks = CASE WHEN LEN(P.Remarks) > 0 THEN P.Remarks ELSE 'Item Purchase Exp. on Inv #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.purinvcode))) END,
	cr_remarks = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=P.QE2_AccCode) + ' Payable',
	saletax_remarks= NULL,
	CheckNo = NULL,
	usercode= P.salesmancode, vouchercode= P.purinvcode, invoicecode= P.purinvcode,
	invoicetype = 2 /*2 stands for purchase*/,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL,
	AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL, AmtRef = NULL,
	OutstandingAmt = P.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0, PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = P.GRN, GCCode = P.GCCode, Vehicle = P.Vehicle, ShipTo = P.ShipTo, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, P.CurrencyCode, P.ConversionFactor,

-- SP_CRS_VirtualGL_PurchaseReturn
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_PurchaseReturn
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_invacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @PRRemks CHAR(1), @InvSys CHAR(1), @RoundUpTo TINYINT

SET @RoundUpTo = (SELECT A=dbo.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('roundpurinvon'))
SET @InvSys = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'InventorySystemUsed')), 'P')

SET @ln_invacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_InventoryAcc')
SET @ln_purchaseacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseAccount')
SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_equityacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_EquityACC')
SET @ln_purchaseretacc  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseReturnsAccount')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')

SET @PRRemks = (SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'ShowPRetRemarksInLedger' ))

CREATE TABLE #lt_pret (clientinstanceid smallint not null, code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lt_pret
SELECT P.Clientinstanceid, P.PrInvCode 
FROM CRS_PRLedger P
WHERE P.posted = 'Y' and P.accountfor = 'Y' AND 
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT V.ClientInstanceid, V.DocumentCode FROM CRS_VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType IN ('PR') AND V.DocumentCode = P.PrInvCode)

INSERT INTO CRS_VirtualGLTemp		/*accounting for purchase returns*/ 
SELECT  P.ClientInstanceid, documentcode = P.prinvcode, documenttype    = 'PR', catcode = P.PRCatCode,
		dr_acccode = CASE P.PRCatCode
		WHEN 6 THEN @ln_equityacc /* Opening P/RETURN */ ELSE CASE WHEN P.CustCode > 0 THEN P.CustCode ELSE P.suppcode END /* Cash/Credit P/RETURN */ END,
 	cr_acccode = CASE WHEN @InvSys = 'P' THEN @ln_purchaseretacc ELSE @ln_invacc END,
	AlternateAccCode = Null,
 	date    = P.date,
	SaleTax= CASE P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
		WHEN  'N' THEN 
			ROUND(
			SUM((D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND(D.looseqty * D.prprice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM((D.looseqty * D.prprice) * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) -
				P.flatdisc) * (P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpTo)
		ELSE 0.00 END,
	Gross=  CASE P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
		WHEN  'N' THEN 
			ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty * D.prprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + 
				P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, @RoundUpTo)
		ELSE
			ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty * D.prprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + 
				P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, @RoundUpTo) +
			ROUND(
			SUM((D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND(D.looseqty * D.prprice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM((D.looseqty * D.prprice) * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) -
				P.flatdisc) * (P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpTo)
		END,
	dr_remarks = CASE @PRRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN P.Remarks
			ELSE CASE P.PrCatCode
				WHEN 6 THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Receivable on ' END + ' pur. return #: ' +
				RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.prinvcode))) 
			END,
	cr_remarks = 'Stock returned on ' + CASE P.PrCatCode WHEN 6 THEN 'open' ELSE '' END +
		' pur. return #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.prinvcode))),
	saletax_remarks= 'S.Tax receivable on ' + 
			CASE P.PrCatCode WHEN 6 THEN 'open' ELSE ':' END + 
			' pur. return #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.prinvcode))),
	CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode = P.salesmancode, vouchercode=P.prinvcode, invoicecode=P.prinvcode,
	invoicetype = 4 /*4 stands for purchase return*/,
	Amt = P.Amt, DrAmtAccCode = P.PaymentAccCode, CrAmtAccCode = P.suppcode,
	AmtBy = P.AmtBy, AmtDate = P.AmtDate, AmtRef = P.AmtReference,
	OutstandingAmt = P.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0, PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax = 0.00, FBRPosFee=0.0
FROM  CRS_Prledger P, CRS_Prdetail D
WHERE STR(P.Clientinstanceid, 10) + STR(P.purinvcode, 10) IN (SELECT STR(#lt_pret.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lt_pret.Code,10) FROM #lt_pret) AND
	P.Clientinstanceid = D.Clientinstanceid AND
	P.prinvcode = D.prinvcode
GROUP BY P.ClientInstanceid, P.prinvcode, P.suppcode, P.CustCode, P.prcatcode, P.date, P.discperc, P.misccharges, 
	P.salestax, P.flatdisc, P.invgstperc1, P.salesmancode, P.Amt, P.PaymentAccCode, 
	P.AmtBy, P.AmtDate, P.AmtReference, P.OutstandingAmt, P.Remarks, P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate

TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_pret

DECLARE @InvSys CHAR(1)

CREATE TABLE #lsl (clientinstanceid smallint not null, code INT NOT NULL)

SELECT R.clientinstanceid, R.ReceiptInvCode 
FROM CRS_ReceiptHeader R
WHERE R.Posted = 'Y' AND
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT V.Clientinstanceid, V.DocumentCode FROM CRS_VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType IN ('RCT') AND V.clientinstanceid = R.clientinstanceid AND V.DocumentCode = R.ReceiptInvCode)

SELECT  A.ClientInstanceID,
	documentcode = A.ReceiptInvCode, documenttype = 'RCT', catcode = A.ReceiptCategoryCode,
	dr_acccode = CASE WHEN @InvSys <> 'P' THEN @invacc ELSE @goodsacc END,
	cr_acccode = A.CrAccCode,

	Gross=Round(SUM(D.qty * D.Price), 0),

GROUP BY A.ClientInstanceID, A.ReceiptInvCode, A.ReceiptCode, A.CrAccCode, A.ReceiptCategoryCode, A.PostDate, A.SalesmanCode, A.Remarks

-- SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Sales
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Sales
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_invacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cgs NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_AdvIncomeTaxSale NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_fbrposfeeacc NUMERIC(5,0)
DECLARE @SRemks CHAR(1), @InvSys CHAR(1), @RoundUpYo TINYINT, @AdvIncomeTax CHAR(1)

SET @AdvIncomeTax = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference('ApplyAdvanceIncomeTaxInSale')), 'N')
SET @RoundUpYo = (SELECT A=dbo.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('roundsaleinvon'))
SET @InvSys = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'InventorySystemUsed')), 'P')
SET @ln_invacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_InventoryAcc')
SET @ln_cgs = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CostOfGoodsSoldAcc')
SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_salesacc    = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesACC')
SET @ln_salesretacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesReturnACC')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')
SET @ln_AdvIncomeTaxSale = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvIncomeTaxSale')
SET @ln_fbrposfeeacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_FBRPOSFeeAcc')

SET @SRemks = (SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'ShowSaleRemarksInLedger' ))

CREATE TABLE #lsl (clientinstanceid smallint not null, code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lsl
SELECT  S.Clientinstanceid, S.SaleInvCode 
FROM CRS_SaleLedger S
WHERE S.Posted = 'Y' and S.AccountFor = 'Y' AND 
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT V.ClientInstanceid, V.DocumentCode FROM CRS_VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType IN ('SV') AND V.ClientInstanceid = S.ClientInstanceid AND V.DocumentCode = S.SaleInvCode)

INSERT INTO CRS_VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for sales*/
SELECT  S.Clientinstanceid, documentcode = S.saleinvcode, documenttype    = 'SV', catcode = S.SaleCatCode,
	dr_acccode = CASE S.saleCatCode	WHEN 1 THEN S.CashAccCode /* Cash Sale */
		WHEN 3 THEN S.CashAccCode /* Cash Sale */ ELSE S.custcode /* Credit Sale */ END,
	cr_acccode = @ln_salesacc,
	AlternateAccCode = CASE S.saleCatCode WHEN 1 THEN S.custcode  /* Cash Sale */
		WHEN 3 THEN S.custcode  /* Cash Sale */ ELSE Null END,
	Date    = S.date,
	SaleTax=Round(
	SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
	SUM(ROUND( (D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
		(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
	ROUND( (SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
		(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * S.discperc)) -
		S.flatdisc) * (S.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpYo),
	Gross=Round(
	SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
		(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * S.discperc)) + 
		S.misccharges + S.salestax - S.flatdisc, @RoundUpYo),
	dr_remarks = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN S.Remarks
			ELSE CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'Cash receipt on sale #: '
				WHEN 1 THEN 'Cash receipt on sale #: ' 
				ELSE 'Receivable on cr. sale #: ' END +
				RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))) 
			END,
	cr_remarks = 'Revenue from ' + CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'cash' 
			WHEN 1 THEN 'cash' ELSE 'cr.' END + ' sale #: ' + 
			RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))),
	saletax_remarks= 'S.Tax ' + CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'received' 
		WHEN 1 THEN 'received' ELSE 'receivable' END + ' on ' + 
		CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'cash' WHEN 1 THEN 'cash'
		ELSE 'cr.' END + ' sale #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))),
	CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.salesmancode, vouchercode= S.saleinvcode, invoicecode= S.saleinvcode,
	invoicetype = 1 /*1 stands for sales*/,
	Amt = CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 2 THEN S.Amt ELSE 0 END,
	DrAmtAccCode = S.PaymentAccCode, CrAmtAccCode = S.Custcode, 
	AmtBy = S.AmtBy, AmtDate = S.AmtDate, AmtRef = S.AmtReference, 
	OutstandingAmt = S.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
					CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
					ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
					END
				ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = S.GRN, GCCode = S.GCCode, Vehicle = S.Vehicle, ShipTo = S.ShipTo, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, CGS=ISNULL(SUM((D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.AvgPrice), 0),
	S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate,
	AdvIncomeTax = CASE WHEN @AdvIncomeTax = 'Y' THEN ISNULL(S.AdvanceTaxAmt,0) ELSE 0 END, S.FBRPosFee
FROM CRS_Saleledger S, CRS_Saledetail D
WHERE STR(S.Clientinstanceid, 10) + STR(S.saleinvcode, 10) IN (SELECT STR(#lsl.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lsl.Code,10) FROM #lsl) AND
	S.Clientinstanceid = D.Clientinstanceid AND
	S.saleinvcode = D.saleinvcode 
GROUP BY S.Clientinstanceid, S.saleinvcode, S.custcode, S.salecatcode, S.date, S.discperc, S.misccharges, 
	S.salestax, S.flatdisc, S.invgstperc1, S.salesmancode, S.Amt, S.PaymentAccCode,
	S.AmtBy, S.AmtDate, S.AmtReference, S.OutstandingAmt, S.patientcode, S.admissioncode, S.Remarks,
	S.GRN, S.GCCode, S.Vehicle, S.ShipTo, S.CashAccCode, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate, S.AdvanceTaxAmt, S.FBRPosFee

INSERT INTO CRS_VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for sales having impactinventory='Y' and account for ='Y'*/
SELECT  S.Clientinstanceid, documentcode = S.saleinvcode, documenttype    = 'SV', catcode = S.SaleCatCode,
	dr_acccode = CASE S.saleCatCode	WHEN 1 THEN S.CashAccCode /* Cash Sale */ 
		WHEN 3 THEN S.CashAccCode /* Cash Sale */ ELSE S.custcode /* Credit Sale */ END,
	cr_acccode = @ln_salesacc,
	AlternateAccCode = CASE S.saleCatCode WHEN 1 THEN S.custcode /* Cash Sale */
		WHEN 3 THEN S.custcode  /* Cash Sale */ ELSE Null END,
	Date    = S.date,
	SaleTax=Round(
	SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
	SUM(ROUND( (D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
	ROUND( (SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
		(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * S.discperc)) -
		S.flatdisc) * (S.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpYo),
	Gross=Round(
	SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *	(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * S.discperc)) + 
		S.misccharges + S.salestax - S.flatdisc, @RoundUpYo),
	dr_remarks = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN S.Remarks
		ELSE CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'Cash receipt on sale #: '
			WHEN 1 THEN 'Cash receipt on sale #: ' ELSE 'Receivable on cr. sale #: ' END +
			RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))) 
		END,
	cr_remarks = 'Revenue from ' + CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'cash' 
		WHEN 1 THEN 'cash' ELSE 'cr.' END + ' sale #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))),
	saletax_remarks= 'S.Tax ' + CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'received'
		WHEN 1 THEN 'received' ELSE 'receivable' END + ' on ' + 
		CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'cash' WHEN 1 THEN 'cash' ELSE 'cr.' END + ' sale #: ' + 
		RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))),
	CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.salesmancode, vouchercode= S.saleinvcode, invoicecode= S.saleinvcode,
	invoicetype = 1 /*1 stands for sales*/,
	Amt = CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 2 THEN S.Amt ELSE 0 END,
	DrAmtAccCode = S.PaymentAccCode, CrAmtAccCode = S.Custcode,
	AmtBy = S.AmtBy, AmtDate = S.AmtDate, AmtRef = S.AmtReference,
	OutstandingAmt = S.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
					CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
					ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
					END
				ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = S.GRN, GCCode = S.GCCode, Vehicle = S.Vehicle, ShipTo = S.ShipTo, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, CGS=0,
	S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate,
	AdvIncomeTax = CASE WHEN @AdvIncomeTax = 'Y' THEN ISNULL(S.AdvanceTaxAmt,0) ELSE 0 END, S.FBRPosFee
FROM CRS_Saleledger S, CRS_Saleinvdetail D
WHERE STR(S.Clientinstanceid, 10) + STR(S.saleinvcode, 10) IN (SELECT STR(#lsl.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lsl.Code,10) FROM #lsl) AND
	S.Clientinstanceid = D.Clientinstanceid AND
	S.saleinvcode = D.saleinvcode 
GROUP BY S.Clientinstanceid, S.saleinvcode, S.custcode, S.salecatcode, S.date, S.discperc, S.misccharges,
	S.salestax, S.flatdisc, S.invgstperc1, S.salesmancode, S.Amt, S.PaymentAccCode,
	S.AmtBy, S.AmtDate, S.AmtReference, S.OutstandingAmt, S.patientcode, S.admissioncode, S.Remarks,
	S.GRN, S.GCCode, S.Vehicle, S.ShipTo, S.CashAccCode, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate, S.AdvanceTaxAmt, S.FBRPosFee

INSERT INTO CRS_VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for cash received via master cash window during sales*/
SELECT  S.Clientinstanceid, documentcode = S.saleinvcode, documenttype    = 'SV', catcode = S.SaleCatCode,
	dr_acccode = S.CashAccCode,
	cr_acccode = S.CustCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = S.CashCharged,
	dr_remarks = 'Cash Received on Sale Inv. No.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.SaleInvCode, 10))), 
	cr_remarks = 'Cash Received on Sale Inv. No.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.SaleInvCode, 10))),
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.salesmancode, vouchercode= S.saleinvcode, invoicecode= S.saleinvcode,
	invoicetype = 1 /*1 stands for sales*/,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = S.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
					CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
					ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
					END
				ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = S.GRN, GCCode = S.GCCode, Vehicle = S.Vehicle, ShipTo = S.ShipTo, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, CGS=0, S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate,
	AdvIncomeTax = 0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM CRS_saleledger S
WHERE S.SaleCatCode NOT IN (1, 3) AND S.CashCharged > 0 AND
	STR(S.Clientinstanceid, 10) + STR(S.saleinvcode, 10) IN (SELECT STR(#lsl.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lsl.Code,10) FROM #lsl)
UNION ALL
SELECT  S.Clientinstanceid, documentcode = S.saleinvcode, documenttype    = 'SV', catcode = S.SaleCatCode,
	dr_acccode = D.AccCode,
	cr_acccode = S.CustCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = Amount,
	dr_remarks = D.Remarks, cr_remarks = D.Remarks,
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.salesmancode, vouchercode= S.saleinvcode, invoicecode= S.saleinvcode,
	invoicetype = 1 /*1 stands for sales*/,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = S.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
					CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
					ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
					END
				ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = S.GRN, GCCode = S.GCCode, Vehicle = S.Vehicle, ShipTo = S.ShipTo, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, CGS=0, S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate,
	AdvIncomeTax = 0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM CRS_saleledger S, CRS_CashierWindow D
WHERE STR(S.Clientinstanceid, 10) + STR(S.saleinvcode, 10) IN (SELECT STR(#lsl.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lsl.Code,10) FROM #lsl) AND 
	S.saleinvcode = D.saleinvcode

-- SP_CRS_VirtualGL_SalesReturn
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_SalesReturn
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_invacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cgs NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0)

DECLARE @SRRemks CHAR(1), @InvSys CHAR(1), @RoundUpYo TINYINT

SET @RoundUpYo = (SELECT A=dbo.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('roundsalereturninvon'))
SET @InvSys = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'InventorySystemUsed')), 'P')

SET @ln_invacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_InventoryAcc')
SET @ln_cgs = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CostOfGoodsSoldAcc')
SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_salesacc    = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesACC')
SET @ln_salesretacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesReturnACC')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')

SET @SRRemks = (SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'ShowSRetRemarksInLedger' ))

CREATE TABLE #lt_sret (clientinstanceid smallint not null, code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lt_sret
SELECT  S.Clientinstanceid, S.SRInvCode 
FROM CRS_SRLedger S
WHERE S.posted = 'Y' and S.accountfor = 'Y' AND
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT V.ClientInstanceid, V.DocumentCode FROM CRS_VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType IN ('SR') AND V.ClientInstanceid = S.ClientInstanceid AND V.DocumentCode = S.SRInvCode)

INSERT INTO CRS_VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for sales return*/
SELECT  S.Clientinstanceid, documentcode = S.srinvcode, documenttype = 'SR', catcode = S.SRCatCode,
	dr_acccode = @ln_salesretacc,
	cr_acccode = CASE S.srCatCode WHEN 6 THEN S.CashAccCode /* Cash S/Return*/ 
		WHEN 8 THEN S.CashAccCode /* Cash S/Return*/ ELSE S.custcode /* Credit S/Return*/ END,
	AlternateAccCode = CASE S.srCatCode WHEN 6 THEN S.custcode /* Cash S/Return*/
		WHEN 8 THEN S.custcode /* Cash S/Return*/ ELSE NULL /* Credit S/Return*/ END,
	Date    = S.date,
	SaleTax=ROUND(
		SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
		SUM(ROUND( (D.looseqty * D.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
		ROUND( (sum( (D.looseqty * D.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
			(1- (.01 * S.discperc)) - S.flatdisc) * (S.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpYo),
	Gross= Round( sum( (D.looseqty * D.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
		    (1- (.01 * S.discperc)) + S.misccharges + S.salestax - S.flatdisc, @RoundUpYo),
	dr_remarks = 'Revenue (reversal) on ' + CASE S.SRCatCode WHEN 6 THEN 'cash'
		WHEN 8 THEN 'cash' ELSE 'cr.' END + ' sale ret. #: ' + 
		RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.srinvcode))) + 
		CASE WHEN S.saleinvcode is null Then '' 
		     ELSE ', Sale #:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))) END,
	cr_remarks = CASE @SRRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN S.Remarks
		ELSE CASE S.SRCatCode WHEN 6 THEN 'Cash paid on sale ret.#: '
			WHEN 8 THEN 'Cash paid on sale ret.#: ' ELSE 'Payable on cr. sale ret.#: ' END +
			RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.srinvcode))) + 
			CASE WHEN S.saleinvcode is null Then '' 
			     ELSE ', Sale #:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))) END
		END,
	saletax_remarks= 'S.Tax ' + 
		CASE S.SRCatCode WHEN 6 THEN 'Paid' WHEN 8 THEN 'Paid' ELSE 'Payable' END + 
		' on sale ret. #: ' +  RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.srinvcode)))+ 
		CASE WHEN S.saleinvcode is null Then '' 
		     ELSE ', sale #:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))) END,
	CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= ISNULL(S.salesmancode, 0), vouchercode= S.srinvcode, invoicecode= S.srinvcode,
	invoicetype = 3 /*3 stands for sales return*/,
	Amt =  CASE S.SRCatCode WHEN 8 THEN 0 ELSE S.Amt END,
	DrAmtAccCode = S.Custcode, CrAmtAccCode = S.PaymentAccCode, AmtBy = S.AmtBy,
	AmtDate = S.AmtDate, AmtRef = S.AmtReference,
	OutstandingAmt = S.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
			CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
			ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
			END
		ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode,
	CGS=ISNULL(SUM((D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * CASE WHEN S.SaleInvCode > 0 THEN D.AvgPrice ELSE (D.SRPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - S.DiscPerc * 0.01)) END),0),
	S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate, AdvIncomeTax=ISNULL(S.AdvanceTaxAmt,0), FBRPosFee= ISNULL(S.FBRPosFee,0)
FROM CRS_SRledger S, CRS_SRdetail D
WHERE STR(S.Clientinstanceid, 10) + STR(S.srinvcode, 10) IN (SELECT STR(#lt_sret.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lt_sret.Code,10) FROM #lt_sret) AND
	S.Clientinstanceid = D.Clientinstanceid AND
	S.srinvcode = D.srinvcode 
GROUP BY S.Clientinstanceid, S.srinvcode, S.custcode, S.srcatcode, S.CashAccCode, S.date, S.discperc, S.misccharges,
	 S.salestax, S.flatdisc, S.invgstperc1, S.salesmancode, S.saleinvcode, S.Amt,
	 S.PaymentAccCode, S.AmtBy, S.AmtDate, S.AmtReference, S.OutstandingAmt,
	 S.PatientCode, S.AdmissionCode, S.CashAccCode, S.Remarks,
	 S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate, S.AdvanceTaxAmt, S.FBRPosFee

INSERT INTO CRS_VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for cash received via master cash window during sales*/
SELECT  S.Clientinstanceid, documentcode = S.srinvcode, documenttype = 'SR', catcode = S.SRCatCode,
	dr_acccode = S.CustCode,
	cr_acccode = S.CashAccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = S.CashCharged,
	dr_remarks = 'Cash Paid on S/R No.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.SRInvCode, 10))), 
	cr_remarks = 'Cash Paid on S/R No.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.SRInvCode, 10))),
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.salesmancode, vouchercode= S.srinvcode, invoicecode= S.srinvcode,
	invoicetype = 3 /*3 stands for sale return*/,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = S.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
					CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
					ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
					END
				ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, CGS=0,
	S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate, AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM CRS_SRledger S
WHERE S.SRCatCode NOT IN (6, 8) AND S.CashCharged > 0 AND
	STR(S.Clientinstanceid, 10) + STR(S.srinvcode, 10) IN (SELECT STR(#lt_sret.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lt_sret.Code,10) FROM #lt_sret)
UNION ALL
SELECT  S.Clientinstanceid, documentcode = S.srinvcode, documenttype    = 'SR', catcode = S.SRCatCode,
	dr_acccode = S.CustCode,
	cr_acccode = D.AccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = Amount,
	dr_remarks = D.Remarks, cr_remarks = D.Remarks,
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.salesmancode, vouchercode= S.srinvcode, invoicecode= S.srinvcode,
	invoicetype = 3 /*3 stands for sales Return*/,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = S.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
					CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
					ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
					END
				ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, CGS=0,
	S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate,AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM CRS_srledger S, CRS_MasterCashWin D
WHERE STR(S.Clientinstanceid, 10) + STR(S.srinvcode, 10) IN (SELECT STR(#lt_sret.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lt_sret.Code,10) FROM #lt_sret) AND
	S.Clientinstanceid = D.Clientinstanceid AND
	S.srinvcode = D.DocumentCode AND D.DocumentType = 'SR'

TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_sret

-- SP_CRS_VirtualGL_TransactionWindow
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_TransactionWindow
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

CREATE TABLE #lt_transaction (clientinstanceid smallint not null, code INT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO #lt_transaction
SELECT T.Clientinstanceid, T.DocumentCode
FROM CRS_TransactionHeader T
WHERE NOT EXISTS 
	(SELECT DISTINCT V.ClientInstanceid, V.DocumentCode FROM CRS_VirtualGL V 
	WHERE V.DocumentType IN (SELECT ShortName FROM TransactionType) AND V.Clientinstanceid = T.Clientinstanceid AND V.DocumentCode = T.DocumentCode)

INSERT INTO CRS_VirtualGLTemp	/* accounting for cash received via transaction window */
SELECT  TH.Clientinstanceid, 
	documentcode = TH.documentcode, 
	documenttype    = TT.ShortName, 
	catcode = TH.TransactionTypeCode,
	dr_acccode = TH.CashAccCode,
	cr_acccode = TH.AccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = TH.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = TH.CashCharged,
	dr_remarks = 'Cash Recvd. Against Transaction Doc. Code: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10))), 
	cr_remarks = 'Cash Recvd. Against Transaction Doc. Code: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10))), 
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= TH.usercode, vouchercode= TH.TransactionCode, invoicecode= TH.TransactionCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=TH.PatientCode,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM CRS_TransactionHeader TH, TransactionType TT
WHERE TH.CashCharged > 0 AND TH.Posted = 'Y' AND
	STR(TH.Clientinstanceid, 10) + STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10) IN (SELECT STR(#lt_transaction.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lt_transaction.Code,10) FROM #lt_transaction) AND
	TH.TransactionTypeCode = TT.TransactionTypeCode AND
	TT.TransactionCatCode = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT  TH.Clientinstanceid, 
	documentcode = TH.documentcode, 
	documenttype    = TT.ShortName, 
	catcode = TH.TransactionTypeCode,
	dr_acccode = TD.AccCode,
	cr_acccode = TH.AccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = TH.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = TD.Amount,
	dr_remarks = 'Amount Recvd. Against Transaction Doc. Code: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10))), 
	cr_remarks = 'Amount Recvd. Against Transaction Doc. Code: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10))), 
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= TH.usercode, vouchercode= TH.TransactionCode, invoicecode= TH.TransactionCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=TH.PatientCode,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM CRS_TransactionHeader TH, CRS_TransactionDetail TD, TransactionType TT
WHERE 
	TH.Posted = 'Y' AND
	TH.TransactionTypeCode = TT.TransactionTypeCode AND
	TT.TransactionCatCode = 1 AND
	TH.DocumentCode = TD.DocumentCode AND
	TD.Amount > 0 AND
	STR(TH.Clientinstanceid, 10) + STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10) IN (SELECT STR(#lt_transaction.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lt_transaction.Code,10) FROM #lt_transaction)
UNION ALL
SELECT  TH.Clientinstanceid, 
	documentcode = TH.documentcode, 
	documenttype    = TT.ShortName, 
	catcode = TH.TransactionTypeCode,
	dr_acccode = TH.AccCode,
	cr_acccode = TH.CashAccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = TH.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = TH.CashCharged,
	dr_remarks = 'Cash Paid Against Transaction Doc. Code: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10))), 
	cr_remarks = 'Cash Paid Against Transaction Doc. Code: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10))), 
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= TH.usercode, vouchercode= TH.TransactionCode, invoicecode= TH.TransactionCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=TH.PatientCode,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM CRS_TransactionHeader TH, TransactionType TT
WHERE TH.CashCharged > 0 AND TH.Posted = 'Y' AND
	TH.TransactionTypeCode = TT.TransactionTypeCode AND
	TT.TransactionCatCode = 2 AND
	STR(TH.Clientinstanceid, 10) + STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10) IN (SELECT STR(#lt_transaction.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lt_transaction.Code,10) FROM #lt_transaction)
UNION ALL
SELECT  TH.Clientinstanceid, 
	documentcode = TH.documentcode, 
	documenttype    = TT.ShortName, 
	catcode = TH.TransactionTypeCode,
	dr_acccode = TH.AccCode,
	cr_acccode = TD.AccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = TH.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = TD.Amount,
	dr_remarks = 'Amount Paid Against Transaction Doc. Code: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10))), 
	cr_remarks = 'Amount Paid Against Transaction Doc. Code: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10))), 
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= TH.usercode, vouchercode= TH.TransactionCode, invoicecode= TH.TransactionCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=TH.PatientCode,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM CRS_TransactionHeader TH, CRS_TransactionDetail TD, TransactionType TT
WHERE 
	TH.Posted = 'Y' AND
	TH.TransactionTypeCode = TT.TransactionTypeCode AND
	TT.TransactionCatCode = 2 AND
	TH.DocumentCode = TD.DocumentCode AND
	TD.Amount > 0 AND
	STR(TH.Clientinstanceid, 10) + STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10) IN (SELECT STR(#lt_transaction.ClientInstanceid,10) + STR(#lt_transaction.Code,10) FROM #lt_transaction)

TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_transaction

-- SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Vouchers
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CRS_VirtualGL_Vouchers
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0)

SET @ln_purchaseacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseAccount')
SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_equityacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_EquityACC')
SET @ln_purchaseretacc  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseReturnsAccount')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')

CREATE TABLE #lt_voucher (ClientInstanceID SMALLINT, code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lt_voucher
SELECT  H.ClientInstanceID, H.GLVochCode 
FROM    CRS_GLHeader H
WHERE   NOT EXISTS 
	(SELECT DISTINCT V.ClientInstanceID, V.DocumentCode
	FROM CRS_VirtualGL V, CRS_VocherCategory VC 
	WHERE V.ClientInstanceID = VC.ClientInstanceID AND V.DocumentType = VC.ShortName AND
	H.ClientInstanceID = V.ClientInstanceID AND V.DocumentCode = H.GLVochCode) AND H.Posted = 'Y'

/*  Create Accounting Vouchers that are manullay entered by user but not accounted for yet (depending on VIRTUALGL Table). That is the posted Accounting Vouchers not entered in VIRTUALGL but exist in GLHeader */
INSERT INTO CRS_VirtualGL
	(ClientInstanceID, DocumentCode, DocumentType, CatCode, AccCode, AlternateAccCode, date, Debit, Credit, Remarks, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate)
Select	H.ClientInstanceID, documentcode = H.glvochcode,
	documenttype    = VC.ShortName,
	catcode = H.VochCatCode,
	acccode = D.acccode, 
	AlternateAccCode = NULL, 
	date    = H.Date,
	debit   = D.debit, 
	credit  = D.credit,
	remarks = CASE WHEN h.acccode = d.acccode THEN H.Remarks ELSE D.remarks END,
	CheckNo = CASE WHEN h.acccode = d.acccode THEN H.ChkNo ELSE D.ChkNo END, 
	UserCode = H.salesmancode, H.VoucherCode, D.InvoiceCode, VC.InvoiceType, 
	OutstandingAmt= D.OutstandingAmt, Balance= D.Balance, 
	VRow = CASE D.DEBIT WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, D.PatientCode,
	GRN=NULL, GCCode=NULL, Vehicle=NULL, ShipTo=NULL, GuestCode=D.GuestCode, StudentCode=D.StudentCode, H.CurrencyCode, H.ConversionRate
from CRS_GLHeader H, CRS_GLDetail D, CRS_VocherCategory VC
where STR(H.ClientInstanceID,10) + STR(H.GLVochCode,10) IN 
	(SELECT STR(#lt_voucher.ClientInstanceID,10) + STR(#lt_voucher.Code,10) Code FROM #lt_voucher) AND
	H.ClientInstanceID = D.ClientInstanceID AND 
	H.ClientInstanceID = VC.ClientInstanceID AND 
	H.glvochcode = D.glvochcode and H.vochcatcode = VC.vochcatcode

TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_voucher

name: SP_CRS_ZONALAREASALES_CROSSTAB
definition:
-- SP_CRS_ZONALAREASALES_CROSSTAB
CREATE   PROCEDURE SP_CRS_ZONALAREASALES_CROSSTAB 
@Zonecode INT, @startdate datetime, 
@enddate datetime, @ReportGrouping CHAR(1), 
@GroupList VARCHAR(8000), @Pricetype TinyInt, 
@TotCol Float, @ColCaption SMALLINT AS

/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'crosstab_reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of a
	zone's areas and items selected depending upon the grouping criteria selected.

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@zoneCode = Zone for which report is required
	@startdate, @ar_enddate = Determine the period of report
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items in report
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
	@Pricetype = 1 stands for Actual Price, 2 stands for Sale/Trade Price, 3 stands for Purchase price and 4 stands for Average price
	@TotCol = the number of cross tab clolumns for the report (area shortname columns)
*/

DELETE CrossTab_ReportData

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @coltable TABLE (code int, shortname varchar(100), rowid INT identity(1,1))
DECLARE @UPD VARCHAR(4000), @Col VARCHAR(10), @RowID INT, @colname VARCHAR(100), @colcode VARCHAR(100), @str_col VARCHAR(10)
DECLARE @totareas FLOAT, @curriter int, @iterations int, @i int, @tot int
DECLARE @ICODE INTEGER, @AREACODE INTEGER, @QTY INT, @VAL NUMERIC(15, 5), @err INT

SELECT @totareas = ISNULL((SELECT Count(Area.AreaCode) FROM ZONEAREAS Z,Area WHERE Z.ZONECODE=@zoneCode AND Z.AreaCode = Area.AreaCode), 0)

DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

IF @totareas > 0 and @TotCol > 0
BEGIN

	SELECT @tot = (SELECT MIN(A) FROM (SELECT A=@TotCol UNION SELECT A=@TotAreas) T)

	INSERT @coltable (Code, ShortName)
	SELECT Area.AreaCode, Name=CASE WHEN @ColCaption = 1 THEN Area.ShortName ELSE Area.Name END
	FROM ZONEAREAS Z,Area 
	WHERE Z.ZONECODE=@zoneCode AND Z.AreaCode = Area.AreaCode
	ORDER BY AREA.ShortName

	SET @iterations = CEILING(@totareas/@TotCol)
	SET @curriter = 1
	SET @RowID = 0
	WHILE @curriter <= @iterations
	BEGIN
		
		INSERT INTO CrossTab_ReportData (Code1, Code2, Code3)
		SELECT Code, @curriter, @zoneCode FROM @Tab_ItemList

		SET @i = 1
		WHILE @i <= @tot
		BEGIN
			SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
			SELECT @colname = RTRIM(LTRIM(ISNULL((SELECT shortname FROM @coltable WHERE ROWID = @RowID), '')))
			SELECT @colcode = RTRIM(LTRIM(STR((SELECT CODE FROM @coltable WHERE ROWID = @RowID), 7)))
			IF @colcode IS NULL
			BEGIN
				BREAK
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @str_col = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@i, 7)))
				SELECT @UPD = 	'UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData SET C_Name' + @str_col + 
								' = ''' + @colname + ''', C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colcode +
								' WHERE CODE2 = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@curriter, 7)))
				EXECUTE (@UPD)
				SET @err = @@ERROR
				IF @err <> 0
				BEGIN
					SET @UPD = 'UPDATION ERROR, DETAILS: ' + @UPD
					RAISERROR(@UPD, 16, 1, @UPD)
					RETURN -1
				END 
				SET @i = @i + 1
			END
		END
		SET @curriter = @curriter + 1
	END

	DECLARE C1 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT S.ICODE, QTY = ISNULL(Sum(S.QTY), 0),
		VAL= ROUND(SUM(
			CASE @Pricetype WHEN 1 THEN S.NETAMT 
			WHEN 2 THEN S.QTY * ROUND(I.SALEPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			WHEN 3 THEN S.QTY * ROUND(I.PURPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			ELSE S.QTY * ROUND(I.AVGPRICE, 2) END), 0), 
		S.AREACODE
	FROM
		(SELECT SD.ICODE,
			C.AREACODE,
			CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
			QTY = ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
			NETAMT=Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc))), 0), 2)
		FROM
			CRS_SALELEDGER SL,
			CRS_SALEDETAIL SD,
			CUSTOMER C,
			(SELECT AREACODE, ZONECODE FROM ZONEAREAS WHERE ZONECODE = @zonecode) A
		WHERE
			SD.ClientInstanceID = SL.ClientInstanceID AND
			SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND
			SL.POSTED='Y' AND 
			A.AREACODE = C.AREACODE AND
			C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
			SL.DATE BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		GROUP BY
			SD.ICODE,
			SL.CustCode,
			C.AREACODE
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 	SD.ICODE,
			C.AREACODE,
			CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
			QTY = - ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
			NETAMT= - Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty * SD.SRPrice) *
					(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc))), 0), 2)
		FROM
			CRS_SRLEDGER SL,
			CRS_SRDETAIL SD,
			CUSTOMER C,
			(SELECT AREACODE, ZONECODE FROM ZONEAREAS WHERE ZONECODE = @zonecode) A
		WHERE
			SD.ClientInstanceID = SL.ClientInstanceID AND
			SL.SRINVCODE = SD.SRINVCODE AND
			SL.POSTED='Y' AND 
			A.AREACODE = C.AREACODE AND
			C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
			SL.DATE BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		GROUP BY
			SD.ICODE,
			SL.CustCode,
			C.AREACODE) S, ITEM I
	WHERE I.ICODE = S.ICODE AND I.ICODE IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
	GROUP BY 
		S.AREACODE,
		S.ICODE
	ORDER BY S.AREACODE, S.ICODE

	OPEN C1
	FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @ICODE, @QTY, @VAL, @AREACODE
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SET @i = 1
		WHILE @i <= @tot
		BEGIN
			SELECT @colcode = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@ICODE, 7)))
			SELECT @colname = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@AREACODE, 7)))
			SET @str_col = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@i, 7)))

			SELECT @UPD = 	'UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData SET ' + 
							'QTY' + @str_col + ' = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@QTY, 7))) + 
							', VAL' + @str_col + ' = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@VAL, 15, 5))) + 
							', C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colname +
							' WHERE CODE1 = ' + @colcode + ' AND ' + 
							' C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colname
			EXECUTE (@UPD)
			SET @err = @@ERROR
			IF @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @UPD = 'CROSSTAB PLOTING ERROR, DETAILS: ' + @UPD
				RAISERROR(@UPD, 16, 1, @UPD)
				CLOSE C1
				DEALLOCATE C1
				RETURN -1
			END 
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @ICODE, @QTY, @VAL, @AREACODE
	END
	CLOSE C1
	DEALLOCATE C1

	UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData 
	SET NAME1 = I.NAME,
		NAME2 = I.CustomICode,
		Name3 = I.PackingDesc,
		Name4 = (SELECT NAME FROM ZONE WHERE ZONECODE = @ZONECODE),   
		Code5=CASE @ReportGrouping 
			WHEN 'M' THEN I.MANFCODE
			WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
			WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
			ELSE I.PACKCODE END,
		Name5 = CASE @ReportGrouping 
			WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
			WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
			WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
			ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,
		Value1= CASE @Pricetype WHEN 1 THEN ROUND(I.SALEPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			WHEN 2 THEN ROUND(I.SALEPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			WHEN 3 THEN ROUND(I.PURPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			ELSE ROUND(I.AVGPRICE, 2) END
	FROM ITEM I, CrossTab_ReportData C
	WHERE I.ICODE = C.CODE1

	EXECUTE SP_UPDATE_TOTAL_CrossTab_ReportData
END
RETURN 0

name: SP_CUSTCATWISESALES
definition:
-- SP_CUSTCATWISESALES
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CUSTCATWISESALES @ar_startdate datetime, @ar_enddate datetime, @ReportGrouping CHAR(1), @GroupList VARCHAR(8000), @CustCatList VARCHAR(8000), @AreaList VARCHAR(8000), @ZeroRows tinyint AS 
/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of a
	customer categories specified in parameter @custCatList and items selected 
	depending upon the grouping criteria selected.

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@ar_startdate, @ar_enddate = Determine the period of report
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items in report
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
	@CustCatList = A comma separated list of customercategory
	@AreaList	 = A comma separated list of areas
	@ZeroRows = 1 include rows with zero net sales and 0 for otherwise
*/

DELETE ReportData

DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_CustCatList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_AreaList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_CustCatList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@CustCatList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_AreaList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@AreaList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

INSERT INTO ReportData (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, name3, name4, name5, value1, value2)
SELECT  Code1=S.ICODE,   
	Code2=S.CUSTCATCODE,    
	Code3=CASE @ReportGrouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN I.MANFCODE
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
		ELSE I.PACKCODE END,
	Name1=I.NAME,
	Name2=(SELECT NAME FROM CUSTOMERCATEGORY WHERE CUSTCATCODE = S.CUSTCATCODE),
	Name3=CASE @ReportGrouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
		WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
		WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
		ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,   
	Name4=I.CUSTOMICODE,   
	Name5=I.PackingDesc,
	Value1= ISNULL(SUM(QTY), 0),   
	Value2 = ROUND(SUM(NETAMT), 0)
FROM    
	(SELECT INVNO=-1,
		ICODE=I.ICODE,
		C.CUSTCATCODE,
		QTY = 0,
		NETAMT=0
	FROM
		(SELECT C.CustCatCode 
		FROM CUSTOMER C 
		WHERE C.AreaCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_AreaList) AND
			C.CustCatCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_CustCatList)) C,
		(SELECT ICODE=MIN(Code) FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	WHERE CASE @ZeroRows WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END = 1
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=-1,
		ICODE=I.ICODE,
		C.CUSTCATCODE,
		QTY = 0,
		NETAMT=0
	FROM
		(SELECT CUSTCATCODE=MIN(C.CustCatCode)
		FROM CUSTOMER C 
		WHERE C.AreaCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_AreaList) AND
			C.CustCatCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_CustCatList)) C,
		(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	WHERE CASE @ZeroRows WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END = 1
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=SL.SALEINVCODE,
		SD.ICODE,
		C.CUSTCATCODE,
		QTY = ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
		NETAMT=Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc))), 0), 2)
	FROM
		SALELEDGER SL,
		SALEDETAIL SD,
		(SELECT C.CustCode, C.AreaCode, C.CustCatCode 
		FROM CUSTOMER C 
		WHERE C.AreaCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_AreaList) AND
			C.CustCatCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_CustCatList)) C,
		(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	WHERE
		C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND
		SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
	GROUP BY
		SL.SaleInvCode,
		SD.ICODE,
		C.CUSTCATCODE
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=SL.SALEINVCODE,
		SD.ICODE,
		C.CUSTCATCODE,
		QTY = ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
		NETAMT=Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc))), 0), 2)
	FROM
		SALELEDGER SL,
		SALEINVDETAIL SD,
		(SELECT C.CustCode, C.AreaCode, C.CustCatCode 
		FROM CUSTOMER C 
		WHERE C.AreaCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_AreaList) AND
			C.CustCatCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_CustCatList)) C,
		(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	WHERE
		SL.IMPACTINVENTORY = 'N' AND
		C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND
		SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
	GROUP BY
		SL.SaleInvCode,
		SD.ICODE,
		C.CUSTCATCODE
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=SL.SRINVCODE,
		SD.ICODE,
		C.CUSTCATCODE,
		QTY = - ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
		NETAMT= - Round(ISNULL(SUM(SD.looseqty * SD.SRPrice *
				(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc))), 0), 2)
	FROM
		SRLEDGER SL,
		SRDETAIL SD,
		(SELECT C.CustCode, C.AreaCode, C.CustCatCode 
		FROM CUSTOMER C 
		WHERE C.AreaCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_AreaList) AND
			C.CustCatCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_CustCatList)) C,
		(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	WHERE
		C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SRINVCODE = SD.SRINVCODE AND
		SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
	GROUP BY
		SL.SRInvCode,
		SD.ICODE,
		C.CUSTCATCODE) S,
	(SELECT * FROM ITEM WHERE ICODE IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)) I
WHERE
	S.ICode = I.ICode
GROUP BY
	S.CUSTCATCODE,
	S.ICODE,
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.PackingDesc,
	I.ICatCode,
	I.ICCode,
	I.ManfCode,
	I.PackCode

-- SP_CUSTCATWISESALESDETAIL
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CUSTCATWISESALESDETAIL @ar_startdate datetime, @ar_enddate datetime, @ReportGrouping CHAR(1), @GroupList VARCHAR(8000), @CustCatList VARCHAR(8000), @AreaList VARCHAR(8000), @ZeroRows tinyint AS 
/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of a
	customers (specified by a subset of customer category using parameter @custCatList) 
	and items selected depending upon the grouping criteria selected.

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@ar_startdate, @ar_enddate = Determine the period of report
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items in report
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
	@CustCatList = A comma separated list of customercategory
	@AreaList	 = A comma separated list of areas
	@ZeroRows = 1 include rows with zero net sales and 0 for otherwise
*/

DELETE ReportData

DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_CustCatList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_AreaList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @MIN_CUSTCODE INT, @MIN_ICODE INT

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_CustCatList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@CustCatList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_AreaList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@AreaList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

SET @MIN_CUSTCODE = ISNULL((SELECT MIN(C.CustCode) FROM CUSTOMER C 
						WHERE C.AreaCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_AreaList) AND
						C.CustCatCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_CustCatList)), 0)

INSERT INTO ReportData (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, name3, name4, name5, value1, value2, Value3, value4, value5, Value6, Value7, Value8, Value9, Value10, Value11, Value12, Value13)
SELECT
	Code1=I.ICODE,   
	Code2=ISNULL(S.CUSTCODE, @MIN_CUSTCODE),    
	Code3=CASE @ReportGrouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN I.MANFCODE
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
		ELSE I.PACKCODE END,
	Name1=I.NAME,
	Name2=(SELECT NAME FROM ACCOUNTS WHERE ACCCODE = ISNULL(S.CUSTCODE, @MIN_CUSTCODE)),
	Name3=CASE @ReportGrouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
		WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
		WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
		ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,   
	Name4=I.CUSTOMICODE,   
	Name5=I.PackingDesc,
	Value1 = ROUND(I.SalePrice / CASE I.PackUnits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PackUnits END, 2),
	Value2 = ISNULL(O.QTY, 0),
	Value3 = ISNULL(O.VAL, 0),
	Value4 = ISNULL(P.QTY, 0),
	Value5 = ISNULL(P.VAL, 0),
	Value6 = ISNULL(PR.QTY, 0),
	Value7 = ISNULL(PR.VAL, 0),
	Value8= ISNULL(S.QTY, 0),
	Value9 = ISNULL(S.VAL, 0),
	Value10 = ISNULL(SR.QTY, 0),
	Value11 = ISNULL(SR.VAL, 0),
	Value12 = ISNULL(OT.QTY, 0),
	Value13 = ISNULL(OT.VAL, 0)	
	
FROM
	(SELECT * FROM ITEM WHERE ITEM.ICODE IN 
		(SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)) I
	LEFT OUTER JOIN 
	(SELECT
		ICODE=CODE,
		QTY=ISNULL(Qty, 0),
		VAL=ISNULL(Value, 0)
	FROM udf_openingstock (@ar_startdate, @ReportGrouping, @GroupList, 1)) AS O ON (I.ICode = O.ICode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT
		PD.ICODE,
		QTY=ISNULL(Sum( (PD.looseqty + PD.Packqty + PD.bonusqty) * CASE PL.PurCatCode WHEN 1 THEN PD.Packunits WHEN 2 THEN PD.Packunits ELSE 1 END), 0),
		VAL=Round(ISNULL(SUM((PD.looseqty + PD.PackQty) * PD.PurPrice *
				(1 - (.01 * PD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * PL.discperc))), 0), 2)
	FROM
		PURLEDGER PL, PURDETAIL PD,	(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	WHERE
		PL.POSTED='Y' AND PL.PURINVCODE = PD.PURINVCODE AND
		PD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		PL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND PL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
	GROUP BY PD.ICODE) AS P ON (I.ICode = P.ICode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN 
	(SELECT 
		PD.ICODE,
		QTY=ISNULL(Sum(PD.looseqty + PD.bonusqty), 0),
		VAL=Round(ISNULL(SUM(PD.looseqty * PD.PRPrice *
				(1 - (.01 * PD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * PL.discperc))), 0), 2)
	FROM PRLEDGER PL, PRDETAIL PD, (SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	WHERE
		PL.POSTED='Y' AND PL.PRINVCODE = PD.PRINVCODE AND
		PD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		PL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND PL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
	GROUP BY PD.ICODE) AS PR ON (I.ICode = PR.ICode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN 
	(SELECT
		SD.ICODE,
		QTY = ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
		VAL=  Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty * SD.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc))), 0), 2)
	FROM
		SRLEDGER SL,
		SRDETAIL SD,
		(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	WHERE
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SRINVCODE = SD.SRINVCODE AND
		SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
	GROUP BY
		SD.ICODE) AS SR ON (I.ICode = SR.ICode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT 
		T.ICode, Qty=SUM(T.Qty), Val=SUM(T.Val)
	FROM
		(SELECT
			SD.ICODE,
			QTY=-ISNULL(Sum(SD.qty), 0),
			VAL=-Round(ISNULL(SUM(SD.qty * (SD.SalePrice / CASE SD.Packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE SD.Packunits END)), 0), 2)
		FROM
			IssueHeader SL,
			IssueDETAIL SD,
			(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
		WHERE
			SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.ISSUEINVCODE = SD.ISSUEINVCODE AND
			SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
			SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
		GROUP BY
			SD.ICODE
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 
			SD.ICODE,
			QTY=ISNULL(Sum(SD.qty), 0),
			VAL=Round(ISNULL(SUM(SD.qty * (SD.SalePrice / CASE SD.Packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE SD.Packunits END)), 0), 2)
		FROM
			RECEIPTHeader SL,
			RECEIPTDETAIL SD,
			(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
		WHERE
			SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.RECEIPTINVCODE = SD.RECEIPTINVCODE AND
			SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
			SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
		GROUP BY
			SD.ICODE
		UNION ALL
		SELECT
			SD.ICODE,
			QTY=ISNULL(Sum(SD.Looseqty * CASE SL.AdjCatCode WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END), 0),
			VAL=Round(ISNULL(SUM(SD.Looseqty * (SD.SalePrice / CASE SD.Packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE SD.Packunits END) * CASE SL.AdjCatCode WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END), 0), 2)
		FROM
			AdjHeader SL,
			AdjDETAIL SD,
			(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
		WHERE
			SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.ADJCODE = SD.ADJCODE AND
			SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
			SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
		GROUP BY SD.ICODE) T
	GROUP BY T.ICODE) AS OT ON (I.ICode = OT.ICode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT
		SD.ICODE,
		C.CUSTCODE,
		QTY = ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
		VAL=  Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc))), 0), 2)
	FROM
		SALELEDGER SL,
		SALEDETAIL SD,
		(SELECT C.CustCode
		FROM CUSTOMER C 
		WHERE C.AreaCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_AreaList) AND
			C.CustCatCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_CustCatList)) C,
		(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	WHERE
		C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND
		SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
	GROUP BY
		C.CUSTCODE,
		SD.ICODE
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		SD.ICODE,
		C.CUSTCODE,
		QTY = ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
		VAL=  Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc))), 0), 2)
	FROM
		SALELEDGER SL,
		SALEINVDETAIL SD,
		(SELECT C.CustCode
		FROM CUSTOMER C 
		WHERE C.AreaCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_AreaList) AND
			C.CustCatCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_CustCatList)) C,
		(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	WHERE
		SL.IMPACTINVENTORY = 'N' AND
		C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND
		SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
	GROUP BY
		C.CUSTCODE,
		SD.ICODE) AS S ON (I.ICode = S.ICode)
