-- SP_CUSTCATWISESALESDETAIL_CROSSTAB
CREATE   PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CUSTCATWISESALESDETAIL_CROSSTAB 
	@ar_startdate datetime, 
	@ar_enddate datetime, 
	@ReportGrouping CHAR(1), 
	@GroupList VARCHAR(8000), 
	@CustCatCode INT, 
	@AreaList VARCHAR(8000), 
	@TotCol Float AS 
/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of a
	customers (specified by a customer category using parameter @custCatCode)
	and items selected depending upon the grouping criteria selected.

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@ar_startdate, @ar_enddate = Determine the period of report
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items in report
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
	@CustCatCode = customercategory for which report is needed
	@AreaList	 = A comma separated list of areas
	@TotCol = the number of cross tab clolumns for the report (customer columns)
*/

DELETE CrossTab_ReportData

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_AreaList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_AreaList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@AreaList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

DECLARE @coltable TABLE (code int, name varchar(100), rowid INT identity(1,1))
DECLARE @UPD VARCHAR(4000), @Col VARCHAR(10), @RowID INT, @colname VARCHAR(100), @colcode VARCHAR(100), @str_col VARCHAR(10)
DECLARE @totcols FLOAT, @curriter int, @iterations int, @i int, @tot int, @err INT
DECLARE @ICODE INTEGER, @AREACODE INTEGER, @ACCCODE INTEGER, @QTY INT, @VAL NUMERIC(15, 5)

SELECT @totcols = ISNULL((SELECT Count(A.AccCode) 
						FROM Accounts A, Customer C, @Tab_AreaList AR
						WHERE A.SubCode=3 AND A.AccCode = C.CustCode AND A.Active='Y' AND
							C.CustCatCode = @CustCatCode AND AR.CODE = C.AreaCode), 0)

IF @totcols > 0 and @TotCol > 0
BEGIN

	SELECT @tot = (SELECT MIN(A) FROM (SELECT A=@TotCol UNION SELECT A=@TotCols) T)

	INSERT @coltable
	SELECT A.AccCode, Name=A.Name
	FROM Accounts A, Customer C, @Tab_AreaList AR
	WHERE A.SubCode=3 AND A.AccCode = C.CustCode AND A.Active='Y' AND
		C.CustCatCode = @CustCatCode AND AR.CODE = C.AreaCode
	ORDER BY A.Name

	SET @iterations = CEILING(@totcols/@TotCol)
	SET @curriter = 1
	SET @RowID = 0

	INSERT INTO CrossTab_ReportData (Code1, Code2)
	SELECT Code, 0 FROM @Tab_ItemList

	WHILE @curriter <= @iterations
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO CrossTab_ReportData (Code1, Code2)
		SELECT Code, @curriter FROM @Tab_ItemList

		SET @i = 1
		WHILE @i <= @tot
		BEGIN
			SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
			SELECT @colname = RTRIM(LTRIM(ISNULL((SELECT NAME FROM @coltable WHERE ROWID = @RowID), '')))
			SELECT @colcode = RTRIM(LTRIM(STR((SELECT CODE FROM @coltable WHERE ROWID = @RowID), 10)))
			IF @colcode IS NULL
			BEGIN
				BREAK
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @str_col = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@i, 7)))
				SELECT @UPD = 	'UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData SET C_Name' + @str_col + ' = ''' + @colname + 
								''', C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colcode +
								' WHERE CODE2 = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@curriter, 7)))
				EXECUTE (@UPD)
				SET @err = @@ERROR
				IF @err <> 0
				BEGIN
					SET @UPD = 'CROSSTAB GENERATE ERROR, DETAILS: ' + @UPD
					RAISERROR(@UPD, 16, 1, @UPD)
					RETURN -1
				END 
				SET @i = @i + 1
			END
		END
		SET @curriter = @curriter + 1
	END

	UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData 
	SET Value2 = K.OQTY,  Value3 = K.OVAL, Value4 = K.PQTY, Value5 = K.PVAL,
		Value6 = K.PRQTY, Value7 = K.PRVAL, Value8= K.SQTY, Value9 = K.SVAL, 
		Value10= K.SRQTY, Value11 = K.SRVAL, Value12= K.OTQTY, Value13 = K.OTVAL
	FROM CrossTab_ReportData C,
		(SELECT
			ICODE=I.ICODE,   
			OQty = ISNULL(O.QTY, 0),
			OVal = ISNULL(O.VAL, 0),
			PQTY = ISNULL(P.QTY, 0),
			PVAL = ISNULL(P.VAL, 0),
			PRQTY = ISNULL(PR.QTY, 0),
			PRVAL = ISNULL(PR.VAL, 0),
			SQTY = ISNULL(S.QTY, 0),
			SVAL = ISNULL(S.VAL, 0),
			SRQTY = ISNULL(SR.QTY, 0),
			SRVAL = ISNULL(SR.VAL, 0),
			OTQTY = ISNULL(OT.QTY, 0),
			OTVAL = ISNULL(OT.VAL, 0)	
		FROM
			(SELECT * FROM ITEM WHERE ITEM.ICODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)) I
			LEFT OUTER JOIN 
			(SELECT
				ICODE=CODE,
				QTY=ISNULL(Qty, 0),
				VAL=ISNULL(Value, 0)
			FROM udf_openingstock (@ar_startdate, @ReportGrouping, @GroupList, 1)) AS O ON (I.ICode = O.ICode)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN
			(SELECT
				PD.ICODE,
				QTY=ISNULL(Sum( (PD.looseqty + PD.Packqty + PD.bonusqty) * CASE PL.PurCatCode WHEN 1 THEN PD.Packunits WHEN 2 THEN PD.Packunits ELSE 1 END), 0),
				VAL=Round(ISNULL(SUM((PD.looseqty + PD.PackQty) * PD.PurPrice *
						(1 - (.01 * PD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * PL.discperc))), 0), 2)
			FROM
				PURLEDGER PL, PURDETAIL PD,	(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
			WHERE
				PL.POSTED='Y' AND PL.PURINVCODE = PD.PURINVCODE AND
				PD.ICode = I.ICode AND
				PL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND PL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
			GROUP BY PD.ICODE) AS P ON (I.ICode = P.ICode)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN 
			(SELECT 
				PD.ICODE,
				QTY=ISNULL(Sum(PD.looseqty + PD.bonusqty), 0),
				VAL=Round(ISNULL(SUM(PD.looseqty * PD.PRPrice *
						(1 - (.01 * PD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * PL.discperc))), 0), 2)
			FROM PRLEDGER PL, PRDETAIL PD, (SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
			WHERE
				PL.POSTED='Y' AND PL.PRINVCODE = PD.PRINVCODE AND
				PD.ICode = I.ICode AND
				PL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND PL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
			GROUP BY PD.ICODE) AS PR ON (I.ICode = PR.ICode)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN
			(SELECT 
				T.ICode, Qty=SUM(T.Qty), Val=SUM(T.Val)
			FROM
				(SELECT
					SD.ICODE,
					QTY=-ISNULL(Sum(SD.qty), 0),
					VAL=-Round(ISNULL(SUM(SD.qty * (SD.SalePrice / CASE SD.Packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE SD.Packunits END)), 0), 2)
				FROM
					IssueHeader SL,
					IssueDETAIL SD,
					(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
				WHERE
					SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.ISSUEINVCODE = SD.ISSUEINVCODE AND
					SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
					SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
				GROUP BY
					SD.ICODE
				UNION ALL
				SELECT 
					SD.ICODE,
					QTY=ISNULL(Sum(SD.qty), 0),
					VAL=Round(ISNULL(SUM(SD.qty * (SD.SalePrice / CASE SD.Packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE SD.Packunits END)), 0), 2)
				FROM
					RECEIPTHeader SL,
					RECEIPTDETAIL SD,
					(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
				WHERE
					SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.RECEIPTINVCODE = SD.RECEIPTINVCODE AND
					SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
					SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
				GROUP BY
					SD.ICODE
				UNION ALL
				SELECT
					SD.ICODE,
					QTY=ISNULL(Sum(SD.Looseqty * CASE SL.AdjCatCode WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END), 0),
					VAL=Round(ISNULL(SUM(SD.Looseqty * (SD.SalePrice / CASE SD.Packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE SD.Packunits END) * CASE SL.AdjCatCode WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END), 0), 2)
				FROM
					AdjHeader SL,
					AdjDETAIL SD,
					(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
				WHERE
					SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.ADJCODE = SD.ADJCODE AND
					SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
					SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
				GROUP BY SD.ICODE) T
			GROUP BY T.ICODE) AS OT ON (I.ICode = OT.ICode)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN 
			(SELECT
				ICODE=SD.ICODE,
				QTY = ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
				VAL=  Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
							(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc))), 0), 2)
			FROM
				SALELEDGER SL,
				SALEDETAIL SD,
				(SELECT C.CustCode
				FROM CUSTOMER C 
				WHERE C.AreaCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_AreaList) AND
					C.CustCatCode = @CustCatCode) C,
				(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
			WHERE
				C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
				SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND
				SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
				SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
			GROUP BY
				SD.ICODE) AS S ON (I.ICode = S.ICode)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN 
			(SELECT
				ICODE=SD.ICODE,
				QTY = ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
				VAL=  Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty * SD.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc))), 0), 2)
			FROM
				SRLEDGER SL,
				SRDETAIL SD,
				(SELECT C.CustCode
				FROM CUSTOMER C 
				WHERE C.AreaCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_AreaList) AND
					C.CustCatCode = @CustCatCode) C,
				(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
			WHERE
				C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
				SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SRINVCODE = SD.SRINVCODE AND
				SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
				SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
			GROUP BY SD.ICODE) AS SR ON (I.ICode = SR.ICode)) K
	WHERE C.CODE1 = K.ICODE

	DECLARE C1 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT
		ICODE=SD.ICODE,
		ACCCODE=C.CUSTCODE,
		QTY = ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
		VAL=  Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc))), 0), 2)
	FROM
		SALELEDGER SL,
		SALEDETAIL SD,
		(SELECT C.CustCode
		FROM CUSTOMER C 
		WHERE C.AreaCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_AreaList) AND
			C.CustCatCode = @CustCatCode) C,
		(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	WHERE
		C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND
		SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
	GROUP BY
		C.CUSTCODE,
		SD.ICODE

	OPEN C1
	FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @ICODE, @AccCode, @QTY, @VAL
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SET @i = 1
		WHILE @i <= @tot
		BEGIN
			SELECT @colcode = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@ICODE, 7)))
			SELECT @colname = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@AccCODE, 7)))
			SET @str_col = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@i, 7)))

			SELECT @UPD = 	'UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData SET ' + 
							'QTY' + @str_col + ' = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@QTY, 10))) + 
							', VAL' + @str_col + ' = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@VAL, 15, 5))) + 
							', C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colname +
							' WHERE CODE2 > 0 AND CODE1 = ' + @colcode + ' AND ' + 
							' C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colname
			EXECUTE (@UPD)
			SET @err = @@ERROR
			IF @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @UPD = 'CROSSTAB PLOTING ERROR, DETAILS: ' + @UPD
				RAISERROR(@UPD, 16, 1, @UPD)
				CLOSE C1
				DEALLOCATE C1
				RETURN -1
			END 
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @ICODE, @AccCode, @QTY, @VAL
	END
	CLOSE C1
	DEALLOCATE C1

	UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData 
	SET NAME1 = I.NAME,
		NAME2 = I.CustomICode,
		Name3 = I.PackingDesc,
		Name4 = (SELECT NAME FROM CustomerCategory WHERE CUSTCATCODE = @CUSTCATCODE),   
		Code5=CASE @ReportGrouping 
			WHEN 'M' THEN I.MANFCODE
			WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
			WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
			ELSE I.PACKCODE END,
		Name5 = CASE @ReportGrouping 
			WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
			WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
			WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
			ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,
		Value1= ROUND(I.SALEPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
	FROM ITEM I, CrossTab_ReportData C
	WHERE I.ICODE = C.CODE1

	EXECUTE SP_UPDATE_TOTAL_CrossTab_ReportData
END
RETURN 0

-- SP_CustGroup_ItemGroup_NetSale_CrossTab
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CustGroup_ItemGroup_NetSale_CrossTab
@CustGroupCode INT, @ItemGroupCode INT, @startdate datetime, @enddate datetime AS

/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'crosstab_reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of a
	customer of a cusomer group and items of an item group 

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@CustGroupCode = Customer Group for which report is required
	@ItemGroupCode = Item Group for which report is required
	@startdate, @ar_enddate = Determine the period of report
*/

DELETE CrossTab_ReportData

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @coltable TABLE (code int, shortname varchar(100), rowid INT identity(1,1))
DECLARE @UPD VARCHAR(4000), @Col VARCHAR(10), @RowID INT, @colname VARCHAR(100), @colcode VARCHAR(100), @str_col VARCHAR(10)
DECLARE @totitems FLOAT, @curriter int, @iterations int, @i int, @tot int
DECLARE @ICODE INTEGER, @CustCODE INTEGER, @QTY INT, @VAL NUMERIC(15, 5), @err INT, @TotCol SMALLINT

SELECT @totitems = ISNULL((SELECT Count(ICode) FROM ItemGroupDetail WHERE ItemGroupCode = @CustGroupCode), 0)
SET @TotCol = 12
IF @totitems > 0
BEGIN
	SELECT @tot = (SELECT MIN(A) FROM (SELECT A=@TotCol UNION SELECT A=@totitems) T)

	INSERT @coltable (Code, ShortName)
	SELECT ICode , Name=ShortName
	FROM Item
	WHERE ICode IN (SELECT ICODE FROM ItemGroupDetail WHERE ItemGroupCode = @ItemGroupCode)
	ORDER BY ShortName

	SET @iterations = Ceiling(@totitems/@TotCol)
	SET @curriter = 1
	SET @RowID = 0
	WHILE @curriter <= @iterations
	BEGIN
		
		INSERT INTO CrossTab_ReportData (Code1, Code2, Code3, Code5)
		SELECT CustCODE, @curriter, @CustGroupCode, @ItemGroupCode FROM CustomerGroupDetail WHERE CustomerGroupCode = @CustGroupCode

		SET @i = 1
		WHILE @i <= @tot
		BEGIN
			SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
			SELECT @colname = RTRIM(LTRIM(ISNULL((SELECT shortname FROM @coltable WHERE ROWID = @RowID), '')))
			SELECT @colcode = RTRIM(LTRIM(STR((SELECT CODE FROM @coltable WHERE ROWID = @RowID), 7)))
			IF @colcode IS NULL
			BEGIN
				BREAK
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @str_col = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@i, 7)))
				SELECT @UPD = 	'UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData SET C_Name' + @str_col + 
								' = ''' + @colname + ''', C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colcode +
								' WHERE CODE2 = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@curriter, 7)))
				EXECUTE (@UPD)
				SET @err = @@ERROR
				IF @err <> 0
				BEGIN
					SET @UPD = 'UPDATION ERROR, DETAILS: ' + @UPD
					RAISERROR(@UPD, 16, 1, @UPD)
					RETURN -1
				END 
				SET @i = @i + 1
			END
		END
		SET @curriter = @curriter + 1
	END

	DECLARE C1 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT S.ICODE, S.CustCode, QTY = ISNULL(Sum(S.QTY), 0), VAL= ISNULL(SUM(S.NETAMT), 0)
	FROM
		(SELECT INVNO=SL.SALEINVCODE,
			SD.ICODE,
			CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
			QTY = ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
			NETAMT=Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)), 0), 2)
		FROM
			SALELEDGER SL,
			SALEDETAIL SD,
			CUSTOMER C
		WHERE
			C.CustCode IN (SELECT CustCODE FROM CustomerGroupDetail WHERE CustomerGroupCode = @CustGroupCode) AND
			C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND SL.POSTED='Y' AND 
			SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND
			SL.DATE BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND
			SD.ICOde IN (SELECT ICODE FROM ItemGroupDetail WHERE ItemGroupCode = @ItemGroupCode)
		GROUP BY
			SL.SaleInvCode,
			SD.ICODE,
			SL.CustCode,
			SL.DiscPerc
		UNION ALL
		SELECT INVNO=SL.SRINVCODE,
			SD.ICODE,
			CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
			QTY = - ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
			NETAMT= - Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty * SD.SRPrice) *
					(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)), 0), 2)
		FROM
			SRLEDGER SL,
			SRDETAIL SD,
			CUSTOMER C
		WHERE
			C.CustCode IN (SELECT CustCODE FROM CustomerGroupDetail WHERE CustomerGroupCode = @CustGroupCode) AND
			C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND SL.POSTED='Y' AND 
			SL.SRINVCODE = SD.SRINVCODE AND
			SL.DATE BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND
			SD.ICOde IN (SELECT ICODE FROM ItemGroupDetail WHERE ItemGroupCode = @ItemGroupCode)
		GROUP BY
			SL.SRInvCode,
			SD.ICODE,
			SL.CustCode,
			SL.DiscPerc) S, Accounts A
	WHERE S.CustCODE = A.AccCODE
	GROUP BY 
		S.CustCode,
		S.ICODE
	ORDER BY S.CustCODE, S.ICODE

	OPEN C1
	FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @ICODE, @CustCODE, @QTY, @VAL
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SET @i = 1
		WHILE @i <= @tot
		BEGIN
			SELECT @colcode = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@CustCODE, 7)))
			SELECT @colname = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@ICODE, 7)))
			SET @str_col = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@i, 7)))

			SELECT @UPD = 	'UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData SET ' + 
							'QTY' + @str_col + ' = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@QTY, 7))) + 
							', VAL' + @str_col + ' = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@VAL, 15, 5))) + 
							', C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colname +
							' WHERE CODE1 = ' + @colcode + ' AND ' + 
							' C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colname
			EXECUTE (@UPD)
			SET @err = @@ERROR
			IF @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @UPD = 'CROSSTAB PLOTING ERROR, DETAILS: ' + @UPD
				RAISERROR(@UPD, 16, 1, @UPD)
				CLOSE C1
				DEALLOCATE C1
				RETURN -1
			END 
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @ICODE, @CustCODE, @QTY, @VAL
	END
	CLOSE C1
	DEALLOCATE C1

	UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData 
	SET NAME1 = A.NAME,
		NAME2 = A.AliasName,
		Name3 = NULL,
		Name4 = (SELECT NAME FROM CustomerGroup WHERE CustomerGroupCODE = @CustGroupCODE),
		Name5 = (SELECT NAME FROM ItemGroup WHERE ItemGroupCODE = @ItemGroupCODE)
	FROM Accounts A, CrossTab_ReportData C
	WHERE A.AccCODE = C.CODE1

	EXECUTE SP_UPDATE_TOTAL_CrossTab_ReportData
END
RETURN 0

-- sp_Customer_Sale_Accounts

/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_Customer_Sale_Accounts    Script Date: 4/23/02 4:29:59 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_Customer_Sale_Accounts    Script Date: 4/8/02 6:26:06 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_Customer_Sale_Accounts    Script Date: 3/6/02 3:39:36 PM ******/
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_Customer_Sale_Accounts @ad_date datetime ,@ad_ldate datetime AS



/*----------------------for opening balance-----------------------*/

create table #lt_pvamts 
(
	debit  numeric (15, 2) NOT NULL,
	credit numeric (15, 2) NOT NULL,
	code   numeric (5,0) NOT NULL,
	name varchar(50) NOT NULL
)

/***************************** Credit Sales Transactions **********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select
	 Debit = Isnull(Round(SUM(saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
	 SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
	    (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
	 Round( (sum( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
	    (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) - saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
	 Round( sum( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
	    (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
	 credit = 0.0,
	 custcode=saleledger.custcode	,
	 name=(select accounts.name from accounts where acccode=saleledger.custcode)
     
from     saleledger, saledetail  
where    saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and
	 saleledger.salecatcode = 2   and 
 	 saleledger.date < @ad_date  and
	 saleledger.posted = 'Y' 

group by saleledger.saleinvcode,
	 salecatcode, 
         saleledger.custcode,
	 saleledger.date,
	 saleledger.discperc,
	 saleledger.misccharges,
	 saleledger.salestax,
	 saleledger.invgstperc1,
	 saleledger.flatdisc

/************************** Credit Sales Returns Transactions ******************************/

insert   #lt_pvamts
select   Debit = 0.0,
	 Credit = Isnull(Round(SUM(srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
			    (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc)) * srdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			Round( (sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
			    (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) - 
			    srledger.flatdisc) * (srledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
			Round( sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
			    (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) + 
			    srledger.misccharges + srledger.salestax - srledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
         custcode=srledger.custcode,
	 name=(select accounts.name from accounts where acccode=srledger.custcode)
from     srledger, srdetail
where    srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode and
	 srledger.srcatcode = 7     and 
 	 srledger.date < @ad_date  and
	 srledger.posted = 'Y' 	 
group by srledger.srinvcode,
	 srledger.srcatcode,
         srledger.custcode,
	 srledger.date,
	 srledger.discperc,
	 srledger.misccharges,
	 srledger.salestax,
	 srledger.invgstperc1,
	 srledger.flatdisc

/***************************** Debit Services Transactions ********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts

select  debit = IsNull( sum(IsNull(servicedetail.price, 0) * 
	(1 - (.01 * servicedetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * serviceheader.discperc)) +
	serviceheader.misccharges - serviceheader.flatdisc,0),
	credit= 0.0,
        custcode=serviceheader.custcode	,
	name=(select accounts.name from accounts where acccode=serviceheader.custcode)
from     serviceheader, servicedetail
where    serviceheader.serviceinvcode = servicedetail.serviceinvcode and
	 serviceheader.servicecatcode = 11     and 
 	 serviceheader.date < @ad_date  and
	 serviceheader.posted = 'Y' 
	

group by serviceheader.serviceinvcode,
	 serviceheader.servicecatcode,
         serviceheader.custcode,
	 serviceheader.date,
	 serviceheader.discperc,
	 serviceheader.misccharges,
	 serviceheader.flatdisc

/************************* Credit Services Returns Transactions ***************************/

insert #lt_pvamts

select  debit = 0.0,
	credit= IsNull( sum(IsNull(serviceRdetail.ServicePrice, 0) * 
		(1 - (.01 * serviceRdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * serviceRheader.discperc)) +
	serviceRheader.misccharges - serviceRheader.flatdisc,0),
        custcode=serviceRheader.custcode,
	name=(select accounts.name from accounts where acccode=serviceRheader.custcode)

from     serviceRheader, serviceRdetail

where    serviceRheader.serviceRinvcode = serviceRdetail.serviceRinvcode and
	 serviceRheader.serviceRcatcode = 14 and 
 	 serviceRheader.date < @ad_date  and
	 serviceRheader.posted = 'Y' 

group by serviceRheader.serviceRinvcode,
	 serviceRheader.serviceRcatcode,
         serviceRheader.custcode,
	 serviceRheader.date,
	 serviceRheader.discperc,
	 serviceRheader.misccharges,
	 serviceRheader.flatdisc
/**************************** Any Acccounting Transactions ********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select  IsNull( sum(gldetail.debit), 0),
        IsNull( sum(gldetail.credit), 0),
        custcode=gldetail.acccode	,
	name=(select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode=gldetail.acccode)
	 
from     glheader, gldetail  
where    glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode and 
 	 glheader.date < @ad_date  and
	 glheader.posted = 'Y' and
         gldetail.acccode IN (select custcode from customer) 
GROUP BY gldetail.acccode	 

/******************************* Any Bills Receivables ***********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select  0,
        IsNull( sum(notes.amount), 0),
        custcode=notes.acccode,
        name=(select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode=notes.acccode)
    
	 
from     notes
where    notes.notecatcode = 1 and
	 notes.posted = 'Y' and
	 notes.postdate < @ad_date  and
	 notes.acccode IN (select custcode from customer) 
GROUP BY notes.acccode



/******** Collecting the result and assigning to the relevent reference variable *********/
delete from reportdata
insert into reportdata(code1,name1,value1,value2,value3,value4,value5,value6,value7,value8)
select code,name,IsNull(sum(debit) - sum(credit),0),0,0,0,0,0,0,0
	from   #lt_pvamts 
	group by name,
                 code 

insert into reportdata(code1,value1,value2,value3,value4,value5,value6,value7,value8)
select customer.custcode,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0

from  customer

where 
	 customer.custcode Not IN (select code1 from reportdata) 


update 	reportdata
set 	name1=accounts.name
from 	accounts,reportdata
where	reportdata.name1=Null and
	reportdata.code1=accounts.acccode
/*----------inserting AreaCode--------------*/
update reportdata
set code2=customer.areacode
from customer
where reportdata.code1=customer.custcode
/*--------------end AreaCode--------------*/

/*---------------end---------------------------------------------*/





/*
insert into reportdata(code1,name1)
select custcode,accounts.name
from accounts,customer
where accounts.acccode=customer.custcode*/



/*--------------------for CreditSale-----------------------*/

update reportdata
set value7=SaleH.amount

from reportdata,(select amount=sum(sale.amount),customercode=sale.custcode
		
		from  
		(select custcode=customer.custcode , 
			amount= Isnull(
				Round(SUM(saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * 
					(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * 
					saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				Round( (sum( (saledetail.looseqty * 
					(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * 
					(1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc))-saleledger.flatdisc)*
					(saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
				Round( sum( (saledetail.looseqty * 
					(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * 
					(1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + 
					saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)
		from	saleledger, saledetail ,customer
		where	saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and
			saleledger.salecatcode = 2   and
			saleledger.Posted = 'Y'   and	
			saleledger.date >= @ad_date  and
			saleledger.date <= @ad_ldate  and
			saleledger.custcode =customer.custcode
		group by
			saleledger.saleinvcode,
			salecatcode, 
			saleledger.date,
			saleledger.discperc,
			saleledger.misccharges,
			saleledger.salestax,
			saleledger.flatdisc,
			saleledger.invgstperc1,
			customer.custcode) as Sale 

	 	group by sale.custcode	

		) saleH

where reportdata.code1=SaleH.customercode


/*-----------------------------end sale-------------------*/


/*-------------------for Credit Sale Return--------------------*/

update reportdata
set value2=SaleReturnH.amount

from reportdata,(select amount=sum(salereturn.amount),customercode=SaleReturn.custcode
		 
		 from (
			select  custcode=customer.custcode,
	
				Amount= Isnull(
					Round(SUM(srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.unitsalestax) + 
					SUM(ROUND( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
					    (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc)) * 
					    srdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
					Round( (sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
					    (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * 
					    (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) - 
					    srledger.flatdisc) * 
					    (srledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
					Round( sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
					    (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * 
					    (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) + 
					    srledger.misccharges + srledger.salestax - srledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)
			from     srledger, srdetail, customer  
			where    srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode and
	        		 srledger.srcatcode = 7     and 
	 			 srledger.posted  = 'Y' and 	
				 srledger.date >= @ad_date  and
		        	 srledger.date <= @ad_ldate  and
 	 			 srledger.custcode = customer.custcode

			group by srledger.srinvcode,
				 srledger.srcatcode,
	 			 srledger.date,
	 			 srledger.discperc,
	 			 srledger.misccharges,
				 srledger.salestax,
				 srledger.invgstperc1,
	 			 srledger.flatdisc,
		 		 customer.custcode
	 		) as SaleReturn

	   	 group by salereturn.custcode	

		) as SaleReturnH

where reportdata.code1=SaleReturnH.customercode


/*----------------------end------------------------*/

/*-----------------------total recieved----------------------*/

update reportdata
set value3=Recieved.amount

from reportdata,(select   customercode=customer.custcode,
			
			amount=case sum(Round(gldetail.credit, 0))
				when NULL then 0.0
	 			else sum(Round(gldetail.credit, 0))
	 			end
		from     glheader, gldetail , customer
		Where	glheader.posted = 'Y' and
			glheader.vochcatcode in (2,4) and
			glheader.date >= @ad_date  and
	 		glheader.date <= @ad_ldate  and
			glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode and	
			gldetail.acccode = customer.custcode  
		group by customer.custcode

	 		) as Recieved

where reportdata.code1=Recieved.customercode








/*--------------------------end recieved-------------------*/


/*--------------------------total adjustment----------*/


update reportdata
set value4=Adjustment.amount

from reportdata,(select   customercode=customer.custcode,
			
			amount= ISNULL( sum(Round(gldetail.debit, 0)),0) 
				
		from     glheader, gldetail , customer
		Where	glheader.posted = 'Y' and
			glheader.vochcatcode in (5,8,10,1,3) and
			glheader.date >= @ad_date  and
			glheader.date <= @ad_ldate  and
			glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode and	
			gldetail.acccode = customer.custcode  
		group by customer.custcode

	 		) as Adjustment

where reportdata.code1=Adjustment.customercode




update reportdata
set value8=Adjustment.amount

from reportdata,(select   customercode=customer.custcode,
			
			amount=  ISNULL( sum(Round(gldetail.credit, 0)),0)
				
		from     glheader, gldetail , customer
		Where	glheader.posted = 'Y' and
			glheader.vochcatcode in (5,8,10) and
			glheader.date >= @ad_date  and
			glheader.date <= @ad_ldate  and
			glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode and	
			gldetail.acccode = customer.custcode  
		group by customer.custcode

	 		) as Adjustment

where reportdata.code1=Adjustment.customercode

/*----------------end adjustment-----------------------*/




/*----------------------total CreditService---------*/
update reportdata
set value5=ServiceH.amount

from reportdata,(Select amount=sum(service.amount),customercode=service.custcode
		
		 from     (
				select  custcode=serviceheader.custcode,
			 		amount = IsNull( sum(IsNull(servicedetail.price, 0) * 	(1 - (.01 * servicedetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * serviceheader.discperc)) +	serviceheader.misccharges - serviceheader.flatdisc,0)
	
				from     serviceheader, servicedetail, customer
				where    serviceheader.serviceinvcode = servicedetail.serviceinvcode and
	 				serviceheader.servicecatcode = 11     and 
	 				serviceheader.posted = 'Y' and
					serviceheader.date >= @ad_date  and
					serviceheader.date <= @ad_ldate  and
	 				serviceheader.custcode = customer.custcode

				group by serviceheader.serviceinvcode,
					 serviceheader.servicecatcode,
	 				serviceheader.date,
	 				serviceheader.discperc,
	 				serviceheader.misccharges,
	 				serviceheader.flatdisc,
	 				serviceheader.custcode
			 )as Service
		group by service.custcode 
		
		) as ServiceH

where reportdata.code1=ServiceH.customercode
/*-----------------end service-------------------*/


/*----------------------total CreditServiceReturn---------*/
update reportdata
set value6=ServiceReturnH.amount

from reportdata,(select amount=sum(servicereturn.amount),customercode=servicereturn.custcode
		
		from    (select  custcode=serviceRheader.custcode,

-- SP_CustomerNetSaleMonthSummary
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_CustomerNetSaleMonthSummary 
	@ar_startdate datetime, 
	@ar_enddate datetime 
AS
/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'reportdata' table to be used for netsale of customers in
	cross tabulation of months
PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@ar_startdate, @ar_enddate = Determine the period of report
*/

DELETE ReportData

INSERT INTO ReportData (Name1, Name2, Name3, Name4, Date1, Value1, Value2)
SELECT 
	CC.Name,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	SaleType = ISNULL((SELECT ST.Name FROM SaleType ST, SaleLedger SL WHERE SL.SaleInvCode=S.DocumentCode AND SL.SaleTypeCode=ST.SaleTypeCode), '.'),	
	Date = CAST(S.Date AS DateTime),
	NetSale = SUM(S.NetSale),
	Discount = 	
		(SELECT Discount=SUM(VG.Credit) FROM VirtualGL VG 
		WHERE VG.AccCode = A.AccCode AND
		VG.Date BETWEEN @ar_startdate AND @ar_enddate AND 
		VG.DocumentType IN ('JV') AND VG.Credit > 0)
FROM
	CustomerCategory CC,
	Customer C, 
	Accounts A,
	(SELECT 
		Date = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(VG.Date)))) + '/01/' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(VG.Date)))),
		VG.AccCode, 
		VG.DocumentCode,
		NetSale = SUM(CASE VG.DocumentType WHEN 'SV' THEN VG.Debit WHEN 'SR' THEN  - (VG.Credit) ELSE 0 END)
	FROM VirtualGL VG 
	WHERE 
		VG.AccCode IN (SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SubCode = 3 ) AND
		VG.Date BETWEEN @ar_startdate AND @ar_enddate AND 
		VG.DocumentType IN ('SV', 'SR') AND VG.CatCode IN (2,7)
	GROUP BY
		VG.DocumentCode, 
		VG.Date,
		VG.AccCode) S
WHERE 
	CC.CustCatCode = C.CustCatCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	A.AccCode = S.AccCode
GROUP BY
	CC.Name,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	A.AccCode,
	S.DocumentCode,
	CAST(S.Date AS DateTime)
ORDER BY
	CC.Name,
	A.Name,
	A.AliasName,
	Date

CREATE PROCEDURE sp_CustomersBalance AS


create table #lt_pvamts 
(
	custcode numeric (5, 0) NOT NULL,
	debit  numeric (15, 2) NOT NULL,
	credit numeric (15, 2) NOT NULL
)

DELETE  ReportData	

/******************************* Any Credit Sales **********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select   customer.custcode,
	 Debit = Isnull(Round(SUM(saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
	 SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
	    (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
	 Round( (sum( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
	    (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) - saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
	 Round( sum( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
	    (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
	 Credit = 0
from     saleledger, saledetail, customer  
where    saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and
	 saleledger.salecatcode = 2   and 
	 saleledger.Posted = 'Y'   and	
	 saleledger.custcode = customer.custcode
group by saleledger.saleinvcode,
	 salecatcode, 
	 saleledger.date,
	 saleledger.discperc,
	 saleledger.misccharges,
	 saleledger.salestax,
	 saleledger.flatdisc,
	 saleledger.invgstperc1,
	 customer.custcode

/******************************* Credit Sales Returns **********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select   customer.custcode,
	 Debit = 0,
	 Credit = Isnull(Round(SUM(srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.unitsalestax) + 
	 SUM(ROUND( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
	    (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc)) * srdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
	 Round( (sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
	    (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) - srledger.flatdisc) * (srledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
	 Round( sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
	    (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) + srledger.misccharges + srledger.salestax - srledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)
from     srledger, srdetail, customer  
where    srledger.Srinvcode = srdetail.Srinvcode and
	 srledger.srcatcode = 7   and 
	 srledger.Posted = 'Y'   and	
	 srledger.custcode = customer.custcode
group by srledger.srinvcode,
	 srcatcode, 
	 srledger.date,
	 srledger.discperc,
	 srledger.misccharges,
	 srledger.salestax,
	 srledger.flatdisc,
	 srledger.invgstperc1,
	 customer.custcode

/******************************* Any Credit Services **********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts

select  serviceheader.custcode,
	debit = IsNull( sum(IsNull(servicedetail.price, 0) * 
	(1 - (.01 * servicedetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * serviceheader.discperc)) +
	serviceheader.misccharges - serviceheader.flatdisc,0),
	credit= 0.0
from     serviceheader, servicedetail, customer
where    serviceheader.serviceinvcode = servicedetail.serviceinvcode and
	 serviceheader.servicecatcode = 11     and 
	 serviceheader.posted = 'Y' and
	 serviceheader.custcode = customer.custcode

group by serviceheader.serviceinvcode,
	 serviceheader.servicecatcode,
	 serviceheader.date,
	 serviceheader.discperc,
	 serviceheader.misccharges,
	 serviceheader.flatdisc,
	 serviceheader.custcode

/******************************* Any Credit Services Returns ********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts

select  serviceRheader.custcode,
	debit = 0.0,
	credit= IsNull( sum(IsNull(serviceRdetail.Serviceprice, 0) * 
	(1 - (.01 * serviceRdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * serviceRheader.discperc)) +
	serviceRheader.misccharges - serviceRheader.flatdisc,0)
from     serviceRheader, serviceRdetail, customer
where    serviceRheader.serviceRinvcode = serviceRdetail.serviceRinvcode and
	 serviceRheader.serviceRcatcode = 14 and 
	 serviceRheader.posted = 'Y' and
	 serviceRheader.custcode = customer.custcode

group by serviceRheader.serviceRinvcode,
	 serviceRheader.serviceRcatcode,
	 serviceRheader.date,
	 serviceRheader.discperc,
	 serviceRheader.misccharges,
	 serviceRheader.flatdisc,
	 serviceRheader.custcode


/********************************* Any A/c Vouchers *************************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select   customer.custcode,
	 case sum(Round(gldetail.debit, 0))
	 when NULL then 0.0
	 else sum(Round(gldetail.debit, 0))
	 end, 
	 case sum(Round(gldetail.credit, 0))
	 when NULL then 0.0
	 else sum(Round(gldetail.credit, 0))
	 end
from     glheader, gldetail , customer
Where	glheader.posted = 'Y' and
	gldetail.acccode = customer.custcode and 
	glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode 	
group by customer.custcode

/******************************* Any Bills Receivables **********************************/


insert #lt_pvamts
select  customer.custcode,
	0, 
	IsNull( sum(notes.amount), 0)
from    notes , customer
Where	notes.posted = 'Y' and
	notes.notecatcode = 1 and
	notes.acccode = customer.custcode

group by customer.custcode

/*********************************** Final Report *************************************/

INSERT ReportData(code1, name1, value1)

select   accounts.acccode,
	 accounts.name,
         sum(#lt_pvamts.debit) - sum(#lt_pvamts.credit) 
	
from     #lt_pvamts, accounts

where    #lt_pvamts.custcode = accounts.acccode

Group by accounts.acccode,
	 accounts.name

order by accounts.name


/***************************** Final House Keeping *********************************/

drop table #lt_pvamts

select * from reportdata

        IsNull( sum(notes.amount), 0),
        custcode=notes.acccode,
        name=(select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode=notes.acccode)
    
	 
from     notes
where    notes.notecatcode = 1 and
	 notes.posted = 'Y' and
	 notes.postdate >= @ad_date  and
         notes.postdate <= @ad_ldate  and
	 notes.acccode IN (select custcode from customer) 
GROUP BY notes.acccode



/******** Collecting the result and assigning to the relevent reference variable *********/


update reportdata

set value2=A.ddebit,value3=A.dcredit

from

(select code,name,ddebit=IsNull(sum(debit) ,0),dcredit=IsNull(sum(credit),0)
	from   #lt_pvamts 
	group by name,
                 code) as A

where reportdata.code1=A.code
 
drop table #lt_pvamts

-- SP_DailyIncomeStatement_With_GP_Summary
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_DailyIncomeStatement_With_GP_Summary 
	@StartDate DATETIME, 
	@EndDate DATETIME,
	@ReportType CHAR(1),
	@Accounts VARCHAR(8000)
AS

TRUNCATE TABLE REPORTDATA 

/*
Author: M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose: Purpose of this Code is to compute the profit/loss of a period and describes
it in the form of sales/service category
Parameter Description:
	@StartDate Start DateTime
	@EndDate Ending DateTime
	@ReportType = 'M' Medical Store and 
	@ReportType = 'H' Hospital
	@ReportType = 'B' Both
	@Accounts  (Comma Separated List of Account Codes)
*/

CREATE TABLE #lt_CatAccounts (Code INT)

INSERT INTO #lt_CatAccounts
SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@Accounts, ',')

IF @ReportType='S' OR @ReportType='A'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (Date1, Name1, Name2, Name3, Name4, Value1, Code1, Code2, Code3, Code4)
	SELECT	
		Date=CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), R.Date, 101)),
		FunctionalArea='S',
		Category='MED. G/P',
		Details = '',
		Type=' Revenue', 
		Amt=ROUND(SUM(R.Sales + R.Ret + R.CGS), 0),
		AccCode=-2,
		CatAccCode=-2,
		OrderBy=-1,
		Code=NULL
	FROM
		(SELECT	
			Date=CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), S.Date, 101),
			Sales=ROUND(SUM(
				CASE S.TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN 
					S.itemvalue - (S.flatdisc * (S.itemvalue/
						CASE S.grossamt WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE S.grossamt END))
				ELSE 0 END), 0),
			Ret=0,
			CGS=-SUM(S.Cost)
		FROM	
			(SELECT
				SL.saleinvcode,
				SL.Date,
				SD.icode,
				Cost = SUM((SD.LooseQty+SD.BonusQty) * SD.AvgPrice),
				GrossValue = SUM(SD.looseqty * SD.saleprice ) ,
				ItemDiscValue = SUM((SD.looseqty * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc))*
									 (.01 * SD.discperc) + SD.itemflatdisc ),
				InvItemDiscValue = SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc))*
										(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc) ) *  (.01 * SL.discperc) ),
				ItemValue=SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc))*
					(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1 - (.01 * SL.discperc)),
				GrossAmt=
					(SELECT SUM((SDD.looseqty*(SDD.saleprice - SDD.itemflatdisc)) *
						(1 - (.01 * SDD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * SLL.discperc)))
					FROM	saledetail SDD, saleledger SLL
					WHERE SLL.saleinvcode=SL.saleinvcode and SLL.saleinvcode=SDD.saleinvcode
					GROUP BY SLL.saleinvcode),
				SL.flatdisc,
				catcode=SL.salecatcode,
				type='S'
			FROM
				saleledger SL,	 
				saledetail SD
			WHERE
				SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
				SL.Date >= @StartDate AND SL.Date <= @EndDate
			GROUP BY 
				 SL.saleinvcode,
				 SL.Date,
				 SL.salesmancode,
				 SD.icode,
				 SL.salecatcode,
				 SL.discperc,
				 SL.flatdisc,
				 SL.invgstperc1,
				 SL.salecatcode) S
		GROUP BY 
			CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), S.Date, 101)
		UNION ALL
		SELECT	
			Date=CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), S.Date, 101),
			Sales=0,
			Ret=-ROUND(SUM(
			CASE S.TYPE WHEN 'R' THEN
				S.itemvalue - (S.flatdisc*(S.itemvalue/
					CASE S.grossamt WHEN 0 THEN 1 
					ELSE S.grossamt END)) 
			ELSE 0 END), 0),
			CGS=SUM(S.Cost)
		FROM	
			(SELECT
				SL.srinvcode,
				SL.Date,
				SD.icode,
				Cost = SUM((SD.LooseQty+SD.BonusQty) * SD.AvgPrice),
				GrossValue = SUM( SD.looseqty * SD.srprice ) ,
				ItemDiscValue = SUM((SD.looseqty * SD.srprice ) * (.01 * SD.discperc) ),
				InvItemDiscValue = SUM( ( (SD.looseqty * SD.srprice) *
											(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc) ) ) * (.01 * SL.discperc) ),
				ItemValue=SUM((SD.looseqty * SD.srprice *
					(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1 - (.01 * SL.discperc))),
				GrossAmt=(SELECT SUM((SDD.looseqty * SDD.srprice *
						(1 - (.01 * SDD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SLL.discperc)))
					FROM	srdetail SDD, srledger SLL
					WHERE SLL.srinvcode=SL.srinvcode and SLL.srinvcode=SDD.srinvcode
					GROUP BY SLL.srinvcode),
				SL.flatdisc,
				catcode=SL.srcatcode,
				type='R'
			FROM
				srledger SL,	 
				srdetail SD
			WHERE
				SL.SRInvCode = SD.SRInvCode AND
				SL.Date >= @StartDate AND SL.Date <= @EndDate
			GROUP BY
				 SL.srinvcode,
				 SL.Date,
				 SL.salesmancode,
				 SD.icode,
				 SL.srcatcode,
				 SL.discperc,
				 SL.flatdisc,
				 SL.invgstperc1,
				 SL.srcatcode) S
		GROUP BY 
			CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), S.Date, 101)) R
	GROUP BY 
		R.Date
END

IF @ReportType='H' OR @ReportType='A'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (Date1, Name1, Name2, Name3, Name4, Value1, Code1, Code2, Code3, Code4)
	SELECT	
		Date=CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), R.Date, 101)),
		FunctionalArea='H',
		Category=(SELECT SC.Name FROM ServiceCategory SC WHERE SC.ServiceCatCode = R.ServiceCatCode),
		Details = '',
		Type=' Revenue', 
		Amt=ROUND(SUM(R.Sales + R.Ret), 0),
		AccCode=-1,
		CatAccCode=-1,
		OrderBy=0,
		Code=NULL
	FROM
		(SELECT	
			Date=CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), S.Date, 101),
			SV.ServiceCatCode,
			Sales=ROUND(SUM(
				CASE S.TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN 
					S.itemvalue - (S.flatdisc * (S.itemvalue/
						CASE S.grossamt WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE S.grossamt END))
				ELSE 0 END), 0),
			Ret=0
		FROM	
			(SELECT
				SL.Serviceinvcode,
				SL.Date,
				SD.servicecode,
				GrossValue = SUM(SD.qty * SD.price ) ,
				ItemDiscValue = SUM((SD.qty * SD.price)*
									 (.01 * SD.discperc)),
				InvItemDiscValue = SUM((SD.qty * SD.price) *
										(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc) ) *  (.01 * SL.discperc) ),
				ItemValue=SUM((SD.qty * SD.price)*
					(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1 - (.01 * SL.discperc)),
				GrossAmt=
					(SELECT SUM((SDD.qty * SDD.Price) *
						(1 - (.01 * SDD.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * SLL.discperc)))
					FROM	servicedetail SDD, serviceheader SLL
					WHERE SLL.serviceinvcode=SL.serviceinvcode and SLL.serviceinvcode=SDD.serviceinvcode
					GROUP BY SLL.serviceinvcode),
				SL.flatdisc,
				type='S'
			FROM
				serviceheader SL, servicedetail SD
			WHERE
				SL.serviceInvCode = SD.serviceInvCode AND
				SL.Date >= @StartDate AND SL.Date <= @EndDate
			GROUP BY 
				 SL.serviceinvcode,
				 SL.Date,
				 SL.salesmancode,
				 SD.servicecode,
				 SL.servicecatcode,
				 SL.discperc,
				 SL.flatdisc) S, Service SV
		WHERE 
			S.ServiceCode = SV.ServiceCode
		GROUP BY 
			CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), S.Date, 101), SV.ServiceCatCode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT	
			Date=CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), S.Date, 101),
			SV.ServiceCatCode,
			Sales=0,
			Ret=-ROUND(SUM(
			CASE S.TYPE WHEN 'R' THEN
				S.itemvalue - (S.flatdisc*(S.itemvalue/
					CASE S.grossamt WHEN 0 THEN 1 
					ELSE S.grossamt END)) 
			ELSE 0 END), 0)
		FROM	
			(SELECT
				SL.servicerinvcode,
				SL.Date,
				SD.servicecode,
				GrossValue = SUM( SD.qty * SD.serviceprice ) ,
				ItemDiscValue = SUM((SD.qty * SD.serviceprice ) * (.01 * SD.discperc) ),
				InvItemDiscValue = SUM( ( (SD.qty * SD.serviceprice) *
											(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc) ) ) * (.01 * SL.discperc) ),
				ItemValue=SUM((SD.qty * SD.serviceprice *
					(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1 - (.01 * SL.discperc))),
				GrossAmt=(SELECT SUM((SDD.qty * SDD.serviceprice *
						(1 - (.01 * SDD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SLL.discperc)))
					FROM	servicerdetail SDD, servicerheader SLL
					WHERE SLL.servicerinvcode=SL.servicerinvcode and SLL.servicerinvcode=SDD.servicerinvcode
					GROUP BY SLL.servicerinvcode),
				SL.flatdisc,
				type='R'
			FROM
				servicerheader SL, servicerdetail SD
			WHERE
				SL.ServiceRInvCode = SD.ServiceRInvCode AND
				SL.Date >= @StartDate AND SL.Date <= @EndDate
			GROUP BY
				 SL.servicerinvcode,
				 SL.Date,
				 SL.salesmancode,
				 SD.servicecode,
				 SL.servicercatcode,
				 SL.discperc,
				 SL.flatdisc) S, Service SV
		WHERE S.ServiceCode = SV.ServiceCode
		GROUP BY 
			CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), S.Date, 101), SV.ServiceCatCode) R
	GROUP BY 
		R.Date, R.ServiceCatCode
END 

INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (Date1, Name1, Name2, Name3, Name4, Value1, Code1, Code2, Code3, Code4)
SELECT 
	Date=CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @ENDDate, 101)),
	FunctionalArea='A',
	Category='z Expenses',
	Details = 'Expense',
	Type='Expenses', 
	Amt = SUM(Credit - DEBIT),
	AccCode= -1,
	CatAccCode= -2,
	OrderBy=1,
	Code=NULL
FROM Accounts A, GLHeader H, GLDetail GD, SubAccounts S, CategoryAccounts C
WHERE
	H.Date >= @StartDate AND H.Date <= @EndDate AND
	H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
	H.GLVochCode = GD.GLVochCode AND 
	GD.AccCode = A.AccCode AND
	A.SubCode = S.SubAccCode AND
	S.CatAccCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM #lt_CatAccounts) AND
	S.CatAccCode = C.CatAccCode AND
	C.MainAccCode IN (5)

INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (Date1, Name1, Name2, Name3, Name4, Value1, Code1, Code2, Code3, Code4)
SELECT 
	Date=CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), H.Date, 101)),
	FunctionalArea=GD.Remarks,
	Category=C.Name,
	Details = A.Name,
	GroupAccount=S.Name, 
	Amt = Credit - DEBIT,
	AccCode= A.AccCode,
	CatAccCode=C.CatAccCode,
	OrderBy=2,
	Code=H.GLVochCode
FROM Accounts A, GLHeader H, GLDetail GD, SubAccounts S, CategoryAccounts C
WHERE
	H.Date >= @StartDate AND H.Date <= @EndDate AND
	H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
	H.GLVochCode = GD.GLVochCode AND 
	GD.AccCode = A.AccCode AND
	A.SubCode = S.SubAccCode AND
	S.CatAccCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM #lt_CatAccounts) AND
	S.CatAccCode = C.CatAccCode AND
	C.MainAccCode IN (5)

-- SP_DailyIncomeStatement_With_GP_Summary2
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_DailyIncomeStatement_With_GP_Summary2
	@StartDate DATETIME, 
	@EndDate DATETIME,
	@Accounts VARCHAR(8000)
AS

TRUNCATE TABLE REPORTDATA 

/*
Author: M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose: Purpose of this Code is to compute the profit/loss of a period and describes
it in the form of sales/service category
Parameter Description:
	@StartDate Start DateTime
	@EndDate Ending DateTime
	@Accounts  (Comma Separated List of Account Codes)
*/

CREATE TABLE #lt_CatAccounts (Code INT)

INSERT INTO #lt_CatAccounts
SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@Accounts, ',')

INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (Name1, Name2, Name3, Value1, Value2, Code1)
SELECT	
	PatientName = (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(P.Name)) + ' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(P.RegNo)) + ')' FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = R.PatientCode),
	Category=(SELECT SC.Name FROM ServiceCategory SC WHERE SC.ServiceCatCode = R.ServiceCatCode),
	Type=' Revenue', 
	Amt=ROUND(SUM(R.GrossSales - R.GrossRet), 0),
	Discount=ROUND(SUM(R.SaleDiscount - R.RetDiscount), 0),
	OrderBy=0
FROM
	(SELECT	
		S.PatientCode,
		SV.ServiceCatCode,
		GrossSales=ISNULL(SUM(S.GrossValue), 0),
		SaleDiscount= ISNULL(SUM(S.Discount), 0),
		GrossRet=0.00,
		RetDiscount=0.00
	FROM	
		(SELECT
			SL.PatientCode,
			SD.servicecode,
			GrossValue = SUM(SD.qty * SD.price ) ,
			Discount = 
			ISNULL(SUM(SD.qty * SD.ServiceFlatDisc), 0) + 
			ISNULL(SUM((SD.qty * (SD.price - SD.ServiceFlatDisc)) * (.01 * SD.discperc)), 0) + 
			ISNULL(SUM((SD.qty * (SD.price - SD.ServiceFlatDisc)) * (1 - (.01 * SD.discperc) ) *  (.01 * SL.discperc) ), 0) +
			ISNULL(SL.flatdisc, 0),
			type='S'
		FROM
			serviceheader SL, servicedetail SD
		WHERE
			SL.serviceInvCode = SD.serviceInvCode AND
			SL.Date >= @StartDate AND SL.Date <= @EndDate
		GROUP BY 
			 SL.serviceinvcode,
			 SL.Date,
			 SL.salesmancode,
			 SD.servicecode,
			 SL.servicecatcode,
			 SL.PatientCode,
			 SL.discperc,
			 SL.flatdisc) S, Service SV
	WHERE 
		S.ServiceCode = SV.ServiceCode
	GROUP BY 
		S.PatientCode, SV.ServiceCatCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT	
		S.PatientCode,
		SV.ServiceCatCode,
		GrossSales=0.00,
		SaleDiscount= 0.00,
		GrossRet=ISNULL(SUM(S.GrossValue), 0),
		RetDiscount=ISNULL(SUM(S.Discount), 0)
	FROM	
		(SELECT
			SL.PatientCode,
			SD.servicecode,
			GrossValue = SUM(SD.qty * SD.serviceprice ) ,
			Discount = 
			ISNULL(SUM(SD.qty * SD.ServiceFlatDisc), 0) + 
			ISNULL(SUM((SD.qty * (SD.serviceprice - SD.ServiceFlatDisc)) * (.01 * SD.discperc)), 0) + 
			ISNULL(SUM((SD.qty * (SD.serviceprice - SD.ServiceFlatDisc)) * (1 - (.01 * SD.discperc) ) *  (.01 * SL.discperc) ), 0) +
			ISNULL(SL.flatdisc, 0),
			type='R'
		FROM
			serviceRheader SL, serviceRdetail SD
		WHERE
			SL.serviceRInvCode = SD.serviceRInvCode AND
			SL.Date >= @StartDate AND SL.Date <= @EndDate
		GROUP BY 
			 SL.serviceRinvcode,
			 SL.Date,
			 SL.salesmancode,
			 SD.servicecode,
			 SL.serviceRcatcode,
			 SL.PatientCode,
			 SL.discperc,
			 SL.flatdisc) S, Service SV
	WHERE 
		S.ServiceCode = SV.ServiceCode
	GROUP BY 
		S.PatientCode, SV.ServiceCatCode) R
GROUP BY 
	R.PatientCode, R.ServiceCatCode
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	PatientName = A.Name,
	Category='«Expenses»',
	Type='Expenses', 
	Amt = SUM(Credit - DEBIT),
	Discount = 0,
	OrderBy=1
FROM Accounts A, GLHeader H, GLDetail GD, SubAccounts S, CategoryAccounts C
WHERE
	H.Date >= @StartDate AND H.Date <= @EndDate AND
	H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
	H.GLVochCode = GD.GLVochCode AND 
	GD.AccCode = A.AccCode AND
	A.SubCode = S.SubAccCode AND
	S.CatAccCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM #lt_CatAccounts) AND
	S.CatAccCode = C.CatAccCode AND
	C.MainAccCode IN (5)
GROUP BY A.Name

-- sp_DailyLedger_LPLedger
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_DailyLedger_LPLedger 
	@custcode INTEGER,
	@datetype VARCHAR(100),
	@start_date DATETIME, 
	@end_date DATETIME,
	@caption VARCHAR(100)
AS

DELETE ReportData

CREATE TABLE #sale (
	CustAliasName VARCHAR(20),
	Customer VARCHAR(100),
	ICode INT,
	ItemAliasName VARCHAR(100),
	ItemName VARCHAR(100),
	PackingDesc VARCHAR(100),
	Packing VARCHAR(100),
	SaleQty NUMERIC(15,4),
	FormNoAndQty VARCHAR(4000)
)

INSERT INTO #sale
SELECT 
	CustomerAliasName=A.AliasName,
	Customer = A.Name,
	ICode = SD.ICode,
	ItemAliasName=I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	PackingDesc = I.PackingDesc,
	Packing = (SELECT IP.Name FROM ItemPacking IP WHERE IP.PackCode = I.PackCode),
	SaleQty = SUM(SD.LooseQty),
	FormNoAndQty = ''
FROM
	Item I, SaleLedger SL, SaleInvDetail SD, Accounts A
WHERE
	CASE 
	WHEN lower(@datetype) = 'originaldate' THEN SL.OriginalDate 
	WHEN lower(@datetype) = 'lastsavingdate' THEN SL.Date 
	WHEN lower(@datetype) = 'billingdate' THEN SL.BillingDate 
	ELSE SL.Date 
	End Between @start_date AND @end_date AND
	SL.CustCode = @custcode AND
	SL.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	SL.Posted = 'Y' AND
	SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode
GROUP BY
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	SD.ICode,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name,
	I.PackingDesc,
	I.PackCode

UPDATE #Sale SET FormNoAndQty = dbo.Fn_GetFormNoAndQty_DailyLedger(@custcode, ICode, @datetype, @start_date, @end_date)

SELECT 
	CustAliasName,
	Customer,
	ICode,
	ItemAliasName,
	ItemName,
	PackingDesc,
	Packing,
	SaleQty,
	FormNoAndQty
FROM #Sale
ORDER BY ItemName

name: SP_DateWiseSaleBreakup

-- SP_DateWiseSaleBreakup
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_DateWiseSaleBreakup
	@ai_custcode int,
	@ad_startdate datetime,
	@ad_enddate datetime,
	@ai_days int,
	@ad_discperc numeric(6, 2)
AS 

/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	This report displays the breakup of sales in specified sales period

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	This function takes following parameters i.e. 
		1. @ai_custcode  = customer code whose sale is to required
		2. @ad_startdate = suggests the sale period start point
		3. @ad_enddate   = suggests the sale period end point
		4. @ai_days      = the chunk duraion in terms of days
		5. @ad_discperc  = discount %age to applied to sale
*/

DELETE ReportData

DECLARE @tmpdate datetime, @tmpdate2 datetime
DECLARE @counter int
DECLARE @date_str VARCHAR(100)
SET @tmpdate = @ad_startdate
SET @counter = 1

WHILE @tmpdate + @ai_days <= @ad_enddate
BEGIN
	SET @date_str = CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @tmpdate + @ai_days - 1, 101) + ' 23:59:59'
	INSERT INTO ReportData (Date1, Date2, Code1, Code2)
	SELECT @tmpdate, CONVERT(DateTime, @date_str), @ai_custcode, @Counter

	SET @tmpdate = @tmpdate + @ai_days
	SET @counter = @counter + 1
END

INSERT INTO ReportData (Date1, Date2, Code1, Code2)
SELECT @tmpdate, @ad_enddate, @ai_custcode, @Counter

UPDATE ReportData
SET
	Name1 = (SELECT A.AliasName FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = @ai_custcode),
	Name2 = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = @ai_custcode),
	Code3 = 
		(SELECT MIN(S.SaleInvCode) FROM SaleLedger S
		WHERE S.CustCode = @ai_custcode AND S.Date BETWEEN ReportData.Date1 AND ReportData.Date2),
	Code4 = 
		(SELECT MAX(S.SaleInvCode) FROM SaleLedger S
		WHERE S.CustCode = @ai_custcode AND S.Date BETWEEN ReportData.Date1 AND ReportData.Date2),
	Code5  = @ad_discperc,
	Value1 = 
		(SELECT SUM(S.netamount) 
		FROM 
			(SELECT 
			netamount = 
					Round(
					SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
						(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + 
							saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0)
					+
					Round(
					SUM( (saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.bonusqty) * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
					SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * 
								  (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
								  (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
						 ROUND( (SUM((saledetail.looseqty * 
								(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
								(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) -
								saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0)
			FROM SaleLedger, SaleDetail
			WHERE 
				SaleLedger.CustCode = @ai_custcode AND 
				SaleLedger.Date BETWEEN ReportData.Date1 AND ReportData.Date2 AND
				SaleLedger.SaleInvCode = SaleDetail.SaleInvCode
			GROUP BY
				SaleLedger.saleinvcode,   
				SaleLedger.date,
				SaleLedger.salecatcode, 
				SaleLedger.patientcode,
				SaleLedger.custrefno,	 
				SaleLedger.remarks,
				SaleLedger.relationcode,
				SaleLedger.DiscPerc,
				SaleLedger.MiscCharges,
				SaleLedger.SalesTax,
				SaleLedger.FlatDisc,
				SaleLedger.DiscPerc,
				SaleLedger.FlatDisc,
				SaleLedger.InvGSTPerc1
			UNION ALL
			SELECT 
			netamount = 
					Round(
					SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
						(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + 
							saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0)
					+
					Round(
					SUM( (saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.bonusqty) * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
					SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * 
								  (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
								  (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
						 ROUND( (SUM((saledetail.looseqty * 
								(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
								(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) -
								saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0)
			FROM SaleLedger, SaleInvDetail SaleDetail
			WHERE 
				SaleLedger.CustCode = @ai_custcode AND 
				SaleLedger.ImpactInventory = 'N' AND
				SaleLedger.Date BETWEEN ReportData.Date1 AND ReportData.Date2 AND
				SaleLedger.SaleInvCode = SaleDetail.SaleInvCode
			GROUP BY
				SaleLedger.saleinvcode,   
				SaleLedger.date,
				SaleLedger.salecatcode, 
				SaleLedger.patientcode,
				SaleLedger.custrefno,	 
				SaleLedger.remarks,
				SaleLedger.relationcode,
				SaleLedger.DiscPerc,
				SaleLedger.MiscCharges,
				SaleLedger.SalesTax,
				SaleLedger.FlatDisc,
				SaleLedger.DiscPerc,
				SaleLedger.FlatDisc,
				SaleLedger.InvGSTPerc1) S)

RETURN 0

CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_DB_Fetch_DropBoxInfo 
	@SRV VARCHAR(100),
	@DB VARCHAR(100),
	@Owner VARCHAR(100),
	@StartDate DATETIME,
	@EndDate DATETIME,
	@UserCode SMALLINT
AS
DECLARE @MySiteCode INT, @GroupCode INT, @err INT, @DocType VARCHAR(4000), @Qry VARCHAR(8000), @Prefix VARCHAR(4000), @RightCode INT
SET @MySiteCode = (SELECT MAX(SiteCode) FROM Site WHERE InstanceID IN (SELECT Name FROM ClientInstance))
IF @MySiteCode > 0 
BEGIN
	SET @GroupCode = (SELECT dbo.fn_GetGroupCode(@UserCode))
	
	SET @Prefix=''
	IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SRV))) = 0 OR @SRV IS NULL) 
		SET @Prefix = ''
	ELSE
		SET @Prefix = @SRV + '.' 
	
	IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DB))) = 0 OR @DB IS NULL)
		SET @Prefix = @Prefix
	ELSE
		SET @Prefix = @Prefix + @DB + '.'
	
	IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@OWNER))) = 0 OR @OWNER IS NULL)
		SET @Prefix = @Prefix + 'DBO' + '.'
	ELSE
		SET @Prefix = @Prefix + @OWNER + '.'
	
	SET @DocType = ''
	SET @RightCode = (SELECT MAX(RightCode) FROM GroupRights WHERE GroupCode=@GroupCode AND RightCode=5294)
	IF @RightCode = 5294
		SET @DocType = @DocType + '''S'','
	SET @RightCode = (SELECT MAX(RightCode) FROM GroupRights WHERE GroupCode=@GroupCode AND RightCode=5295)
	IF @RightCode = 5295
		SET @DocType = @DocType + '''SR'','
	SET @RightCode = (SELECT MAX(RightCode) FROM GroupRights WHERE GroupCode=@GroupCode AND RightCode=5296)
	IF @RightCode = 5296
		SET @DocType = @DocType + '''P'','
	SET @RightCode = (SELECT MAX(RightCode) FROM GroupRights WHERE GroupCode=@GroupCode AND RightCode=5297)
	IF @RightCode = 5297
		SET @DocType = @DocType + '''PR'','
	SET @RightCode = (SELECT MAX(RightCode) FROM GroupRights WHERE GroupCode=@GroupCode AND RightCode=5298)
	IF @RightCode = 5298
		SET @DocType = @DocType + '''PO'','
	SET @RightCode = (SELECT MAX(RightCode) FROM GroupRights WHERE GroupCode=@GroupCode AND RightCode=5299)
	IF @RightCode = 5299
		SET @DocType = @DocType + '''IS'','
	SET @RightCode = (SELECT MAX(RightCode) FROM GroupRights WHERE GroupCode=@GroupCode AND RightCode=5300)
	IF @RightCode = 5300
		SET @DocType = @DocType + '''EI'''
	IF Right(@DocType, 1) = ','
	SET @DocType = LEFT(@DocType, LEN(@DocType) - 1)

	IF @StartDate IS NULL 
		SET @StartDate = GETDATE() - 30

	IF @EndDate IS NULL 
		SET @EndDate = GETDATE()

	IF LEN(@DocType) > 0
		SET @Qry = 'SELECT MySiteCode= ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@MySiteCode,10))) + ', SiteCode, TargetSiteCode, SourceSite, TargetSite, DocumentType, DocumentCode, AliasName, Account, Category, Amount, Date, PushedOn, Pulled, PulledOn, PulledBy, RespondWith, Remarks, RefNo, RefNo2, RefNo3, RefNo4, RefNo5 FROM ' + @Prefix + 'View_DB_DropBox WHERE DATE BETWEEN ' + '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @StartDate, 121) + '''' + ' AND ' + '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @EndDate, 121) + '''' + ' AND DocumentType IN (' + @DocType + ') AND (SiteCode = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@MySiteCode,10))) + ' OR TargetSiteCode = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@MySiteCode,10))) + ')'
	ELSE
		SET @Qry = 'SELECT MySiteCode= ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@MySiteCode,10))) + ', SiteCode, TargetSiteCode, SourceSite, TargetSite, DocumentType, DocumentCode, AliasName, Account, Category, Amount, Date, PushedOn, Pulled, PulledOn, PulledBy, RespondWith, Remarks, RefNo, RefNo2, RefNo3, RefNo4, RefNo5 FROM ' + @Prefix + 'View_DB_DropBox WHERE 1=2'
END
ELSE
	SET @Qry = 'SELECT MySiteCode=NULL, SiteCode, TargetSiteCode, SourceSite, TargetSite, DocumentType, DocumentCode, AliasName, Account, Category, Amount, Date, PushedOn, Pulled, PulledOn, PulledBy, RespondWith, Remarks, RefNo, RefNo2, RefNo3, RefNo4, RefNo5 FROM View_DB_DropBox WHERE 1=2'

EXECUTE (@Qry)

-- SP_DB_PushExpiryIntimationToDropBox
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DB_PushExpiryIntimationToDropBox]
	@SInvCode INT,
	@LInvCode INT,
	@IntimationType SMALLINT,
	@UserCode SMALLINT,
	@SRV VARCHAR(100),
	@DB VARCHAR(100),
	@OWNER VARCHAR(100),
	@Count INT OUTPUT
AS

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE @Ins_Header VARCHAR(4000), @Ins_Detail VARCHAR(4000), @Prefix VARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @err INT

SET @Prefix=''
IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SRV))) = 0 OR @SRV IS NULL) 
	SET @Prefix = ''
ELSE
	SET @Prefix = @SRV + '.' 

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DB))) = 0 OR @DB IS NULL)
	SET @Prefix = @Prefix
ELSE
	SET @Prefix = @Prefix + @DB + '.'

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@OWNER))) = 0 OR @OWNER IS NULL)
	SET @Prefix = @Prefix + 'DBO' + '.'
ELSE
	SET @Prefix = @Prefix + @OWNER + '.'

Select @Count = count(*)
From   ExpiryIntimation WITH (UPDLOCK)
Where  ExpiryIntimation.sitecode IS NOT NULL AND ExpiryIntimation.TargetSiteCode IS NOT NULL AND
	ExpiryIntimation.IntimationCode Between @SInvCode AND @LInvCode AND 
	ExpiryIntimation.IntimationTypeCode=@IntimationType AND
	ExpiryIntimation.Posted = 'Y' AND Pushed='N'

SET @Ins_Header = 'INSERT INTO ' + @Prefix + 'DB_ExpiryIntimation (SiteCode,TargetSiteCode,IntimationCode,IntimationTypeCode,IntimationSerialNo,AccCode,Date,RefNo,Remarks1,Remarks2,UserCode,CustCode,PushedOn,PushedBy,Pulled,PulledOn,PulledBy) ' + ' SELECT SiteCode,TargetSiteCode,IntimationCode,IntimationTypeCode,IntimationSerialNo,AccCode,Date,RefNo,Remarks1,Remarks2,UserCode,CustCode,PushedOn=GETDATE(),PushedBy=' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@UserCode))) + ',Pulled=''N'',PulledOn=NULL,PulledBy=NULL FROM ExpiryIntimation WHERE SiteCode IS NOT NULL AND TargetSiteCode IS NOT NULL AND Posted=''Y'' AND Pushed=''N'' AND IntimationCode BETWEEN ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@SInvCode))) + ' AND ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@LInvCode))) + ' AND IntimationTypeCode = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@IntimationType)))
SET @Ins_Detail = 'INSERT INTO ' + @Prefix + 'DB_ExpiryIntimationDetail (SiteCode,IntimationCode,ICode,Batch,Expiry,Qty,Packunits,PackPrice,Price,InvoiceCode,InvoiceDate,RefNo,RefDate,RowID,ManfCode,LastAccCode) ' + ' SELECT P.SiteCode,P.IntimationCode,D.ICode,D.Batch,D.Expiry,D.Qty,D.Packunits,D.PackPrice,D.Price,D.InvoiceCode,D.InvoiceDate,D.RefNo,D.RefDate,D.RowID,D.ManfCode,D.LastAccCode FROM ExpiryIntimationDetail D, ExpiryIntimation P WHERE P.IntimationCode = D.IntimationCode AND P.SiteCode IS NOT NULL AND P.TargetSiteCode IS NOT NULL AND P.Posted=''Y'' AND P.Pushed=''N'' AND P.IntimationCode BETWEEN ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@SInvCode))) + ' AND ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@LInvCode))) + ' AND P.IntimationTypeCode = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@IntimationType)))
	
EXECUTE (@Ins_Header)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Error Pushing Expiry Intimation Header into Drop Box', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

EXECUTE (@Ins_Detail)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Error Pushing Expiry Intimation Details into Drop Box', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

UPDATE DBO.ExpiryIntimation 
SET Pushed='Y', PushedOn=GETDATE(), PushedBy = @UserCode
WHERE SiteCode IS NOT NULL AND TargetSiteCode IS NOT NULL AND Posted='Y' AND Pushed='N' AND 
	IntimationCode BETWEEN @SInvCode AND @LInvCode AND
	ExpiryIntimation.IntimationTypeCode=@IntimationType

IF @@ERROR <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Data Updation: Error Updating Expiry Intimation Header Info', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 
RETURN 0

POCode BETWEEN @SInvCode AND @LInvCode

	RETURN -1
END

TRUNCATE TABLE ReportData

SET @Ins_Header = 'INSERT INTO ReportData (Name1) SELECT MAX(PrefValue) FROM ' + @Prefix + 'SoftwarePreferences WHERE Name = ''DropBox_AutoPullPurOrderAsQutation'''
--PRINT @Ins_Header 
EXECUTE (@Ins_Header)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Unable to Fetch Remote Preference Value for Quotation Generation', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

SET @RemotePref = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(Name1) FROM ReportData WHERE Name1 IS NOT NULL), 'N')

IF @RemotePref = 'Y'
BEGIN
	SET @Exec_RemoteSP = @Prefix + 'SP_GenerateQuotations_From_DropBox'
	SET @err = 0
	EXECUTE(@Exec_RemoteSP)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Executing Quotation Generation On Remote Server', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

RETURN 0

	SET @Ins_Detail = 'INSERT INTO ' + @Prefix + 'DB_SRDetail (SiteCode,SRInvcode,Icode,Gcode,Batch,Expiry,PackQty,LooseQty,PackUnits,SRPrice,DiscPerc,SalesTax,AvgPrice,UnitSalesTax,GSTPerc,SRUtn,BonusQty,SalePrice,SaleRowId,RowId,ReturnItemDescription,TotalPieces,PiecesInHand,AlternatePurPrice,CommissionPerUnit,CommissionPerc,AlternateCustomICode,NewAvgPrice,Claimable,ClaimableDiscPerc,ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,CurrStock) ' + 'SELECT S.SiteCode,S.SRInvcode,D.Icode,D.Gcode,D.Batch,D.Expiry,D.PackQty,D.LooseQty,D.PackUnits,D.SRPrice,D.DiscPerc,D.SalesTax,D.AvgPrice,D.UnitSalesTax,D.GSTPerc,D.SRUtn,D.BonusQty,D.SalePrice,D.SaleRowId,D.RowId,D.ReturnItemDescription,D.TotalPieces,D.PiecesInHand,D.AlternatePurPrice,D.CommissionPerUnit,D.CommissionPerc,D.AlternateCustomICode,D.NewAvgPrice,D.Claimable,D.ClaimableDiscPerc,D.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,D.CurrStock FROM SRDetail D, srledger S WHERE S.SRInvcode = D.SRInvCode AND S.SiteCode IS NOT NULL AND S.TargetSiteCode IS NOT NULL AND S.Posted=''Y'' AND S.Pushed=''N'' AND S.SRInvCode BETWEEN ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@SInvCode))) + ' AND ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@LInvCode))) + ' AND S.CustCode = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@CustCode)))
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	Select @Count = count(*)
	From   srledger WITH (UPDLOCK)
	Where  srledger.sitecode IS NOT NULL AND srledger.TargetSiteCode IS NOT NULL AND
		srledger.srinvcode Between @SInvCode AND @LInvCode AND 
		srledger.Posted = 'Y' AND Pushed='N'

	SET @Ins_Header = 'INSERT INTO ' + @Prefix + 'DB_SRLedger (SiteCode,TargetSiteCode,SRInvCode,SaleInvCode,Date,SRCatCode,CustCode,SalesmanCode,DiscPerc,FlatDisc,MiscCharges,Remarks,InvGSTPerc1,Smancode,CustRefno,CustRefno2,CustRefno3,CustRefno4,invtotal,AdvanceTax,AdvanceTaxAmt,FBRPOSFee,PushedOn,PushedBy,Pulled,PulledOn,PulledBy) ' + 'SELECT SiteCode,TargetSiteCode,SRInvCode,SaleInvCode,Date,SRCatCode,CustCode,SalesmanCode,DiscPerc,FlatDisc,MiscCharges,Remarks,InvGSTPerc1,Smancode,CustRefno,CustRefno2,CustRefno3,CustRefno4,invtotal,AdvanceTax,AdvanceTaxAmt,FBRPOSFee,PushedOn=GETDATE(),PushedBy=' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@UserCode))) + ',Pulled=''N'',PulledOn=NULL,PulledBy=NULL FROM DBO.srledger WHERE SiteCode IS NOT NULL AND TargetSiteCode IS NOT NULL AND Posted=''Y'' AND Pushed=''N'' AND SRInvCode BETWEEN ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@SInvCode))) + ' AND ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@LInvCode)))
	SET @Ins_Detail = 'INSERT INTO ' + @Prefix + 'DB_SRDetail (SiteCode,SRInvcode,Icode,Gcode,Batch,Expiry,PackQty,LooseQty,PackUnits,SRPrice,DiscPerc,SalesTax,AvgPrice,UnitSalesTax,GSTPerc,SRUtn,BonusQty,SalePrice,SaleRowId,RowId,ReturnItemDescription,TotalPieces,PiecesInHand,AlternatePurPrice,CommissionPerUnit,CommissionPerc,AlternateCustomICode,NewAvgPrice,Claimable,ClaimableDiscPerc,ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,CurrStock) ' + 'SELECT S.SiteCode,S.SRInvcode,D.Icode,D.Gcode,D.Batch,D.Expiry,D.PackQty,D.LooseQty,D.PackUnits,D.SRPrice,D.DiscPerc,D.SalesTax,D.AvgPrice,D.UnitSalesTax,D.GSTPerc,D.SRUtn,D.BonusQty,D.SalePrice,D.SaleRowId,D.RowId,D.ReturnItemDescription,D.TotalPieces,D.PiecesInHand,D.AlternatePurPrice,D.CommissionPerUnit,D.CommissionPerc,D.AlternateCustomICode,D.NewAvgPrice,D.Claimable,D.ClaimableDiscPerc,D.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,D.CurrStock FROM SRDetail D, srledger S WHERE S.SRInvcode = D.SRInvCode AND S.SiteCode IS NOT NULL AND S.TargetSiteCode IS NOT NULL AND S.Posted=''Y'' AND S.Pushed=''N'' AND S.SRInvCode BETWEEN ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@SInvCode))) + ' AND ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@LInvCode)))
END
	
EXECUTE (@Ins_Header)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Error Pushing S/R Header into Drop Box', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

EXECUTE (@Ins_Detail)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Error Pushing S/R Details into Drop Box', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

IF @CustCode > 0
	UPDATE DBO.srledger 
	SET Pushed='Y', PushedOn=GETDATE(), PushedBy = @UserCode
	WHERE SiteCode IS NOT NULL AND TargetSiteCode IS NOT NULL AND Posted='Y' AND Pushed='N' AND 
		SRInvCode BETWEEN @SInvCode AND @LInvCode AND CustCode = @CustCode
ELSE
	UPDATE DBO.srledger 
	SET Pushed='Y', PushedOn=GETDATE(), PushedBy = @UserCode
	WHERE SiteCode IS NOT NULL AND TargetSiteCode IS NOT NULL AND Posted='Y' AND Pushed='N' AND 
		SRInvCode BETWEEN @SInvCode AND @LInvCode

IF @@ERROR <> 0
BEGIN

	RETURN -1
END

definition:
-- SP_DeleteBasicData
CREATE   PROCEDURE SP_DeleteBasicData
	@SRV VARCHAR(50), 
	@DB VARCHAR(50), 
	@OWNER VARCHAR(20) 
AS    
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

DECLARE @DEL NVARCHAR(1000), @SQL NVARCHAR(1000), @QRY NVARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @CON NVARCHAR(50), @NOTIN NVARCHAR(50), @TableName NVARCHAR(50), @WHR VARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @full_table_name NVARCHAR(255), @ColName NVARCHAR(255), @PKCOND NVARCHAR(1000)
DECLARE @Priority SMALLINT, @KeySeq SMALLINT
DECLARE @table_id INT, @err INT, @rowcount INT
SET @DEL = N'DELETE '
SET @WHR = N'WHERE '
SET @SQL = N' FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.'
SET @CON = N'CONVERT(VarChar(10),'
SET @NOTIN = N' NOT IN (SELECT '

DECLARE Del1 CURSOR FOR
SELECT TABLENAME=LTRIM(RTRIM(TABLENAME)), PRIORITY
FROM TransferableData
WHERE Enable='Y' AND AutoDelete = 'Y'
ORDER BY Priority

OPEN Del1

FETCH NEXT FROM Del1 
INTO @TableName, @Priority
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @PKCOND = ''
	SET @full_table_name = LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.' + @TableName
	SET @table_id = OBJECT_ID(@full_table_name)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @err <> 0 OR @table_id IS NULL
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Data Deletion: Invalid Object Refered: Name = %s', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
		CLOSE Del1
		DEALLOCATE Del1
		RETURN -1
	END

	DELETE REPORTDATA
	EXECUTE('INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (Code1) SELECT COUNT(*) ' + @SQL + @TableName)
	SET @rowcount = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Code1) FROM REPORTDATA), 0)
	IF @rowcount > 0
	BEGIN
		DECLARE Del2 CURSOR FOR
		SELECT
			COLNAME = CONVERT(sysname,c.name),
			KEYSEQ =  
				CASE when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  1) then convert (smallint,1)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  2) then convert (smallint,2)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  3) then convert (smallint,3)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  4) then convert (smallint,4)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  5) then convert (smallint,5)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  6) then convert (smallint,6)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  7) then convert (smallint,7)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  8) then convert (smallint,8)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  9) then convert (smallint,9)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 10) then convert (smallint,10)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 11) then convert (smallint,11)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 12) then convert (smallint,12)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 13) then convert (smallint,13)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 14) then convert (smallint,14)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 15) then convert (smallint,15)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 16) then convert (smallint,16)
				end   
		from
			sysindexes i, syscolumns c, sysobjects o
		where
			o.id = @table_id and 
			o.id = c.id and o.id = i.id and 
			(i.status & 0x800) = 0x800 and 
			(c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  1) or 
				c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  2) or 
				c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  3) or 
				c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  4) or
				c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  5) or         c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  6) or         c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  7) or         c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  8) or         c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  9) or         c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 10) or         c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 11) or         c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 12) or         c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 13) or         c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 14) or         c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 15) or         c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 16)        )   
		order by 2
		
		OPEN Del2
		FETCH NEXT FROM Del2
		INTO @ColName, @KeySeq
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			IF @KeySeq <> 1
			BEGIN
				SET @PKCOND = @PKCOND + ' + '
			END
			SET @PKCOND = @PKCOND + ' ' + @CON + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + ')'
			FETCH NEXT FROM Del2 
			INTO @ColName, @KeySeq
		END
		CLOSE Del2
		DEALLOCATE Del2
		SET @QRY = @DEL + @TableName + ' ' + @WHR + @PKCOND + @NOTIN + @PKCOND + @SQL + @TableName + ')'
		EXECUTE (@QRY)
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Data Deletion: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
			CLOSE Del1
			DEALLOCATE Del1
			RETURN -1
		END
	END
	FETCH NEXT FROM Del1 
	INTO @TableName, @Priority
END
CLOSE Del1
DEALLOCATE Del1
RETURN 0

-- SP_DeletePostedTransactions
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_DeletePostedTransactions
AS
DECLARE @err INT, @RowID INT, @Script VARCHAR(1000), @Stmt VARCHAR(100), @tablename VARCHAR(255)
DECLARE @maxlogid int, @KeepBal CHAR(1)

SET @KeepBal = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('keep_accbal_on_archive')
SET @KeepBal = ISNULL(@KeepBal,'Y')

IF @KeepBal='Y'
BEGIN
-- Fill up the a/c repository for later use
	EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_VirtualGL 'A'
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Executing Accounting Repository.', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	
	SET @maxlogid = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(LogID) FROM AccountBalanceLog), 0) + 1
	IF @maxlogid <= 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in fetching maximum log id.', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	
	INSERT INTO AccountBalanceLog (LogID, Date, AccCode, Balance)
	SELECT 
		LogID = @maxlogid,
		Date = GETDATE(),
		A.AccCode, 
		Balance=Sum(ISNULL(V.Debit,0) - ISNULL(V.Credit, 0))
	FROM VirtualGL V, Accounts A
	WHERE V.AccCode = A.AccCode
	GROUP BY A.AccCode
	HAVING Sum(ISNULL(V.Debit,0) - ISNULL(V.Credit, 0)) <> 0
	
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Insert Account balance log.', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @KeepBal='Y'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO VirtualGL (DocumentCode, DocumentType, AccCode, CatCode, AlternateAccCode, Debit, Credit, Date,
		CheckNo, Remarks, UserCode, PatientCode, VoucherCode, INVOICECODE, OUTSTANDINGAMT, BALANCE, 
		InvoiceType, VRow, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode)
	SELECT DocumentCode=1, DocumentType='TV', L.AccCode, CatCode=1, AlternateAccCode=NULL,
		Debit=SUM(CASE WHEN BALANCE > 0 THEN ABS(BALANCE) ELSE 0 END), 
		Credit=SUM(CASE WHEN BALANCE < 0 THEN ABS(BALANCE) ELSE 0 END), 
		L.Date,
		CheckNo=NULL, Remarks='Balance B/F:', UserCode=1, PatientCode=NULL, VoucherCode=1, 
		INVOICECODE=NULL, OUTSTANDINGAMT=0, BALANCE=0, 
		InvoiceType=NULL, VRow=0, GRN=NULL, GCCode=NULL, Vehicle=NULL, ShipTo=NULL, 
		GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL
	FROM AccountBalanceLog L, Accounts A
	WHERE L.LogID = @maxlogid AND L.AccCode = A.AccCode
	GROUP BY L.AccCode, A.Name, L.Date
	ORDER BY A.Name
END
RETURN 0
