-- SP_DeleteSaleInvoice_Bulk
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_DeleteSaleInvoice_Bulk
	@SInvCode INT
AS

DECLARE @PostedCount INT, @LInvCode INT, @err INT, @ICode INT, @CursorRows INT, @rt_code INT
DECLARE @GCode SMALLINT
DECLARE @Batch VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @Expiry DATETIME
DECLARE @Qty NUMERIC(15, 4), @CurrQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @NewQty NUMERIC(15, 4)

SET @PostedCount = ISNULL((SELECT Count(SaleInvCode) FROM SaleLedger WHERE SaleInvCode >= @SInvCode AND Posted='Y'), 0)
SET @LInvCode  = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(SaleInvCode) FROM SaleLedger), 0)
IF @PostedCount > 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('%d Posted Sale Invoice(s) exist within the range: [%d to %d]~r~nTherefore can not delete sale invoices', 16, 1, @PostedCount, @SInvCode, @LInvCode)
	RETURN -1
END

DELETE DBO.SaleDetailLog WHERE SaleInvCode >= @SInvCode
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in truncating Sale Invoice log Details', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

DELETE DBO.SaleLedgerLog WHERE SaleInvCode >= @SInvCode
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in truncating Sale Invoice log', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

DECLARE C1 CURSOR FORWARD_ONLY STATIC FOR
SELECT D.GCode, D.ICode, D.Batch, D.Expiry, Qty = SUM(D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty)
FROM 
	SaleLedger S, SaleDetail D
WHERE 
	S.Posted = 'N' AND
	S.SaleInvCode >= @SInvCode AND
	S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND
	D.Due IS NULL
GROUP BY
	D.ICode, D.GCode, D.Batch, D.Expiry
ORDER BY
	D.ICode, D.GCode, D.Batch, D.Expiry

OPEN C1
SET @CursorRows = @@Cursor_Rows

IF @CursorRows <= 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in deletion of sale invoices.~r~nReason:- No Items found in these sale invoices ', 16, 1)
	CLOSE C1
	DEALLOCATE C1
	RETURN -1
END

FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @GCode, @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @Qty
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	EXECUTE @rt_code = sp_GetItemStockBatch @GCode, @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @CurrQty Output
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in fetching stock for items', 16, 1)
		CLOSE C1
		DEALLOCATE C1
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @NewQty = @CurrQty + @Qty

	EXECUTE @rt_code = sp_UpdateItemStockBatch @GCode, @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @NewQty
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in updation of stock for items', 16, 1)
		CLOSE C1
		DEALLOCATE C1
		RETURN -1
	END

	FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @GCode, @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @Qty
END
CLOSE C1
DEALLOCATE C1

DELETE DBO.SaleDetail WHERE SaleInvCode >= @SInvCode
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in truncating Sale Invoice Details', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

DELETE DBO.SaleLedger WHERE SaleInvCode >= @SInvCode
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in truncating Sale Invoice Details', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

UPDATE _TabMaxKey 
SET TabMaxKey = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(SaleInvCode) FROM SaleLedger), 0)
WHERE TabName = 'SaleLedger'
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in Updating Sale Invoice Counter', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

UPDATE _HeaderTabMaxKey
SET TabMaxKey = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(SL.HeaderInvNo) FROM SaleLedger SL WHERE SL.HeaderNo = _HeaderTabMaxKey.HeaderCode), 0)
WHERE Module=1
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in Updating Header Wise Sale Invoice Counter', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

RETURN 0

CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_DeleteSyncedTransactions
AS
DECLARE @err INT, @SyncableRows INT, @RowID INT, @tablename VARCHAR(255), @ArchAccData CHAR(1), @Synchronize CHAR(1)
DECLARE @ParentTable VARCHAR(255), @ParentPK VARCHAR(255), @UpdateParent CHAR(1), @Posted CHAR(1)
DECLARE @Qry NVARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @maxlogid int, @KeepBal CHAR(1), @DeleteSyncedTran CHAR(1)

SET @DeleteSyncedTran = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('deletesyncedtransactions')
SET @DeleteSyncedTran = ISNULL(@DeleteSyncedTran,'N')

IF @DeleteSyncedTran = 'N'
	RETURN 0

SET @KeepBal = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('keep_accbal_on_archive')
SET @KeepBal = ISNULL(@KeepBal,'Y')
SET @ArchAccData = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('archiveaccountingdata')

IF @KeepBal='Y'
BEGIN
-- Fill up the a/c repository for later use
	EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_VirtualGL 'A'
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Executing Accounting Repository.', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	
	SET @maxlogid = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(LogID) FROM AccountBalanceLog), 0) + 1
	IF @maxlogid <= 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in fetching maximum log id.', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	
	INSERT INTO AccountBalanceLog (LogID, Date, AccCode, Balance)
	SELECT 
		LogID = @maxlogid,
		Date = GETDATE(),
		A.AccCode, 
		Balance=Sum(ISNULL(V.Debit,0) - ISNULL(V.Credit, 0))
	FROM VirtualGL V, Accounts A
	WHERE V.AccCode = A.AccCode
	GROUP BY A.AccCode
	HAVING Sum(ISNULL(V.Debit,0) - ISNULL(V.Credit, 0)) <> 0
	
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Insert Account balance log.', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	TRUNCATE TABLE VirtualGL

	INSERT INTO VirtualGL (DocumentCode, DocumentType, AccCode, CatCode, AlternateAccCode, Debit, Credit, Date,
		CheckNo, Remarks, UserCode, PatientCode, VoucherCode, INVOICECODE, OUTSTANDINGAMT, BALANCE, 
		InvoiceType, VRow, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode)
	SELECT DocumentCode=1, DocumentType='TV', L.AccCode, CatCode=1, AlternateAccCode=NULL,
		Debit=SUM(CASE WHEN BALANCE > 0 THEN ABS(BALANCE) ELSE 0 END), 
		Credit=SUM(CASE WHEN BALANCE < 0 THEN ABS(BALANCE) ELSE 0 END), 
		L.Date,
		CheckNo=NULL, Remarks='Balance B/F:', UserCode=1, PatientCode=NULL, VoucherCode=1, 
		INVOICECODE=NULL, OUTSTANDINGAMT=0, BALANCE=0, 
		InvoiceType=NULL, VRow=0, GRN=NULL, GCCode=NULL, Vehicle=NULL, ShipTo=NULL, 
		GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL
	FROM AccountBalanceLog L, Accounts A
	WHERE L.LogID = @maxlogid AND L.AccCode = A.AccCode
	GROUP BY L.AccCode, A.Name, L.Date
	ORDER BY A.Name
END

-- SP_Drop_Constraint
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_Drop_Constraint @TableName VARCHAR(255), @ConstraintType VARCHAR(255)
AS
DECLARE @Stmt VARCHAR(8000), @Constraint VARCHAR(1000)

SET @Stmt = 'ALTER TABLE '

SET @Constraint = (SELECT so2.Name FROM SysObjects so, SysConstraints sc, sysobjects so2 WHERE so.Name=@TableName AND so.id = sc.id AND sc.ConstID = so2.id AND so2.xtype=@ConstraintType)

IF LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Constraint))) <= 0 RETURN 0

SET @Stmt = 'ALTER TABLE DBO.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@TableName)) + ' DROP CONSTRAINT ' + @Constraint

EXECUTE (@Stmt)

RETURN 0

-- SP_DropColumnLevelConstraint
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_DropColumnLevelConstraint
AS

DECLARE @ConstCount INT, @LoopCount INT, @Priority NUMERIC(6,2)
DECLARE @Table VARCHAR(60), @Col VARCHAR(60), @Const VARCHAR(1000), @Stmt VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @OldTable VARCHAR(60)

DECLARE C1 CURSOR FOR
SELECT dd.tablename, dd.columnname, dd.priority, so.name
FROM
	(select so.id, so.name from sysobjects so) p, 
	sysobjects so, 
	sysconstraints sc,
	dropdata dd
WHERE
	dd.tablename = p.name and
	p.id = so.parent_obj and
	so.id = sc.constid and 
	so.parent_obj in (OBJECT_ID(p.name)) /* and 
	xtype ='D'*/ and 
	sc.colid > 0 AND 
	sc.colid in
	(SELECT sl.colid 
	FROM syscolumns sl 
	WHERE
		sl.id IN (OBJECT_ID(p.name)) and 
		sl.name IN (dd.columnname))
ORDER BY dd.priority

OPEN C1
FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @Table, @Col, @Priority, @Const
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @Stmt = 'ALTER TABLE DBO.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@Table)) + ' DROP CONSTRAINT ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@Const))
	EXECUTE (@Stmt)
	FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @Table, @Col, @Priority, @Const
END
CLOSE C1
DEALLOCATE C1

RETURN 0

-- SP_DropImportTables
CREATE   PROCEDURE SP_DropImportTables
AS
/*
Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Version:1.0
Comments:This stored procedure is build using iterative prototyping sofware process model so at this
	 stage some of the temporary basic data tables (acting as import buffer area) are used for storing data.
	 This SP must be execute before executing the following stored procedures.
	 1-SP_ImportData	
	 2-sp_SynchronizeData
*/
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

/*Variables to be used in drop process*/
DECLARE @TableName NVARCHAR(255), @DropQuery NVARCHAR(1000)
DECLARE @err INT

DECLARE TmpCrs1 CURSOR FOR
SELECT TABLENAME = 'DBO.Import_' + LTRIM(RTRIM(TABLENAME))
FROM TransferableData 
WHERE Enable='Y' AND (AUTOINSERT = 'Y' OR AUTOUPDATE = 'Y' OR AUTODELETE = 'Y' OR UPDATETABMAXKEY = 'Y')
ORDER BY Priority

OPEN TmpCrs1

FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs1 INTO @TableName
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @DropQuery = 'DROP TABLE ' + @TableName

	IF exists (select * from dbo.sysobjects where id = object_id(@TableName) and OBJECTPROPERTY(id, N'IsUserTable') = 1)
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE (@DropQuery)
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Problem occurred while execution of Import Tables Drop Procedure, Table Name = %s', 16, 1, @TableName)
			CLOSE TmpCrs1
			DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
			RETURN -1
		END 

	END
		
	FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs1 INTO @TableName
END
CLOSE TmpCrs1
DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1

SET @TableName = 'DBO.Import_GodownDetail'
SET @DropQuery = 'DROP TABLE ' + @TableName

IF exists (select * from dbo.sysobjects where id = object_id(@TableName) and OBJECTPROPERTY(id, N'IsUserTable') = 1)
BEGIN
	EXECUTE (@DropQuery)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Problem occurred while execution of Import Tables Drop Procedure, Table Name = %s', 16, 1, @TableName)
		RETURN -1
	END 

END

RETURN 0

IF exists (select * from dbo.sysobjects where id = object_id(N'[dbo].[PDTEMP]') and OBJECTPROPERTY(id, N'IsUserTable') = 1)

-- sp_Empty_DataCarryDB
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_Empty_DataCarryDB @SRV VARCHAR(50), @DB VARCHAR(50), @OWNER VARCHAR(20) AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON
Declare @tablename VarChar(100), @query VarChar(8000), @rows INT, @row INT, @inrow INT
DECLARE @TransTable TABLE (TableName VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, ID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1))
INSERT INTO @TransTable (TableName)
SELECT 'GodownDetail'
UNION
SELECT 'SaleDetail'
UNION
SELECT 'SaleLedger'
UNION
SELECT 'PrDetail'
UNION
SELECT 'PrLedger'
UNION
SELECT 'PrDetail'
UNION
SELECT 'PurOrderHeader'
UNION
SELECT 'PurOrderDetail '
UNION
SELECT 'SaleOrderHeader '
UNION
SELECT 'SaleOrderDetail '
UNION
SELECT 'ServiceDetail '
UNION
SELECT 'ServiceHeader '
UNION
SELECT 'QuotationDetail '
UNION
SELECT 'QuotationHeader '
UNION
SELECT 'PurDetail '
UNION
SELECT 'PurLedger '
UNION
SELECT 'ExpiryIntimation '
UNION
SELECT 'ExpiryIntimationDetail '
UNION 
Select TableName
From   TransferableData
Where  Enable='Y' AND AutoUpdate='Y' OR AutoInsert = 'Y' OR AutoDelete = 'Y' OR UpdateTabMaxKey = 'Y'

SET @rows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(TableName) FROM @TransTable),0)
SET @row=1
While @rows > 0 AND @row <= @rows
BEGIN
	Set @tablename = (SELECT TableName FROM @TransTable WHERE ID = @row)
	Set @query = 'Delete From ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.' + @tablename
	IF lower(@tablename) = 'item'
	BEGIN
		SET @inrow = 1
		WHILE @inrow <= 40
		BEGIN
			Set @query = 'Delete From ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.item WHERE ICode < ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(50000 * @inrow)))
			Execute(@query)
			IF @@Error <> 0
			Begin
				RaisError('Some Problem occur in emptying DataCarryDB, Table Name = %s',16,1, @tablename)
				Return -1
			End
			SET @inrow = @inrow + 1
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		Execute(@query)
		IF @@Error <> 0
		Begin
			RaisError('Some Problem occur in emptying DataCarryDB, Table Name = %s',16,1, @tablename)
			Return -1
		End
	END
	SET @row = @row + 1
END

Return 1

-- sp_ExtractExpiryIntimation
CREATE   PROCEDURE DBO.sp_ExtractExpiryIntimation
	@UserCode SMALLINT,
	@ConsolidatedIntimation INT,
	@GroupType CHAR(1),
	@GroupList VARCHAR(8000),
	@AccCode SMALLINT,
	@CustCode SMALLINT,
	@Type SMALLINT,
	@IntimationCode INT OUTPUT
As
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @continue Int, @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @totalrows Int, @rowcount Int, @counter Int, @serialno int
IF @ConsolidatedIntimation <= 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('No Expiry Intimation Selected' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

IF @GroupType='S' AND @GroupList='S'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList
	SELECT DISTINCT ICode 
	FROM ItemSuppliers 
	WHERE SuppCode=@AccCode
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList
	select CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@GroupType, @GroupList)
END

SET @totalrows = ISNULL(
	(SELECT COUNT(D.ICode) 
	FROM 
		(SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I, 
		ExpiryIntimationDetail D
	WHERE D.IntimationCode = @ConsolidatedIntimation AND D.ICode = I.Code), 0)

IF @totalrows IS NULL OR @totalrows <= 0
	RETURN 0

Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'ExpiryIntimation', @IntimationCode Output
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
Begin
	RAISERROR('New Expiry Intimation Code Generation Problem' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1
End

SET @serialno = ISNULL((SELECT COUNTER FROM dbo.IntimationType WITH (UPDLOCK HOLDLOCK) WHERE IntimationTypeCode=@Type), 0)
IF @serialno > 0
BEGIN
	SET @serialno = @serialno + 1

	UPDATE dbo.IntimationType
	SET COUNTER = @serialno
	WHERE IntimationTypeCode=@Type
END

INSERT INTO ExpiryIntimation (IntimationCode, IntimationTypeCode, IntimationSerialNo, AccCode, Date, RefNo, Remarks1, Remarks2, UserCode, Posted, PostedBy, PostDate, CustCode)
VALUES (@IntimationCode, @Type, @serialno, @AccCode, GETDATE(), '', 'Extracted Expiry Intimation', 'Consolidated Intimation Code = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@ConsolidatedIntimation))), @UserCode, 'N', @UserCode, GETDATE(), @CustCode)

IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@rowcount = 0
Begin
	RAISERROR('Expiry Intimation Header Row Insertion Problem for Expiry Intimation Code %d' ,16, 1, @IntimationCode)
	RETURN -1
End

INSERT INTO ExpiryIntimationDetail (IntimationCode, ICode, Batch, Expiry, Qty, Packunits, PackPrice, Price, InvoiceCode, InvoiceDate, RefNo, RefDate, LastAccCode, ManfCode)
SELECT T.IntimationCode, T.ICode, T.Batch, T.Expiry, T.Qty, T.PackUnits, T.PackPrice, T.Price, T.InvoiceCode, T.InvoiceDate, T.RefNo, T.RefDate, T.LastAccCode, T.ManfCode
FROM
	(SELECT IntimationCode=@IntimationCode, D.ICode, D.Batch, D.Expiry, D.Qty, D.Packunits, D.PackPrice, D.Price, D.InvoiceCode, D.InvoiceDate, D.RefNo, D.RefDate, D.RowID, D.LastAccCode, D.ManfCode
	FROM 	ExpiryIntimationDetail D, 
		ExpiryIntimation H, 
		(SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	WHERE H.IntimationCode = @ConsolidatedIntimation AND
		H.IntimationCode = D.IntimationCode AND
		D.ICode = I.Code) T,
	Item I
WHERE T.ICode = I.ICode
ORDER BY T.RowID

IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@rowcount = 0
Begin
	RAISERROR('Expiry Intimation Detail Row Insertion Problem for Expiry Intimation Code =%d' ,16, 1, @IntimationCode)
	RETURN -1
End

Return 0

definition:
-- SP_Fetch_ChildServerSales
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.SP_Fetch_ChildServerSales
	@SRV VARCHAR(255), 
	@DB VARCHAR(50), 
	@OWNER VARCHAR(20),
	@UserCode SMALLINT
AS

SET XACT_ABORT ON
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

/* Variables to be used in import process */
DECLARE @INS VARCHAR(4000), @SQL VARCHAR(4000), @WHR VARCHAR(4000), @WHR_Cln VARCHAR(4000), @Query VARCHAR(4000), @stdate VARCHAR(100), @edate VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @err INT, @rt_code INT, @SaleType INT
DECLARE @dt DATETIME, @Prefix VARCHAR(1000), @INQry VARCHAR(4000)

SET @Prefix = LTRIM(RTRIM(@SRV)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner))
SET @SaleType = 1
SET @WHR = N' WHERE Posted=''Y'' AND Transmit = ' + CHAR(39) + 'Y' + CHAR(39) + ' AND Transmited = ' + CHAR(39) + 'N' + CHAR(39)

WHILE @SaleType <= 3
BEGIN
	DELETE ReportData

	IF @SaleType = 1
	BEGIN
		SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO IMP_SaleLedger '
		SET @SQL = N' SELECT ServerName=' + '''' + @SRV + ''', TransDate=GETDATE(), InvType = 1, SaleInvCode, SaleCatCode , CustCode , SalesmanCode, date, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SalesTax, Posted, PostDate, Remarks, CustRefNo, headerno, headerinvno, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, SPrice, QuotationNo, DoctCode, PatientCode, RePrintingCounter, CashReceived, InvGSTPerc1, PrintWaranty, PrintBatch, MessageCode, SManCode, InvoiceSize, CustRefno2, CustRefno3, CustRefno4, GSTNO, InvTotal, MachineName, ModifyCounter, itemdiscpercno, RelationCode, DiseaseCode, WardCode, AdmissionCode, ReturnCounter, Paid, BillingDate, UnReceivedBalance, TotalOfSaleReturns, ListOfSrInvoices, printbalance, AccountFor, PaymentMode, PaymentAccCode, Amt, AmtBY, AmtDate, AmtReference, OutstandingAmt, Marked, Transferable, Transfered, TransferedOn, TransferedBy, Imported, ImportedBy, deliveredby, SaleTypeCode, Balance, PptCustCode, DELETED, PresCode, ImpactInventory, SaleOrderCode, SaleComments1, SaleComments2, AlterSaleInvCode, RecurringInvoice, RecurringPeriod, LastRecurringInvCode, RecurringAgainst, ConsiderInPO, VisitCode, DueDate, SRBufferInvCode, CustRefNo5, GCCode, GRN, SuppInvCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuaranteePersonCode, CashTendered, CashCharged, CashBack, CashAccCode, CustLicNo, CustLicExpiry, ModuleId, DocCode=SaleInvCode, SaleTypeInvNo, CRS_Transfered, CRS_TransferedOn, GuestCode, GuestCheckInCode, StudentCode, CustSiteCode, Transmit, Transmited, Fiscalized, FiscalizedOn, FiscalInvoiceNo, AdvanceTax, ISNULL(AdvanceTaxAmt, 0), FBRPOSFee FROM ' + @Prefix + '.SaleLedger '
		SET @InQry = N'INSERT INTO ReportData (Code1) SELECT SaleInvCode FROM ' + @Prefix + '.SaleLedger '
		SET @WHR = N' WHERE SaleInvCode IN (SELECT Code1 FROM ReportData)'
	END
	IF @SaleType = 2
	BEGIN
		SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO IMP_AdvSaleLedger '
		SET @SQL = N' SELECT ServerName=' + '''' + @SRV + ''', TransDate=GETDATE(), InvType = 2, * FROM ' + @Prefix + '.AdvSaleLedger '
		SET @InQry = N'INSERT INTO ReportData (Code1) SELECT AdvSaleInvCode FROM ' + @Prefix + '.AdvSaleLedger '
		SET @WHR = N' WHERE AdvSaleInvCode IN (SELECT Code1 FROM ReportData)'
	END
	IF @SaleType = 3
	BEGIN
		SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO IMP_SRLedger '
		SET @SQL = N' SELECT ServerName=' + '''' + @SRV + ''', TransDate=GETDATE(), InvType = 3, SRInvCode,SaleInvCode,Date,SRCatCode,CustCode,SalesmanCode,DiscPerc,FlatDisc,MiscCharges,Posted,PostDate,Remarks,SalesTax,OriginalDate,ModifiedBy,PostedBy,HeaderNo,InvGSTPerc1,Smancode,CustRefno,CustRefno2,CustRefno3,CustRefno4,PatientCode,MachineName,HeaderInvNo,AdmissionCode,invtotal,AccountFor,PaymentMode,PaymentAccCode,Amt,AmtBY,AmtDate,AmtReference,OutstandingAmt,Marked,PageSize,ReprintingCounter,DoctCode,ConsiderInPO,CashAccCode,CashTendered,CashCharged,CashBack,RetViaBillSummary,CRS_Transfered,CRS_TransferedOn,GuestCode,GuestCheckInCode,StudentCode,Synced,SyncedOn,SyncedBy,CurrencyCode,ConversionRate,Fiscalized,FiscalizedOn,FiscalInvoiceNo,Transmit,Transmited,AdvanceTax,AdvanceTaxAmt,FBRPOSFee FROM ' + @Prefix + '.SRLedger '
		SET @InQry = N'INSERT INTO ReportData (Code1) SELECT SRInvCode FROM ' + @Prefix + '.SRLedger '
		SET @WHR = N' WHERE SRInvCode IN (SELECT Code1 FROM ReportData)'
	END
	SET @WHR_Cln = @WHR
	SET @InQry = @InQry + N' WHERE Posted=''Y'' AND Transmit = ' + CHAR(39) + 'Y' + CHAR(39) + ' AND Transmited = ' + CHAR(39) + 'N' + CHAR(39)
	
	EXECUTE (@InQry)
--	Print @InQry
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Fetch Sales Data Problem: Error Inserting Sales Data into ReportData From Server (%s) ', 16, 1, @SRV)
		RETURN -1
	END 

	SET @Query = @INS + @SQL + @WHR
	EXECUTE (@Query)
--	PRINT (@Query)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Fetch Sales Data Problem: Error Transfering Sales Data From Server (%s) ', 16, 1, @SRV)
		RETURN -1
	END 
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF @SaleType = 1
		BEGIN
			SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO IMP_SaleDetail '
			SET @SQL = N'SELECT ServerName=' + '''' + @SRV + ''', SaleInvcode, ICode, GCode, Batch, Expiry, PackQty, LooseQty, PackUnits, SalePrice, AvgPrice, Rate, DiscPerc, SalesTax, RowID, Due, SatisfiedDate, itemflatdisc, SaleItemDescription, PackPrice, UnitSalesTax, GSTPerc, SaleUtn, bonusqty, claimable, balancestock, RowGroup, ClaimableDiscPerc, ManfDate, PackQtyForSale, BonusPackQtyForSale, SaleOrderRowID, DescICode, SourceSaleInvCode=SaleInvCode, SaleRowID=NULL, IssueRowID=NULL, PurUnitRate, RPPUnitRate, TotalPieces, PiecesInHand, PackSalePrice, RefusalSaleRowID=NULL, AlternatePurPrice, CommissionPerUnit, CommissionPerc, AlternateCustomICode, BatchCost, ISNULL(ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,0) FROM ' + @Prefix +'.SaleDetail '
		END
		IF @SaleType = 2
		BEGIN
			SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO IMP_AdvSaleDetail '
			SET @SQL = N'SELECT ServerName=' + '''' + @SRV + ''', * FROM ' + @Prefix + '.AdvSaleDetail '
		END
		IF @SaleType = 3
		BEGIN
			SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO IMP_SRDetail (ChildServer,SRInvcode,Icode,Gcode,Batch,Expiry,PackQty,LooseQty,PackUnits,SRPrice,DiscPerc,SalesTax,AvgPrice,UnitSalesTax,GSTPerc,SRUtn,BonusQty,SalePrice,SaleRowId,ReturnItemDescription,TotalPieces,PiecesInHand,AlternatePurPrice,CommissionPerUnit,CommissionPerc,AlternateCustomICode,NewAvgPrice,Claimable,ClaimableDiscPerc,ItemAdvanceTaxPerc) '
			SET @SQL = N'SELECT ServerName=' + '''' + @SRV + ''',SRInvcode,Icode,Gcode,Batch,Expiry,PackQty,LooseQty,PackUnits,SRPrice,DiscPerc,SalesTax,AvgPrice,UnitSalesTax,GSTPerc,SRUtn,BonusQty,SalePrice,SaleRowId,ReturnItemDescription=LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SRUTN))),TotalPieces,PiecesInHand,AlternatePurPrice,CommissionPerUnit,CommissionPerc,AlternateCustomICode,NewAvgPrice,Claimable,ClaimableDiscPerc,ISNULL(ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,0) FROM ' + @Prefix + '.SRDetail '
		END
	
--		SET @WHR = N' WHERE Transmit = ' + CHAR(39) + 'Y' + CHAR(39) + ' AND Transmited = ' + CHAR(39) + 'N' + CHAR(39) + ')'
		SET @Query = @INS + @SQL + @WHR
--		PRINT (@Query)
		EXECUTE (@Query)
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Fetch Sales/Returns Data Detail Problem: Error Fetching Sales Data Detail From Server (%s) ', 16, 1, @SRV)
			RETURN -1
		END 
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @SaleType <> 2
			BEGIN
				IF @SaleType = 1
				BEGIN
					SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO IMP_CashierWindow SELECT ChildServer=' + CHAR(39) + @SRV + CHAR(39) + ', CW.* FROM '  + @Prefix +  '.CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode IN (SELECT Code1 FROM ReportData) '
				END
				IF @SaleType = 3
				BEGIN
					SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO IMP_MasterCashWin SELECT ChildServer=' + CHAR(39) + @SRV + CHAR(39) + ', CW.* FROM '  + @Prefix + '.MasterCashWin CW WHERE CW.DocumentType = ' + CHAR(39) + 'SR' + CHAR(39) + ' AND DocumentCode IN (SELECT Code1 FROM ReportData)'
				END
				SET @Query = @INS
	
				EXECUTE (@Query)
				SET @err = @@ERROR
				IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
				BEGIN
					RAISERROR('Fetching Sales Data Problem: Error Updating Master Cashier Window Related Data (%d)', 16, 1, @SaleType)
					RETURN -1
				END 
			END
	
			IF @SaleType = 1
			BEGIN
				SET @Query = 'UPDATE ' + @Prefix + '.SaleLedger SET Transmited = ' + CHAR(39) + 'Y' + CHAR(39) + @WHR
			END
			IF @SaleType = 2
			BEGIN
				SET @Query = 'UPDATE ' + @Prefix + '.AdvSaleLedger SET Transmited = ' + CHAR(39) + 'Y' + CHAR(39) + @WHR
			END
			IF @SaleType = 3
			BEGIN
				SET @Query = 'UPDATE ' + @Prefix + '.SRLedger SET Transmited = ' + CHAR(39) + 'Y' + CHAR(39) + @WHR
			END
			
--			PRINT (@Query)
			EXECUTE (@Query)
			SET @err = @@ERROR
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Fetch Sales Data Problem: Error Fetching Sales', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END 
		END
	END
	SET @SaleType = @SaleType + 1
END

SET @dt = GETDATE()
Execute @rt_code = SP_Set_DateTime_Preference 'LastSaleTransmited', @dt
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
Begin
	RaisError( 'Unable to Record Last Sale Fetch Information in Software Preferences' , 16 , 1)
	RETURN -1								
End

Execute @rt_code = sp_ChildServer_AllSales_Translation @Srv, @UserCode
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
Begin
	RaisError( 'Unable to Translate Child Server Sales for Server (%s)' , 16 , 1, @Srv)
	RETURN -1								
End

RETURN 0

name: sp_FetchCustomerLatestDiscounts
definition:
-- sp_FetchCustomerLatestDiscounts
CREATE Procedure DBO.sp_FetchCustomerLatestDiscounts
	@custcode Int, 
	@icode Int, 
	@itemflatdisc Numeric(5,2) OUTPUT,  
	@discperc Numeric(5,2) OUTPUT,  
	@rows SmallInt OUTPUT 
As

Select @rows = count(*) , @itemflatdisc = Max(saledetail.itemflatdisc), @discperc = MAX(saledetail.discperc)
From 
	saleledger , 
	saledetail , 
	(Select date = max(sl.date) 
	from saleledger sl, saledetail sd
	where sl.custcode = @custcode And
	      sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode And
	      sd.icode = @icode) A
Where   saleledger.custcode = @custcode And 
	saleledger.date = A.date And 
	saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode And
	saledetail.icode = @icode
Group By saledetail.icode,
	 saledetail.itemflatdisc,
	 saledetail.discperc

-- sp_FetchCustomerLatestNetRate
CREATE Procedure DBO.sp_FetchCustomerLatestNetRate
	@custcode Int, 
	@icode Int, 
	@netrate Numeric(8,2) OUTPUT,  
	@rows SmallInt OUTPUT As

Select @rows = count(*) , @NetRate = Max( ROUND((saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - saledetail.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - saleledger.discperc * 0.01), 2))
From 
	saleledger , 
	saledetail , 
	(Select date = max(sl.date) 
	from saleledger sl, saledetail sd
	where sl.custcode = @custcode And
	      sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode And
	      sd.icode = @icode) A

-- sp_Finalize_Production
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_Finalize_Production 
	@ai_sInvCode integer, 
	@ai_lInvCode integer, 
	@ai_UserCode integer 
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @IssuePrice CHAR(1)

	Set @IssuePrice = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('DetermineIssuePriceInProductionFrom')

	INSERT INTO DBO.ProdBuffer (ProdCode, ProdRowID, ICode, Qty, Remarks, PackUnits, PackPrice, Price, ItemFlatDisc, DiscPerc, ProcessCharge, ProcessChargePerc)
	SELECT DISTINCT
		ProdCode=H.ProdCode,
		ProdRowID=D.RowID,
		RD.ICode,
		Round( (RD.Qty * (D.Qty / CASE WHEN R.Qty <=0 THEN 1 ELSE R.Qty END)), (SELECT dbo.Fn_GetColumnPrecision('Qty')) ) As Qty , 
		RD.Remarks,
		RD.PackUnits,

		PackPrice = CASE @IssuePrice 
						WHEN '1' THEN RD.PackPrice 
						WHEN '2' THEN ISNULL((SELECT I.SalePrice FROM Item I WHERE I.ICode = RD.ICode), 0) 
						WHEN '3' THEN ISNULL((SELECT I.PurPrice FROM Item I WHERE I.ICode = RD.ICode), 0) 
						WHEN '4' THEN ISNULL((SELECT I.RecentPurPrice FROM Item I WHERE I.ICode = RD.ICode), 0) 
						ELSE ISNULL((SELECT ROUND(I.AvgPrice,2) FROM Item I WHERE I.ICode = RD.ICode), 0) END,
		Price = CASE @IssuePrice 
						WHEN '1' THEN RD.Price 
						WHEN '2' THEN ISNULL((SELECT ROUND(I.SalePrice / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits > 0 THEN I.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2) FROM Item I WHERE I.ICode = RD.ICode), 0) 
						WHEN '3' THEN ISNULL((SELECT ROUND(I.PurPrice / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits > 0 THEN I.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2) FROM Item I WHERE I.ICode = RD.ICode), 0) 
						WHEN '4' THEN ISNULL((SELECT ROUND(I.RecentPurPrice / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits > 0 THEN I.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2) FROM Item I WHERE I.ICode = RD.ICode), 0) 
						ELSE ISNULL((SELECT ROUND(I.AvgPrice,2) FROM Item I WHERE I.ICode = RD.ICode), 0) END,		
		RD.ItemFlatDisc,
		RD.DiscPerc,
		RD.ProcessCharge,
		RD.ProcessChargePerc
	FROM 
		ProdHeader H, ProdDetail D, 
		RecipeDetail RD,
		(SELECT R1.*
		FROM Recipe R1
		WHERE STR(R1.ResultedItem, 7) + STR(R1.Priority, 7) IN
			(SELECT DISTINCT STR(RR.ResultedItem,7) + STR(MIN(RR.Priority), 7)
			FROM Recipe RR 
			WHERE RR.ResultedItem IN 
				(SELECT DISTINCT PD.ICode 
				FROM ProdHeader P, ProdDetail PD
				WHERE P.ProdCode Between @ai_sInvCode AND @ai_lInvCode AND 
					P.Posted='N' AND P.Finalized = 'N' AND 
					P.ProdCode = PD.ProdCode)
			GROUP BY RR.ResultedItem)) R
	WHERE 
		H.ProdCode Between @ai_sInvCode AND @ai_lInvCode AND
		H.Posted = 'N' AND
		H.Finalized = 'N' AND
		H.ProdCode = D.ProdCode AND
		D.ICode = R.ResultedItem AND
		R.RecipeCode = RD.RecipeCode
	ORDER BY
		ProdRowID

	IF @@RowCount > 0
		UPDATE ProdHeader
		SET Finalized   = 'Y', FinalizedOn = GETDATE(), FinalizedBy = @ai_UserCode
		WHERE 
			ProdCode Between @ai_sInvCode AND @ai_lInvCode AND
			Posted = 'N' AND
			Finalized = 'N'
RETURN 0
END

-- sp_FinalizeSaleOrder
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_FinalizeSaleOrder 
	@ai_socatcode INTEGER, 
	@ai_sInvCode integer, 
	@ai_lInvCode integer, 
	@ai_UserCode integer, 
	@ai_custcode integer, 
	@ai_OneOrAll INTEGER 
AS

DECLARE @OrderCode INT, @RowID INT, @TotRows INT, @rt_code INT
DECLARE @ai_list VARCHAR(8000)
CREATE TABLE #lt_invoicelist (Code INT NOT NULL, ROWID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1))

IF @ai_OneOrAll=0
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #lt_invoicelist 
	SELECT SaleOrderCode
	FROM SaleOrderHeader
	Where  	 
		SaleOrderHeader.SOCatCode = @ai_socatcode AND
		SaleOrderHeader.SaleOrderCode Between @ai_sInvCode AND @ai_lInvCode AND
		SaleOrderHeader.CustCode = @ai_custcode AND
		SaleOrderHeader.Posted = 'N' AND
		SaleOrderHeader.Finalized = 'N' AND
		SaleOrderHeader.Deleted = 'N'

	Update  SaleOrderHeader
	Set  SaleOrderHeader.Finalized   = 'Y'
	Where  	 
		SaleOrderHeader.SOCatCode = @ai_socatcode AND
		SaleOrderHeader.SaleOrderCode Between @ai_sInvCode AND @ai_lInvCode AND
		SaleOrderHeader.CustCode = @ai_custcode AND
		SaleOrderHeader.Posted = 'N' AND
		SaleOrderHeader.Finalized = 'N' AND
		SaleOrderHeader.Deleted = 'N'
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #lt_invoicelist 
	SELECT SaleOrderCode
	FROM SaleOrderHeader
	Where  	 
		SaleOrderHeader.SOCatCode = @ai_socatcode AND
		SaleOrderHeader.SaleOrderCode Between @ai_sInvCode AND @ai_lInvCode AND
		SaleOrderHeader.Posted = 'N'	AND
		SaleOrderHeader.Finalized = 'N' AND
		SaleOrderHeader.Deleted = 'N'

	Update  SaleOrderHeader
	Set  SaleOrderHeader.Finalized   = 'Y'
	Where  	 
		SaleOrderHeader.SOCatCode = @ai_socatcode AND
		SaleOrderHeader.SaleOrderCode Between @ai_sInvCode AND @ai_lInvCode AND
		SaleOrderHeader.Posted = 'N'	AND
		SaleOrderHeader.Finalized = 'N' AND
		SaleOrderHeader.Deleted = 'N'
END

SET @RowID = 1
SET @TotRows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #lt_invoicelist), 0)

WHILE @RowID <= @TotRows
BEGIN
	SET @OrderCode = (SELECT Code FROM #lt_invoicelist WHERE RowID = @RowID)
	SET @ai_list = @ai_list + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@OrderCode,10))) + ','
	SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
END

IF Right(@ai_list,1) = ','
	SET @ai_list = LEFT(@ai_list, LEN(@ai_list) - 1)

EXECUTE @rt_code = DBO.SP_CreateAutoTriggerSMS @ai_list, 12, 'Finalized'
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Unable to Create Auto Trigger SMS on Sale Posting' , 16 , 1)
	RETURN -1
END

RETURN 0

CREATE  PROCEDURE sp_FindAndReplaceItemInProformaSales
	@saleinvgroupcode int, 
	@finditem Int, 
	@findsaleprice NUMERIC(12,2), 
	@replaceitem Int, 
	@replacesaleprice NUMERIC(12,2)
AS

DECLARE @invcount INT, @RowID INT, @SaleInvCode INT
Create Table #saletemp ( SaleInvcode INT not null , RowID INT identity(1,1))

IF @finditem = @replaceitem
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #saletemp (SaleInvCode)
	SELECT DISTINCT GD.SaleInvCode
	FROM SaleInvGroupDetail GD, SaleLedger S, SaleDetail D
	WHERE GD.SaleInvGroupCode = @saleinvgroupcode AND
		GD.SaleInvcode = S.SaleInvCode AND
		S.Posted = 'N' AND
		S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND
		D.ICode = @finditem
END

INSERT INTO #saletemp (SaleInvCode)
SELECT DISTINCT GD.SaleInvCode
FROM SaleInvGroupDetail GD, SaleLedger S, SaleInvDetail D
WHERE GD.SaleInvGroupCode = @saleinvgroupcode AND
	GD.SaleInvcode = S.SaleInvCode AND
	S.Posted = 'N' AND
	S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND
	D.ICode = @finditem

SET @invcount = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(SaleInvCode) FROM #saletemp),0)
IF @invcount > 0
BEGIN
	IF @finditem = @replaceitem
	BEGIN
		UPDATE SaleDetail
		SET ICode = @replaceitem, SalePrice = ISNULL(@replacesaleprice, 0)
		FROM SaleInvGroupDetail GD, SaleLedger S, SaleDetail D
		WHERE GD.SaleInvGroupCode = @saleinvgroupcode AND
			GD.SaleInvcode = S.SaleInvCode AND
			S.Posted = 'N' AND
			S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND
			D.ICode = @finditem
	END

	UPDATE SaleInvDetail
	SET ICode = @replaceitem, SalePrice = ISNULL(@replacesaleprice, 0)
	FROM SaleInvGroupDetail GD, SaleLedger S, SaleInvDetail D
	WHERE GD.SaleInvGroupCode = @saleinvgroupcode AND
		GD.SaleInvcode = S.SaleInvCode AND
		S.Posted = 'N' AND
		S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND
		D.ICode = @finditem
	
	UPDATE Saleledger 
	SET InvTotal = dbo.fn_getSaleInvTotal (Saleledger.saleinvcode)
	Where saleinvcode IN (SELECT SaleInvCode FROM #saletemp)
END

Return 0

CREATE  PROCEDURE dbo.SP_FiscalizeSaleInvoice @SaleInvCode INT, @UserCode SMALLINT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @Url varchar(1024), @HttpMethod varchar(10), @ParamsValues varchar(8000), @SoapAction varchar(1024), @Response varchar(8000)
DECLARE @rt_code INT, @UseTestSvc CHAR(1), @FiscalInvCode VARCHAR(100)

IF ISNULL((SELECT MAX(Fiscalized) FROM SaleLedger WHERE SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode), 'N') = 'Y'
	RETURN 0

CREATE TABLE #ResonseTab (status varchar(50), statusText varchar(1024), response varchar(4000))

SET @UseTestSvc = ISNULL(DBO.Fn_GetPreference('UseFBRTestService'),'Y')
IF @UseTestSvc = 'Y'
BEGIN
	SET @Url = ISNULL(DBO.Fn_GetPreference('FBRTestServiceURL'), 'http://localhost:8524/api/IMSFiscal/Get')
	SET @HttpMethod = 'GET'
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SET @Url = ISNULL(DBO.Fn_GetPreference('FBRInvoiceServiceURL'), 'http://localhost:8524/api/IMSFiscal/GetInvoiceNumberByModel')
	SET @HttpMethod = 'POST'
END
SET @SoapAction = null
SET @ParamsValues = ''

EXECUTE @rt_code = DBO.SP_GetSaleInvoice_JSON @SaleInvCode, @ParamsValues OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Unable to Generate JSON String for Fiscalization of Sale Invoice %d' , 16 , 1, @SaleInvCode)
	RETURN -1
END

IF LEN(@Url) > 0 AND LEN(@ParamsValues) > 0 AND LEN(@HttpMethod) > 0
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #ResonseTab (status, statusText, response)	
	EXECUTE @rt_code = DBO.SP_RequestHttpWebService @Url, @HttpMethod, @ParamsValues, @SoapAction
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Unable to send web service request sucessfully for Fiscalization of Sale Invoice %d' , 16 , 1, @SaleInvCode)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @Response = (SELECT MAX(response) FROM #ResonseTab)
	PRINT @Response
	IF CHARINDEX('"Code":"100"', @Response, 1) > 0
	BEGIN
		IF CHARINDEX('{"InvoiceNumber":"', @Response, 1) > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @FiscalInvCode = ISNULL(SUBSTRING(@Response, 19, CHARINDEX('","Code":"100"', @Response, 1) - 19), '')

			PRINT @FiscalInvCode

			UPDATE SaleLedger SET Fiscalized = 'Y', FiscalizedOn = GETDATE(), FiscalInvoiceNo = ISNULL(@FiscalInvCode, '')
			WHERE SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Unable to Get Fiscal Invoice Code sucessfully for Sale Invoice %d' , 16 , 1, @SaleInvCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

RETURN 0

name: sp_fixutnbug
definition:
-- sp_fixutnbug

CREATE PROCEDURE sp_fixutnbug AS
DECLARE @utn BIGINT
DECLARE @nextutn BIGINT

DECLARE @TransType Varchar(20)
DECLARE @TransCode INT
DECLARE @date datetime
DECLARE @gcode smallint
DECLARE @icode int
DECLARE @batch varchar(10)
DECLARE @expiry datetime

SELECT @utn=utn from _utn

SELECT @nextutn=max(a)
FROM
(SELECT max(purutn) as a FROM purdetail UNION ALL
SELECT max(prutn) as a FROM prdetail UNION ALL
SELECT max(saleutn) as a FROM saledetail UNION ALL
SELECT max(srutn) as a FROM srdetail UNION ALL
SELECT max(issueutn) as a FROM issuedetail UNION ALL
SELECT max(receiptutn) as a FROM receiptdetail UNION ALL
SELECT max(adjutn) as a FROM adjdetail UNION ALL
SELECT max(glutn) as a FROM gldetail UNION ALL
SELECT max(transferutn) as a FROM Tdetail UNION ALL
SELECT max(duesatisfyutn) as a FROM duesatisfydetail) A
SELECT @nextutn=isnull(@nextutn, 0)+1
SELECT @nextutn

IF @utn IS NULL
BEGIN
/*	CREATE TABLE #tmp_table
	{TransType Varchar(2) NOT NULL,
	TransCode INT NOT NULL,
	Date DATETIME NOT NULL,
	gcode smallint NOT NULL,
	icode int NOT NULL,
	batch varchar(10) NOT NULL,
	expirydate datetime NOT NULL,
	rowid BIGINT identity (@nextutn, 1)
	}
*/
	DECLARE abc CURSOR FOR
	SELECT TransType='purdetail', TransCode=pl.PurInvCode, date=pl.postdate, pd.gcode, pd.icode, pd.batch, pd.expiry
	FROM PurLedger pl, purdetail pd
	WHERE pl.Posted='Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode and pd.purutn is null
	UNION ALL
	SELECT TransType='prdetail', TransCode=pl.PrInvCode, date=pl.date, pd.gcode, pd.icode, pd.batch, pd.expiry
	FROM PrLedger pl, PrDetail pd
	WHERE pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode and pd.prutn is null
	UNION ALL
	SELECT TransType='saledetail', TransCode=sl.SaleInvCode, date=sl.date, sd.gcode, sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry
	FROM SaleLedger sl, SaleDetail sd
	WHERE sl.SaleInvCode = sd.SaleInvCode and sd.saleutn is null
	UNION ALL
	SELECT TransType='srdetail', TransCode=sl.SrInvCode, date=sl.date, sd.gcode, sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry
	FROM SrLedger sl, SrDetail sd
	WHERE sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode and sd.srutn is null
	UNION ALL
	SELECT TransType='duesatisfydetail', TransCode=ds.DueSatisfyCode, date=ds.duesatisfydate, dd.gcode, dd.icode, dd.batch, dd.expiry
	FROM DueSatisfyHeader ds, DueSatisfyDetail dd
	WHERE ds.duesatisfycode = dd.DueSatisfyCode and dd.duesatisfyutn is null
	UNION ALL
	SELECT TransType='issuedetail', TransCode=ih.IssueInvCode, date=ih.date, id.gcode, id.icode, id.batch, id.expiry
	FROM IssueHeader ih, IssueDetail id 
	WHERE ih.IssueInvCode = id.IssueInvCode and id.Issueutn is null
	UNION ALL
	SELECT TransType='receiptdetail', TransCode=rh.ReceiptInvCode, date=postdate, rd.gcode, rd.icode, rd.batch, rd.expiry
	FROM ReceiptHeader rh , ReceiptDetail rd
	WHERE rh.Posted='Y' and rh.ReceiptInvCode = rd.ReceiptInvCode and rd.Receiptutn is null
	UNION ALL
	SELECT TransType='adjdetail', TransCode=ah.AdjCode, date=ah.date, ad.gcode, ad.icode, ad.batch, ad.expiry
	FROM AdjHeader ah, AdjDetail ad
	WHERE ah.adjCode = ad.adjCode and ad.adjutn is null
	UNION ALL
	SELECT TransType='tdetail', TransCode=ah.TransCode, date=ah.postdate, ah.dgcode, ad.icode, ad.batch, ad.expiry
	FROM THeader ah, TDetail ad
	WHERE ah.TransCode = ad.TransCode and ad.Transferutn is not null and posted='Y'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT TransType='gldetail', TransCode=gh.GlVochCode, date=gh.date, gcode=gd.glrowid, icode=gd.acccode, '', null
	FROM GlHeader gh, GlDetail gd
	WHERE gh.GlVochCode = gd.GlVochCode and gd.glutn is null
	ORDER BY Date, TransCode

	OPEN abc

	FETCH NEXT FROM abc INTO @TransType, @TransCode, @date, @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		IF @TransType= 'purdetail'
		BEGIN
			update purdetail
			set purutn=@nextutn
			where purinvcode=@TransCode and gcode=@gcode and
				icode=@icode and batch=@batch and expiry=@expiry
		END

		IF @TransType= 'prdetail'
		BEGIN
			update prdetail
			set prutn=@nextutn
			where prinvcode=@TransCode and gcode=@gcode and
				icode=@icode and batch=@batch and expiry=@expiry
		END

		IF @TransType= 'saledetail'
		BEGIN
			update saledetail
			set saleutn=@nextutn
			where saleinvcode=@TransCode and gcode=@gcode and
				icode=@icode and batch=@batch and expiry=@expiry
		END

		IF @TransType= 'srdetail'
		BEGIN
			update srdetail
			set srutn=@nextutn
			where srinvcode=@TransCode and gcode=@gcode and
				icode=@icode and batch=@batch and expiry=@expiry
		END

		IF @TransType= 'receiptdetail'
		BEGIN
			update receiptdetail
			set receiptutn=@nextutn
			where receiptinvcode=@TransCode and gcode=@gcode and
				icode=@icode and batch=@batch and expiry=@expiry
		END

		IF @TransType= 'issuedetail'
		BEGIN
			update issuedetail
			set issueutn=@nextutn
			where issueinvcode=@TransCode and gcode=@gcode and
				icode=@icode and batch=@batch and expiry=@expiry
		END

		IF @TransType= 'adjdetail'
		BEGIN
			update adjdetail
			set adjutn=@nextutn
			where adjcode=@TransCode and gcode=@gcode and
				icode=@icode and batch=@batch and expiry=@expiry
		END

		IF @TransType= 'duesatisfydetail'
		BEGIN
			update duesatisfydetail
			set duesatisfyutn=@nextutn
			where duesatisfycode=@TransCode and gcode=@gcode and
				icode=@icode and batch=@batch and expiry=@expiry
		END

		IF @TransType= 'tdetail'
		BEGIN
			update tdetail
			set transferutn=@nextutn
			where transcode=@TransCode and
				icode=@icode and batch=@batch and expiry=@expiry
		END

		IF @TransType= 'gldetail'
		BEGIN
			update gldetail
			set glutn=@nextutn
			where glvochcode=@TransCode and glrowid=@gcode and
				acccode=@icode
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM abc INTO @TransType, @TransCode, @date, @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry
		SELECT @nextutn = @nextutn + 1
	END
	CLOSE abc
	DEALLOCATE abc
	UPDATE _UTN SET utn=@nextutn+1
END

-- sp_Generate_BatchWiseSale_From_SaleOrder
CREATE  PROCEDURE sp_Generate_BatchWiseSale_From_SaleOrder
	@SaleOrderCode INT,
	@NewSaleInvCode INT OUTPUT
AS

Declare @module Int, @headerinvno Int, @continue Int, @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @totalrows Int, @rowcount Int, @counter Int
Declare @SaleInvCode Int, @HeaderInvCode INT
Declare @saleprice Numeric(12,2), @rate Numeric(12,2), @discperc Numeric(5,2), @itemflatdisc Numeric(15,2), @unitsalestax Numeric(12,2), @gstperc1 Numeric(6,2), @gstperc2 Numeric(6,2), @hold_avgprice Numeric(15,5)
Declare @icode Int, @gcode int, @packunits Int
Declare @totalstock NUMERIC(15, 4), @totalqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @looseQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @BonusQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @totalbatchqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @delqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @currqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @newqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @total_availablestock NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @batch VarChar(100), @itemname VarChar(60), @expiry DateTime, @serverdate DateTime
Declare @saleutn BigInt
DECLARE @Headerno INT
Declare @rowgroup Int, @innercounter Int
SET @Headerno = 1
Set @module = ( Select module from module where name = 'Sales' )
Set @serverdate = GETDATE()

Create Table #saletemp ( id int not null identity(1,1), icode Int , gcode smallint, batch varchar(100), expiry datetime, looseqty Int, bonusqty Int, SalePrice  Numeric(12,2), DiscPerc Numeric(8,2), ItemFlatDisc Numeric(12,2), UnitSalesTax Numeric(12,2), GstPerc Numeric(6,2) )
Insert Into #saletemp ( icode, gcode, batch, expiry, looseqty, bonusqty , saleprice, discperc, itemflatdisc, unitsalestax, gstperc )
Select icode, gcode, batch, expiry, looseqty, 0, saleprice, discperc, itemflatdisc, unitsalestax, gstperc
From SaleOrderDetail
Where SaleOrderCode = @SaleOrderCode AND (LooseQty + BonusQty) > 0
Order By rowid

Set @totalrows = ISNULL((Select count(*) from #SaleTemp), 0)
Set @continue = 0
Set @rowgroup = 0

IF @totalrows > 0 And @continue >= 0
Begin
	Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'Saleledger' , @SaleInvCode Output
	Set @rowgroup = 0
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	Begin
		Set @continue  = -1
	End

	SET @NewSaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode
	IF @continue >= 0
	Begin
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno , @module,  @headerinvno Output 
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
	END

	IF @continue >= 0
	Begin
		Set @Err = 0 
		Set @RowCount = 1

		Insert Into SaleLedger (SaleInvCode, SaleCatCode, CustCode, SalesmanCode, Date, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SalesTax, Posted, PostDate, 
			Remarks, CustRefNo, Headerno, headerinvno, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, SPrice, QuotationNo, DoctCode, PatientCode, 
			RePrintingCounter, CashReceived, InvGSTPerc1, PrintWaranty, PrintBatch, MessageCode, SManCode, InvoiceSize, CustRefno2, CustRefno3,
			CustRefno4, GSTNO, InvTotal, MachineName, ModifyCounter, ItemDiscPercNo, RelationCode, DiseaseCode, WardCode, AdmissionCode, 
			ReturnCounter, Paid, BillingDate, UnReceivedBalance, TotalOfSaleReturns, ListOfSrInvoices, printbalance, AccountFor, PaymentMode, 
			PaymentAccCode, Amt, AmtBY, AmtDate, AmtReference, OutstandingAmt, Marked, Transferable, Transfered, TransferedOn, TransferedBy, 
			Imported, ImportedBy, deliveredby, SaleTypeCode, Balance, PptCustCode, DELETED, PresCode, ImpactInventory, SaleOrderCode, 
			SaleComments1, SaleComments2, AlterSaleInvCode, RecurringInvoice, RecurringPeriod, LastRecurringInvCode, RecurringAgainst, ConsiderInPO, VisitCode, DueDate, SRBufferInvCode, CustRefNo5, 
			SuppInvCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo)
		SELECT @SaleInvCode, SaleCatCode=2, CustCode, UserCode, Date=GETDATE(), DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SalesTax=0, Posted='Y', PostDate=GETDATE(), 
			Remarks, CustRefNo, @HeaderNo, @HeaderInvCode, Date=GETDATE(), ModifiedBy, PostedBy, Sprice=1,  QuotationCode, DoctCode, PatientCode, 
			RePrintingCounter, CashReceived=0, InvGSTPerc1, Printwaranty='N', PrintBatch='N', MessageCode, SManCode, InvoiceSize, CustRefno2, CustRefno3, 
			CustRefno4, GSTNO, InvTotal, MachineName, ModifyCounter, ItemDiscPercNo, RelationCode, DiseaseCode, WardCode, AdmissionCode=NULL,
			ReturnCounter=0, Paid='N', BillingDate, UnreceivedBalance=InvTotal, TotalOfSaleReturns=0, '', 'Y', 'Y', PaymentMode='C', 
			PaymentAccCode=2, Amt=0, AmtBY=NULL, AmtDate=GETDATE(), AmtReference=NULL, OutStandingAmt = InvTotal, Marked='N', Transferable='N', Transfered='N', TransferedOn=NULL, TransferedBy=NULL, 
			Imported='N', ImportedBy=NULL, DeliveredBy=NULL, SaleTypeode=1, Balance=0, PptCustCode, Deleted='N', PresCode, ImpactInventory='Y', SaleOrderCode, 
			SaleComments1=(SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference('SaleComments1')), SaleComments2=(SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference('SaleComments2')), 
			AlterSaleInvCode=NULL, RecurringInvoice='N', RecurringPeriod=0, 
			LastRecurringInvCode=NULL, RecurringAgainst=NULL, ConsiderInPO='Y', VisitCode=NULL, DueDate=GETDATE(), SRBufferInvCode=NULL, CustRefNo5=NULL, 
			SuppInvCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo
		FROM SaleOrderHeader
		WHERE SaleOrderCode = @SaleOrderCode

		Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount

		IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
		Begin 
			RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Ledger : %d' ,16,1,  @SaleInvCode )
			Set @continue  = -1
		End 
		ELSE
		Begin
			Set @innercounter = 1
			While ( @innercounter <= @totalrows ) AND ( @continue >= 0 )
			Begin
				Select @icode = icode , @Gcode = Gcode, @Batch=Batch, @Expiry=Expiry, @looseqty = looseqty, @bonusqty = bonusqty, @saleprice = saleprice, @discperc = discperc,  @itemflatdisc = itemflatdisc, @unitsalestax = unitsalestax, @gstperc1 = gstperc
				From #saletemp
		        Where id = @innercounter

				Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
				SET @totalqty = @looseqty + @bonusqty
				IF @totalqty > 0 AND @RowCount > 0 AND @Err = 0
				Begin
					Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
					IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
					Begin
						Set @continue = -1
					End
					ELSE
					Begin
						set @total_availablestock = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.icode = @icode)
						IF @total_availablestock < 0 OR @total_availablestock IS NULL
							SET @total_availablestock=0
						Set @totalstock = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and godowndetail.icode = @icode  )
						Set @totalbatchqty = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and godowndetail.icode = @icode and godowndetail.Batch = @batch and godowndetail.Expiry = @expiry)
						IF @totalbatchqty >= @totalqty
						Begin 
							Set @newqty = @totalbatchqty - @totalqty
							IF @newqty > 0
								Execute @rt_code = sp_SaleUpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty , @totalbatchqty
							Else
								Execute @rt_code = sp_DeleteItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @totalqty
	
							IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
							Begin
								Set @continue  = -1								
							End
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								Set @rowgroup = @rowgroup + 1
								Select @rate = saleprice, @packunits = packunits
								From ITEM
								Where icode = @icode
			
								IF @packunits = 0 OR @packunits Is Null 
									Set @packunits = 1
		
								Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @saleutn Output
								IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
								Begin
									Set @continue  = -1															
								End
								ELSE
								BEGIN
									SET @total_availablestock = @total_availablestock - @looseqty - @bonusqty

									Insert Into SaleDetail (SaleInvCode, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, packqty, looseqty, bonusqty, packunits, saleprice, avgprice, rate, discperc, salestax, itemflatdisc, packprice, unitsalestax, gstperc, saleutn, balancestock, rowgroup)
									Values (@saleinvcode, @icode, @gcode, @batch, @expiry, 0, @looseqty, @bonusqty, @packunits, @saleprice, @hold_avgprice, @rate / @packunits, @discperc, 0, @itemflatdisc, @rate, @unitsalestax, @gstperc1, @saleutn, @total_availablestock, @rowgroup)
									Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
									IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
									Begin 
										RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Detail for Sale Inv. No. : %d' ,16,1, @SaleInvCode  )
										Set @continue  = -1
									End
								END
							END						END
						ELSE
						Begin
							Set @itemname = (Select name from item where icode = @icode )	
							RaisError( 'Not enough stock for item (%s) to decrease for Sale Inv. No : %d' , 16 , 1, @itemname, @SaleInvCode  )
							Set @continue  = -1								
						End
					END
				End
				Set @innercounter = @innercounter + 1
			End

			IF ( @continue >= 0 ) and @innercounter > @totalrows
			Begin
				Update Saleledger 
				Set InvTotal = ISNULL(dbo.fn_getSaleInvTotal (Saleledger.saleinvcode), 0)
				Where saleinvcode = @saleinvcode
			
				Select @Err = @@Error, @Rowcount = @@RowCount
				IF  @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0
				Begin
					RaisError( 'Unable to update Sale Inv. total for Sale Invoice %d' , @saleinvcode, 16 , 1 )
					Set @continue  = -1									
				End
			
				IF ( @continue >= 0 )
				BEGIN
					Update SaleOrderHeader 
					SET Posted = 'Y', POSTDATE=GETDATE(), Finalized='Y'
					WHERE SaleOrderCode = @SaleOrderCode
			
					Select @Err = @@Error, @Rowcount = @@RowCount
					IF  @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0
					BEGIN 
						RaisError( 'Unable to update Sale Order Status (Inv. No. %d)' , @saleordercode, 16 , 1 )
						Set @continue  = -1									
					END
				END
			
			End
		End
	End
End

Drop Table #saletemp

Return @continue
