-- sp_Generate_BillSummary_Vouchers
CREATE Procedure sp_Generate_BillSummary_Vouchers
	@BillSummCode1 INT, 
	@BillSummCode2 INT,
	@UserCode INT
As
DECLARE @AccCode SMALLINT, @Type SMALLINT, @VochCatCode SMALLINT
DECLARE @TotVoch INT, @BillSummaryCode Int, @SaleInvCode INT, @RowID INT
DECLARE @GLVochCode Int, @VoucherCode INT
Declare @MaxUtn BIGINT, @BillSummaryTypeCode SMALLINT, @Utn BIGINT
Declare @Counter Int, @RowCount Int, @TotalRows Int, @continue Int, @Err Int, @rt_code Int 
DECLARE @Amt NUMERIC(15,2), @SaleInvBalance NUMERIC(15,2), @NewBalance NUMERIC(15,2)

/*
Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Purpose:This Stored Procedure takes arguments :-
	@BillSummCode1 = Starting Bill Summary
	@BillSummCode2 = Ending Bill Summary
	@UserCode 		= User Initiating Posting
*/
Set @continue = 0

Declare Curs_Voch Cursor Forward_Only Static
FOR	
SELECT 
	DISTINCT B.BillSummaryCode, 
	B.BillSummaryTypeCode,
	AccCode=D.CashAccCode, 
	Type=1, 
	VochCatCode=CASE B.BillSummaryTypeCode WHEN 1 THEN 2 ELSE 12 END
FROM 
	BillSummary B, BillSummaryDetail D
WHERE
	B.BillSummaryCode BETWEEN @BillSummCode1 AND @BillSummCode2 AND
	B.Posted ='N' AND
	B.Finalized = 'Y' AND
	B.BillSummaryCode = D.BillSummaryCode AND
	D.CashAmt <> 0 AND
	D.CashAccCode IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	DISTINCT B.BillSummaryCode, 
	B.BillSummaryTypeCode,
	AccCode=D.BankAccCode, 
	Type=2, 
	VochCatCode=CASE B.BillSummaryTypeCode WHEN 1 THEN 4 ELSE 13 END
FROM 
	BillSummary B, BillSummaryDetail D
WHERE
	B.BillSummaryCode BETWEEN @BillSummCode1 AND @BillSummCode2 AND
	B.Posted ='N' AND
	B.Finalized = 'Y' AND
	B.BillSummaryCode = D.BillSummaryCode AND
	D.ChequeAmt <> 0 AND
	D.BankAccCode IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	DISTINCT B.BillSummaryCode, 
	B.BillSummaryTypeCode,
	AccCode=D.DebitNoteAccCode, 
	Type=3, 
	VochCatCode=CASE B.BillSummaryTypeCode WHEN 1 THEN 19 ELSE 21 END
FROM 
	BillSummary B, BillSummaryDetail D
WHERE
	B.BillSummaryCode BETWEEN @BillSummCode1 AND @BillSummCode2 AND
	B.Posted ='N' AND
	B.Finalized = 'Y' AND
	B.BillSummaryCode = D.BillSummaryCode AND
	D.DebitNoteAmt <> 0 AND
	D.DebitNoteAccCode IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	DISTINCT B.BillSummaryCode, 
	B.BillSummaryTypeCode,
	AccCode=D.CreditNoteAccCode, 
	Type=4, 
	VochCatCode=CASE B.BillSummaryTypeCode WHEN 1 THEN 20 ELSE 22 END
FROM 
	BillSummary B, BillSummaryDetail D
WHERE
	B.BillSummaryCode BETWEEN @BillSummCode1 AND @BillSummCode2 AND
	B.Posted ='N' AND
	B.Finalized = 'Y' AND
	B.BillSummaryCode = D.BillSummaryCode AND
	D.CreditNoteAmt <> 0 AND
	D.CreditNoteAccCode IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
	B.BillSummaryCode, Type, AccCode

OPEN Curs_Voch

SET @TotVoch = @@Cursor_Rows

IF @TotVoch <= 0 
BEGIN
	Close Curs_Voch
	Deallocate Curs_Voch
	RETURN 0
END

CREATE TABLE #VoucherDetail (
	BillSummaryCode INT, 
	BillSummaryTypeCode SMALLINT,
	HeaderAccCode SMALLINT,
	Type SMALLINT,
	CustCode SMALLINT, 
	AccBalance NUMERIC(15, 2),
	InvoiceCode INT, 
	OutstandingAmt NUMERIC(15, 2),
	Amount NUMERIC(15,2),
	BillSummOrder INT,
	Utn BIGINT, 
	RowID INT IDENTITY(1,1)
)

INSERT INTO #VoucherDetail (BillSummaryCode, BillSummaryTypeCode, HeaderAccCode, Type, CustCode, AccBalance, InvoiceCode, OutstandingAmt, Amount, BillSummOrder)
SELECT 
	B.BillSummaryCode, B.BillSummaryTypeCode, D.CashAccCode, 1, D.CustCode, D.AccBalance, D.SaleInvCode, D.OutstandingAmt, Amount=D.CashAmt, D.RowID
FROM 
	BillSummary B, BillSummaryDetail D
WHERE
	B.BillSummaryCode BETWEEN @BillSummCode1 AND @BillSummCode2 AND
	B.Posted ='N' AND
	B.Finalized = 'Y' AND
	B.BillSummaryCode = D.BillSummaryCode AND
	D.CashAmt <> 0 AND
	D.CashAccCode IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	B.BillSummaryCode, B.BillSummaryTypeCode, D.BankAccCode, 2, D.CustCode, D.AccBalance, D.SaleInvCode, D.OutstandingAmt, Amount=D.ChequeAmt, D.RowID
FROM 
	BillSummary B, BillSummaryDetail D
WHERE
	B.BillSummaryCode BETWEEN @BillSummCode1 AND @BillSummCode2 AND
	B.Posted ='N' AND
	B.Finalized = 'Y' AND
	B.BillSummaryCode = D.BillSummaryCode AND
	D.ChequeAmt <> 0 AND
	D.BankAccCode IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	B.BillSummaryCode, B.BillSummaryTypeCode, D.DebitNoteAccCode, 3, D.CustCode, D.AccBalance, D.SaleInvCode, D.OutstandingAmt, Amount=D.DebitNoteAmt, D.RowID
FROM 
	BillSummary B, BillSummaryDetail D
WHERE
	B.BillSummaryCode BETWEEN @BillSummCode1 AND @BillSummCode2 AND
	B.Posted ='N' AND
	B.Finalized = 'Y' AND
	B.BillSummaryCode = D.BillSummaryCode AND
	D.DebitNoteAmt <> 0 AND
	D.DebitNoteAccCode IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	B.BillSummaryCode, B.BillSummaryTypeCode, D.CreditNoteAccCode, 4, D.CustCode, D.AccBalance, D.SaleInvCode, D.OutstandingAmt, Amount=D.CreditNoteAmt, D.RowID
FROM 
	BillSummary B, BillSummaryDetail D
WHERE
	B.BillSummaryCode BETWEEN @BillSummCode1 AND @BillSummCode2 AND
	B.Posted ='N' AND
	B.Finalized = 'Y' AND
	B.BillSummaryCode = D.BillSummaryCode AND
	D.CreditNoteAmt <> 0 AND
	D.CreditNoteAccCode IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
	RowID

Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount

IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
Begin 
	RaisError( 'Error occured in making voucher details for BillSummary : %d' ,16,1,  @BillSummaryCode  )
	Close Curs_Voch
	Deallocate Curs_Voch
	DROP TABLE #VoucherDetail
	RETURN -1
End

EXECUTE @err = SP_MaxUtn @RowCount, @MaxUtn OUTPUT
IF @err <> 0 AND @@ERROR <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError( 'Error occured in generating utn for A/c Vouchers of BillSummary : %d' ,16,1,  @BillSummaryCode  )
	Close Curs_Voch
	Deallocate Curs_Voch
	DROP TABLE #VoucherDetail
	RETURN -1
END

UPDATE #VoucherDetail SET UTN= @MaxUtn - @RowCount + RowID

FETCH NEXT FROM Curs_Voch
INTO @BillSummaryCode, @BillSummaryTypeCode, @AccCode, @Type, @VochCatCode
WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
BEGIN
	EXECUTE @err = SP_GetTabMaxkey 'GLHeader', @GLVochCode Output
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('GL Voucher Code generation problem' ,16, 1)	
		Close Curs_Voch
		Deallocate Curs_Voch
		DROP TABLE #VoucherDetail
		RETURN -1
	END

	EXECUTE @err = SP_GetVoucherCode @vochcatcode, @VoucherCode Output
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Voucher Code Generation Problem' ,16, 1)
		Close Curs_Voch
		Deallocate Curs_Voch
		DROP TABLE #VoucherDetail
		RETURN -1
	END

	INSERT INTO GLHeader 
		(GLVochCode, VochCatCode, AccCode, Date, SalesmanCode, 
		Posted, PostDate, Remarks, 
		OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, 
		CHKNo, VoucherCode, SMANCode, TransferAble, Transfered, 
		TransferedOn, TransferedBy, Imported, 
		ImportedBy, BillSummaryCode)
	SELECT @GLVochCode, @VochCatCode, @AccCode, Date=Date, UserCode,
		Posted='Y', PostDate = GETDATE(), Remarks='System Generated Voucher - Bill Summary: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@BillSummaryCode))),
		OriginalDate=Date, ModifiedBy=NULL, PostedBy=@UserCode,
		ChkNo='', @VoucherCode, SMANCode=NULL, Transferable='N', Transferred='N', 
		TransferedOn=NULL, TransferedBy=NULL, Imported='N', 
		ImportedBy=NULL, @BillSummaryCode
	FROM
		BillSummary
	WHERE BillSummaryCode = @BillSummaryCode

	Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
	IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
	Begin 
		RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into GLHeader for BillSummary : %d' ,16,1,  @BillSummaryCode  )
		Close Curs_Voch
		Deallocate Curs_Voch
		DROP TABLE #VoucherDetail
		RETURN -1
	End

	INSERT INTO GLDetail (GLVochCode, AccCode, Debit, Credit, CHKNo, Remarks, GLUTN, PatientCode, InvoiceCode, OutStandingAmt, Balance)
	SELECT @GLVochCode, CustCode, 
		Debit = CASE @Type WHEN 3 THEN Amount ELSE 0.00 END,
		Credit = CASE @Type WHEN 3 THEN 0.00 ELSE Amount END,
		CHKNO = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(InvoiceCode, 10))), 
		Remarks = CASE @Type 
			WHEN 1 THEN 'Cash Receipt'
			WHEN 2 THEN 'Bank Receipt'
			WHEN 3 THEN 'Debit Note Issued'
			ELSE 'Credit Note Issued' END + ' - Bill Summary: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@BillSummaryCode))),
		UTN, PatientCode=NULL, InvoiceCode=InvoiceCode, OutStandingAmt=OutstandingAmt, BALANCE=AccBalance
	FROM
		#VoucherDetail
	WHERE 
		BillSummaryCode = @BillSummaryCode AND
		HeaderAccCode = @AccCode AND
		Type = @Type

	Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
	IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
	Begin
		RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into GLDetail for BillSummary : %d' ,16,1,  @BillSummaryCode  )
		DROP TABLE #VoucherDetail
		RETURN -1
	End

	INSERT INTO GLDetail
		(GLVochCode, AccCode, Debit, Credit, CHKNo, Remarks,
		GLUTN, PatientCode, InvoiceCode, OutStandingAmt, Balance)
	SELECT @GLVochCode, @AccCode, 
		Debit = SUM(CASE @Type WHEN 3 THEN 0.00 ELSE Amount END),
		Credit = SUM(CASE @Type WHEN 3 THEN Amount ELSE 0.00 END),
		CHKNO = NULL, 
		Remarks = CASE @Type 
			WHEN 1 THEN 'Cash Receipt'
			WHEN 2 THEN 'Bank Receipt'
			WHEN 3 THEN 'Debit Note Issued'
			ELSE 'Credit Note Issued' END + ' - Bill Summary : ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@BillSummaryCode))),
		MAX(UTN)+1, PatientCode=NULL, InvoiceCode=NULL, OutStandingAmt=0.00, BALANCE=DBO.fn_AccountBalance(GETDate(), @AccCode)
	FROM
		#VoucherDetail
	WHERE 
		BillSummaryCode = @BillSummaryCode AND
		HeaderAccCode = @AccCode AND
		Type = @Type
	GROUP BY
		BillSummaryCode, HeaderAccCode, Type

	Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
	IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
	Begin
		RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into GLDetail for BillSummary : %d' ,16,1,  @BillSummaryCode  )
		Close Curs_Voch
		Deallocate Curs_Voch
		DROP TABLE #VoucherDetail
		RETURN -1
	End

	Fetch Next From Curs_Voch
	Into @BillSummaryCode, @BillSummaryTypeCode, @AccCode, @Type, @VochCatCode
END
Close Curs_Voch
Deallocate Curs_Voch

SET @RowCount = (SELECT Count(*) FROM #VoucherDetail)
IF @RowCount <= 0
	RETURN 0

SET @RowID = 1

WHILE @RowID <= @RowCount
BEGIN
	SET @SaleInvCode = (SELECT InvoiceCode FROM #VoucherDetail WHERE RowID = @RowID)
	IF @SaleInvCode > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @Utn  = ISNULL((SELECT UTN FROM #VoucherDetail WHERE RowID = @RowID), 0)
		SET @Amt  = ISNULL((SELECT Amount FROM #VoucherDetail WHERE RowID = @RowID), 0)
		SET @Type = ISNULL((SELECT Type FROM #VoucherDetail WHERE RowID = @RowID), 0)
		SET @BillSummaryTypeCode = ISNULL((SELECT BillSummaryTypeCode FROM #VoucherDetail WHERE RowID = @RowID), 0)

		EXECUTE @err = SP_GetSaleInvBalance @SaleInvCode, @SaleInvBalance OUTPUT
		IF @err <> 0 AND @@ERROR <> 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError( 'Error occured in Fetching Balance of Sale Invoice: %d while posting of BillSummary : %d' ,16,1, @SaleInvCode, @BillSummaryCode )
			DROP TABLE #VoucherDetail
			RETURN -1
		END

		SET @SaleInvBalance = ISNULL(@SaleInvBalance, 0)

		UPDATE GLDetail SET OutStandingAmt = @SaleInvBalance WHERE GLUTN = @Utn

		IF @BillSummaryTypeCode = 2
		BEGIN
			IF @Type = 3
				SET @NewBalance = ISNULL(@SaleInvBalance,0) + ISNULL(@Amt, 0)
			ELSE
				SET @NewBalance = ISNULL(@SaleInvBalance,0) - ISNULL(@Amt, 0)
	
			IF @NewBalance < 0
			BEGIN
				RaisError( 'Error Occured while updation of Balance of Sale Invoice: %d while posting of BillSummary : %d' ,16,1, @SaleInvCode, @BillSummaryCode )
				DROP TABLE #VoucherDetail
				RETURN -1
			END
	
			EXECUTE @err = SP_UpdateSaleInvBalance @SaleInvCode, @NewBalance
			IF @err <> 0 AND @@ERROR <> 0
			BEGIN
				RaisError( 'Error occured in Fetching Balance of Sale Invoice: %d while posting of BillSummary : %d' ,16,1, @SaleInvCode, @BillSummaryCode )
				DROP TABLE #VoucherDetail
				RETURN -1
			END
		END
	END
	SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
END

DROP TABLE #VoucherDetail
RETURN 0

name: SP_Generate_Proforamsales_For_ServiceOrder
definition:
-- SP_Generate_Proforamsales_For_ServiceOrder
CREATE   PROCEDURE DBO.SP_Generate_Proforamsales_For_ServiceOrder
	@ServiceOCode INT, @UserCode SMALLINT, @SaleInvCode INT OUTPUT
AS 

DECLARE @errcode INT, @item_count INT

SET @item_count = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IssueDetail D, IssueHeader H WHERE H.ServiceOCode = @ServiceOCode AND H.IssueInvCode=D.IssueInvCode), 0)


IF @ServiceOCode <> 0 AND @item_count > 0
BEGIN
	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'SaleLedger' , @SaleInvCode OUTPUT
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Fetching SaleLedger Key Value', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	SET @SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode + 1

	INSERT INTO SaleLedger (SaleInvCode, SaleCatCode, CustCode, SalesManCode, 
		Date, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SalesTax, Posted, PostDate, 
		Remarks, CustRefNo, HeaderNo, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PatientCode, 
		PostedBy, SPrice, CashAccCode, CashTendered, CashCharged, CashBack, ImpactInventory)
	SELECT
		@SaleInvCode, SaleCatCode=2, CustCode, SalesManCode=@UserCode, 
		Date=GetDate(), DiscPerc=0, FlatDisc=0, MiscCharges=0, SalesTax=0, Posted='Y', PostDate=GETDATE(), 
		Remarks=Remarks, CustRefNo=Reference1, HeaderNo, OriginalDate=GETDATE(), ModifiedBy=Null, PatientCode, 
		PostedBy=@UserCode, Sprice=1, CashAccCode=2, CashTendered=0, CashCharged=0, CashBack=0, ImpactInventory='N'
	FROM	
		ServiceOHeader
	WHERE
		ServiceOCode = @ServiceOCode AND ServiceOHeader.Posted='N'

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in Sale Ledger', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	INSERT INTO SaleInvDetail (SaleInvCode, ICode, GCode, Batch, Expiry, Looseqty, 
		PackUnits, SalePrice, AvgPrice, Rate, DiscPerc, ItemFlatDisc, 
		SaleItemDescription, PackPrice, UnitSalesTax, 
		GSTPerc, SaleUtn, BonusQty, RowGroup, IssueRowID, Claimable, ClaimableDiscPerc)
	SELECT @SaleInvCode, D.ICode, D.GCode, D.Batch, D.Expiry, D.Qty, 
		I.PackUnits, D.SalePrice, D.AvgPrice, D.SalePrice, DiscPerc=0, ItemFlatDisc=0,
		D.ItemDescription, I.SalePrice, UnitSalesTax= ROUND(I.PackSalesTax / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits > 0 THEN I.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2), 
		I.GSTPerc1, SaleUtn=NULL, BonusQty=0, RowGroup=1, D.IssRowID, D.Claimable, D.ClaimableDiscPerc
	FROM IssueDetail D, IssueHeader H, Item I
	WHERE H.ServiceOCode = @ServiceOCode AND H.IssueInvCode=D.IssueInvCode AND D.ICode = I.ICode
	ORDER BY D.IssueInvCode, D.IssRowID

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in Sale Inv Detail', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction	
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'SaleLedger' , @SaleInvCode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Updating SaleLedger Key Value', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE SaleLedger
	SET InvTotal = ISNULL(T.InvTotal, 0)
	FROM SaleLedger, 
		(SELECT SL.SaleInvCode,
		InvTotal = ISNULL(Case when Round(Sum ( (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL.discperc /100) - flatdisc   +   misccharges), 2) IS NULL Then 0  Else Round(Sum ( (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -  SD.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL.discperc /100) ) - SL.flatdisc   +   SL.misccharges, 0) End +
		Round(Sum (Round ((SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty)*   SD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 -   SD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) *   SD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 )) +  
		(Case when (Round(Sum ( (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL.discperc /100) - flatdisc), 2)) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01 IS NULL Then 0  Else (Round(Sum ( (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL.discperc /100) ) - flatdisc ,2) ) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01 End ), 0), 0)
		FROM 
			SaleLedger SL, SaleInvDetail SD
		WHERE SL.SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode AND SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode
		GROUP BY SL.saleinvcode, SL.flatdisc, SL.misccharges, SL.discperc, SL.invgstperc1) T
	WHERE T.SaleInvCode=SaleLedger.SaleInvCode

	UPDATE SaleLedger 
	SET OutStandingAmt = ISNULL(InvTotal, 0)
	WHERE SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode

END
IF @@ERROR = 0 
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	RETURN -1
END

name: sp_Generate_Sale_From_PendingQuotations
definition:
-- sp_Generate_Sale_From_PendingQuotations
CREATE Procedure dbo.sp_Generate_Sale_From_PendingQuotations
	@machinename VARCHAR(30),
	@CustCode INT,
	@GCode SMALLINT,
	@UserCode SMALLINT,
	@startdate DateTime, 
	@enddate DateTime,
	@NewSaleInvCode INT OUTPUT
AS

SET NoCount On
Declare @headerno int, @module Int, @saletypecode SmallInt, @salecatcode Int, @headerinvno Int, @continue Int, @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @totalrows Int, @rowcount Int, @counter Int
Declare @SaleInvCode Int, @satisfiableqty Int, @satisfiedqty Int
Declare @saleprice Numeric(12,2), @rate Numeric(12,2), @discperc Numeric(5,2), @claimablediscperc Numeric(5,2), @itemflatdisc Numeric(12,2), @unitsalestax Numeric(12,2), @gstperc1 Numeric(6,2), @gstperc2 Numeric(6,2), @hold_avgprice Numeric(15,5)
Declare @icode Int, @packunits Int
Declare @totalqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @givenqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @reqqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @batchqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @delqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @currqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @newqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @total_availablestock NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @batch VarChar(100), @itemname VarChar(60), @expiry DateTime, @serverdate DateTime, @invoicesize CHAR(1)
Declare @saleutn BigInt, @salerows Int, @rowgroup Int, @lineitems_rowcount Int, @innercounter Int, @quotationcode int, @QuotPopulateSetting INT

SET @machinename = @@Servername
Set @salecatcode = 2
Set @saletypecode = 2
set @headerno=1
Set @module = ( Select module from module where name = 'Sales' )
Set @serverdate = getdate()
SET @QuotPopulateSetting = ISNULL((SELECT DBO.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('quotationpopulationsetting')), 1)
SET @invoicesize = ISNULL((SELECT DBO.Fn_GetPreference('creditsalepagesize')), 'F')

Create Table #saletemp (
	TID INT not null identity(1,1),
	quotationcode int, 
	icode Int, RowID INT, itemdescription VARCHAR(100), 
	packunits smallint, SalePrice  Numeric(12,2), 
	UnitSalesTax Numeric(12,2), GstPerc Numeric(6,2), 
	satisfiableqty Int, satisfiedqty Int, 
	satisfiablebonus Int, satisfiedbonus Int,  
	ItemFlatDisc Numeric(12,2), DiscPerc Numeric(6,2), claimablediscperc Numeric(6,2),
	stock numeric(15,4)
)

Insert Into #saletemp (quotationcode, icode, rowid, itemdescription, 
	packunits, saleprice, unitsalestax, GSTPerc, satisfiableqty,
	satisfiedqty, satisfiablebonus, satisfiedbonus, 
	itemflatdisc, discperc, claimablediscperc, stock)
SELECT
	T.quotationcode, T.icode, T.RowID, T.itemdescription,
	packunits=CASE WHEN @QuotPopulateSetting = 1 THEN T.packunits ELSE I.PackUnits END,
	SalePrice = 
		Round(
		CASE WHEN T.LoosePack=1 THEN 
			CASE WHEN @QuotPopulateSetting = 1 THEN 
				T.saleprice 
			ELSE 
				I.SalePrice / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits > 0 THEN I.PackUnits ELSE 1 END 
			END 
		ELSE 
			CASE WHEN @QuotPopulateSetting = 1 THEN 
				T.saleprice / CASE WHEN T.PackUnits > 0 THEN T.PackUnits ELSE 1 END 
			ELSE
				I.SalePrice / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits > 0 THEN I.PackUnits ELSE 1 END 
			END 
		END, 2),
	unitsalestax = CASE WHEN @QuotPopulateSetting = 1 THEN T.unitsalestax ELSE ROUND(I.Packsalestax  / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits > 0 THEN I.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2) END,
	GSTPerc = CASE WHEN @QuotPopulateSetting = 1 THEN T.GSTPerc ELSE I.GSTPerc1 END, 
	satisfiableqty= (CASE WHEN T.LoosePack=1 THEN T.qty ELSE T.qty * T.PackUnits END) - T.soldqty,
	satisfiedqty=0, 
	satisfiablebonus = (CASE WHEN T.LoosePack=1 THEN T.bonusqty ELSE T.bonusqty * T.PackUnits END) - T.soldbonus, 
	satisfiedbonus=0,
	itemflatdisc = CASE WHEN @QuotPopulateSetting = 1 THEN T.itemflatdisc ELSE I.flatdisc END,
	DiscPerc = CASE WHEN @QuotPopulateSetting = 1 THEN T.discperc ELSE I.salediscperc END,
	claimablediscperc = CASE WHEN @QuotPopulateSetting = 1 THEN T.claimablediscperc ELSE I.claimablediscperc END,
	stock = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(gd.Currqty) FROM godowndetail gd WHERE GCode=@GCode and gd.ICode=T.ICode),0)
FROM
	(SELECT DISTINCT ICode FROM godowndetail WHERE GCode=@GCode) GD, 
	Item I,
	(SELECT 
		QD.quotationcode,   
		QH.LoosePack,
		QH.CustCode,
		QD.icode,   
		itemflatdisc = QD.itemflatdisc,
		RowID=QD.IDENTITYCOL,
		QD.itemdescription,
		PackUnits = QD.packunits,
		SalePrice = QD.saleprice,
		QD.salestax,  
		QD.bonusqty,
		unitsalestax = QD.unitsalestax,
		GSTPerc = QD.GSTPErc,
		Qty = QD.Qty,
		DiscPerc = QD.discperc,
		claimablediscperc = QD.claimablediscperc,
		soldqty = 
		ISNULL((select looseqty=sum(sd.looseqty)
			from saledetail AS sd inner join saleledger sl on sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode
			where sd.quotationcode = qh.quotationcode and sd.icode=QD.icode
			group by sd.icode), 0),
		soldbonus = 
		ISNULL((select bonusqty=sum(sd.bonusqty)
			from saledetail AS sd inner join saleledger sl on sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode
			where sd.quotationcode = qh.quotationcode and sd.icode=QD.icode
			group by sd.icode), 0)
	FROM 
		QuotationHeader QH,
		QuotationDetail QD
	WHERE 
		QH.CustCode = @CustCode AND
		QH.OriginalDate BETWEEN @startdate AND @enddate AND
		QH.Active = 'Y' AND QH.Posted = 'Y' AND
		QH.quotationcode = QD.quotationcode) T
WHERE 
	(T.Qty > T.SoldQty OR T.BonusQty > T.SoldBonus) AND
	T.icode = GD.icode AND T.icode = I.icode
ORDER BY 
	Rowid

DELETE #SaleTemp WHERE Stock <= 0 AND (satisfiableqty <= 0 OR satisfiablebonus <= 0)

Set @salerows = (Select count(*) from #saletemp)
Set @continue = 0
Set @rowgroup = 0

IF @salerows > 0 And @continue >= 0
Begin
	Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'Saleledger' , @SaleInvCode Output
	Set @rowgroup = 0
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	Begin
		Set @continue  = -1
	End
	Else
	Begin
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno, @module, @headerinvno Output 
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
		Else
		Begin
			Set @Err = 0 
			Set @RowCount = 1

			Insert Into SaleLedger (SaleInvCode, SaleCatCode, CustCode, SPrice, SalesManCode, Date, Discperc, Flatdisc, MiscCharges, SalesTax, Posted, PostDate,  HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo, OriginalDate, InvTotal, MachineName, ModifyCounter, BillingDate, SaleTypeCode, InvoiceSize)
			Values (@SaleInvCode, @salecatcode, @custcode, 1, @usercode, @serverdate, 0, 0, 0, 0, 'N', @serverdate, @headerno, @headerinvno, @serverdate, 0 , @machinename, 0, @serverdate, @saletypecode, @invoicesize)

			Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
			IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
			Begin 
				RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Ledger : %d' ,16,1,  @SaleInvCode  )
				Set @continue  = -1
			End 
			Else
			Begin
				Set @innercounter = 1
				While @innercounter <= @salerows AND @continue >= 0
				Begin
					Select @icode = icode , @satisfiableqty = satisfiableqty, @satisfiedqty = satisfiedqty, @saleprice = saleprice, @discperc = discperc,  @itemflatdisc = itemflatdisc, @unitsalestax = unitsalestax, @gstperc1 = gstperc, @quotationcode = quotationcode, @claimablediscperc = claimablediscperc
					From #saletemp
				    Where Tid = @innercounter

					Select @RowCount = @@RowCount
					IF  ( @RowCount = 1 ) AND  ( (@satisfiableqty - @satisfiedqty) > 0 )
					Begin
						Set @givenqty = @satisfiableqty - @satisfiedqty
						set @total_availablestock = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.icode = @icode)
						IF @total_availablestock < 0 OR @total_availablestock IS NULL
							SET @total_availablestock=0
						Set @totalqty = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and godowndetail.icode = @icode  )
						IF @totalqty > 0 AND @total_availablestock > 0 AND @givenqty > 0
						BEGIN
							IF @givenqty > 0
								Update #saletemp Set satisfiedqty = @satisfiedqty + @givenqty Where icode = @icode AND Tid = @innercounter

							Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
							IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
							Begin
								Set @continue  = -1
							End
							Else
							Begin
								IF @totalqty >= @givenqty 
								Begin 
									Set @rowgroup = @rowgroup + 1
									Select @rate = saleprice, @packunits = packunits
									From ITEM
									Where icode = @icode
									IF @packunits = 0 OR @packunits Is Null 
										Set @packunits = 1
									Set @reqqty = @givenqty
									Declare ItemBatch_Cursor Cursor Static Forward_Only
									For 	Select  batch, expiry, Currqty 
									From    godowndetail 
									Where  godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and
											godowndetail.icode = @icode 
									Order by priority, expiry, Currqty
		
									Open ItemBatch_Cursor
									Set @totalrows = @@Cursor_Rows
									Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
									Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
									Set @counter = 1	
									While @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @counter <= @totalrows AND @reqqty > 0
									Begin
										Set @batchqty = @currqty
										IF @batchqty >= @ReqQty 
											Set @delqty = @reqqty
										Else
											Set @delqty = @batchqty
										Set @reqqty = @reqqty - @delqty
	
										Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @saleutn Output
										IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
										Begin
											Set @continue  = -1															
										End 									
										SET @total_availablestock = @total_availablestock - @delqty
	
										Insert Into SaleDetail (SaleInvCode, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, packqty, looseqty, packunits, saleprice, avgprice, rate, discperc, salestax, itemflatdisc, packprice, unitsalestax, gstperc, saleutn, balancestock, rowgroup, quotationcode, claimablediscperc)
										Values (@saleinvcode, @icode, @gcode, @batch, @expiry, 0, @delqty, @packunits, @saleprice, @hold_avgprice, @rate / @packunits, @discperc, 0, @itemflatdisc, @rate, @unitsalestax, @gstperc1, @saleutn, @total_availablestock, @rowgroup, @quotationcode, @claimablediscperc)
										Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
										IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
										Begin 
											RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Detail for Sale Inv. No. : %d' ,16,1, @SaleInvCode  )
											Set @continue  = -1
										End 							

										Else
										Begin
											Set @newqty = @currqty - @delqty
											IF @newqty > 0
												Execute @rt_code = sp_SaleUpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty , @currqty
											Else
												Execute @rt_code = sp_DeleteItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty
											IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
											Begin
												Set @continue  = -1								
											End
										End
										Set @counter = @counter + 1
										Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
										Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
									End
								Close ItemBatch_Cursor
								Deallocate ItemBatch_Cursor
								End
								Else
								IF @totalqty > 0 AND @totalqty < @givenqty 
								Begin 
									Set @rowgroup = @rowgroup + 1
									Select @rate = saleprice, @packunits = packunits
									From ITEM
									Where icode = @icode

									IF @packunits = 0 OR @packunits Is Null 
										Set @packunits = 1
								
									Set @reqqty = @totalqty
								
									Declare ItemBatch_Cursor Cursor Static Forward_Only
									For 	Select  batch, expiry, Currqty 
									From    godowndetail 
									Where  godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and
											godowndetail.icode = @icode 
									Order by priority, expiry, Currqty
		
									Open ItemBatch_Cursor
									Set @totalrows = @@Cursor_Rows
									Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
									Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
									Set @counter = 1	
									While @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @counter <= @totalrows AND @reqqty > 0
									Begin
										Set @batchqty = @currqty
										IF @batchqty >= @ReqQty 
											Set @delqty = @reqqty
										Else
											Set @delqty = @batchqty
										Set @reqqty = @reqqty - @delqty
	
										Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @saleutn Output
										IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
										Begin
											Set @continue  = -1															
										End 									
										SET @total_availablestock = @total_availablestock - @delqty
	
										Insert Into SaleDetail (SaleInvCode, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, packqty, looseqty, packunits, saleprice, avgprice, rate, discperc, salestax, itemflatdisc, packprice, unitsalestax, gstperc, saleutn, balancestock, rowgroup, quotationcode, claimablediscperc)
										Values (@saleinvcode, @icode, @gcode, @batch, @expiry, 0, @delqty, @packunits, @saleprice, @hold_avgprice, @rate / @packunits, @discperc, 0, @itemflatdisc, @rate, @unitsalestax, @gstperc1, @saleutn, @total_availablestock, @rowgroup, @quotationcode, @claimablediscperc)
										Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
										IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
										Begin 
											RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Detail for Sale Inv. No. : %d' ,16,1, @SaleInvCode  )
											Set @continue  = -1
										End 							
										Else
										Begin
											Set @newqty = @currqty - @delqty
											IF @newqty > 0
												Execute @rt_code = sp_SaleUpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty , @currqty
											Else
												Execute @rt_code = sp_DeleteItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty
											IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
											Begin
												Set @continue  = -1								
											End
										End
										Set @counter = @counter + 1
										Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
										Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
									End
								Close ItemBatch_Cursor
								Deallocate ItemBatch_Cursor
								End
								ELSE
								Begin
									Set @itemname = (Select name from item where icode = @icode )	
									RaisError( 'Not enough stock for item (%s) to decrease for Sale Inv. No : %d' , 16 , 1, @itemname, @SaleInvCode  )
									Set @continue  = -1								
								End
							End
						END
					End	
					Set @innercounter = @innercounter + 1
				End
			End
		End	
	End
End

Drop Table #saletemp

IF ( @continue >= 0 ) AND @SaleInvCode > 0
Begin
	Update Saleledger 
	Set InvTotal = dbo.fn_getSaleInvTotal (Saleledger.saleinvcode), OutstandingAmt = dbo.fn_getSaleInvTotal (Saleledger.saleinvcode)
	Where saleinvcode = @SaleInvCode

	Select @Err = @@Error, @Rowcount = @@RowCount
	IF  @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0
	Begin
		RaisError( 'Unable to update SaleInvoices for Sale Inv. total' , 16 , 1 )
		Set @continue  = -1									
	End
	SET @NewSaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode
End

Return @continue

name: SP_Generate_Svc_For_CustomerServiceTemplate
definition:
-- SP_Generate_Svc_For_CustomerServiceTemplate
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_Generate_Svc_For_CustomerServiceTemplate
	@Code INT, @UserCode SMALLINT
AS 
--Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
--@Code stands for CustomerServiceTemplateCode to be processed
DECLARE @errcode INT, @ServiceCode INT, @ServiceInvCode INT, @end_invcode INT, @Rows INT, @DetailRows INT, @NewRowID INT, @SinvCode INT, @EInvCode INT

SET @Rows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(CustomerServiceTemplateCode)
FROM CustomerServiceTemplate 
WHERE CustomerServiceTemplateCode = @Code AND Posted='Y' AND SvcInvGenerated='N'), 0)
IF @Rows = 0 OR @Rows IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError('Template Already Posted OR used, Please select another one.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @DetailRows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CustomerServiceTemplateDetail WHERE CustomerServiceTemplateCode = @Code), 0)
IF @DetailRows = 0 OR @DetailRows IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError('Template Has no rows for Customers, Please select another one.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @ServiceCode = (SELECT ServiceCode FROM CustomerServiceTemplate WHERE CustomerServiceTemplateCode = @Code AND Posted='Y' AND SvcInvGenerated='N')
IF @ServiceCode = 0 OR @ServiceCode IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError('Template Has no Service selected, Please select another one.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

CREATE TABLE #StudTemp (
	CustCode SMALLINT NOT NULL, 
	ServiceCode INT NOT NULL, 
	Qty NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,  
	Charges NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL, 
	DiscPerc NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL, 
	ServiceFlatDisc NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL, 
	NewRowID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
	RowID INT NOT NULL,
	Remarks VARCHAR(100) NULL,
	ServiceInvCode INT NULL)

INSERT INTO #StudTemp (CustCode, ServiceCode, Qty, Charges, DiscPerc, ServiceFlatDisc, Remarks, ServiceInvCode, RowID)
SELECT CustCode, @ServiceCode, Qty, Charges, DiscPerc, ServiceFlatDisc, Remarks, ServiceInvCode=NULL, RowID
FROM CustomerServiceTemplateDetail 
WHERE CustomerServiceTemplateCode = @Code
ORDER BY RowID

SET @DetailRows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #StudTemp), 0)
IF @ServiceCode <> 0 AND @DetailRows > 0
BEGIN
	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @ServiceInvCode OUTPUT
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Fetching ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE #StudTemp SET ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode + NewRowID

	INSERT INTO ServiceHeader (ServiceInvCode, CustCode, SalesManCode, ServiceCatCode,
		Remarks, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, Date, 
		PostedBy, PostDate, HeaderNo, DiscPerc, 
		FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SaleInvCode, Posted, ReprintingCounter,
		ServiceOCode, CashReceived, CashTendered, CashCharged, CashBack)
	SELECT
		D.ServiceInvCode, CustCode=C.CustCode, SalesManCode=@UserCode, SerivceCatCode=11,
		Remarks=D.Remarks, OriginalDate=GETDATE(), ModifiedBy=Null, Date=GetDate(),
		PostedBy=@UserCode, PostDate=GETDATE(), HeaderNo=1, DiscPerc=0, 
		FlatDisc=0, MiscCharges=0, SaleInvCode=NULL, Posted='Y', ReprintingCounter=0,
		ServiceOCode=Null, CashReceived=0, CashTendered=0, CashCharged=0, CashBack=0
	FROM	
		#StudTemp D, Customer C
	WHERE
		C.CustCode = D.CustCode
	
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceHeader', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	
	INSERT INTO ServiceDetail (ServiceInvCode, ServiceCode, SManCode, Qty, Price, ServiceFlatDisc, DiscPerc, Remarks)
	SELECT ServiceInvCode, @ServiceCode, SManCode=1, Qty, SalePrice=Charges, ServiceFlatDisc, DiscPerc, Remarks
	FROM #StudTemp
	
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceDetail', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	
	UPDATE CustomerServiceTemplateDetail
	SET ServiceInvCode = T.ServiceInvCode
	FROM #StudTemp T, CustomerServiceTemplateDetail D
	WHERE T.RowID = D.RowID
	
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Updating Customer Service Template Record', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @SinvCode = ISNULL((SELECT MIN(ServiceInvCode) FROM #StudTemp), 0)
	SET @EInvCode = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(ServiceInvCode) FROM #StudTemp), 0)

	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @EInvCode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Updating ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE ServiceHeader 
	SET InvTotal = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(ServiceInvCode), 0)
	WHERE ServiceInvCode BETWEEN @SinvCode AND @EInvCode
	
	UPDATE ServiceHeader 
	SET OutStandingAmt = InvTotal
	WHERE ServiceInvCode BETWEEN @SinvCode AND @EInvCode

	UPDATE CustomerServiceTemplate SET SvcInvGenerated='Y' WHERE CustomerServiceTemplateCode = @Code
END
IF @@ERROR = 0 
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	RETURN -1
END

-- SP_Generate_Svc_For_CustomerStudentServiceTemplate
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_Generate_Svc_For_CustomerStudentServiceTemplate
	@Code INT, @UserCode SMALLINT
AS 
--Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
--@Code stands for StudentServiceTemplateCode to be processed
DECLARE @errcode INT, @ServiceCode INT, @ServiceInvCode INT, @end_invcode INT, @Rows INT, @DetailRows INT, @NewRowID INT, @SinvCode INT, @EInvCode INT, @CustCode INT

SET @Rows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(CustomerStudentServiceTemplateCode)
FROM CustomerStudentServiceTemplate 
WHERE CustomerStudentServiceTemplateCode = @Code AND Posted='Y' AND SvcInvGenerated='N'), 0)
IF @Rows = 0 OR @Rows IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError('Template Already Posted OR used, Please select another one.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @DetailRows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CustomerStudentServiceTemplateDetail WHERE CustomerStudentServiceTemplateCode = @Code), 0)
IF @DetailRows = 0 OR @DetailRows IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError('Template Has no rows for students, Please select another one.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @ServiceCode = (SELECT ServiceCode FROM CustomerStudentServiceTemplate WHERE CustomerStudentServiceTemplateCode = @Code AND Posted='Y' AND SvcInvGenerated='N')
IF @ServiceCode = 0 OR @ServiceCode IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError('Template Has no Service selected, Please select another one.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @CustCode = (SELECT CustCode FROM CustomerStudentServiceTemplate WHERE CustomerStudentServiceTemplateCode = @Code AND Posted='Y' AND SvcInvGenerated='N')
IF @CustCode = 0 OR @CustCode IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError('Template Has no Customer selected, Please select another one.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

CREATE TABLE #StudTemp (
	StudentCode INT NOT NULL, 
	ServiceCode INT NOT NULL, 
	Qty NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,  
	Charges NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL, 
	DiscPerc NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL, 
	ServiceFlatDisc NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL, 
	RowID INT NOT NULL,
	Remarks VARCHAR(100) NULL)

INSERT INTO #StudTemp (StudentCode, ServiceCode, Qty, Charges, DiscPerc, ServiceFlatDisc, RowID, Remarks)
SELECT D.StudentCode, @ServiceCode, D.Qty, D.Charges, D.DiscPerc, D.ServiceFlatDisc, D.RowID, 
	Remarks=ISNULL((SELECT S.Name + ' (' + S.RegNo + ')' FROM Student S WHERE S.StudentCode = D.StudentCode), D.Remarks)
FROM CustomerStudentServiceTemplateDetail D
WHERE D.CustomerStudentServiceTemplateCode = @Code
ORDER BY D.RowID

SET @DetailRows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #StudTemp), 0)

IF @ServiceCode <= 0 AND @DetailRows <= 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Please Try Again', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @errcode = 0
EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @ServiceInvCode OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Fetching ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END
SET @ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode + 1

INSERT INTO ServiceHeader (ServiceInvCode, CustCode, SalesManCode, ServiceCatCode,
	Remarks, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, Date, 
	PostedBy, PostDate, HeaderNo, DiscPerc, 
	FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SaleInvCode, Posted, ReprintingCounter,
	ServiceOCode, CashReceived, CashTendered, CashCharged, CashBack, 
	StudentCode)
SELECT
	@ServiceInvCode, CustCode=@CustCode, SalesManCode=@UserCode, SerivceCatCode=11,
	Remarks='Student Fee Contribution', OriginalDate=GETDATE(), ModifiedBy=Null, Date=GetDate(),
	PostedBy=@UserCode, PostDate=GETDATE(), HeaderNo=1, DiscPerc=0, 
	FlatDisc=0, MiscCharges=0, SaleInvCode=NULL, Posted='Y', ReprintingCounter=0,
	ServiceOCode=Null, CashReceived=0, CashTendered=0, CashCharged=0, CashBack=0,
	StudentCode=NULL

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@Rowcount = 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem Inserting Row into ServiceHeader Table', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END
	
INSERT INTO ServiceDetail (ServiceInvCode, ServiceCode, SManCode, Qty, Price, ServiceFlatDisc, DiscPerc, Remarks)
SELECT @ServiceInvCode, @ServiceCode, SManCode=1, Qty, SalePrice=Charges, ServiceFlatDisc, DiscPerc, Remarks
FROM #StudTemp
ORDER BY RowID
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceDetail', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

UPDATE CustomerStudentServiceTemplateDetail
SET ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in Updating Student Service Template Record', 16, 1)
	Rollback Transaction
	RETURN -1
END

SET @errcode = 0
EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @ServiceInvCode
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Updating ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
	Rollback Transaction
	RETURN -1
END

UPDATE ServiceHeader 
SET InvTotal = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(ServiceInvCode), 0)
WHERE ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode

UPDATE ServiceHeader 
SET OutStandingAmt = InvTotal
WHERE ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode

UPDATE CustomerStudentServiceTemplate SET SvcInvGenerated='Y' WHERE CustomerStudentServiceTemplateCode = @Code

IF @@ERROR = 0 
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	RETURN -1
END

CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_Generate_Svc_For_ServiceOrder
	@ServiceOCode INT, @UserCode SMALLINT, @ServiceInvCode INT OUTPUT
AS 

DECLARE @errcode INT, @end_invcode INT, @svc_count INT

SET @svc_count = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ServiceODetail WHERE ServiceOCode = @ServiceOCode), 0)

IF @ServiceOCode <> 0 AND @svc_count > 0
BEGIN
	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @ServiceInvCode OUTPUT
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Fetching ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	SET @ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode + 1

	INSERT INTO ServiceHeader (ServiceInvCode, CustCode, SalesManCode, ServiceCatCode,
		Remarks, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, Date,
		PostedBy, PostDate, HeaderNo, DiscPerc, Ref1, Ref2, 
		FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SaleInvCode, Posted, ReprintingCounter,
		ServiceOCode, CashReceived, CashTendered, CashCharged, CashBack, PatientCode,
		StudentCode, FullPatientName, PatientAge, PatientSex, PatientRefBy, ServiceInvTypeCode, MessageCode, ServiceInvGSTPerc)
	SELECT
		@ServiceInvCode, CustCode=CustCode, SalesManCode=@UserCode, SerivceCatCode=11,
		Remarks=Remarks, OriginalDate=GETDATE(), ModifiedBy=Null, Date=GetDate(),
		PostedBy=@UserCode, PostDate=GETDATE(), HeaderNo=1, DiscPerc, LEFT(Reference1,60), LEFT(Reference2,60), 
		FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SaleInvCode=SaleInvCode, Posted='N', ReprintingCounter=0,
		ServiceOCode=@ServiceOCode, CashReceived=0, CashTendered=0, CashCharged=0, CashBack=0, PatientCode,
		StudentCode=NULL, FullPatientName, PatientAge, PatientSex, PatientRefBy, ServiceInvTypeCode, MessageCode, ServiceInvGSTPerc
	FROM	
		ServiceOHeader
	WHERE
		ServiceOCode = @ServiceOCode AND ServiceOHeader.Posted='N'

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceHeader', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	INSERT INTO ServiceDetail (ServiceInvCode, ServiceCode, SManCode, Qty, Price, ServiceFlatDisc, DiscPerc, Remarks, ServiceFlatTax, ServiceGSTPerc)
	SELECT @ServiceInvCode, ServiceCode, SManCode, Qty, Price, ServiceFlatDisc, DiscPerc, Remarks=NULL, ServiceFlatTax, ServiceGSTPerc
	FROM ServiceODetail 
	WHERE ServiceOCode = @ServiceOCode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceDetail', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction	
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @ServiceInvCode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Updating ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE ServiceHeader 
	SET InvTotal = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(ServiceInvCode), 0)
	WHERE ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode

	UPDATE ServiceHeader 
	SET OutStandingAmt = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(ServiceInvCode), 0)
	WHERE ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode

	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_PostService_CustWise @ServiceInvCode, @ServiceInvCode, 11, @UserCode, NULL, 1
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Posting Service Invoice %d', 16, 1, @ServiceInvCode)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END
END
IF @@ERROR = 0 
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	RETURN -1
END

AS 

DECLARE @errcode INT, @end_invcode INT, @FeeDay INT, @Today INT, @DueDate DATETIME

SET @FeeDay = ISNULL((SELECT Class.FeeDueOn FROM Class WHERE Class.ClassCode = @ClassCode), 1)
SET @Today = (SELECT DAY(GETDATE()))
IF @Today >= @FeeDay 
BEGIN
	IF MONTH(GETDATE()) < 12
		SET @DueDate = CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(GETDATE()), 7))) + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(GETDATE()) + 1, 7))) + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@FeeDay, 7))) AS DateTime)
	ELSE
		SET @DueDate = CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(GETDATE()) + 1, 7))) + '-' + '01' + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@FeeDay, 7))) AS DateTime)
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SET @DueDate = CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(GETDATE()), 7))) + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(GETDATE()), 7))) + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@FeeDay, 7))) AS DateTime)
END

SET @DueDate = ISNULL(@DueDate,GETDATE())

IF @ServiceCode <> 0 AND @StudentCode <> 0
BEGIN
	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @ServiceInvCode OUTPUT
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Fetching ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	SET @ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode + 1

	INSERT INTO ServiceHeader (ServiceInvCode, CustCode, SalesManCode, ServiceCatCode,
		Remarks, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, Date, 
		PostedBy, PostDate, HeaderNo, DiscPerc, 
		FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SaleInvCode, Posted, ReprintingCounter,
		ServiceOCode, CashReceived, CashTendered, CashCharged, CashBack, 
		StudentCode, DueDate)
	SELECT
		@ServiceInvCode, CustCode=S.CustCode, SalesManCode=@UserCode, SerivceCatCode=11,
		Remarks=@Remarks, OriginalDate=GETDATE(), ModifiedBy=Null, Date=GetDate(),
		PostedBy=@UserCode, PostDate=GETDATE(), HeaderNo=1, DiscPerc=0, 
		FlatDisc=0, MiscCharges=0, SaleInvCode=NULL, Posted='Y', ReprintingCounter=0,
		ServiceOCode=Null, CashReceived=0, CashTendered=0, CashCharged=0, CashBack=0,
		StudentCode=S.StudentCode, 
		DueDate = @DueDate
	FROM	
		Student S
	WHERE
		S.StudentCode = @StudentCode

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceHeader', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	INSERT INTO ServiceDetail (ServiceInvCode, ServiceCode, SManCode, Qty, Price, ServiceFlatDisc, DiscPerc, Remarks)
	SELECT @ServiceInvCode, @ServiceCode, SManCode=1, Qty=1, SalePrice=@Fee, ServiceFlatDisc=CASE WHEN ROUND((@Fee - @FlatDisc) * (1 - @DiscPerc * 0.01),2) > 0 THEN @FlatDisc ELSE @Fee END, DiscPerc=@DiscPerc, @Remarks

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceDetail', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction	
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE StudentClass
	SET LastServiceInvDate = GETDATE(), ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode
	FROM StudentClass 
	WHERE ClassCode = @ClassCode AND StudentCode = @StudentCode

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Updating Student Fee Record', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @ServiceInvCode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Updating ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE ServiceHeader 
	SET InvTotal = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(ServiceInvCode), 0)
	WHERE ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode

	UPDATE ServiceHeader 
	SET OutStandingAmt = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(ServiceInvCode), 0)
	WHERE ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode

END
IF @@ERROR = 0 
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	RETURN -1
END

		RETURN -1
	END

	INSERT INTO ServiceDetail (ServiceInvCode, ServiceCode, SManCode, Qty, Price, ServiceFlatDisc, DiscPerc, Remarks)
	SELECT @ServiceInvCode, @ServiceCode, SManCode=1, Qty=1, SalePrice=@Fee, ServiceFlatDisc=CASE WHEN ROUND((@Fee - @FlatDisc) * (1 - @DiscPerc * 0.01),2) > 0 THEN @FlatDisc ELSE @Fee END, DiscPerc=@DiscPerc, @Remarks
	UNION ALL
	SELECT @ServiceInvCode, ServiceCode, SManCode, Qty, SalePrice, ServiceFlatDisc, DiscPerc, Remarks=NULL
	FROM ServiceTemplateDetail
	WHERE @ServiceTemplate > 0 AND ServiceTemplateCode = @ServiceTemplate

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceDetail', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction	
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE StudentClass
	SET LastServiceInvDate = GETDATE(), ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode
	FROM StudentClass 
	WHERE ClassCode = @ClassCode AND StudentCode = @StudentCode

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Updating Student Fee Record', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @ServiceInvCode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Updating ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE ServiceHeader 
	SET InvTotal = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(ServiceInvCode), 0)
	WHERE ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode

	UPDATE ServiceHeader 
	SET OutStandingAmt = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(ServiceInvCode), 0)
	WHERE ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode

END
IF @@ERROR = 0 
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	RETURN -1
END

-- SP_Generate_Svc_For_StudentServiceTemplate
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_Generate_Svc_For_StudentServiceTemplate
	@Code INT, @UserCode SMALLINT
AS 
--Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
--@Code stands for StudentServiceTemplateCode to be processed
DECLARE @errcode INT, @ServiceCode INT, @ServiceInvCode INT, @end_invcode INT, @Rows INT, @DetailRows INT, @NewRowID INT, @SinvCode INT, @EInvCode INT

SET @Rows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(StudentServiceTemplateCode)
FROM StudentServiceTemplate 
WHERE StudentServiceTemplateCode = @Code AND Posted='Y' AND SvcInvGenerated='N'), 0)
IF @Rows = 0 OR @Rows IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError('Template Already Posted OR used, Please select another one.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @DetailRows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM StudentServiceTemplateDetail WHERE StudentServiceTemplateCode = @Code), 0)
IF @DetailRows = 0 OR @DetailRows IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError('Template Has no rows for students, Please select another one.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @ServiceCode = (SELECT ServiceCode FROM StudentServiceTemplate WHERE StudentServiceTemplateCode = @Code AND Posted='Y' AND SvcInvGenerated='N')
IF @ServiceCode = 0 OR @ServiceCode IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError('Template Has no Service selected, Please select another one.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

CREATE TABLE #StudTemp (
	StudentCode INT NOT NULL, 
	ServiceCode INT NOT NULL, 
	Qty NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,  
	TransportRouteCode INT NULL,
	VehicleCode INT NULL,
	Charges NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL, 
	DiscPerc NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL, 
	ServiceFlatDisc NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL, 
	NewRowID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
	RowID INT NOT NULL,
	Remarks VARCHAR(100) NULL,
	ServiceInvCode INT NULL)

INSERT INTO #StudTemp (StudentCode, ServiceCode, Qty, TransportRouteCode, VehicleCode, Charges, DiscPerc, ServiceFlatDisc, Remarks, ServiceInvCode, RowID)
SELECT StudentCode, @ServiceCode, Qty, TransportRouteCode, VehicleCode, Charges, DiscPerc, ServiceFlatDisc, Remarks, ServiceInvCode=NULL, RowID
FROM StudentServiceTemplateDetail 
WHERE StudentServiceTemplateCode = @Code
ORDER BY RowID

SET @DetailRows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #StudTemp), 0)
IF @ServiceCode <> 0 AND @DetailRows > 0
BEGIN
	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @ServiceInvCode OUTPUT
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Fetching ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE #StudTemp SET ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode + NewRowID

	INSERT INTO ServiceHeader (ServiceInvCode, CustCode, SalesManCode, ServiceCatCode,
		Remarks, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, Date, 
		PostedBy, PostDate, HeaderNo, DiscPerc, 
		FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SaleInvCode, Posted, ReprintingCounter,
		ServiceOCode, CashReceived, CashTendered, CashCharged, CashBack, 
		StudentCode)
	SELECT
		D.ServiceInvCode, CustCode=S.CustCode, SalesManCode=@UserCode, SerivceCatCode=11,
		Remarks=D.Remarks, OriginalDate=GETDATE(), ModifiedBy=Null, Date=GetDate(),
		PostedBy=@UserCode, PostDate=GETDATE(), HeaderNo=1, DiscPerc=0, 
		FlatDisc=0, MiscCharges=0, SaleInvCode=NULL, Posted='Y', ReprintingCounter=0,
		ServiceOCode=Null, CashReceived=0, CashTendered=0, CashCharged=0, CashBack=0,
		StudentCode=S.StudentCode
	FROM	
		#StudTemp D, Student S
	WHERE
		S.StudentCode = D.StudentCode
	
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceHeader', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	
	INSERT INTO ServiceDetail (ServiceInvCode, ServiceCode, SManCode, Qty, Price, ServiceFlatDisc, DiscPerc, Remarks, TransportRouteCode, VehicleCode)
	SELECT ServiceInvCode, @ServiceCode, SManCode=1, Qty, SalePrice=Charges, ServiceFlatDisc, DiscPerc, Remarks, TransportRouteCode, VehicleCode
	FROM #StudTemp
	
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceDetail', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	
	UPDATE StudentServiceTemplateDetail
	SET ServiceInvCode = T.ServiceInvCode
	FROM #StudTemp T, StudentServiceTemplateDetail D
	WHERE T.RowID = D.RowID
	
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Updating Student Service Template Record', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @SinvCode = ISNULL((SELECT MIN(ServiceInvCode) FROM #StudTemp), 0)
	SET @EInvCode = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(ServiceInvCode) FROM #StudTemp), 0)

	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @EInvCode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Updating ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE ServiceHeader 
	SET InvTotal = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(ServiceInvCode), 0)
	WHERE ServiceInvCode BETWEEN @SinvCode AND @EInvCode
	
	UPDATE ServiceHeader 
	SET OutStandingAmt = InvTotal
	WHERE ServiceInvCode BETWEEN @SinvCode AND @EInvCode

	UPDATE StudentServiceTemplate SET SvcInvGenerated='Y' WHERE StudentServiceTemplateCode = @Code
END
IF @@ERROR = 0 
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	RETURN -1
END

-- SP_Generate_Svc_From_AdmPatientRecSvc
CREATE   PROCEDURE DBO.SP_Generate_Svc_From_AdmPatientRecSvc AS 

DECLARE @tot_admitted_patients INT, @start_invcode INT, @end_invcode INT, @errcode INT
DECLARE @service_table TABLE 
	(AdmissionCode INT NOT NULL, ServiceInvCode INT NULL, Rowid INT IDENTITY(1, 1))

BEGIN TRANSACTION

SET @tot_admitted_patients = 
	ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(PA.AdmissionCode)
			FROM PatientAdmission PA WITH (HOLDLOCK, ROWLOCK), AdmittedPatientRecurringServices APR
			WHERE PA.Discharged1  ='N' AND PA.Discharged  ='N' AND 
				PA.AdmissionCode = APR.AdmissionCode AND
				GETDATE() >= ISNULL(APR.StartDate, '12-12-9999 00:00:00') AND
				GETDATE() >= ISNULL(APR.NextRunOn, '12-12-1900 00:00:00')), 0)

IF @tot_admitted_patients <> 0
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO @service_table (AdmissionCode, ServiceInvCode)
	SELECT PA.AdmissionCode, NULL
	FROM PatientAdmission PA
	WHERE 	PA.Discharged1='N' AND PA.Discharged='N' AND 
		PA.AdmissionCode IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT AdmittedPatientRecurringServices.AdmissionCode 
			FROM AdmittedPatientRecurringServices
			WHERE GETDATE() >= ISNULL(AdmittedPatientRecurringServices.StartDate, '12-12-9999 00:00:00') AND
				GETDATE() >= ISNULL(AdmittedPatientRecurringServices.NextRunOn, '12-12-1900 00:00:00'))
	ORDER BY PA.AdmissionCode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Fetching Admitted Patient Recurring Services', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @start_invcode OUTPUT
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Fetching ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE @service_table
	SET ServiceInvCode = @start_invcode + RowID
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in Temporary Table', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	INSERT INTO ServiceHeader (ServiceInvCode, CustCode, SalesManCode, ServiceCatCode,
		Remarks, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, Date, PostedBy, PostDate, HeaderNo, 
		DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SaleInvCode, Posted, DoctCode, ReprintingCounter,
		ServiceOCode, CashReceived, PatientCode, AdmissionCode)
	SELECT
		T.ServiceInvCode, CustCode=P.CustCode, SalesManCode=1, SerivceCatCode=11,
		Remarks='Recurring Services', OriginalDate=GETDATE(), ModifiedBy=Null, Date=GetDate(),
		PostedBy=1, PostDate=GETDATE(), HeaderNo=1, DiscPerc=0, FlatDisc=0, MiscCharges=0,
		SaleInvCode=NULL, Posted='Y', DoctCode=PA.DoctorCode, ReprintingCounter=0,
		ServiceOCode=Null, CashReceived=0, PatientCode=Null, PA.AdmissionCode
	FROM	
		PatientAdmission PA, Patient P, (SELECT ServiceInvCode, AdmissionCode FROM @service_table) T
	WHERE
		PA.AdmissionCode = T.AdmissionCode AND PA.PatientCode = P.PatientCode
	ORDER BY T.AdmissionCode

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceHeader', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	INSERT INTO ServiceDetail (ServiceInvCode, ServiceCode, SManCode, Qty, Price, DiscPerc)
	SELECT T.ServiceInvCode, APR.ServiceCode, APR.SManCode, APR.Qty, APR.SalePrice, APR.DiscPerc
	FROM (SELECT ServiceInvCode, AdmissionCode FROM @service_table) T, AdmittedPatientRecurringServices APR
	WHERE T.AdmissionCode = APR.AdmissionCode AND
		GETDATE() >= ISNULL(APR.StartDate, '12-12-9999 00:00:00') AND
		GETDATE() >= ISNULL(APR.NextRunOn, '12-12-1900 00:00:00')
	ORDER BY APR.AdmissionCode, APR.RowID	

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceDetail', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction	
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE PatientAdmission 
	SET PatientAdmission.RecurringServicesChargedOn = GETDATE(), 
		PatientAdmission.ServiceInvCode = T.ServiceInvCode
	FROM PatientAdmission, (SELECT ServiceInvCode, AdmissionCode FROM @service_table) T
	WHERE PatientAdmission.AdmissionCode = T.admissioncode			

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Updating Patient Admission Record', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE AdmittedPatientRecurringServices
	SET NextRunOn = DATEADD(hh, AdmittedPatientRecurringServices.FrequencyHrs, ISNULL(AdmittedPatientRecurringServices.NextRunOn, GETDATE()))
	FROM 
		PatientAdmission PA,
		AdmittedPatientRecurringServices
	WHERE 	PA.Discharged1='N' AND PA.Discharged='N' AND 
		PA.AdmissionCode = AdmittedPatientRecurringServices.AdmissionCode AND
		GETDATE() >= ISNULL(AdmittedPatientRecurringServices.StartDate, '12-12-9999 00:00:00') AND
		GETDATE() >= ISNULL(AdmittedPatientRecurringServices.NextRunOn, '12-12-1900 00:00:00')

	SET @end_invcode = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(ServiceInvCode) FROM @service_table), 0)
	IF @@ERROR <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Updating Service Header Key Value', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE ServiceHeader
	SET InvTotal = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(ServiceHeader.ServiceInvCode), 0)
	WHERE ServiceHeader.ServiceInvCode IN (SELECT DISTINCT ServiceInvCode FROM @service_table)

	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @end_invcode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Updating ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

END
IF @@ERROR = 0 
BEGIN
	Commit Transaction
	RETURN 0
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	Rollback Transaction
	RETURN -1
END

-- SP_Generate_Svc_From_CheckedInGuest
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_Generate_Svc_From_CheckedInGuest 
AS 

DECLARE @tot_checkedin INT, @start_invcode INT, @end_invcode INT, @errcode INT
DECLARE @service_table TABLE 
	(GuestCheckInCode INT NOT NULL, ServiceInvCode INT NULL, Rowid INT IDENTITY(1, 1))

BEGIN TRANSACTION

SET @tot_checkedin = 
	ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(GC.GuestCheckInCode)
			FROM GuestCheckIn GC WITH (HOLDLOCK, ROWLOCK), GuestCheckInService GCS
			WHERE GC.CheckOut ='N' AND 
				GC.GuestCheckInCode = GCS.GuestCheckInCode AND
				DATEDIFF(dd, ISNULL(GC.RecurringServiceChargedOn, 0), GETDATE()) >= 1), 0)

IF @tot_checkedin <> 0
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO @service_table (GuestCheckInCode, ServiceInvCode)
	SELECT GC.GuestCheckInCode, NULL
	FROM GuestCheckIn GC
	WHERE 	GC.CheckOut='N' AND 
			DATEDIFF(dd, ISNULL(GC.RecurringServiceChargedOn, 0), GETDATE()) >= 1 AND
			GC.GuestCheckInCode IN (SELECT DISTINCT GuestCheckInCode FROM GuestCheckInService)
	ORDER BY GC.GuestCheckInCode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Fetching Checked-In Guest Recurring Services', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @start_invcode OUTPUT
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Fetching ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE @service_table
	SET ServiceInvCode = @start_invcode + RowID
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in Temporary Table', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	INSERT INTO ServiceHeader (ServiceInvCode, CustCode, SalesManCode, ServiceCatCode,
		Remarks, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, Date, PostedBy, PostDate, HeaderNo, 
		DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SaleInvCode, Posted, DoctCode, ReprintingCounter,
		ServiceOCode, CashReceived, GuestCode, GuestCheckInCode)
	SELECT
		T.ServiceInvCode, CustCode=G.CustCode, SalesManCode=1, SerivceCatCode=11,
		Remarks='Recurring Services', OriginalDate=GETDATE(), ModifiedBy=Null, Date=GetDate(),
		PostedBy=1, PostDate=GETDATE(), HeaderNo=1, DiscPerc=0, FlatDisc=0, MiscCharges=0,
		SaleInvCode=NULL, Posted='Y', DoctCode=NULL, ReprintingCounter=0,
		ServiceOCode=Null, CashReceived=0, GuestCode=GC.GuestCode, GC.GuestCheckInCode
	FROM	
		GuestCheckIn GC, Guest G, (SELECT ServiceInvCode, GuestCheckInCode FROM @service_table) T
	WHERE
		GC.GuestCheckInCode = T.GuestCheckInCode AND GC.GuestCode = G.GuestCode
	ORDER BY T.GuestCheckInCode

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceHeader', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	INSERT INTO ServiceDetail (ServiceInvCode, ServiceCode, SManCode, Qty, Price, DiscPerc)
	SELECT T.ServiceInvCode, GCS.ServiceCode, GCS.SManCode, GCS.Qty, GCS.SalePrice, GCS.DiscPerc
	FROM (SELECT ServiceInvCode, GuestCheckInCode FROM @service_table) T, GuestCheckInService GCS
	WHERE T.GuestCheckInCode = GCS.GuestCheckInCode
	ORDER BY GCS.GuestCheckInCode, GCS.RowID

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceDetail', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction	
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE GuestCheckIn 
	SET GuestCheckIn.RecurringServiceChargedOn = GETDATE(), GuestCheckIn.ServiceInvCode = T.ServiceInvCode
	FROM GuestCheckIn, (SELECT ServiceInvCode, GuestCheckInCode FROM @service_table) T
	WHERE GuestCheckIn.GuestCheckInCode = T.GuestCheckInCode			

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Updating Guest Checked-In Record', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @end_invcode = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(ServiceInvCode) FROM @service_table), 0)
	IF @@ERROR <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Updating Service Header Key Value', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END


	UPDATE ServiceHeader SET InvTotal = dbo.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(T.ServiceInvCode)
	FROM (SELECT ServiceInvCode FROM @service_table) T, ServiceHeader
	WHERE ServiceHeader.ServiceInvCode = T.ServiceInvCode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Updating Service Invoice Totals', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @end_invcode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Updating ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

END
IF @@ERROR = 0 
BEGIN
	Commit Transaction
	RETURN 0
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	Rollback Transaction
	RETURN -1
END

-- SP_Generate_Svc_From_PatientRecSvc
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_Generate_Svc_From_PatientRecSvc AS 

DECLARE @tot_patients INT, @start_invcode INT, @end_invcode INT, @errcode INT
DECLARE @service_table TABLE 
	(PatientCode INT NOT NULL, ServiceInvCode INT NULL, Rowid INT IDENTITY(1, 1))

BEGIN TRANSACTION

SET @tot_patients = 
	ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(P.PatientCode)
			FROM Patient P WITH (HOLDLOCK, ROWLOCK), PatientRecServices PR
			WHERE P.AutoGenRecurringServiceInv ='Y' AND 
				P.PatientCode = PR.PatientCode),0)

IF @tot_patients <> 0
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO @service_table (PatientCode, ServiceInvCode)
	SELECT PA.PatientCode, NULL
	FROM Patient PA, PatientRecServices PR
	WHERE 	PA.AutoGenRecurringServiceInv='Y' AND 
			PA.PatientCode = PR.PatientCode
	ORDER BY PA.PatientCode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Fetching Patient Recurring Services', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @start_invcode OUTPUT
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Fetching ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE @service_table
	SET ServiceInvCode = @start_invcode + RowID
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in Temporary Table', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	INSERT INTO ServiceHeader (ServiceInvCode, CustCode, SalesManCode, ServiceCatCode,
		Remarks, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, Date, PostedBy, PostDate, HeaderNo, 
		DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SaleInvCode, Posted, DoctCode, ReprintingCounter,
		ServiceOCode, CashReceived, PatientCode, AdmissionCode)
	SELECT
		T.ServiceInvCode, CustCode=P.CustCode, SalesManCode=1, SerivceCatCode=11,
		Remarks='Recurring Services', OriginalDate=GETDATE(), ModifiedBy=Null, Date=GetDate(),
		PostedBy=1, PostDate=GETDATE(), HeaderNo=1, DiscPerc=0, FlatDisc=0, MiscCharges=0,
		SaleInvCode=NULL, Posted='Y', DoctCode=P.DoctCode, ReprintingCounter=0,
		ServiceOCode=Null, CashReceived=0, PatientCode=P.PatientCode, NULL
	FROM	
		Patient P, (SELECT ServiceInvCode, PatientCode FROM @service_table) T
	WHERE
		P.PatientCode = T.PatientCode
	ORDER BY P.PatientCode

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceHeader', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	INSERT INTO ServiceDetail (ServiceInvCode, ServiceCode, SManCode, Qty, Price, DiscPerc)
	SELECT T.ServiceInvCode, APR.ServiceCode, APR.SManCode, APR.Qty, APR.SalePrice, APR.DiscPerc
	FROM (SELECT ServiceInvCode, PatientCode FROM @service_table) T, PatientRecServices APR
	WHERE T.PatientCode = APR.PatientCode
	ORDER BY APR.PatientCode, APR.RowID	

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceDetail', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction	
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE Patient
	SET Patient.RecurringServicesChargedOn = GETDATE(), 
		Patient.ServiceInvCode = T.ServiceInvCode
	FROM Patient, (SELECT ServiceInvCode, PatientCode FROM @service_table) T
	WHERE Patient.PatientCode = T.PatientCode

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Updating Patient Record', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @end_invcode = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(ServiceInvCode) FROM @service_table), 0)
	IF @@ERROR <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in Updating Service Header Key Value', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @end_invcode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Updating ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

END
IF @@ERROR = 0 
BEGIN
	Commit Transaction
	RETURN 0
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	Rollback Transaction
	RETURN -1
END

Set @serverdate = @enddate

Create Table  #randomitemlist ( lineid Int Not Null, randomvalue Int Not Null )
Create Table #saletemp ( id int not null identity(1,1), icode Int , satisfiableqty Int, satisfiedqty Int, SalePrice  Numeric(12,2), DiscPerc Numeric(8,2), ItemFlatDisc Numeric(12,2), UnitSalesTax Numeric(12,2), GstPerc Numeric(6,2) )
Insert Into #saletemp ( icode, satisfiableqty, satisfiedqty , saleprice, discperc, itemflatdisc, unitsalestax, gstperc )
Select icode, looseqty, 0, saleprice, discperc, itemflatdisc, unitsalestax, gstperc
From SaleTemplateDetail
Where SaleTemplateCode = @saletemplatecode
Order By rowid

Set @saletemplate_rowcount = (Select count(*) from saletemplatedetail where saletemplatecode = @saletemplatecode) + 1
Set @anyitem_exist  = ( Select Sum(Satisfiableqty - Satisfiedqty) from #saletemp )
Set @continue = 0
Set @invcounter = 1
Set @invdetail_exist = 1
Set @rowgroup = 0

	While @anyitem_exist > 0 And @continue >= 0
	Begin
		IF @invdetail_exist >  0 
			Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'Saleledger' , @SaleInvCode Output
		IF ( @firsttime = 0  )
		Begin
			Set @sinvno = @saleinvcode	
			Set @firsttime = 1
		End
		Set @rowgroup = 0
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
		Else
		Begin
			IF @invdetail_exist >  0 
				Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno , @module,  @headerinvno Output 
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
			Begin
				Set @continue  = -1
			End
			Else
			Begin
				Set @Err = 0 
				Set @RowCount = 1
				IF @invdetail_exist >  0 
				Begin
					Insert Into SaleLedger (SaleInvCode, SaleCatCode, CustCode, SPrice, SalesManCode, Date, Discperc, Flatdisc, MiscCharges, SalesTax, Posted, PostDate,  HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo, OriginalDate, InvTotal, MachineName, ModifyCounter, BillingDate, SaleTypeCode)
					Values (@SaleInvCode, @salecatcode, @custcode, 1, @usercode, @serverdate, 0, 0, 0, 0, 'N', @serverdate, @headerno, @headerinvno, @serverdate, 0 , @machinename, 0, @serverdate, @saletypecode)
					Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
				End
				IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
				Begin 
					RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Ledger : %d' ,16,1,  @SaleInvCode  )
					Set @continue  = -1
				End 
				Else
				Begin
					Set @rand_lineitems = Rand() * @max_lineitems
					IF @rand_lineitems = 0 
						Set @rand_lineitems = 1
					Set @anyitem_exist  = ( Select Sum(Satisfiableqty - Satisfiedqty) from #saletemp )
					Set @lineitems_rowcount =  @max_lineitems /* + @max_lineitems_coushin */
					Truncate Table #randomitemlist
					Insert Into #randomitemlist
					exec sp_getRandomValueTable @lineitems_rowcount, @saletemplate_rowcount
					Set @innercounter = 1
					While ( @rand_lineitems > 0 )  AND ( @anyitem_exist > 0 ) AND ( @innercounter <= @lineitems_rowcount ) AND ( @continue >= 0 )
					Begin
						Set @rand_item = ( Select randomvalue from #randomitemlist where lineid = @innercounter )
						Select @icode = icode , @satisfiableqty = satisfiableqty, @satisfiedqty = satisfiedqty, @saleprice = saleprice, @discperc = discperc,  @itemflatdisc = itemflatdisc, @unitsalestax = unitsalestax, @gstperc1 = gstperc
						From #saletemp
					        Where id = @rand_item
						Select @RowCount = @@RowCount
						Set @item_in_inv_exist = ( Select count(*) From SaleDetail Where SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode AND icode = @icode  ) 
						IF  ( @item_in_inv_exist = 0 ) AND ( @RowCount = 1 ) AND  ( (@satisfiableqty - @satisfiedqty) > 0 )
						Begin
								Set @rand_itemqty = Rand() * @max_itemqty
								IF @rand_itemqty = 0 
									Set @rand_itemqty = 1
								IF ( @rand_itemqty + @satisfiedqty ) <=  @satisfiableqty 
									Set @givenqty = @rand_itemqty
								Else
									Set @givenqty = @satisfiableqty - @satisfiedqty
								IF @givenqty <= 0 
									Set @givenqty = 1
								Else
									Update #saletemp Set satisfiedqty = @satisfiedqty + @givenqty Where icode = @icode
								Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
								IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
								Begin
									Set @continue  = -1
								End
								Else
								Begin
									set @total_availablestock = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.icode = @icode)
									IF @total_availablestock < 0 OR @total_availablestock IS NULL
										SET @total_availablestock=0
									Set @totalqty = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and godowndetail.icode = @icode  )
									IF @totalqty >= @givenqty 
									Begin 
										Set @rowgroup = @rowgroup + 1
										Select @rate = saleprice, @packunits = packunits
										From ITEM
										Where icode = @icode
										IF @packunits = 0 OR @packunits Is Null 
											Set @packunits = 1
										Set @reqqty = @givenqty
										Declare ItemBatch_Cursor Cursor Static Forward_Only
										For 	Select  batch, expiry, Currqty 
										From    godowndetail 
										Where  godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and
											    godowndetail.icode = @icode 
										Order by priority, expiry, Currqty
		
										Open ItemBatch_Cursor
										Set @totalrows = @@Cursor_Rows
										Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
										Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
										Set @counter = 1	
										While @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @counter <= @totalrows AND @reqqty > 0
										Begin
											Set @batchqty = @currqty
											IF @batchqty >= @ReqQty 
												Set @delqty = @reqqty
											Else
												Set @delqty = @batchqty
											Set @reqqty = @reqqty - @delqty
	
											Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @saleutn Output
											IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
											Begin
												Set @continue  = -1															
											End 									
											SET @total_availablestock = @total_availablestock - @delqty
	
											Insert Into SaleDetail (SaleInvCode, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, packqty, looseqty, packunits, saleprice, avgprice, rate, discperc, salestax, itemflatdisc, packprice, unitsalestax, gstperc, saleutn, balancestock, rowgroup)
											Values (@saleinvcode, @icode, @gcode, @batch, @expiry, 0, @delqty, @packunits, @saleprice, @hold_avgprice, @rate / @packunits, @discperc, 0, @itemflatdisc, @rate, @unitsalestax, @gstperc1, @saleutn, @total_availablestock, @rowgroup)
											Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
											IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
											Begin 
												RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Detail for Sale Inv. No. : %d' ,16,1, @SaleInvCode  )
												Set @continue  = -1
											End 							
											Else
											Begin
												Set @newqty = @currqty - @delqty
												IF @newqty > 0
													Execute @rt_code = sp_SaleUpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty , @currqty
												Else
													Execute @rt_code = sp_DeleteItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty
												IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
												Begin
													Set @continue  = -1								
												End
											End
											Set @counter = @counter + 1
											Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
											Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
										End
									Close ItemBatch_Cursor
									Deallocate ItemBatch_Cursor
									End
									Else
									Begin
										Set @itemname = (Select name from item where icode = @icode )	
										RaisError( 'Not enough stock for item (%s) to decrease for Sale Inv. No : %d' , 16 , 1, @itemname, @SaleInvCode  )
										Set @continue  = -1								
									End
								End
						End	
/*
						Else
						Begin 
							Set @rand_lineitems = @rand_lineitems + 1
						End 
*/
						Set @innercounter = @innercounter + 1
						Set @anyitem_exist  = ( Select Sum(Satisfiableqty - Satisfiedqty) from #saletemp )
						Set @rand_lineitems = @rand_lineitems - 1
					End
					Set @invdetail_exist = ( Select count(*) from saledetail where saleinvcode = @saleinvcode )
				End
			End	
		End
	Set @anyitem_exist  = ( Select Sum(Satisfiableqty - Satisfiedqty) from #saletemp )
	End

Drop Table #saletemp
Drop Table #randomitemlist

IF ( @continue >= 0 )
Begin
	Set @einvno = @SaleInvCode
	Update Saleledger 
	Set InvTotal = dbo.fn_getSaleInvTotal (Saleledger.saleinvcode)
	Where saleinvcode between @sinvno and @einvno

	Select @Err = @@Error, @Rowcount = @@RowCount
	IF  @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0
	Begin
		RaisError( 'Unable to update SaleInvoices for Sale Inv. total' , 16 , 1 )
		Set @continue  = -1									
	End
	Else
	Begin
		Exec @rt_code = sp_setDateForAutoSaleGen @startdate, @enddate, @sinvno, @einvno
		Select @Err = @@Error
		IF @Err <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
		Begin
			RaisError( 'Unable to update SaleInvoices for Date adjustment' , 16 , 1 )
			Set @continue  = -1									
		End
		Else
		Begin
			Insert Into AutoSaleLog (SaleTemplateCode, SSaleInvCode, ESaleInvCode, SDate, EDate )
			Values (@saletemplatecode, @sinvno, @einvno, @startdate, @enddate )
			Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
			IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0
			Begin
				RaisError( 'Database error in inserting record in AutoSaleLog' , 16 , 1 )
				Set @continue  = -1									
			End
		End
	End
End

Return @continue
