-- sp_GenerateIssue
CREATE  Procedure [dbo].[sp_GenerateIssue] 
	@ProdCode Int, 
	@UserCode Int, 
	@HeaderNo Int, 
	@serverdate DateTime, 
	@IssueInvCode Int Output 
As

Declare @Code Int, @deptcode Int, @module SmallInt, @utn Int, @HeaderInvNo Int, @category smallint, @IssueCode INT
Declare @IssueType SmallInt, @PriceType SmallInt, @IssueGodownStrategy SMALLINT, @dracccode smallint
Declare @ICode Int, @GCode Int, @packunits Int, @AreaCode Int, @ProdRowID INT, @RowID INT, @GroupCode INT
Declare @GivenQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @TotalQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @CurrQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @DelQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @BatchQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @ReqQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @NewQty NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @Price Numeric(12,2), @PurPrice Numeric(12,2), @SalePrice Numeric(12,2), @Hold_AvgPrice Numeric(15,5), @RecentPurPrice Numeric(12,2), @total_availablestock NUMERIC(15, 4)
DECLARE @ItemFlatDisc Numeric(10,2), @DiscPerc Numeric(5,2), @ProcessCharge Numeric(10,2), @ProcessChargePerc Numeric(5,2)
Declare @batch VarChar(100), @ItemName VarChar(100), @AutoPost CHAR(1), @AccountFor CHAR(1)
Declare @Items_Rows Int, @Counter Int, @RowCount Int, @TotalRows Int, @continue Int, @Err Int, @rt_code Int 
Declare @expiry DateTime

/*
Author: M.Usman
Purpose:This Stored Procedure takes an argument of Production Code (@ProdCode)
	and against that Production Code it generates Issue Invoice Auto Posted.
*/
Set @continue = 0
Set @DeptCode = ISNULL((SELECT IssueDeptCode FROM ProdHeader WHERE ProdCode = @ProdCode), 1)
Set @AreaCode = 1 /* Default Selection */
Set @module = ( Select Module From Module Where Lower(Name) = 'issue' ) 
Set @pricetype = DBO.Fn_Get_INT_Preference('IssuePriceTypeCode')
SET @GroupCode = ISNULL((SELECT MIN(GroupCode) FROM UserGroups WHERE UserCode=@UserCode), 1)
SET @Category = 2 -- Production
SET @AccountFor = ISNULL((SELECT AccountFor FROM IssueCategory WHERE IssueCategoryCode=@Category), 'N')
IF @AccountFor = 'Y'
	SET @dracccode = ISNULL((SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name='GT_WIPAcc'), 33) -- cr wor in process a/c
ELSE
	SET @dracccode = NULL

SET @AutoPost = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('AutoPostIssueOnProdPost')
IF @AutoPost IS NULL
	SET @AutoPost = 'Y'

IF @GroupCode > 0 
	SET @IssueGodownStrategy = ISNULL((SELECT IssueGodownStrategy FROM Groups WHERE GroupCode=@GroupCode), 1)
ELSE
	SET @IssueGodownStrategy = 1

IF @IssueGodownStrategy = 1
	Set @GCode = ( Select IssueGCode From ProdHeader Where ProdCode = @ProdCode )

	Declare Cursor_Items Cursor Forward_Only Static
	For	Select			
			RD.ICode, 
			Sum(RD.Qty) As Qty, 
			Max(I.PackUnits) As PackUnits ,
			Round(Max(I.PurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) As PurPrice ,
			Round(Max(I.SalePrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) As SalePrice ,
			Round(Max(I.RecentPurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) As RecentPurPrice ,
			/*CASE @PriceType 
				WHEN 1 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) 
				WHEN 2 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice2)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) 
				WHEN 3 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice3)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) 
				WHEN 4 THEN Round(Max(I.PurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) 
				WHEN 5 THEN Round(Max(I.RecentPurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) 
				WHEN 6 THEN Round(Max(I.AvgPrice), 2) 
				WHEN 7 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice4)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) 
				WHEN 8 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice5)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) END*/ RD.Price As Price,
			RD.ItemFlatDisc, RD.DiscPerc, RD.ProcessCharge, RD.ProcessChargePerc, RD.ProdRowID, RD.RowID
		From  	
			(
			Select ICode, Qty, RowID
			From   ProdDetail
			Where  ProdDetail.ProdCode = @ProdCode
			) PD,
			(SELECT R1.*
			FROM Recipe R1
			WHERE STR(R1.ResultedItem, 7) + STR(R1.Priority, 7) IN
				(SELECT DISTINCT STR(RR.ResultedItem,7) + STR(MIN(RR.Priority), 7)
				FROM Recipe RR 
				WHERE RR.ResultedItem IN 
					(SELECT DISTINCT D.ICode 
					FROM ProdHeader P, ProdDetail D
					WHERE P.ProdCode = @ProdCode AND 
						P.ProdCode = D.ProdCode)
				GROUP BY RR.ResultedItem)) R,
			ProdBuffer RD,
			Item I
		Where   PD.ICode = R.ResultedItem AND
			RD.ProdCode = @ProdCode AND
			PD.RowID = RD.ProdRowID AND
			RD.ICode = I.ICode			
		Group By RD.ProdRowID, RD.ICode, RD.Price, RD.RowID, RD.ItemFlatDisc, RD.DiscPerc, RD.ProcessCharge, RD.ProcessChargePerc
		Order By RD.RowID

	Open Cursor_Items
	Set @Items_Rows = @@Cursor_Rows
	IF @Items_Rows > 0 
	Begin
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'IssueHeader' , @Code Output
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
		Else
		Begin
			Set @IssueInvCode = @Code
			Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno , @module,  @headerinvno Output 
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
			Begin
				Set @continue  = -1
			End
			Else
			Begin
				Set @IssueCode = NULL
				Execute @rt_code = sp_GetIssueCategoryCounter @Category , @IssueCode Output 
				IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
				Begin
					Set @continue  = -1
				End
				Else
				Begin
					Insert Into IssueHeader (IssueInvCode, DeptCode, Date, OriginalDate, SalesManCode, Posted, PostDate, PostedBy, AreaCode, HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo, PriceTypeCode, Remarks, IssueCategoryCode, AccountFor, DrAccCode, IssueCode)
					Values (@Code, @deptcode, @serverdate, @serverdate, @usercode, @AutoPost, @serverdate, @usercode, @AreaCode, @headerno, @headerinvno, @pricetype, 'SYSTEM GENERATED ISSUE', @Category, @AccountFor, @DrAccCode, @IssueCode)
					Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
					IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
					Begin 
						RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Issue Header : %d' ,16,1,  @Code  )
						Set @continue  = -1
					End 
					Else
					Begin
						Fetch Next From Cursor_Items
						Into @icode, @givenqty, @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice, @price, @ItemFlatDisc, @DiscPerc, @ProcessCharge, @ProcessChargePerc, @ProdRowID, @RowID
						While @@Fetch_Status = 0 AND @continue >= 0
						Begin
							IF @IssueGodownStrategy = 2
								SET @Gcode = ISNULL((SELECT GCode FROM Item WHERE ICode=@icode), 1)
	
							SET @Price = ((@Price - @ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - @DiscPerc * 0.01)) + @ProcessCharge + ((@Price - @ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - @DiscPerc * 0.01) * @ProcessChargePerc * 0.01)
							Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
							IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
							Begin
								Set @continue  = -1
							End
							Else
							Begin
								Set @packunits = Case When @packunits Is Null Then 1 When @packunits = 0 Then 1 Else @packunits End
								Set @totalqty = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and godowndetail.icode = @icode  )
								IF @totalqty >= @givenqty 
								Begin 
									set @total_availablestock = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.icode = @icode)
									IF @total_availablestock < 0 OR @total_availablestock IS NULL
										SET @total_availablestock=0

									Set @reqqty = @givenqty
									Declare ItemBatch_Cursor Cursor Static Forward_Only
									For 	Select  batch, expiry, Currqty 
										From    godowndetail 
										Where  	godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and
											godowndetail.icode = @icode 
										Order by priority, expiry, Currqty
		
									Open ItemBatch_Cursor
									Set @totalrows = @@Cursor_Rows
									Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
									Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
									Set @counter = 1	
									While @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @counter <= @totalrows AND @reqqty > 0
									Begin
										Set @batchqty = @currqty
										IF @batchqty >= @ReqQty 
											Set @delqty = @reqqty
										Else
											Set @delqty = @batchqty
										Set @reqqty = @reqqty - @delqty
	
										Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @utn Output
										IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
										Begin
											Set @continue  = -1															
										End 									
										SET @total_availablestock = @total_availablestock - @delqty
										
										Insert Into IssueDetail (IssueInvCode, GCode, ICode, Batch, Expiry, Qty, SalePrice, PurchasePrice, AvgPrice, PackUnits, MRPP, IssueUtn, Price , BalanceStock)
										Values(@Code, @GCode, @ICode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty, @saleprice, @purprice, @hold_avgprice, @packunits, @recentpurprice, @utn, @price , @total_availablestock)
										Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
										IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
										Begin 
											RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Issue Detail for Production : %d' ,16,1, @Code  )
											Set @continue  = -1
										End 							
										Else
										Begin
											Set @newqty = @currqty - @delqty
											IF @newqty > 0
												Execute @rt_code = sp_SaleUpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty , @currqty
											Else
												Execute @rt_code = sp_DeleteItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty
											IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
											Begin
												Set @continue  = -1								
											End
										End
										Set @counter = @counter + 1
										Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
										Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
									End
									Close ItemBatch_Cursor
									Deallocate ItemBatch_Cursor
								End
								Else
								Begin
									Set @itemname = (Select name from item where icode = @icode )	
									RaisError( 'Not enough stock for item (%s) to decrease for Issue No. : %d' , 16 , 1, @itemname, @Code  )
									Set @continue  = -1								
								End
							End
							Fetch Next From Cursor_Items
							Into @icode, @givenqty , @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice, @price, @ItemFlatDisc, @DiscPerc, @ProcessCharge, @ProcessChargePerc, @ProdRowID, @RowID
						End
					End
				End
			End
		End	
	End

Close Cursor_Items
Deallocate Cursor_Items

IF @continue <> 0 
Begin
	Return -1
End
Else
Begin 
	Return 0
End

-- sp_GenerateIssue_On_ProdunctionNote
CREATE    PROCEDURE sp_GenerateIssue_On_ProdunctionNote
	@ProdNoteCode Int, 
	@UserCode Int, 
	@IssueInvCode Int Output 
As

Declare @Code Int, @deptcode Int, @module SmallInt, @utn Int, @HeaderInvNo Int, @category smallint, @IssueCode INT, @dracccode smallint, @AccountFor CHAR(1)
Declare @IssueType SmallInt, @PriceType SmallInt, @HeaderNo SmallInt
Declare @ICode Int, @GCode Int, @packunits Int, @AreaCode Int, @ProdRowID INT, @RowID INT, @TotalPieces INT, @PiecesInHand INT
Declare @GivenQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @TotalQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @CurrQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @DelQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @BatchQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @ReqQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @NewQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @total_availablestock NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @Price Numeric(12,2), @PurPrice Numeric(12,2), @SalePrice Numeric(12,2), @Hold_AvgPrice Numeric(15,5), @RecentPurPrice Numeric(12,2)
DECLARE @ItemFlatDisc Numeric(10,2), @DiscPerc Numeric(5,2), @ProcessCharge Numeric(10,2), @ProcessChargePerc Numeric(5,2)
Declare @batch VarChar(100), @ItemName VarChar(100), @errtext VARCHAR(4000)
Declare @Items_Rows Int, @Counter Int, @RowCount Int, @TotalRows Int, @continue Int, @Err Int, @rt_code Int 
Declare @expiry DateTime, @serverdate DateTime

/*
Author: M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:This Stored Procedure takes an argument of Production Note Code (@ProdNoteCode)
and against that Production Note, it generates Issue Invoice Auto Posted.
*/
Set @continue = 0
Set @DeptCode = ISNULL((SELECT IssueDeptCode FROM ProdNote WHERE ProdNoteCode=@ProdNoteCode), 1)
Set @HeaderNo = 1
Set @AreaCode = 1 /* Default Selection */
Set @module = ( Select Module From Module Where Lower(Name) = 'issue' ) 
Set @pricetype = DBO.Fn_Get_INT_Preference('IssuePriceTypeCode')
Set @serverdate = GETDATE()
SET @Category = 2 -- Production
SET @AccountFor = ISNULL((SELECT AccountFor FROM IssueCategory WHERE IssueCategoryCode=@Category), 'N')
IF @AccountFor = 'Y'
	SET @dracccode = ISNULL((SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name='GT_WIPAcc'), 33) -- cr wor in process a/c
ELSE
	SET @dracccode = NULL

Declare Cursor_Items Cursor Forward_Only Static
For	Select			
		PNI.ICode, 
		PNI.GCode, 
		Sum(PNI.Qty) As Qty, 
		SUM(PNI.TotalPieces) AS TotalPieces,
		PNI.PackUnits,
		Round(Max(I.PurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) As PurPrice ,
		Round(Max(I.SalePrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) As SalePrice ,
		Round(Max(I.RecentPurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) As RecentPurPrice ,
		CASE @PriceType 
			WHEN 1 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) 
			WHEN 2 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice2)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) 
			WHEN 3 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice3)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) 
			WHEN 4 THEN Round(Max(I.PurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) 
			WHEN 5 THEN Round(Max(I.RecentPurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) 
			WHEN 6 THEN Round(Max(I.AvgPrice), 2) 
			WHEN 7 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice4)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) 
			WHEN 8 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice5)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) END As Price,
		PNI.RowID
	From  	
		ProdNoteIssue PNI,
		Item I
	Where   PNI.ProdNoteCode = @ProdNoteCode AND
		PNI.ICode = I.ICode			
	Group By PNI.RowID, PNI.ICode, PNI.GCode, PNI.PackUnits
	Order By PNI.RowID

Open Cursor_Items
Set @Items_Rows = @@Cursor_Rows
IF @Items_Rows > 0 
Begin
	Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'IssueHeader' , @Code Output
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	Begin
		Set @continue  = -1
	End
	Else
	Begin
		Set @IssueInvCode = @Code
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno , @module,  @headerinvno Output 
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
		Else
		Begin
			Set @IssueCode = NULL
			Execute @rt_code = sp_GetIssueCategoryCounter @Category , @IssueCode Output 
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
			Begin
				Set @continue  = -1
			End
			Else
			Begin
				Insert Into IssueHeader (IssueInvCode, DeptCode, Date, OriginalDate, SalesManCode, Posted, PostDate, PostedBy, AreaCode, HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo, PriceTypeCode, Remarks, RecipientCode, IssueCategoryCode, AccountFor, DrAccCode, IssueCode)
				Values (@Code, @deptcode, @serverdate, @serverdate, @usercode, 'Y', @serverdate, @usercode, @AreaCode, @headerno, @headerinvno, @pricetype, 'PRODUCTION NOTE BASED ISSUE', 1, @Category, @AccountFor, @DrAccCode, @IssueCode)
				Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
				IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
				Begin 
					RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Issue Header : %d' ,16,1,  @Code  )
					Set @continue  = -1
				End 
				Else
				Begin
					Fetch Next From Cursor_Items
					Into @icode, @gcode, @givenqty, @totalpieces, @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice, @price, @RowID
					While @@Fetch_Status = 0 AND @continue >= 0
					Begin
						Set @itemname = (Select name from item where icode = @icode )
	--					SET @Price = ((@Price - @ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - @DiscPerc * 0.01)) + @ProcessCharge + ((@Price - @ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - @DiscPerc * 0.01) * @ProcessChargePerc * 0.01)
						Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
						IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
						Begin
							SET @errtext = 'Unable to aquire item lock for item = ' + @itemname
							Set @continue  = -1								
						End
	 					ELSE
	 					BEGIN
	 						Execute @rt_code = SP_GetItemTotalPiecesInHand @icode, @piecesinhand OutPut
	 						IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
	 						Begin
	 							SET @errtext = 'Unable to fetch total pieces in hand for item = ' + @itemname
	 							Set @continue  = -1
	 						End
	 						Else
	 						BEGIN
	 							IF @totalpieces > @piecesinhand
	 							BEGIN
	 								SET @errtext = 'Total Pieces asked to issue are more than total pieces in hand for item = ' + @itemname
	 								Set @continue  = -1
	 							END
	 							ELSE
	 							BEGIN
	 								Execute @rt_code = SP_UpdateItemTotalPiecesInHand @icode, -1, @totalpieces
	 								IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
	 								Begin
	 									SET @errtext = 'Error Updating pieces in hand for item = ' + @itemname
	 									Set @continue  = -1
	 								End
	 							END
	 						END
	 					END
	 					IF @continue >= 0
	 					BEGIN
							set @total_availablestock = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.icode = @icode)
							IF @total_availablestock < 0 OR @total_availablestock IS NULL
								SET @total_availablestock=0

							Set @packunits = Case When @packunits Is Null Then 1 When @packunits = 0 Then 1 Else @packunits End
							Set @totalqty = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and godowndetail.icode = @icode  )
							IF @totalqty >= @givenqty 
							Begin 
								Set @reqqty = @givenqty
								Declare ItemBatch_Cursor Cursor Static Forward_Only
								For 	Select  batch, expiry, Currqty 
									From    godowndetail 
									Where  	godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and
										godowndetail.icode = @icode 
									Order by priority, expiry, Currqty
	
								Open ItemBatch_Cursor
								Set @totalrows = @@Cursor_Rows
								Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
								Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
								Set @counter = 1	
								While @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @counter <= @totalrows AND @reqqty > 0
								Begin
									Set @batchqty = @currqty
									IF @batchqty >= @ReqQty 
										Set @delqty = @reqqty
									Else
										Set @delqty = @batchqty
									Set @reqqty = @reqqty - @delqty
	
									Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @utn Output
									IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
									Begin
										Set @continue  = -1															
									End 									
									SET @total_availablestock = @total_availablestock - @delqty
									
									Insert Into IssueDetail (IssueInvCode, GCode, ICode, Batch, Expiry, Qty, SalePrice, PurchasePrice, AvgPrice, PackUnits, MRPP, IssueUtn, Price, TotalPieces, PiecesInHand , BalanceStock)
									Values(@Code, @GCode, @ICode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty, @saleprice, @purprice, @hold_avgprice, @packunits, @recentpurprice, @utn, @price , @TotalPieces, @PiecesInHand  , @total_availablestock)
									Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
									IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
									Begin 
										RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Issue Detail for Production : %d' ,16,1, @Code  )
										Set @continue  = -1
									End 							
									Else
									Begin
										Set @newqty = @currqty - @delqty
										IF @newqty > 0
											Execute @rt_code = sp_SaleUpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty , @currqty
										Else
											Execute @rt_code = sp_DeleteItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty
										IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
										Begin
											Set @continue  = -1								
										End
									End
									Set @counter = @counter + 1
									Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
									Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
								End
								Close ItemBatch_Cursor
								Deallocate ItemBatch_Cursor
							End
							Else
							Begin
								Set @itemname = (Select name from item where icode = @icode )	
								RaisError( 'Not enough stock for item (%s) to decrease for Issue No. : %d' , 16 , 1, @itemname, @Code  )
								Set @continue  = -1								
							End
						End
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							RaisError(@errtext, 16 , 1)
							Set @continue  = -1								
						END
						Fetch Next From Cursor_Items
						Into @icode, @gcode, @givenqty, @totalpieces, @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice, @price, @RowID
					End
				End
			End
		End
	End	
End

Close Cursor_Items
Deallocate Cursor_Items

IF @continue <> 0 
Begin
	Return -1
End
Else
Begin 
	Return 0
End

-- sp_GenerateItemLog_DataCarryDB
CREATE    Procedure sp_GenerateItemLog_DataCarryDB @SRV VARCHAR(50), @DB VARCHAR(50), @OWNER VARCHAR(20) AS
/*
Author: Muhammad Usman
Version:1.0
Author: Muhammad Azhar
Version:1.1 changed logic to see saleprice in transferabledata_restrictedcolumns 
*/
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON
Declare @query VarChar(2000)
Set @query = 'SELECT * INTO #TItem from ' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.' + 'item                     '
Set @query = @query + 'Insert Into ItemLog '
Set @query = @query + ' Select 	GetDate() AS TodayDate, i.saleprice, (SELECT isnull(sum(g.currqty),0) FROM godowndetail g WHERE g.icode=item.icode), item.* '
Set @query = @query + ' from   	item , #TItem i '
Set @query = @query + ' where  	item.icode = i.icode AND item.saleprice <> i.saleprice and not exists (select columnname from transferabledata_restrictedcolumns where tablename=' + '''item''' + ' and columnname=' + '''saleprice'')'
Execute(@query)
--PRINT @query
IF @@Error <> 0
Begin
	RaisError('Some Problem occur in generating ItemLog',16,1)
	Return -1
End
Return 1

name: sp_GenerateMarkedSaleFromTemplate
definition:
-- sp_GenerateMarkedSaleFromTemplate
CREATE     Procedure sp_GenerateMarkedSaleFromTemplate
	@saletemplatecode Int, 
	@usercode Int, 
	@MachineName VARCHAR(100),
	@sinvno Int OUTPUT, 
	@einvno Int OUTPUT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

Declare @module Int, @custcode Int, @saletypecode SmallInt, @headerno SmallInt, @headerinvno Int, @continue Int, @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @totalrows Int, @rowcount Int, @invcounter Int, @counter Int, @OutofStock INT, @RowID INT, @gcode smallint, @SaleCatCode TINYINT
Declare @InvCode INT, @SaleInvCode Int, @OldInvCode INT, @satisfiableqty Int, @satisfiedqty Int, @item_in_inv_exist Int
Declare @saleprice Numeric(12,2), @rate Numeric(12,2), @discperc Numeric(5,2), @itemflatdisc Numeric(12,2), @unitsalestax Numeric(12,2), @gstperc1 Numeric(6,2), @gstperc2 Numeric(6,2), @hold_avgprice Numeric(15,5)
Declare @icode Int, @anyitem_exist Int, @packunits Int
Declare @Quantity NUMERIC(15, 4), @BonusQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @totalqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @givenqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @reqqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @batchqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @delqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @currqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @newqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @total_availablestock NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @batch VarChar(100), @itemname VarChar(60), @expiry DateTime, @serverdate DateTime, @Remarks VARCHAR(100)
Declare @saleutn BigInt, @firsttime Bit
Declare @saletemplate_rowcount Int, @invdetail_exist Int, @rowgroup Int, @lineitems_rowcount Int, @innercounter Int

SET @OutofStock = 
	ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(T.ICode)
	FROM
		(SELECT ICode, Qty=SUM(ISNULL(LooseQty,0) + ISNULL(BonusQty,0)), Stock = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(GD.CurrQty) FROM GodownDetail GD WHERE GD.ICode = SaleTemplateDetail.ICode), 0)
		FROM SaleTemplateDetail 
		WHERE SaleTemplateCode = @saletemplatecode AND Marked='Y' AND (LooseQty + BonusQty) > 0
		GROUP BY ICode) T
	WHERE
		T.Qty > T.Stock), 0)

IF @OutofStock > 0
BEGIN
	RaisError( 'Not Enough Stock exists for some items of sale template no. %d' ,16,1, @saletemplatecode)
	RETURN -1
END

CREATE TABLE #SaleTemp 
(SaleInvCode INT, SaleCatCode TINYINT, OldInvCode INT, SaleDate DATETIME, CustCode SMALLINT, ICode INT, LooseQty NUMERIC(15,4), BonusQty NUMERIC(15,4), SalePrice NUMERIC(15,2), DiscPerc NUMERIC(5,2), ItemFlatDisc NUMERIC(10,2), 
UnitSalesTax NUMERIC(15,2), GSTPerc NUMERIC(5,2), PackUnits INT, Remarks VARCHAR(100), 
SatisfiableQty NUMERIC(15,4), SatisfiedQty NUMERIC(15,4), RowID INT IDENTITY(1,1))

INSERT INTO #SaleTemp (SaleInvCode, SaleCatCode, OldInvCode, SaleDate, CustCode, ICode, LooseQty, BonusQty, SalePrice, DiscPerc, ItemFlatDisc, UnitSalesTax, GSTPerc, PackUnits, Remarks, SatisfiableQty, SatisfiedQty)
SELECT SaleInvCode=-1, ISNULL(SaleCatCode, 3), OldInvCode=SaleInvCode, SaleDate, CustCode, ICode, LooseQty, BonusQty, SalePrice, DiscPerc, ItemFlatDisc, UnitSalesTax, GSTPerc, PackUnits, Remarks, SatisfiableQty = LooseQty + BonusQty, SatisfiedQty=0
FROM SaleTemplateDetail 
WHERE SaleTemplateCode = @saletemplatecode AND Marked='Y' AND (LooseQty + BonusQty) > 0
ORDER BY SaleInvCode, RowID

Set @saletypecode = 1
Set @module = ( Select module from module where name = 'Sales' )
SET @Headerno=1
Set @saletemplate_rowcount = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #SaleTemp), 0)
Set @anyitem_exist  = ISNULL(( Select Sum(Satisfiableqty - Satisfiedqty) from #saletemp ), 0)
Set @continue = 0
Set @invcounter = 1
Set @rowgroup = 0
SET @RowID=1

While @anyitem_exist > 0 And @continue >= 0
Begin
	SET @CustCode = ISNULL((SELECT CustCode FROM #SaleTemp WHERE RowID = @RowID), 19)
	SET @ServerDate = ISNULL((SELECT SaleDate FROM #SaleTemp WHERE RowID = @RowID), GETDATE())
	SET @OldInvCode = (SELECT OldInvCode FROM #SaleTemp WHERE RowID = @RowID)
	SET @InvCode = (SELECT SaleInvCode FROM #SaleTemp WHERE RowID = @RowID)
	SET @SaleInvCode = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(SaleInvCode) FROM #SaleTemp WHERE OldInvCode = @OldInvCode), -1)
	SET @SaleCatCode = ISNULL((SELECT SaleCatCode FROM #SaleTemp WHERE RowID = @RowID), 3)
	SET @Remarks = ISNULL((SELECT Remarks FROM #SaleTemp WHERE RowID = @RowID), '')
	Set @rowgroup = 0
	IF @InvCode = -1 AND @SaleInvCode = -1
	BEGIN
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'Saleledger' , @SaleInvCode Output
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
		IF @continue >= 0
		BEGIN
			Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno , @module,  @headerinvno Output 
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
			Begin
				Set @continue  = -1
			End
		END
		IF @continue >= 0
		BEGIN
			Insert Into SaleLedger (SaleInvCode, SaleCatCode, CustCode, SPrice, SalesManCode, Date, Discperc, Flatdisc, MiscCharges, SalesTax, Posted, PostDate,  HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo, OriginalDate, InvTotal, MachineName, ModifyCounter, BillingDate, SaleTypeCode, Remarks, CustRefNo)
			Values (@SaleInvCode, @SaleCatCode, @custcode, 1, @usercode, @serverdate, 0, 0, 0, 0, 'N', @serverdate, @headerno, @headerinvno, @serverdate, 0 , @MachineName, 0, @serverdate, @saletypecode, @Remarks, @OldInvCode)
			Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
			IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
			Begin 
				RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Ledger : %d' ,16,1,  @SaleInvCode)
				Set @continue  = -1
			End 
		END
	END
	
	IF @continue >= 0
	Begin
		Set @anyitem_exist  = ISNULL(( Select Sum(Satisfiableqty - Satisfiedqty) from #saletemp ), 0)
		IF @OldInvCode > 0
			Set @lineitems_rowcount = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) from #saletemp WHERE OldInvCode = @OldInvCode AND SatisfiableQty - SatisfiedQty > 0), 1)
		ELSE
			Set @lineitems_rowcount = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) from #saletemp WHERE OldInvCode IS NULL AND SatisfiableQty - SatisfiedQty > 0), 1)
		Set @innercounter = 1
		While ( @anyitem_exist > 0 ) AND ( @innercounter <= @lineitems_rowcount ) AND ( @continue >= 0 )
		Begin
			Select @icode = icode , @Quantity=LooseQty, @BonusQty=BonusQty, @satisfiableqty = satisfiableqty, @satisfiedqty = satisfiedqty, @saleprice = saleprice, @discperc = discperc,  @itemflatdisc = itemflatdisc, @unitsalestax = unitsalestax, @gstperc1 = gstperc
			From #saletemp
		        Where RowID = @RowID
			Select @RowCount = @@RowCount
			IF (@RowCount > 0) AND ( (@satisfiableqty - @satisfiedqty) > 0 )
			Begin
				IF ( @Quantity + @BonusQty + @satisfiedqty ) <= @satisfiableqty 
					Set @givenqty = @Quantity + @BonusQty
				Else
					Set @givenqty = @satisfiableqty - @satisfiedqty

				IF @givenqty <= 0 
					Set @givenqty = 1
				Else
					Update #saletemp Set satisfiedqty = @satisfiedqty + @givenqty Where icode = @icode AND RowID=@RowID

				Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
				IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
				Begin
					Set @continue  = -1
				End
				Else
				Begin
					set @total_availablestock = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.icode = @icode)
					IF @total_availablestock < 0 OR @total_availablestock IS NULL
						SET @total_availablestock=0
					Set @totalqty = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.icode = @icode)
					IF @totalqty >= @givenqty 
					Begin 
						Set @rowgroup = @rowgroup + 1
						Select @rate = saleprice, @packunits = packunits
						From ITEM
						Where icode = @icode
						IF @packunits = 0 OR @packunits Is Null 
							Set @packunits = 1
						Set @reqqty = @givenqty
						Declare ItemBatch_Cursor Cursor Static Forward_Only
						For 	Select  gcode, batch, expiry, Currqty 
						From    godowndetail 
						Where   godowndetail.icode = @icode 
						Order by gcode, priority, expiry, Currqty

						Open ItemBatch_Cursor
						Set @totalrows = @@Cursor_Rows
						Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
						Into 	@gcode, @batch, @expiry, @currqty
						Set @counter = 1	
						While @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @counter <= @totalrows AND @reqqty > 0
						Begin
							Set @batchqty = @currqty
							IF @batchqty >= @ReqQty 
								Set @delqty = @reqqty
							Else
								Set @delqty = @batchqty
							Set @reqqty = @reqqty - @delqty
							IF @delqty >= @Quantity
							BEGIN
								SET @Quantity = @Quantity
								SET @BonusQty = @delqty - @Quantity
								IF @BonusQty < 0
									SET @BonusQty = 0
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								SET @Quantity = @Quantity - @delqty
								IF @Quantity < 0
									SET @Quantity = 0
								SET @BonusQty = 0
							END

							Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @saleutn Output
							IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
							Begin
								Set @continue  = -1															
							End 									
							SET @total_availablestock = @total_availablestock - @Quantity - @BonusQty

							Insert Into SaleDetail (SaleInvCode, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, packqty, looseqty, bonusqty, packunits, saleprice, avgprice, rate, discperc, salestax, itemflatdisc, packprice, unitsalestax, gstperc, saleutn, balancestock, rowgroup)
							Values (@saleinvcode, @icode, @gcode, @batch, @expiry, 0, @Quantity, @BonusQty, @packunits, @saleprice, @hold_avgprice, @rate / @packunits, @discperc, 0, @itemflatdisc, @rate, @unitsalestax, @gstperc1, @saleutn, @total_availablestock, @rowgroup)
							Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
							IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
							Begin
								RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Detail for Sale Inv. No. : %d' ,16,1, @SaleInvCode  )
								Set @continue  = -1
							End 							
							Else
							Begin
								Set @newqty = @currqty - @delqty
								IF @newqty > 0
									Execute @rt_code = sp_SaleUpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty , @currqty
								Else
									Execute @rt_code = sp_DeleteItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty
								IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
								Begin
									Set @continue  = -1								
								End
							End
							Set @counter = @counter + 1
							Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
							Into 	@gcode, @batch, @expiry, @currqty
						End
						Close ItemBatch_Cursor
						Deallocate ItemBatch_Cursor
					End
					Else
					Begin
						Set @itemname = (Select name from item where icode = @icode )	
						RaisError( 'Not enough stock for item (%s) to decrease for Sale Inv. No : %d' , 16 , 1, @itemname, @SaleInvCode  )
						Set @continue  = -1								
					End
				End
			End	
			Set @innercounter = @innercounter + 1
			Set @anyitem_exist  = ISNULL(( Select Sum(Satisfiableqty - Satisfiedqty) from #saletemp ), 0)
		End
	End
	IF @OldInvCode > 0
		UPDATE #SaleTemp SET SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode WHERE OldInvCode = @OldInvCode AND RowID=@RowID
	ELSE
		UPDATE #SaleTemp SET SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode WHERE RowID=@RowID

	Set @RowID = @RowID + 1
	Set @anyitem_exist  = ISNULL(( Select Sum(Satisfiableqty - Satisfiedqty) from #saletemp ), 0)
End

IF ( @continue >= 0 )
Begin
	Set @sinvno = (SELECT MIN(SaleInvCode) FROM #SaleTemp)
	Set @einvno = (SELECT MAX(SaleInvCode) FROM #SaleTemp)

	Update Saleledger 
	Set InvTotal = dbo.fn_getSaleInvTotal (Saleledger.saleinvcode)
	Where saleinvcode between @sinvno and @einvno

	Select @Err = @@Error, @Rowcount = @@RowCount
	IF  @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0
	Begin
		RaisError( 'Unable to update SaleInvoices for Sale Inv. total' , 16 , 1 )
		Set @continue  = -1									
	End
End

Return @continue

name: sp_GeneratePayroll
definition:
-- sp_GeneratePayroll
CREATE Procedure dbo.sp_GeneratePayroll @Type INT, @EmpCategory VARCHAR(8000), @EmpDept VARCHAR(8000), @StartDate DATETIME, @EndDate DATETIME, @UserCode Int, @PaySlipsGenerated Int Output As
/*
Author: M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:This Stored Procedure generates payroll for employees selected using employee category and department
*/
Declare @StartCode Int, @EndCode Int, @RowID INT, @PayslipRows INT
Declare @RowCount Int, @TotalRows Int, @continue Int, @Err Int, @rt_code Int 

DECLARE @Tab_EmpCategory TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_EmpDept TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE #TempPay (
PayrollCode INT,
EmpCode INT, WorkDays NUMERIC(6,2), Presents NUMERIC(6,2), Absents NUMERIC(6,2), Leaves NUMERIC(6,2),
PerHourRate NUMERIC(12,2), BasicPay NUMERIC(12,2), OverTimeHours NUMERIC(12,2), OverTimeRate NUMERIC(12,2), 
OverTime NUMERIC(12,2), BonusPay NUMERIC(12,2), SpecialPay NUMERIC(12,2), AdditionalPay NUMERIC(12,2), 
OtherPay NUMERIC(12,2), Fine NUMERIC(12,2), Penalty NUMERIC(12,2), OtherCharge NUMERIC(12,2), Advance NUMERIC(12,2), 
NetPayable NUMERIC(12,2), Sundays NUMERIC(6,2), Holidays NUMERIC(6,2), 
AdvAccCode INT, PayType INT, HoursWorked NUMERIC(10,4),
Allowances NUMERIC(12,2), Deductions NUMERIC(12,2)
)

CREATE TABLE #TempPay2 (
PayrollCode INT,
EmpCode INT, WorkDays NUMERIC(6,2), Presents NUMERIC(6,2), Absents NUMERIC(6,2), Leaves NUMERIC(6,2),
PerHourRate NUMERIC(12,2), BasicPay NUMERIC(12,2), OverTimeHours NUMERIC(12,2), OverTimeRate NUMERIC(12,2), 
OverTime NUMERIC(12,2), BonusPay NUMERIC(12,2), SpecialPay NUMERIC(12,2), AdditionalPay NUMERIC(12,2), 
OtherPay NUMERIC(12,2), Fine NUMERIC(12,2), Penalty NUMERIC(12,2), OtherCharge NUMERIC(12,2), Advance NUMERIC(12,2), 
NetPayable NUMERIC(12,2), Sundays NUMERIC(6,2), Holidays NUMERIC(6,2), 
AdvAccCode INT, PayType INT, HoursWorked NUMERIC(10,4), 
Allowances NUMERIC(12,2), Deductions NUMERIC(12,2),
ROWID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1)
)


INSERT INTO @Tab_EmpCategory SELECT Code FROM dbo.udf_StringToTabl(@EmpCategory, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_EmpDept SELECT Code FROM dbo.udf_StringToTabl(@EmpDept, ',')
SET @StartCode = 0
Execute @rt_code = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'EMP_Payroll' , @StartCode Output
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
Begin
	RaisError('Error occured in aquiring latest payslip code' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1
End

--Payroll Header
IF @Type=1
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #TempPay 
		(PayrollCode, EmpCode, WorkDays, Presents, Absents, Leaves,
		PerHourRate, BasicPay, OverTimeHours, 
		OverTimeRate, OverTime, 
		BonusPay, SpecialPay, AdditionalPay, 
		OtherPay, Fine, Penalty, OtherCharge, Advance, 
		NetPayable, Sundays, Holidays, 
		AdvAccCode, PayType, HoursWorked)
	SELECT PayrollCode=@StartCode, E.EmpCode, WorkDays=0, Presents=ISNULL(T.Presents,0), Absents=ISNULL(T.Absents, 0), 
		Leaves=ISNULL(T.Leaves,0), 
		PerHourRate=P.PerHourRate, 
		BasicPay=ISNULL(CASE WHEN P.OverTime='Y' THEN CASE WHEN T.HoursWorked > (P.WorkingHours * P.PayFrequencyFactor) THEN (P.WorkingHours * P.PayFrequencyFactor) ELSE T.HoursWorked END ELSE T.HoursWorked END * P.PerHourRate,0), 
		OverTimeHours=ISNULL(T.OverTimeHrs,0), 
		OverTimeRate=P.OverTimeRate, OverTime=ISNULL(CASE WHEN P.OverTime='Y' THEN T.OverTimeHrs * P.OverTimeRate ELSE 0 END,0), 
		BonusPay=0, SpecialPay=0, AdditionalPay=0, 
		OtherPay=0, Fine=0, Penalty=0, OtherCharge=0,
		Advance= ISNULL((SELECT 
				Advance=CASE 
					WHEN T.Adv_Acc_Balance <> T.Balance THEN 
						CASE WHEN T.Adv_Acc_Balance >= T.Installment THEN T.Installment 
						ELSE T.Adv_Acc_Balance END 
					ELSE 
						CASE WHEN T.Balance >= T.Installment THEN T.Installment 
						ELSE T.Adv_Acc_Balance END
					END
			FROM
				(SELECT 
					EA.EmpAdvAccCode,
					Amount=SUM(EA.Amount), 
					ReturnedAmt=SUM(EA.ReturnedAmt), 
					Balance=SUM(EA.Amount) - SUM(EA.ReturnedAmt), 
					Installment=SUM(EA.Installment),
					Adv_Acc_Balance = ISNULL((SELECT Balance=SUM(V.Debit - V.Credit) FROM VirtualGL V WHERE AccCode=EA.EmpAdvAccCode), 0)
				FROM EMP_Advance EA
				WHERE EA.Amount - EA.ReturnedAmt > 0
				GROUP BY EA.EmpAdvAccCode) T
			WHERE T.EmpAdvAccCode = E.AdvAccCode), 0), 
		NetPayable=0, Sundays=ISNULL(T.Sundays ,0), Holidays=ISNULL(T.Holidays,0), 
		E.AdvAccCode, P.PayType, HoursWorked=ISNULL(T.TotalTime,0)
	FROM EMP_Employee E, EMP_Pay P, EMP_Category C, EMP_Department D,
		(SELECT 
			EA.EmpCode, 
			Presents = SUM(CASE WHEN EA.AttendanceStatusCode = 1 THEN 1 WHEN EA.AttendanceStatusCode = 4 OR EA.AttendanceStatusCode = 5 OR EA.AttendanceStatusCode = 6 OR EA.AttendanceStatusCode = 10 THEN 0.5 ELSE 0 END),
			Absents = SUM(CASE WHEN EA.AttendanceStatusCode = 2 OR EA.AttendanceStatusCode = 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
			Leaves = SUM(CASE WHEN EA.AttendanceStatusCode = 11 OR EA.AttendanceStatusCode = 3 THEN 1 WHEN EA.AttendanceStatusCode = 5 OR EA.AttendanceStatusCode = 6 OR EA.AttendanceStatusCode = 7 OR EA.AttendanceStatusCode = 8 THEN 0.5 ELSE 0 END),
			Sundays = CASE WHEN E.SundaysPaid ='Y' THEN ISNULL(DBO.udf_Count_DayOfWeek(@StartDate, @EndDate, 'Sunday'), 0) ELSE 0 END,
			Holidays = CASE WHEN E.HolidaysPaid ='Y' THEN ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(EH.Date) FROM EMP_Holiday EH WHERE EH.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate), 0) ELSE 0 END,
			OverTimeHrs = 
				CASE 
				WHEN E.Overtime='N' THEN 0 
				ELSE 
					CASE 
						WHEN (SUM(DATEDIFF(n, EA.TimeIn, ISNULL(EA.TimeOut, GETDATE()))) / 60.0000) > (E.WorkingHours * E.PayFrequencyFactor) THEN 
							(SUM(DATEDIFF(n, EA.TimeIn, ISNULL(EA.TimeOut, GETDATE()))) / 60.0000) - (E.WorkingHours * E.PayFrequencyFactor) 
						ELSE 0 
					END
				END,
			HoursWorked = CAST(SUM(DATEDIFF(n, EA.TimeIn, ISNULL(EA.TimeOut, GETDATE()))) / 60.0000 AS NUMERIC(12,4)),
			MinWorked = CAST((SUM(DATEDIFF(n, EA.TimeIn, ISNULL(EA.TimeOut, GETDATE()))) / 60) % 60 AS INT),
			TotalTime = CAST(SUM(DATEDIFF(n, EA.TimeIn, ISNULL(EA.TimeOut, GETDATE()))) / 60.0000 AS NUMERIC(12,4)) + (CAST((SUM(DATEDIFF(n, EA.TimeIn, ISNULL(EA.TimeOut, GETDATE()))) / 60) % 60 AS INT) / 60.0000)
		FROM EMP_Attendance EA, 
				(SELECT EE.EmpCode, EE.DeptCode, EE.EmpCatCode, EP.Overtime, EP.WorkingHours, EP.WorkingWeekDays, EP.PerHourRate, EP.SundaysPaid, EP.HolidaysPaid, EP.PayFrequencyFactor
				FROM EMP_Employee EE LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_Pay EP ON (EE.EmpCode = EP.EmpCode)) AS E
		WHERE 
			E.EmpCode = EA.EmpCode AND
			EA.TimeIn IS NOT NULL AND 
			EA.TimeOut IS NOT NULL AND 
			EA.TimeIn >= @StartDate AND EA.TimeIn <= @EndDate
		GROUP BY 
			EA.EmpCode,
			E.Overtime,
			E.WorkingHours,
			E.WorkingWeekDays,
			E.SundaysPaid,	
			E.HolidaysPaid,
			E.PayFrequencyFactor) T
	WHERE C.EmpCatCode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_EmpCategory) AND
		D.DeptCode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_EmpDept) AND 
		E.Active = 'Y' AND
		E.EmpCatCode = C.EmpCatCode AND
		E.DeptCode = D.DeptCode AND
		E.EmpCode = P.EmpCode AND 
		E.EmpCode = T.EmpCode AND
		E.AccCode IN (SELECT A.AccCode FROM Accounts A WHERE A.Active='Y')
	UNION
	SELECT PayrollCode=@StartCode, E.EmpCode, WorkDays=0, Presents=0, Absents=0, 
		Leaves=0, PerHourRate=P.PerHourRate, BasicPay=ISNULL(P.BasicPay,0), OverTimeHours=0, 
		OverTimeRate=P.OverTimeRate, OverTime=0, 
		BonusPay=0, SpecialPay=0, AdditionalPay=0, 
		OtherPay=0, Fine=0, Penalty=0, OtherCharge=0,
		Advance= ISNULL((SELECT 
				Advance=CASE 
					WHEN T.Adv_Acc_Balance <> T.Balance THEN 
						CASE WHEN T.Adv_Acc_Balance >= T.Installment THEN T.Installment 
						ELSE T.Adv_Acc_Balance END 
					ELSE 
						CASE WHEN T.Balance >= T.Installment THEN T.Installment 
						ELSE T.Adv_Acc_Balance END
					END
			FROM
				(SELECT 
					EA.EmpAdvAccCode,
					Amount=SUM(EA.Amount), 
					ReturnedAmt=SUM(EA.ReturnedAmt), 
					Balance=SUM(EA.Amount) - SUM(EA.ReturnedAmt), 
					Installment=SUM(EA.Installment),
					Adv_Acc_Balance = ISNULL((SELECT Balance=SUM(V.Debit - V.Credit) FROM VirtualGL V WHERE AccCode=EA.EmpAdvAccCode), 0)
				FROM EMP_Advance EA
				WHERE 	EA.Amount - EA.ReturnedAmt > 0
				GROUP BY EA.EmpAdvAccCode) T
			WHERE T.EmpAdvAccCode = E.AdvAccCode), 0), 
		NetPayable=0, Sundays=0, Holidays=0, 
		E.AdvAccCode, P.PayType, HoursWorked=0
	FROM EMP_Employee E, EMP_Pay P, EMP_Category C, EMP_Department D
	WHERE C.EmpCatCode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_EmpCategory) AND
		D.DeptCode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_EmpDept) AND 
		E.Active = 'Y' AND
		E.EmpCatCode = C.EmpCatCode AND
		E.DeptCode = D.DeptCode AND
		E.EmpCode = P.EmpCode AND 
		E.EmpCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT EA.EmpCode 
			FROM EMP_Attendance EA 
			WHERE EA.TimeIn IS NOT NULL AND EA.TimeOut IS NOT NULL AND 
			EA.TimeIn >= @StartDate AND EA.TimeIn <= @EndDate) AND 
		E.AccCode IN (SELECT A.AccCode FROM Accounts A WHERE A.Active='Y')
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #TempPay 
		(PayrollCode, EmpCode, WorkDays, Presents, Absents, Leaves,
		PerHourRate, BasicPay, OverTimeHours, 
		OverTimeRate, OverTime, 
		BonusPay, SpecialPay, AdditionalPay, 
		OtherPay, Fine, Penalty, OtherCharge, Advance, 
		NetPayable, Sundays, Holidays, 
		AdvAccCode, PayType, HoursWorked)
	SELECT PayrollCode=@StartCode, E.EmpCode, WorkDays=0, Presents=0, Absents=0, Leaves=0,
		PerHourRate=P.PerHourRate, BasicPay=ISNULL(P.BasicPay,0), OverTimeHours=0, 
		OverTimeRate=P.OverTimeRate, OverTime=0, 
		BonusPay=0, SpecialPay=0, AdditionalPay=0, 
		OtherPay=0, Fine=0, Penalty=0, OtherCharge=0,
		Advance= ISNULL((SELECT 
				Advance=CASE 
					WHEN T.Adv_Acc_Balance <> T.Balance THEN 
						CASE WHEN T.Adv_Acc_Balance >= T.Installment THEN T.Installment 
						ELSE T.Adv_Acc_Balance END 
					ELSE 
						CASE WHEN T.Balance >= T.Installment THEN T.Installment 
						ELSE T.Adv_Acc_Balance END
					END
			FROM
				(SELECT 
					EA.EmpAdvAccCode,
					Amount=SUM(EA.Amount), 
					ReturnedAmt=SUM(EA.ReturnedAmt), 
					Balance=SUM(EA.Amount) - SUM(EA.ReturnedAmt), 
					Installment=SUM(EA.Installment),
					Adv_Acc_Balance = ISNULL((SELECT Balance=SUM(V.Debit - V.Credit) FROM VirtualGL V WHERE AccCode=EA.EmpAdvAccCode), 0)
				FROM EMP_Advance EA
				WHERE 	EA.Amount - EA.ReturnedAmt > 0
				GROUP BY EA.EmpAdvAccCode) T
			WHERE T.EmpAdvAccCode = E.AdvAccCode), 0), 
		NetPayable=0, Sundays=0, Holidays=0, 
		E.AdvAccCode, P.PayType, HoursWorked=0
	FROM EMP_Employee E, EMP_Pay P, EMP_Category C, EMP_Department D
	WHERE C.EmpCatCode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_EmpCategory) AND
		D.DeptCode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_EmpDept) AND 
		E.Active = 'Y' AND
		E.EmpCatCode = C.EmpCatCode AND
		E.DeptCode = D.DeptCode AND
		E.EmpCode = P.EmpCode AND 
		E.AccCode IN (SELECT A.AccCode FROM Accounts A WHERE A.Active='Y')
END

UPDATE #TempPay
SET Allowances = 
	ISNULL((SELECT Allowances=ISNULL(SUM(T.FlatAmount + ROUND((T.BasicPay * T.Percentage * 0.01), 2)), 0)
	FROM 
		(SELECT PA.*, E.BasicPay
		FROM EMP_PayAllowance PA, #TempPay E
		WHERE E.EmpCode = PA.EmpCode) T
	WHERE #TempPay.EmpCode = T.EMPCode), 0)

UPDATE #TempPay
SET Deductions = 
	ISNULL((SELECT Deductions=ISNULL(SUM(T.FlatAmount + ROUND((T.BasicPay * T.Percentage * 0.01), 2)), 0)
	FROM 
		(SELECT PD.*, E.BasicPay
		FROM EMP_PayDeduction PD, #TempPay E
		WHERE E.EmpCode = PD.EmpCode) T
	WHERE #TempPay.EmpCode = T.EMPCode), 0)

UPDATE #TempPay
SET NetPayable = ROUND(ISNULL(BasicPay,0) + ISNULL(OverTime,0) + ISNULL(BonusPay,0) + ISNULL(AdditionalPay,0) + ISNULL(OtherPay,0) - ISNULL(Fine,0) - ISNULL(Penalty,0) - ISNULL(OtherCharge,0) - ISNULL(Advance,0) + 
	ISNULL(Allowances, 0) - ISNULL(Deductions, 0), 0)

DELETE #TempPay WHERE NetPayable IS NULL
DELETE #TempPay WHERE NetPayable < 0

INSERT INTO #TempPay2 
		(PayrollCode, EmpCode, WorkDays, Presents, Absents, Leaves,
		PerHourRate, BasicPay, OverTimeHours, 
		OverTimeRate, OverTime, 
		BonusPay, SpecialPay, AdditionalPay, 
		OtherPay, Fine, Penalty, OtherCharge, Advance, 
		NetPayable, Sundays, Holidays, 
		AdvAccCode, PayType, HoursWorked)
SELECT 
		PayrollCode, EmpCode, WorkDays, Presents, Absents, Leaves,
		PerHourRate, BasicPay, OverTimeHours, 
		OverTimeRate, OverTime, 
		BonusPay, SpecialPay, AdditionalPay, 
		OtherPay, Fine, Penalty, OtherCharge, Advance, 
		NetPayable, Sundays, Holidays, 
		AdvAccCode, PayType, HoursWorked
FROM #TempPay

UPDATE #TempPay2 SET PayrollCode = PayrollCode + RowID

SET @PayslipRows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #TempPay2), 0)
IF @PayslipRows = 0
	RETURN 0

SET @EndCode = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(PayrollCode) FROM #TempPay2), @StartCode)

-- Insert Payroll Header Rows
INSERT INTO EMP_Payroll (PayrollCode,Date,UserCode,Posted,PostDate,PostedBy,LastSaved,
	FromDate,ToDate,EmpCode,WorkDays,Presents,Absents,Leaves,PerHourRate,BasicPay,
	OverTimeHours,OverTimeRate,OverTime,BonusPay,SpecialPay,AdditionalPay,OtherPay,Fine,Penalty,
	OtherCharge,Advance,NetPayable,Remarks,Paid,PaidVia,PaymentDate,PaymentRefNo,
	PaymentRemarks,PaidBy,Sundays,Holidays,HoursWorked)
SELECT PayrollCode,Date=GETDATE(),UserCode=@UserCode,Posted='N',PostDate=NULL,PostedBy=NULL,LastSaved=GETDATE(),
	FromDate=@StartDate,ToDate=@EndDate,EmpCode,WorkDays,Presents,Absents,Leaves,PerHourRate,BasicPay,
	OverTimeHours,OverTimeRate,OverTime,BonusPay,SpecialPay,AdditionalPay,OtherPay,Fine,Penalty,
	OtherCharge,Advance,NetPayable,Remarks='Auto Generated',Paid='N',PaidVia=2,PaymentDate=GETDATE(),PaymentRefNo='CASH',
	PaymentRemarks='',PaidBy=@UserCode,Sundays,Holidays,HoursWorked
FROM #TempPay2
--Insert Allowances

INSERT INTO EMP_PayrollAllowances
SELECT 
	PayrollCode = (SELECT T.PayrollCode FROM #TempPay2 T WHERE T.EmpCode=PA.EmpCode),
	PA.AllowanceCode,
	PA.AttendanceWise,
	PA.Percentage,
	PA.FlatAmount
FROM EMP_Employee E, EMP_Category C, EMP_Department D, EMP_PayAllowance PA
WHERE C.EmpCatCode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_EmpCategory) AND
	D.DeptCode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_EmpDept) AND 
	E.Active = 'Y' AND
	E.EmpCatCode = C.EmpCatCode AND
	E.DeptCode = D.DeptCode AND
	E.EmpCode = PA.EmpCode AND 
	E.EmpCode IN (SELECT TM.EmpCode FROM #TempPay2 TM)

--Insert Deductions

INSERT INTO EMP_PayrollDeductions
SELECT 
	PayrollCode = (SELECT T.PayrollCode FROM #TempPay2 T WHERE T.EmpCode=PD.EmpCode),
	PD.DeductionCode,   
	PD.Percentage,   
	PD.FlatAmount  
FROM EMP_Employee E, EMP_Category C, EMP_Department D, EMP_PayDeduction PD
WHERE C.EmpCatCode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_EmpCategory) AND
	D.DeptCode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_EmpDept) AND 
	E.Active = 'Y' AND
	E.EmpCatCode = C.EmpCatCode AND
	E.DeptCode = D.DeptCode AND
	E.EmpCode = PD.EmpCode AND 
	E.EmpCode IN (SELECT TM.EmpCode FROM #TempPay2 TM)

SET @PaySlipsGenerated = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #TempPay2), 0)

UPDATE EMP_Payroll
SET NetPayable = ROUND(ISNULL(BasicPay,0) + ISNULL(OverTime,0) + ISNULL(BonusPay,0) + ISNULL(AdditionalPay,0) + ISNULL(OtherPay,0) - ISNULL(Fine,0) - ISNULL(Penalty,0) - ISNULL(OtherCharge,0) - ISNULL(Advance,0) +
	ISNULL((SELECT Allowances=SUM(EA.FlatAmount + ROUND((E.BasicPay * EA.Percentage * 0.01), 2))
		FROM EMP_PayrollAllowances EA, Emp_Payroll E
		WHERE EA.PayrollCode=E.PayrollCode AND E.PayrollCode = EMP_Payroll.PayrollCode
		GROUP BY E.PayrollCode, E.BasicPay), 0) -
	ISNULL((SELECT Deductions=SUM(ED.FlatAmount + ROUND((E.BasicPay * ED.Percentage * 0.01), 2))
		FROM EMP_PayrollDeductions ED, Emp_Payroll E
		WHERE ED.PayrollCode=E.PayrollCode AND E.PayrollCode = EMP_Payroll.PayrollCode
		GROUP BY E.PayrollCode, E.BasicPay), 0), 0)
WHERE PayrollCode BETWEEN @StartCode AND @EndCode

EXECUTE @rt_code = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'EMP_Payroll' , @EndCode
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Updating EMP_Payroll Key Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

RETURN 0

-- SP_GenerateQuotations_From_DropBox
CREATE  PROCEDURE dbo.SP_GenerateQuotations_From_DropBox
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @UnpulledOrders INT, @UserCode SMALLINT, @MySiteCode INT, @start_no INT, @end_no INT, @errcode INT

SET @MySiteCode = (SELECT MIN(SiteCode) FROM Site WHERE InstanceID IN (SELECT Name FROM clientinstance))
IF @MySiteCode < 0 OR @MySiteCode IS NULL
	RETURN 0

SET @UnpulledOrders = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DB_PurOrderHeader WHERE Pulled='N' AND TargetSiteCode = @MySiteCode), 0)
IF @UnpulledOrders <= 0 OR @UnpulledOrders  IS NULL
	RETURN 0

SET @errcode = 0
EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'Quotation' , @start_no OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Fetching Quotation Header Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

DECLARE @header TABLE (Code INT, SiteCode INT, CustCode INT, POCode INT, RowID INT IDENTITY(1, 1))

SET @UserCode = 1

INSERT INTO @header (Code, SiteCode, CustCode, POCode)
SELECT Code=@start_no, P.SiteCode, CustCode=(SELECT MAX(C.CustCode) FROM Customer C WHERE C.SiteCode = P.SiteCode), P.POCode
FROM DB_PurOrderHeader P
WHERE P.Pulled='N' AND P.TargetSiteCode = @MySiteCode

IF @@RowCount = 0
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END

UPDATE @header SET Code = @start_no + RowID
IF @@RowCount = 0
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END

INSERT INTO QuotationHeader (QuotationCode, CustCode, SalesmanCode, date, discperc, flatdisc, misccharges, salestax, sprice, 
	ValidateUpto, Postdate, Remarks, CustRefNo, HeaderNo, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, Posted, InvGSTPerc1,
	Remarks2, Remarks3, Remarks4, Remarks5, Remarks6, Remarks7, Remarks8, Remarks9, PageSize, MessageCode,
	SManCode, LoosePack, ConsolidatedSaleOrder, Active, Locked, AutoInsertNewItems, 
	Synced, SyncedOn, SyncedBy, DeliveryDays, ValidityDays, PaymentTo)
SELECT T.Code, T.CustCode, SalesmanCode=@UserCode, Date=GETDATE(), P.DiscPerc, P.Flatdisc, P.misccharges, salestax=0, sprice=CASE WHEN C.PriceOnSale IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE C.PriceOnSale END, 
	ValidateUpto=GETDATE(), Postdate=GETDATE(), P.Remarks, CustRefNo=LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.POCode))), HeaderNo=1, OriginalDate=GETDATE(), 
	ModifiedBy=NULL, PostedBy=NULL, Posted='N', P.InvGSTPerc1,
	Remarks2=P.PurOrderTerms1, Remarks3=P.PurOrderTerms2, Remarks4=P.PurOrderTerms3, Remarks5=P.PurOrderTerms4, Remarks6=P.PurOrderTerms5, Remarks7=P.PurOrderTerms6, Remarks8=P.PurOrderTerms7, Remarks9=P.PurOrderTerms8, 
	PageSize=DBO.Fn_GetPreference('pagesize'), MessageCode=C.MessageCode,
	SManCode=C.SalesManCode, LoosePack=2, ConsolidatedSaleOrder=NULL, 
	Active='Y', Locked='N', AutoInsertNewItems='Y', 
	Synced='N', SyncedOn=NULL, SyncedBy=NULL, DeliveryDays=0, ValidityDays=0, C.PaymentAPI
FROM @header T, DB_PurOrderHeader P, Customer C
WHERE P.Pulled='N' AND P.TargetSiteCode = @MySiteCode AND T.SiteCode=P.SiteCode AND T.POCode=P.POCode AND T.CustCode=C.CustCode

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@RowCount <=0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Inserting Quotation Header Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

INSERT INTO QuotationDetail 
	(QuotationCode, ICode, Qty, PackUnits, SalePrice, DiscPerc, SalesTax, ItemFlatDisc, Bonusqty,
	GSTPerc, UnitSalesTax, ItemDescription, Gcode, RemoteNetSaleQty, RemoteStock, PORAte, PODiscPerc, 
	SpecialRate, RefNo, ClaimableDiscPerc, Color, Remote_ReOrderQty, Remote_OptimumQty, Remote_MinQty, Remote_POQty)
SELECT QuotationCode=T.Code, D.ICode, D.Qty, I.PackUnits, I.SalePrice, D.DiscPerc, SalesTax=0, D.ItemFlatDisc, D.Bonusqty,
	D.GSTPerc, D.PackSalesTax, ItemDescription=I.Name, Gcode=1, RemoteNetSaleQty=ISNULL(D.SoldQty - D.ReturnQty, 0), RemoteStock=ISNULL(D.Stock,0), PORAte=D.Rate, PODiscPerc=D.DiscPerc, 
	SpecialRate=D.Rate, RefNo=NULL, ClaimableDiscPerc=0, Color=NULL, D.ReOrderQty, D.OptimumQty, D.MinQty, ISNULL(POQty,0)
FROM DB_PurOrderDetail D, @header T, Item I
WHERE (D.Qty + D.Bonusqty) > 0 AND D.SiteCode = T.SiteCode AND D.POCode = T.POCode AND D.ICode = I.ICode
ORDER BY
	D.POCode, D.PORowID

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT <= 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Inserting Quotation Detail Rows', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @end_no = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(Code) FROM @header), 0)

EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'Quotation' , @end_no
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Updating Quotation Header Key Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

UPDATE QuotationHeader 
SET InvTotal = dbo.fn_GetQuotationTotal(@end_no)
WHERE QuotationCode BETWEEN @start_no AND @end_no

UPDATE DB_PurOrderHeader
SET Pulled='Y', PulledOn=GETDATE(), PulledBy=@UserCode
WHERE Pulled='N' AND TargetSiteCode = @MySiteCode AND 
	STR(POCode,10) + STR(SiteCode, 10) IN (SELECT STR(T.POCode,10) + STR(T.SiteCode, 10) FROM @header T)
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT <= 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Updating P/O Status in Drop Box', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

RETURN 0
