-- sp_GenerateReceipt
CREATE Procedure dbo.sp_GenerateReceipt 
	@ProdCode Int, 
	@UserCode Int, 
	@HeaderNo Int, 
	@serverdate DateTime, 
	@IssueInvCode INT,
	@ReceiptInvCode Int OutPut 
As
Declare @Code Int, @deptcode Int, @category smallint, @module SmallInt, @utn Int, @HeaderInvNo Int, @ReceiptCode INT
Declare @IssueType SmallInt, @PriceType SmallInt, @priority SmallInt, @GodownStrategy SMALLINT, @GroupCode INT, @cracccode smallint
Declare @ICode Int, @GCode Int, @packunits Int, @AreaCode Int
Declare @GivenQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @TotalQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @CurrQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @DelQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @BatchQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @ReqQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @NewQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @TotStock NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @Price Numeric(12,2), @PurPrice Numeric(12,2), @SalePrice Numeric(12,2), @Hold_AvgPrice Numeric(15,5), @RecentPurPrice Numeric(12,2), @NewAvgPrice NUMERIC(15,5)
Declare @batch VarChar(100), @ItemName VarChar(100), @UpdateAvgPrice CHAR(1)
Declare @Items_Rows Int, @Counter Int, @RowCount Int, @TotalRows Int, @continue Int, @Err Int, @rt_code Int 
Declare @expiry DateTime, @RecomputeCost CHAR(1), @AutoPost CHAR(1), @AccountFor CHAR(1)

/*
Author: M.Usman, Azhar
Purpose:This Stored Procedure takes an argument of Production Code (@ProdCode)
	and against that Production Code it generates Receipt Invoice Auto Posted.
*/
Set @continue = 0
Set @DeptCode = ISNULL((SELECT ReceiptDeptCode FROM ProdHeader WHERE ProdCode = @ProdCode), 1)
Set @AreaCode = 1 /* Default Selection */
Set @module = ( Select Module From Module Where Lower(Name) = 'receipt' ) 
Set @pricetype = DBO.Fn_Get_INT_Preference('ReceiptPriceTypeCode')
SET @GroupCode = ISNULL((SELECT MIN(GroupCode) FROM UserGroups WHERE UserCode=@UserCode), 1)
SET @Category = 2 -- Production
SET @AccountFor = ISNULL((SELECT AccountFor FROM ReceiptCategory WHERE ReceiptCategoryCode=@Category), 'N')
IF @AccountFor = 'Y'
	SET @cracccode = ISNULL((SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name='GT_WIPAcc'), 33) -- cr wor in process a/c
ELSE
	SET @cracccode = NULL

IF @GroupCode > 0 
	SET @GodownStrategy = ISNULL((SELECT ReceiptGodownStrategy FROM Groups WHERE GroupCode=@GroupCode), 1)
ELSE
	SET @GodownStrategy = 1

IF @GodownStrategy = 1
	Set @GCode = ( Select ReceiptGCode From ProdHeader Where ProdCode = @ProdCode )

Set @batch = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('defaultbatch')
Set @expiry = DBO.Fn_Get_DateTime_Preference('defaultexpiry')
SET @UpdateAvgPrice = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('UpdAvgPriceInReceipt')
Set @priority = 10
Set @RecomputeCost = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('ReComputeCostInProduction')
SET @AutoPost = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('AutoPostReceiptOnProdPost')
IF @AutoPost IS NULL
	SET @AutoPost = 'Y'

Declare Cursor_Items Cursor Forward_Only Static
FOR	Select			
	PD.ICode As ICode, 
	PD.Batch, PD.Expiry,
	Sum(PD.Qty) As Qty , 
	Max(I.PackUnits) As PackUnits ,
	Round(Max(I.PurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) As PurPrice ,
	Round(Max(I.SalePrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) As SalePrice ,
	Round(Max(I.RecentPurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) As RecentPurPrice ,
	CASE WHEN @IssueInvCode > 0 THEN 
		CASE @RecomputeCost
			WHEN 'Y' THEN 
				ROUND((SELECT SUM(ISD.Qty * ISD.Price) FROM IssueDetail ISD, RecipeDetail RD WHERE ISD.IssueInvCode = @IssueInvCode AND R.RecipeCode = RD.RecipeCode AND RD.ICode = ISD.ICode) / CASE WHEN Sum(PD.Qty) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE Sum(PD.Qty) END , 2)
			ELSE 
				CASE @pricetype WHEN 1 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 2 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice2)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 3 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice3)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 4 THEN Round(Max(I.PurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 5 THEN Round(Max(I.RecentPurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 6 THEN Round(Max(I.AvgPrice), 2) WHEN 7 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice4)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 8 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice5)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) END 
		END
	ELSE
		CASE @pricetype WHEN 1 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 2 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice2)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 3 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice3)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 4 THEN Round(Max(I.PurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 5 THEN Round(Max(I.RecentPurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 6 THEN Round(Max(I.AvgPrice), 2) WHEN 7 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice4)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 8 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice5)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) END 
	END As Price
From  	Recipe R, 
	(
	Select ICode, Qty, Batch, Expiry
	From   ProdDetail
	Where  ProdDetail.ProdCode = @ProdCode
	) PD, Item I
Where   R.ResultedItem = PD.ICode AND
	PD.ICode = I.ICode AND
	R.Priority = ( Select Min(Priority) From Recipe Where ResultedItem = PD.ICode )
Group By PD.ICode, PD.Batch, PD.Expiry, R.RecipeCode

Open Cursor_Items
Set @Items_Rows = @@Cursor_Rows
IF @Items_Rows > 0 
Begin
	Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'ReceiptHeader' , @Code Output
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	Begin
		Set @continue  = -1
	End
	Else
	Begin
		Set @ReceiptInvCode = @Code
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno , @module,  @headerinvno Output 
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
		Else
		Begin
			Set @ReceiptCode = NULL
			Execute @rt_code = sp_GetReceiptCategoryCounter @Category , @ReceiptCode  Output 
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
			Begin
				Set @continue  = -1
			End
			Else
			Begin
				Insert Into ReceiptHeader (ReceiptInvCode, DeptCode, Date, OriginalDate, SalesManCode, Posted, PostDate, PostedBy, AreaCode, HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo, PriceTypeCode, Remarks, ReceiptCategoryCode, AccountFor, CrAccCode, ReceiptCode)
				Values (@Code, @deptcode, @serverdate, @serverdate, @usercode, @AutoPost, @serverdate, @usercode, @AreaCode, @headerno, @headerinvno, @pricetype, 'SYSTEM GENERATED RECEIPT', @Category, @AccountFor, @CrAccCode, @ReceiptCode)
				Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
				IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
				Begin 
					RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Receipt Header : %d' ,16,1,  @Code  )
					Set @continue  = -1
				End 
				Else
				Begin
					Fetch Next From Cursor_Items
					Into @icode, @Batch, @Expiry, @givenqty, @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice, @price
					While @@Fetch_Status = 0 AND @continue >= 0
					Begin
						IF @GodownStrategy = 2
							SET @Gcode = ISNULL((SELECT GCode FROM Item WHERE ICode=@icode), 1)
	
						Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
						IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
						Begin
							Set @continue  = -1
						End
						Else
						Begin
							Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @utn OutPut
							IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
							Begin
								Set @continue  = -1															
							End 									
							Set @packunits = Case When @packunits Is Null Then 1 When @packunits = 0 Then 1 Else @packunits End
	
							Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemStockAll @ICode, @TotStock OutPut
							IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
							Begin
								Set @continue  = -1															
							End
	
							IF @UpdateAvgPrice = 'Y'
							BEGIN
								SET	@NewAvgPrice = ISNULL((SELECT ROUND(((@TotStock * @hold_avgprice) + (@givenqty * @price)) / (@givenqty + @TotStock), 5) ), 0)
								IF @AutoPost='Y'
								BEGIN
									Execute @rt_code = sp_UpdateItemAvgPrice @ICode, @NewAvgPrice
									IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
									Begin
										Set @continue  = -1															
									End
								END
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								SET @NewAvgPrice = @hold_avgprice
							END
	
							IF @continue <> -1
							BEGIN
								Insert Into ReceiptDetail (ReceiptInvCode, GCode, ICode, Batch, Expiry, Qty, Priority, SalePrice, PurchasePrice, AvgPrice, PackUnits, MRPP, ReceiptUtn, Price, UpdateAvgPrice, NewAvgPrice, CurrStock )
								Values(@Code, @GCode, @ICode, @batch, @expiry, @givenqty, @priority, @saleprice, @purprice, @hold_avgprice, @packunits, @recentpurprice, @utn, @price, @UpdateAvgPrice, @NewAvgPrice, @TotStock )
								Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
								IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
								Begin 
									RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Receipt Detail for Production : %d' ,16,1,  @ProdCode  )
									Set @continue  = -1
								End 							
								Else
								Begin
									IF @AutoPost = 'Y'
									BEGIN
										Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @currqty Output
										IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
										Begin
											Set @continue  = -1																	
										End 
										Else
										Begin
											Set @newqty = @currqty + @givenqty	
											Execute @rt_code = sp_UpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty
											IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
											Begin
												Set @continue  = -1								
											End
										End
									END
								End
							END
						End
						Fetch Next From Cursor_Items
						Into @icode, @Batch, @Expiry, @givenqty , @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice, @price
	
					End
				End
			End
		End
	End	
End

Close Cursor_Items
Deallocate Cursor_Items

IF @continue <> 0 
Begin
	Return -1
End
Else
Begin 
	Return 0
End

name: sp_GenerateReceipt_On_ProdunctionNote
definition:
-- sp_GenerateReceipt_On_ProdunctionNote
CREATE    Procedure sp_GenerateReceipt_On_ProdunctionNote
	@ProdNoteCode Int, 
	@UserCode Int, 
	@ReceiptInvCode Int OutPut 
As
Declare @Code Int, @RowID INT, @deptcode Int, @module SmallInt, @category SmallInt, @utn Int, @HeaderInvNo Int
Declare @IssueType SmallInt, @PriceType SmallInt, @priority SmallInt, @HeaderNo Int, @ReceiptCode INT, @cracccode smallint
Declare @ICode Int, @GCode Int, @packunits Int, @AreaCode Int, @TotalPieces INT, @PiecesInHand INT
Declare @GivenQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @TotalQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @CurrQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @DelQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @BatchQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @ReqQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @NewQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @TotStock NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @Price Numeric(12,2), @PurPrice Numeric(12,2), @SalePrice Numeric(12,2), @Hold_AvgPrice Numeric(15,5), @RecentPurPrice Numeric(12,2), @NewAvgPrice NUMERIC(15,5), @NetRate NUMERIC(15,5)
Declare @batch VarChar(100), @ItemName VarChar(100), @UpdateAvgPrice CHAR(1), @errtext VARCHAR(4000)
Declare @Items_Rows Int, @Counter Int, @RowCount Int, @TotalRows Int, @continue Int, @Err Int, @rt_code Int 
Declare @expiry DateTime, @serverdate DateTime, @RecomputeCost CHAR(1), @AccountFor CHAR(1)

/*
Author: M.Azhar Inayat
Purpose:This Stored Procedure takes an argument of Production Note Code (@ProdNoteCode)
and against that Production Note it generates Receipt Invoice Auto Posted.
*/
Set @continue = 0
Set @DeptCode = ISNULL((SELECT ReceiptDeptCode FROM ProdNote WHERE ProdNoteCode=@ProdNoteCode), 1)
Set @HeaderNo = 1
Set @AreaCode = 1 /* Default Selection */
Set @module = ( Select Module From Module Where Lower(Name) = 'receipt' ) 
Set @pricetype = DBO.Fn_Get_INT_Preference('ReceiptPriceTypeCode')
Set @batch = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('defaultbatch')
Set @expiry = DBO.Fn_Get_DateTime_Preference('defaultexpiry')
SET @UpdateAvgPrice = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('UpdAvgPriceInReceipt')
Set @priority = 10
Set @RecomputeCost = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('ReComputeCostInProduction')
SET @serverdate = GETDATE()
SET @Category = 2 -- Production
SET @AccountFor = ISNULL((SELECT AccountFor FROM ReceiptCategory WHERE ReceiptCategoryCode=@Category), 'N')
IF @AccountFor = 'Y'
	SET @cracccode = ISNULL((SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name='GT_WIPAcc'), 33) -- cr wor in process a/c
ELSE
	SET @cracccode = NULL

Declare Cursor_Items Cursor Forward_Only Static
FOR	Select			
		PNR.ICode, PNR.GCode, PNR.Batch, PNR.Expiry,
		SUM(PNR.TotalPieces) AS TotalPieces,
		Sum(PNR.Qty) As Qty, PNR.PackUnits,
		Round(Max(I.PurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) As PurPrice ,
		Round(Max(I.SalePrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) As SalePrice ,
		Round(Max(I.RecentPurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) As RecentPurPrice ,
		CASE @pricetype WHEN 1 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 2 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice2)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 3 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice3)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 4 THEN Round(Max(I.PurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 5 THEN Round(Max(I.RecentPurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 6 THEN Round(Max(I.AvgPrice), 2) WHEN 7 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice4)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 8 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice5)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) END As Price,
		PNR.RowID
	From  	ProdNoteReceipt PNR, Item I
	Where   PNR.ProdNoteCode = @ProdNoteCode AND
		PNR.ICode = I.ICode
	Group By PNR.ICode, PNR.GCode, PNR.Batch, PNR.Expiry, PNR.PackUnits, PNR.RowID

Open Cursor_Items
Set @Items_Rows = @@Cursor_Rows
IF @Items_Rows > 0 
Begin
	Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'ReceiptHeader' , @Code Output
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	Begin
		Set @continue  = -1
	End
	Else
	Begin
		Set @ReceiptInvCode = @Code
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno , @module,  @headerinvno Output 
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
		Else
		Begin
			Set @ReceiptCode = NULL
			Execute @rt_code = sp_GetReceiptCategoryCounter @Category , @ReceiptCode  Output 
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
			Begin
				Set @continue  = -1
			End
			Else
			Begin
				Insert Into ReceiptHeader (ReceiptInvCode, DeptCode, Date, OriginalDate, SalesManCode, Posted, PostDate, PostedBy, AreaCode, HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo, PriceTypeCode, Remarks, RecipientCode, ReceiptCategoryCode, AccountFor, CrAccCode, ReceiptCode, QE1_AccCode, QE2_AccCode, QE3_AccCode, QE4_AccCode, QE5_AccCode, WE1_AccCode, WE2_AccCode, WE3_AccCode, WE4_AccCode, WE5_AccCode, QExp1_CrAccCode, QExp2_CrAccCode, QExp3_CrAccCode, QExp4_CrAccCode, QExp5_CrAccCode, WExp1_CrAccCode, WExp2_CrAccCode, WExp3_CrAccCode, WExp4_CrAccCode, WExp5_CrAccCode)
				SELECT @Code, @deptcode, @serverdate, @serverdate, @usercode, 'Y', @serverdate, @usercode, @AreaCode, @headerno, @headerinvno, @pricetype, 'PRODUCTION NOTE BASED RECEIPT', 1, @Category, @AccountFor, @CrAccCode, @ReceiptCode, QE1_AccCode, QE2_AccCode, QE3_AccCode, QE4_AccCode, QE5_AccCode, WE1_AccCode, WE2_AccCode, WE3_AccCode, WE4_AccCode, WE5_AccCode, QExp1_CrAccCode, QExp2_CrAccCode, QExp3_CrAccCode, QExp4_CrAccCode, QExp5_CrAccCode, WExp1_CrAccCode, WExp2_CrAccCode, WExp3_CrAccCode, WExp4_CrAccCode, WExp5_CrAccCode
				FROM ProdNote
				WHERE ProdNoteCode = @ProdNoteCode
				Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
				IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
				Begin 
					RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Receipt Header : %d' ,16,1,  @Code  )
					Set @continue  = -1
				End 
				Else
				Begin
					Fetch Next From Cursor_Items
					Into @icode, @gcode, @Batch, @Expiry, @TotalPieces, @givenqty, @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice, @price, @RowID
					While @@Fetch_Status = 0 AND @continue >= 0
					Begin
						Set @itemname = (Select name from item where icode = @icode )
						Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
						IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
						Begin
							SET @errtext = 'Unable to aquire item lock for item = ' + @itemname
							Set @continue  = -1
						End
	 					ELSE
	 					BEGIN
	 						Execute @rt_code = SP_GetItemTotalPiecesInHand @icode, @piecesinhand OutPut
	 						IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
	 						Begin
	 							SET @errtext = 'Unable to fetch total pieces in hand for item = ' + @itemname
	 							Set @continue  = -1
	 						End
	 						Else
	 						BEGIN
								Execute @rt_code = SP_UpdateItemTotalPiecesInHand @icode, 1, @totalpieces
								IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
								Begin
									SET @errtext = 'Error Updating pieces in hand for item = ' + @itemname
									Set @continue  = -1
								End
	 						END
	 					END
	 					IF @continue >= 0
						Begin
							Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @utn OutPut
							IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
							Begin
								Set @continue  = -1															
							End 									
							Set @packunits = Case When @packunits Is Null Then 1 When @packunits = 0 Then 1 Else @packunits End
	
							Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemStockAll @ICode, @TotStock OutPut
							IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
							Begin
								Set @continue  = -1															
							End
	
							IF @UpdateAvgPrice = 'Y'
							BEGIN
								SET @NetRate = ISNULL((SELECT ROUND((((Qty * Price) + (Qty * (QE1 + QE2 + QE3 + QE4 + QE5)) + (Qty * UnitWeight * (WE1 + WE2 + WE3 + WE4 + WE5))) / CASE WHEN Qty = 0 THEN 1 ELSE Qty END), 5) FROM ProdNoteReceipt WHERE ProdNoteCode = @ProdNoteCode AND RowID = @RowID), 0)
								SET @NewAvgPrice = ISNULL((SELECT ROUND(((@TotStock * @hold_avgprice) + (@givenqty * @NetRate)) / (@givenqty + @TotStock), 5) ), 0)
								Execute @rt_code = sp_UpdateItemAvgPrice @ICode, @NewAvgPrice
								IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
								Begin
									Set @continue  = -1															
								End
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								SET @NewAvgPrice = @hold_avgprice
							END
	
							IF @continue <> -1
							BEGIN
								Insert Into ReceiptDetail (ReceiptInvCode, GCode, ICode, Batch, Expiry, Qty, Priority, SalePrice, PurchasePrice, AvgPrice, PackUnits, MRPP, ReceiptUtn, Price, UpdateAvgPrice, NewAvgPrice, CurrStock, TotalPieces, PiecesInHand, UnitWeight, QE1, QE2, QE3, QE4, QE5, WE1, WE2, WE3, WE4, WE5)
								SELECT @Code, @GCode, @ICode, @batch, @expiry, @givenqty, @priority, @saleprice, @purprice, @hold_avgprice, @packunits, @recentpurprice, @utn, @price, @UpdateAvgPrice, @NewAvgPrice, @TotStock , @TotalPieces, @PiecesInHand, UnitWeight, QE1, QE2, QE3, QE4, QE5, WE1, WE2, WE3, WE4, WE5
								FROM ProdNoteReceipt
								WHERE ProdNoteCode = @ProdNoteCode AND RowID = @RowID
								Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
								IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
								Begin 
									RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Receipt Detail for Production : %d', 16, 1, @ProdNoteCode)
									Set @continue  = -1
								End 							
								Else
								Begin
									Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @currqty Output
									IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
									Begin
										Set @continue  = -1																	
									End 
									Else
									Begin
										Set @newqty = @currqty + @givenqty	
										Execute @rt_code = sp_UpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty
										IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
										Begin
											Set @continue  = -1								
										End
									End
								End
							END
						End
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							RaisError(@errtext, 16 , 1)
							Set @continue  = -1								
						END
						Fetch Next From Cursor_Items
						Into @icode, @GCode, @Batch, @Expiry, @totalpieces, @givenqty , @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice, @price, @RowID
	
					End
				End
			End
		End
	End	
End

Close Cursor_Items
Deallocate Cursor_Items

IF @continue <> 0 
Begin
	Return -1
End
Else
Begin 
	Return 0
End

name: sp_GenerateSale_From_PreSales
definition:
-- sp_GenerateSale_From_PreSales
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_GenerateSale_From_PreSales
	@PreSaleInvCode INT,
	@UserCode SMALLINT,
	@NewSaleInvCode INT OUTPUT
AS

Declare @module Int, @headerinvno Int, @continue Int, @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @totalrows Int, @rowcount Int, @counter Int
Declare @SaleInvCode Int, @HeaderInvCode INT
Declare @saleprice Numeric(12,2), @rate Numeric(12,2), @discperc Numeric(5,2), @itemflatdisc Numeric(15,2), @unitsalestax Numeric(12,2), @gstperc1 Numeric(6,2), @gstperc2 Numeric(6,2), @hold_avgprice Numeric(15,5)
Declare @icode Int, @gcode int, @packunits Int
Declare @totalstock NUMERIC(15, 4), @totalqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @looseQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @BonusQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @totalbatchqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @delqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @currqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @newqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @balancestock NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @batch VarChar(100), @itemname VarChar(60), @expiry DateTime, @serverdate DateTime
Declare @saleutn BigInt, @custcode SMALLINT, @itemdescription VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @Headerno INT, @MachineName VARCHAR(100)
Declare @rowgroup Int, @innercounter Int

Set @custcode = ISNULL((SELECT Custcode FROM PreSaleHeader WHERE PreSaleInvCode=@presaleinvcode), 19)
SET @Headerno = 1
Set @module = ( Select module from module where name = 'Sales' )
Set @serverdate = GETDATE()
SET @MachineName = LEFT(@@ServerName, 15)

Create Table #saletemp ( id int not null identity(1,1), icode Int , gcode smallint, batch varchar(100), expiry datetime, looseqty Int, bonusqty Int, SalePrice  Numeric(12,2), DiscPerc Numeric(8,2), ItemFlatDisc Numeric(12,2), UnitSalesTax Numeric(12,2), GstPerc Numeric(6,2), itemdescription varchar(100) )
Insert Into #saletemp ( icode, gcode, batch, expiry, looseqty, bonusqty , saleprice, discperc, itemflatdisc, unitsalestax, gstperc , itemdescription )
Select icode, gcode, batch, expiry, qty, 0, saleprice, discperc, itemflatdisc=0, unitsalestax=0, gstperc=0, itemdescription
From PreSaleDetail
Where PreSaleInvCode = @PreSaleInvCode AND (Qty + BonusQty) > 0
Order By rowid

Set @totalrows = ISNULL((Select count(*) from #SaleTemp), 0)
Set @continue = 0
Set @rowgroup = 0

IF @totalrows > 0 And @continue >= 0
Begin
	Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'Saleledger' , @SaleInvCode Output
	Set @rowgroup = 0
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	Begin
		Set @continue  = -1
	End

	SET @NewSaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode
	IF @continue >= 0
	Begin
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno , @module,  @headerinvno Output 
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
	END

	IF @continue >= 0
	Begin
		Set @Err = 0 
		Set @RowCount = 1

		Insert Into SaleLedger (SaleInvCode, SaleCatCode, CustCode, SalesmanCode, Date, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SalesTax, Posted, PostDate, 
			Remarks, CustRefNo, Headerno, headerinvno, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, SPrice, QuotationNo, DoctCode, PatientCode, 
			RePrintingCounter, CashReceived, InvGSTPerc1, PrintWaranty, PrintBatch, MessageCode, SManCode, InvoiceSize, CustRefno2, CustRefno3,
			CustRefno4, GSTNO, InvTotal, MachineName, ModifyCounter, ItemDiscPercNo, RelationCode, DiseaseCode, WardCode, AdmissionCode, 
			ReturnCounter, Paid, BillingDate, UnReceivedBalance, TotalOfSaleReturns, ListOfSrInvoices, printbalance, AccountFor, PaymentMode, 
			PaymentAccCode, Amt, AmtBY, AmtDate, AmtReference, OutstandingAmt, Marked, Transferable, Transfered, TransferedOn, TransferedBy, 
			Imported, ImportedBy, deliveredby, SaleTypeCode, Balance, PptCustCode, DELETED, PresCode, ImpactInventory, SaleOrderCode, 
			SaleComments1, SaleComments2, AlterSaleInvCode, RecurringInvoice, RecurringPeriod, LastRecurringInvCode, RecurringAgainst, ConsiderInPO, VisitCode, DueDate, SRBufferInvCode, CustRefNo5, 
			SuppInvCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo)
		SELECT @SaleInvCode, SaleCatCode=2, @CustCode, @UserCode, Date=GETDATE(), DiscPerc=0, FlatDisc=0, MiscCharges=0, SalesTax=0, Posted='Y', PostDate=GETDATE(), 
			Remarks, CustRefNo, @HeaderNo, @HeaderInvCode, Date=GETDATE(), ModifiedBy=NULL, PostedBy=@UserCode, Sprice=1,  QuotationCode=NULL, DoctCode=NULL, PatientCode=NULL, 
			RePrintingCounter=0, CashReceived=0, InvGSTPerc1=0, Printwaranty='N', PrintBatch='N', MessageCode=1, SManCode=NULL, InvoiceSize='F', CustRefno2, CustRefno3, 
			CustRefno4, GSTNO=1, InvTotal=0, @MachineName, ModifyCounter=NULL, ItemDiscPercNo=1, RelationCode=NULL, DiseaseCode=NULL, WardCode=NULL, AdmissionCode=NULL,
			ReturnCounter=0, Paid='N', BillingDate=OrderDate, UnreceivedBalance=0, TotalOfSaleReturns=0, '', 'Y', 'Y', PaymentMode='C', 
			PaymentAccCode=2, Amt=0, AmtBY=NULL, AmtDate=GETDATE(), AmtReference=NULL, OutStandingAmt = 0, Marked='N', Transferable='N', Transfered='N', TransferedOn=NULL, TransferedBy=NULL, 
			Imported='N', ImportedBy=NULL, DeliveredBy=NULL, SaleTypeode=1, Balance=0, PptCustCode=NULL, Deleted='N', PresCode=NULL, ImpactInventory='Y', SaleOrderCode=NULL, 
			SaleComments1=(SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference('SaleComments1')), SaleComments2=(SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference('SaleComments2')), 
			AlterSaleInvCode=NULL, RecurringInvoice='N', RecurringPeriod=0, 
			LastRecurringInvCode=NULL, RecurringAgainst=NULL, ConsiderInPO='Y', VisitCode=NULL, DueDate=GETDATE(), SRBufferInvCode=NULL, CustRefNo5=NULL, 
			SuppInvCode=NULL, GRN=NULL, GCCode=NULL, Vehicle=NULL, ShipTo=NULL
		FROM PreSaleHeader
		WHERE PreSaleInvCode = @PreSaleInvCode

		Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount

		IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
		Begin 
			RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Ledger : %d' ,16,1,  @SaleInvCode )
			Set @continue  = -1
		End 
		ELSE
		Begin
			Set @innercounter = 1
			While ( @innercounter <= @totalrows ) AND ( @continue >= 0 )
			Begin
				Select @icode = icode , @Gcode = Gcode, @Batch=Batch, @Expiry=Expiry, @looseqty = looseqty, @bonusqty = bonusqty, @saleprice = saleprice, @discperc = discperc,  @itemflatdisc = itemflatdisc, @unitsalestax = unitsalestax, @gstperc1 = gstperc, @itemdescription=itemdescription
				From #saletemp
		        Where id = @innercounter

				Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
				SET @totalqty = @looseqty + @bonusqty
				IF @totalqty > 0 AND @RowCount > 0 AND @Err = 0
				Begin
					Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
					IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
					Begin
						Set @continue = -1
					End
					ELSE
					Begin
						Set @totalstock = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and godowndetail.icode = @icode  )
						Set @totalbatchqty = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and godowndetail.icode = @icode and godowndetail.Batch = @batch and godowndetail.Expiry = @expiry)
						IF @totalbatchqty >= @totalqty
						Begin 
							Set @newqty = @totalbatchqty - @totalqty
							IF @newqty > 0
								Execute @rt_code = sp_SaleUpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty , @totalbatchqty
							Else
								Execute @rt_code = sp_DeleteItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @totalqty
	
							IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
							Begin
								Set @continue  = -1								
							End
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								Set @rowgroup = @rowgroup + 1
								Select @rate = saleprice, @packunits = packunits
								From ITEM
								Where icode = @icode
			
								IF @packunits = 0 OR @packunits Is Null 
									Set @packunits = 1
		
								Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @saleutn Output
								IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
								Begin
									Set @continue  = -1															
								End
								ELSE
								BEGIN
									Insert Into SaleDetail (SaleInvCode, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, packqty, looseqty, bonusqty, packunits, saleprice, avgprice, rate, discperc, salestax, itemflatdisc, packprice, unitsalestax, gstperc, saleutn, balancestock, rowgroup, saleitemdescription)
									Values (@saleinvcode, @icode, @gcode, @batch, @expiry, 0, @looseqty, @bonusqty, @packunits, @saleprice, @hold_avgprice, @rate / @packunits, @discperc, 0, @itemflatdisc, @rate, @unitsalestax, @gstperc1, @saleutn, 0, @rowgroup, @itemdescription)
									Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
									IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
									Begin 
										RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Detail for Sale Inv. No. : %d' ,16,1, @SaleInvCode  )
										Set @continue  = -1
									End
								END
							END						END
						ELSE
						Begin
							Set @itemname = (Select name from item where icode = @icode )	
							RaisError( 'Not enough stock for item (%s) to decrease for Sale Inv. No : %d' , 16 , 1, @itemname, @SaleInvCode  )
							Set @continue  = -1								
						End
					END
				End
				Set @innercounter = @innercounter + 1
			End

			IF ( @continue >= 0 ) and @innercounter > @totalrows
			Begin
				Update Saleledger 
				Set InvTotal = ISNULL(dbo.fn_getSaleInvTotal (Saleledger.saleinvcode), 0), OutStandingAmt=ISNULL(dbo.fn_getSaleInvTotal (Saleledger.saleinvcode), 0)
				Where saleinvcode = @saleinvcode
			
				Select @Err = @@Error, @Rowcount = @@RowCount
				IF  @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0
				Begin
					RaisError( 'Unable to update Sale Inv. total for Sale Invoice %d' , @saleinvcode, 16 , 1 )
					Set @continue  = -1									
				End
			
				IF ( @continue >= 0 )
				BEGIN
					Update PreSaleHeader 
					SET Posted = 'Y', POSTDATE=GETDATE(), PostedBy = @UserCode, SaleInvCode=@SaleInvCode
					WHERE PreSaleInvCode = @PreSaleInvCode
			
					Select @Err = @@Error, @Rowcount = @@RowCount
					IF  @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0
					BEGIN 
						RaisError( 'Unable to update Sale Order Status (Inv. No. %d)' , @PreSaleInvCode, 16 , 1 )
						Set @continue  = -1									
					END
				END
			
			End
		End
	End
End

Drop Table #saletemp

Return @continue

-- sp_GenerateSale_From_SaleOrder
CREATE  Procedure sp_GenerateSale_From_SaleOrder 
	@SaleOrderCode INT, 
	@UserCode SMALLINT, 
	@NewSaleInvCode INT OUTPUT 
AS
Declare @module Int, @custcode Int, @saletypecode SmallInt, @salecatcode Int, @headerinvno Int, @continue Int, @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @totalrows Int, @rowcount Int, @invcounter Int, @counter Int
Declare @SaleInvCode Int, @looseqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @satisfiableqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @satisfiedqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @ItemAdvanceTaxPerc NUMERIC(5, 2)
Declare @saleprice Numeric(12,2), @rate Numeric(12,2), @discperc Numeric(5,2), @Claimable CHAR(1), @claimableDiscPerc Numeric(6,2), @itemflatdisc Numeric(12,2), @unitsalestax Numeric(12,2), @gstperc1 Numeric(6,2), @gstperc2 Numeric(6,2), @hold_avgprice Numeric(15,5)
Declare @icode Int, @anyitem_exist Int, @packunits Int, @finalized CHAR(1), @posted CHAR(1)
Declare @totalqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @givenqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @reqqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @batchqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @delqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @currqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @newqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @total_availablestock NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @batch VarChar(100), @itemname VarChar(60), @expiry DateTime, @serverdate DateTime, @machinename varchar(15)
Declare @saleutn BigInt, @firsttime Bit, @Headerno Smallint, @gcode SMALLINT, @SOCatCode SMALLINT
Declare @saleorder_rowcount Int, @invdetail_exist Int, @rowgroup Int, @lineitems_rowcount Int, @innercounter Int, @saleitemdescription varchar(100)

/*
SET @finalized = ISNULL((SELECT Finalized FROM SaleOrderHeader WHERE SaleOrderCode=@SaleOrderCode), 'N')
IF @finalized <> 'Y'
BEGIN
	RaisError( 'Sale Order is Not Finalized, Please Finalize first' ,16,1)
	RETURN -1
END
*/

SET @posted = ISNULL((SELECT Posted FROM SaleOrderHeader WHERE SaleOrderCode=@SaleOrderCode), 'N')
IF @posted = 'Y'
BEGIN
	RaisError( 'Sale Order is Already Posted, Can not post again.' ,16,1)
	RETURN -1
END

Set @firsttime = 0
Set @custcode = 19
Set @salecatcode = 3 
Set @saletypecode = 2
Set @module = ( Select module from module where name = 'Sales' )
Set @serverdate = GETDATE()
SET @SOCatCode = ISNULL((SELECT SOCatCode FROM SaleOrderHeader WHERE SaleOrderCode=@SaleOrderCode), 1)

Create Table #saletemp ( id int not null identity(1,1), icode Int , gcode smallint, looseqty NUMERIC(15, 4), satisfiableqty NUMERIC(15, 4), satisfiedqty NUMERIC(15, 4), SalePrice  Numeric(12,2), DiscPerc Numeric(8,2), Claimable CHAR(1), ClaimableDiscPerc Numeric(8,2), ItemFlatDisc Numeric(12,2), UnitSalesTax Numeric(12,2), GstPerc Numeric(6,2) , saleitemdescription varchar(100), ItemAdvanceTaxPerc NUMERIC(5,2), rowid int)

Insert Into #saletemp ( icode, gcode, looseqty, satisfiableqty, satisfiedqty , saleprice, discperc, claimable, claimablediscperc, itemflatdisc, unitsalestax, gstperc , saleitemdescription, ItemAdvanceTaxPerc, rowid)
Select icode, gcode, sum(looseqty), sum(looseqty), 0, max(saleprice), max(discperc), max(claimable), max(claimablediscperc), max(itemflatdisc), max(unitsalestax), max(gstperc), saleitemdescription, max(ItemAdvanceTaxPerc), rowid=MAX(rowId)
From SaleOrderDetail
Where SaleOrderCode = @SaleOrderCode
group by icode, gcode, saleitemdescription 
Order By rowid

Set @saleorder_rowcount = (Select count(icode) from SaleOrderDetail where saleordercode = @saleordercode) + 1
Set @anyitem_exist  = ( Select Sum(Satisfiableqty - Satisfiedqty) from #saletemp )
Set @continue = 0
Set @invcounter = 1
Set @invdetail_exist = 1
Set @rowgroup = 0
SET @Headerno = ( Select HeaderNo from SaleOrderHeader WHERE SaleOrderCode = @SaleOrderCode)
While @anyitem_exist > 0 And @continue >= 0
Begin
	IF @invdetail_exist >  0 
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'Saleledger' , @SaleInvCode Output
	IF ( @firsttime = 0  )
	Begin
		Set @firsttime = 1
	End
	Set @rowgroup = 0
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	Begin
		Set @continue  = -1
	End
	Else
	Begin
		IF @invdetail_exist >  0 
			Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno , @module,  @headerinvno Output 
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
		Else
		Begin
			Set @Err = 0 
			Set @RowCount = 1
			IF @invdetail_exist >  0 
			Begin
				Insert Into SaleLedger (SaleInvCode, SaleCatCode, CustCode, SalesmanCode, Date, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SalesTax, Posted, PostDate, 					Remarks, CustRefNo, Headerno, headerinvno, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, SPrice, QuotationNo, DoctCode, PatientCode, 
					RePrintingCounter, CashReceived, InvGSTPerc1, PrintWaranty, PrintBatch, MessageCode, SManCode, InvoiceSize, CustRefno2, CustRefno3,
					CustRefno4, GSTNO, InvTotal, MachineName, ModifyCounter, ItemDiscPercNo, RelationCode, DiseaseCode, WardCode, AdmissionCode, 
					ReturnCounter, Paid, BillingDate, UnReceivedBalance, TotalOfSaleReturns, ListOfSrInvoices, printbalance, AccountFor, PaymentMode, 
					PaymentAccCode, Amt, AmtBY, AmtDate, AmtReference, OutstandingAmt, Marked, Transferable, Transfered, TransferedOn, TransferedBy, 
					Imported, ImportedBy, deliveredby, SaleTypeCode, Balance, PptCustCode, DELETED, PresCode, ImpactInventory, SaleOrderCode, 
					SaleComments1, SaleComments2, AlterSaleInvCode, RecurringInvoice, RecurringPeriod, LastRecurringInvCode, RecurringAgainst, ConsiderInPO, VisitCode, DueDate, SRBufferInvCode, CustRefNo5, 
					SuppInvCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, AdvanceTax, AdvanceTaxAmt, MiscCharges1, MiscCharges2, MiscCharges3, MiscCharges4, MiscCharges5, FBRPOSFee)
				SELECT @SaleInvCode, SaleCatCode=2, CustCode, UserCode, Date=GETDATE(), DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SalesTax=0, Posted='N', PostDate=GETDATE(), 
					Remarks, CustRefNo, @HeaderNo, @headerinvno, Date=GETDATE(), ModifiedBy, PostedBy, Sprice=1,  QuotationCode, DoctCode, PatientCode, 
					RePrintingCounter, CashReceived=0, InvGSTPerc1, Printwaranty='N', PrintBatch='N', MessageCode, SManCode, InvoiceSize, CustRefno2, CustRefno3, 
					CustRefno4, GSTNO, InvTotal, MachineName, ModifyCounter, ItemDiscPercNo, RelationCode, DiseaseCode, WardCode, AdmissionCode=NULL,
					ReturnCounter=0, Paid='N', BillingDate, UnreceivedBalance=InvTotal, TotalOfSaleReturns=0, '', 'Y', 'Y', PaymentMode='C', 
					PaymentAccCode=2, Amt=0, AmtBY=NULL, AmtDate=GETDATE(), AmtReference=NULL, OutStandingAmt = InvTotal, Marked='N', Transferable='N', Transfered='N', TransferedOn=NULL, TransferedBy=NULL, 
					Imported='N', ImportedBy=NULL, DeliveredBy=NULL, SaleTypeode=1, Balance=0, PptCustCode, Deleted='N', PresCode, ImpactInventory='Y', SaleOrderCode, 
					SaleComments1=(SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference('SaleComments1')), SaleComments2=(SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference('SaleComments2')), 
					AlterSaleInvCode=NULL, RecurringInvoice='N', RecurringPeriod=0, 
					LastRecurringInvCode=NULL, RecurringAgainst=NULL, ConsiderInPO='Y', VisitCode=NULL, DueDate=GETDATE(), SRBufferInvCode=NULL, CustRefNo5=NULL, 
					SuppInvCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, AdvanceTax, AdvanceTaxAmt, MiscCharges1, MiscCharges2, MiscCharges3, MiscCharges4, MiscCharges5, FBRPOSFee
				FROM SaleOrderHeader
				WHERE SaleOrderCode = @SaleOrderCode

				Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
			End
			IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
			Begin 
				RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Ledger : %d' ,16,1,  @SaleInvCode  )
				Set @continue  = -1
			End 
			Else
			Begin
				Set @anyitem_exist  = ( Select Sum(Satisfiableqty - Satisfiedqty) from #saletemp )
				SET @lineitems_rowcount = ( Select COUNT(*) from #saletemp )
				Set @innercounter = 1
				While ( @anyitem_exist > 0 ) AND ( @innercounter <= @lineitems_rowcount ) AND ( @continue >= 0 )
				Begin
					Select @icode = icode , @gcode = gcode , @looseqty = looseqty , @satisfiableqty = satisfiableqty, @satisfiedqty = satisfiedqty, @saleprice = saleprice, @discperc = discperc, @itemflatdisc = itemflatdisc, @unitsalestax = unitsalestax, @gstperc1 = gstperc, @saleitemdescription = saleitemdescription, @Claimable=Claimable, @claimableDiscPerc=claimableDiscPerc, @ItemAdvanceTaxPerc=ItemAdvanceTaxPerc
					From #saletemp
				        Where id = @innercounter
					Select @RowCount = @@RowCount
					IF ( @RowCount = 1 ) AND  ( (@satisfiableqty - @satisfiedqty) > 0 )
					Begin
							IF ( @looseqty + @satisfiedqty ) <=  @satisfiableqty 
								Set @givenqty = @looseqty
							Else
								Set @givenqty = @satisfiableqty - @satisfiedqty
							IF @givenqty <= 0 
								Set @givenqty = 1
							Else
								Update #saletemp Set satisfiedqty = @satisfiedqty + @givenqty Where icode = @icode

							Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
							IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
							Begin
								Set @continue  = -1
							End
							Else
							Begin
								Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemStockAll @ICode, @total_availablestock OutPut
								Set @totalqty = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and godowndetail.icode = @icode  )
								IF @totalqty >= @givenqty 
								Begin 
									Set @rowgroup = @rowgroup + 1
									Select @rate = saleprice, @packunits = packunits
									From ITEM
									Where icode = @icode
									IF @packunits = 0 OR @packunits Is Null 
										Set @packunits = 1
									Set @reqqty = @givenqty
									Declare ItemBatch_Cursor Cursor Static Forward_Only
									For 	Select  batch, expiry, Currqty 
									From    godowndetail 
									Where  godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and
										    godowndetail.icode = @icode 
									Order by priority, expiry, Currqty
	
									Open ItemBatch_Cursor
									Set @totalrows = @@Cursor_Rows
									Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
									Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
									Set @counter = 1	
									While @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @counter <= @totalrows AND @reqqty > 0
									Begin
										Set @batchqty = @currqty
										IF @batchqty >= @ReqQty 
											Set @delqty = @reqqty
										Else
											Set @delqty = @batchqty
										Set @reqqty = @reqqty - @delqty

										Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @saleutn Output
										IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
										Begin
											Set @continue  = -1															
										End 									
										SET @total_availablestock = @total_availablestock - @delqty

										Insert Into SaleDetail (SaleInvCode, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, packqty, looseqty, packunits, saleprice, avgprice, rate, discperc, salestax, itemflatdisc, packprice, unitsalestax, gstperc, saleutn, balancestock, rowgroup, saleitemdescription, Claimable, ClaimableDiscPerc, ItemAdvanceTaxPerc)
										Values (@saleinvcode, @icode, @gcode, @batch, @expiry, 0, @delqty, @packunits, @saleprice, @hold_avgprice, @rate / @packunits, @discperc, 0, @itemflatdisc, @rate, @unitsalestax, @gstperc1, @saleutn, @total_availablestock, @rowgroup, @saleitemdescription, @Claimable, @ClaimableDiscPerc, @ItemAdvanceTaxPerc)
										Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
										IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
										Begin 
											RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Detail for Sale Inv. No. : %d' ,16,1, @SaleInvCode  )
											Set @continue  = -1
										End 							
										Else
										Begin
											Set @newqty = @currqty - @delqty
											IF @newqty > 0
												Execute @rt_code = sp_SaleUpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty , @currqty
											Else
												Execute @rt_code = sp_DeleteItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty
											IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
											Begin
												Set @continue  = -1								
											End
										End
										Set @counter = @counter + 1
										Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
										Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
									End
								Close ItemBatch_Cursor
								Deallocate ItemBatch_Cursor
								End
								Else
								Begin
									Set @itemname = (Select name from item where icode = @icode )	
									RaisError( 'Not enough stock for item (%s) to decrease for Sale Inv. No : %d' , 16 , 1, @itemname, @SaleInvCode  )
									Set @continue  = -1								
								End
							End
					End	
					Set @innercounter = @innercounter + 1
					Set @anyitem_exist  = ( Select Sum(Satisfiableqty - Satisfiedqty) from #saletemp )
				End
				Set @invdetail_exist = ( Select count(*) from saledetail where saleinvcode = @saleinvcode )
			End
		End	
	End
Set @anyitem_exist  = ( Select Sum(Satisfiableqty - Satisfiedqty) from #saletemp )
End

Drop Table #saletemp

IF ( @continue >= 0 )
Begin
	Update Saleledger 
	Set InvTotal = dbo.fn_getSaleInvTotal (Saleledger.saleinvcode)
	Where saleinvcode = @SaleInvCode

	Select @Err = @@Error, @Rowcount = @@RowCount
	IF  @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0
	Begin
		RaisError( 'Unable to update Sale Invoice for Sale Inv. %d' , 16 , 1 , @SaleInvCode)
		Set @continue  = -1									
	End

	IF ( @continue >= 0 )
	BEGIN
		UPDATE SaleOrderHeader SET Finalized='Y', Status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE SaleOrderCode = @SaleOrderCode

		Execute @rt_code = sp_PostSaleOrder @SOCatCode, @SaleOrderCode, @SaleOrderCode, @UserCode, NULL, 1
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
		BEGIN 
			RaisError( 'Unable to update Sale Order Posting Status (Sale Order No. %d)' , @SaleOrderCode, 16 , 1 )
			Set @continue  = -1									
		END
	END
End

IF ( @continue >= 0 )
	SET @NewSaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode

Return @continue

-- SP_GenerateServiceTicket
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_GenerateServiceTicket @ServiceInvCode INT, @UserCode SMALLINT
AS

IF (SELECT DBO.Fn_GetPreference('genserviceticketonposting')) = 'N'
	RETURN 0

DECLARE @tot_services INT, @tot_tickets INT, @start_ticket INT, @end_ticket INT, @errcode INT, @RowId INT, @In_RowID INT, @In_Qty INT, @TicketCode INT, @ServiceCode INT, @Interval INT, @ExpiryDays INT
DECLARE @Posted CHAR(1), @Date DATETIME, @Expiry DateTime, @Price NUMERIC(12,2), @DiscPerc NUMERIC(5,2), @method CHAR(1)
DECLARE @service_table TABLE 
	(ServiceCode INT, Date DATETIME, Qty INT, Expiry DateTime, Price NUMERIC(12,2), DiscPerc NUMERIC(5,2), Rowid INT IDENTITY(1, 1), Interval INT, ExpiryDays INT)

IF @ServiceInvCode IS NULL
	RETURN 0

IF @UserCode IS NULL
	SET @UserCode = 1

SET @Posted = ISNULL((SELECT Posted FROM ServiceHeader WHERE ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode), 'N')
IF @Posted = 'N' OR @Posted IS NULL
	RETURN 0

SET @method = ISNULL((SELECT DBO.Fn_GetPreference('serviceticketgenerationmethod')), 'Q')
IF @method IS NULL
	SET @method = 'Q'

SET @tot_tickets = ISNULL(
	(SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN @method = 'S' THEN S.TicketsToGenerate ELSE D.Qty END)
	FROM ServiceDetail D WITH (HOLDLOCK, ROWLOCK), Service S
	WHERE D.ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode AND
		D.ServiceCode = S.ServiceCode AND
		S.TicketRequired = 'Y'), 0)

IF @tot_tickets = 0
	RETURN 0

INSERT INTO @service_table (ServiceCode, Date, Qty, Expiry, Price, DiscPerc, Interval, ExpiryDays)
SELECT D.ServiceCode, Date=GETDATE(), Qty = CASE WHEN @method = 'S' THEN S.TicketsToGenerate ELSE CAST(D.Qty AS INT) END, D.DeliveryDate, D.Price, D.DiscPerc, CASE WHEN @method = 'S' THEN S.TicketIntervalInDays ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN @method = 'S' THEN TicketExpiryInDays ELSE 0 END
FROM ServiceDetail D, Service S
WHERE D.ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode AND 
	D.ServiceCode = S.ServiceCode AND
	S.TicketRequired = 'Y'
ORDER BY D.SrvRowID

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Fetching Ticketing Services', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @tot_services = ISNULL((SELECT count(*) from @service_table), 0)

IF @tot_services = 0 
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END 

SET @errcode = 0
EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'ServiceTicket' , @start_ticket OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Fetching Service Ticket Key Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @rowid = 1
WHILE @RowId <= @tot_services 
BEGIN
	SET @In_RowID = 1
	SET @In_Qty = (SELECT Qty FROM @service_table WHERE RowID = @RowID)
	SET @ServiceCode = (SELECT ServiceCode FROM @service_table WHERE RowID = @RowID)
	SET @Interval  = (SELECT Interval FROM @service_table WHERE RowID = @RowID)
	SET @ExpiryDays  = (SELECT ExpiryDays FROM @service_table WHERE RowID = @RowID)
	SET @Date = (SELECT Date FROM @service_table WHERE RowID = @RowID)
	SET @Expiry = (SELECT CASE WHEN @method = 'S' THEN @Date + @ExpiryDays ELSE Expiry END FROM @service_table WHERE RowID = @RowID)
	SET @Price  = ISNULL((SELECT Price FROM @service_table WHERE RowID = @RowID), 0)
	SET @DiscPerc  = ISNULL((SELECT DiscPerc FROM @service_table WHERE RowID = @RowID), 0)
	WHILE @In_RowId <= @In_Qty
	BEGIN
		Set @TicketCode = @start_ticket + @In_RowId
		IF @In_RowID > 1
		BEGIN
			SET @Date = @Date + @Interval
			SET @Expiry = (SELECT CASE WHEN @method = 'S' THEN @Date + @ExpiryDays ELSE Expiry END FROM @service_table WHERE RowID = @RowID)
		END
		INSERT INTO ServiceTicket (ServiceTicketCode, Date, ServiceInvCode, ServiceCode, Price, DiscPerc, ExpiresOn, TicketUsed, TicketUsedOn, UserCode)
		VALUES (@TicketCode , @Date, @ServiceInvCode, @ServiceCode, @Price, @DiscPerc, @Expiry, 'N', GETDATE(), @UserCode)
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceHeader', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
		Set @In_RowID = @In_RowID + 1
	END
	Set @start_ticket = @TicketCode
	Set @RowID = @RowID + 1
END
Set @end_ticket = @TicketCode
SET @errcode = 0
EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'ServiceTicket' , @end_ticket
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Updating Service Ticket Key Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

-- SP_Get_PreviousSaleHistory
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_Get_PreviousSaleHistory
	@sourcedb VARCHAR(1000),
	@targetdb VARCHAR(1000),
	@startdate DATETIME,
	@enddate DATETIME
AS

DECLARE @INS_SQL VARCHAR(8000), @DEL VARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @err INT

SET @DEL = 'TRUNCATE TABLE ' + @targetdb + '.DBO.PreviousSaleHistory' 

EXECUTE (@DEL)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Deletion Problem While Clearing Previous Sale History', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

SET @INS_SQL = 
	'INSERT INTO ' + @targetdb + '.DBO.PreviousSaleHistory ' +
	'SELECT S.Date, S.ICode, SaleQty = SUM(S.SaleQty), ReturnQty = SUM(S.ReturnQty), SaleValue = SUM(S.SaleValue), ReturnValue = SUM(S.ReturnValue) FROM ' +
	'(SELECT DATE=CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), SL.Date, 110)), ' +
	'SD.ICode, SaleQty = SUM(SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty), ReturnQty = 0, SaleValue = SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * 0.01)), ReturnValue = 0 ' +
	'FROM ' + @sourcedb + '.DBO.SaleLedger SL, ' + @sourcedb + '.DBO.SaleDetail SD WHERE SL.Date BETWEEN ''' +
	CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @startdate, 110) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @startdate, 114) + ''' AND ''' +
	CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @enddate, 110) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @enddate, 114) + ''' AND ' +
	' SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode GROUP BY SL.Date, SD.ICode UNION ALL ' +
	'SELECT DATE=CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), SL.Date, 110)), SD.ICode, SaleQty = 0, ReturnQty = SUM(SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty), SaleValue=0, ReturnValue = SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * 0.01)) FROM ' +
	@sourcedb + '.DBO.SRLedger SL, ' + @sourcedb + '.DBO.SRDetail SD WHERE SL.Date BETWEEN ''' +
	CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @startdate, 110) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @startdate, 114) + ''' AND ''' +
	CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @enddate, 110) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @enddate, 114) + ''' AND ' +
	' SL.SRInvCode = SD.SRInvCode ' + 
	'GROUP BY SL.Date, SD.ICode) S GROUP BY S.Date, S.ICode'

EXECUTE (@INS_SQL)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Insertion Problem While Storing Previous Sale History', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

RETURN 0

-- SP_Get_PreviousSaleHistory_OnArchival
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_Get_PreviousSaleHistory_OnArchival
	@startdate DATETIME,
	@enddate DATETIME
AS

DECLARE @err INT

INSERT INTO DBO.PreviousSaleHistory 
SELECT S.Date, S.ICode, SaleQty = SUM(S.SaleQty), ReturnQty = SUM(S.ReturnQty), SaleValue = SUM(S.SaleValue), ReturnValue = SUM(S.ReturnValue) 
FROM 
	(SELECT 
		DATE=CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), SL.Date, 110)), 
		SD.ICode, 
		SaleQty = SUM(SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty), 
		ReturnQty = 0, 
		SaleValue = SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 
		ReturnValue = 0 
	FROM 
		DBO.SaleLedger SL, DBO.SaleDetail SD 
	WHERE 
		SL.Date BETWEEN @startdate AND @enddate AND 
		SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode 
	GROUP BY 
		SL.Date, SD.ICode UNION ALL 
	SELECT 
		DATE=CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), SL.Date, 110)), SD.ICode, SaleQty = 0, ReturnQty = SUM(SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty), SaleValue=0, ReturnValue = SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * 0.01)) 
	FROM 
		DBO.SRLedger SL, DBO.SRDetail SD 
	WHERE SL.Date BETWEEN @startdate AND @enddate AND
		SL.SRInvCode = SD.SRInvCode
	GROUP BY 
		SL.Date, SD.ICode) S 
GROUP BY S.Date, S.ICode

SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Insertion Problem While Storing Previous Sale History', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

RETURN 0

CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_GetAccountLoyaltyBalance
	@AccCode INT, 
	@BalanceDate DATETIME,
	@LayaltyPointsBalance INT OUTPUT,
	@LayaltyPointsValue NUMERIC(12,2) OUTPUT
AS
/*
Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Description:
This stored procedure is used to get a loyalty points balance for all cards of an account and points value 
*/
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @LoyaltyCardCode INT, @LoyaltyPolicyCode INT, @Points INT, @PointsValue NUMERIC(12,2), @LayaltyPointsSlab INT
DECLARE @Err INT, @RowID INT, @RowCount INT

CREATE TABLE #PointsTemp (
	LoyaltyCardCode INT, 
	LoyaltyPolicyCode INT,
	Points INT, 
	PointsValue NUMERIC(12,2),
	RowID INT IDENTITY(1,1)
)

INSERT INTO #PointsTemp (LoyaltyCardCode, LoyaltyPolicyCode, Points, PointsValue)
SELECT LoyaltyCardCode, LoyaltyPolicyCode, Points = 0, PointsValue = 0
FROM LoyaltyCard 
WHERE AccCode=@AccCode

SET @Err = @@Error
IF @Err <> 0 OR @@Error <> 0 
BEGIN 
	RaisError('Problem occured while fetching loyalty card points balance Information, Error Code = %d' ,16, 1, @Err)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @RowCount = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #PointsTemp), 0)
IF @RowCount = 0 OR @RowCount IS NULL
BEGIN 
	SET @LayaltyPointsBalance = 0
	SET @LayaltyPointsValue = 0
	RETURN 0
END

SET @RowID = 1
WHILE @RowID <= @RowCount
BEGIN
	SELECT @LoyaltyCardCode = LoyaltyCardCode, @LoyaltyPolicyCode = LoyaltyPolicyCode, @Points = Points, @PointsValue = PointsValue
	FROM #PointsTemp
	WHERE RowID = @RowID

	EXECUTE @Err = DBO.SP_GetLoyaltyCardBalance @LoyaltyCardCode, @BalanceDate, @Points OUT, @PointsValue OUT
	IF @Err <> 0 OR @@Error <> 0 
	BEGIN 
		RaisError('Problem occured while fetching loyalty card balance, Loyalty Card Code = %d' ,16, 1, @LoyaltyCardCode)
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE #PointsTemp SET Points = @Points, PointsValue = @PointsValue WHERE RowID = @RowID
	SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
END

SET @LayaltyPointsBalance = ISNULL((SELECT PointsBalance=ISNULL(SUM(Points), 0) FROM #PointsTemp), 0)
SET @LayaltyPointsValue = ISNULL((SELECT PointsBalance=ISNULL(SUM(PointsValue), 0) FROM #PointsTemp), 0)

RETURN 0

CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_GetAliasName
	@UserCode INT,
	@AliasName VARCHAR(75),
	@ICode INT OUTPUT,
	@ItemName VARCHAR(60) OUTPUT,
	@RetType INT OUTPUT
AS
DECLARE @GroupCode INT, @TempICode INT, @RetCode INT
DECLARE @err INT, @rowcount INT

SET @GroupCode = (SELECT MIN(GroupCode) FROM UserGroups WHERE UserCode = @UserCode)
Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
IF @err = 0 AND @rowcount = 1
BEGIN
	IF DBO.Fn_GetPreference('GroupCategoryRights') = 'Y'
	BEGIN
		SELECT   @ICode = item.icode, @ItemName = item.name
		FROM     item
		WHERE    item.customicode  = @AliasName AND 
			(item.Restricted='N' OR (Item.Restricted='Y' AND Exists (select * from grouprights where rightcode = 515 and groupcode = @GroupCode) ) ) AND
			item.Active=1 AND 
			Item.ICatCode IN 
				(SELECT ICatCode 
				FROM ItemCategory 
				WHERE ICatCode IN 
					(SELECT ItemsCategoryCode FROM ItemsGroupCategory WHERE GroupCode IN
						 (SELECT GroupCode FROM UserGroups WHERE UserCode = @UserCode)))
		Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
		IF @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
			SET @RetCode = -1
			SET @RetType = 0
			RETURN @RetCode
		END
		IF @rowcount = 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT   @ICode = item.icode, @ItemName = item.name
			FROM     item
			WHERE    item.icode in (SELECT MAX(AI.ICode) FROM AlternateItemAlias AI WHERE AI.CustomICode = @AliasName) AND 
				(item.Restricted='N' OR (Item.Restricted='Y' AND Exists (select * from grouprights where rightcode = 515 and groupcode = @GroupCode) ) ) AND
				item.Active=1 AND 
				Item.ICatCode IN 
					(SELECT ICatCode 
					FROM ItemCategory 
					WHERE ICatCode IN 
						(SELECT ItemsCategoryCode FROM ItemsGroupCategory WHERE GroupCode IN
							 (SELECT GroupCode FROM UserGroups WHERE UserCode = @UserCode)))
			Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
			IF @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
				SET @RetCode = -1
				SET @RetType = 0
				RETURN @RetCode
			END
			IF @rowcount = 0
			BEGIN
				SET @ICode = NULL
				SET @ItemName = NULL
			END
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT  @ICode = item.icode, @ItemName=item.name
		FROM    item
		WHERE   item.customicode  = @AliasName AND
				  item.Active = 1 AND 
				  (item.Restricted='N' OR (Item.Restricted='Y' AND Exists (select * from grouprights where rightcode = 515 and groupcode = @GroupCode) ) )
		Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
		IF @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
			SET @RetCode = -1
			SET @RetType = 0
			RETURN @RetCode
		END
		IF @rowcount = 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT  @ICode = item.icode, @ItemName=item.name
			FROM    item
			WHERE   item.icode in (SELECT MAX(AI.ICode) FROM AlternateItemAlias AI WHERE AI.CustomICode = @AliasName) AND
					  item.Active = 1 AND 
					  (item.Restricted='N' OR (Item.Restricted='Y' AND Exists (select * from grouprights where rightcode = 515 and groupcode = @GroupCode) ) )
			Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
			IF @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
				SET @RetCode = -1
				SET @RetType = 0
				RETURN @RetCode
			END
			IF @rowcount = 0
			BEGIN
				SET @ICode = NULL
				SET @ItemName = NULL
			END
		END
	END

	IF @ICode IS NULL
	BEGIN
		IF DBO.Fn_GetPreference('SearchItemCodeIfAliasNameNotFound') = 'Y'
		BEGIN
			SET @TempICode = ISNULL((SELECT CAST(@AliasName AS INT)),0)
			Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
			IF @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
				SET @RetCode = -1
				SET @RetType = 0
				RETURN @RetCode
			END
			IF @TempICode > 0
			BEGIN
				IF DBO.Fn_GetPreference('GroupCategoryRights') = 'Y'
				BEGIN
					SELECT   @ICode=item.icode, @ItemName=item.name
					FROM     item
					WHERE    item.icode  = @TempICode AND 
						(item.Restricted='N' OR (Item.Restricted='Y' AND Exists (select * from grouprights where rightcode = 515 and groupcode = @GroupCode) ) ) AND
						item.Active=1 AND 
						Item.ICatCode IN 
							(SELECT ICatCode 
							FROM ItemCategory 
							WHERE ICatCode IN 
								(SELECT ItemsCategoryCode 
								FROM ItemsGroupCategory 
								WHERE GroupCode IN
									(SELECT GroupCode 
									FROM UserGroups 
									WHERE UserCode = @UserCode)))
					Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
					IF @err <> 0
					BEGIN
						RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
						SET @RetCode = -1
						SET @RetType = 0
						RETURN @RetCode
					END
					IF @rowcount = 0
					BEGIN
						SET @ICode = NULL
						SET @ItemName = NULL
					END
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT @ICode=item.icode, @ItemName=item.name
					FROM   item
					WHERE item.icode  = @TempICode AND
						item.Active = 1 AND 
						(item.Restricted='N' OR (Item.Restricted='Y' AND Exists (select * from grouprights where rightcode = 515 and groupcode = @GroupCode) ) )
					Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
					IF @err <> 0
					BEGIN
						RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
						SET @RetCode = -1
						SET @RetType = 0
						RETURN @RetCode
					END
					IF @rowcount = 0
					BEGIN
						SET @ICode = NULL
						SET @ItemName = NULL
					END
				END
		
				IF @ICode IS NULL
				BEGIN
					RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
					SET @RetCode = -1
					SET @RetType = 0
					RETURN @RetCode
				END
				ELSE 
				BEGIN
					SET @RetCode = 0
					SET @RetType = 1
				END
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
				SET @RetCode = -1
				SET @RetType = 0
				RETURN @RetCode
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
			SET @RetCode = -1
			SET @RetType = 0
			RETURN @RetCode
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @RetCode = 0
		SET @RetType = 0
	END
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	RaisError('Unable to fetch group code for user code = %d' , 16, 1, @usercode)
	Return -1
END

	 
Return @RetCode

				BEGIN
					RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
					SET @RetCode = -1
					SET @RetType = 0
					RETURN @RetCode
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @NewAliasName = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@TempICode)))
					EXECUTE @RetCode = SP_GetAliasName_WithQtyPrice @UserCode, @NewAliasName, @ICode OUTPUT, @ItemName OUTPUT, @RetType OUTPUT, @Qty OUTPUT, @PurPrice OUTPUT, @SalePrice OUTPUT
					IF @@Error <> 0 OR @RetCode < 0
					BEGIN
						RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
						SET @RetCode = -1
						SET @RetType = 0
						RETURN @RetCode
					END
				END
			END
			IF @Icode > 0 AND @RetCode=0
			BEGIN
				SET @AllowSaleInDecimalQty = ISNULL((SELECT AllowSaleInDecimalQty FROM Item WHERE ICode=@ICode), 'Y')
				IF @AllowSaleInDecimalQty = 'Y'
				BEGIN
					SET @Qty = CAST(@WeightStr AS NUMERIC(15,4)) / 1000
					IF @Qty < 0.01
						SET @Qty = @Qty * 1000
				END
				ELSE
					SET @Qty = CAST(@WeightStr AS INT)

				SET @RetCode = 0
				SET @RetType = 0
			END
		END 
	END
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	RaisError('Unable to fetch group code for user code = %d' , 16, 1, @usercode)
	Return -1
END

IF @Alternate = 1 AND @RetType=0
BEGIN
	SET @RetType = 2
END
Return @RetCode

-- SP_GetBonusPolicyBased_ItemBonusQty
CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_GetBonusPolicyBased_ItemBonusQty
	@ICode INT,
	@QtySold NUMERIC(15,4),
	@BonusQty INT OUTPUT
AS
/*
Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Description:
This stored procedure returns the bonusqty according to the policy slab that is applicable 
to the qty sold passed as an input to this procedure
Input:
	@ICode		= Item Code
	@QtySold	= Qty Sold (units sold)
	@BonusQty	= Bonus Qty Determined via the bonus policy slab applicable
*/
IF @ICode IS NULL OR @ICode < 0 
BEGIN 
	SET @BonusQty = NULL
	RaisError('Problem occured while fetching bonus qty. Item is null' ,16,1)
	RETURN -1
END

DECLARE @BonusPolicyCode SMALLINT
SET @BonusPolicyCode = (SELECT BonusPolicyCode FROM Item WHERE ICode = @ICode)

IF @BonusPolicyCode IS NULL
BEGIN
	SET @BonusQty = NULL
	RETURN 0
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SET @BonusQty = 
		(SELECT BonusQty = CAST((@QtySold / CASE WHEN SaleQty <> 0 THEN SaleQty ELSE 1 END) AS INT) * BonusQty 
		FROM 
			BonusPolicyDetail D, 
			(SELECT QtyLimit=MIN(QtyLimit) 
			FROM BonusPolicyDetail 
			WHERE BonusPolicyCode=@BonusPolicyCode AND 
				QtyLimit >= @QtySold AND 
				ExpiryDate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME)
			UNION
			SELECT QtyLimit=MAX(QtyLimit) 
			FROM BonusPolicyDetail 
			WHERE ExpiryDate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND 
			BonusPolicyCode=@BonusPolicyCode AND 
			QtyLimit <= @QtySold) T
		WHERE D.BonusPolicyCode=@BonusPolicyCode AND 
			D.ExpiryDate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND
			D.QtyLimit = T.QtyLimit AND
			T.QtyLimit <= @QtySold)
END

RETURN 0

-- SP_GetDiscountPolicyBased_ItemDiscount
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_GetDiscountPolicyBased_ItemDiscount
	@ICode INT,
	@QtySold NUMERIC(15,4),
	@DiscPerc NUMERIC(5, 2) OUTPUT,
	@ItemFlatDisc NUMERIC(12, 2) OUTPUT
AS
/*
Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Description:
This stored procedure returns the item discount (in percenatage) 
according to the policy slab that is applicable to the qty sold 
passed as an input to this procedure
Input:
	@ICode		= Item Code
	@QtySold	= Qty Sold (units sold)
	@DiscPerc	= Item Disccount Percentage Determined via the discount policy slab applicable
*/
IF @ICode IS NULL OR @ICode < 0 
BEGIN 
	SET @DiscPerc = NULL
	SET @ItemFlatDisc = NULL
	RaisError('Problem occured while fetching Discount (%), Item is null' ,16,1)
	RETURN -1
END

DECLARE @DiscountPolicyCode SMALLINT
SET @DiscountPolicyCode = (SELECT DiscountPolicyCode FROM Item WHERE ICode = @ICode)

IF @DiscountPolicyCode IS NULL
BEGIN
	SET @DiscPerc = NULL
	SET @ItemFlatDisc = NULL
	RETURN 0
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SET @DiscPerc = 
		(SELECT D.DiscPerc
		FROM DiscountPolicyDetail D,
			(SELECT QtyLimit=MIN(QtyLimit) 
			FROM DiscountPolicyDetail 
			WHERE ExpiryDate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND 
				DiscountPolicyCode=@DiscountPolicyCode AND 
				QtyLimit >= @QtySold
			UNION
			SELECT QtyLimit=MAX(QtyLimit) 
			FROM DiscountPolicyDetail 
			WHERE ExpiryDate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND 
				DiscountPolicyCode=@DiscountPolicyCode AND 
				QtyLimit <= @QtySold) T
		WHERE 
			ExpiryDate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND 
			DiscountPolicyCode=@DiscountPolicyCode AND
			D.QtyLimit = T.QtyLimit AND
			T.QtyLimit <= @QtySold)

	SET @ItemFlatDisc = 
		(SELECT D.ItemFlatDisc
		FROM DiscountPolicyDetail D,
			(SELECT QtyLimit=MIN(QtyLimit) 
			FROM DiscountPolicyDetail 
			WHERE ExpiryDate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND 
				DiscountPolicyCode=@DiscountPolicyCode AND 
				QtyLimit >= @QtySold
			UNION
			SELECT QtyLimit=MAX(QtyLimit) 
			FROM DiscountPolicyDetail 
			WHERE ExpiryDate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND 
				DiscountPolicyCode=@DiscountPolicyCode AND 
				QtyLimit <= @QtySold) T
		WHERE 
			ExpiryDate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND 
			DiscountPolicyCode=@DiscountPolicyCode AND
			D.QtyLimit = T.QtyLimit AND
			T.QtyLimit <= @QtySold)
END

RETURN 0

-- SP_GetGodownConsumption
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_GetGodownConsumption @GCode SMALLINT, @Type SMALLINT, @StartDate DATETIME, @EndDate DATETIME
AS
DELETE REPORTDATA

INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (Code1, Value1)
SELECT 
	ICode = T.ICode,
	Qty = SUM(T.Qty)
FROM
 	(SELECT D.ICode, Qty = SUM(D.LooseQty)
 	FROM SaleLedger H, SaleDetail D
 	WHERE 
 		(@Type = 1 OR @Type = 4) AND
 		H.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND
 		H.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND
 		D.GCode = @GCode
 	GROUP BY
 		D.ICode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT D.ICode, Qty = -SUM(D.LooseQty)
	FROM SRLedger H, SRDetail D
	WHERE 
 		(@Type = 1 OR @Type = 4) AND
		H.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND
		H.SRInvCode = D.SRInvCode AND
		D.GCode = @GCode
	GROUP BY
		D.ICode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT D.ICode, Qty = SUM(D.Qty)
	FROM IssueHeader H, IssueDetail D
	WHERE 
		(@Type = 2 OR @Type = 4) AND
		H.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND
		H.IssueInvCode = D.IssueInvCode AND
		D.GCode = @GCode
	GROUP BY
		D.ICode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT D.ICode, Qty = -SUM(D.Qty)
	FROM ReceiptHeader H, ReceiptDetail D
	WHERE 
		(@Type = 2 OR @Type = 4) AND
		H.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND
		H.ReceiptInvCode = D.ReceiptInvCode AND
		D.GCode = @GCode
	GROUP BY
		D.ICode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT D.ICode, Qty = SUM(D.Qty)
	FROM THeader H, TDetail D
	WHERE 
		(@Type = 3 OR @Type = 4) AND
		H.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND
		H.SGCode = @GCode AND
		H.TransCode = D.TransCode
	GROUP BY
		D.ICode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT D.ICode, Qty = -SUM(D.Qty)
	FROM THeader H, TDetail D
	WHERE 
		(@Type = 3 OR @Type = 4) AND
		H.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND
		H.DGCode = @GCode AND
		H.TransCode = D.TransCode
	GROUP BY
		D.ICode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT D.ICode, Qty = SUM(CASE WHEN H.AdjCatCode = 1 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * D.LooseQty)
	FROM AdjHeader H, AdjDetail D
	WHERE 
		@Type = 4 AND
		H.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND
		H.AdjCode = D.AdjCode AND 
		D.GCode = @GCode
	GROUP BY
		D.ICode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT D.ICode, Qty = - SUM(CASE WHEN H.PurCatCode > 2 THEN (D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) ELSE  (D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.PackUnits END)
	FROM PurLedger H, PurDetail D
	WHERE 
		@Type = 4 AND
		H.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND
		H.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND 
		D.GCode = @GCode
	GROUP BY
		D.ICode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT D.ICode, Qty = SUM(D.LooseQty)
	FROM PRLedger H, PRDetail D
	WHERE 
		@Type = 4 AND
		H.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND
		H.PRInvCode = D.PRInvCode AND 
		D.GCode = @GCode
	GROUP BY
		D.ICode) T
GROUP BY 
	ICode
HAVING 
	SUM(T.Qty) > 0

CREATE  Procedure dbo.sp_GetHeaderTabMaxKey @headercode As SmallInt, @modulecode As SmallInt, @key As Int Output
As

Declare @modulename As VarChar(60)
Declare @Err As Int , @RowCount As Int
Set NoCount On
SELECT 	@key = TABMAXKEY
FROM	_HEADERTABMAXKEY WITH (UPDLOCK HOLDLOCK)
WHERE	_HEADERTABMAXKEY.HeaderCode = @HeaderCode AND
		_HEADERTABMAXKEY.Module = @Modulecode
Select @Err = @@Error , @RowCount = @@RowCount
IF @Err = 0 AND @rowcount > 0 
Begin
	Set @key = @key + 1
	UPDATE dbo._HEADERTABMAXKEY
	SET 	 TABMAXKEY = @key
	WHERE	_HEADERTABMAXKEY.HeaderCode = @HeaderCode AND
			_HEADERTABMAXKEY.Module = @Modulecode
	Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount	
	IF @Err <> 0 OR @rowcount = 0 	
	Begin
		Select @modulename = name from module where module = @modulecode
		Set NoCount OFF
		RaisError('Exception occured in updating max key for module %s' ,16, 1, @modulename)
		Return -1		
	End 
End
ELSE
Begin
	Select @modulename = name from module where module = @modulecode
	Set NoCount OFF
	RaisError('Exception occured in getting max key for module %s' ,16, 1, @modulename)
	Return -1		
End 
Set NoCount OFF

Return 0

-- SP_GetItemAliasName
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_GetItemAliasName
	@AliasName VARCHAR(75),
	@ICode INT OUTPUT,
	@ItemName VARCHAR(60) OUTPUT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @TempICode INT, @RetCode INT
DECLARE @err INT, @rowcount INT

SELECT  @ICode = item.icode, @ItemName=item.name
FROM    item
WHERE   item.customicode  = @AliasName AND item.Active = 1 AND item.Restricted='N'
Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
IF @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
	SET @RetCode = -1
	RETURN @RetCode
END

IF @rowcount = 0
BEGIN
	SELECT  @ICode = item.icode, @ItemName=item.name
	FROM    item
	WHERE   item.Active = 1 AND item.Restricted='N' AND
		item.icode in (SELECT MAX(AI.ICode) FROM AlternateItemAlias AI WHERE AI.CustomICode = @AliasName)
			  
	Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
	IF @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
		SET @RetCode = -1
		RETURN @RetCode
	END
	IF @rowcount = 0
	BEGIN
		SET @ICode = NULL
		SET @ItemName = NULL
	END
END

IF @ICode IS NULL
BEGIN
	IF DBO.Fn_GetPreference('SearchItemCodeIfAliasNameNotFound') = 'Y'
	BEGIN
		SET @TempICode = ISNULL((SELECT CAST(@AliasName AS INT)),0)
		Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
		IF @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
			SET @RetCode = -1
			RETURN @RetCode
		END
		IF @TempICode > 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT @ICode=item.icode, @ItemName=item.name
			FROM   item
			WHERE item.icode  = @TempICode AND item.Active = 1 AND item.Restricted='N'

			Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
			IF @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
				SET @RetCode = -1
				RETURN @RetCode
			END
			IF @rowcount = 0
			BEGIN
				SET @ICode = NULL
				SET @ItemName = NULL
			END
	
			IF @ICode IS NULL
			BEGIN
				RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
				SET @RetCode = -1
				RETURN @RetCode
			END
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				SET @RetCode = 0
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
			SET @RetCode = -1
			RETURN @RetCode
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
		SET @RetCode = -1
		RETURN @RetCode
	END
END
	 
Return @RetCode

-- SP_GetItemReqQtyForTransfer
CREATE  Procedure dbo.SP_GetItemReqQtyForTransfer 
	@startdate datetime, 
	@enddate datetime, 
	@icode Int, 
	@gcode int, 
	@reqqty NUMERIC(15, 4) OUTPUT
As

Set NoCount On

	Select  @reqqty = (SaleQty - IsNull(SaleRetQty,0)) 
	From (
		Select saledetail.icode, IsNull ( Sum(saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.bonusqty) , 0) As SaleQty
		From Saleledger , Saledetail 
		Where Saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode AND
				saleledger.date between @startdate and @enddate AND
				saledetail.gcode = @gcode AND
				saledetail.icode = @icode
		Group By saledetail.icode
		) S Left Outer Join 
		(
		Select srdetail.icode, IsNull ( Sum(srdetail.looseqty + srdetail.bonusqty) , 0) As SaleRetQty
		From Srledger , Srdetail 
		Where srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode AND
		 	   srledger.date between @startdate and @enddate AND
			   srdetail.gcode = @gcode AND
			   srdetail.icode = @icode
		Group By srdetail.icode
		) Sr 
	On S.icode = Sr.icode
	Where (SaleQty - IsNull(SaleRetQty,0) ) > 0
Set NoCount OFF

-- SP_GetPriceFromServicePricePolicy
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_GetPriceFromServicePricePolicy
	@ServiceCode INT,
	@Price NUMERIC(12, 2) OUTPUT
AS
/*
Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Description:
This stored procedure returns the service price for the service passed 
as an input to this procedure. The policy will be applicable only if 
it is valid for today. That is to say if policy is not expired and
its price for current day of week will be returned.

Input:
	@ServiceCode = Service Code
	@Price		 = Service Price Determined via the price policy applicable
*/
IF @ServiceCode IS NULL OR @ServiceCode < 0 
BEGIN 
	SET @Price = NULL
	RaisError('Problem occured while fetching Service Price, Service is null' ,16,1)
	RETURN -1
END

DECLARE @PricePolicyCode SMALLINT
SET @PricePolicyCode = 
	(SELECT MAX(ServicePricePolicyCode) 
	FROM ServicePricePolicy 
	WHERE GetDate() BETWEEN StartDate AND EndDate AND ServiceCode = @ServiceCode)

IF @PricePolicyCode IS NULL
BEGIN
	SET @Price = NULL
	RETURN 0
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SET @Price = 
		ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(D.Price, 0)
		FROM ServicePricePolicyDetail D
		WHERE 
			D.ServicePricePolicyCode=@PricePolicyCode AND
			D.WeekDayCode = DatePart(dw, GetDate())), 0)

END

RETURN 0

name: SP_GetPricePolicyBased_ItemPrice
definition:
-- SP_GetPricePolicyBased_ItemPrice
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_GetPricePolicyBased_ItemPrice
	@UserCode INT,
	@ICode INT,
	@QtySold NUMERIC(15,4),
	@Price NUMERIC(15, 4) OUTPUT
AS
/*
Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Description:
This stored procedure returns the item price according to the 
policy slab that is applicable to the qty sold for the concerned
item passed as an input to this procedure
Input:
	@UserCode	= User Code
	@ICode		= Item Code
	@QtySold	= Qty Sold (units sold)
	@Price		= Item Price Determined via the price policy slab applicable
*/
DECLARE @GetPrice INT, @GetItemFlatDisc INT, @GetItemDiscPerc INT

SET @GetPrice = ISNULL((SELECT RightCode FROM GroupRights WHERE GroupCode IN (SELECT MIN(GroupCode) FROM UserGroups WHERE UserCode=@UserCode) AND RightCode=5070), 0)
SET @GetItemFlatDisc = ISNULL((SELECT RightCode FROM GroupRights WHERE GroupCode IN (SELECT MIN(GroupCode) FROM UserGroups WHERE UserCode=@UserCode) AND RightCode=5071), 0)
SET @GetItemDiscPerc = ISNULL((SELECT RightCode FROM GroupRights WHERE GroupCode IN (SELECT MIN(GroupCode) FROM UserGroups WHERE UserCode=@UserCode) AND RightCode=5072), 0)

IF @UserCode IS NULL OR @UserCode < 0 
BEGIN 
	SET @Price = NULL
	RaisError('Problem occured while fetching Item Price, User is Not Valid / null' ,16,1)
	RETURN -1
END

IF @ICode IS NULL OR @ICode < 0 
BEGIN 
	SET @Price = NULL
	RaisError('Problem occured while fetching Item Price, Item is not valid / null' ,16,1)
	RETURN -1
END

DECLARE @PricePolicyCode INT
DECLARE @PackUnits INT

SET @PricePolicyCode = (SELECT PricePolicyCode FROM PricePolicy WHERE ICode = @ICode)
SET @PackUnits = (SELECT Item.PackUnits FROM Item WHERE Item.ICode = @ICode)
IF @PackUnits = 0 
	SET @PackUnits = 1

IF @PricePolicyCode IS NULL
BEGIN
	SET @Price = NULL
	RETURN 0
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SET @Price = 
		(SELECT ROUND(
			((CASE WHEN @GetPrice > 0 THEN D.Price/@PackUnits ELSE ISNULL((SELECT I.SalePrice / @PackUnits FROM Item I WHERE I.ICode = @ICode), @Price) END - 
			CASE WHEN @GetItemFlatDisc > 0 THEN D.ItemFlatDisc ELSE 0 END) *
			(1 - CASE WHEN @GetItemDiscPerc > 0 THEN D.DiscPerc ELSE 0 END * 0.01)), 2)
		FROM PricePolicyDetail D,
			(SELECT QtyLimit=MIN(QtyLimit) 
			FROM PricePolicyDetail 
			WHERE ExpiryDate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND 
				PricePolicyCode=@PricePolicyCode AND 
				QtyLimit >= @QtySold
			UNION
			SELECT QtyLimit=MAX(QtyLimit) 
			FROM PricePolicyDetail 
			WHERE ExpiryDate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND 
				PricePolicyCode=@PricePolicyCode AND 
				QtyLimit <= @QtySold) T
		WHERE 
			ExpiryDate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND 
			PricePolicyCode=@PricePolicyCode AND
			D.QtyLimit = T.QtyLimit AND
			T.QtyLimit <= @QtySold)

END

RETURN 0

-- sp_getRandomValueTable
Create Procedure sp_getRandomValueTable @rows Int, @max_randomvalue Int As
Declare @randomtable Table (lineid Int Not Null Identity(1,1) , randomvalue Int Not Null )
Declare @counter Int, @randomvalue Int
	Set @counter = 1
	IF ( @rows <= 0 )
		Set @rows = 1
	While ( @counter <=  @rows )
	Begin
		WaitFor Delay '00:00:00.003'
		Set @randomvalue = Rand() * @max_randomvalue
		IF ( @randomvalue = 0 )
			Set @randomvalue = 1
		Insert Into @randomTable (randomvalue)
		Values (@randomvalue)
		Set @counter = @counter + 1 
	End
	Select lineid, randomvalue
	From  @randomtable
Return 0

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetReceiptCategoryCounter] @Category As SmallInt, @Counter As Int Output
As
--Author : Azhar
Declare @Err As Int , @RowCount As Int
Set NoCount On

SELECT @Counter = Counter
FROM	dbo.ReceiptCategory WITH (UPDLOCK HOLDLOCK)
WHERE	ReceiptCategoryCode = @Category

Select @Err = @@Error , @RowCount = @@RowCount
IF @Err = 0 AND @rowcount > 0 
Begin
	Set @Counter = @Counter + 1
	UPDATE dbo.ReceiptCategory 
	SET 	Counter = @Counter
	WHERE	ReceiptCategoryCode = @Category

	Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount	
	IF @Err <> 0 OR @rowcount = 0 	
	Begin
		Set NoCount OFF
		RaisError('Exception occured in updating receipt category counter' ,16, 1)
		Return -1		
	End 
End
ELSE
Begin
	Set NoCount OFF
	RaisError('Exception occured in fetching receipt category counter' ,16, 1)
	Return -1		
End 
Set NoCount OFF

Return 0

-- SP_GetSaleInvoice_JSON
CREATE   PROCEDURE DBO.SP_GetSaleInvoice_JSON @SaleInvCode INT, @JSON VARCHAR(8000) OUTPUT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @Qry VARCHAR(8000), @Q VARCHAR(8000), @PosID VARCHAR(100)

SET @PosID = ISNULL(DBO.Fn_GetPreference('FBRPOSID'),'')
SET @Qry = ''

--910247

DECLARE C1 CURSOR FOR 
SELECT A
FROM 
(SELECT A='{"InvoiceNumber":"","POSID":"' + @PosID + '","USIN":"' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.SaleInvCode))) + 
'","DateTime":"' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), S.DATE, 121) + 
'","BuyerNTN":"' + ISNULL(C.NTNNo,'') + '","BuyerCNIC":"' + ISNULL(C.NIC,'') + '","BuyerName":"' + ISNULL(A.Name,'') + '","BuyerPhoneNumber":"' + ISNULL(C.Phone,'') + '","TotalBillAmount":"' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.InvTotal,12, 2))) + 
'","TotalQuantity":"' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(ISNULL((SELECT SUM(D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) FROM SaleDetail D WHERE D.SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode),0)))) + '","TotalSaleValue":"' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(ISNULL(S.InvTotal,0) - ISNULL(DBO.fn_getTaxOnSaleInv(S.SaleInvCode),0),12, 2))) + 
'","TotalTaxCharged":"' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(DBO.fn_getTaxOnSaleInv(S.SaleInvCode), 12,2))) + 
'","Discount":"'+ LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(ISNULL((SELECT SUM(ROUND((D.LooseQty * D.ItemFlatDisc) + (D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (D.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2)) FROM SaleDetail D WHERE D.SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode),0),12,2)))  + '","FurtherTax":"0.0","PaymentMode":"1","RefUSIN":"null","InvoiceType":"1","Items":['
FROM SaleLedger S, Customer C, Accounts A
WHERE S.SaleInvCode=@SaleInvCode AND S.CustCode=C.CustCode AND S.CustCode=A.AccCode
UNION ALL
SELECT A='{"ItemCode":"' + I.customICode + '","ItemName":"' + I.Name + '","Quantity":"' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty, 10,4))) +
'","PCTCode":"' + P.Description + '","TaxRate":"' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(STS.TaxPerc, 6, 2))) + '","SaleValue":"' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice, 12, 2))) + '","TotalAmount":"' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice,12, 2))) + '","TaxCharged":"' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.UnitSalesTax,12,2))) + '","Discount":"' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(ROUND((D.LooseQty * D.ItemFlatDisc) + 
(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (D.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2),12,2))) + '","FurtherTax":"0.0","InvoiceType":"1","RefUSIN":"null"},'
