WHERE D.SaleInvCode=@SaleInvCode AND D.ICode=I.ICode AND I.PCTCode = P.PCTCode AND I.SalesTaxScheduleCode=STS.SalesTaxScheduleCode) T 

OPEN C1

INTO @Q

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0

	INTO @Q
END
SET @JSON = ''

IF Right(@Qry, 1) = ',' 
	SET @Qry = LEFT(@Qry, LEN(@Qry) - 1)

SET @JSON = @Qry + ']}'

Print @JSon

CLOSE C1

-- SP_GetService_AliasName
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_GetService_AliasName
	@UserCode INT,
	@AliasName VARCHAR(75),
	@ServiceCode INT OUTPUT,
	@ServiceName VARCHAR(60) OUTPUT
AS
DECLARE @GroupCode INT, @TempCode INT, @RetCode INT
DECLARE @err INT, @rowcount INT

SET @RetCode=0
SET @GroupCode = (SELECT MIN(GroupCode) FROM UserGroups WHERE UserCode = @UserCode)
Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
IF @err = 0 AND @rowcount = 1
BEGIN
	IF DBO.Fn_GetPreference('EnableServiceCatRights') = 'Y'
	BEGIN
		SELECT   @ServiceCode = Service.ServiceCode, @ServiceName = Service.name
		FROM     Service
		WHERE   Service.Active = 'Y' AND 
			Service.AliasName = @AliasName AND 
			Service.ServiceCatCode IN 
				(SELECT ServiceCatCode 
				FROM GroupAllowedServiceCategory
				WHERE GroupCode = @GroupCode)
		Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
		IF @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Unable to fetch Service Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
			SET @RetCode = -1
			RETURN @RetCode
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT   @ServiceCode = Service.ServiceCode, @ServiceName = Service.name
		FROM     Service
		WHERE    Service.Active = 'Y' AND Service.AliasName = @AliasName

		Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
		IF @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Unable to fetch Service Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
			SET @RetCode = -1
			RETURN @RetCode
		END
	END
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	RaisError('Unable to fetch group code for user code = %d' , 16, 1, @usercode)
	Return -1
END

IF @ServiceCode IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError('Unable to fetch Service Alias Name = %s' , 16, 1, @AliasName)
	SET @RetCode = -1
	RETURN @RetCode
END
 
Return @RetCode

CREATE PROCEDURE sp_GLOpeningBalance @l_Date DateTime, @l_AccCode numeric(5,0), @lf_Balance float OUTPUT AS

declare @l_Balance numeric(11,2)
select  sum(gldetail.debit) as debit, 
	sum(gldetail.credit) as credit INTO #TMPJV 
from glheader, gldetail
where   glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode  
and 	glheader.date <=  @l_Date 
and     gldetail.AccCode = @l_AccCode 

select @l_Balance = case sum(debit) 
			when NULL then 0.0
			else sum(debit) 
		    end 
	 		- 
		    case sum(credit)
			when NULL then 0.0
			else sum(credit) 	
		    end
from #tmpjv
Select @lf_Balance = Convert(float, @l_Balance)
Drop Table #tmpjv

-- SP_GodownDetail_RepairForZeroDecimal
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_GodownDetail_RepairForZeroDecimal
AS

DECLARE @ColPrec INT, @GD_Err_Rows INT
SET @ColPrec = ISNULL((SELECT ColPrecision FROM ColumnPreferences WHERE ColumnName='Qty' AND ColPrecision=0), 0)
IF @ColPrec = 0
BEGIN
	SET @GD_Err_Rows = (SELECT COUNT(ICode) FROM GodownDetail WHERE CurrQty <> CAST(CurrQty AS INT))
	IF @GD_Err_Rows > 0
	BEGIN
		UPDATE GodownDetail SET CurrQty = ROUND(CurrQty, 0) WHERE CurrQty <> CAST(CurrQty AS INT)
		DELETE GodownDetail WHERE CurrQty = 0
		UPDATE SaleDetail SET LooseQty = ROUND(LooseQty, 0) WHERE LooseQty <> CAST(LooseQty AS INT)
		UPDATE SaleDetail SET BonusQty = ROUND(BonusQty, 0) WHERE BonusQty <> CAST(BonusQty AS INT)
		UPDATE SRDetail SET LooseQty = ROUND(LooseQty, 0) WHERE LooseQty <> CAST(LooseQty AS INT)
		UPDATE SRDetail SET BonusQty = ROUND(BonusQty, 0) WHERE BonusQty <> CAST(BonusQty AS INT)
		UPDATE AdjDetail SET LooseQty = ROUND(LooseQty, 0) WHERE LooseQty <> CAST(LooseQty AS INT)
		UPDATE TDetail SET Qty = ROUND(Qty, 0) WHERE Qty <> CAST(Qty AS INT)
		UPDATE DueSatisfyDetail SET DueSatisfyQty  = ROUND(DueSatisfyQty ,0) WHERE DueSatisfyQty <> CAST(DueSatisfyQty AS INT)
		UPDATE PurDetail SET LooseQty = ROUND(LooseQty, 0) WHERE LooseQty <> CAST(LooseQty AS INT)
		UPDATE PurDetail SET PackQty = ROUND(PackQty, 0) WHERE PackQty <> CAST(PackQty AS INT)
		UPDATE PurDetail SET BonusQty = ROUND(BonusQty, 0) WHERE BonusQty <> CAST(BonusQty AS INT)
	END
END
RETURN 0

name: SP_GodownItemOpeningStock
definition:
-- sp_GodownItemOpeningStock
CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_GodownItemOpeningStock 
	@l_date datetime, 
	@l_gcode INT, 
	@l_icode INT, 
	@l_godownqty  NUMERIC(15, 4) output  AS

Declare @l_purqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @l_purretqty NUMERIC(15, 4),
	@l_saleqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @l_saleretqty NUMERIC(15, 4),
	@l_satisfyqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @l_transferqty_increase NUMERIC(15, 4),
	@l_transferqty_decrease NUMERIC(15, 4), @l_issueqty NUMERIC(15, 4),
	@l_Receiptqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @l_Adjqty NUMERIC(15, 4)
	
/*************************** Purchase *********************************/
select @l_purqty  = /*(select IsNull(sum(purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty * purdetail.packunits + (Case When purledger.purcatcode IN (3, 7, 8) Then purdetail.bonusqty Else purdetail.bonusqty * purdetail.packunits End)), 0)*/
			(Select IsNull(sum(Case When purledger.purcatcode IN (3, 7, 8)  THEN purdetail.looseqty + (purdetail.packqty * purdetail.packunits) + purdetail.bonusqty
			Else  purdetail.looseqty + (purdetail.packqty * purdetail.packunits) + (purdetail.bonusqty * purdetail.packunits) END),0)
		     from   purledger, 
			    purdetail
		     where  purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and
			    purdetail.gcode = @l_gcode and 
	 	   	    purdetail.icode = @l_icode and 
			    purledger.posted = 'Y' and 		
	 	   	    purledger.postdate < @l_date ) 

	

/**************************** Purchase Return *********************************/
Select @l_purretqty = (select	IsNull(sum(prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.packqty * prdetail.packunits + prdetail.bonusqty), 0)
		       from	prledger, 
				prdetail  
		       where	prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode and
	             		prdetail.gcode = @l_gcode and 
	             		prdetail.icode = @l_icode and 
				prledger.posted = 'Y' and
	 	     		prledger.postdate < @l_date )

/***************************** Sale from Godown *************************************/
select @l_saleqty = (select 	IsNull( Sum( saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.bonusqty + saledetail.packqty * saledetail.packunits), 0)
				/*date = case when saledetail.Due = 'S' then saledetail.satisfieddate else saleledger.date end*/
		     from   	saleledger, 
				saledetail
		     where  	saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and
		   		saledetail.gcode = @l_gcode and 
	 	   		saledetail.icode = @l_icode and 
				saledetail.Due IS Null and 
				/*saleledger.posted = 'Y' and*/
	 	   		saleledger.date < @l_date) 
	 
/******************************* Sale Return to Godown **********************************/
Select @l_saleretqty = (select  IsNull( Sum( srdetail.looseqty + srdetail.bonusqty + srdetail.packqty * srdetail.packunits), 0) 
		     	from    srledger, 
				srdetail  

		     	where   srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode and
				srdetail.gcode = @l_gcode and 
	             		srdetail.icode = @l_icode and 
				srledger.posted = 'Y' and
				srledger.postdate < @l_date )

/********************************** Satisfy Due *****************************************/
Select @l_satisfyqty = (select IsNull(sum(DueSatisfydetail.duesatisfyqty), 0)
			from   DueSatisfyHeader,
			       DueSatisfydetail
			where  DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyCode = DueSatisfyDetail.DueSatisfyCode and	
			       DueSatisfyDetail.gcode = @l_gcode and 
			       DueSatisfyDetail.icode = @l_icode and 	
			       DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfydate < @l_date )

/*============Increase in Qty due to Transfer===================*/
Select @l_transferqty_increase = (select IsNull(sum(tdetail.qty), 0)
			from   THeader,
			       Tdetail
			where  THeader.TransCode = TDetail.TransCode and	
			       THeader.Dgcode = @l_gcode and 	
			       TDetail.icode = @l_icode and 
			       THeader.date < @l_date and
			       THeader.Posted = 'Y' )

/************************** Decrease in Qty due to Transfer ****************************/
Select @l_transferqty_decrease = (select IsNull(sum(tdetail.qty), 0)
			from   THeader,
			       Tdetail
			where  THeader.TransCode = TDetail.TransCode and	
			       THeader.Sgcode = @l_gcode and 	
			       TDetail.icode = @l_icode and 	
			       THeader.date < @l_date and
			       THeader.Posted = 'Y' )
 
/************************************** Issue *********************************************/
Select @l_issueqty = (select IsNull(sum(Issuedetail.qty), 0)
			from   IssueHeader,
			       IssueDetail
			where  IssueHeader.date < @l_date and
                               IssueHeader.IssueInvCode = IssueDetail.IssueinvCode and	
			       IssueDetail.gcode = @l_gcode and
			       IssueDetail.icode = @l_icode) 


/************************************* Receipt *****************************************/
Select @l_receiptqty = (select IsNull(sum(Receiptdetail.qty), 0)
			from   ReceiptHeader,
			       ReceiptDetail
			where  ReceiptHeader.date < @l_date and
                               ReceiptHeader.ReceiptInvCode = ReceiptDetail.ReceiptinvCode and	
			       ReceiptDetail.gcode = @l_gcode and 
			       ReceiptDetail.icode = @l_icode AND
				ReceiptHeader.posted = 'Y')

/************************************* Stock Adjustments *************************************/
Select @l_adjqty = (select IsNull(sum(	CASE AdjCatCode 
					WHEN 1 THEN Adjdetail.Looseqty
					ELSE -Adjdetail.Looseqty END), 0)
			from   AdjHeader,
			       AdjDetail
			where  AdjHeader.date < @l_date and
                               AdjHeader.AdjCode = AdjDetail.AdjCode and
			       AdjDetail.gcode = @l_gcode and 
			       AdjDetail.icode = @l_icode AND
				AdjHeader.posted = 'Y')

/********************************* Get the sum up value ********************************/
Select @l_godownqty  = @l_purqty  + @l_saleretqty  - @l_issueqty - @l_purretqty - @l_saleqty - @l_satisfyqty + @l_Receiptqty + @l_Adjqty + @l_transferqty_Increase - @l_transferqty_decrease
/*---------end-------------------------*/
--Select balance = @l_godownqty, purchase = @l_purqty,salereturn = @l_saleretqty, purchasereturn = @l_purretqty, sale = @l_saleqty, satisfy = @l_satisfyqty

CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_GodownWiseStockInHand 
	@ReportGrouping CHAR(1), 
	@GroupList VARCHAR(8000), 
	@ZeroRows TinyInt, 
	@Pricetype TinyInt 
AS
/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of a
	Godown and items selected depending upon the grouping criteria selected.

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items in report
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
	@ZeroRows = 1 include rows with zero stock and 0 for otherwise
	@Pricetype = 1 stands for Sale/Trade Price, 2 stands for Purchase price and 3 stands for Average price
*/

DELETE ReportData

DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

INSERT INTO ReportData (code1, Name1, code2, Name2, code3, Name3, name4, name5, value1, value2, value3, value4, value5, Name6, Name7, Name8)
SELECT 
	Code1=G.GCode,
	Name1=G.Name,
	Code2=CASE @ReportGrouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN I.MANFCODE
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
		ELSE I.PACKCODE END,
	Name2=CASE @ReportGrouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
		WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
		WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
		ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,
	Code3=I.ICode,
	Name3=I.Name,
	Name4=I.CustomICode,
	Name5=I.PackingDesc,
	Value1=Case @Pricetype
			WHEN 1 THEN Round(I.SalePrice / I.PackUnits, 2)
			WHEN 2 THEN Round(I.PurPrice / I.PackUnits, 2)
			WHEN 3 THEN Round(I.AvgPrice, 2) END,   
	Value2=I.PackUnits,
	Value3=ISNULL(SUM(GD.CurrQty),0),   
	Value4 =ISNULL(ROUND(CAST(SUM(GD.CurrQty) AS FLOAT) / CAST(I.packUnits AS FLOAT), 2),0),
	Value5 = ISNULL(SUM(GD.CurrQty),0) *
			Case @Pricetype
			WHEN 1 THEN Round(I.SalePrice / I.PackUnits, 2)
			WHEN 2 THEN Round(I.PurPrice / I.PackUnits, 2)
			WHEN 3 THEN Round(I.AvgPrice, 2) END,
	Name6=CASE WHEN @ReportGrouping='M' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
		ELSE (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode) END,
	Name7=CASE WHEN @ReportGrouping IN ('C','M') THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
		ELSE (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode) END,
	Name8=CASE WHEN @ReportGrouping IN ('C','M','L') THEN (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE)
		ELSE (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode) END
FROM
	(SELECT GCode, ICode, CurrQty 
	FROM GodownDetail
	WHERE ICode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
	UNION ALL
	SELECT G.GCode, ICode=(SELECT Code=MIN(CODE) FROM @Tab_ItemList), CurrQty=0
	FROM Godown G
	WHERE G.GCode NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT GCODE FROM GodownDetail)
	UNION ALL
	SELECT GCode=(SELECT GCode=MIN(GCode) FROM GODOWN), ICode, CurrQty=0
	FROM 	(SELECT ICODE=CODE 
					FROM @Tab_ItemList
					WHERE CODE NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ICODE FROM GODOWNDETAIL)) I
	WHERE 1 = @ZeroRows)GD,
	Godown G,
	Item I

WHERE	
	I.ICode = GD.ICode AND
	GD.GCode = G.GCode AND
	I.active=1

GROUP BY 
	G.GCode,
	G.Name,
	I.ICODE,
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.ICatCode,
	I.ManfCode,
	I.ICCode,
	I.PackCode,
	I.PurPrice, 
	I.SalePrice, 
	I.AvgPrice, 
	I.PackUnits, 
	I.PackingDesc

-- SP_GraduateClass
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_GraduateClass @GraduationCode INT
AS
DECLARE @GraduatedStudents INT, @err INT

SET @GraduatedStudents = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ClassGraduationDetail WHERE GraduationCode=@GraduationCode AND Graduate = 'Y'), 0)
IF @GraduatedStudents <= 0
	RETURN 0

DECLARE @StudentList TABLE (ClassCode INT, StudentCode INT, RollNo VARCHAR(40), RowID INT, ThisID INT IDENTITY(1,1))

INSERT INTO @StudentList (ClassCode, StudentCode, RollNo, RowID)
SELECT C.ClassCode, D.StudentCode, D.RollNo, D.RowID
FROM 
	ClassGraduation C , ClassGraduationDetail D
WHERE 
	C.GraduationCode=@GraduationCode AND 
	C.GraduationCode = D.GraduationCode AND
	Graduate = 'Y'
ORDER BY D.RowID

SET @GraduatedStudents = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @StudentList), 0)
IF @GraduatedStudents <= 0
	RETURN 0

DECLARE @ThisID INT, @StudentCode INT, @ClassCode INT, @RollNo VARCHAR(40), @RowID INT, @UserCode SMALLINT
DECLARE @Reason VARCHAR(100)
SET @Reason = ISNULL((SELECT Remarks FROM ClassGraduation WHERE GraduationCode = @GraduationCode), 'School Leaving By Graduation')
SET @UserCode = ISNULL((SELECT UserCode FROM ClassGraduation WHERE GraduationCode = @GraduationCode), 1)

SET @ThisID=1
WHILE @ThisID <= @GraduatedStudents
BEGIN
	SET @ClassCode = (SELECT ClassCode FROM @StudentList WHERE ThisID = @ThisID)
	SET @StudentCode = (SELECT StudentCode FROM @StudentList WHERE ThisID = @ThisID)
	SET @RollNo = (SELECT RollNo FROM @StudentList WHERE ThisID = @ThisID)
	SET @RowID = (SELECT RowID FROM @StudentList WHERE ThisID = @ThisID)

	INSERT INTO DBO.SchoolLeaving (Date, StudentCode, ClassCode, RollNo, AdmissionDate, LastServiceInvCode, LastServiceInvDate, Reason, UserCode, GraduationRowID)
	SELECT Date=GETDATE(), Studentcode, ClassCode, RollNo, AdmissionDate, ServiceInvCode, LastServiceInvDate, @Reason, @UserCode, @RowID
	FROM StudentClass
	WHERE ClassCode = @ClassCode AND StudentCode = @StudentCode
	IF @err <> 0 OR @@Error <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Can Not Insert Student Record in School Leaving for the specified class', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE StudentClass SET GraduationRowID = @RowID WHERE ClassCode = @ClassCode AND StudentCode = @StudentCode
	IF @err <> 0 OR @@Error <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Can Not Update Student Entrollment in the specified class', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE Student SET Status = 'L' WHERE StudentCode = @StudentCode
	SET @ThisID = @ThisID + 1
END

UPDATE Class SET Promoted = 'Y', Graduated='Y' WHERE ClassCode = @ClassCode
RETURN 0

name: SP_GroupWise_RePrioritizeStockBatches
definition:
-- SP_GroupWise_RePrioritizeStockBatches
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_GroupWise_RePrioritizeStockBatches 
	@Method INT, 
	@Grouping CHAR(1),
	@GroupList VARCHAR(8000)
AS
/*
Author : Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Date : May 12, 2011
Purpose : Implement the selected/prefered Stock Allocation Method
	@Method = Selected/Prefered Stock Allocation Method
	@Grouping = The criteria for grouping the items
	@All = The criteria for grouping ALL the groups for items 
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
*/

DECLARE @batch VARCHAR(100), @ItemName Varchar(100)
DECLARE @ICode INT, @OldICode INT, @errcode INT, @Priority INT
DECLARE @Expiry DATETIME, @InDate DATETIME
DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@Grouping, @GroupList)

IF @Method = 1	/* Shortest Expiry First Method */
BEGIN
	UPDATE GodownDetail 
	SET Priority=10 
	WHERE GodownDetail.ICode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)
END


IF @Method = 2	/* FIFO Method*/
BEGIN
	/*
	Step - 1 :- Set Default Priority To Each Batch in Stock
	*/
	UPDATE GodownDetail 
	SET Priority=9
	WHERE GodownDetail.ICode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)
	
	SET @OldICode = NULL
	SET @Priority = 0
	/*
	Step - 2 :- Find Min InDate for each Batch in Stock
	*/
	
	DECLARE cursor1 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT T.ICode, T.Batch, T.Expiry, InDate=MIN(T.InDate)
	FROM
		(SELECT GD.ICode, GD.Batch, GD.Expiry, InDate=MIN(H.PostDate)
		FROM PurDetail D, PurLedger H, GodownDetail GD
		WHERE H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
			H.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND 
			D.ICode = GD.ICode AND
			D.Batch = GD.Batch AND
			D.Expiry = GD.Expiry AND
			GD.ICode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		GROUP BY
			GD.ICode,
			GD.Batch, 
			GD.Expiry
		UNION ALL
		SELECT GD.ICode, GD.Batch, GD.Expiry, InDate=MIN(H.PostDate)
		FROM SRDetail D, SRLedger H, GodownDetail GD
		WHERE H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
			H.SRInvCode = D.SRInvCode AND 
			D.ICode = GD.ICode AND
			D.Batch = GD.Batch AND
			D.Expiry = GD.Expiry AND
			GD.ICode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		GROUP BY
			GD.ICode,
			GD.Batch, 
			GD.Expiry
		UNION ALL
		SELECT GD.ICode, GD.Batch, GD.Expiry, InDate=MIN(H.PostDate)
		FROM ReceiptDetail D, ReceiptHeader H, GodownDetail GD
		WHERE H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
			H.ReceiptInvCode = D.ReceiptInvCode AND 
			D.ICode = GD.ICode AND
			D.Batch = GD.Batch AND
			D.Expiry = GD.Expiry AND
			GD.ICode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		GROUP BY
			GD.ICode,
			GD.Batch, 
			GD.Expiry
		UNION ALL
		SELECT GD.ICode, GD.Batch, GD.Expiry, InDate=MIN(H.Date)
		FROM AdjDetail D, AdjHeader H, GodownDetail GD
		WHERE H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
			AdjCatCode=1 AND
			H.AdjCode = D.AdjCode AND 
			D.ICode = GD.ICode AND
			D.Batch = GD.Batch AND
			D.Expiry = GD.Expiry AND
			GD.ICode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		GROUP BY
			GD.ICode,
			GD.Batch, 
			GD.Expiry) T
	GROUP BY
		T.ICode,
		T.Batch, 
		T.Expiry
	ORDER BY
		ICode,
		InDate,
		Expiry,
		Batch
	
	OPEN cursor1

	/* Step 3 Update Priority as it suits */	
	FETCH NEXT FROM cursor1
	INTO @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @InDate
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		IF @ICode = @OldICode
			SET @Priority = @Priority + 1
		ELSE
			SET @Priority = 1
	
		IF @Priority > 8
			SET @Priority = 8
	
		UPDATE GodownDetail SET Priority = @Priority WHERE ICode=@ICode AND Batch = @Batch AND Expiry = @Expiry
	
		SET @OldICode = @ICode
	
		FETCH NEXT FROM cursor1 INTO @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @InDate
	END
	CLOSE cursor1
	DEALLOCATE cursor1
END

IF @Method = 3	/* LIFO Method*/
BEGIN
	/*
	Step - 1 :- Set Default Priority To Each Batch in Stock
	*/
	UPDATE GodownDetail SET Priority=30
 	WHERE GodownDetail.ICode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)
	
	SET @OldICode = NULL
	SET @Priority = 10
	/*
	Step - 2 :- Find Lastest InDate for each Batch in Stock
	*/
	
	DECLARE cursor2 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT T.ICode, T.Batch, T.Expiry, InDate=MAX(T.InDate)
	FROM
		(SELECT GD.ICode, GD.Batch, GD.Expiry, InDate=MAX(H.PostDate)
		FROM PurDetail D, PurLedger H, GodownDetail GD
		WHERE H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
			H.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND 
			D.ICode = GD.ICode AND
			D.Batch = GD.Batch AND
			D.Expiry = GD.Expiry AND
			GD.ICode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		GROUP BY
			GD.ICode,
			GD.Batch, 
			GD.Expiry
		UNION ALL
		SELECT GD.ICode, GD.Batch, GD.Expiry, InDate=MAX(H.PostDate)
		FROM SRDetail D, SRLedger H, GodownDetail GD
		WHERE H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
			H.SRInvCode = D.SRInvCode AND 
			D.ICode = GD.ICode AND
			D.Batch = GD.Batch AND
			D.Expiry = GD.Expiry AND
			GD.ICode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		GROUP BY
			GD.ICode,
			GD.Batch, 
			GD.Expiry
		UNION ALL
		SELECT GD.ICode, GD.Batch, GD.Expiry, InDate=MAX(H.PostDate)
		FROM ReceiptDetail D, ReceiptHeader H, GodownDetail GD
		WHERE H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
			H.ReceiptInvCode = D.ReceiptInvCode AND 
			D.ICode = GD.ICode AND
			D.Batch = GD.Batch AND
			D.Expiry = GD.Expiry AND
			GD.ICode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		GROUP BY
			GD.ICode,
			GD.Batch, 
			GD.Expiry
		UNION ALL
		SELECT GD.ICode, GD.Batch, GD.Expiry, InDate=MAX(H.Date)
		FROM AdjDetail D, AdjHeader H, GodownDetail GD
		WHERE H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
			AdjCatCode=1 AND
			H.AdjCode = D.AdjCode AND 
			D.ICode = GD.ICode AND
			D.Batch = GD.Batch AND
			D.Expiry = GD.Expiry AND
			GD.ICode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		GROUP BY
			GD.ICode,
			GD.Batch, 
			GD.Expiry) T
	GROUP BY
		T.ICode,
		T.Batch, 
		T.Expiry
	ORDER BY
		ICode,
		InDate DESC,
		Expiry,
		Batch
	
	OPEN cursor2
	
	/* Step 3 Update Priority as it suits */	
	FETCH NEXT FROM cursor2
	INTO @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @InDate
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		IF @ICode = @OldICode
			SET @Priority = @Priority + 1
		ELSE
			SET @Priority = 11
	
		IF @Priority > 29
			SET @Priority = 29
	
		UPDATE GodownDetail SET Priority = @Priority WHERE ICode=@ICode AND Batch = @Batch AND Expiry = @Expiry
	
		SET @OldICode = @ICode
	
		FETCH NEXT FROM cursor2 INTO @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @InDate
	END
	CLOSE cursor2
	DEALLOCATE cursor2
END

-- SP_GuestCheckInBalance
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_GuestCheckInBalance
	@GuestCheckInCode INT,
	@Balance NUMERIC(15, 2) OUTPUT
AS

EXECUTE SP_VirtualGL 'A'
/*
Author: M.Azhar Inayat

Purpose:
	This Stored Procedure is used to get balance of Guest
	But First of all it updates latest balance in accounts by exceuting sp_virtualgl
	Then It Takes 2 rguments:-   
	1- @GuestCheckInCode Determines the Guest to be CheckOut
	2- @Balance
*/    

SET @Balance = 
	ISNULL(
		(SELECT Balance=SUM(V.Debit - V.Credit)
		FROM VirtualGL V, Accounts A
		WHERE V.GuestCode IN 
			(SELECT P.GuestCode 
			FROM GuestCheckIn P 
			WHERE P.GuestCheckInCode = @GuestCheckInCode) AND
		V.AccCode = A.AccCode AND
		V.AccCode IN (SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SubCode=3)), 0)

CREATE PROCEDURE sp_GuestOpeningBalance @al_GuestCode INT, @ad_edate datetime, @af_openbalance NUMERIC(15,5) OUT AS 
/*
	Two Parameters:-
		1)	ad_edate datetime 	(date upto which the balance is required)
		2)	af_openbalance float 	(output variable returns the balance to caller)
*/
/******** Collecting the result and assigning to the relevent reference variable *********/
select @af_openbalance = isnull( 
(select sum(V.debit) - sum(V.credit)
from VirtualGL V
WHERE V.GuestCode = @al_GuestCode AND 
	V.AccCode IN 
		(SELECT CustCode 
		FROM Guest
		WHERE GuestCode = @al_GuestCode) AND
	V.Date < @ad_edate), 0)

-- sp_HoldOn
Create Procedure sp_HoldOn @value SmallInt As
Declare @m TinyInt, @s TinyInt, @result SmallInt, @time Varchar(15)
Set @m = 0 
Set @s = 0 
Set @value = (Select fcatlength From SysCatelog Where fcatid = 7)
IF @value >= 60
Begin
	Set @result  = ( @value % 60 )
	IF @result = 0 
		Set @M = @value / 60
	Else
	Begin
		Set @M = @value / 60
		Set @s = @result
	End
End
Else 
Begin
	Set @s = @value
End
Set @time = '00:' + Cast(@m As VarChar(2)) + ':' + Cast(@s As VarChar(2)) 
WaitFor Delay @time

CREATE PROCEDURE sp_Import_Purchases_From_DataCarryDB

AS 
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON
DECLARE @query VARCHAR(2500), @Temp VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @errcode INT, @PurInvCode INT, @end_invcode INT, @RowCount INT

SELECT OldInvCode=PurInvCode,PurInvCode=-1,PurCatCode,SuppCode,SuppInvCode,SalesmanCode,Date,POCode,DiscPerc,FlatDisc,MiscCharges,SalesTax,Posted,postdate,Remarks,OriginalDate,ModifiedBy,PostedBy,SuppInvDate,GRN,PORB,InvGSTPerc1,purtypecode,HeaderNo,HeaderInvNo,InvTotal,AccountFor,PaymentMode,PaymentAccCode,Amt,AmtBY,AmtDate,AmtReference,OutstandingAmt,Marked,Transferable,Transfered,TransferedOn,TransferedBy,Imported,ImportedBy,PrintBalance,PurInvPageSize,CurrencyCode,ConversionFactor,PrintCounter,AssociatedSaleOrderCode,AssociatedSaleInvCode,GCCode,Vehicle,ShipTo,NewPurchaseOrderNo,LCNO,UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate,ImpactInventory,ImpPurInvCode,CreditDays,SuppInvAmount,CRS_Transfered,CRS_TransferedOn,ICatCode,MonthlyCounter,DailyCounter,CustCode,QE1_AccCode,QE2_AccCode,QE3_AccCode,QE4_AccCode,QE5_AccCode,WE1_AccCode,WE2_AccCode,WE3_AccCode,WE4_AccCode,WE5_AccCode

SET @query = 'ALTER TABLE #Header ADD RowID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1)'

IF @@Error <> 0

	Return -1

Set @query = @query + ' Select OldInvCode=PurInvCode,PurInvCode=-1,PurCatCode,SuppCode,SuppInvCode,SalesmanCode,Date,POCode,DiscPerc,FlatDisc,MiscCharges,SalesTax,Posted,postdate,Remarks,OriginalDate,ModifiedBy,PostedBy,SuppInvDate,GRN,PORB,InvGSTPerc1,purtypecode,HeaderNo,HeaderInvNo,InvTotal,AccountFor,PaymentMode,PaymentAccCode,Amt,AmtBY,AmtDate,AmtReference,OutstandingAmt,Marked,Transferable,Transfered,TransferedOn,TransferedBy,Imported,ImportedBy,PrintBalance,PurInvPageSize,CurrencyCode,ConversionFactor,PrintCounter,AssociatedSaleOrderCode,AssociatedSaleInvCode,GCCode,Vehicle,ShipTo,NewPurchaseOrderNo,LCNO,UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate,ImpactInventory,ImpPurInvCode,CreditDays,SuppInvAmount,CRS_Transfered,CRS_TransferedOn,ICatCode,MonthlyCounter,DailyCounter,CustCode,QE1_AccCode,QE2_AccCode,QE3_AccCode,QE4_AccCode,QE5_AccCode,WE1_AccCode,WE2_AccCode,WE3_AccCode,WE4_AccCode,WE5_AccCode '
Set @query = @query + ' From ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.' + 'PurLedger '
Set @query = @query + ' Where PurInvCode Between ' + Cast(@sinvcode As VarChar(10)) + ' And ' + Cast(@linvcode As VarChar(10)) /*+ ' AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(PurInvCode AS VARCHAR(10)))) NOT IN (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(SuppInvCode)) FROM PurLedger WHERE SuppInvCode IS NOT NULL) '*/
IF @SuppCode > 0
BEGIN
	Set @query = @query + ' AND SuppCode = ' + Cast(@SuppCode As VarChar(10))
END
Set @query = @query + ' ORDER BY OldInvCode '
Execute(@query)
IF @@Error = 0 AND @@RowCount > 0 
Begin
	Set @query = 'Insert Into #Detail (OldInvCode,PurInvCode,ICode,Gcode,Batch,Expiry,PackQty,LooseQty,PackUnits,PurPrice,DiscPerc,AvgPrice,BonusQty,NewAvgPrice,CurrStock,GSTPerc,UnitSalesTax,PurUtn,SalePrice,itemdescription,rate,SalePriceForItem,ForeignPrice,PurPriceInAdvPur,NetRate,RecentPurPrice,TotalPieces,PiecesInHand,ReceiptRowID,ManfCodeForItem,DiscountedSalePrice,FlatDiscForItem,RetailPrice,AlternateCustomICode,ManfDate,UnitWeight,QE1,QE2,QE3,QE4,QE5,WE1,WE2,WE3,WE4,WE5,BatchSalePrice) '
	Set @query = @query + 'Select OldInvCode=PurInvCode,PurInvCode=-1,ICode,Gcode,Batch,Expiry,PackQty,LooseQty,PackUnits,PurPrice,DiscPerc,AvgPrice,BonusQty,NewAvgPrice,CurrStock,GSTPerc,UnitSalesTax,PurUtn,SalePrice,itemdescription,rate,SalePriceForItem,ForeignPrice,PurPriceInAdvPur,NetRate,RecentPurPrice,TotalPieces,PiecesInHand,ReceiptRowID,ManfCodeForItem,DiscountedSalePrice,FlatDiscForItem,RetailPrice,AlternateCustomICode,ManfDate,UnitWeight,QE1,QE2,QE3,QE4,QE5,WE1,WE2,WE3,WE4,WE5,BatchSalePrice '
	Set @query = @query + 'From ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.' + 'PurDetail '
	Set @query = @query + 'Where PurInvCode Between ' + Cast(@sinvcode As VarChar(10)) + ' And ' + Cast(@linvcode As VarChar(10))  /*+ ' AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(PurInvCode AS VARCHAR(10)))) NOT IN (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(SuppInvCode)) FROM PurLedger WHERE SuppInvCode IS NOT NULL) '*/
	IF @SuppCode > 0
	BEGIN
		Set @query = @query + ' AND PurInvCode IN (SELECT PurInvCode FROM PurLedger WHERE SuppCode = ' + Cast(@SuppCode As VarChar(10)) + ') '
	END
	Set @query = @query + ' ORDER BY OldInvCode, PurRowId '
	Execute(@query)
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@RowCount = 0 	
	Begin
		RaisError('Problem in inserting detail records From Remote DataBase',16,1)
		Return -1

CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_Import_Quot_SO_PO_FromParentServer
	@SRV VARCHAR(50), 
	@DB VARCHAR(50), 
	@OWNER VARCHAR(20),
	@Quot CHAR(1),
	@SO CHAR(1),
	@PO CHAR(1)
AS

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

/* Variables to be used in import process */
DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(4000), @Query VARCHAR(8000), @FROM VARCHAR(2000)
DECLARE @err INT, @rt_code INT

SET @FROM = N' FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.'

IF @Quot='Y'
BEGIN
	SET @SQL = N'SELECT * ' + @FROM + 'QuotationHeader Q WHERE Q.QuotationCode NOT IN (SELECT QuotationCode FROM QuotationHeader)'
	SET @Query = 'INSERT INTO DBO.QuotationHeader ' + @SQL
	EXECUTE (@Query)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Quotation Header Import Problem: Error Importing Quotations Header From Parent Server.', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END 

	SET @SQL = N'SELECT D.QuotationCode, D.ICode, D.Qty, D.PackUnits, D.SalePrice, D.DiscPerc, D.SalesTax, D.ItemFlatDisc, D.BonusQty, D.GSTPerc, D.UnitSalesTax, D.ItemDescription, D.GCode, D.RemoteNetSaleQty, D.RemoteStock, D.PORate, D.SpecialRate, D.RefNo ' + @FROM + 'QuotationDetail D, QuotationHeader Q WHERE Q.QuotationCode = D.QuotationCode AND Q.QuotationCode NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT QD.QuotationCode FROM QuotationDetail QD) ORDER BY D.QuotationCode, D.ROWID'
	SET @Query = 'INSERT INTO DBO.QuotationDetail (QuotationCode, ICode, Qty, PackUnits, SalePrice, DiscPerc, SalesTax, ItemFlatDisc, BonusQty, GSTPerc, UnitSalesTax, ItemDescription, GCode, RemoteNetSaleQty, RemoteStock, PORate, SpecialRate, RefNo)' + @SQL
	EXECUTE (@Query)

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Quotation Detail Import Problem: Error Importing Quotations Detail From Parent Server.', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END 
END

IF @SO='Y'
BEGIN
	SET @SQL = N'SELECT * ' + @FROM + 'SaleOrderHeader H WHERE H.SaleOrderCode NOT IN (SELECT SaleOrderCode FROM SaleOrderHeader) '
	SET @Query = 'INSERT INTO DBO.SaleOrderHeader ' + @SQL
	EXECUTE (@Query)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Sale Order Header Import Problem: Error Importing Sale Order Header From Parent Server.', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END 

	SET @SQL = N'SELECT D.SaleOrderCode, D.ICode, D.GCode, D.LooseQty, D.PackUnits, D.SalePrice, D.AvgPrice, D.Rate, D.DiscPerc, D.ItemFlatDisc, D.SaleItemDescription, D.PackPrice, D.UnitSalesTax, D.GSTPerc, D.BonusQty, D.RowGroup, D.PackQtyForSale, D.BonusPackQtyForSale, D.Remarks, D.SaleOrderItemStatusCode, D.QuotationRowID, D.PrescriptionRowID, D.Batch, D.Expiry ' + @FROM + 'SaleOrderDetail D, SaleOrderHeader H WHERE H.SaleOrderCode = D.SaleOrderCode AND H.SaleOrderCode NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT DD.SaleOrderCode FROM SaleOrderDetail DD) ORDER BY D.SaleOrderCode, D.ROWID'
	SET @Query = 'INSERT INTO DBO.SaleOrderDetail (SaleOrderCode, ICode, GCode, LooseQty, PackUnits, SalePrice, AvgPrice, Rate, DiscPerc, ItemFlatDisc, SaleItemDescription, PackPrice, UnitSalesTax, GSTPerc, BonusQty, RowGroup, PackQtyForSale, BonusPackQtyForSale, Remarks, SaleOrderItemStatusCode, QuotationRowID, PrescriptionRowID, Batch, Expiry)' + @SQL
	EXECUTE (@Query)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Sale Order Detail Import Problem: Error Importing Sale Order Detail From Parent Server.', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END 
END

IF @PO='Y'
BEGIN
	SET @SQL = N'SELECT * ' + @FROM + 'PurOrderHeader H WHERE H.POCode NOT IN (SELECT POCode FROM PurOrderHeader)'
	SET @Query = 'INSERT INTO DBO.PurOrderHeader ' + @SQL

	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Purchase Order Header Import Problem: Error Importing Purchase Order Header From Parent Server.', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END 
	
	SET @SQL = N'SELECT D.POCode, D.ICode, D.Batch, D.Expiry, D.Qty, D.Rate, D.DiscPerc, D.BonusQty, D.Stock, D.ReorderQty, D.OptimumQty, D.MinQty, D.PackUnits, D.SoldQty, D.ReturnQty, D.QtySatisfied, D.BonusQtySatisfied, D.SaleOrderRequest, D.TransitStock, D.Remarks, D.ItemFlatDisc, D.PackSalesTax, D.GSTPerc, D.PurPrice, D.SalePrice, D.RPP, D.PackAvgPrice, D.ForeignPrice, D.LastPurInvCode, D.LastPurDate ' + @FROM + 'PurOrderDetail D, PurOrderHeader H WHERE H.POCode = D.POCode AND H.POCode NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT DD.POCode FROM PurOrderDetail DD) ORDER BY D.POCode, D.PORowID'
	SET @Query = 'INSERT INTO DBO.PurOrderDetail (POCode, ICode, Batch, Expiry, Qty, Rate, DiscPerc, BonusQty, Stock, ReorderQty, OptimumQty, MinQty, PackUnits, SoldQty, ReturnQty, QtySatisfied, BonusQtySatisfied, SaleOrderRequest, TransitStock, Remarks, ItemFlatDisc, PackSalesTax, GSTPerc, PurPrice, SalePrice, RPP, PackAvgPrice, ForeignPrice, LastPurInvCode, LastPurDate)' + @SQL
	EXECUTE (@Query)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Purchase Order Detail Import Problem: Error Importing Purchase Order Detail From Parent Server.', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END 
END

RETURN 0

AS

SELECT OldInvCode=QuotationCode,QuotationCode=-1,CustCode,SalesmanCode,date,DiscPerc,FlatDisc,MiscCharges,SalesTax,SPrice,ValidateUpTo,PostDate,Remarks,CustRefNo,headerno,OriginalDate,ModifiedBy,PostedBy,Posted,InvGSTPerc1,Remarks2,Remarks3,Remarks4,Remarks5,Remarks6,Remarks7,Remarks8,Remarks9,Pagesize,MessageCode,SManCode,LoosePack,ConsolidatedSaleOrder

INTO #Detail
FROM QuotationDetail
WHERE QuotationCode<0

SET @query = 'ALTER TABLE #Header ADD RowID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1)'
EXECUTE (@query)
IF @@Error <> 0
Begin
	RaisError('Problem in adding identity column in temporary table',16,1)
	Return -1
End

Set @query = 'Insert Into #Header (OldInvCode,QuotationCode,CustCode,SalesmanCode,date,DiscPerc,FlatDisc,MiscCharges,SalesTax,SPrice,ValidateUpTo,PostDate,Remarks,CustRefNo,headerno,OriginalDate,ModifiedBy,PostedBy,Posted,InvGSTPerc1,Remarks2,Remarks3,Remarks4,Remarks5,Remarks6,Remarks7,Remarks8,Remarks9,Pagesize,MessageCode,SManCode,LoosePack,ConsolidatedSaleOrder) '

Set @query = @query + ' From ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.' + 'QuotationHeader '
Set @query = @query + ' Where QuotationCode Between ' + Cast(@sinvcode As VarChar(10)) + ' And ' + Cast(@linvcode As VarChar(10)) /*+ ' AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(QuotationCode AS VARCHAR(10)))) NOT IN (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(SuppInvCode)) FROM QuotationHeader WHERE SuppInvCode IS NOT NULL) '*/
IF @CustCode > 0
BEGIN
	Set @query = @query + ' AND CustCode = ' + Cast(@CustCode As VarChar(10))
END
Set @query = @query + ' ORDER BY OldInvCode '
Execute(@query)
IF @@Error = 0 AND @@RowCount > 0 
Begin
	Set @query = 'Insert Into #Detail (OldInvCode,QuotationCode,ICode,Qty,PackUnits,SalePrice,DiscPerc,SalesTax,itemflatdisc,BonusQty,GSTPerc,UnitSalesTax,ItemDescription,gcode,RemoteNetSaleQty,RemoteStock,PORate,PODiscPerc,SpecialRate,RefNo) '

	Set @query = @query + 'From ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.' + 'QuotationDetail '
	Set @query = @query + 'Where QuotationCode Between ' + Cast(@sinvcode As VarChar(10)) + ' And ' + Cast(@linvcode As VarChar(10))  /*+ ' AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(QuotationCode AS VARCHAR(10)))) NOT IN (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(SuppInvCode)) FROM QuotationHeader WHERE SuppInvCode IS NOT NULL) '*/
	IF @CustCode > 0
	BEGIN
		Set @query = @query + ' AND QuotationCode IN (SELECT QuotationCode FROM QuotationHeader WHERE CustCode = ' + Cast(@CustCode As VarChar(10)) + ') '
	END
	Set @query = @query + ' ORDER BY OldInvCode, RowID '
	Execute(@query)
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@RowCount = 0 	
	Begin
		RaisError('Problem in inserting detail records From Remote DataBase',16,1)
		Return -1
	End
End
Else
Begin
	IF @@RowCount = 0 AND @@Error=0
	BEGIN
		Return 1
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem in inserting header records From Remote DataBase',16,1)
		Return -1
	END
End

SET @RowCount = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #Header)
IF @linvcode >= @sinvcode AND @RowCount > 0
BEGIN
	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'Quotation' , @QuotationCode OUTPUT
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Fetching QuotationHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	UPDATE #Header SET QuotationCode = @QuotationCode + RowID
	UPDATE #Detail SET QuotationCode = H.QuotationCode FROM #Detail D, #Header H WHERE H.OldInvCode = D.OldInvCode

	INSERT INTO QuotationHeader (QuotationCode,CustCode,SalesmanCode,date,DiscPerc,FlatDisc,MiscCharges,SalesTax,SPrice,ValidateUpTo,PostDate,Remarks,CustRefNo,headerno,OriginalDate,ModifiedBy,PostedBy,Posted,InvGSTPerc1,Remarks2,Remarks3,Remarks4,Remarks5,Remarks6,Remarks7,Remarks8,Remarks9,Pagesize,MessageCode,SManCode,LoosePack,ConsolidatedSaleOrder)

	FROM #Header
	ORDER BY OldInvCode

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in QuotationHeader', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	INSERT INTO QuotationDetail (QuotationCode,ICode,Qty,PackUnits,SalePrice,DiscPerc,SalesTax,itemflatdisc,BonusQty,GSTPerc,UnitSalesTax,ItemDescription,gcode,RemoteNetSaleQty,RemoteStock,PORate,PODiscPerc,SpecialRate,RefNo)

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in Quotation Detail', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction	
		RETURN -1
	END
	SET @end_invcode = ISNULL((SELECT Max(QuotationCode) FROM #Header),1)
	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'Quotation' , @end_invcode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Updating QuotationHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END
END
IF @@ERROR = 0 
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	RETURN -1
END

	UPDATE #SHeader SET ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode + RowID
	UPDATE #SDetail SET ServiceInvCode = H.ServiceInvcode FROM #SDetail D, #SHeader H WHERE H.OldInvCode = D.OldInvCode

	INSERT INTO ServiceHeader (ServiceInvCode,CustCode,SalesmanCode,ServiceCatCode,Remarks,OriginalDate,ModifiedBy,Date,PostedBy,PostDate,HeaderNo,DiscPerc,FlatDisc,MiscCharges,SaleInvCode,Posted,DoctCode,RePrintingCounter,ServiceOCode,CashReceived,PatientCode,AdmissionCode,DueDate,FullPatientName,PatientAge,PatientSex,PatientRefBy,Ref1,Ref2,CashAccCode,CashTendered,CashCharged,CashBack,InvTotal,OutStandingAmt,TokenNo,GuestCode,GuestCheckInCode,StudentCode,Marked,ServiceInvTypeCode,MessageCode,ServiceInvGSTPerc)
	SELECT ServiceInvCode,CustCode,SalesmanCode,ServiceCatCode,Remarks,OriginalDate,ModifiedBy,Date,PostedBy,PostDate,HeaderNo,DiscPerc,FlatDisc,MiscCharges,SaleInvCode=NULL,Posted,DoctCode,RePrintingCounter,ServiceOCode=NULL,CashReceived,PatientCode,AdmissionCode=NULL,DueDate,FullPatientName,PatientAge,PatientSex,PatientRefBy,Ref1,Ref2=OldInvCode,CashAccCode,CashTendered,CashCharged,CashBack,InvTotal,OutStandingAmt,TokenNo,GuestCode,GuestCheckInCode,StudentCode,Marked,ServiceInvTypeCode,MessageCode,ServiceInvGSTPerc
	FROM #SHeader
	ORDER BY OldInvCode

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceHeader', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	INSERT INTO ServiceDetail (ServiceInvCode,ServiceCode,Price,DiscPerc,SmanCode,Qty,Commission,DeliveryDate,SampleTaken,ReportMade,CostPrice,Remarks,ServiceFlatDisc,ServiceGSTPerc,ServiceFlatTax,TransportRouteCode,VehicleCode)
	SELECT ServiceInvCode,ServiceCode,Price,DiscPerc,SmanCode,Qty,Commission,DeliveryDate,SampleTaken,ReportMade,CostPrice,Remarks,ServiceFlatDisc,ServiceGSTPerc,ServiceFlatTax,TransportRouteCode,VehicleCode
	FROM #SDetail

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceDetail', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction	
		RETURN -1
	END
	SET @end_invcode = ISNULL((SELECT Max(ServiceInvCode) FROM #SHeader),1)
	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @end_invcode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Updating ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
		Rollback Transaction
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE ServiceHeader 
	SET InvTotal = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(ServiceInvCode), 0)
	WHERE ServiceInvCode IN (SELECT ServiceInvCode FROM #SHeader)

	UPDATE ServiceHeader SET OutStandingAmt = CASE WHEN CashCharged > InvTotal THEN 0 ELSE InvTotal - CashCharged END
	WHERE ServiceCatCode <> 10 AND ServiceInvCode IN (SELECT ServiceInvCode FROM #SHeader)
END
IF @@ERROR = 0 
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	RETURN -1
END

-- SP_ImportData
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_ImportData 
	@SRV VARCHAR(50), 
	@DB VARCHAR(50), 
	@OWNER VARCHAR(20) 
AS

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

/* Variables to be used in import process */
DECLARE @TableName NVARCHAR(255), @Imp_TableName NVARCHAR(255), @full_table_name NVARCHAR(255)
DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(50), @Query VARCHAR(4000), @FROM VARCHAR(1000), @LastDate DATETIME
DECLARE @table_id INT, @err INT, @rt_code INT
DECLARE @dt DATETIME

SET @SQL = N'SELECT * INTO '
SET @FROM = N' FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.'

DECLARE TmpCrs1 CURSOR FOR
SELECT TABLENAME=LTRIM(RTRIM(TABLENAME)), IMP_TABLENAME = 'DBO.Import_' + LTRIM(RTRIM(TABLENAME))
FROM TransferableData 
WHERE Enable='Y' AND (AUTOINSERT = 'Y' OR AUTOUPDATE = 'Y' OR AUTODELETE = 'Y' OR UPDATETABMAXKEY = 'Y')
ORDER BY Priority

OPEN TmpCrs1

FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs1 INTO @TableName, @Imp_TableName
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @full_table_name = LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.' + @TableName
	SET @table_id = OBJECT_ID(@full_table_name)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0 OR @table_id IS NULL
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Import Basic Data Problem: Invalid Object Refered: Name = %s', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
		CLOSE TmpCrs1
		DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
		RETURN -1
	END 

	IF LOWER(@TableName) = 'item'
	BEGIN
		SET @LastDate = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(LastUpdate) FROM Item), '01-01-1900 00:00:00')
		SET @Query = @SQL + @Imp_TableName + ' ' + @FROM + @TableName + ' AS T WHERE T.LastUpdate NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT I.LASTUPDATE FROM Item I)'
	END
	ELSE
		SET @Query = @SQL + @Imp_TableName + ' ' + @FROM + @TableName
	EXECUTE (@Query)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Import Basic Data Problem: Error Transfering Data From %s into %s ', 16, 1, @TableName, @Imp_TableName)
		CLOSE TmpCrs1
		DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
		RETURN -1
	END 
	FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs1 INTO @TableName, @Imp_TableName
END
CLOSE TmpCrs1
DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1

SET @full_table_name = LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.GodownDetail'
SET @table_id = OBJECT_ID(@full_table_name)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0 OR @table_id IS NULL
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Import Stock Data Problem: Invalid Object Refered: Name = %s', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
	RETURN -1
END 

SET @Imp_TableName = LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.Import_GodownDetail'
SET @Query = @SQL + @Imp_TableName + ' ' + @FROM + 'GodownDetail'
EXECUTE (@Query)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Import Stock Data Problem: Error Transfering Data From %s into %s ', 16, 1, @TableName, @Imp_TableName)
	RETURN -1
END 

SET @dt = GETDATE()
Execute @rt_code = SP_Set_DateTime_Preference 'LastDataImport', @dt
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
Begin
	RaisError( 'Unable to Record Last Sale Import Information in Software Preferences' , 16 , 1)
	RETURN -1								
End

INSERT INTO DataImportLog (LogDate, ImportedBy, ImportType, Remarks)
VALUES (GetDate(), 1, 'Complete Data Import', 'Complete Data Import')

RETURN 0

CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.sp_ImportData_From_ParentServer
	@SRV VARCHAR(50), 
	@DB VARCHAR(50), 
	@OWNER VARCHAR(20) 
AS

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

DECLARE @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @continue Int

BEGIN TRANSACTION T1

DECLARE @RC int
DECLARE @SequenceID int, @mySeq int
DECLARE @AppVersion int, @myVer int
DECLARE @DBStatus int, @dbstat int
SET @mySeq = ISNULL((SELECT SequenceID From Sequence), 0)
SET @myVer = ISNULL((SELECT Appversion From Sequence), 0)
SET @dbstat = ISNULL((SELECT DBStatus From Sequence), 0)

EXEC @RC = DBO.SP_GetVersionInfo @SRV, @DB, @OWNER, @SequenceID OUTPUT , @AppVersion OUTPUT , @DBStatus OUTPUT 
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
BEGIN
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION T1
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	IF @SequenceID <> @mySeq OR @AppVersion <> @myVer OR @DBStatus <> @dbstat
	BEGIN
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION T1
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE @rt_code = DBO.SP_DropImportTables
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION T1
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			COMMIT TRANSACTION T1
		
			BEGIN TRANSACTION T2
			EXECUTE @rt_code = DBO.SP_ImportData @SRV, @DB, @OWNER
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
			BEGIN
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION T2
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				COMMIT TRANSACTION T2
			END
		END
	END
END
RETURN 0

CREATE   PROCEDURE DBO.sp_ImportSales
	@SRV VARCHAR(255), 
	@DB VARCHAR(255), 
	@OWNER VARCHAR(255), 
	@StartDate DateTime, 
	@EndDate DateTime, 
	@TemplateCode Int Output 
As

/*SET environment*/
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

/*Declare Variables*/
DECLARE @TableQualifier NVARCHAR(4000), @SQLDETAIL NVARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @HeaderCode INT, @errcode INT
/*
Prepare TableQualifier Variable from passed parameters
*/
SET @TableQualifier = LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner))

/*
Get Primary Key value for fresh datatransfer log instance
*/
EXECUTE @errcode = SP_GetTabMaxkey 'SaleTemplateHeader' , @TemplateCode Output
SET @errcode = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in generating sale template', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

INSERT INTO SaleTemplateHeader (SaleTemplateCode, Date, Modified, Name, HeaderNo)
SELECT @TemplateCode, Date=GetDate(), Modified=GETDATE(), Name = 'FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@StartDate AS VARCHAR(100)))) + ' TO ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@EndDate AS VARCHAR(100)))) + ' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@TemplateCode))) +  ')', HeaderNo=1
IF @@ERROR <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in generating sale template header', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @errcode = 0

SET @SQLDETAIL = 'INSERT INTO DBO.SaleTemplateDetail (SaleTemplateCode, Icode, LooseQty, PackQty, SalePrice, DiscPerc, ItemFlatDisc, UnitSalesTax, GSTPerc, PackUnits, Remarks, BonusQty, SaleInvCode, SaleDate, CustCode, SaleCatCode, Marked) SELECT Template=' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@TemplateCode))) + ' , D.ICode, LooseQty=SUM(D.LooseQty), PackQty=0, D.SalePrice, D.DiscPerc, D.ItemFlatDisc, D.UnitSalesTax, D.GstPerc, D.PackUnits, Remarks=S.Remarks, BonusQty = SUM(D.BonusQty), SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode, SaleDate=S.Date, CustCode=S.CustCode, S.SaleCatCode, Marked=''Y'' FROM ' + @TableQualifier + '.SaleLedger S, ' + @TableQualifier + '.SaleDetail D, ' + @TableQualifier + '.Item I WHERE S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND S.Date BETWEEN ''' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@StartDate AS VARCHAR(100)))) + ''' AND ''' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(@EndDate AS VARCHAR(100)))) + ''' AND D.ICode = I.ICode GROUP BY I.Name, S.SaleInvCode, S.Date, S.CustCode, S.SaleCatCode, S.Remarks, D.ICode, D.SalePrice, D.DiscPerc, D.ItemFlatDisc, D.UnitSalesTax, D.GstPerc, D.PackUnits ORDER BY S.SaleInvCode, D.ICode'
EXECUTE(@SQLDETAIL)
IF @@ERROR = 0 AND @errcode = 0
	RETURN 0
ELSE
	RaisError('Unable To successfully generate sale template detail', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1

CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.sp_ImportStock_From_ParentServer
	@SRV VARCHAR(50), 
	@DB VARCHAR(50), 
	@OWNER VARCHAR(20),
	@UserCode SMALLINT
AS

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

DECLARE @Query VARCHAR(4000), @FROM VARCHAR(1000)
DECLARE @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @continue Int
DECLARE @RC int
DECLARE @SequenceID int, @mySeq int
DECLARE @AppVersion int, @myVer int
DECLARE @DBStatus int, @dbstat int
SET @mySeq = ISNULL((SELECT SequenceID From Sequence), 0)
SET @myVer = ISNULL((SELECT Appversion From Sequence), 0)
SET @dbstat = ISNULL((SELECT DBStatus From Sequence), 0)

BEGIN TRANSACTION T1

EXEC @RC = DBO.SP_GetVersionInfo @SRV, @DB, @OWNER, @SequenceID OUTPUT , @AppVersion OUTPUT , @DBStatus OUTPUT 
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
BEGIN
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION T1
	RAISERROR('Import Stock Problem: Failure in Version Fetching', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	IF @SequenceID <> @mySeq OR @AppVersion <> @myVer OR @DBStatus <> @dbstat
	BEGIN
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION T1
		RAISERROR('Import Stock Problem: Version Conflict Exist between the two databases', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		SET @Query = N'TRUNCATE TABLE GodownDetail'
		EXECUTE (@Query)
		IF @@Error <> 0 
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION T1
			RAISERROR('Stock Truncation Problem', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
		SET @Query = N'INSERT INTO GodownDetail SELECT T.* FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.GodownDetail T WHERE T.ICode IN (SELECT ICode FROM Item)'
		EXECUTE (@Query)
		IF @@Error <> 0 
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION T1
			RAISERROR('Stock Import Error', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO DataImportLog (LogDate, ImportedBy, ImportType, Remarks)
			VALUES (GetDate(), @UserCode, 'Stock Position Only', 'Stock Position Updated via Job')
		END
	END
END
COMMIT TRANSACTION T1
RETURN 0

-- sp_IncomeStatement
CREATE   PROCEDURE sp_IncomeStatement @ad_SDate DateTime, @ad_EDate DateTime, @ac_level Char(1) AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_temp NUMERIC(20, 5), @ln_RevenueFromSalesCat NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_DirectExpensesCat NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_OperatingExpensesCat NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_OtherExpensesCat NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_OtherRevenuesCat NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_invacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cgs NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @InvSys CHAR(1)

SET @InvSys = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'InventorySystemUsed')), 'P')
SET @ln_invacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_InventoryAcc')
SET @ln_cgs = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CostOfGoodsSoldAcc')
SET @ln_purchaseacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseAccount')
SET @ln_cashacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_equityacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_EquityACC')
SET @ln_salesacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesACC')
SET @ln_salesretacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesReturnACC')
SET @ln_purchaseretacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseReturnsAccount')
SET @ln_revfromservice  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_RevenueFromServices')
SET @ln_OtherRevenuesCat= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_OtherRevenuesCat')
SET @ln_RevenueFromSalesCat=(SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_RevenueFromSalesCat')
SET @ln_DirectExpensesCat= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_DirectExpensesCat')
SET @ln_OperatingExpensesCat=(SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_OperatingExpensesCat')
SET @ln_OtherExpensesCat=(SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_OtherExpensesCat')
SET @ln_OtherRevenuesCat=(SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_OtherRevenuesCat')

DELETE reportdata

BEGIN TRANSACTION

insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
select	code1=-1,
	code2=1,
	code3=0,
	name1= (SELECT name 
		from categoryaccounts 
		where catacccode = @ln_RevenueFromSalesCat),
	name2='',
	value1= isnull(sum(isnull(v.debit, 0) - isnull(v.credit, 0)), 0),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
from virtualgl v
where   v.acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode in 
		(SELECT subacccode 
		from subaccounts 
		where catacccode = @ln_RevenueFromSalesCat)) and
	v.date >= @ad_SDate and v.date <= @ad_EDate

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) from reportdata where code2=1)

insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
select	code1=-1,
	code2=2,
	code3=0,
	name1= 'COST OF SALES',
	name2='',
	value1=(select isnull(sum(isnull(v.debit, 0) - isnull(v.credit,0)), 0) from virtualgl v
		where  	v.acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode in 
					(SELECT subacccode 
					from subaccounts 
					where catacccode = @ln_DirectExpensesCat)) and
			v.date >= @ad_SDate and v.date <= @ad_EDate) + 
		(select Round(isnull(sum(isnull(newavgprice*newstock, 0)), 0),0)
		from stockledger
		where 	date < @ad_SDate AND
			convert(varchar(10), icode) + ' ' + convert(varchar(20), utn) IN
			(select convert(varchar(10), icode) + ' ' + convert(varchar(20), max(utn))
		from stockledger
		where @InvSys = 'P' AND date < @ad_SDate
		group by icode)) - 
		(select Round(isnull(sum(isnull(newavgprice*newstock, 0)), 0),0)
		from stockledger
		where 	date <= @ad_EDate AND
			convert(varchar(10), icode) + ' ' + convert(varchar(20), utn) IN
			(select convert(varchar(10), icode) + ' ' + convert(varchar(20), max(utn))
		from stockledger
		where @InvSys = 'P' AND date <= @ad_EDate
		group by icode)), 
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) from reportdata where code2=2)

insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
select	code1=-1,
	code2=3,
	code3=0,
	name1= 'GROSS PROFIT/LOSS',
	name2='',
	value1=(select isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) from reportdata),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) from reportdata where code2=3)

insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
select	code1=-1,
	code2=4,
	code3=0,
	name1= (SELECT name 
		from categoryaccounts 
		where catacccode = @ln_OperatingExpensesCat),
	name2='',
	value1=isnull(sum(v.debit - v.credit), 0),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
from virtualgl v
where   v.acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode in 
		(SELECT subacccode 
		from subaccounts 
		where catacccode = @ln_OperatingExpensesCat)) and
	v.date >= @ad_SDate and v.date <= @ad_EDate

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) from reportdata where code2=4)

IF @ln_temp <> 0
BEGIN
insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
select	code1=-1,
	code2=5,
	code3=0,
	name1= 'OPERATING PROFIT/LOSS',
	name2='',
	value1= (select sum(isnull(value1, 0)) from reportdata where code2 in (3,4)),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
END

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) from reportdata where code2=5)

insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
select	code1=-1,
	code2=6,
	code3=0,
	name1= (SELECT name 
		from categoryaccounts 
		where catacccode = @ln_OtherExpensesCat),
	name2='',
	value1=isnull(sum(v.debit - v.credit), 0),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
from virtualgl v
where   v.acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode in 
		(SELECT subacccode 
		from subaccounts 
		where catacccode = @ln_OtherExpensesCat)) and
	v.date >= @ad_SDate and v.date <= @ad_EDate

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) from reportdata where code2=6)

IF @ln_temp <> 0
BEGIN
insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
select	code1=-1,
	code2=7,
	code3=0,
	name1= 'PROFIT/LOSS AFTER ' + (SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(NAME)) FROM categoryaccounts 
					where catacccode = @ln_OtherExpensesCat),
	name2='',
	value1= (select isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) from reportdata where code2 in ((select max(code2) from reportdata where code2 in (3, 5)),6)),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
END

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) from reportdata where code2=7)

insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
select	code1=-1,
	code2=8,
	code3=0,
	name1= (SELECT name 
		from categoryaccounts 
		where catacccode = @ln_OtherRevenuesCat),
	name2='',
	value1= isnull(sum(v.debit - v.credit), 0),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
from virtualgl v
where   v.acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode in 
		(SELECT subacccode 
		from subaccounts 
		where catacccode = @ln_OtherRevenuesCat)) and
	v.date >= @ad_SDate and v.date <= @ad_EDate

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) from reportdata where code2=8)

IF @ln_temp <> 0
BEGIN
insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
select	code1=-1,
	code2=9,
	code3=0,
	name1= 'NET INCOME/LOSS',
	name2='',
	value1= (select isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) from reportdata where code2 in ((select max(code2) from reportdata where code2 in (3, 5, 7)),8)),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
END

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) from reportdata where code2=9)

insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
select	code1=-1,
	code2=10,
	code3=0,
	name1= (SELECT name 
		from categoryaccounts 
		where catacccode = c.catacccode),
	name2='',
	value1=isnull(sum(v.debit - v.credit), 0),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
from virtualgl v, categoryaccounts c, subaccounts s, accounts a
where   v.acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode in 
		(SELECT subacccode 
		from subaccounts 
		where catacccode in 
			(SELECT catacccode 
			from categoryaccounts 
			where mainacccode in (4, 5) and catacccode not in 
				(@ln_RevenueFromSalesCat, @ln_DirectExpensesCat, 
				 @ln_OperatingExpensesCat, @ln_OtherExpensesCat, 
				 @ln_OtherRevenuesCat)))) and
	v.date >= @ad_SDate and v.date <= @ad_EDate and
	v.acccode = a.acccode and a.subcode=s.subacccode and s.catacccode = c.catacccode
GROUP BY c.catacccode

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) from reportdata where code2=10)

IF @ln_temp <> 0
BEGIN
insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
select	code1=-1,
	code2=11,
	code3=0,
	name1= 'NET INCOME/LOSS FOR THE PERIOD',
	name2='',
	value1= (select isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) 
		from reportdata 
		where code2 in ((select max(code2) from reportdata where code2 in (3, 5, 7, 9)), 10)),
	value2=0,
	value3=0,
	value4=0,
	date1 =@ad_SDate,
	date2 =@ad_EDate,
	value5=@ac_level
END

IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 0
	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(sum(isnull(value1, 0)), 0) from reportdata where code2=11)

UPDATE REPORTDATA SET Value1 = 0 WHERE VALUE1 is NULL

IF @ac_level <> '0'
BEGIN
	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(code2, 0) from reportdata where code2=1)
	IF @ln_temp <> 0
	BEGIN
		insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
		select	code1=1,
			code2=(select max(code2)+1 from reportdata),
			code3=ac.acccode,
			name1= ac.name,
			name2=(select distinct name1 from reportdata where code2=1),
			value1=a.balance,
			value2=0,
			value3=0,
			value4=1,
			date1 =@ad_SDate,
			date2 =@ad_EDate,
			value5=@ac_level
		from 
		(select acccode, isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) as balance
		from virtualgl where acccode in 
			(select acccode from accounts where subcode in 
				(SELECT subacccode 
				from subaccounts 
				where catacccode = @ln_RevenueFromSalesCat)) and
			date >= @ad_SDate and date <= @ad_EDate
		group by acccode) a, accounts ac
		where a.acccode=ac.acccode
	END

	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(code2, 0) from reportdata where code2=2)
	IF @ln_temp <> 0
	BEGIN
		IF @InvSys = 'P'
		BEGIN
			insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
			select	code1=2,
				code2=(select max(code2)+1 from reportdata),
				code3=-2,
				name1= 'OPENING STOCK/INVENTORY ',
				name2=(select distinct name1 from reportdata where code2=2),
				value1=	(select Round(isnull(sum(isnull(newavgprice*newstock, 0)),0),0)
					from stockledger
					where 	date < @ad_SDate AND
						convert(varchar(10), icode) + ' ' + convert(varchar(20), utn) IN
						(select convert(varchar(10), icode) + ' ' + convert(varchar(20), max(utn))
						from stockledger
						where date < @ad_SDate
						group by icode)),
				value2=0,
				value3=0,
				value4=1,
				date1 =@ad_SDate,
				date2 =@ad_EDate,
				value5=@ac_level
		END

		insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
		select	code1=2,
			code2=(select max(code2)+1 from reportdata),
			code3=ac.acccode,
			name1= ac.name,
			name2=(select distinct name1 from reportdata where code2=2),
			value1=isnull(a.balance, 0),
			value2=0,
			value3=0,
			value4=1,
			date1 =@ad_SDate,
			date2 =@ad_EDate,
			value5=@ac_level
		from 
		(select acccode, sum(isnull(debit, 0)-isnull(credit, 0)) as balance
		from virtualgl where acccode in 
			(select acccode from accounts where subcode in 
				(SELECT subacccode 
				from subaccounts 
				where catacccode = @ln_DirectExpensesCat)) and
			date >= @ad_SDate and date <= @ad_EDate
		group by acccode) a, accounts ac
		where a.acccode=ac.acccode
	
		IF @InvSys = 'P'
		BEGIN
			insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
			select	code1=2,
				code2=(select max(code2)+1 from reportdata),
				code3=-1,
				name1= 'CLOSING STOCK/INVENTORY ',
				name2=(select distinct name1 from reportdata where code2=2),
				value1=	(select Round(isnull(sum(-isnull(newavgprice*newstock, 0)), 0), 0)
					from stockledger
					where 	date <= @ad_EDate AND
						convert(varchar(10), icode) + ' ' + convert(varchar(20), utn) IN
					(select convert(varchar(10), icode) + ' ' + convert(varchar(20), max(utn))
						from stockledger
						where date <= @ad_EDate
						group by icode)),
				value2=0,
				value3=0,
				value4=1,
				date1 =@ad_SDate,
				date2 =@ad_EDate,
				value5=@ac_level
		END
	END

	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(code2, 0) from reportdata where code2=4)
	IF @ln_temp <> 0
	BEGIN
		insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
		select	code1=4,
			code2=(select max(code2)+1 from reportdata),
			code3=acccode,
			name1= name,
			name2=(select distinct name1 from reportdata where code2=4),
			value1=isnull(balance, 0),
			value2=0,
			value3=0,
			value4=1,
			date1 =@ad_SDate,
			date2 =@ad_EDate,
			value5=@ac_level
		from
		(select a.acccode, a.name, sum(isnull(v.debit, 0)-isnull(v.credit, 0)) as balance
		from virtualgl v, accounts a
		where v.acccode in 
			(select acccode from accounts where subcode in 
				(select subacccode from subaccounts where catacccode in 
					(SELECT catacccode 
					from categoryaccounts 
					where catacccode = @ln_OperatingExpensesCat))) and
			v.acccode = a.acccode and 
			v.date >= @ad_SDate and v.date <= @ad_EDate
		group by a.acccode, a.name) a
	END

	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(code2, 0) from reportdata where code2=6)
	IF @ln_temp <> 0
	BEGIN
		insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
		select	code1=6,
			code2=(select max(code2)+1 from reportdata),
			code3=acccode,
			name1= name,
			name2=(select distinct name1 from reportdata where code2=6),
			value1=isnull(balance, 0),
			value2=0,
			value3=0,
			value4=1,
			date1 =@ad_SDate,
			date2 =@ad_EDate,
			value5=@ac_level
		from
		(select a.acccode, a.name, sum(isnull(v.debit, 0)-isnull(v.credit, 0)) as balance
		from virtualgl v, accounts a
		where v.acccode in 
			(select acccode from accounts where subcode in 
				(select subacccode from subaccounts where catacccode in 
					(SELECT catacccode 
					from categoryaccounts 
					where catacccode = @ln_OtherExpensesCat))) and
			v.acccode = a.acccode and 
			v.date >= @ad_SDate and v.date <= @ad_EDate
		group by a.acccode, a.name) a
	END

	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(code2, 0) from reportdata where code2=8)
	IF @ln_temp <> 0
	BEGIN
		insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
		select	code1=8,
			code2=(select max(code2)+1 from reportdata),
			code3=acccode,
			name1= name,
			name2=(select distinct name1 from reportdata where code2=8),
			value1=isnull(balance, 0),
			value2=0,
			value3=0,
			value4=1,
			date1 =@ad_SDate,
			date2 =@ad_EDate,
			value5=@ac_level
		from
		(select a.acccode, a.name, sum(isnull(v.debit, 0)-isnull(v.credit, 0)) as balance
		from virtualgl v, accounts a
		where v.acccode in 
			(select acccode from accounts where subcode in 
				(select subacccode from subaccounts where catacccode in 
					(SELECT catacccode
					from categoryaccounts 
					where catacccode = @ln_OtherRevenuesCat))) and
			v.acccode = a.acccode and 
			v.date >= @ad_SDate and v.date <= @ad_EDate
		group by a.acccode, a.name) a
	END

	insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
	select	code1=10+catacccode,
		code2=catacccode,
		code3=acccode,
		name1= name,
		name2= catname,
		value1=isnull(balance, 0),
		value2=0,
		value3=0,
		value4=1,
		date1 =@ad_SDate,
		date2 =@ad_EDate,
		value5=@ac_level
	from
	(select a.acccode, a.name, c.catacccode, catname=c.name, sum(isnull(v.debit, 0)-isnull(v.credit, 0)) as balance
	from virtualgl v, accounts a, subaccounts s, categoryaccounts c
	where v.acccode in 
		(select acccode from accounts where subcode in 
			(select subacccode from subaccounts where catacccode in 
				(SELECT catacccode 
				from categoryaccounts 
				where mainacccode in (4, 5) and catacccode not in 
					(@ln_RevenueFromSalesCat, @ln_DirectExpensesCat, 
					 @ln_OperatingExpensesCat, @ln_OtherExpensesCat, 
					 @ln_OtherRevenuesCat)))) and
		v.acccode = a.acccode and 
		v.date >= @ad_SDate and v.date <= @ad_EDate and
		a.subcode = s.subacccode and
		s.catacccode = c.catacccode
	group by a.acccode, a.name, c.name, c.catacccode) a
END

UPDATE REPORTDATA SET Value1 = 0 WHERE VALUE1 is NULL

IF @ac_level = '2' OR @ac_level = '3'
BEGIN
	insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
	select	code1=(select max(code1)+1 from reportdata),
		code2=catcode,
		code3=acccode,
		name1=(select name from salecategory where salecatcode = s.catcode),
		name2=(select distinct name1 from reportdata where code3=@ln_salesacc),
		value1= isnull(balance, 0),
		value2=0,
		value3=0,
		value4=2,
		date1 =@ad_SDate,
		date2 =@ad_EDate,
		value5=@ac_level
	from 
	(select	acccode, 
		catcode,
		sum(debit - credit) as balance
	from virtualgl v
	where   acccode in (@ln_salesacc) and
		date >= @ad_SDate and date <= @ad_EDate
	group by v.acccode,v.catcode) S

	insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
	select	code1=(select max(code1)+1 from reportdata),
		code2=catcode,
		code3=acccode,
		name1=(select name from salecategory where salecatcode = sr.catcode),
		name2=(select distinct name1 from reportdata where code3=@ln_salesretacc),
		value1= isnull(balance, 0),
		value2=0,
		value3=0,
		value4=2,
		date1 =@ad_SDate,
		date2 =@ad_EDate,
		value5=@ac_level
	from 
	(select	acccode, 
		catcode,
		sum(debit - credit) as balance
	from virtualgl v
	where   acccode in (@ln_salesretacc) and
		date >= @ad_SDate and date <= @ad_EDate
	group by v.acccode,v.catcode) SR

	insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
	select	code1=(select max(code1)+1 from reportdata),
		code2=catcode,
		code3=acccode,
		name1=(select name from purcategory where purcatcode = p.catcode),
		name2=(select distinct name1 from reportdata where code3=@ln_purchaseacc),
		value1= isnull(balance, 0),
		value2=0,
		value3=0,
		value4=2,
		date1 =@ad_SDate,
		date2 =@ad_EDate,
		value5=@ac_level
	from 
	(select	acccode, 
		catcode,
		sum(debit - credit) as balance
	from virtualgl v
	where   acccode in (@ln_purchaseacc) and
		date >= @ad_SDate and date <= @ad_EDate
	group by v.acccode,v.catcode) P

	insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
	select	code1=(select max(code1)+1 from reportdata),
		code2=catcode,
		code3=acccode,
		name1=(select name from purcategory where purcatcode = p.catcode),
		name2=(select distinct name1 from reportdata where code3=@ln_purchaseretacc),
		value1= isnull(balance, 0),
		value2=0,
		value3=0,
		value4=2,
		date1 =@ad_SDate,
		date2 =@ad_EDate,
		value5=@ac_level
	from 
	(select	acccode, 
		catcode,
		sum(debit - credit) as balance
	from virtualgl v
	where   acccode in (@ln_purchaseretacc) and
		date >= @ad_SDate and date <= @ad_EDate
	group by v.acccode,v.catcode) P

	insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
	select	code1=(select max(code1)+1 from reportdata),
		code2=catcode,
		code3=a.acccode,
		name1=(select name from salecategory where salecatcode = s.catcode),
		name2=(select distinct name1 from reportdata where code3=@ln_revfromservice),
		value1= isnull(balance, 0),
		value2=0,
		value3=0,
		value4=2,
		date1 =@ad_SDate,
		date2 =@ad_EDate,
		value5=@ac_level
	from 
	(select	acccode, 
		catcode,
		sum(debit - credit) as balance
	from virtualgl v
	where   acccode in (@ln_revfromservice) and
		date >= @ad_SDate and date <= @ad_EDate
	group by v.acccode,v.catcode) S, Accounts a
	where S.acccode = a.acccode
END

IF @ac_level = '3'
BEGIN
	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(code2, 0) from reportdata where code3=-2)
	IF @ln_temp <> 0 AND @InvSys = 'P'
	BEGIN
		insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
		select	code1=(select max(code1)+1 from reportdata),
			code2=0,
			code3=item.icode,
			name1= item.name,
			name2=(select distinct name1 from reportdata where code3=-2),
			value1=	stockval,
			value2= newstock,
			value3= newavgprice,
			value4=3,
			date1 =@ad_SDate,
			date2 =@ad_EDate,
			value5=@ac_level
		FROM
		(select icode, newstock, newavgprice, -isnull(newavgprice*newstock, 0) stockval
			from stockledger
			where 	date < @ad_SDate AND
				convert(varchar(10), icode) + ' ' + convert(varchar(20), utn) IN
				(select convert(varchar(10), icode) + ' ' + convert(varchar(20), max(utn))
				from stockledger
				where date < @ad_SDate
				group by icode) and newstock > 0) OS, item
		where OS.icode = item.icode
		order by item.name
	END

	set @ln_temp= (select isnull(code2, 0) from reportdata where code3=-1)
	IF @ln_temp <> 0 AND @InvSys = 'P'
	BEGIN
		insert into reportdata (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, value1, value2, value3, value4, date1, date2, value5)
		select	code1=(select max(code1)+1 from reportdata),
			code2=0,
			code3=item.icode,
			name1= item.name,
			name2=(select distinct name1 from reportdata where code3=-1),
			value1=	stockval,
			value2= newstock,
			value3= newavgprice,
			value4=3,
			date1 =@ad_SDate,
			date2 =@ad_EDate,
			value5=@ac_level
		FROM
			(select icode, newstock, newavgprice, -isnull(newavgprice*newstock, 0) stockval
			from stockledger
			where 	date <= @ad_EDate AND
				convert(varchar(10), icode) + ' ' + convert(varchar(20), utn) IN
				(select convert(varchar(10), icode) + ' ' + convert(varchar(20), max(utn))
				from stockledger
				where date <= @ad_EDate
				group by icode) and newstock > 0) CS, item
		where CS.icode = item.icode
		order by item.name
	END
END

UPDATE REPORTDATA SET Value1 = 0 WHERE VALUE1 is NULL

UPDATE REPORTDATA SET Value2 = 0 WHERE VALUE2 is NULL

COMMIT

-- SP_InheritQuotation
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_InheritQuotation @ai_quotationcode int, @ai_acccode int, @as_remarks varchar(100), @ai_usercode smallint, @ai_newquotationcode INT OUTPUT
AS

Declare @Err As Int , @RowCount As Int, @TABMAXKEY As Int, @ai_newcode AS Int

EXECUTE @err = SP_GetTabMaxkey 'Quotation', @TABMAXKEY Output
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('New Quotation Code generation problem' ,16, 1)	
	RETURN -1			
END

INSERT INTO QuotationHeader (QuotationCode, CustCode, SalesmanCode, date, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, 
	SalesTax, SPrice, ValidateUpTo, PostDate, Remarks, CustRefNo, headerno, 
	OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, Posted,InvGSTPerc1, Remarks2, Remarks3, 
	Remarks4,Remarks5,Remarks6,Remarks7, Remarks8,Remarks9, Pagesize, MessageCode, 
	SManCode, LoosePack, ConsolidatedSaleOrder, Active, Locked, AutoInsertNewItems)
SELECT 
	QuotationCode=@TABMAXKEY, CustCode=@ai_acccode, SalesmanCode=@ai_usercode, date=GetDate(), DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, 
	SalesTax, SPrice, ValidateUpTo, PostDate=GETDATE(), Remarks=@as_remarks, CustRefNo, headerno, 
	OriginalDate=GETDATE(), ModifiedBy, PostedBy, Posted='N', InvGSTPerc1, Remarks2, Remarks3, 
	Remarks4,Remarks5,Remarks6,Remarks7, Remarks8,Remarks9, Pagesize, MessageCode, 
	SManCode, LoosePack, ConsolidatedSaleOrder, Active, Locked, AutoInsertNewItems
FROM QuotationHeader
WHERE QuotationCode = @ai_quotationcode

SET @err = @@ERROR

IF @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Quotation Header Problem' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1			
END

INSERT INTO QuotationDetail (QuotationCode, ICode, Qty, PackUnits, SalePrice, DiscPerc, SalesTax, 
	itemflatdisc, BonusQty, GSTPerc, UnitSalesTax, ItemDescription, gcode, 
	RemoteNetSaleQty, RemoteStock, PORate, PODiscPerc, SpecialRate, RefNo)
SELECT QuotationCode=@TABMAXKEY, ICode, Qty, PackUnits, SalePrice, DiscPerc, SalesTax, 
itemflatdisc, BonusQty, GSTPerc, UnitSalesTax, ItemDescription, gcode, 
RemoteNetSaleQty, RemoteStock, PORate, PODiscPerc, 
SpecialRate, RefNo
FROM QuotationDetail
WHERE QuotationCode=@ai_quotationcode

SET @err = @@ERROR

IF @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Quotation Header Problem' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1			
END
SET @ai_newquotationcode = @TABMAXKEY
Return 0

-- sp_init_customers_balances
CREATE  PROCEDURE sp_init_customers_balances
AS

/*
This CODE is used to INITIALIZE sql 2000 to 2000.
*/
/* Insert row in the Glheader for Customer Balances Voucher*/
Insert INTO GLHeader 
	(GlVochCode, VoucherCode, VochCatCode, AccCode, Date, SalesmanCode, Posted, PostDate, Remarks, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy)
Select 	(Select ISNULL(max(glvochcode), 0) + 1 from glheader), 
	(Select ISNULL(max(vouchercode), 0) + 1 from glheader WHERE glheader.VochCatCode=5), 
	5, 
	(select code from global where tablename='Accounts' and Name='GT_EquityACC'), 
	getdate(), 1, 'Y', getdate(), 
	'CUSTOMER OPENING BALANCE TRANSAFERRED TO CAPITAL ON ' + CONVERT(varchar(30), getdate(), 11), 
	getdate(), 
	NULL, 
	1

/* Insert rows in the GlDetail for Respective Customer Balances*/
Insert INTO GLDetail 
	(GlVochCode, AccCode, PatientCode, GuestCode, StudentCode, Debit, Credit, ChkNo, Remarks, Balance, OutstandingAmt)
Select  (Select max(glvochcode) from glheader),
	acccode, 
	PatientCode, 
	GuestCode, 
	StudentCode, 
	Debit=	Case When Balance > 0 THEN ABS(Balance)
		Else 0
		END,
	Credit=Case When Balance < 0 THEN ABS(Balance)
	Else 0
	END,
	'',
	'CUSTOMER OPENING BALANCE ON ' + CONVERT(varchar(30), getdate(), 11),
	0, 
	0
FROM 	(SELECT ACCCODE, PatientCode, GuestCode, StudentCode, SUM(DEBIT-CREDIT) AS BALANCE 
	FROM VIRTUALGL
