-- SP_init_Fetch_LastPurchaseHistory
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_init_Fetch_LastPurchaseHistory
AS
/*
Author : M. Azhar Inayat
Date : 2024-JUNE-04
Version: 1.0
Purpose: Fetch Last Purchase of each item and store it in a seperate table for future use.
*/
--Erase Old History (if any)
TRUNCATE TABLE DBO.LastPurchaseHistory
--Fetch Latest History
INSERT INTO DBO.LastPurchaseHistory (PurInvCode,Supplier,Date,PurCatCode,ICode,PackUnits,Qty,BonusQty,
	PurPrice,SalePrice,DiscPerc,ItemFlatDisc,UnitSalesTax,GSTPerc,NetRate,AvgPrice,NewAvgPrice,InvDiscPerc,
	CurrStock,AlternateCustomICode,ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,SalesTaxScheduleCode,PCTCode)
SELECT 
	PurInvCode=PL.PurInvCode, 
	Supplier = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=PL.SuppCode),
	Date=PL.Date,
	PurCatCode=PL.PurCatCode,
	ICode = PD.ICode,
	Packunits=PD.PackUnits, 
	Qty = PD.PackQty + PD.LooseQty,
	BonusQty=PD.BonusQty,
	PurPrice=PD.PurPrice,
	SalePrice=PD.SalePrice,
	DiscPerc = PD.DiscPerc,
	ItemFlatDisc = PD.ItemFlatDisc,
	UnitSalesTax=PD.UnitSalesTax,
	GSTPerc = PD.GSTPerc,
	NetRate=PD.NetRate,
	AvgPrice=PD.AvgPrice,
	NewAvgPrice=PD.NewAvgPrice,
	InvDiscPerc = PL.DiscPerc,
	PD.CurrStock,
	PD.AlternateCustomICode,
	PD.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,
	PD.SalesTaxScheduleCode,
	PD.PCTCode
FROM
	PurLedger PL, 
	PurDetail PD,
	(SELECT DD.ICode, PurInvCode = MAX(DD.PurInvCode)
	FROM PurDetail DD
	GROUP BY DD.ICode) D	-- Fetch Latest purchase for each item
WHERE
	PL.PurInvCode = PD.PurInvCode AND
	PL.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND
	PD.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND
	PD.ICode = D.Icode
RETURN 0

-- sp_init_loyaltypoints
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.sp_init_loyaltypoints AS
/*
Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Purpose: Preserve Loyalty Point from last database and use it as opening in this database
*/
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @Err Int, @rowCount INT

SELECT LoyaltyCardCode, PointsBalance=0, AdjustedPoints = SUM(PointsDebit - PointsCredit), AdjustmentValue = SUM(Debit - Credit)
INTO #op_points
FROM LoyaltyCardLedger
GROup BY LoyaltyCardCode

IF @@Error <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('1-Error Processing Opening Loyalty Points' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

DELETE #op_points WHERE AdjustedPoints=0 AND AdjustmentValue=0
IF @@Error <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('1-Error Processing Opening Loyalty Points' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @rowCount = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #op_points), 0)
IF @rowCount = 0
	RETURN 0

CREATE TABLE #tempadj (
AdjustmentCode INT,
AdjustmentTypeCode TINYINT,
Date DATETIME,
UserCode SMALLINT,
LoyaltyCardCode INT,
PointsBalance INT,
AdjustedPoints INT,
AdjustmentValue INT,
Remarks VARCHAR(255),
RowID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1)
)

INSERT INTO #tempadj 
	(AdjustmentCode, AdjustmentTypeCode, Date, UserCode, LoyaltyCardCode,
	PointsBalance, AdjustedPoints, AdjustmentValue, Remarks)
SELECT AdjustmentCode=0, 
	AdjustmentTypeCode=CASE WHEN AdjustedPoints > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, 
	Date=GETDATE(), 
	UserCode=1, 
	LoyaltyCardCode,
	PointsBalance, 
	AdjustedPoints=ABS(AdjustedPoints), 
	AdjustmentValue=ABS(AdjustmentValue), 
	Remarks='Opening Points B/F:'
FROM #op_points
ORDER BY LoyaltyCardCode

SET @Err=@@Error
IF @Err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('4-Error Processing Opening Loyalty Points' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

UPDATE #tempadj SET AdjustmentCode=RowID

SET @Err=@@Error
IF @Err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('5-Error Processing Opening Loyalty Points' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

INSERT INTO LoyaltyPointAdjustment
	(AdjustmentCode, AdjustmentTypeCode, Date, UserCode, LoyaltyCardCode,
	PointsBalance, AdjustedPoints, AdjustmentValue, Remarks)
SELECT	AdjustmentCode, AdjustmentTypeCode, Date, UserCode, LoyaltyCardCode,
	PointsBalance, AdjustedPoints, AdjustmentValue, Remarks
FROM #tempadj

SET @Err=@@Error
IF @Err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('6-Error Processing Opening Loyalty Points' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

TRUNCATE TABLE LoyaltyCardLedger

INSERT INTO LoyaltyCardLedger 
SELECT LP.LoyaltyCardCode, A.AccCode, LP.Date, LP.UserCode, 
	PointsDebit = CASE WHEN LP.AdjustmentTypeCode = 1 THEN LP.AdjustedPoints ELSE 0 END,
	PointsCredit = CASE WHEN LP.AdjustmentTypeCode = 1 THEN 0 ELSE LP.AdjustedPoints END,
	Debit = CASE WHEN LP.AdjustmentTypeCode = 1 THEN LP.AdjustmentValue ELSE 0 END,
	Credit = CASE WHEN LP.AdjustmentTypeCode = 1 THEN 0 ELSE LP.AdjustmentValue END,
	Remarks=LP.Remarks,
	InvoiceType='AD',
	InvoiceCode=AdjustmentCode
FROM LoyaltyPointAdjustment LP, LoyaltyCard C, Accounts A
WHERE LP.LoyaltyCardCode = C.LoyaltyCardCode AND C.AccCode=A.AccCode

SET @Err=@@Error
IF @Err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('7-Error Processing Opening Loyalty Points' ,16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END
RETURN 0

-- sp_init_opening_pur
CREATE   PROCEDURE sp_init_opening_pur

AS

IF (select count(*) from godowndetail)>0 

Begin

insert PurLedger(PurInvCode, PurCatCode, SuppCode, SalesmanCode, Date, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SalesTax, Posted, PostDate, Remarks)
Values (1, 3, 18, 1, getdate(), 0, 0, 0, 0, 'Y', getdate(), 'Opening Purchase ')

insert purdetail (PurInvCode, ICode, Gcode, Batch, Expiry, PackQty, LooseQty, BonusQty, PackUnits, PurPrice, DiscPerc, AvgPrice, NewAvgPrice, saleprice, recentpurprice, NetRate)
select  1, Item.icode, godowndetail.gcode, GodownDetail.batch, GodownDetail.Expiry, 0, GodownDetail.CurrQty, 0, Item.PackUnits, Item.avgprice, 0, Item.avgprice, Item.avgprice, item.saleprice, item.recentpurprice, Item.avgprice
From	Item, GodownDetail
where   Item.icode = GodownDetail.icode 

update purdetail
set purutn=purrowid

update _Utn
set utn=(select isnull(max(purrowid),0) + 3 from purdetail)

/*  purchase invoice total */
update purledger
set invtotal=p.net
from 
(SELECT  purinvcode=purledger.purinvcode,
	Net=ROUND(
		SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty + purdetail.bonusqty) *
			purdetail.unitsalestax) +
		SUM(ROUND((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * purdetail.purprice * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)) * purdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
		ROUND((SUM(((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * purdetail.purprice) * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * 
			(1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) - purledger.flatdisc) * 
			(purledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) + ROUND(SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * purdetail.purprice * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + 
			purledger.misccharges + purledger.salestax - purledger.flatdisc, 0)
	FROM     purledger,	 
		 purdetail
	WHERE    	 
		 purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode 
	GROUP BY purledger.purinvcode,
		 purledger.suppcode, 
		 purledger.purcatcode,
		 purledger.postdate,
		 purledger.discperc,
		 purledger.misccharges,
		 purledger.salestax,
		 purledger.flatdisc,
		 purledger.InvGSTPerc1

) as P
		
where purledger.purinvcode=p.purinvcode

END 
update _Utn
set utn=(select isnull(max(purrowid),0) + 3 from purdetail)

	(select code from global where tablename='Accounts' and Name='GT_EquityACC'),

	'OPENING BALANCE TRANSFERRED TO CAPITAL ON ' + CONVERT(varchar(30), getdate(), 11), 
	getdate(), 
	NULL, 
	1

/* Insert rows in the GlDetail for Respective Balances*/
Insert INTO GLDetail 
	(GlVochCode, AccCode, Debit, Credit, ChkNo, Remarks, Balance, OutstandingAmt)
Select  (Select max(glvochcode) from glheader),
	acccode, 
	Debit=	Case When Balance > 0 THEN ABS(Balance)
		Else 0
		END,
	Credit=Case When Balance < 0 THEN ABS(Balance)
	Else 0
	END,
	'',
	'OPENING BALANCE ON ' + CONVERT(varchar(30), getdate(), 11),
	0,
	0
FROM 	(SELECT ACCCODE, SUM(DEBIT-CREDIT) AS BALANCE 
	FROM VIRTUALGL 
	WHERE ACCCODE IN 
		(SELECT ACCCODE 
		FROM ACCOUNTS A, SUBACCOUNTS S, CATEGORYACCOUNTS C, MAINACCOUNTS M
		WHERE	A.SUBCODE NOT IN (3, 7) AND
			M.MAINACCCODE IN (1,2,3) AND 
			M.MAINACCCODE = C.MAINACCCODE AND
			C.CATACCCODE = S.CATACCCODE AND
			S.SUBACCCODE = A.SUBCODE)
	GROUP BY ACCCODE 
	HAVING SUM(DEBIT-CREDIT) <> 0) B

/* Insert row in the GlDetail for Capital A/C FOR Respective Balances DIFFERENCE*/

	(GlVochCode, AccCode, Debit, Credit, ChkNo, Remarks, Balance, OutstandingAmt)
Select  GlVochCode=(Select max(glvochcode) from glheader),
	Acccode=(select code 
		from global 
		where tablename='Accounts' and Name='GT_EquityACC'), 
	Debit=	Case When Balance > 0 THEN 0 Else ABS(Balance) END,

	FROM GlDetail
	WHERE GlVochCode = (Select max(glvochcode) from glheader)
	HAVING SUM(DEBIT-CREDIT) <> 0) B

Return 0

	'SUPPLIER OPENING BALANCE TRANSFERRED TO CAPITAL ON ' + CONVERT(varchar(30), getdate(), 11), 
	getdate(), 
	NULL, 
	1

/* Insert rows in the GlDetail for Respective SUPPLIER Balances*/
Insert INTO GLDetail 
	(GlVochCode, AccCode, Debit, Credit, ChkNo, Remarks, Balance, OutstandingAmt)
Select  (Select max(glvochcode) from glheader),
	acccode, 
	Debit=	Case When Balance > 0 THEN ABS(Balance)
		Else 0
		END,
	Credit=Case When Balance < 0 THEN ABS(Balance)
	Else 0
	END,
	'',
	'SUPPLIER OPENING BALANCE ON ' + CONVERT(varchar(30), getdate(), 11),
	0, 
	0
FROM 	(SELECT ACCCODE, SUM(DEBIT-CREDIT) AS BALANCE 
	FROM VIRTUALGL 
	WHERE ACCCODE IN (SELECT SUPPCODE FROM SUPPLIER)
	GROUP BY ACCCODE 
	HAVING SUM(DEBIT-CREDIT) <> 0) B

/* Insert row in the GlDetail for Capital A/C FOR Respective SUPPLIER Balances DIFFERENCE*/
Insert INTO GLDetail 
	(GlVochCode, AccCode, Debit, Credit, ChkNo, Remarks, Balance, OutstandingAmt)
Select  GlVochCode=(Select max(glvochcode) from glheader),
	Acccode=(select code 
		from global 
		where tablename='Accounts' and Name='GT_EquityACC'), 
	Debit=	Case When Balance > 0 THEN 0 Else ABS(Balance) END,
	Credit=Case When Balance < 0 THEN 0 Else ABS(Balance) END,
	'',
	'SUPPLIER OPENING BALANCE TRANSFERRED TO CAPITAL ON ' + CONVERT(varchar(30), getdate(), 11),
	0, 
	0
FROM 	(SELECT SUM(DEBIT-CREDIT) AS BALANCE 
	FROM GlDetail
	WHERE GlVochCode = (Select max(glvochcode) from glheader)
	HAVING SUM(DEBIT-CREDIT) <> 0) B

Return 0

definition:
-- SP_Initialize_TabMaxKey
CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_Initialize_TabMaxKey AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

DECLARE @QRY NVARCHAR(4000), @ColName VARCHAR(255), @TBL NVARCHAR(50), @PK NVARCHAR(1000), @FullTBL NVARCHAR(255)
DECLARE @KeySeq SMALLINT, @table_id INT, @err INT

DECLARE Upd1 CURSOR FOR
SELECT TABLENAME=LTRIM(RTRIM(TABNAME))
FROM _TabMaxKey
WHERE TABID <> 12 AND TABName NOT IN ('Quotation','SaleLedgerCashDummy', 'SaleLedgerCreditDummy', 'DataTransferLog','PrescriptionHeaderLog','SRLedger')
UNION ALL
SELECT TABLENAME='SaleLedger'
ORDER BY TABLENAME

OPEN Upd1

FETCH NEXT FROM Upd1 INTO @TBL
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @PK = N''
	SET @FullTBL = 'DBO.' + @TBL
	SET @table_id = OBJECT_ID(@FullTBL)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0 OR @table_id IS NULL
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('TabMaxKey Initialization: Invalid Object Refered: Name = %s', 16, 1, @FullTBL)
		CLOSE Upd1
		DEALLOCATE Upd1
		RETURN -1
	END 

	DECLARE Upd2 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT 	COLNAME = CONVERT(sysname,c.name),
		KEYSEQ =
			CASE
				when c.name = index_col(@FullTBL, i.indid,  1) then convert (smallint,1)
				when c.name = index_col(@FullTBL, i.indid,  2) then convert (smallint,2)
				when c.name = index_col(@FullTBL, i.indid,  3) then convert (smallint,3)
				when c.name = index_col(@FullTBL, i.indid,  4) then convert (smallint,4)
				when c.name = index_col(@FullTBL, i.indid,  5) then convert (smallint,5)
				when c.name = index_col(@FullTBL, i.indid,  6) then convert (smallint,6)
				when c.name = index_col(@FullTBL, i.indid,  7) then convert (smallint,7)
				when c.name = index_col(@FullTBL, i.indid,  8) then convert (smallint,8)
				when c.name = index_col(@FullTBL, i.indid,  9) then convert (smallint,9)
				when c.name = index_col(@FullTBL, i.indid, 10) then convert (smallint,10)
				when c.name = index_col(@FullTBL, i.indid, 11) then convert (smallint,11)
				when c.name = index_col(@FullTBL, i.indid, 12) then convert (smallint,12)
				when c.name = index_col(@FullTBL, i.indid, 13) then convert (smallint,13)
				when c.name = index_col(@FullTBL, i.indid, 14) then convert (smallint,14)
				when c.name = index_col(@FullTBL, i.indid, 15) then convert (smallint,15)
				when c.name = index_col(@FullTBL, i.indid, 16) then convert (smallint,16)
			end
	from
		sysindexes i, syscolumns c, sysobjects o
	where
		o.id = @table_id
		and o.id = c.id
		and o.id = i.id
		and (i.status & 0x800) = 0x800
		and (c.name = index_col (@FullTBL, i.indid,  1) or
		     c.name = index_col (@FullTBL, i.indid,  2) or
		     c.name = index_col (@FullTBL, i.indid,  3) or
		     c.name = index_col (@FullTBL, i.indid,  4) or
		     c.name = index_col (@FullTBL, i.indid,  5) or
		     c.name = index_col (@FullTBL, i.indid,  6) or
		     c.name = index_col (@FullTBL, i.indid,  7) or
		     c.name = index_col (@FullTBL, i.indid,  8) or
		     c.name = index_col (@FullTBL, i.indid,  9) or
		     c.name = index_col (@FullTBL, i.indid, 10) or
		     c.name = index_col (@FullTBL, i.indid, 11) or
		     c.name = index_col (@FullTBL, i.indid, 12) or
		     c.name = index_col (@FullTBL, i.indid, 13) or
		     c.name = index_col (@FullTBL, i.indid, 14) or
		     c.name = index_col (@FullTBL, i.indid, 15) or
		     c.name = index_col (@FullTBL, i.indid, 16)
		    )
	order by 2

	OPEN Upd2
	
	FETCH NEXT FROM Upd2 INTO @ColName, @KeySeq
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		IF @KeySeq <> 1
		BEGIN
			SET @PK = @PK + ' AND '
		END
		SET @PK = @PK + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName))
		FETCH NEXT FROM Upd2 INTO @ColName, @KeySeq
	END
	CLOSE Upd2
	DEALLOCATE Upd2	

	SET @QRY = 'UPDATE _TabMaxKey SET Tabmaxkey = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(' + @PK + ') FROM ' + @TBL + '), 0) WHERE Tabname = ''' + @TBL + ''''
	EXECUTE (@QRY)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('TabMaxKey Initialization: Problem In Updation of %s Table', 16, 1, @FullTBL)
		CLOSE Upd1
		DEALLOCATE Upd1
		RETURN -1
	END 
	FETCH NEXT FROM Upd1 INTO @TBL
END
CLOSE Upd1
DEALLOCATE Upd1
-- Reset counters for some log based tables whose primary key is not defined
UPDATE _TabMaxKey SET Tabmaxkey = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(TransferLogID) FROM DataTransferLog), 0) WHERE Tabname = 'DataTransferLog'
UPDATE _TabMaxKey SET Tabmaxkey = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(LogID) FROM PrescriptionHeaderLog), 0) WHERE Tabname = 'PrescriptionHeaderLog'
UPDATE _TabMaxKey SET Tabmaxkey = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(A) FROM (SELECT A=ISNULL(MAX(SRInvCode), 0) FROM SRLedger UNION SELECT A=ISNULL(MAX(SRBufferInvCode), 0) FROM SRBufferLedger) AS T), 0) WHERE Tabname = 'SRLedger'

-- Reset counters for Quotation since it is named as 'Quotation' instead of 'QuotationHeader'
UPDATE _TabMaxKey SET Tabmaxkey = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(QuotationCode) FROM QuotationHeader), 0) WHERE Tabname = 'Quotation'

-- Reset counters for cash and credit sales dummy counters
UPDATE _TabMaxKey SET Tabmaxkey = 0 WHERE Tabname IN ('SaleLedgerCashDummy', 'SaleLedgerCreditDummy')
UPDATE _TabMaxKey SET Tabmaxkey = 0 WHERE TABID = 12 AND Tabname <> 'SaleLedger'

-- Reset counters for some module based counters
UPDATE VocherCategory SET Counter = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(GLHeader.VoucherCode) FROM GLHeader WHERE GLHeader.VochCatCode = VocherCategory.VochCatcode), 0)
UPDATE NotesCategory SET Counter = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(Notes.VoucherCode) FROM Notes WHERE Notes.NoteCatCode = NotesCategory.NoteCatcode), 0)
UPDATE SaleType SET Counter = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(ISNULL(SaleLedger.SaleTypeInvNo,0)) FROM SaleLedger WHERE SaleLedger.SaleTypeCode = SaleType.SaleTypeCode), 0)
UPDATE SaleOrderCategory SET Counter = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(ISNULL(SaleOrderHeader.SaleOrderCode,0)) FROM SaleOrderHeader WHERE SaleOrderHeader.SOCatCode = SaleOrderCategory.SOCatCode), 0)
UPDATE ReceiptCategory SET Counter = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(ISNULL(ReceiptHeader.ReceiptCode,0)) FROM ReceiptHeader WHERE ReceiptHeader.ReceiptCategoryCode = ReceiptCategory.ReceiptCategoryCode), 0)
UPDATE IssueCategory SET Counter = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(ISNULL(IssueHeader.IssueCode,0)) FROM IssueHeader WHERE IssueHeader.IssueCategoryCode = IssueCategory.IssueCategoryCode), 0)

-- IF Max Primary Key is un acceptable for some table then set them to 100
UPDATE _TabMaxKey SET TabMaxKey = 100 WHERE TabName = 'Accounts' AND ISNULL((SELECT Max(ISNULL(AccCode,0)) FROM Accounts), 0) < 100
UPDATE _TabMaxKey SET TabMaxKey = 100 WHERE TabName = 'SubAccounts' AND ISNULL((SELECT Max(ISNULL(SubAccCode,0)) FROM SubAccounts), 0) < 100
UPDATE _TabMaxKey SET TabMaxKey = 100 WHERE TabName = 'CategoryAccounts' AND ISNULL((SELECT Max(ISNULL(CatAccCode,0)) FROM CategoryAccounts), 0) < 100
UPDATE _TabMaxKey SET TabMaxKey = 100 WHERE TabName = 'VocherCategory' AND ISNULL((SELECT Max(ISNULL(VochCatCode,0)) FROM VocherCategory), 0) < 100

-- Reset Header wise max key
--UPDATE _HeaderTabMaxKey SET TabMaxKey = 0
/*Header Invoice Counters for Sale*/
UPDATE _HeaderTabMaxKey 
SET TabMaxKey = ISNULL((SELECT Max(ISNULL(S.HeaderInvNo,0)) FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.HeaderNo=_HeaderTabMaxKey.HeaderCode), 0)
WHERE Module=1

/*Header Invoice Counters for S/R*/
UPDATE _HeaderTabMaxKey 
SET TabMaxKey = ISNULL((SELECT Max(ISNULL(S.HeaderInvNo,0)) FROM SRLedger S WHERE S.HeaderNo=_HeaderTabMaxKey.HeaderCode), 0)
WHERE Module=2

/*Header Invoice Counters for Purchase*/
UPDATE _HeaderTabMaxKey 
SET TabMaxKey = ISNULL((SELECT Max(ISNULL(S.HeaderInvNo,0)) FROM PurLedger S WHERE S.HeaderNo=_HeaderTabMaxKey.HeaderCode), 0)
WHERE Module=3

/*Header Invoice Counters for P/R*/
UPDATE _HeaderTabMaxKey 
SET TabMaxKey = ISNULL((SELECT Max(ISNULL(S.HeaderInvNo,0)) FROM PrLedger S WHERE S.HeaderNo=_HeaderTabMaxKey.HeaderCode), 0)
WHERE Module=4

/*Header Invoice Counters for Issue*/
UPDATE _HeaderTabMaxKey 
SET TabMaxKey = ISNULL((SELECT Max(ISNULL(S.HeaderInvNo,0)) FROM IssueHeader S WHERE S.HeaderNo=_HeaderTabMaxKey.HeaderCode), 0)
WHERE Module=5

/*Header Invoice Counters for Receipt*/
UPDATE _HeaderTabMaxKey 
SET TabMaxKey = ISNULL((SELECT Max(ISNULL(S.HeaderInvNo,0)) FROM ReceiptHeader S WHERE S.HeaderNo=_HeaderTabMaxKey.HeaderCode), 0)
WHERE Module=6

/*Header Invoice Counters for Adjustment*/
UPDATE _HeaderTabMaxKey 
SET TabMaxKey = ISNULL((SELECT Max(ISNULL(S.HeaderInvNo,0)) FROM AdjHeader S WHERE S.HeaderNo=_HeaderTabMaxKey.HeaderCode), 0)
WHERE Module=7

/*Header Invoice Counters for Transfers*/
UPDATE _HeaderTabMaxKey 
SET TabMaxKey = ISNULL((SELECT Max(ISNULL(S.HeaderInvNo,0)) FROM THeader S WHERE S.HeaderNo=_HeaderTabMaxKey.HeaderCode), 0)
WHERE Module=8

/*Header Invoice Counters for Sale Orders*/
UPDATE _HeaderTabMaxKey 
SET TabMaxKey = ISNULL((SELECT Max(ISNULL(S.HeaderInvNo,0)) FROM SaleOrderHeader S WHERE S.HeaderNo=_HeaderTabMaxKey.HeaderCode), 0)
WHERE Module=12

/*Header Invoice Counters for Quotation*/
--UPDATE _HeaderTabMaxKey SET TabMaxKey = ISNULL((SELECT Max(S.HeaderInvNo) FROM QuotationHeader S WHERE S.HeaderNo=_HeaderTabMaxKey.HeaderCode), 0) WHERE Module=15
UPDATE _HeaderTabMaxKey SET TabMaxKey = 0 WHERE Module=15

/*Header Invoice Counters for Advanced Sale*/
UPDATE _HeaderTabMaxKey 
SET TabMaxKey = ISNULL((SELECT Max(ISNULL(S.HeaderInvNo,0)) FROM AdvSaleLedger S WHERE S.HeaderNo=_HeaderTabMaxKey.HeaderCode), 0)
WHERE Module=21

RETURN 0

CREATE PROCEDURE SP_InPatientBalance
	@AdmissionCode INT,
	@Balance NUMERIC(15, 2) OUTPUT
AS

EXECUTE SP_VirtualGL 'A'
/*
Author: M.Azhar Inayat

Purpose:
	This Stored Procedure is used to get balance of patient
	But First of all it updates latest balance in accounts by exceuting sp_virtualgl
	Then It Takes 2 rguments:-   
	1- @AdmissionCode Determines the patient to be discharged
	2- @Balance
*/    

SET @Balance = 
	ISNULL(
		(SELECT Balance=SUM(V.Debit - V.Credit)
		FROM VirtualGL V, Accounts A
		WHERE V.PatientCode IN 
			(SELECT P.PatientCode 
			FROM PatientAdmission P 
			WHERE P.AdmissionCode = @AdmissionCode) AND
		V.AccCode = A.AccCode AND
		V.AccCode IN (SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SubCode=3)), 0)

-- SP_Insert_CashierActivity
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_Insert_CashierActivity 
	@ModuleID SMALLINT, @DocCode INT, @CatCode SMALLINT,
	@Category VARCHAR(100), @AccCode SMALLINT, @UserCode SMALLINT, 
	@MachineName VARCHAR(20), @HeaderNo SMALLINT, @HeaderInvNo INT, 
	@Amount NUMERIC(15,2), @CashAccCode SMALLINT, @CashTendered NUMERIC(15,2), 
	@CashCharged NUMERIC(15,2), @CashBack NUMERIC(15,2), @Remarks VARCHAR(100), 
	@CashierJobCode INT, @Printed CHAR(1), @SuperVised CHAR(1), @RowID INT OUTPUT
AS

DECLARE @rowsaffected INT, @err INT, @retCode INT, @errcode INT, @ai_dr_acccode INT, @ai_cr_acccode INT
DECLARE @GlVochCode INT, @VochCode INT, @NewDocCode INT
DECLARE @ai_vochcatcode SMALLINT, @ai_salesmancode smallint
DECLARE @ad_date DATETIME
DECLARE @ai_posted CHAR
DECLARE @as_chkno VARCHAR(60)
SET @ai_salesmancode = (SELECT JobOwner FROM CashierJob WHERE CashierJobCode = @CashierJobCode)
SET @retCode = -1
SET @NewDocCode = @DocCode
IF @NewDocCode = 0
	SET @NewDocCode=NULL
IF @ModuleID > 100
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.CashierActivity 
	(Date, ModuleID, DocCode, CatCode, Category, AccCode, 
	UserCode, MachineName, 
	HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo, Amount, CashAccCode, CashTendered, CashCharged, CashBack, 
	Remarks, CashierJobCode, Printed, SuperVised, SuperVisedOn, GLVochCode)
	SELECT
	Date=GETDATE(), @ModuleID, @DocCode, @CatCode, @Category, @AccCode, 
	@UserCode, @MachineName, @HeaderNo, @HeaderInvNo, @Amount, @CashAccCode, 
	@CashTendered, @CashCharged, @CashBack, @Remarks, @CashierJobCode, @Printed, 
	@SuperVised, GETDATE(), GLVochCode=NULL

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Insert Cashier Activity Row Doc. Code: %d' , 16 , 1, @DocCode)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @RowID = (SELECT MAX(RowID) FROM DBO.CashierActivity WHERE ModuleID=@ModuleID AND DOCCode=@DocCode)
	IF @RowID > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @ai_vochcatcode = CASE @ModuleID WHEN 101 THEN 2 WHEN 102 THEN 12 WHEN 103 THEN 1 ELSE 15 END
		SET @ad_date = GETDATE()
		SET @as_chkno = (SELECT CAST(@DocCode AS VARCHAR(60)))
		SET @ai_dr_acccode = CASE @ModuleID WHEN 101 THEN @CashAccCode WHEN 102 THEN @CashAccCode WHEN 103 THEN @AccCode ELSE @AccCode END
		SET @ai_cr_acccode = CASE @ModuleID WHEN 101 THEN @AccCode WHEN 102 THEN @AccCode WHEN 103 THEN @CashAccCode ELSE @CashAccCode END

		EXECUTE @err = SP_CreateVoucher @ai_vochcatcode, @CashAccCode, @ad_date, @ai_salesmancode, 'Y', @ad_date, @Remarks, @ad_date, @ai_salesmancode, @ai_salesmancode, @as_chkno, @ai_dr_acccode, @ai_cr_acccode, @CashCharged, '', @Remarks, NULL, NULL, NULL, @DocCode, 0, 0, @GlVochCode OUTPUT, @VochCode OUTPUT
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Problem Creating Voucher Against Document Code = %d' ,16, 1, @DocCode)
			RETURN -1			
		END

		UPDATE DBO.CashierActivity 
		SET GlVochCode = @GlVochCode
		WHERE RowID = @RowID

		SET @retCode = 0
	END
END

RETURN @retCode

-- SP_InsertBasicData
CREATE    PROCEDURE SP_InsertBasicData 
	@SRV VARCHAR(50), 
	@DB VARCHAR(50), 
	@OWNER VARCHAR(20) 
AS    

SET NOCOUNT ON
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

DECLARE @INS NVARCHAR(1000), @SQL NVARCHAR(4000), @QRY NVARCHAR(4000), @TableName NVARCHAR(100), @LIST NVARCHAR(4000), @FROM NVARCHAR(1000)
DECLARE @ENDD NVARCHAR(50), @CON NVARCHAR(1000), @NOTIN NVARCHAR(1000), @PKCOND NVARCHAR(2000), @WHRTBM NVARCHAR(1000)
DECLARE @full_table_name NVARCHAR(255), @ColName NVARCHAR(255), @MAXCOL NVARCHAR(255), @TABMAXSQL NVARCHAR(3000)
DECLARE @Priority SMALLINT, @KeySeq SMALLINT
DECLARE @table_id INT, @err INT
DECLARE @UPDMAXKEY CHAR(1)

SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO '
SET @SQL = N'SELECT '
set @FROM = N' FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.'
SET @ENDD = N' AS T WHERE '
SET @CON = N'CONVERT(VarChar(10),'
SET @NOTIN = N' NOT IN (SELECT '

DECLARE Ins1 CURSOR FOR  
SELECT TABLENAME=LTRIM(RTRIM(TABLENAME)), PRIORITY, UPDATETABMAXKEY
FROM TransferableData
WHERE Enable='Y' AND AutoInsert = 'Y'
ORDER BY Priority

OPEN Ins1
FETCH NEXT FROM Ins1 INTO @TableName, @Priority, @UPDMaxKey
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SELECT @PKCOND = '', @MAXCOL = ''
	SET @full_table_name = LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.' + @TableName
	SET @table_id = OBJECT_ID(@full_table_name)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @err <> 0 OR @table_id IS NULL
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Invalid Object Refered: Name = %s', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
		CLOSE Ins1
		DEALLOCATE Ins1
		RETURN -1
	END

	DECLARE Ins2 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT 
		COLNAME = CONVERT(sysname,c.name),
		KEYSEQ = 
			CASE 
			when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  1)
				then convert (smallint,1)
			when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  2)
				then convert (smallint,2)
			when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  3) 
				then convert (smallint,3)
			when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  4)
				then convert (smallint,4)
			when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  5)
				then convert (smallint,5)
			when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  6)
				then convert (smallint,6)
			when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  7)
				then convert (smallint,7)
			when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  8)
				then convert (smallint,8)

CREATE PROCEDURE SP_InsertBasicData_To_DataCarryDB @SRV VARCHAR(50), @DB VARCHAR(50), @OWNER VARCHAR(20), @CustCode SMALLINT, @exportitemchangessince DATETIME AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

DECLARE @INS VARCHAR(1000), @SQL VARCHAR(8000), @QRY VARCHAR(8000), @IQRY VARCHAR(8000), @TableName VARCHAR(100), @LIST VARCHAR(8000), @SOURCELIST VARCHAR(8000), @FROM VARCHAR(1000)
DECLARE @ENDD VARCHAR(50), @CON VARCHAR(1000), @NOTIN VARCHAR(1000), @PKCOND VARCHAR(2000), @WHRTBM VARCHAR(1000)
DECLARE @full_table_name VARCHAR(255), @ColName VARCHAR(255), @MAXCOL VARCHAR(255), @TABMAXSQL VARCHAR(3000)
DECLARE @Priority SMALLINT, @KeySeq SMALLINT, @Position SMALLINT
DECLARE @table_id INT, @err INT, @srow INT, @lrow INT
DECLARE @UPDMAXKEY CHAR(1), @ItemTimeStamp VARCHAR(100), @ICodeStr VARCHAR(1000)
SET @ItemTimeStamp = ISNULL((SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @exportitemchangessince, 121)), '1990-01-01 00:00:00')

SET @INS = 'INSERT INTO ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.'
SET @SQL = 'SELECT '
set @FROM = ' FROM ' 
SET @ENDD = ' AS T '
SET @CON = 'CONVERT(VarChar(10),'
SET @NOTIN = ' NOT IN (SELECT '

DECLARE Ins1 CURSOR FOR
SELECT TABLENAME=LTRIM(RTRIM(TABLENAME)), PRIORITY, UPDATETABMAXKEY
FROM TransferableData 
WHERE Enable='Y' AND AutoInsert = 'Y'
ORDER BY Priority

OPEN Ins1

FETCH NEXT FROM Ins1 INTO @TableName, @Priority, @UPDMaxKey
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SELECT @PKCOND = '', @MAXCOL = ''
	SET @full_table_name = @TableName
	SET @table_id = OBJECT_ID(@full_table_name)
	SET @err = @@ERROR

	IF @err <> 0 OR @table_id IS NULL
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Invalid Object Refered: Name = %s', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
		CLOSE Ins1
		DEALLOCATE Ins1
		RETURN -1
	END 

	DECLARE Ins2 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT 	COLNAME = CONVERT(sysname,c.name),
		KEYSEQ =
			CASE
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  1) then convert (smallint,1)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  2) then convert (smallint,2)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  3) then convert (smallint,3)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  4) then convert (smallint,4)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  5) then convert (smallint,5)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  6) then convert (smallint,6)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  7) then convert (smallint,7)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  8) then convert (smallint,8)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  9) then convert (smallint,9)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 10) then convert (smallint,10)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 11) then convert (smallint,11)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 12) then convert (smallint,12)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 13) then convert (smallint,13)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 14) then convert (smallint,14)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 15) then convert (smallint,15)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 16) then convert (smallint,16)
			end
	from
		sysindexes i, syscolumns c, sysobjects o
	where
		o.id = @table_id
		and o.id = c.id
		and o.id = i.id
		and (i.status & 0x800) = 0x800
		and (c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  1) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  2) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  3) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  4) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  5) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  6) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  7) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  8) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  9) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 10) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 11) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 12) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 13) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 14) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 15) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 16)
		    )
	order by 2

	OPEN Ins2
	
	FETCH NEXT FROM Ins2 INTO @ColName, @KeySeq
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		IF @PKCOND <> ''
		BEGIN
			SET @PKCOND = @PKCOND + ' + '
		END
		SET @PKCOND = @PKCOND + ' ' + @CON + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + ')'
		SET @MAXCOL = 'MAX(' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@ColName)) + ')'	
		FETCH NEXT FROM Ins2 INTO @ColName, @KeySeq
	END
	CLOSE Ins2
	DEALLOCATE Ins2

	SET @SQL = ' SELECT '
	SET @LIST=''
	EXECUTE @err = SP_COLUMNLIST 'dbo', @TableName, @LIST OUTPUT
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		CLOSE Ins1
		DEALLOCATE Ins1
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @SOURCELIST = @LIST

	IF lower(@TableName) = 'service'
		SET @SOURCELIST = REPLACE(@SOURCELIST,'Description,',@ColName+'Description=LEFT(Description,255),')

	IF lower(@TableName) = 'servicecomponent'
		SET @SOURCELIST = REPLACE(@SOURCELIST,'RefDescription,',@ColName+'RefDescription=LEFT(RefDescription,255),')

	IF lower(@TableName) = 'customer'
		SET @SOURCELIST = REPLACE(@SOURCELIST,'SpecialInstructions,',@ColName+'SpecialInstructions=LEFT(SpecialInstructions,255),')

	IF lower(@TableName) = 'supplier'
		SET @SOURCELIST = REPLACE(@SOURCELIST,'SpecialInstructions,',@ColName+'SpecialInstructions=LEFT(SpecialInstructions,255),')
		

	DECLARE Ins3 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT
		COLUMNNAME = convert(sysname,c.name),
		POSITION = convert(int,
				   (
					select count(*)
					from syscolumns sc
					where sc.id     =  c.id
					  AND sc.number =  c.number
					  AND sc.colid  <= c.colid
				    ))
	FROM
		sysobjects o,
		syscolumns c
	WHERE
		o.id = @table_id AND c.id = o.id
	ORDER BY 2

	OPEN Ins3

	FETCH NEXT FROM Ins3 INTO @ColName, @Position
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		IF ColumnProperty (@table_id, @ColName, 'IsIdentity') <> 1
		BEGIN
			IF @ColName = (SELECT columnname FROM TransferableData_ExportRestrictedColumns WHERE columnname = @ColName and tablename = @TableName)
			BEGIN
				SET @SOURCELIST = REPLACE(@SOURCELIST,@ColName+',',@ColName+'=0,')
			END
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM Ins3 INTO @ColName, @Position
	END
	CLOSE Ins3
	DEALLOCATE Ins3

	IF RIGHT(@SOURCELIST,1) = ','
		SET @SOURCELIST = LEFT(@SOURCELIST, LEN(@SOURCELIST)-1)

	IF lower(@TableName) = 'item'
		SET @QRY = @INS + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @SOURCELIST + @FROM + @TableName + @ENDD + ' WHERE T.LASTUPDATE >= ''' + @ItemTimeStamp + ''''
	ELSE
		SET @QRY = @INS + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @SOURCELIST + @FROM + @TableName + @ENDD 

	IF lower(@TableName) = 'item' AND @CustCode > 0
		SET @QRY = @QRY + ' AND T.ICatCode IN (SELECT DISTINCT CI.ICatCode FROM DBO.CustWiseItemCategory CI WHERE CI.CustCode = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@CustCode, 7))) + ') '

	IF lower(@TableName) = 'itemsuppliers' AND @CustCode > 0
		SET @QRY = @QRY + ' WHERE T.ICode IN (SELECT DISTINCT I.ICode FROM DBO.CustWiseItemCategory CI, Item I WHERE CI.CustCode = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@CustCode, 7))) + ' AND CI.ICatCode = I.ICatCode) '

	IF lower(@TableName) = 'item' OR lower(@TableName) = 'itemsuppliers'
	BEGIN
		SET @srow = 0
		SET @lrow = 50000
		WHILE @srow <= 2000000
		BEGIN
			IF @CustCode > 0
				SET @ICodeStr = ' AND T.ICode BETWEEN ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@srow))) + ' AND ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@lrow)))
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF lower(@TableName) = 'itemsuppliers' 
					SET @ICodeStr = ' WHERE T.ICode BETWEEN ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@srow))) + ' AND ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@lrow)))
				ELSE
					SET @ICodeStr = ' AND T.ICode BETWEEN ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@srow))) + ' AND ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@lrow)))
			END
			
			SET @IQRY = @QRY + @ICodeStr
--			PRINT @IQRY 
			EXECUTE (@IQRY)
			SET @err = @@ERROR
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
				CLOSE Ins1
				DEALLOCATE Ins1
				RETURN -1
			END
			IF lower(@TableName) = 'item'
			BEGIN
				SET @IQRY = 'Update ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.' +  'Item Set UserCode=1 , ISizeCode=1, IStyleCode=1, IColourCode=1, ISleeveCode=1, IYarnCode=1, IFabricCode=1, IBrandCode=1, IPartCode=1 WHERE ICode BETWEEN ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@srow))) + ' AND ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@lrow)))
				Execute(@IQRY)
				IF @@Error <> 0 
				Begin
					RAISERROR('Updation Problem of Default Values In DataCarryDB', 16, 1)
					RETURN -1	
				End
			END

			SET @srow = @lrow + 1
			SET @lrow = @lrow + 50000
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE (@QRY)
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
			CLOSE Ins1
			DEALLOCATE Ins1
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END
	FETCH NEXT FROM Ins1 INTO @TableName, @Priority, @UPDMaxKey
END
CLOSE Ins1
DEALLOCATE Ins1

SET @QRY = 'Delete From ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.' + 'DataImportlog '
Execute(@QRY)
IF @@Error <> 0 
Begin
	RAISERROR('Problem Initializing Data Import Log in DataCarryDB', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1	
End

RETURN 0

-- sp_InsertItemStock
CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_InsertItemStock 
	@GCode integer, 
	@ICode integer, 
	@Batch VarChar (100), 
	@Expiry datetime, @QTY NUMERIC(15, 4) 
AS
/*
Date : Sep 07,2015
Author : Muhammad Azhar Inayat
@Method = 1 -- Equal Priority / Shortest expiry First
@Method = 2 -- FIFO
@Method = 3 -- LIFO
*/
DECLARE @Priority TINYINT, @Method TINYINT
SET @Method = (SELECT DBO.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('InventoryMovementMethod'))
IF @Method=1
BEGIN 
	SET @Priority = 10
END
ELSE 
BEGIN
	IF @Method=3
	BEGIN
		SET @Priority = ISNULL((SELECT MIN(Priority) FROM GodownDetail WHERE ICode = @ICode), 10)
		IF (@Priority - 1) <= 0
		BEGIN
			UPDATE GodownDetail SET Priority = CASE WHEN Priority >= 255 THEN 255 ELSE Priority + 1 END WHERE ICode = @ICode
			SET @Priority = ISNULL((SELECT MIN(Priority) FROM GodownDetail WHERE ICode = @ICode), 10)
			IF (@Priority - 1) <= 0
				SET @Priority = 0
			ELSE
				SET @Priority = @Priority - 1
		END
		ELSE
			SET @Priority = @Priority - 1
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF @Method=2
		BEGIN
			SET @Priority = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(Priority) FROM GodownDetail WHERE ICode = @ICode), 10)
			IF (@Priority + 1) >= 255
			BEGIN
				UPDATE GodownDetail SET Priority = CASE WHEN Priority >= 255 THEN 255 WHEN Priority <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE Priority - 1 END WHERE ICode = @ICode
				SET @Priority = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(Priority) FROM GodownDetail WHERE ICode = @ICode), 10)
				IF (@Priority + 1) >= 255
					SET @Priority = 255
				ELSE
					SET @Priority = @Priority + 1
			END
			ELSE
				SET @Priority = @Priority + 1
		END
	END
END
Insert GodownDetail (Gcode, Icode, Batch, Expiry, Priority)
Values (@GCode, @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @Priority)

-- SP_IsActiveItem
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_IsActiveItem @ICode INT
AS
/*
Author: M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose: 
	This Stored Procedure is used to know the satus of an item 
	whether it is active or not. It takes only one parameter 
	i.e. Item Code. If item code is not valid then it returns -1 
	otherwise it returns the items' active status 
		@Active = 0 mean  INACTIVE
		@Active = 1 means ACTIVE 
*/
DECLARE @active TINYINT
IF @ICODE IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Active Y/N Status, Not a valid item ' , 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @active = (SELECT Active FROM DBO.Item WHERE ICode = @ICode)

IF @active IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Status for Active Y/N Item Code = %d' , 16, 1, @ICode)
	RETURN -1
END
RETURN @active

CREATE PROCEDURE sp_itemactivity @s_date datetime,@l_date datetime AS


delete from reportdata
insert into reportdata (code10, code11,name1,name2,code1,value1,code2,value2,code3,value3,code4,value4,code5,
value5,code6,value6,code7,value7,code8,value8,code9,value9)


select A.icode ,
icatcode=A.icatcode,

itemname=A.name,
aliasname=A.customicode,


saleqty=isnull((select sum(saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.bonusqty) from saledetail,saleledger 
		 where saleledger.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		       saleledger.saleinvcode=saledetail.saleinvcode and
		       saledetail.due is Null and
		       saledetail.icode=A.icode),0),
	


salevalues= isnull((select sum((saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.bonusqty) * rate) from saledetail,saleledger 
		 where saleledger.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		       saleledger.saleinvcode=saledetail.saleinvcode and
		       saledetail.due is Null and
		       saledetail.icode=A.icode),0),
	


satisfyqty= isnull((select sum(duesatisfydetail.duesatisfyqty) from duesatisfydetail , duesatisfyheader
	   where  duesatisfyheader.duesatisfydate between @s_date and @l_date and
	          duesatisfyheader.duesatisfycode=duesatisfydetail.duesatisfycode and 
		  duesatisfydetail.icode=A.icode),0),

satisfyvalue= isnull((select sum(duesatisfydetail.duesatisfyqty * (packsaleprice/packunits)) from duesatisfydetail , duesatisfyheader
	   where  duesatisfyheader.duesatisfydate between @s_date and @l_date and
	          duesatisfyheader.duesatisfycode=duesatisfydetail.duesatisfycode and 
		  duesatisfydetail.icode=A.icode),0),


saleretqty=isnull((select sum(srdetail.looseqty +srdetail.bonusqty) from srdetail,srledger 
		  where srledger.date between @s_date and @l_date  and 
			srledger.srinvcode=srdetail.srinvcode and 
			srdetail.icode=A.icode),0),


saleretvalue=isnull((select sum((srdetail.looseqty + srdetail.bonusqty) * saleprice) from srdetail,srledger 
		  where srledger.date between @s_date and @l_date  and 
			srledger.srinvcode=srdetail.srinvcode and 
			srdetail.icode=A.icode),0),
purqty=isnull(( 
		select sum(Case When purledger.purcatcode IN (3, 7, 8)  THEN
                        	purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty
			   Else (purdetail.packqty  + purdetail.bonusqty) * purdetail.packunits 
                           END)
		from purdetail,purledger 
		where purledger.postdate between @s_date and @l_date  and 
		           purledger.posted='Y' and
		      purledger.purinvcode=purdetail.purinvcode and
		      purdetail.icode=A.icode
		   ),0),

purvalues=isnull(( 
		select sum(Case When purledger.purcatcode IN (3, 7, 8)  THEN
                        	(purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty) * (purdetail.saleprice/purdetail.packunits)
			   Else ((purdetail.packqty  + purdetail.bonusqty) * (purdetail.saleprice/purdetail.packunits))
                           END)
		from purdetail,purledger 
		where purledger.postdate between @s_date and @l_date  and 
		           purledger.posted='Y' and
		      purledger.purinvcode=purdetail.purinvcode and
		      purdetail.icode=A.icode
		   ),0),



prqty=isnull((select sum(prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.bonusqty)
	      from prdetail,prledger 
	      where prledger.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		    prledger.prinvcode=prdetail.prinvcode and
		    prdetail.icode=A.icode),0),

prvalue=isnull((select sum((prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.bonusqty ) * (prdetail.packsaleprice/prdetail.packunits))
	      from prdetail,prledger 
	      where prledger.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		    prledger.prinvcode=prdetail.prinvcode and
		    prdetail.icode=A.icode),0),

adjIncQty=isnull((select sum(adjdetail.looseqty)
	      from adjdetail,adjheader 
	      where adjheader.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		    adjcatcode=1 and
		    adjheader.adjcode=adjdetail.adjcode and
		    adjdetail.icode=A.icode),0),

adjIncVal=isnull((select sum( adjdetail.looseqty * (adjdetail.saleprice/adjdetail.packunits) )
	      from adjdetail,adjheader 
	      where adjheader.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		    adjcatcode=1 and
		    adjheader.adjcode=adjdetail.adjcode and
		    adjdetail.icode=A.icode),0),

adjDecrQty=isnull((select sum(adjdetail.looseqty)
	      from adjdetail,adjheader 
	      where adjheader.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		    adjcatcode<>1 and
		    adjheader.adjcode=adjdetail.adjcode and
		    adjdetail.icode=A.icode),0),

adjDecrVal=isnull((select sum( adjdetail.looseqty * (adjdetail.saleprice/adjdetail.packunits) )
	      from adjdetail,adjheader 
	      where adjheader.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		    adjcatcode<>1 and
		    adjheader.adjcode=adjdetail.adjcode and
		    adjdetail.icode=A.icode),0),



issueqty=isnull((select sum(issuedetail.qty) from issuedetail , issueheader
	      where  issueheader.date between @s_date and @l_date and
	          issueheader.issueinvcode=issuedetail.issueinvcode and 
		  issuedetail.icode=A.icode),0)
	  
	,
issueval=isnull((select sum(issuedetail.qty * saleprice) from issuedetail , issueheader
	      where  issueheader.date between @s_date and @l_date and
	          issueheader.issueinvcode=issuedetail.issueinvcode and 
		  issuedetail.icode=A.icode),0),

receiptqty=isnull((select sum(receiptdetail.qty) from receiptdetail , receiptheader
	      where  receiptheader.date between @s_date and @l_date and
		     receiptheader.posted='Y' and
	          receiptheader.receiptinvcode=receiptdetail.receiptinvcode and 
		  receiptdetail.icode=A.icode),0),

receiptvalue=isnull((select sum(receiptdetail.qty * saleprice) from receiptdetail , receiptheader
	      where  receiptheader.date between @s_date and @l_date and
		     receiptheader.posted='Y' and
	          receiptheader.receiptinvcode=receiptdetail.receiptinvcode and 
		  receiptdetail.icode=A.icode),0)

from item as A 

where  A.active=1

-- SP_ItemStockMovementAtAvgPrice
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_ItemStockMovementAtAvgPrice @ar_startdate datetime, @ar_enddate datetime, @ReportGrouping CHAR(1), @GroupList VARCHAR(8000)
AS
/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	Returns a result in ReportData Table containing itemcode, and stock movement results

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@ar_startdate = Determine the date whose opening stock is required
	@ar_startdate = Determine the date whose closing stock is required
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
*/
TRUNCATE TABLE ReportData

DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_Avg TABLE (DATE DATETIME, ICODE INT NOT NULL, AvgPrice NUMERIC(15,5))

INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList
SELECT Code FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

INSERT INTO @Tab_Avg 
SELECT Date=P.PostDate, D.ICode, AvgPrice=D.NewAvgPrice
FROM 
	PurLedger P, PurDetail D
WHERE 
	P.Posted = 'Y' AND
	P.PostDate <= @ar_enddate AND
	P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND
	D.ICode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)
UNION ALL
SELECT Date=S.PostDate, D.ICode, AvgPrice=D.NewAvgPrice
FROM 
	SrLedger S, SrDetail D
WHERE 
	S.Posted = 'Y' AND
	S.PostDate <= @ar_enddate AND
	S.SRInvCode = D.SRInvCode AND
	D.ICode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)
UNION ALL
SELECT Date=S.PostDate, D.ICode, AvgPrice=D.NewAvgPrice
FROM 
	ReceiptHeader S, ReceiptDetail D
WHERE 
	S.Posted = 'Y' AND
	S.PostDate <= @ar_enddate AND
	S.ReceiptInvCode = D.ReceiptInvCode AND
	D.ICode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)
UNION ALL
SELECT Date=S.PostedDate, D.ICode, AvgPrice=D.NewAvgPrice
FROM 
	AdjHeader S, AdjDetail D
WHERE 
	S.Posted = 'Y' AND
	S.PostedDate <= @ar_enddate AND
	S.AdjCode = D.AdjCode AND
	D.ICode IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)

INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (Code1, Name1, Name2, Code2, Name3, Name4, Code3, Code4, Code5, Value1, Value2, Value3, 
	Value4, Value5, Value6, Value7, Value8, Value9, Value10, Value11, Value12, Value13, Value14, Value15, Value16, Value17, Value18)
SELECT	
	ICode=A.Icode, AliasName= i.customicode, Item = i.name,
	Code = CASE @ReportGrouping WHEN 'M' THEN I.ManfCode WHEN 'C' THEN I.icatcode WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode ELSE I.PackCode END,
	packingdesc=max(i.packingdesc),
	Name = CASE @ReportGrouping WHEN 'M' THEN M.Name WHEN 'C' THEN C.Name WHEN 'L' THEN L.Name ELSE P.Name END,
	OPRate = ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 T.AvgPrice FROM @Tab_Avg T WHERE T.ICode = A.ICode AND T.Date <= @ar_startdate ORDER BY T.Date DESC), 0),
	CLRate = ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 T.AvgPrice FROM @Tab_Avg T WHERE T.ICode = A.ICode AND T.Date <= @ar_enddate ORDER BY T.Date DESC), 0),
	openqty	  =SUM(A.openqty),
	PurQty 	  =SUM(A.PurQty),
	PurValue  =SUM(A.PurValue),
	PRetQty	  =SUM(A.PRetQty),
	PRetValue =SUM(A.PRetValue),
	SaleQty	  =SUM(A.SaleQty),
	SaleValue =SUM(A.SaleValue),
	SRetQty	  =SUM(A.SRetQty),
	SRetValue =SUM(A.SRetValue),
	IssueQty  =SUM(A.IssueQty),
	IssueValue  =SUM(A.IssueValue),
	DueSatisfyQty=SUM(A.DueSatisfyQty),
	DueSatisfyValue  =SUM(A.DueSatisfyValue),
	ReceiptQty=SUM(A.ReceiptQty),
	ReceiptValue=SUM(A.ReceiptValue),
	AdjIncQty=SUM(A.AdjIncQty),
	AdjIncValue=SUM(A.AdjIncValue),
	AdjDecQty=SUM(A.AdjDecQty),
	AdjDecValue=SUM(A.AdjDecValue)
FROM	
	Item I,
	Manufacturer M,
	ItemCategory C,
	ItemClass L,
	ItemPacking P,
	(SELECT	
		Icode, 
		openqty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='OP' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
		PurQty 	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
		PurValue  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PV' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
		PRetQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PR' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
		PRetValue =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PR' THEN Value ELSE 0 END),
		SaleQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
		SaleValue =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
		SRetQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SR' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
		SRetValue =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SR' THEN Value ELSE 0 END),
		IssueQty  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='IV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
		IssueValue=SUM(CASE WHEN type='IV' THEN Value ELSE 0 END),
		DueSatisfyQty =SUM(CASE WHEN type='DS' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
		DueSatisfyValue  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='DS' THEN Value ELSE 0 END),
		ReceiptQty=SUM(CASE WHEN type='RV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
		ReceiptValue=SUM(CASE WHEN type='RV' THEN Value ELSE 0 END),
		AdjIncQty=SUM(CASE WHEN type='AI' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
		AdjIncValue=SUM(CASE WHEN type='AI' THEN Value ELSE 0 END),
		AdjDecQty=SUM(CASE WHEN type='AD' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
		AdjDecValue=SUM(CASE WHEN type='AD' THEN Value ELSE 0 END)
	FROM
		(SELECT	type='OP', pd.icode, qty = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
									when 1 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
									when 2 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
									else pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty end, 0)),
			Value = 0
		FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd
		WHERE 
			pl.posted = 'Y' AND 
			pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
			pl.PostDate < @ar_startdate and 
			pd.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT type='OP', pd.icode, qty  = - sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits), Value = 0
		FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
		      pl.date < @ar_startdate and 
			pd.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT type='OP', sd.icode, qty  = -sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty), Value = 0
		FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
		    sl.date < @ar_startdate AND sd.Due IS NULL and 
			sd.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT type='OP', sd.icode, qty  = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty), Value = 0
		FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
		    sl.PostDate < @ar_startdate and 
			sd.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT type='OP', sd.icode, qty  = -sum(sd.qty), Value = 0
		FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
		      sl.date < @ar_startdate  and 
			sd.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select type='OP', sd.icode, qty  = sum(sd.qty), Value = 0
		FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
		      sl.PostDate < @ar_startdate and 
			sd.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select type='OP', sd.icode, qty = sum(sd.looseqty), Value = 0
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
		      sl.PostedDate < @ar_startdate and 
			sd.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT type='OP', sd.icode, qty = -sum(sd.looseqty), Value = 0
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
		      sl.PostedDate < @ar_startdate and 
			sd.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT type='OP', d.icode, qty = -sum(d.duesatisfyqty), Value = 0
		FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d
		WHERE h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND
		      h.duesatisfydate < @ar_startdate and 
			d.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By d.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	type='PV',
			pd.icode,
			qty = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
				when 1 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
				when 2 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
				else pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty end, 0)),
			value = sum(isnull((pd.packqty + pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.netrate, 0))
		FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd
		WHERE 
			pl.posted = 'Y' AND 
			pl.Postdate BETWEEN @ar_startdate and @ar_enddate AND
			pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
			pd.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	type='PR',
			pd.icode,
			qty = sum(pd.looseqty + PD.bonusqty),
			value = sum((pd.looseqty + PD.bonusqty) * pd.AvgPrice)
		FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd
		WHERE 
			pl.posted = 'Y' AND 
			pl.date BETWEEN @ar_startdate and @ar_enddate AND
			pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
			pd.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	type='SV',
			sd.icode,
			qty = sum(sd.looseqty + SD.bonusqty),
			value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty) * sd.AvgPrice)
		FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
		WHERE 
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND  
			sl.date BETWEEN @ar_startdate and @ar_enddate AND
			sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND SD.Due IS NULL AND
			sd.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	type='SR',
			sd.icode,
			qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty),
			value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty) * CASE WHEN sl.saleinvcode > 0 THEN sd.AvgPrice ELSE sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01) END)
		FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
		WHERE 
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
			sl.postdate BETWEEN @ar_startdate and @ar_enddate AND
			sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
			sd.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	type='IV',
			sd.icode,
			qty = sum(sd.qty),
			value = sum(sd.qty  * sd.AvgPrice)
		FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd
		WHERE 
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
			sl.date BETWEEN @ar_startdate and @ar_enddate AND
			sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
			sd.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	type='DS',
			d.icode,
			qty = sum(d.duesatisfyqty),
			value = sum((d.duesatisfyqty) * d.AvgPrice)
		FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d
		WHERE 
			h.duesatisfydate BETWEEN @ar_startdate and @ar_enddate AND
			h.duesatisfycode = d.duesatisfycode AND
			d.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By d.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	type='RV',
			sd.icode,
			qty = sum(sd.qty),
			value = sum((sd.qty) * sd.AvgPrice)
		FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd
		WHERE 
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
			sl.postdate BETWEEN @ar_startdate and @ar_enddate AND
			sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
			sd.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	type='AI',
			sd.icode,
			qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
			value = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.avgprice)
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
		WHERE 
			sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
			sl.posteddate BETWEEN @ar_startdate and @ar_enddate AND
			sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode AND
			sd.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	type='AD',
			sd.icode,
			qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
			value = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.avgprice)
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
		WHERE 
			sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
			sl.posteddate BETWEEN @ar_startdate and @ar_enddate AND
			sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode AND
			sd.icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT type='OP', icode, qty = 0, value=0 
		FROM ITEM	
		WHERE icode in (select CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)) K
	GROUP BY ICode) A
WHERE 
	I.icode = A.icode AND
	I.ManfCode = M.ManfCode AND
	I.ICatCode = C.ICatCode AND
	I.ICCode = L.ICCode AND
	I.PackCode = P.PackCode
GROUP BY 
	A.icode,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name,
	I.ICatCode,
	I.ICCode,
	I.ManfCode,
	I.PackCode,
	I.PackingDesc,
	M.Name,
	C.Name,
	L.Name,
	P.Name
RETURN 0

-- SP_LockBatch
CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_LockBatch 
	@GCode Integer, 
	@ICode Integer, 
	@Batch VarChar (100), 
	@Expiry DateTime, 
	@Qty NUMERIC(15, 4), 
	@LockBatch CHAR(1),
	@LockReasonCode SMALLINT
AS   
/*
Date : Dec 31,2020
Author : Muhammad Azhar Inayat
*/

Declare @itemname VarChar(60)  
Declare @string_expiry VarChar(25)  
Declare @rowsaffected Integer  
Declare @err Integer   

Update	GodownDetail  
Set	Locked = @LockBatch, LockReasonCode = @LockReasonCode 
Where	GodownDetail.GCode  = @GCode and
	GodownDetail.ICode  = @ICode and
	GodownDetail.Batch  = @Batch and
	GodownDetail.Expiry = @Expiry and
	GodownDetail.CurrQty = @Qty

Select @rowsaffected = @@RowCount , @err = @@Error    

IF @rowsaffected = 0 OR @err <> 0   
Begin   
	RAISERROR  ('Unable to lock batch for an item' , 16 , 1)
	Return -1   
End    
Return 0

name: SP_MachineWiseSaleAndReturn_CrossTab
definition:
-- SP_MachineWiseSaleAndReturn_CrossTab
CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_MachineWiseSaleAndReturn_CrossTab
	@StartDate DateTime, 
	@EndDate DateTime
AS

DELETE ReportData

INSERT INTO ReportData (Code1, Name1, Name2, Value1, Value2, Date1, Date2)
SELECT 
	S.MainGroup,
	S.CategoryName,
	S.MachineName,
	Sale=SUM(S.Sale),
	SaleReturn=SUM(S.SaleReturn),
	@StartDate, 
	@EndDate
FROM
	(SELECT
		T.MainGroup,
		CategoryName=
			CASE 
			WHEN SubGroup = 2 OR SubGroup= 9 THEN '*** Discount ***' 
			WHEN SubGroup = 3 OR SubGroup= 10 THEN '*** Misc. Charges ***' 
			WHEN SubGroup = 4 OR SubGroup= 11 THEN '*** Sales Tax ***' 
			WHEN SubGroup = 5 OR SubGroup= 12 THEN '*** Rounding Difference ***' 
			WHEN SubGroup = 6 OR SubGroup= 13 THEN '*** Credit ***' 
			WHEN SubGroup = 7 THEN '*** Returns ***' 
			ELSE IC.Name END,
		T.MachineName,
		Sale=SUM(CASE T.SubGroup WHEN 8 THEN 0 ELSE T.Value END),
		SaleReturn=SUM(CASE WHEN T.SubGroup >= 8 THEN T.Value ELSE 0 END)
	FROM
		(SELECT 
			MainGroup=1, SUBGroup=1, 
			MachineName=(SELECT MIN(MachineName) FROM SaleLedger), 
			ICatCode, Value=0
		FROM ItemCategory
		UNION ALL
		SELECT   -- category wise sales
			MainGroup=1, SUBGroup=1, SL.MachineName,
			I.icatcode, Value = IsNull( sum(round(((SD.looseqty + SD.packqty * SD.packunits) * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (.01 *  SD.discperc)),2))  ,0)
		FROM 
			SaleDetail SD, SaleLedger SL, Item I
		WHERE 
			SL.date between @StartDate and @EndDate and SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode and SD.icode=I.icode
		GROUP BY 
			SL.MachineName,	I.ICatCode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 		-- Sale Discounts
			MainGroup=2, SUBGroup=2, SL.MachineName, ICatCode=9999999,
			Value = - (SL.FlatDisc + ISNULL( SUM(ROUND(((SD.looseqty + SD.packqty * SD.packunits) * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)),2)) * 0.01 * SL.discperc, 0))
		FROM
			SaleDetail SD, SaleLedger SL
		WHERE 
			SL.date between @StartDate and @EndDate and 
			(SL.FlatDisc <> 0 OR SL.DiscPerc <> 0) AND SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode 
		GROUP BY
			SL.MachineName, SL.SaleInvCode, SL.FlatDisc, SL.DiscPerc 
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 		-- Sale Misc.Charges
			MainGroup=2, SUBGroup=3, SL.MachineName, ICatCode=9999999, Value = SUM(SL.MiscCharges)
		FROM
			SaleDetail SD, SaleLedger SL
		WHERE 
			SL.date between @StartDate and @EndDate and SL.MiscCharges <> 0 AND
			SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode 
		GROUP BY
			SL.MachineName
		UNION ALL
		SELECT   --SalesTax On Sales
			MainGroup=2, SUBGroup=4, T.MachineName, ICatCode=9999999,
			Value = ISNULL( SUM(Round(T.itemsalestax + T.invtax,0) ),0)
		FROM
			(SELECT 
				SL.MachineName,
				itemsalestax = Sum (Round (SD.looseqty * SD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (SD.looseqty * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * SD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),
				invtax=	Round ( (Sum ( SD.looseqty * SD.saleprice) 
					-   Round(Sum (Round(( SD.looseqty  * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc) * (SD.discperc * .01)) + (SD.looseqty  * SD.itemflatdisc),2)), 2) 
					-  Sum (Round( SD.looseqty * (SD.saleprice  - SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (SD.discperc * .01)),2)) * (SL.discperc * 0.01)
					- SL.flatdisc ) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01 , 2)
			FROM 
				Saleledger SL, Saledetail SD
			WHERE 
				(SL.invgstperc1 <> 0 OR SD.unitsalestax <> 0 OR SD.gstperc <> 0) AND
				SL.date between @StartDate and @EndDate AND SL.saleinvcode = SD.saleinvcode
			GROUP BY 
				SL.misccharges, SL.flatdisc, SL.date, SL.saleinvcode,
				SL.MachineName, SL.discperc, SL.salestax, SL.invgstperc1) T
		GROUP BY T.MachineName
		UNION ALL
		SELECT   --Sale Rounding Diff
			MainGroup=2, SUBGroup=5, SL.MachineName, ICatCode=9999999,
			Value = 
			Round(Sum ( SD.looseqty * SD.saleprice)
			- Round(Sum (Round(( SD.looseqty  * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc) * (SD.discperc * .01)) + (SD.looseqty  * SD.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)
			- Sum ( Round(SD.looseqty   * (SD.saleprice  - SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (SD.discperc * .01)),2)) * (SL.discperc * 0.01) 
			+ SL.misccharges - SL.flatdisc,0)  
			-
			(Sum ( SD.looseqty * SD.saleprice)
			- Round(Sum (Round(( SD.looseqty  * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc) * (SD.discperc * .01)) + (SD.looseqty  * SD.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)
			- Sum (Round( SD.looseqty   * (SD.saleprice  - SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (SD.discperc * .01)),2)) * (SL.discperc * 0.01)
			+ SL.misccharges - SL.flatdisc)
		FROM 
			SaleLedger SL, SaleDetail SD
		WHERE 
			SL.SaleCatCode NOT IN (2) AND SL.date between @StartDate and @EndDate AND
			SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode 
		GROUP BY 
			SL.SaleInvCode, SL.MachineName, SL.DiscPerc, SL.MiscCharges, SL.FlatDisc
		UNION ALL
		SELECT   --Credit Sale Value
			MainGroup=2, SUBGroup=6, SL.MachineName, ICatCode=9999999, Value = - dbo.fn_GetSaleInvTotal(SL.SaleInvCode)
		FROM 
			SaleLedger SL
		WHERE 
			SL.SaleCatCode IN (2) AND SL.date between @StartDate and @EndDate
		GROUP BY 
			SL.SaleInvCode, SL.MachineName
		UNION ALL
		SELECT   --Sale Return Value
			MainGroup=2, SUBGroup=7, SL.MachineName, ICatCode=9999999, Value = - dbo.fn_GetSRInvTotal(SL.SRInvCode)
		FROM 
			SRLedger SL
		WHERE 
			SL.date between @StartDate and @EndDate
		GROUP BY 
			SL.SRInvCode, SL.MachineName
		UNION ALL
		SELECT	-- category wise sale returns
			MainGroup=1, SUBGroup=8, SL.MachineName, I.icatcode, Value = -IsNull( sum(round(((SD.looseqty + SD.packqty * SD.packunits) * SD.srprice) * (1 - (.01 *  SD.discperc)),2))  ,0)
		FROM 
			SRDetail SD, SRLedger SL, Item I
		WHERE 
			SL.date between @StartDate and @EndDate and SL.srinvcode=SD.srinvcode and SD.icode=I.icode
		GROUP BY 
			SL.MachineName, I.ICatCode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 		-- Sale Discounts
			MainGroup=2, SUBGroup=9, SL.MachineName, ICatCode=9999999,
			Value = (SL.FlatDisc + ISNULL( SUM(ROUND(((SD.looseqty + SD.packqty * SD.packunits) * (SD.srprice)) * (1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)),2)) * 0.01 * SL.discperc, 0))
		FROM
			SRDetail SD, SRLedger SL
		WHERE 
			SL.date between @StartDate and @EndDate and 
			(SL.FlatDisc <> 0 OR SL.DiscPerc <> 0) AND SL.srinvcode=SD.srinvcode 
		GROUP BY
			SL.MachineName, SL.SRInvCode, SL.FlatDisc, SL.DiscPerc 
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 		-- Sale Misc.Charges
			MainGroup=2, SUBGroup=10, SL.MachineName, ICatCode=9999999, Value = - SUM(SL.MiscCharges)
		FROM
			SRDetail SD, SRLedger SL
		WHERE 
			SL.date between @StartDate and @EndDate and SL.MiscCharges <> 0 AND
			SL.srinvcode=SD.srinvcode 
		GROUP BY
			SL.MachineName
		UNION ALL
		SELECT   --SalesTax On Sales
			MainGroup=2, SUBGroup=11, T.MachineName, ICatCode=9999999,
			Value = - ISNULL( SUM(Round(T.itemsalestax + T.invtax,0) ),0)
		FROM
			(SELECT 
				SL.MachineName,
				itemsalestax = Sum (Round (SD.looseqty * SD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (SD.looseqty * (SD.srprice) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * SD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),
				invtax=	Round ( (Sum ( SD.looseqty * SD.srprice) 
					-   Round(Sum (Round(( SD.looseqty  * SD.srprice * (SD.discperc * .01)),2)), 2) 
					-  Sum (Round( SD.looseqty * SD.srprice * (1 - (SD.discperc * .01)),2)) * (SL.discperc * 0.01)
					- SL.flatdisc ) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01 , 2)
			FROM 
				SRledger SL, SRdetail SD
			WHERE 
				(SL.invgstperc1 <> 0 OR SD.unitsalestax <> 0 OR SD.gstperc <> 0) AND
				SL.date between @StartDate and @EndDate AND SL.srinvcode = SD.srinvcode
			GROUP BY 
				SL.misccharges, SL.flatdisc, SL.date, SL.srinvcode,
				SL.MachineName, SL.discperc, SL.salestax, SL.invgstperc1) T
		GROUP BY T.MachineName
		UNION ALL
		SELECT   --Sale Return Rounding Diff
			MainGroup=2, SUBGroup=12, SL.MachineName, ICatCode=9999999,
			Value = 
			- (Round(Sum ( SD.looseqty * SD.srprice)
			- Round(Sum (Round(( SD.looseqty  * SD.srprice * (SD.discperc * .01)),2)), 2)
			- Sum ( Round(SD.looseqty   * SD.srprice * (1 - (SD.discperc * .01)),2)) * (SL.discperc * 0.01) 
			+ SL.misccharges - SL.flatdisc,0)  
			-
			(Sum ( SD.looseqty * SD.srprice)
			- Round(Sum (Round(( SD.looseqty  * SD.srprice * (SD.discperc * .01)), 2)), 2)
			- Sum (Round( SD.looseqty * SD.srprice * (1 - (SD.discperc * .01)),2)) * (SL.discperc * 0.01)
			+ SL.misccharges - SL.flatdisc))
		FROM 
			SRLedger SL, SRDetail SD
		WHERE 
			SL.SRCatCode NOT IN (2) AND SL.date between @StartDate and @EndDate AND
			SL.SRInvCode = SD.SRInvCode 
		GROUP BY 
			SL.SRInvCode, SL.MachineName, SL.DiscPerc, SL.MiscCharges, SL.FlatDisc
		UNION ALL
		SELECT   --Credit Sale Return Value
			MainGroup=2, SUBGroup=13, SL.MachineName, ICatCode=9999999, Value = dbo.fn_GetSRInvTotal(SL.SRInvCode)
		FROM 
			SRLedger SL
		WHERE 
			SL.SRCatCode NOT IN (8) AND SL.date between @StartDate and @EndDate
		GROUP BY 
			SL.SRInvCode, SL.MachineName) T
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemCategory AS IC ON (T.ICatCode = IC.ICatCode) 
	GROUP BY
		T.MainGroup,
		T.SubGroup,
		T.MachineName,
		IC.Name) S
GROUP BY
	S.MainGroup,
	S.MachineName,
	S.CategoryName
ORDER BY 
	S.MainGroup,
	S.MachineName,
	S.CategoryName

-- sp_MakeAccountAliasUnique
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_MakeAccountAliasUnique AS    SET NOCOUNT ON     /*BEGIN TRANSACTION T1*/    DECLARE @AccCode INT  DECLARE @AliasName Varchar(12)  DECLARE @OldAliasName Varchar(12)  DECLARE @Counter INT  DECLARE @ConflictRows INT    /*Remove AliasName Having Null*/  UPDATE Accounts   SET AliasName = RTRIM(LTRIM(convert(varchar(10), AccCode))) + 'R1'  WHERE AliasName IS NULL    SELECT @ConflictRows = COUNT(*) FROM Accounts   WHERE AliasName IN  (SELECT AliasName FROM Accounts  GROUP BY AliasName HAVING COUNT(AliasName) > 1)    WHILE @ConflictRows > 0  BEGIN   DECLARE C1 CURSOR FOR    SELECT AccCode, AliasName FROM Accounts    WHERE AliasName IN   (SELECT AliasName FROM Accounts   GROUP BY AliasName HAVING COUNT(AliasName) > 1)   ORDER BY AliasName, AccCode      OPEN C1     SELECT @OldAliasName=NULL   SELECT @Counter=0     FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @AccCode, @AliasName     WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0   BEGIN    IF @OldAliasName IS NULL     BEGIN      SELECT @OldAliasName=@AliasName      SELECT @Counter=0     END      IF @OldAliasName <> @AliasName     BEGIN      SELECT @OldAliasName=@AliasName      SELECT @Counter=0     END    ELSE     BEGIN      SELECT @Counter=@Counter+1         UPDATE Accounts       SET AliasName = RTRIM(LTRIM(AliasName)) + 'V' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @Counter)))      WHERE AliasName = @AliasName AND AccCode = @AccCode     END       FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @AccCode, @AliasName   END   CLOSE C1   DEALLOCATE C1     SELECT @ConflictRows = COUNT(*) FROM Accounts    WHERE AliasName IN   (SELECT AliasName FROM Accounts   GROUP BY AliasName HAVING COUNT(AliasName) > 1)    END    /*COMMIT TRANSACTION T1*/

-- SP_MakePriceChanges
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_MakePriceChanges
AS

DECLARE @ConstCount INT, @RowID INT, @RowCount INT, @LoopCount INT, @Priority NUMERIC(6,2)
DECLARE @Table VARCHAR(60), @Col VARCHAR(60), @Const VARCHAR(1000), @Stmt VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @OldTable VARCHAR(60), @newdatatype VARCHAR(100)

DECLARE C1 CURSOR FOR
SELECT dd.tablename, dd.columnname, dd.priority, so.name, dd.newdatatype
FROM
	(select so.id, so.name from sysobjects so) p, 
	sysobjects so, 
	sysconstraints sc,
	PriceChanges dd
WHERE
	dd.tablename = p.name and
	p.id = so.parent_obj and
	so.id = sc.constid and 
	so.parent_obj in (OBJECT_ID(p.name)) /* and 
	xtype ='D'*/ and 
	sc.colid > 0 AND 
	sc.colid in
	(SELECT sl.colid 
	FROM syscolumns sl 
	WHERE
		sl.id IN (OBJECT_ID(p.name)) and 
		sl.name IN (dd.columnname))
ORDER BY dd.priority

OPEN C1
FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @Table, @Col, @Priority, @Const, @NewDataType
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @Stmt = 'ALTER TABLE DBO.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@Table)) + ' DROP CONSTRAINT ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@Const))
	EXECUTE (@Stmt)
	FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @Table, @Col, @Priority, @Const, @NewDataType
END
CLOSE C1
DEALLOCATE C1

DECLARE C2 CURSOR FOR
SELECT dd.tablename, dd.columnname, dd.priority, dd.newdatatype
FROM
	PriceChanges dd
ORDER BY dd.priority

OPEN C2
FETCH NEXT FROM C2 INTO @Table, @Col, @Priority, @NewDataType
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @Stmt = 'UPDATE DBO.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@Table)) + ' SET ' + @Col + ' = 0.00 WHERE ' + @Col + ' IS NULL'
	EXECUTE (@Stmt)
	SET @Stmt = 'ALTER TABLE DBO.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@Table)) + ' ALTER COLUMN ' + @Col + ' ' + @newdatatype
	EXECUTE (@Stmt)
	SET @Stmt = 'ALTER TABLE DBO.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@Table)) + ' ADD CONSTRAINT DF_' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@Table)) + '_' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@col)) + ' DEFAULT (0) FOR ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@col))
	EXECUTE (@Stmt)
	FETCH NEXT FROM C2 INTO @Table, @Col, @Priority, @NewDataType
END
CLOSE C2
DEALLOCATE C2

RETURN 0

-- SP_ManageLoyaltyPoints
CREATE    PROCEDURE DBO.SP_ManageLoyaltyPoints
	@InvType VARCHAR(2), 
	@InvoiceCode INTEGER
AS
/*
Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Description:
This stored procedure is used to manage loyalty point an account is entitled for
On Sales --Points are added
On Sales Return --Points are reversed
On Loyalty Redemption -- Points are deducted
On Loyalty Adjustment -- Points +/-
*/
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @NetAmt NUMERIC(12,2), @LoyaltyAmt NUMERIC(12,2), @LoyaltyCardCode INT, @LoyaltyPoints INT, @PointsValue NUMERIC(12,2), @LoyaltyPolicyCode INT

IF @InvoiceCode IS NULL OR @InvoiceCode < 0 
BEGIN 
	SET @LoyaltyPoints = 0
	RaisError('Problem occured while fetching Invoice/Document Information' ,16,1)
	RETURN -1
END

DELETE LoyaltyCardLedger WHERE InvoiceType=@InvType AND InvoiceCode = @InvoiceCode

IF @InvType='SV' /*On Sales - Loyalty Points Addition*/
BEGIN
	SET @NetAmt = ISNULL((SELECT Amt=DBO.fn_GetSaleInvLoyaltyTotal(@InvoiceCode)), 0)
	SET @LoyaltyCardCode = (SELECT MIN(LoyaltyCardCode) FROM LoyaltyCard WHERE ExpiryDate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND AccCode IN (SELECT CustCode FROM SaleLedger WHERE SaleInvCode=@InvoiceCode))
	SET @LoyaltyPolicyCode = (SELECT LoyaltyPolicyCode FROM LoyaltyCard WHERE LoyaltyCardCode = @LoyaltyCardCode)
	SET @LoyaltyAmt = @NetAmt
	SET @LoyaltyPoints = 0
	IF @LoyaltyPolicyCode > 0 AND @LoyaltyCardCode > 0
	BEGIN
		SELECT @LoyaltyPoints=A.LoyaltyPoints, @PointsValue=A.RedemptionValue
		FROM
		(SELECT D.LoyaltyPoints, D.RedemptionValue
		FROM 
			LoyaltyPolicyDetail D, 
			(SELECT SaleLimit=MIN(SaleLimit) 
			FROM LoyaltyPolicyDetail 
			WHERE LoyaltyPolicyCode=@LoyaltyPolicyCode AND 
				SaleLimit >= @LoyaltyAmt
			UNION
			SELECT SaleLimit=MAX(SaleLimit) 
			FROM LoyaltyPolicyDetail 
			WHERE LoyaltyPolicyCode=@LoyaltyPolicyCode AND 
			SaleLimit <= @LoyaltyAmt) T
		WHERE D.LoyaltyPolicyCode=@LoyaltyPolicyCode AND 
			D.SaleLimit = T.SaleLimit AND
			T.SaleLimit <= @LoyaltyAmt) A

		IF @LoyaltyPoints > 0 OR @PointsValue > 0
			INSERT INTO LoyaltyCardLedger (LoyaltyCardCode, AccCode, Date, UserCode, PointsDebit, PointsCredit, Debit, Credit, Remarks, InvoiceType, InvoiceCode)
			SELECT L.LoyaltyCardCode, L.AccCode, Date=S.Date, S.SalesManCode, @LoyaltyPoints, 0, Debit=@PointsValue, Credit=0.00, 'Loyalty Points Earned', @InvType, @InvoiceCode
			FROM SaleLedger S, LoyaltyCard L
			WHERE S.SaleInvCode = @InvoiceCode AND
				L.LoyaltyCardCode = @LoyaltyCardCode AND
				S.CustCode = L.AccCode AND
				S.SaleInvCode NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT InvoiceCode FROM LoyaltyCardLedger WHERE InvoiceType='SV')
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @LoyaltyPoints = 0
		RETURN 0
	END
END

IF @InvType='SR' /*On Sales Return - Loyalty Points Substraction */
BEGIN
	SET @NetAmt = ISNULL((SELECT Amt=DBO.fn_getSRInvLoyaltyTotal(@InvoiceCode)), 0)
	SET @LoyaltyCardCode = (SELECT MIN(LoyaltyCardCode) FROM LoyaltyCard WHERE ExpiryDate >= CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 101) AS DATETIME) AND AccCode IN (SELECT CustCode FROM SRLedger WHERE SRInvCode=@InvoiceCode))
	SET @LoyaltyPolicyCode = (SELECT LoyaltyPolicyCode FROM LoyaltyCard WHERE LoyaltyCardCode = @LoyaltyCardCode)
	SET @LoyaltyAmt = @NetAmt
	SET @LoyaltyPoints = 0
	IF @LoyaltyPolicyCode > 0 AND @LoyaltyCardCode > 0
	BEGIN
		SELECT @LoyaltyPoints=A.LoyaltyPoints, @PointsValue=A.RedemptionValue
		FROM
		(SELECT D.LoyaltyPoints, D.RedemptionValue
		FROM 
			LoyaltyPolicyDetail D, 
			(SELECT SaleLimit=MIN(SaleLimit) 
			FROM LoyaltyPolicyDetail 
			WHERE LoyaltyPolicyCode=@LoyaltyPolicyCode AND 
				SaleLimit >= @LoyaltyAmt
			UNION
			SELECT SaleLimit=MAX(SaleLimit) 
			FROM LoyaltyPolicyDetail 
			WHERE LoyaltyPolicyCode=@LoyaltyPolicyCode AND 
			SaleLimit <= @LoyaltyAmt) T
		WHERE D.LoyaltyPolicyCode=@LoyaltyPolicyCode AND 
			D.SaleLimit = T.SaleLimit AND
			T.SaleLimit <= @LoyaltyAmt) A

		IF @LoyaltyPoints > 0 OR @PointsValue > 0
			INSERT INTO LoyaltyCardLedger (LoyaltyCardCode, AccCode, Date, UserCode, PointsDebit, PointsCredit, Debit, Credit, Remarks, InvoiceType, InvoiceCode)
			SELECT L.LoyaltyCardCode, L.AccCode, Date=S.Date, S.SalesManCode, 0, @LoyaltyPoints, Debit=0.00, Credit=@PointsValue, 'Loyalty Points Reversed', @InvType, @InvoiceCode
			FROM SRLedger S, LoyaltyCard L
			WHERE S.SRInvCode = @InvoiceCode AND
				L.LoyaltyCardCode = @LoyaltyCardCode AND
				S.CustCode = L.AccCode AND
				S.SRInvCode NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT InvoiceCode FROM LoyaltyCardLedger WHERE InvoiceType='SR')
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @LoyaltyPoints = 0
		RETURN 0
	END
END

IF @InvType='RD' /*On Loyalty Points Redemption*/
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO LoyaltyCardLedger (LoyaltyCardCode, AccCode, Date, UserCode, PointsDebit, PointsCredit, Debit, Credit, Remarks, InvoiceType, InvoiceCode)
	SELECT L.LoyaltyCardCode, L.AccCode, Date=LR.Date, LR.UserCode, PointsDebit=0, PointsCredit=LR.PointsRedeemed, Debit=0, Credit=LR.PointsValue, 'Loyalty Points Redeemed', @InvType, @InvoiceCode
	FROM LoyaltyRedemption LR, LoyaltyCard L
	WHERE LR.LoyaltyRedemptionCode = @InvoiceCode AND
		LR.LoyaltyCardCode = L.LoyaltyCardCode AND
		LR.LoyaltyRedemptionCode NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT InvoiceCode FROM LoyaltyCardLedger WHERE InvoiceType='RD')
END

IF @InvType='AD' /*On Loyalty Points Adjustment*/
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO LoyaltyCardLedger (LoyaltyCardCode, AccCode, Date, UserCode, PointsDebit, PointsCredit, Debit, Credit, Remarks, InvoiceType, InvoiceCode)
	SELECT L.LoyaltyCardCode, L.AccCode, Date=LA.Date, LA.UserCode, 
		PointsDebit=CASE WHEN LA.AdjustmentTypeCode = 1 THEN LA.AdjustedPoints ELSE 0 END, 
		PointsCredit=CASE WHEN LA.AdjustmentTypeCode = 1 THEN 0 ELSE LA.AdjustedPoints END, 
		Debit=CASE WHEN LA.AdjustmentTypeCode = 1 THEN LA.AdjustmentValue ELSE 0 END, 
		Credit=CASE WHEN LA.AdjustmentTypeCode = 1 THEN 0 ELSE LA.AdjustmentValue END, 
		'Loyalty Points ' + CASE WHEN LA.AdjustmentTypeCode = 1 THEN 'Added ' ELSE 'Deducted' END, 
		@InvType, @InvoiceCode
	FROM LoyaltyPointAdjustment LA, LoyaltyCard L
	WHERE LA.AdjustmentCode = @InvoiceCode AND
		LA.LoyaltyCardCode = L.LoyaltyCardCode AND
		LA.AdjustmentCode NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT InvoiceCode FROM LoyaltyCardLedger WHERE InvoiceType='AD')
END

RETURN 0

definition:
-- SP_Mark_UserAttendance
CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_Mark_UserAttendance
	@UserCode SMALLINT, @RowID INT, @Mode INT,@date_in_out DateTime, @Msg VARCHAR(200) OUTPUT
AS

/*
Author:M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	The Purpose of this code is to Mark Attendance of a user
	Depending on attendance mode :-
	IF mode=1 (Time in) Insert a new row for User Attendece
	IF mode=2 (Time out) Update an existing row for timeout
*/

--Lock user first so that no other request can time-in the specified user
DECLARE @uc SMALLINT
DECLARE @rid INT
DECLARE @username VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @dt DATETIME, @dt2 DATETIME

SET @username = ISNULL((SELECT UserName FROM DBO.Users WHERE UserCode = @UserCode), '')

SET @uc = (SELECT UserCode FROM Users WITH (UPDLOCK HOLDLOCK) WHERE UserCode = @UserCode)

EXECUTE SP_Check_UserAttendance @UserCode, @rid out
IF @@Error <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Unable to fetch user attendance status user = %s, RowId = %d ', 16, 1, @username, @rid)
	RETURN -1
END

IF @rid = @RowId
BEGIN
	SET @Dt = @date_in_out /*GetDate()*/
	IF @Mode=1
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO DBO.UserAttendance (UserCode, TimeIn, TimeOut, Remarks)
		SELECT @UserCode, @Dt, NULL, ''
	
		IF @@Error <> 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Unable to Insert user attendance record user = %s ', 16, 1, @username)
			RETURN -1
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @Msg = 'Time-in On = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(100), @Dt)))
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @dt2 = (SELECT TimeIn FROM DBO.UserAttendance WHERE UserCode = @UserCode AND RowID = @RowID)
		/*IF @dt2 > GETDATE()*/
		IF @dt2 > @date_in_out
		BEGIN
			RaisError('User Time-in date is greater than current system date~r~nUnable to update user attendance record user = %s, RowId = %d ', 16, 1, @username, @rid)
			RETURN -1
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE DBO.UserAttendance
			SET TimeOut = @dt
			WHERE UserCode = @UserCode AND 
				RowID = @RowID
		
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@RowCount <= 0
			BEGIN
				RaisError('Unable to update user attendance record user = %s, RowId = %d ', 16, 1, @username, @rid)
				RETURN -1
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @Msg = 'Time-in On = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(100), @dt2))) + ', Time-out On = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(100), @dt)))
			END
		END
	END
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	RaisError('Unable to mark User Attendance for user = %s, RowId = %d, Possible Reasons are Time in/out status changed, Try again ', 16, 1, @username, @rid)
	RETURN -1
END
RETURN 0
