definition:
-- SP_MarkAttendance
CREATE   PROCEDURE DBO.SP_MarkAttendance @EmpCode INT, @FingerCode TINYINT, @AttendanceCode BIGINT OUT, @AttendanceDateTime DATETIME
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @ApplyDeptTimeSlabs CHAR(1)
DECLARE @DeptCode INT, @WeekDay INT, @Margin INT
DECLARE @TimeSlabType TINYINT, @AttendanceStatusCode TINYINT
DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME, @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME

SET @ApplyDeptTimeSlabs = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('ApplyDeptTimeSlabsInOnlineAtten')
IF @ApplyDeptTimeSlabs IS NULL
	SET @ApplyDeptTimeSlabs='N'

IF @AttendanceDateTime IS NULL
	SET @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()
ELSE
	SET @DateTimeNow = @AttendanceDateTime

SET @DeptCode = (SELECT DeptCode FROM EMP_Employee WHERE EmpCode=@EmpCode)
SET @WeekDay = DATEPART(dw, GETDATE())

IF @ApplyDeptTimeSlabs = 'Y'
BEGIN
	SELECT TOP 1 @TimeSlabType=TimeSlabType, @StartTime=StartTime, @EndTime = EndTime
	FROM 
		(SELECT TimeSlabType=1, StartTime=CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), FHTimeIN, 114), EndTime=CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), FHTimeOUT, 114)
		FROM Emp_DepartmentTiming 
		WHERE DeptCode = @DeptCode AND WeekDayCode = @WeekDay AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), getdate(), 114) BETWEEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), FHTimeIN, 114) AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), FHTimeOUT, 114)
		UNION
		SELECT TimeSlabType=2, StartTime=CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SHTimeIN, 114), EndTime=CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SHTimeOUT, 114)
		FROM Emp_DepartmentTiming 
		WHERE DeptCode = @DeptCode AND WeekDayCode = @WeekDay AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), getdate(), 114) BETWEEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SHTimeIN, 114) AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SHTimeOUT, 114)) AS TimeSlabs

	IF @TimeSlabType <= 0 OR @TimeSlabType IS NULL
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('No Allowed Time Slot Exists for this employee, Please consult administrator to check allowed time slot for concerned department', 16, 1)
	END
	SET @StartTime = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @StartTime, 114) AS DATETIME)
	SET @EndTime = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @EndTime, 114) AS DATETIME)
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SET @AttendanceCode = (SELECT MIN(AttendanceCode) FROM EMP_Attendance WHERE EMPCode=@EmpCode AND Payed = 'N' AND TimeOut IS NULL)

	IF @AttendanceCode IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SET @StartTime = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) + ' 00:00:00' AS DATETIME)
		SET @EndTime = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE()+1, 101) + ' 23:59:59' AS DATETIME)
		SET @TimeSlabType = 0
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @StartTime = (SELECT TIMEIN FROM EMP_Attendance WHERE EMPCode=@EmpCode AND Payed = 'N' AND TimeOut IS NULL AND AttendanceCode = @AttendanceCode)
		SET @EndTime = (SELECT TIMEIN FROM EMP_Attendance WHERE EMPCode=@EmpCode AND Payed = 'N' AND TimeOut IS NULL AND AttendanceCode = @AttendanceCode)
		SET @TimeSlabType = 0
	END
END

IF @AttendanceCode IS NULL OR @AttendanceCode <= 0
BEGIN
	SET @AttendanceCode = 
		(SELECT MIN(AttendanceCode) 
		FROM EMP_Attendance 
		WHERE EMPCode=@EmpCode AND 
			Payed = 'N' AND 
			TIMEIN BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime AND 
			TimeOut IS NULL)
END

IF @AttendanceCode > 0
BEGIN
	SELECT TOP 1 @AttendanceStatusCode=AttendanceStatusCode, @Margin=Margin 
	FROM EMP_AttendanceStatus 
	WHERE TimeType=2 AND Half=@TimeSlabType

	UPDATE EMP_Attendance
	SET 
		TimeOut = @DateTimeNow, 
		FingerCodeOut = @FingerCode, 
		AttendanceStatusCode = CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(n, @DateTimeNow, @EndTime) > @Margin THEN @AttendanceStatusCode ELSE AttendanceStatusCode END
	WHERE AttendanceCode = @AttendanceCode

	RETURN 0
END

SELECT TOP 1 @AttendanceStatusCode=AttendanceStatusCode, @Margin=Margin 
FROM EMP_AttendanceStatus 
WHERE AutoSet='Y' AND TimeType=1 AND Half=@TimeSlabType AND
	AttendanceStatusCode = CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(n, @EndTime, @DateTimeNow) <= Margin THEN AttendanceStatusCode ELSE @AttendanceStatusCode END

IF ISNULL(@AttendanceStatusCode,0) <= 0
	SET @AttendanceStatusCode=1

INSERT INTO EMP_Attendance (EmpCode, FingerCode, TimeIn, TimeOut, AttendanceStatusCode, Payed, Comments, FingerCodeOut)
VALUES (@EmpCode, @FingerCode, @DateTimeNow, NULL, @AttendanceStatusCode, 'N', NULL, NULL)

SET @AttendanceCode = (SELECT MAX(AttendanceCode)
	FROM EMP_Attendance 
	WHERE 
		EMPCode=@EmpCode AND 
		Payed = 'N' AND
		TIMEIN BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime AND
		TimeOut IS NULL)

RETURN 0

-- sp_maxutn
CREATE  PROCEDURE sp_maxutn @lbi_rows bigint, @lbi_maxutn  bigint  OUTPUT AS

Declare @err As Int, @rowcount As Int

Set @lbi_maxutn  =  ( SELECT utn FROM _utn WITH (updlock holdlock) )
Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@Rowcount

IF @err = 0 AND @rowcount > 0 
Begin
	Update _utn
	Set utn=utn + @lbi_rows
	Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@Rowcount	
	IF @err <> 0 OR @rowcount = 0 	
	Begin
		RaisError('Unable to Update transaction UTN' , 16 , 1)
		Return -1
	End
End
Else
Begin
	RaisError('Unable to fetch transaction UTN' , 16 , 1)
	Return -1
End

Return 0

-- SP_MonthlyNetSaleSummary
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_MonthlyNetSaleSummary 
	@Type VARCHAR(100), @StartDate DATETIME, @EndDate DATETIME 
AS
DELETE DBO.REPORTDATA

INSERT INTO DBO.REPORTDATA (Name1, Code1, Name2, Date1, Value1)
SELECT @Type, T.Code, Name = 'OVERALL NET SALES', T.Date, Amt=SUM(T.Amt)
FROM 
	(SELECT Code=1, Date= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date)))), Amt= SUM(S.InvTotal)
	FROM SaleLedger S
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
	GROUP BY S.HeaderNo, LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date))))
	UNION ALL
	SELECT Code=1, Date= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date)))), Amt= - SUM(S.InvTotal)
	FROM SRLedger S
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
	GROUP BY S.HeaderNo, LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date)))) ) T
WHERE UPPER(@Type)='OVERALL NET SALES'
GROUP BY T.Code, T.Date
UNION ALL
SELECT @Type, T.Code, Name = 'Header No.:' + STR(T.Code), T.Date, Amt=SUM(T.Amt)
FROM 
	(SELECT Code=S.HeaderNo, Date= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date)))), Amt= SUM(S.InvTotal)
	FROM SaleLedger S
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
	GROUP BY S.HeaderNo, LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date))))
	UNION ALL
	SELECT Code=S.HeaderNo, Date= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date)))), Amt= - SUM(S.InvTotal)
	FROM SRLedger S
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
	GROUP BY S.HeaderNo, LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date))))) T
WHERE UPPER(@Type)='HEADER'
GROUP BY T.Code, T.Date
UNION ALL
SELECT @Type, T.Code, Name = (SELECT K.Name FROM SalesMan K WHERE K.SalesManCode = T.Code), T.Date, Amt=SUM(T.Amt)
FROM 
	(SELECT Code=S.SManCode, Date= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date)))), Amt= SUM(S.InvTotal)
	FROM SaleLedger S
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
	GROUP BY S.SManCode, LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date))))
	UNION ALL
	SELECT Code=S.SManCode, Date= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date)))), Amt= - SUM(S.InvTotal)
	FROM SRLedger S
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
	GROUP BY S.SManCode, LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date))))) T
WHERE UPPER(@Type)='SALE PERSON'
GROUP BY T.Code, T.Date
UNION ALL
SELECT @Type, T.Code, Name = (SELECT K.Name FROM Accounts K WHERE K.AccCode = T.Code), T.Date, Amt=SUM(T.Amt)
FROM 
	(SELECT Code=S.CustCode, Date= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date)))), Amt= SUM(S.InvTotal)
	FROM SaleLedger S
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
	GROUP BY S.CustCode, LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date))))
	UNION ALL
	SELECT Code=S.CustCode, Date= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date)))), Amt= - SUM(S.InvTotal)
	FROM SRLedger S
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
	GROUP BY S.CustCode, LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date))))) T
WHERE UPPER(@Type)='CUSTOMER'
GROUP BY T.Code, T.Date
UNION ALL
SELECT @Type, T.Code, Name = (SELECT K.Name FROM Area K WHERE K.AreaCode = T.Code), T.Date, Amt=SUM(T.Amt)
FROM 
	(SELECT Code=C.AreaCode, Date= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date)))), Amt= SUM(S.InvTotal)
	FROM SaleLedger S, Customer C
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND S.CustCode = C.CustCode
	GROUP BY C.AreaCode, LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date))))
	UNION ALL
	SELECT Code=C.AreaCode, Date= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date)))), Amt= - SUM(S.InvTotal)
	FROM SRLedger S, Customer C
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND S.CustCode = C.CustCode
	GROUP BY C.AreaCode, LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date))))) T
WHERE UPPER(@Type)='AREA'
GROUP BY T.Code, T.Date
UNION ALL
SELECT @Type, T.Code, Name = (SELECT K.Name FROM SubArea K WHERE K.SubAreaCode = T.Code), T.Date, Amt=SUM(T.Amt)
FROM 
	(SELECT Code=C.SubAreaCode, Date= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date)))), Amt= SUM(S.InvTotal)
	FROM SaleLedger S, Customer C
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND S.CustCode = C.CustCode
	GROUP BY C.SubAreaCode, LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date))))
	UNION ALL
	SELECT Code=C.SubAreaCode, Date= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date)))), Amt= - SUM(S.InvTotal)
	FROM SRLedger S, Customer C
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND S.CustCode = C.CustCode
	GROUP BY C.SubAreaCode, LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date))))) T
WHERE UPPER(@Type)='SUBAREA'
GROUP BY T.Code, T.Date
UNION ALL
SELECT @Type, T.Code, Name = (SELECT K.Name FROM CustomerCategory K WHERE K.CustCatCode = T.Code), T.Date, Amt=SUM(T.Amt)
FROM 
	(SELECT Code=C.CustCatCode, Date= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date)))), Amt= SUM(S.InvTotal)
	FROM SaleLedger S, Customer C
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND S.CustCode = C.CustCode
	GROUP BY C.CustCatCode, LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date))))
	UNION ALL
	SELECT Code=C.CustCatCode, Date= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date)))), Amt= - SUM(S.InvTotal)
	FROM SRLedger S, Customer C
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate AND S.CustCode = C.CustCode
	GROUP BY C.CustCatCode, LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date))))) T
WHERE UPPER(@Type)='CUSTOMER CATEGORY'
GROUP BY T.Code, T.Date
UNION ALL
SELECT @Type, T.Code, Name = (SELECT K.UserName FROM Users K WHERE K.UserCode = T.Code), T.Date, Amt=SUM(T.Amt)
FROM 
	(SELECT Code=S.SalesManCode, Date= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date)))), Amt= SUM(S.InvTotal)
	FROM SaleLedger S
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
	GROUP BY S.SalesManCode, LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date))))
	UNION ALL
	SELECT Code=S.SalesManCode, Date= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date)))), Amt= - SUM(S.InvTotal)
	FROM SRLedger S
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
	GROUP BY S.SalesManCode, LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(S.Date)))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(S.Date))))) T
WHERE UPPER(@Type)='USER'
GROUP BY T.Code, T.Date

-- SP_MONTHLYSALES
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_MONTHLYSALES @ar_startdate datetime, @ar_enddate datetime, @ai_pricetype INT , @ai_returns INT, @ai_bonus INT, @ai_allcust INT, @ai_custcode INT
AS

DELETE ReportData

INSERT INTO ReportData (date1, name1, code1, name2, name3, name4, code2, value1, value2, value3, name5, name6)
SELECT	
	st.Date,
	Name = ic.Name,
	Code = i.icatcode,
	Item = i.name,
	AliasName= i.customicode,
	PackingDesc= i.PackingDesc,
	St.Icode,
	Rate = Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2),
	SaleQty	  =SUM(qty),
	SaleValue =SUM(CASE @ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN value ELSE Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2) * qty END),
	Manfname=(SELECT M.Name FROM Manufacturer M WHERE M.ManfCode = I.ManfCode),
	Customer = CASE WHEN @ai_allcust = 0 THEN (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = @ai_custcode) ELSE 'ALL CUSTOMERS' END
FROM
(SELECT	sd.icode,
	DATE= LTRIM(RTRIM(MONTH(DATE))) + '-01-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(DATENAME(YEAR, DATE))),
	qty = sum(sd.looseqty + CASE @ai_bonus WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE sd.bonusqty END + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
	value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
		(sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd, 
	(select c.custcode from customer c WHERE @ai_allcust = 0 AND C.CustCode = @ai_custcode
	UNION 
	select c.custcode from customer c WHERE @ai_allcust = 1) CS
WHERE 
	sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
	sl.custcode = CS.CustCode AND
	sl.date >= @ar_startdate and sl.date <= @ar_enddate
Group By sd.icode, sl.date
UNION ALL
SELECT	sd.icode,
	DATE= LTRIM(RTRIM(MONTH(DATE))) + '-01-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(DATENAME(YEAR, DATE))),
	qty = sum(sd.looseqty + CASE @ai_bonus WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE sd.bonusqty END),
	value = sum((sd.looseqty) *
		(sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
FROM saleledger sl, saleinvdetail sd, 
	(select c.custcode from customer c WHERE @ai_allcust = 0 AND C.CustCode = @ai_custcode
	UNION 
	select c.custcode from customer c WHERE @ai_allcust = 1) CS
WHERE 
	sl.impactinventory = 'N' AND sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
	sl.custcode = CS.CustCode AND
   sl.date >= @ar_startdate and sl.date <= @ar_enddate
Group By sd.icode, sl.date
UNION ALL
select	sd.icode,
	DATE=LTRIM(RTRIM(MONTH(DATE))) + '-01-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(DATENAME(YEAR, DATE))),
	qty = -sum(sd.looseqty + CASE @ai_bonus WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE sd.bonusqty END + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
	value = -sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
		sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd, 
	(select c.custcode from customer c WHERE @ai_allcust = 0 AND C.CustCode = @ai_custcode
	UNION 
	select c.custcode from customer c WHERE @ai_allcust = 1) CS
WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
	sl.custcode = CS.CustCode AND
	sl.date >= @ar_startdate and sl.date <= @ar_enddate AND
	@ai_returns = 1
Group By sd.icode, sl.date) St, 
	Item i, itemcategory ic
WHERE st.icode = i.icode and i.icatcode = ic.icatcode
GROUP BY St.icode, i.name, i.customicode, st.date, i.icatcode, ic.Name, i.manfcode, i.saleprice, i.packunits, i.PackingDesc
ORDER BY st.date, ic.name, i.icatcode, i.name, i.customicode, St.icode

-- SP_MONTHLYSALESANDSTOCK_ITEMWISE
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_MONTHLYSALESANDSTOCK_ITEMWISE 
	@ar_startdate datetime, 
	@ar_enddate datetime, 
	@ar_icode INT AS    

DECLARE @date1 DATETIME, @date2 DATETIME    
DELETE ReportData    
SELECT @date1=@ar_startdate, @date2=@ar_enddate    

WHILE @date1 <= @date2  
BEGIN   
	INSERT INTO ReportData (date1, date2, code1, name1, name2, value1, value2, code2)
	SELECT     
		date1=CONVERT(DATETIME, LTRIM(RTRIM(MONTH(@date1))) + '-01-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(YEAR(@date1)))),    
		date2=CONVERT(DATETIME, LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN MONTH(@date1) + 1 = 13 THEN 1      ELSE MONTH(@date1) + 1 END)) + '-01-' +      RTRIM(LTRIM(CASE WHEN MONTH(@date1) + 1 = 13 THEN YEAR(@date1) + 1 ELSE      YEAR(@date1) END))),    
		@ar_ICode,    
		customicode,    
		name,    0,    0,    0   
	FROM item   
	WHERE icode=@ar_ICode     

	INSERT INTO ReportData (date1, date2, code1, name1, name2, value1, value2, code2)   
	SELECT     
		date1=CONVERT(DATETIME, LTRIM(RTRIM(MONTH(@date1))) + '-01-' +      LTRIM(RTRIM(YEAR(@date1)))),    date2=CONVERT(DATETIME, LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN MONTH(@date1) + 1 = 13 THEN 1      ELSE MONTH(@date1) + 1 END)) + '-01-' +      RTRIM(LTRIM(CASE WHEN MONTH(@date1) + 1 = 13 THEN YEAR(@date1) + 1 ELSE      YEAR(@date1) END))),    
		@ar_ICode,    
		customicode,    
		name,    0,    0,    1   
	FROM item   
	WHERE icode=@ar_ICode     

	SELECT @date1 = CONVERT(DATETIME, LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN MONTH(@date1) + 1 = 13 THEN 1      ELSE MONTH(@date1) + 1 END)) + '-01-' +      RTRIM(LTRIM(CASE WHEN MONTH(@date1) + 1 = 13 THEN YEAR(@date1) + 1 ELSE      YEAR(@date1) END)))  END    

	UPDATE REPORTDATA  
	SET VALUE1=ISNULL((select sum(netqty)    
		FROM    
			(SELECT ((packqty + bonusqty) * packunits) as netqty    
			from purdetail, purledger    
			where purledger.purcatcode in (1,2) and 
				purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and      
				posted = 'Y' and purdetail.icode=@ar_icode and 
				purledger.date < reportdata.date2    
			union all    
			select (looseqty +  bonusqty) as netqty    
			from purdetail, purledger    
			where purledger.purcatcode in (3,7,8) and      
				purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and 
				posted = 'Y' and purdetail.icode=@ar_icode AND     
				purledger.date < reportdata.date2    
			union all    
			select -(looseqty +  bonusqty) as netqty    
			from prdetail, prledger    
			where prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode and      
				prdetail.icode=@ar_icode and 
				prledger.date < reportdata.date2    
			union all    
			select -(looseqty+bonusqty) as netqty    
			from saledetail, saleledger    
			where saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and 
				due is null and      
				saledetail.icode=@ar_icode and 
				saleledger.date < reportdata.date2    
			union all    
			select (looseqty+bonusqty) as netqty    
			from srdetail, srledger    
			where srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode and      
				srdetail.icode=@ar_icode and 
				srledger.date < reportdata.date2    
			union all    
			select -(duesatisfyqty) as netqty    
			from duesatisfydetail, duesatisfyheader    
			where duesatisfyheader.duesatisfycode = duesatisfydetail.duesatisfycode and      
				duesatisfydetail.icode=@ar_icode and 
				duesatisfyheader.duesatisfydate < reportdata.date2    
			union all    
			select -(qty) as netqty    
			from issuedetail, issueheader    
			where issueheader.issueinvcode = issuedetail.issueinvcode and      
				issuedetail.icode=@ar_icode and 
				issueheader.date < reportdata.date2    
			union all    
			select qty as netqty    
			from receiptdetail, receiptheader    
			where receiptheader.receiptinvcode = receiptdetail.receiptinvcode and      
				posted='Y' and receiptdetail.icode=@ar_icode and      
				receiptheader.date < reportdata.date2    
			union all    
			select case adjcatcode when 1 then looseqty when 2 then -looseqty end as netqty    
			from adjdetail, adjheader    
			where adjheader.adjcode = adjdetail.adjcode and      
				adjdetail.icode=@ar_icode and 
				adjheader.date < reportdata.date2) net), 0),   
		Name3 ='Closing Stock'    
	FROM REPORTDATA  
	WHERE Code2=0    

	UPDATE REPORTDATA
	SET Value1 =ISNULL((SELECT sum(qty)
	FROM
		(SELECT qty= sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits)
		FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND 
			sd.icode=@ar_icode AND     
			sl.date >= reportdata.date1 and sl.date < reportdata.date2
		UNION ALL    
		SELECT qty= sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
		FROM saleledger sl, saleinvdetail sd
		WHERE sl.impactinventory = 'N' AND sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
			sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND 
			sd.icode=@ar_icode AND  
			sl.date >= reportdata.date1 and sl.date < reportdata.date2
		UNION ALL    
		select qty = -sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits)    
		FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd    
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND     
			sd.icode=@ar_icode AND     
			sl.date >= reportdata.date1  and sl.date < reportdata.date2) S), 0),   
			name3 ='Net Sale'    
		from REPORTDATA  
		WHERE Code2=1

-- SP_MONTHLYSALESCLASSWISE
CREATE   PROCEDURE DBO.SP_MONTHLYSALESCLASSWISE 
	@ar_startdate datetime, 
	@ar_enddate datetime, 
	@as_IsActualPrice varchar(1) AS   

DELETE ReportData

INSERT INTO ReportData (date1, name1, code1, name2, name3, code2, value1, value2, value3, name4)
SELECT    st.Date,   Name = ic.Name,   Code = i.iccode,   Item = i.name,   AliasName= i.customicode,   St.Icode,   Rate = Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2),   SaleQty   =SUM(qty),   SaleValue =(Case when @as_IsActualPrice='Y' THEN SUM(value) ELSE SUM(qty)* Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2) end),   I.PackingDesc 
FROM   
	Item i
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT sd.icode,    
		DATE= LTRIM(RTRIM(MONTH(DATE))) + '-01-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(DATENAME(YEAR, DATE))),
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *    sd.saleprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))   
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd   
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND  
        	sl.date >= @ar_startdate and sl.date <= @ar_enddate
		Group By sd.icode, sl.date   
	UNION ALL 
	SELECT sd.icode,    
		DATE= LTRIM(RTRIM(MONTH(DATE))) + '-01-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(DATENAME(YEAR, DATE))),
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty) * sd.saleprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))   
	FROM saleledger sl, saleinvdetail sd   
	WHERE sl.impactinventory = 'N' and sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND  
        	sl.date >= @ar_startdate and sl.date <= @ar_enddate
		Group By sd.icode, sl.date   
	UNION ALL 
		select sd.icode,
		DATE=LTRIM(RTRIM(MONTH(DATE))) + '-01-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(DATENAME(YEAR, DATE))),
		qty = -sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		value = -sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *    sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01)) 
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd   
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
	      sl.date >= @ar_startdate and sl.date <= @ar_enddate   
	Group By sd.icode, sl.date) AS St ON (i.ICode = st.ICode), 
	itemclass ic  
WHERE i.iccode = ic.iccode  
GROUP BY St.icode, 
	i.name,
	i.customicode, 
	st.date, i.iccode, 
	ic.Name,
	i.saleprice,
	i.packunits,
	i.PackingDesc
ORDER BY st.date,
	 ic.name,
	 i.iccode,
	 i.name, i.customicode, 
	 St.icode
update reportdata
set date1=(select max(date1) from reportdata)
where date1 is null

name: SP_MONTHLYSALESSUMMARY

-- SP_MONTHLYSALESSUMMARY
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_MONTHLYSALESSUMMARY 
	@ar_startdate datetime, 
	@ar_enddate datetime, 
	@ReportGrouping CHAR(1), 
	@GroupList VARCHAR(8000) AS
/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of
	months and groups selected depending upon the grouping criteria selected (manfufacture, itemcategory, packing, class wise)

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@ar_startdate, @ar_enddate = Determine the period of report
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items in report
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
*/

DELETE ReportData

DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

INSERT INTO ReportData (name1, name2, code1, Name3, value1)
SELECT
	Name1 = T.Month,
	Name2 = T.GroupName,
	Code1 = T.GroupCode,
	Name3 = T.SaleType,
	Value1 = SUM(T.Value)

FROM
	(SELECT	
		Month=S.MONTH,
		GroupCode=CASE @ReportGrouping 
			WHEN 'M' THEN I.MANFCODE
			WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
			WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
			ELSE I.PACKCODE END,
		GroupName=CASE @ReportGrouping 
			WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
			WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
			WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
			ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,   
		ICode=S.ICode,
		SaleType = (SELECT ST.Name FROM SaleType ST WHERE ST.SaleTypeCode=S.SaleTypeCode),
		Value = SUM(value)
	FROM
		(SELECT	
			sd.icode,
			sl.saletypecode,
			MONTH= DATENAME(MONTH, DATE) + ' ' + DATENAME(YEAR, DATE),
			value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
				sd.saleprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
		FROM 
			saleledger sl, saledetail sd, @TAB_ItemList I
		WHERE 
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
			sl.date >= @ar_startdate and sl.date <= @ar_enddate AND
			sd.icode = I.code
		Group By 
			sd.icode, 
			sl.saletypecode,
			DATENAME(MONTH, DATE) + ' ' + DATENAME(YEAR, DATE)
		UNION ALL
		SELECT	
			sd.icode,
			sl.saletypecode,
			MONTH= DATENAME(MONTH, DATE) + ' ' + DATENAME(YEAR, DATE),
			value = sum((sd.looseqty) *
				sd.saleprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
		FROM 
			saleledger sl, saleinvdetail sd, @TAB_ItemList I
		WHERE 
			sl.impactinventory = 'N' AND
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
			sl.date >= @ar_startdate and sl.date <= @ar_enddate AND
			sd.icode = I.code
		Group By 
			sd.icode, 
			sl.saletypecode,
			DATENAME(MONTH, DATE) + ' ' + DATENAME(YEAR, DATE)
		UNION ALL
		select	
			sd.icode,
			saletypecode=(SELECT s.saletypecode FROM saleledger s where s.saleinvcode = sl.saleinvcode),
			MONTH= DATENAME(MONTH, DATE) + ' ' + DATENAME(YEAR, DATE),
			value = -sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
				sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
		FROM 
			srledger sl, srdetail sd, @TAB_ItemList I
		WHERE 
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
			sl.date >= @ar_startdate and sl.date <= @ar_enddate AND
			sd.icode = I.code
		Group By 
			sd.icode, 
			sl.saleinvcode,
			DATENAME(MONTH, DATE) + ' ' + DATENAME(YEAR, DATE)) S, 
		(SELECT * FROM Item WHERE ICODE IN (SELECT CODE FROM @TAB_ItemList)) I
	WHERE 
		I.icode = S.icode
	GROUP BY
		S.MONTH,
		S.ICODE,
		S.SaleTypeCode,
		I.ICatCode,
		I.ICCode,
		I.ManfCode,
		I.PackCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT	
		MONTH= DATENAME(MONTH, @ar_startdate) + ' ' + DATENAME(YEAR, @ar_startdate),
		GroupCode=K.Code,
		GroupName=CASE @ReportGrouping 
			WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE = K.Code)
			WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE = K.Code)
			WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE = K.Code)
			ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE = K.CODE) END,   
		ICode=0,
		SaleType = NULL,
		Value = 0
	FROM (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_GroupList) K) T
GROUP BY
	T.Month,
	T.GroupName,
	T.GroupCode,
	T.SaleType

-- SP_OpeningBalance
CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_OpeningBalance @AccCode INT, @DateTime DATETIME, @Bal NUMERIC(15, 5) OUTPUT
AS
/*
Author: 
	M.Usman + M.Azhar
Purpose:
	This procedure is used to compute account balance of an account at a 
	given date/time. But if that account is already included in some 
	summary account then it returns a combined balance of all the accounts
	that are included/member of that summary account
PreProcessing:
	First of all it executes SP_VirtualGL (Accounting repository) to accomodate uptodate transactions
*/
BEGIN
	EXECUTE SP_VirtualGL 'A'
	
	SET @BAL = 0

	SET @BAL = 
		ISNULL(
			(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(DEBIT - CREDIT), 0) 
			FROM VIRTUALGL 
			WHERE 
				AccCode IN 
					(SELECT AccCode FROM udf_GetSummaryAccountList(@AccCode)) AND 
				DATE <= @DateTime), 0)
END

definition:
-- SP_OpeningCashInHand
CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_OpeningCashInHand @ad_date datetime, @af_openbalance float out AS

declare @ln_openbalance numeric(12, 2)

create table #lt_CashAmts 
(
	received  numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,
	payed     numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL

)

/************************ All Sale ************************************/
/******************Retail, Whole Sale Cash ******************************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select   received = ISNULL(
		Round(
			SUM(saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * 
				(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * 
				saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((saledetail.looseqty * 
				(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) -
				saleledger.flatdisc) * 
				(saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
		Round(
			SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - 
				saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + 
				saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - 
				saleledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
	 payed    = 0.0

from     saleledger, saledetail  

where    saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and
	 (saleledger.salecatcode = 1   or
	 saleledger.salecatcode = 3   or
	 saleledger.salecatcode = 5) and
	 saleledger.posted = 'Y' and
	 saleledger.date < @ad_date

group by saleledger.saleinvcode,
	 saleledger.salecatcode, 
	 saleledger.date,
	 saleledger.discperc,
	 saleledger.misccharges,
	 saleledger.salestax,
	 saleledger.invgstperc1,
	 saleledger.flatdisc


/************************ All Sale Return ******************************/
/*************Retail Sale Return , Whole Sale Return Cash***************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select  received = 0,
	payed    = ISNULL(
		ROUND(
			SUM(srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
				(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc)) * 
				srdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
				(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) - srledger.flatdisc) * 
				(srledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
		Round(
			SUM( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
			(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) + 
			srledger.misccharges + srledger.salestax - srledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)
from     srledger, 		
	 srdetail  		

where    srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode and
	 (srledger.srcatcode = 6 or
	 srledger.srcatcode = 8) and
	 srledger.posted = 'Y' and
	 srledger.date < @ad_date

group by srledger.srinvcode, 		
	 srledger.srcatcode,
	 srledger.date,		
	 srledger.discperc,
	 srledger.misccharges,
	 srledger.salestax,
	 srledger.invgstperc1,
	 srledger.flatdisc


/**************************** Services *********************************/
/************************** Cash,Retail Services ******************************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select  received = Case 
	  	   When Round(sum((servicedetail.price) * (1 - (.01 * servicedetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * serviceheader.discperc)) + serviceheader.misccharges - serviceheader.flatdisc, 0) IS NULL THEN 0.0
		   Else Round(sum((servicedetail.price) * (1 - (.01 * servicedetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * serviceheader.discperc)) + serviceheader.misccharges - serviceheader.flatdisc, 0)
	 	   End,
	payed    = 0

from     serviceheader LEFT OUTER JOIN servicedetail ON (serviceheader.serviceinvcode = servicedetail.serviceinvcode)

where    serviceheader.servicecatcode IN(10,12) and 
	 serviceheader.posted = 'Y' and

	 serviceheader.date < @ad_date

group by serviceheader.serviceinvcode,
	 serviceheader.servicecatcode,
	 serviceheader.date,
	 serviceheader.discperc,
	 serviceheader.misccharges,
	 serviceheader.flatdisc

/**************************** Services Returns *********************************/
/************************** Cash,Retail Services Returns ******************************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select  received = 0,
	payed    = Case 
	  	   When Round(sum((ServiceRDetail.serviceprice) * (1 - (.01 * ServiceRDetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * ServiceRHeader.discperc)) + ServiceRHeader.misccharges - ServiceRHeader.flatdisc, 0) IS NULL THEN 0.0
		   Else Round(sum((ServiceRDetail.serviceprice) * (1 - (.01 * ServiceRDetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * ServiceRHeader.discperc)) + ServiceRHeader.misccharges - ServiceRHeader.flatdisc, 0)
	 	   End
from     ServiceRHeader LEFT OUTER JOIN ServiceRDetail ON (ServiceRHeader.serviceRinvcode = ServiceRDetail.serviceRinvcode)
where    ServiceRHeader.serviceRcatcode IN(13,15) and 
	 ServiceRHeader.posted = 'Y' and
	 ServiceRHeader.date < @ad_date
group by ServiceRHeader.serviceRinvcode,
	 ServiceRHeader.serviceRcatcode,
	 ServiceRHeader.date,
	 ServiceRHeader.discperc,
	 ServiceRHeader.misccharges,
	 ServiceRHeader.flatdisc

/************************** Purchase Cash *********************************/
/************************** Packs  Purchaes *******************************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select   received = 0,
	 payed    = ISNULL(
		ROUND(
			SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty + purdetail.bonusqty) *
				purdetail.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * 
				purdetail.purprice * (1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)) * 
				purdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM(((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * 
				purdetail.purprice) * (1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) - purledger.flatdisc) * 
				(purledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
		ROUND(
			SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * purdetail.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + 
				purledger.misccharges + purledger.salestax - 
				purledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)
from     purledger,
	 purdetail	

where    purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and
	 purledger.purcatcode = 1 and
	 purledger.posted = 'Y' and
	 purledger.date < @ad_date

group by purledger.purinvcode, 
	 purledger.purcatcode,
	 purledger.date,
	 purledger.discperc,
	 purledger.misccharges,
	 purledger.salestax,
	 purledger.invgstperc1,
	 purledger.flatdisc


/************************** Purchase Cash *********************************/
/************************** Loose  Purchaes *******************************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select   received = 0,
	 payed    = ISNULL(
		ROUND(
			SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty + purdetail.bonusqty) *
				purdetail.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * 
				purdetail.purprice * (1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)) * 
				purdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM(((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * 
				purdetail.purprice) * (1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) - purledger.flatdisc) * 
				(purledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
		ROUND(
			SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty) * purdetail.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + 
				purledger.misccharges + purledger.salestax - 
				purledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)
from     purledger,
	 purdetail	

where    purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and
	 purledger.purcatcode = 7 and
	 purledger.posted = 'Y' and
	 purledger.date < @ad_date

group by purledger.purinvcode, 
	 purledger.purcatcode,
	 purledger.date,
	 purledger.discperc,
	 purledger.misccharges,
	 purledger.salestax,
	 purledger.invgstperc1,
	 purledger.flatdisc


/*********************** Purchase Cash Return *****************************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select   received = ISNULL(
		ROUND(
			SUM((prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.bonusqty) * prdetail.unitsalestax)+
			SUM(ROUND(prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc)) * 
				prdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM((prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice) * 
				(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * prledger.discperc)) - prledger.flatdisc) * 
				(prledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
		ROUND(
			SUM((prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice) * 
				(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * prledger.discperc)) + prledger.misccharges + 
				prledger.salestax - prledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
	payed    = 0

from     prledger, 
	 prdetail		

where    prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode and
	 prledger.prcatcode = 4  and
	 prledger.posted = 'Y' and
	 prledger.date < @ad_date

group by prledger.prinvcode, 
	 prledger.prcatcode, 
	 prledger.date,
	 prledger.discperc,
	 prledger.misccharges,
	 prledger.salestax,
	 prledger.invgstperc1,
	 prledger.flatdisc

/***************** All Accounting Vouchers **************************/

insert #lt_CashAmts
select   received = Case 
			When sum(gldetail.debit) IS Null Then 0
			Else sum(gldetail.debit)
		    End, 
	 payed    = Case 
			When sum(gldetail.credit) IS Null Then 0
			Else sum(gldetail.credit)
		    End	
from     glheader, 
	 gldetail		 	
 where    glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode and
	 glheader.posted = 'Y' and
	 glheader.date < @ad_Date and
	 gldetail.acccode IN (Select accounts.acccode from accounts where accounts.subcode = (select code from global where lower(name) = lower('GT_CashSub') ) )
/**************************************************************************/
select @ln_openbalance =( select case 
				  when sum(received) - sum(payed) IS NULL then 0.0

				  else sum(received) - sum(payed)
				 end
			  from   #lt_CashAmts )

select @af_openbalance = (Select Convert(float, @ln_openbalance))

/*drop table #lt_CashAmts*/

-- sp_OtherAccTransactionStatus

CREATE PROCEDURE sp_OtherAccTransactionStatus @ad_date datetime ,@ad_ldate datetime,@ai_subacccode smallint AS

create table #lt_pvamts 
(
	debit  numeric (15, 2) NOT NULL,
	credit numeric (15, 2) NOT NULL,
	code   numeric (5,0) NOT NULL,
	name varchar(50) NOT NULL
)

/**************************** Any Acccounting Transactions ********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select  IsNull( sum(gldetail.debit), 0),
        IsNull( sum(gldetail.credit), 0),
        custcode=gldetail.acccode	,
	name=(select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode=gldetail.acccode)
	 
from     glheader, gldetail , accounts 
where    glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode and 
 	 glheader.date < @ad_date  and
	 glheader.posted = 'Y' and
         gldetail.acccode NOT IN (select custcode from customer) and
	 gldetail.acccode NOT IN (select suppcode from supplier) and
	 gldetail.acccode=accounts.acccode and
	 accounts.subCode=@ai_subacccode
GROUP BY gldetail.acccode	 


/******************************* Any Bills Receivables ***********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select  0,
        IsNull( sum(notes.amount), 0),
        custcode=notes.acccode,
        name=(select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode=notes.acccode)
    
	 
from     notes,accounts
where    notes.notecatcode = 1 and

	 notes.posted = 'Y' and
	 notes.postdate < @ad_date  and
	  notes.acccode NOT IN (select custcode from customer) and
	 notes.acccode NOT IN (select suppcode from supplier) and
	 notes.acccode=accounts.acccode and
	 accounts.subCode= @ai_subacccode 
GROUP BY notes.acccode

/******** Collecting the result and assigning to the relevent reference variable *********/

delete from reportdata
insert into reportdata(code1,name1,value1,value2,value3)
select code,name,IsNull(sum(debit) - sum(credit),0),0,0
	from   #lt_pvamts 
	group by name,
                 code 



update 	reportdata
set 	name1=accounts.name
from 	accounts,reportdata

where	reportdata.name1 IS Null and
	reportdata.code1=accounts.acccode

delete from #lt_pvamts

/*-----------------------------For Transactions Within The Period----------------*/
/*===============================================================================*/



/**************************** Any Acccounting Transactions ********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select  IsNull( sum(gldetail.debit), 0),
        IsNull( sum(gldetail.credit), 0),
        custcode=gldetail.acccode	,

	name=(select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode=gldetail.acccode)
 
from     glheader, gldetail ,accounts 
where    glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode and 
 	 glheader.date >= @ad_date  and
	 glheader.date <= @ad_ldate  and
	 glheader.posted = 'Y' and
         gldetail.acccode NOT IN (select custcode from customer) and
	 gldetail.acccode NOT IN (select suppcode from supplier) and
	 gldetail.acccode=accounts.acccode and
	 accounts.subCode= @ai_subacccode

GROUP BY gldetail.acccode	 

/******************************* Any Bills Receivables ***********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select  0,
        IsNull( sum(notes.amount), 0),
        custcode=notes.acccode,
        name=(select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode=notes.acccode)
    
	 
from     notes,accounts
where    notes.notecatcode = 1 and

	 notes.posted = 'Y' and
	 notes.postdate >= @ad_date  and
         notes.postdate <= @ad_ldate  and
	 notes.acccode NOT IN (select custcode from customer) and
	 notes.acccode NOT IN (select suppcode from supplier) and
	 notes.acccode=accounts.acccode and
	 accounts.subCode=@ai_subacccode  
GROUP BY notes.acccode



/******** Collecting the result and assigning to the relevent reference variable *********/


update reportdata

set value2=A.ddebit,value3=A.dcredit

from

(select code,name,ddebit=IsNull(sum(debit) ,0),dcredit=IsNull(sum(credit),0)
	from   #lt_pvamts 
	group by name,
                 code) as A


where reportdata.code1=A.code
 
drop table #lt_pvamts

CREATE PROCEDURE sp_PatientOpeningBalance @al_PatientCode INT, @ad_edate datetime, @af_openbalance NUMERIC(15,5) OUT AS 
/*
	Two Parameters:-

	V.Date < @ad_edate), 0)

definition:
-- SP_PerformSchoolLeaving
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_PerformSchoolLeaving @StudentCode INT, @ClassCode INT, @UserCode SMALLINT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @errcode INT, @InvCount INT, @ServiceRInvCode INT, @ServiceInvCode INT, @Unpostedtrans INT, @SRAllocationCode INT
DECLARE @tot_services INT, @ResultCode INT, @ServiceCode INT, @start_no INT, @end_no INT
DECLARE @RowId INT, @In_RowID INT, @In_Qty INT, @TmpCode INT
DECLARE @msg VARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @Date DATETIME
DECLARE @SR_Balance NUMERIC(15,2), @SVC_Balance NUMERIC(15,2), @amt NUMERIC(15,2), @New_Service_Balance NUMERIC(15,2), @New_SR_Balance NUMERIC(15,2)
DECLARE @svc TABLE 
	(ServiceInvCode INT, RowID INT IDENTITY(1, 1))

IF @UserCode IS NULL
	SET @UserCode = 1

SET @InvCount = ISNULL((SELECT Count(ServiceInvCode) FROM ServiceHeader WHERE StudentCode = @StudentCode AND OutstandingAmt > 0), 0)

INSERT INTO @svc (ServiceInvCode)
SELECT DISTINCT ServiceInvCode
FROM ServiceHeader
WHERE StudentCode = @StudentCode AND OutstandingAmt > 0

SET @InvCount = @@RowCount
IF @InvCount > 0
BEGIN
	SET @errcode = 0
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'ServiceRHeader' , @start_no OUTPUT
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Fetching Service Return Header Value', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @RowID = 1

	WHILE @RowID <= @InvCount
	BEGIN
		SET @Date = GETDATE()
		SET @ServiceRInvCode = @start_no + @RowID 
		SET @end_no = @ServiceRInvCode
		SET @ServiceInvCode = (SELECT ServiceInvCode FROM @svc WHERE RowID = @RowID)

		INSERT INTO ServiceRHeader (ServiceRInvCode, ServiceInvCode, CustCode, SalesmanCode, ServiceRCatCode, Remarks,
			OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, Date, PostedBy, PostDate, HeaderNo, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, 
			SaleInvCode, Posted, DoctCode, PatientCode, AdmissionCode, 
			CashAccCode, CashTendered, CashCharged, CashBack, InvTotal, GuestCode, GuestCheckInCode, StudentCode,
			OutstandingAmt, Marked)
		SELECT @ServiceRInvCode, ServiceInvCode, CustCode, SalesmanCode, ServiceRCatCode=CASE WHEN ServiceCatCode = 10 THEN 13 ELSE 14 END, 
			Remarks='Return Against Service Inv. ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(ServiceInvCode AS VARCHAR(10)))) + ' On School Leaving',
			OriginalDate=@Date, ModifiedBy=NULL, Date=@Date, PostedBy=@UserCode, PostDate=@Date, HeaderNo, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, 
			SaleInvCode, Posted='Y', DoctCode, PatientCode, AdmissionCode, 
			CashAccCode, CashTendered=0, CashCharged=0, CashBack=0, InvTotal, GuestCode, GuestCheckInCode, StudentCode,
			OutstandingAmt, Marked='N'
		FROM ServiceHeader 
		WHERE ServiceInvCode IN (SELECT ServiceInvCode FROM @svc WHERE RowID = @RowID)
	
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@RowCount <=0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Problem while Inserting Service Purchase Invoice Header Value', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
		INSERT INTO ServiceRDetail (ServiceRInvCode, ServiceCode, ServicePrice, DiscPerc, SManCode, Qty, 
			SrvRowID, Commission, CostPrice, ServiceFlatDisc)
		SELECT @ServiceRInvCode, ServiceCode, ServicePrice=Price, DiscPerc, SManCode, Qty, 
			SrvRowID, Commission, CostPrice, ServiceFlatDisc
		FROM ServiceDetail
		WHERE ServiceInvCode IN (SELECT ServiceInvCode FROM @svc WHERE RowID = @RowID)
		ORDER BY SRVRowID
	
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT <= 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Problem while Inserting Service Return Detail Rows', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END

		UPDATE ServiceRHeader 
		SET InvTotal = DBO.fn_getServiceReturnInvTotal(ServiceRInvCode)
		WHERE ServiceRInvCode = @ServiceRInvCode
		
		UPDATE ServiceRHeader 
		SET OutStandingAmt = InvTotal
		WHERE ServiceRInvCode = @ServiceRInvCode

		EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockServiceSRInvoice @ServiceRInvCode
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Problem while Locking Service Return Invoice : %d', 16, 1, @ServiceRInvCode)
			RETURN -1
		END

		EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockServiceInvoice @ServiceInvCode
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Problem while Locking Service Invoice : %d', 16, 1, @ServiceInvCode)
			RETURN -1
		END

		EXECUTE @errcode = SP_CheckUnpostedServiceInvInTransactions @ServiceInvCode, NULL, 'SR', @Unpostedtrans OUT, @msg OUT
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Unposted Transactions exists for Service Invoice : %d', 16, 1, @ServiceInvCode)
			RETURN -1
		END

		IF @Unpostedtrans = 0
		BEGIN
			EXECUTE @errcode = SP_GetServiceSRInvBalance @ServiceRInvCode, @SR_Balance OUT
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
			BEGIN
				RaisError('Problem while Fetching Service Return Invoice Balance : %d', 16, 1, @ServiceRInvCode)
				RETURN -1
			END

			IF @SR_Balance > 0
			BEGIN
				EXECUTE @errcode = SP_GetServiceInvBalance @ServiceInvCode, @SVC_Balance OUT
				IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
				BEGIN
					RaisError('Problem while Fetching Service Invoice Balance : %d', 16, 1, @ServiceInvCode)
					RETURN -1
				END

				IF @SVC_Balance > 0
				BEGIN
					IF @SVC_Balance <= @SR_Balance
						SET @amt = @SVC_Balance
					ELSE
						SET @amt = @SR_Balance

					SET @New_Service_Balance = @SVC_Balance - @amt
					SET @New_SR_Balance = @SR_Balance - @amt

					EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateServiceSRInvBalance @ServiceRInvCode, @New_SR_Balance
					IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
					BEGIN
						RaisError('Problem while Updating Service Return Invoice Balance For Ret #: %d', 16, 1, @ServiceRInvCode)
						RETURN -1
					END

					EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateServiceInvBalance @ServiceInvCode, @New_Service_Balance
					IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
					BEGIN
						RaisError('Problem while Updating Service Invoice Balance for Inv : %d', 16, 1, @ServiceInvCode)
						RETURN -1
					END

					EXECUTE @errcode = SP_CreateServiceSRAllocation @ServiceRInvCode, @ServiceInvCode, @Date, @UserCode, 'Y', @Date, @SVC_Balance, @Amt, @SRAllocationCode OUT
					IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
					BEGIN
						RaisError('Problem while Updating Service Invoice Balance for Inv : %d', 16, 1, @ServiceInvCode)
						RETURN -1
					END
				END
			END
		END

		SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
	END

	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'ServiceRHeader' , @end_no
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Problem while Updating Service Return Key Value', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	
END

DELETE DBO.StudentClass WHERE StudentCode = @StudentCode AND ClassCode = @ClassCode

UPDATE Student SET Status='L' WHERE StudentCode = @StudentCode

EXECUTE SP_VirtualGL 'A'

RETURN 0

CREATE Procedure sp_POList_From_DropBox @SRV VARCHAR(50), @DB VARCHAR(50), @OWNER VARCHAR(20), @SiteCode INT AS
/*
Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Comments:ResultSet from this query is used in the definition of datawindow.
*/
Set ANSI_NULLS ON /*As query in this sp is used for Distributed/Heterogeneous databases*/
Set ANSI_WARNINGS ON
Declare @Query VarChar(2000), @Prefix VARCHAR(4000)

SET @Prefix=''
IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SRV))) = 0 OR @SRV IS NULL) 
	SET @Prefix = ''
ELSE
	SET @Prefix = @SRV + '.' 

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DB))) = 0 OR @DB IS NULL)
	SET @Prefix = @Prefix
ELSE
	SET @Prefix = @Prefix + @DB + '.'

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@OWNER))) = 0 OR @OWNER IS NULL)
	SET @Prefix = @Prefix + 'DBO' + '.'
ELSE
	SET @Prefix = @Prefix + @OWNER + '.'

Set @Query = 'Select SiteCode, Site=(SELECT Site.Name + SPACE(1) + CHAR(45) + SPACE(1) + InstanceID FROM Site WHERE Site.Sitecode = T.SiteCode), T.POCode, T.Date, T.Remarks, T.PurOrderCatCode, T.CustCode From  ' + @Prefix +  'DB_PurOrderHeader AS T WHERE T.TargetSiteCode = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@SiteCode))) + ' AND T.Pulled = ''N'''

Execute (@Query)
Return 1

name: sp_Post_SaleReturn_BillSummary
definition:
-- sp_Post_SaleReturn_BillSummary
CREATE  PROCEDURE sp_Post_SaleReturn_BillSummary
	@SRBufferInvCode Int, 
	@UserCode Int,
	@BillSumm CHAR(1)
As
Declare @saleinvcode INT, @utn INT, @RowID INT
Declare @priority SMALLINT
Declare @ICode Int, @GCode Int, @packunits Int, @TotalPieces INT, @PiecesInHand INT
Declare @LooseQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @BonusQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @TotalQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @CurrQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @BatchQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @ReqQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @NewQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @total_availablestock NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @Price Numeric(12,2), @PurPrice Numeric(12,2), @SalePrice Numeric(12,2), @RecentPurPrice Numeric(12,2), @NewAvgPrice NUMERIC(15,5), @DiscPerc NUMERIC(5,2)
Declare @batch VarChar(100), @ItemName VarChar(100), @AvgPrice Numeric(15,5)
Declare @Items_Rows Int, @Counter Int, @RowCount Int, @TotalRows Int, @continue Int, @Err Int, @rt_code Int 
Declare @expiry DateTime
DECLARE @UpdActMon CHAR(1)
/*
Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Purpose:This Stored Procedure takes an argument of Sale Return Code (@SRBufferInvCode)
	and update stock of that sale return.
*/
Set @continue = 0
Set @priority = 10

Declare Cursor_Items Cursor Forward_Only Static
FOR	
SELECT 
	RD.ICode, RD.Gcode, RD.Batch, RD.Expiry, RD.LooseQty, 
	RD.BonusQty, RD.PackUnits, RD.SRPrice, RD.DiscPerc, 
	RD.TotalPieces, RD.PiecesInHand, RD.RowID, I.Name
FROM 
	SRBufferLedger R, 
	SRBufferDetail RD, 
	Item I
Where  
	R.SRBufferInvCode = @SRBufferInvCode AND
	R.RetViaBillSummary = @BillSumm AND
	R.SRBufferInvCode = RD.SRBufferInvCode AND
	RD.ICode = I.ICode
ORDER BY 
	R.SRBufferInvCode,
	RD.RowID

OPEN Cursor_Items
SET @Items_Rows = @@Cursor_Rows
IF @Items_Rows <= 0 
BEGIN
	RaisError( 'Unable to fetch sale return invoice : %d' , 16, 1, @SRBufferInvCode )
	Close Cursor_Items
	Deallocate Cursor_Items
	RETURN -1
END

FETCH NEXT FROM Cursor_Items
INTO @ICode, @Gcode, @Batch, @Expiry, @LooseQty, @BonusQty, @PackUnits, @Price, @DiscPerc, @TotalPieces, @PiecesInHand, @RowID, @ItemName

WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
BEGIN
	Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @utn OutPut
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	Begin
		RaisError( 'Error occured in fetching utn ' ,16,1)
		Close Cursor_Items
		Deallocate Cursor_Items
		RETURN -1
	End

	EXECUTE @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @AvGPrice OutPut
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError( 'Error occured in Fetching Avg Price for Item : %s' ,16,1,  @ItemName)
		Close Cursor_Items
		Deallocate Cursor_Items
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF @Batch <> 'due'
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE @rt_code = SP_IsActiveItem @ICode
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <  0
		BEGIN
			RaisError( 'Error occured in fetching item status for active Y/N, Item Name : %s' ,16,1,  @ItemName)
			Close Cursor_Items
			Deallocate Cursor_Items
			RETURN -1
		END

		IF @rt_code = 0
		BEGIN
			EXECUTE @rt_code = SP_SetItemActiveStatus @ICode, 1
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
			BEGIN
				RaisError( 'Error occured in marking item status as active, Item Name : %s' ,16,1,  @ItemName)
				Close Cursor_Items
				Deallocate Cursor_Items
				RETURN -1
			END
		END

		SET @packunits = Case When @packunits Is Null Then 1 When @packunits = 0 Then 1 Else @packunits End
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemStockAll @ICode, @total_availablestock OutPut

		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @currqty Output
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
		Begin
			RaisError( 'Error occured in fetching batch wise item stock details for Item Name : %s' ,16,1,  @ItemName)
			Close Cursor_Items
			Deallocate Cursor_Items
			RETURN -1
		End 

		Set @newqty = @currqty + @looseqty + @BonusQty
		Execute @rt_code = sp_UpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
		Begin
			RaisError( 'Error occured in Updating batch wise item stock details for Item Name : %s' ,16,1,  @ItemName)
			Close Cursor_Items
			Deallocate Cursor_Items
			RETURN -1
		End
	END

	Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemTotalPiecesInHand @icode, @piecesinhand
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
	Begin
		RaisError( 'Error occured in Fetching item wise pieces in hand details for Item Name : %s' ,16,1,  @ItemName)
		Close Cursor_Items
		Deallocate Cursor_Items
		RETURN -1
	End

	Execute @rt_code = sp_UpdateItemTotalPiecesInHand @icode, 1 , @totalpieces
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
	Begin
		RaisError( 'Error occured in updating item wise pieces in hand details for Item Name : %s' ,16,1,  @ItemName)
		Close Cursor_Items
		Deallocate Cursor_Items
		RETURN -1
	End

	UPDATE SRBufferDetail 
	SET CurrStock=@total_availablestock, AvgPrice = @AvGPrice, SRUtn = @utn, PiecesInHand = @piecesinhand
	WHERE SRBufferInvCode = @SRBufferInvCode AND RowID = @RowID

	Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
	IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
	Begin 
		RaisError( 'Error occured in updating Sale Return Detail of S/R Code : %d' ,16,1,  @SRBufferInvCode)
		Close Cursor_Items
		Deallocate Cursor_Items
		RETURN -1
	End 							

	Fetch Next From Cursor_Items
	Into @ICode, @Gcode, @Batch, @Expiry, @LooseQty, @BonusQty, @PackUnits, @Price, @DiscPerc, @TotalPieces, @PiecesInHand, @RowID, @ItemName
End

Close Cursor_Items
Deallocate Cursor_Items

UPDATE SRBufferLedger
SET Posted='Y', PostDate=GETDATE(), PostedBY=@UserCode 
WHERE SRBufferInvCode = @SRBufferInvCode AND Posted='N' AND RetViaBillSummary=@BillSumm
Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
Begin 
	RaisError( 'Error occured in updation of Sale Return Posting Status, S/R Code : %d' ,16,1,  @SRBufferInvCode)
	RETURN -1
End 							

INSERT INTO SRLedger (SRInvCode, SaleInvCode, Date, SRCatCode, CustCode, SalesmanCode, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, Posted, PostDate, Remarks, SalesTax, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, HeaderNo, InvGSTPerc1, SMANCode, CustRefNo, CustRefNo2, CustRefNo3, CustRefNo4, PatientCode, MachineName, HeaderInvNo, AdmissionCode, InvTotal, AccountFor, PaymentMode, PaymentAccCode, Amt, AmtBy, AmtDate, AmtReference, OutstandingAmt, Marked, PageSize, ReprintingCounter, DoctCode, ConsiderInPO, CashAccCode, CashTendered, CashCharged, CashBack, RetViaBillSummary)
SELECT SRBufferInvCode, SaleInvCode, Date, SRCatCode, CustCode, SalesmanCode, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, Posted, PostDate, Remarks, SalesTax, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, HeaderNo, InvGSTPerc1, SMANCode, CustRefNo, CustRefNo2, CustRefNo3, CustRefNo4, PatientCode, MachineName, HeaderInvNo, AdmissionCode, InvTotal, AccountFor, PaymentMode, PaymentAccCode, Amt, AmtBy, AmtDate, AmtReference, OutstandingAmt, Marked, PageSize, ReprintingCounter=0, DoctCode=NULL, ConsiderInPO='Y', CashAccCode, CashTendered, CashCharged, CashBack, RetViaBillSummary
FROM SRBufferLedger
WHERE SRBufferInvCode = @SRBufferInvCode AND RetViaBillSummary = @BillSumm

Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
Begin 
	RaisError( 'Error occured in Inserting Sale Return Buffer Record into Sales Return Ledger For S/R Code : %d' ,16,1,  @SRBufferInvCode)
	RETURN -1
End 							

INSERT INTO SRDetail (SRInvCode, ICode, GCode, Batch, Expiry, PackQty, LooseQty, PackUnits, SRPrice, DiscPerc, SalesTax, AvgPrice, UnitSalesTax, GSTPerc, SRUTN, BonusQty, SaleRowID, ReturnItemDescription, TotalPieces, PiecesInHand, CurrStock)
SELECT SRBufferInvCode, ICode, GCode, Batch, Expiry, PackQty, LooseQty, PackUnits, SRPrice, DiscPerc, SalesTax, AvgPrice, UnitSalesTax, GSTPerc, SRUTN, BonusQty, SaleRowID, ReturnItemDescription, TotalPieces, PiecesInHand, CurrStock
FROM SRBufferDetail
WHERE SRBufferInvCode = @SRBufferInvCode

Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
Begin 
	RaisError( 'Error occured in Inserting Sale Return Buffer Detail Record into Sales Return Detail Ledger For S/R Code : %d' ,16,1,  @SRBufferInvCode)
	RETURN -1
End 							

SET @saleinvcode = (SELECT SaleInvCode FROM SRBufferLedger WHERE RetViaBillSummary = @BillSumm AND SRBufferInvCode = @SRBufferInvCode)
IF @saleinvcode > 0 
BEGIN
	Update Saleledger 
	SET returncounter=returncounter + 1 
	WHERE saleinvcode= @saleinvcode

	Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
	IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
	Begin 
		RaisError( 'Error occured in updating Sale Invoice For Return Counter, Sale Inv. Code : %d' ,16,1,  @SaleInvCode)
		RETURN -1
	End 							
END

Set @UpdActMon = (SELECT a=DBO.fn_GetPreference('IncSRInActMonitor'))
IF UPPER(@UpdActMon) = 'Y'
BEGIN
	Execute @rt_code = SP_UpdateActivityMonitor 'SR', @SRBufferInvCode
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
	Begin 
		RaisError( 'Error occured in updating Activity Monitor For Sale Return Code : %d' ,16,1,  @SRBufferInvCode)
		Close Cursor_Items
		Deallocate Cursor_Items
		RETURN -1
	End 							
END
Return 0

name: sp_PostBillSummary
definition:
-- sp_PostBillSummary
CREATE  Procedure sp_PostBillSummary
	@BillSummCode1 INT, 
	@BillSummCode2 INT,
	@UserCode INT,
	@BillSumm CHAR(1)
As
DECLARE @BillSummToPost INT, @TotRows INT, @BillSummaryCode INT, @SRBufferInvCode INT, @SRInvCode INT, @SRAllocationCode INT
DECLARE @Err INT, @rt_code INT, @SaleInvCode INT, @ReturnSaleInvoice INT, @RowID INT
DECLARE @CashAmt NUMERIC(15,2), @ChequeAmt NUMERIC(15,2), @DebitNoteAmt NUMERIC(15,2), @CreditNoteAmt NUMERIC(15,2)
DECLARE @SaleInvBalance NUMERIC(15,2), @ReturnAmt NUMERIC(15,2), @NewBalance NUMERIC(15,2)
/*
Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Purpose:This Stored Procedure takes arguments :-
	@BillSummCode1 = Starting Bill Summary
	@BillSummCode2 = Ending Bill Summary
	@UserCode 		= User Initiating Posting
*/
CREATE TABLE #ReturnList (BillSummaryCode INT, SaleInvCode INT, SRInvCode INT, RowID INT Identity(1,1))

SET @BillSummToPost = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(B.BillSummaryCode) FROM BillSummary B WITH (UPDLOCK HOLDLOCK) WHERE B.BillSummaryCode BETWEEN @BillSummCode1 AND @BillSummCode2 AND  B.Posted ='N' AND B.Finalized = 'Y'), 0)

IF @BillSummToPost > 0 
BEGIN
	EXECUTE @rt_code = sp_Generate_BillSummary_Vouchers @BillSummCode1, @BillSummCode2, @UserCode
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
	Begin
		DROP TABLE #ReturnList
		RETURN -1
	End

	Declare C_BSR Cursor Forward_Only Static
	FOR	
	SELECT DISTINCT 
		B.BillSummaryCode, D.SaleInvCode, D.SRBufferInvCode
	FROM 
		BillSummary B, BillSummaryDetail D, SRBufferLedger SR
	Where  
		B.BillSummaryCode BETWEEN @BillSummCode1 AND @BillSummCode2 AND 
		B.Posted ='N' AND B.Finalized = 'Y' AND 
		B.BillSummaryCode = D.BillSummaryCode AND
		D.SRBufferInvCode IS NOT NULL AND 
		SR.Posted = 'N' AND
		SR.SRBufferInvCode = D.SRBufferInvCode AND
		SR.RetViaBillSummary = @BillSumm
	ORDER BY 
		B.BillSummaryCode,
		D.SRBufferInvCode
	
	OPEN C_BSR 
	SET @TotRows = @@Cursor_Rows
	IF @TotRows <= 0 
	BEGIN
		Close C_BSR
		Deallocate C_BSR
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM C_BSR
		INTO @BillSummaryCode, @SaleInvCode, @SRBufferInvCode
		
		WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
		BEGIN
			EXECUTE @rt_code = sp_Post_SaleReturn_BillSummary @SRBufferInvCode, @UserCode, @BillSumm
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
			Begin
				RAISERROR('Error occured in Posting sales return code : %d, Bill Summary Code: %d' ,16,1,  @SRBufferInvCode, @BillSummaryCode)
				Close C_BSR
				Deallocate C_BSR
				DROP TABLE #ReturnList
				RETURN -1
			End
			INSERT INTO #ReturnList (BillSummaryCode, SaleInvCode, SRInvCode) VALUES (@BillSummaryCode, @SaleInvCode, @SRBufferInvCode)

			Fetch Next From C_BSR
			Into @BillSummaryCode, @SaleInvCode, @SRBufferInvCode
		End
		Close C_BSR
		Deallocate C_BSR
	END

	UPDATE BillSummary 
	SET Posted='Y', PostedBY = @UserCode, PostDate=GETDATE()
	WHERE BillSummaryCode BETWEEN @BillSummCode1 AND @BillSummCode2 AND  
		Posted ='N' AND Finalized = 'Y'
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@RowCount = 0 
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Error occured in Posting of Bill Summary Range: [%d TO %d]' ,16,1,  @BillSummCode1, @BillSummCode2)
		DROP TABLE #ReturnList
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @RowID = 1
	SET @TotRows = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #ReturnList)
	IF @TotRows > 0 
	BEGIN
		WHILE @RowID <= @TotRows
		BEGIN
			SET @BillSummaryCode = (SELECT BillSummaryCode FROM #ReturnList WHERE RowID=@RowID)
			SET @SaleInvCode = (SELECT SaleInvCode FROM #ReturnList WHERE RowID=@RowID)
			SET @SRInvCode = (SELECT SRInvCode FROM #ReturnList WHERE RowID=@RowID)
			SET @ReturnSaleInvoice = (SELECT SaleInvCode FROM SRLedger WHERE SRInvCode = @SRInvCode)
	
			IF @BillSummaryCode > 0 AND @SRInvCode > 0 AND @SaleInvCode > 0 AND @SaleInvCode = @ReturnSaleInvoice 
			BEGIN
				EXECUTE @rt_code = SP_AllocateSaleReturn @SRInvCode, @SaleInvCode, @UserCode, @SRAllocationCode OUTPUT
				IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
				Begin
					RAISERROR('Error occured while allocating Sale Return Invoice: %d, against Sales Invoice: %d on Posting of Bill Summary: %d' ,16,1, @SRInvCode, @SaleInvCode, @BillSummaryCode)
					DROP TABLE #ReturnList
					RETURN -1
				End
			END
			SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
		END
	END
End

DROP TABLE #ReturnList
Return 0

-- sp_PostedPurAndReturnCategoryWise
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_PostedPurAndReturnCategoryWise  @ad_date datetime ,@ad_ldate datetime AS

/* Delete Rows from table 'reportdata' */
DELETE FROM reportdata

/* calculate results and populate them in table 'reportdata' */
INSERT INTO reportdata(code1,name1,value1,value2, value4, value5)
SELECT	A.icatcode,
	catname =(SELECT name FROM itemcategory WHERE icatcode=A.icatcode),
	purvalue=(SELECT ISNULL( SUM(ROUND(((PD.looseqty + PD.packqty ) * PD.purprice ) * 
			(1 - (.01 *  PD.discperc)),2))  ,0)
		 FROM purdetail PD, purledger PL, item I
		 WHERE 	PL.date between @ad_date and @ad_ldate and
			PL.posted='Y' and
       			PL.purinvcode=PD.purinvcode and
		 	PD.icode=I.icode AND
		 	I.icatcode=A.icatcode),
	prvalue =(SELECT ISNULL( SUM(ROUND(((PRD.looseqty + PRD.packqty ) * PRD.prprice ) * (1 - (.01 *  PRD.discperc)),2))  ,0)
		 FROM prdetail PRD, prledger PRL, item I
		 WHERE PRL.date between @ad_date and @ad_ldate and
			PRL.posted='Y' and
       			PRL.prinvcode=PRD.prinvcode and
		 	PRD.icode=I.icode AND
		 	I.icatcode=A.icatcode),
	pursalevalue=(SELECT ISNULL( SUM(ROUND(((PD.looseqty + (PD.packqty * PD.packunits) ) *
			(PD.saleprice / 
				CASE PD.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE PD.packunits END)), 2))  ,0)
		 FROM purdetail PD, purledger PL, item I
		 WHERE 	PL.date between @ad_date and @ad_ldate and
			PL.posted='Y' and
       			PL.purinvcode=PD.purinvcode and
		 	PD.icode=I.icode AND
		 	I.icatcode=A.icatcode),
	prsalevalue =(SELECT ISNULL( SUM(ROUND(((PRD.looseqty + PRD.packqty ) * 
			(PRD.packsaleprice / 
				CASE PRD.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE PRD.packunits END)),2))  ,0)
		 FROM prdetail PRD, prledger PRL, item I
		 WHERE PRL.date between @ad_date and @ad_ldate and
			PRL.posted='Y' and
       			PRL.prinvcode=PRD.prinvcode and
		 	PRD.icode=I.icode AND
		 	I.icatcode=A.icatcode)
FROM 	(SELECT DISTINCT (item.icatcode) AS icatcode FROM purdetail,purledger,item 
	WHERE purledger.date between @ad_date and @ad_ldate and
	    purledger.purinvcode=purdetail.purinvcode and
	    purdetail.icode=item.icode   
	UNION
	SELECT DISTINCT (item.icatcode) as icatcode from prdetail,prledger,item 
        WHERE prledger.date between @ad_date and @ad_ldate and
	    prledger.prinvcode=prdetail.prinvcode and
	    prdetail.icode=item.icode) as A

/* update table 'reportdata' for net purchase value */
update reportdata
set     value3 = value1 - value2	

commit

-- sp_PostEmployeeAdvance
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_PostEmployeeAdvance 
	@ai_StartCode integer, 
	@ai_EndCode integer, 
	@ai_UserCode integer
AS    
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @RC INT, @RowID INT, @TotRows INT, @AdvanceCode INT, @ai_vochcatcode int, @ai_acccode int, @ad_date datetime
DECLARE @ai_salesmancode int, @as_posted char(1), @ad_postdate datetime, @as_remarks varchar(100)
DECLARE @ad_originaldate datetime, @ai_modifiedby int, @ai_postedby int, @as_chkno varchar(60), @ai_dr_acccode int
DECLARE @ai_cr_acccode int, @an_amount numeric(15,2), @as_chkno_detail varchar(60), @as_remarks_detail varchar(100)
DECLARE @ai_patientcode int, @ai_guestcode int, @ai_studentcode int, @ai_invoicecode int, @an_outstandingamt numeric(15,2)
DECLARE @an_balance numeric(15,2), @GlVochCode int, @VochCode int, @SMANCode smallint

CREATE TABLE #lt_list (Code INT NOT NULL, ROWID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1))

INSERT INTO #lt_list (Code)
SELECT AdvanceCode
FROM DBO.Emp_Advance
WHERE Posted = 'N' AND AdvanceCode BETWEEN @ai_StartCode AND @ai_EndCode

SET @RowID = 1
SET @TotRows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #lt_list), 0)

WHILE @RowID <= @TotRows
BEGIN
	SET @AdvanceCode = (SELECT Code FROM #lt_list WHERE RowID = @RowID)

	SELECT	@as_posted = 'Y', @ai_vochcatcode = 5, @ai_acccode = 2, @ai_vochcatcode = 5, @ai_acccode = 2, 
		@ad_date = Date, @ad_postdate = Date, @as_remarks = Remarks, @ad_originaldate = Date, 
		@ai_modifiedby = NULL, @ai_postedby = NULL, @as_chkno = RefNo, 
		@ai_dr_acccode = empadvacccode, @ai_cr_acccode = AccCode, 
		@an_amount = Amount, @as_chkno_detail = RefNo, @as_remarks_detail = Remarks,
		@ai_patientcode = NULL, @ai_guestcode = NULL, @ai_studentcode = NULL, 
		@ai_invoicecode = NULL, @an_outstandingamt = 0.00, @an_balance = 0.00, @SMANCode = NULL, @ai_salesmancode=@ai_UserCode,
		@GlVochCode = NULL, @VochCode = NULL
	FROM DBO.Emp_Advance
	WHERE AdvanceCode = @AdvanceCode AND Posted='N'

	EXECUTE @RC = SP_CreateVoucher @ai_vochcatcode, @ai_acccode, @ad_date, @ai_salesmancode, @as_posted, @ad_postdate, @as_remarks, @ad_originaldate, @ai_modifiedby, @ai_postedby, @as_chkno, @ai_dr_acccode, @ai_cr_acccode, @an_amount, @as_chkno_detail, @as_remarks_detail, @ai_patientcode, @ai_guestcode, @ai_studentcode, @ai_invoicecode, @an_outstandingamt, @an_balance, @GlVochCode OUTPUT , @VochCode OUTPUT , @SMANCode
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @RC <>  0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Unable to Add Loyalty Points for Customer on Sale Posting' , 16 , 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	Update DBO.Emp_Advance
	Set GlVochCode = @GlVochCode, posted = 'Y', postedOn = GETDATE(), PostedBy = @ai_UserCode
	Where 
		Posted = 'N' AND
		AdvanceCode = @AdvanceCode

	SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
END

-- sp_PostGeneralLedger
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_PostGeneralLedger 
	@ai_sInvCode integer, 
	@ai_lInvCode integer, 
	@ai_VoucherType integer, 
	@ai_SalesmanCode integer 
AS  
DECLARE @RowID INT, @TotRows INT, @rt_code INT, @GLVochCode INT
DECLARE @ai_list VARCHAR(8000)

/*Create Temporary Table to hold voucher numbers*/
CREATE TABLE #lt_list (Code INT NOT NULL, ROWID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1))

/*Insert unposted voucher numbers into Temporary Table*/
INSERT INTO #lt_list
SELECT GLVochCode
FROM glheader
Where   glheader.glVochCode Between @ai_sInvCode AND @ai_lInvCode AND   
	glheader.VochCatCode = @ai_VoucherType AND glheader.Posted = 'N'

Update  glheader
Set     glheader.posted   = 'Y',
	glheader.postdate = GetDate(),
	glheader.postedby = @ai_SalesmanCode
Where   glheader.glVochCode Between @ai_sInvCode AND @ai_lInvCode AND
	glheader.VochCatCode = @ai_VoucherType AND glheader.Posted = 'N'

SET @RowID = 1
SET @TotRows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #lt_list), 0)
SET @ai_list = ''

WHILE @RowID <= @TotRows
BEGIN
	SET @GLVochCode = (SELECT Code FROM #lt_list WHERE RowID = @RowID)
	SET @ai_list = ISNULL(@ai_list,'') + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@GLVochCode,10))) + ','
	SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
END

IF Right(@ai_list,1) = ','
	SET @ai_list = LEFT(@ai_list, LEN(@ai_list) - 1)
IF LEN(@ai_list) > 0
BEGIN
	EXECUTE @rt_code = DBO.SP_CreateAutoTriggerSMS @ai_list, 45, 'Posting'
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Unable to Create Auto Trigger SMS on Voucher Posting' , 16 , 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

RETURN 0

definition:
-- sp_PostInstallment
CREATE   PROCEDURE DBO.sp_PostInstallment
	@InstallmentCode Int, 
	@UserCode SMALLInt, 
	@SaleInvCode INT OUTPUT
AS

Declare @custcode SMALLInt, @gcode smallint, @icode Int, @packunits Int, @Headerno SMALLINT, @rowgroup Int, @innercounter Int
Declare @saleprice Numeric(12,2), @rate Numeric(12,2), @discperc Numeric(5,2), @itemflatdisc Numeric(12,2), @SaleCatCode SMALLINT, @SaleTypeCode SMALLINT
Declare @unitsalestax Numeric(12,2), @gstperc1 Numeric(6,2), @gstperc2 Numeric(6,2), @hold_avgprice Numeric(15,5), @satisfiableqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @satisfiedqty NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @MarkupAmt Numeric(10,2), @ProcessingFee Numeric(10,2), @DownPayment Numeric(10,2)
Declare @module Int, @headerinvno Int, @continue Int, @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @totalrows Int, @rowcount Int, @counter Int
Declare @totalqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @givenqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @reqqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @batchqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @delqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @currqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @newqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @total_availablestock NUMERIC(15, 4), @NetAmount NUMERIC(12,2)
Declare @batch VarChar(100), @itemname VarChar(60), @expiry DateTime, @serverdate DateTime, @machinename VARCHAR(100)
Declare @saleutn BigInt, @SManCode SMALLINT, @InquiryPersonCode SMALLINT
SET @module = ( Select module from module where name = 'Sales' )
SET @Headerno=1
SET @machinename=@@ServerName
SET @SaleCatCode=2
SET @SaleTypeCode = (SELECT MIN(SaleTypeCode) FROM SaleType)
SET @serverdate = GETDATE()
Select @CustCode=CustCode, @GCode=gcode, @ICode=icode, @PackUnits = PackUnits, @satisfiableqty=qty, @satisfiedqty=0, @SalePrice=saleprice, @itemflatdisc=itemflatdisc, @discperc=discperc, @unitsalestax=0, @gstperc1=0, 
	@MarkupAmt=MarkupAmt, @ProcessingFee=ProcessingFee, @DownPayment=DownPayment,
	@itemname = (SELECT I.Name FROM Item I WHERE I.ICode=@ICode),
	@NetAmount = ROUND(Round((Qty * (SalePrice - ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2) + MarkupAmt + ProcessingFee, 0),
	@SManCode = SManCode , @InquiryPersonCode = InquiryPersonCode
From InstallmentHeader
WHERE InstallmentCode = @InstallmentCode AND Posted='N' AND Approved='Y'

Set @totalrows = @@RowCount
IF @totalrows=0
BEGIN
	RaisError( 'Installment code : %d is not available for posting' ,16,1,  @InstallmentCode)
	RETURN -1
END

IF @satisfiableqty=0
	SET @satisfiableqty=1
Set @saleprice = Round(@NetAmount / @satisfiableqty, 2)
Set @continue = 0
Set @rowgroup = 0
Set @totalqty = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and godowndetail.icode = @icode)
IF @totalqty < @satisfiableqty
BEGIN
	RaisError( 'Not Enough Stock exists for this item : %s to sale against Installment code : %d' ,16,1,  @itemname , @InstallmentCode)
	RETURN -1
END

Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'Saleledger' , @SaleInvCode Output
Set @rowgroup = 0
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
Begin
	RaisError( 'Error in Generating Sale Invoice No. against Installment code : %d' ,16,1,  @InstallmentCode)
	RETURN -1
End

Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno , @module,  @headerinvno Output 
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
Begin
	RaisError( 'Error in Generating Header Sale Invoice No. against Installment code : %d' ,16,1,  @InstallmentCode)
	RETURN -1
End
Set @Err = 0 
Set @RowCount = 1
Insert Into SaleLedger (SaleInvCode, SaleCatCode, CustCode, SPrice, SalesManCode, Date, Discperc, Flatdisc, MiscCharges, SalesTax, Posted, PostDate,  HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo, OriginalDate, InvTotal, MachineName, ModifyCounter, BillingDate, SaleTypeCode, CashAccCode, CashTendered, CashCharged, CashBack, OutstandingAmt, SManCode, DeliveredBy)
Values (@SaleInvCode, @salecatcode, @custcode, 1, @usercode, @serverdate, 0, 0, 0, 0, 'Y', @serverdate, @headerno, @headerinvno, @serverdate, @NetAmount, @machinename, 0, @serverdate, @saletypecode, 2, @DownPayment, @DownPayment, 0, @NetAmount - @DownPayment, @SManCode, @InquiryPersonCode)
Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
Begin 
	RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Ledger : %d' ,16,1,  @SaleInvCode)
	RETURN -1
End 

IF @satisfiedqty > @satisfiableqty 
Begin 
	RaisError( 'Qty Satisfied Exceeded Required Qty for item : %s' ,16,1,  @ItemName)
	RETURN -1
END

Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
Begin
	RaisError( 'Error in Fetching Avg. Price for item : %s' ,16,1,  @ItemName)
	RETURN -1
End

Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemStockAll @ICode, @total_availablestock OutPut
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
Begin
	RETURN -1
End

SET @GivenQty=@satisfiableqty
Set @totalqty = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and godowndetail.icode = @icode)
IF @totalqty >= @givenqty 
Begin 
	Set @rowgroup = @rowgroup + 1
	Select @rate = saleprice, @packunits = packunits
	From ITEM
	Where icode = @icode
	IF @packunits = 0 OR @packunits Is Null 
		Set @packunits = 1

	Set @reqqty = @givenqty

	Declare ItemBatch_Cursor Cursor Static Forward_Only
	For 	Select  batch, expiry, Currqty 
	From    godowndetail 
	Where  godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and
		    godowndetail.icode = @icode 
	Order by priority, expiry, Currqty

	Open ItemBatch_Cursor
	Set @totalrows = @@Cursor_Rows
	Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
	Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
	Set @counter = 1	
	While @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @counter <= @totalrows AND @reqqty > 0 AND @continue <> -1
	Begin
		Set @batchqty = @currqty

		IF @batchqty >= @ReqQty 
			Set @delqty = @reqqty
		Else
			Set @delqty = @batchqty

		Set @reqqty = @reqqty - @delqty

		Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @saleutn Output
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1															
		End 									
		SET @total_availablestock = @total_availablestock - @delqty

		Insert Into SaleDetail (SaleInvCode, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, packqty, looseqty, packunits, saleprice, avgprice, rate, discperc, salestax, itemflatdisc, packprice, unitsalestax, gstperc, saleutn, balancestock, rowgroup)
		Values (@saleinvcode, @icode, @gcode, @batch, @expiry, 0, @delqty, @packunits, @saleprice, @hold_avgprice, @rate / @packunits, 0, 0, 0, @rate, @unitsalestax, @gstperc1, @saleutn, @total_availablestock, @rowgroup)
		Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
		IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
		Begin 
			RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Detail for Sale Inv. No. : %d' ,16,1, @SaleInvCode  )
			Set @continue  = -1
		End 							
		Else
		Begin
			Set @newqty = @currqty - @delqty
			IF @newqty > 0
				Execute @rt_code = sp_SaleUpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty , @currqty
			Else
				Execute @rt_code = sp_DeleteItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
				Set @continue  = -1								
		End
		Set @counter = @counter + 1
		Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
		Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
	End
	Close ItemBatch_Cursor
	Deallocate ItemBatch_Cursor
END
Else
Begin
	RaisError( 'Not enough stock for item (%s) to decrease for Sale Inv. No : %d' , 16 , 1, @itemname, @SaleInvCode )
	Set @continue  = -1								
End

IF ( @continue >= 0 )
Begin
	UPDATE InstallmentHeader 
	SET Posted='Y', PostedBy=@UserCode, PostDate=GETDATE(), SaleInvCode=@SaleInvCode
	WHERE InstallmentCode = @InstallmentCode

	Select @Err = @@Error, @Rowcount = @@RowCount
	IF  @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0
	Begin
		RaisError( 'Unable to update Installment staus from Not Posted To Posted For Installment Code : %d' , 16 , 1 , @InstallmentCode)
		Set @continue  = -1									
	End
End

Return @continue
