name: sp_PostItemConversion
definition:
-- sp_PostItemConversion
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_PostItemConversion
	@code As Int, 
	@usercode As SmallInt, 
	@headerno AS SmallInt,
	@serverdate As DateTime 
As

Declare @adjinccode As Int, @adjdeccode As Int, @headerinvno As Int, @adjutn As BigInt, @effect INT
Declare @icode As Int, @gcode As SmallInt, @batch As VarChar(100), @expiry As DateTime, @defaultbatch As VarChar(100), @defaultexpiry As DateTime
Declare  @reqqty As NUMERIC(15, 4), @givenqty As NUMERIC(15, 4), @totalqty As NUMERIC(15, 4), @currqty As NUMERIC(15, 4), @delqty As NUMERIC(15, 4), @batchqty As NUMERIC(15, 4), @newqty As NUMERIC(15, 4), @TotStock NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @hold_avgprice As NUMERIC(15,5)
Declare @packunits As SmallInt, @price As Numeric(12,2), @purprice As Numeric(12,2), @saleprice As Numeric(12,2), @recentpurprice As Numeric(12,2), @NewAvgPrice As NUMERIC(15,5)
Declare @AdjInc_Items_Rows As Int, @AdjDec_Items_Rows As Int, @totalrows As Int, @counter As Int, @module As SmallInt
Declare @continue As Int, @Err As Int, @RowCount As Int, @rt_code As Int, @err_string As VarChar(200), @itemname As VarChar(100)
DECLARE @UpdateAvgPrice CHAR(1)
DECLARE @remarks As VarChar(100)

SET @effect = (Select ItemConversionEffectCode From ItemConversionHeader Where ItemConversionCode = @code)
Set @remarks=(select ISNULL(remarks,'') from ItemConversionHeader Where ItemConversionCode = @code)
set @remarks= convert(varchar(10),@code)+ ' , ' + @remarks
Set @rt_code = (Select count(*) From ItemConversionHeader Where ItemConversionCode = @code And Posted = 'Y')
IF @rt_code > 0 
	Return 0

Set @continue  = 0
Set @module = ( Select module From Module Where Name = 'Adjustment' )
Set @defaultbatch = DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'defaultbatch' )
Set @defaultexpiry = DBO.Fn_Get_DateTime_Preference( 'defaultexpiry' )
SET @UpdateAvgPrice = DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'UpdAvgPriceInAdjInc' )

IF @effect = 1 -- Increase Source
BEGIN
	Declare Cursor_AdjInc_Items Cursor Forward_Only Static
	For Select ItemConversionHeader.Gcode, ItemConversionHeader.icode, ItemConversionHeader.Qty As GivenQty, item.packunits, item.purprice, item.saleprice, item.recentpurprice
	      From ItemConversionHeader Inner Join Item On ItemConversionHeader.icode = Item.icode
	      Where ItemConversionCode = @code AND Qty > 0
END
ELSE				 -- Decrease Source
BEGIN
	Declare Cursor_AdjInc_Items Cursor Forward_Only Static
	For Select ItemConversionDetail.GCode, ItemConversionDetail.icode, ItemConversionDetail.Qty As GivenQty, item.packunits, item.purprice, item.saleprice, item.recentpurprice
	      From ItemConversionDetail Inner Join Item On ItemConversionDetail.icode = Item.icode
	      Where ItemConversionCode = @code AND Qty > 0
	      Order by rowid
END

Open Cursor_AdjInc_Items
Set @AdjInc_Items_Rows = @@Cursor_Rows
IF @AdjInc_Items_Rows > 0 
Begin
	Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'AdjHeader' , @adjIncCode Output
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	Begin
		Set @continue  = -1
	End
	Else
	Begin
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno , @module,  @headerinvno Output 
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
		Else
		Begin
			Insert Into AdjHeader (AdjCode, AdjCatCode, UserCode, Remarks, Date, ModifiedDate, ModifiedBy, Posted, PostedDate, PostedBy, HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo)
			Values (@adjIncCode, 1, @usercode, @remarks, @serverdate, @serverdate, Null, 'Y', @serverdate, @usercode, @headerno, @headerinvno)
			Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
			IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
			Begin 
				RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Adjustment Increase Header for Item Conversion Code : %d' ,16,1,  @Code  )
				Set @continue  = -1
			End 
			Else
			Begin
				Fetch Next From Cursor_AdjInc_Items
				Into @gcode, @icode, @givenqty, @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice
				While @@Fetch_Status = 0 AND @continue >= 0
				Begin
					Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
					IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
					Begin
						Set @continue  = -1
					End
					Else
					Begin
						Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @adjutn OutPut
						IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
						Begin
							Set @continue  = -1															
						End 									
						
						Set @packunits = Case When @packunits Is Null Then 1 When @packunits = 0 Then 1 Else @packunits End
						IF @hold_avgprice Is Null Or @hold_avgprice = 0 
							Set @price = @purprice / @packunits
						Else							Set @price = Cast( @hold_avgprice As Numeric(8,2) )

						Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemStockAll @ICode, @TotStock OutPut
						IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
						Begin
							Set @continue  = -1															
						End

						IF @UpdateAvgPrice = 'Y'
						BEGIN
							SET	@NewAvgPrice = ISNULL((SELECT ROUND(((@TotStock * @hold_avgprice) + (@givenqty * @price)) / (@givenqty + @TotStock), 5) ), 0)
							Execute @rt_code = sp_UpdateItemAvgPrice @ICode, @NewAvgPrice
							IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
							Begin
								Set @continue  = -1															
							End
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @NewAvgPrice = @hold_avgprice
						END

						IF @continue <> -1
						BEGIN
							Insert Into AdjDetail (AdjCode, GCode, ICode, Batch, Expiry, Looseqty, Priority, Price, AvgPrice, PackUnits, SalePrice, PurPrice, RecentPurPrice, AdjUtn, UpdateAvgPrice, NewAvgPrice, CurrStock )
							Values(@adjIncCode, @GCode, @ICode, @defaultbatch, @defaultexpiry, @givenqty, 0, @price,  @hold_avgprice, @packunits, @saleprice, @purprice, @recentpurprice, @adjutn, @UpdateAvgPrice, @NewAvgPrice, @TotStock  )
	
							Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
							IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
							Begin 
								RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Adjustment Increase Detail for Item Conversion Code : %d' ,16,1,  @Code  )
								Set @continue  = -1
							End 							
							Else
							Begin
								Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @defaultbatch, @defaultexpiry, @currqty Output
								IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
								Begin
									Set @continue  = -1																	
								End 
								Else
								Begin
									Set @newqty = @currqty + @givenqty	
									Execute @rt_code = sp_UpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @defaultbatch, @defaultexpiry, @newqty
									IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
									Begin
										Set @continue  = -1								
									End
								End
							End
						END
					End
					Fetch Next From Cursor_AdjInc_Items
					Into @gcode, @icode, @givenqty, @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice
				End
			End
		End
	End	
End

Close Cursor_AdjInc_Items
Deallocate Cursor_AdjInc_Items
IF @continue <> 0 
Begin
	Return -1
End
Else
Begin
	Set @continue  = 0

	IF @effect = 1 -- Increase Source
	BEGIN
		Declare Cursor_AdjDec_Items Cursor Forward_Only Static
		For Select ItemConversionDetail.GCode, ItemConversionDetail.icode, ItemConversionDetail.Qty As GivenQty, item.packunits, item.purprice, item.saleprice, item.recentpurprice
		      From ItemConversionDetail Inner Join Item On ItemConversionDetail.icode = Item.icode
		      Where ItemConversionCode = @code AND Qty > 0
		      Order by rowid
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		Declare Cursor_AdjDec_Items Cursor Forward_Only Static
		For Select ItemConversionHeader.Gcode, ItemConversionHeader.icode, ItemConversionHeader.Qty As GivenQty, item.packunits, item.purprice, item.saleprice, item.recentpurprice
		      From ItemConversionHeader Inner Join Item On ItemConversionHeader.icode = Item.icode
		      Where ItemConversionCode = @code AND Qty > 0
	END
	
	Open Cursor_AdjDec_Items
	Set @AdjDec_Items_Rows = @@Cursor_Rows
	IF @AdjDec_Items_Rows > 0 
	Begin
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'AdjHeader' , @adjDecCode Output
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
		Else
		Begin
			Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno , @module,  @headerinvno Output 
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
			Begin
				Set @continue  = -1
			End
			Else
			Begin
				Insert Into AdjHeader (AdjCode, AdjCatCode, UserCode, Remarks, Date, ModifiedDate, ModifiedBy, Posted, PostedDate, PostedBy, HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo)
				Values (@adjDecCode, 2, @usercode, @remarks, @serverdate, @serverdate, Null, 'Y', @serverdate, @usercode, @headerno, @headerinvno)
				Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
				IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
				Begin 
					RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Adjustment Decrease for Item Conversion Code : %d' ,16,1,  @Code  )
					Set @continue  = -1
				End 
				Else
				Begin
					Fetch Next From Cursor_AdjDec_Items
					Into @gcode, @icode, @givenqty, @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice
					While @@Fetch_Status = 0 AND @continue >= 0
					Begin
						Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
						IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
						Begin
							Set @continue  = -1
						End
						Else
						Begin
							Set @packunits = Case When @packunits Is Null Then 1 When @packunits = 0 Then 1 Else @packunits End
							Set @totalqty = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and godowndetail.icode = @icode  )
							IF @totalqty >= @givenqty 
							Begin 
								Set @reqqty = @givenqty
								Declare ItemBatch_Cursor Cursor Static Forward_Only
								For 	Select  batch, expiry, Currqty 
									From    godowndetail 
									Where  godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and
										    godowndetail.icode = @icode 
									Order by priority, expiry, Currqty
	
								Open ItemBatch_Cursor
								Set @totalrows = @@Cursor_Rows
								Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
								Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
								Set @counter = 1	
								While @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @counter <= @totalrows AND @reqqty > 0
								Begin
									Set @batchqty = @currqty
									IF @batchqty >= @ReqQty 
										Set @delqty = @reqqty
									Else
										Set @delqty = @batchqty
									Set @reqqty = @reqqty - @delqty

									Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @adjutn Output
									IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
									Begin
										Set @continue  = -1															
									End 									

									Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemStockAll @ICode, @TotStock OUTPUT
									IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
									Begin
										Set @continue  = -1															
									End
			
									SET @NewAvgPrice = @hold_avgprice

									Insert Into AdjDetail (AdjCode, GCode, ICode, Batch, Expiry, Looseqty, Priority, Price, AvgPrice, PackUnits, SalePrice, PurPrice, RecentPurPrice, AdjUtn, UpdateAvgPrice, NewAvgPrice, CurrStock )
									Values(@adjDecCode, @GCode, @ICode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty, 0, @hold_avgprice, @hold_avgprice, @packunits, @saleprice, @purprice, @recentpurprice, @adjutn, @UpdateAvgPrice, @NewAvgPrice, @TotStock )
									Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
									IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
									Begin 
										RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Adjustment Decrease Detail for Item Conversion Code : %d' ,16,1, @Code  )
										Set @continue  = -1
									End 							
									Else
									Begin
										Set @newqty = @currqty - @delqty
										IF @newqty > 0
											Execute @rt_code = sp_SaleUpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty , @currqty
										Else
											Execute @rt_code = sp_DeleteItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty
										IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
										Begin
											Set @continue  = -1								
										End
									End
									Set @counter = @counter + 1
									Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
									Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
								End
								Close ItemBatch_Cursor
								Deallocate ItemBatch_Cursor
							End
							Else
							Begin
								Set @itemname = (Select name from item where icode = @icode )	
								RaisError( 'Not enough stock for item (%s) to decrease for Item Conversion Code : %d' , 16 , 1, @itemname, @Code  )
								Set @continue  = -1								
							End
						End
						Fetch Next From Cursor_AdjDec_Items
						Into @gcode, @icode, @givenqty, @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice
					End
				End
			End
		End	
	End

	Close Cursor_AdjDec_Items
	Deallocate Cursor_AdjDec_Items
	IF @continue <> 0 
	Begin
		Return -1
	End
	Else
	Begin 
		Update ItemConversionHeader
		Set Posted = 'Y' , PostedBy = @usercode, PostDate = GetDate(), AdjIncreaseCode = Case When @AdjInc_Items_Rows > 0 Then @AdjIncCode Else Null End , AdjDecreaseCode = Case When @AdjDec_Items_Rows > 0 Then @adjdecCode Else Null End
		Where ItemConversionCode = @Code
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@RowCount = 0 
		Begin
			RaisError('Posting fail for Item Conversion Code (%d) due to updation problem.' , 16 , 1 , @Code)
			Return -1
		End

		IF @adjIncCode > 0
		BEGIN
			IF (SELECT A=DBO.Fn_GetPreference('IncAdjInActMonitor')) = 'Y'
			BEGIN
				Execute @rt_code = SP_UpdateActivityMonitor 'AI', @adjIncCode
				IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
				BEGIN
					RaisError('Posting fail for Item Conversion Code (%d) due to activity monitor updation problem.' , 16 , 1 , @Code)
					Return -1
				END
			END
		END

		IF @adjdecCode > 0
		BEGIN
			IF (SELECT A=DBO.Fn_GetPreference('IncAdjInActMonitor')) = 'Y'
			BEGIN
				Execute @rt_code = SP_UpdateActivityMonitor 'AD', @adjdecCode
				IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
				BEGIN
					RaisError('Posting fail for Item Conversion Code (%d) due to activity monitor updation problem.' , 16 , 1 , @Code)
					Return -1
				END
			END
		END

		Return 0
	End
End

name: sp_PostPayroll
definition:
-- sp_PostPayroll
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.sp_PostPayroll @ai_scode INT, @ai_ecode INT, @ai_usercode SMALLINT
AS

DECLARE @innercounter Int, @innercounter2 Int, @continue Int, @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @totalrows Int, @totalrows2 int, @totalrows3 int, @rowcount Int, @counter Int, @serverdate DateTime
DECLARE @PayrollCode INT, @Advance NUMERIC(15,2), @EmpCode INT, @AccCode SMALLINT, @AdvAccCode SMALLINT
DECLARE @AdvanceCode INT, @Amount NUMERIC(15,2), @ReturnedAmt NUMERIC(15,2), @Balance NUMERIC(15,2), @Installment NUMERIC(15,2)
SET @serverdate = GETDATE()
DECLARE C1 Cursor FORWARD_ONLY STATIC FOR 
SELECT 
	PayrollCode=EP.PayrollCode, 
	Advance=EP.Advance, 
	EmpCode=EP.EmpCode, 
	AccCode=E.AccCode, 
	AdvAccCode=E.AdvAccCode,
	Balance=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(EA.Amount - EA.ReturnedAmt) FROM EMP_Advance EA WHERE EA.EmpAdvAccCode = E.AdvAccCode), 0)
From
	Emp_Payroll EP, Emp_Employee E
Where  
	EP.Posted='N' AND EP.EmpCode=E.EmpCode AND
	EP.PayrollCode Between @ai_scode AND @ai_ecode
ORDER BY
	PayrollCode

OPEN C1
Set @totalrows = @@Cursor_Rows
IF @totalrows=0
BEGIN
	RaisError( 'Payroll Posting : No rows available for posting' , 16, 1)
	CLOSE C1
	DEALLOCATE C1
	RETURN -1
END
Set @continue = 0
Set @Err = 0 
Set @RowCount = 1
Set @counter = 1	

Fetch Next From C1
Into 	@PayrollCode, @Advance, @EmpCode, @AccCode, @AdvAccCode, @Balance
While @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @counter <= @totalrows
Begin
	IF @Advance > @Balance
	BEGIN
		RaisError( 'Payroll Posting : Advance installment is more than advance taken. Payroll Code: %d ' , 16, 1, @PayrollCode)
		CLOSE C1
		DEALLOCATE C1
		RETURN -1
	END
	DECLARE C2 CURSOR FORWARD_ONLY STATIC FOR
	SELECT AdvanceCode, Amount, ReturnedAmt, Installment
	From   Emp_Advance
	WHERE EmpAdvAccCode = @AdvAccCode AND (Amount - ReturnedAmt) > 0 AND @Advance > 0 AND Installment > 0
	ORDER BY AdvanceCode

	OPEN C2
	Set @totalrows2 = @@Cursor_Rows
	IF @totalrows2 > 0
	BEGIN
		Fetch Next From C2
		INTO @AdvanceCode, @Amount, @ReturnedAmt, @Installment
		SET @innercounter = 1	
		WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @innercounter <= @totalrows2 AND @Advance > 0
		BEGIN
			IF @Advance >= @Installment
			BEGIN
				UPDATE Emp_Advance SET ReturnedAmt = ReturnedAmt + @Installment WHERE AdvanceCode = @AdvanceCode
				SET @Advance = @Advance - @Installment
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				UPDATE Emp_Advance SET ReturnedAmt = ReturnedAmt + @Advance WHERE AdvanceCode = @AdvanceCode
				SET @Advance = 0
			END
			SET @innercounter = @innercounter + 1
			Fetch Next From C2
			INTO @AdvanceCode, @Amount, @ReturnedAmt, @Installment
		END
		IF @Advance > 0
		BEGIN
			DECLARE C3 CURSOR FORWARD_ONLY STATIC FOR
			SELECT AdvanceCode, Amount, ReturnedAmt
			From   Emp_Advance
			WHERE EmpAdvAccCode = @AdvAccCode AND (Amount - ReturnedAmt) > 0 AND @Advance > 0
			ORDER BY AdvanceCode
			OPEN C3
			Set @totalrows3 = @@Cursor_Rows
			IF @totalrows3 > 0
			BEGIN
				Fetch Next From C3
				INTO @AdvanceCode, @Amount, @ReturnedAmt
				SET @innercounter2 = 1	
				WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @innercounter2 <= @totalrows3 AND @Advance > 0
				BEGIN
					IF @Advance >= (@Amount - @ReturnedAmt)
					BEGIN
						UPDATE Emp_Advance SET ReturnedAmt = Amount WHERE AdvanceCode = @AdvanceCode
						SET @Advance = @Advance - (@Amount - @ReturnedAmt)
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						UPDATE Emp_Advance SET ReturnedAmt = ReturnedAmt + @Advance WHERE AdvanceCode = @AdvanceCode
						SET @Advance = 0
					END
					SET @innercounter2 = @innercounter2 + 1
					Fetch Next From C3
					INTO @AdvanceCode, @Amount, @ReturnedAmt
				END
				CLOSE C3
				DEALLOCATE C3
			END
		END
	END
	CLOSE C2
	DEALLOCATE C2

	UPDATE EMP_Payroll 
	SET Posted='Y', PostDate=GETDATE(), PostedBy=@ai_usercode
	WHERE PayrollCode = @PayrollCode AND POSTED='N'

	Set @counter = @counter + 1
	Fetch Next From C1
	Into 	@PayrollCode, @Advance, @EmpCode, @AccCode, @AdvAccCode, @Balance
End
Close c1
Deallocate c1

Return @continue

-- sp_PostPointOfSaleLedger
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_PostPointOfSaleLedger 
	@ai_sInvCode integer, 
	@ai_lInvCode integer,  
	@ai_SalesmanCode integer,
	@ai_custcode integer,
	@ai_OneOrAll INTEGER, 
	@ac_impactinventory CHAR(1) 
AS

DECLARE @saleinvcode INT, @ai_list VARCHAR(8000), @loyalty CHAR(1), @RowID INT, @TotRows INT, @rt_code INT
CREATE TABLE #lt_invoicelist (Code INT NOT NULL, ROWID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1))

SET @saleinvcode = @ai_sInvCode
SET @loyalty = DBO.Fn_GetPreference ('ApplyLoyaltypolicyonsaleposting')

IF @ai_OneOrAll=0
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #lt_invoicelist 
	SELECT SaleInvCode
	FROM SaleLedger
	WHERE	SaleLedger.SaleInvCode Between @ai_sInvCode AND @ai_lInvCode AND
		SaleLedger.SaleCatCode IN ( 1, 2, 3) AND
		SaleLedger.CustCode = @ai_custcode AND
		SaleLedger.Posted = 'N' AND
		SaleLedger.ImpactInventory = @ac_impactinventory

	Update  SaleLedger
	Set     SaleLedger.posted   = 'Y',
		SaleLedger.postdate = GetDate(),
		SaleLedger.postedby = @ai_SalesmanCode	
	Where  	 SaleLedger.SaleInvCode Between @ai_sInvCode AND @ai_lInvCode AND
		SaleLedger.SaleCatCode IN ( 1, 2, 3) AND
		SaleLedger.CustCode = @ai_custcode AND
		SaleLedger.Posted = 'N' AND
		SaleLedger.ImpactInventory = @ac_impactinventory
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #lt_invoicelist 
	SELECT SaleInvCode
	FROM SaleLedger
	WHERE	SaleLedger.SaleInvCode Between @ai_sInvCode AND @ai_lInvCode AND
		SaleLedger.SaleCatCode IN ( 1, 2, 3 ) AND
		SaleLedger.Posted = 'N'	 AND
		SaleLedger.ImpactInventory = @ac_impactinventory

	Update  SaleLedger
	Set     SaleLedger.posted   = 'Y',
		SaleLedger.postdate = GetDate(),
		SaleLedger.postedby = @ai_SalesmanCode	
	Where  	 SaleLedger.SaleInvCode Between @ai_sInvCode AND @ai_lInvCode AND
		SaleLedger.SaleCatCode IN ( 1, 2, 3 ) AND
		SaleLedger.Posted = 'N'	 AND
		SaleLedger.ImpactInventory = @ac_impactinventory
END

SET @RowID = 1
SET @TotRows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #lt_invoicelist), 0)

WHILE @RowID <= @TotRows
BEGIN
	SET @SaleInvCode = (SELECT Code FROM #lt_invoicelist WHERE RowID = @RowID)
	IF @loyalty = 'Y'
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE @rt_code = DBO.SP_ManageLoyaltyPoints 'SV', @SaleInvCode
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Unable to Add Loyalty Points for Customer on Sale Posting' , 16 , 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END
	SET @ai_list = @ai_list + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@SaleInvCode,10))) + ','
	SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
END

IF Right(@ai_list,1) = ','
	SET @ai_list = LEFT(@ai_list, LEN(@ai_list) - 1)

EXECUTE @rt_code = DBO.SP_CreateAutoTriggerSMS @ai_list, 1, 'Posting'
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Unable to Create Auto Trigger SMS on Sale Posting' , 16 , 1)
	RETURN -1
END

RETURN 0

-- sp_PostProduction
CREATE Procedure sp_PostProduction @ProdCode Int, @UserCode Int, @HeaderNo Int, @serverdate DateTime As
Declare @Err Int, @Rows Int, @rt_Code Int
Declare @IssueInvCode Int, @ReceiptInvCode Int
/*
Author: M.Usman
*/
Update ProdHeader With (UPDLOCK HOLDLOCK)
Set    Posted = 'Y', PostedBy= @UserCode, PostDate= GetDate()
Where  ProdCode = @ProdCode And Posted = 'N' AND Finalized = 'Y'
Select @Err = @@Error, @Rows = @@RowCount
IF ( @Err = 0 AND @Rows > 0 )
Begin
	EXEC @rt_code = sp_GenerateIssue @ProdCode, @UserCode, @HeaderNo, @serverdate, @IssueInvCode OutPut
	IF ( @@Error = 0 AND @rt_Code = 0 )
	Begin
		EXEC @rt_code = sp_GenerateReceipt @ProdCode, @UserCode, @HeaderNo, @serverdate, @IssueInvCode, @ReceiptInvCode OutPut
		IF ( @@Error = 0 OR @rt_Code = 0 )		
		BEGIN 
			Update 	ProdHeader
			Set 	IssueInvCode = @IssueInvCode , ReceiptInvCode = @ReceiptInvCode
			Where	ProdCode = @ProdCode
			Select @Err = @@Error, @Rows = @@RowCount
			IF ( @Err <> 0 OR @Rows = 0 )
			BEGIN
				RaisError('Error occured in Posting Production (ProdCode= %d ), Error in Updation of Issue / Receipt Document Contents' ,16,1,  @ProdCode  )
				Return -4
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Error occured in Posting Production (ProdCode= %d ), Error in Generation of Production Receipt Document' ,16,1,  @ProdCode  )
			Return -3
		END
	End
	ELSE	
	Begin
		RaisError('Error occured in Posting Production (ProdCode= %d ), Error in Generation of Production Issue Document' ,16,1,  @ProdCode  )
		Return -2
	END
END 
ELSE
BEGIN
	IF ( @Err <> 0 )
	Begin
		RaisError('Error occured in Posting Production (ProdCode= %d )' ,16,1,  @ProdCode  )
		Return -1
	END
END

Return 0

-- sp_PostPurOrder
CREATE  Procedure SP_PostPurOrder 
	@sinvcode Int, @linvcode Int, @usercode SmallInt As
/*
Author: Muhammad Usman
Version: 2.0
*/
Declare @icode Int, @qty NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @itemname VarChar(70)
Declare @rt_code Int, @continue Int
Declare @avgprice Numeric(15,5)
Set  	@continue = 0
Declare Item_Cursor Cursor FORWARD_ONLY READ_ONLY
For 	Select 	PD.Icode, ( (PD.qty + PD.bonusqty) * PD.packunits ) As Qty
	From   	PurOrderHeader PH Inner Join PurOrderDetail PD 
		On PH.POCode = PD.POCode Inner Join Item I
		On PD.ICode = I.ICode 
	Where	PH.POCode Between @sinvcode And @linvcode And
		PH.Posted = 'N'
	Order By PD.POCode,PD.PORowId

OPEN Item_Cursor
Fetch Next From Item_Cursor
Into @icode, @qty
While @@Fetch_Status = 0 
Begin
	Exec @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @avgprice
	IF @@Error = 0  AND @rt_code = 0 
	Begin
		Exec @rt_code = sp_UpdateTransitStock 0,@icode,@qty
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
		Begin
			Set @itemname = (Select Name From Item Where Icode = @icode )
			RaisError('Unable to Update Transit Stock for Item: %s',16,1, @itemname )
			Set @continue = -1			
		End				
	End
	Else
	Begin
		Set @itemname = (Select Name From Item Where Icode = @icode )
		RaisError('Unable to Lock Item: %s for Transit Stock Updation.',16,1, @itemname )
		Set @continue = -1
	End
	Fetch Next From Item_Cursor
	Into      	@icode,@qty	
End
CLOSE 		Item_Cursor
DEALLOCATE	Item_Cursor

IF @continue = 0 
Begin
	Update PurOrderHeader
	Set    Posted = 'Y' , 
	       PostDate = GetDate(),
	       PostedBy = @usercode
	Where  PoCode Between @sinvcode And @linvcode AND
	       Posted = 'N'
End

Return @continue

name: sp_PostReceipt_From_Production
definition:
-- sp_PostReceipt_From_Production
CREATE Procedure dbo.sp_PostReceipt_From_Production 
	@ProdCode Int, 
	@UserCode Int
As
DECLARE @ReceiptInvCode INT, @IssueInvCode INT
SET @ReceiptInvCode = (SELECT ReceiptInvCode FROM ProdHeader WHERE ProdCode=@ProdCode AND ReceiptInvCode IN (SELECT ReceiptInvCode FROM ReceiptHeader WHERE Posted='N'))
SET @IssueInvCode = (SELECT IssueInvCode FROM ProdHeader WHERE ProdCode=@ProdCode AND IssueInvCode IN (SELECT IssueInvCode FROM IssueHeader WHERE Posted='Y'))

IF @ProdCode > 0 AND @ReceiptInvCode > 0 AND @IssueInvCode > 0
BEGIN
	Declare @utn Int
	Declare @PriceType SmallInt, @priority SmallInt, @GroupCode INT
	Declare @ICode Int, @GCode Int, @packunits Int
	Declare @GivenQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @TotalQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @CurrQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @DelQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @BatchQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @ReqQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @NewQty NUMERIC(15, 4), @TotStock NUMERIC(15, 4)
	Declare @Price Numeric(12,2), @PurPrice Numeric(12,2), @SalePrice Numeric(12,2), @Hold_AvgPrice Numeric(15,5), @RecentPurPrice Numeric(12,2), @NewAvgPrice NUMERIC(15,5)
	Declare @batch VarChar(100), @ItemName VarChar(100), @UpdateAvgPrice CHAR(1)
	Declare @Items_Rows Int, @Counter Int, @RowCount Int, @TotalRows Int, @continue Int, @Err Int, @rt_code Int 
	Declare @expiry DateTime, @RecomputeCost CHAR(1)
	Set @continue = 0

	SET @UpdateAvgPrice = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('UpdAvgPriceInReceipt')
	Set @priority = 10
	Set @RecomputeCost = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('ReComputeCostInProduction')

	UPDATE ReceiptDetail
	SET 
		CurrStock = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(GD.CurrQty) FROM GodownDetail GD WHERE GD.ICode=RD.ICode),0),
		Price = ISNULL(CASE WHEN @IssueInvCode > 0 THEN 
			CASE @RecomputeCost
				WHEN 'Y' THEN 
					(SELECT SUM(isd.qty * isd.price) / CASE WHEN RD.Qty = 0 THEN 1 ELSE RD.Qty END
					FROM
						ProdHeader h, ProdBuffer b, ProdDetail d, IssueDetail isd
					WHERE 
						h.prodcode=@ProdCode and h.prodcode=d.prodcode and 
						d.icode = RD.ICode AND 
						d.prodcode=b.prodcode and b.prodrowid = d.rowid and
						h.issueinvcode = isd.issueinvcode and
						isd.icode = b.icode)
				ELSE 
					CASE @pricetype WHEN 1 THEN Round(I.SalePrice/I.PackUnits , 2) WHEN 2 THEN Round(I.SalePrice2/I.PackUnits, 2) WHEN 3 THEN Round(I.SalePrice3/I.PackUnits , 2) WHEN 4 THEN Round(I.PurPrice/I.PackUnits , 2) WHEN 5 THEN Round(I.RecentPurPrice/I.PackUnits, 2) WHEN 6 THEN Round(I.AvgPrice, 2) WHEN 7 THEN Round(I.SalePrice4/I.PackUnits, 2) WHEN 8 THEN Round(I.SalePrice5/I.PackUnits , 2) END 
			END
		ELSE
			CASE @pricetype WHEN 1 THEN Round(I.SalePrice/I.PackUnits , 2) WHEN 2 THEN Round(I.SalePrice2/I.PackUnits, 2) WHEN 3 THEN Round(I.SalePrice3/I.PackUnits , 2) WHEN 4 THEN Round(I.PurPrice/I.PackUnits , 2) WHEN 5 THEN Round(I.RecentPurPrice/I.PackUnits, 2) WHEN 6 THEN Round(I.AvgPrice, 2) WHEN 7 THEN Round(I.SalePrice4/I.PackUnits, 2) WHEN 8 THEN Round(I.SalePrice5/I.PackUnits , 2) END 
		END,0)
	From  	ReceiptDetail RD, Item I
	Where   RD.ReceiptInvCode = @ReceiptInvCode AND 
		RD.ICode = I.ICode
		
	Declare Cursor_Items Cursor Forward_Only Static
	FOR	Select
		RD.GCode, RD.ICode, RD.Batch, RD.Expiry,
		Sum(RD.Qty) As Qty , 
		Max(RD.PackUnits) As PackUnits ,
		Max(RD.PurchasePrice) As PurPrice ,
		Max(RD.SalePrice) As SalePrice ,
		Max(RD.MRPP) As RecentPurPrice ,
		CASE WHEN @IssueInvCode > 0 THEN 
			CASE @RecomputeCost
				WHEN 'Y' THEN 
					(SELECT SUM(isd.qty * isd.price) / CASE WHEN Sum(RD.Qty) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE Sum(RD.Qty) END
					FROM
						ProdHeader h, ProdBuffer b, ProdDetail d, IssueDetail isd
					WHERE 
						h.prodcode=@ProdCode and h.prodcode=d.prodcode and 
						d.icode = RD.ICode AND 
						d.prodcode=b.prodcode and b.prodrowid = d.rowid and
						h.issueinvcode = isd.issueinvcode and
						isd.icode = b.icode)
				ELSE 
					CASE @pricetype WHEN 1 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 2 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice2)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 3 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice3)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 4 THEN Round(Max(I.PurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 5 THEN Round(Max(I.RecentPurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 6 THEN Round(Max(I.AvgPrice), 2) WHEN 7 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice4)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 8 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice5)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) END 
			END
		ELSE
			CASE @pricetype WHEN 1 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 2 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice2)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 3 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice3)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 4 THEN Round(Max(I.PurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 5 THEN Round(Max(I.RecentPurPrice)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 6 THEN Round(Max(I.AvgPrice), 2) WHEN 7 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice4)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) WHEN 8 THEN Round(Max(I.SalePrice5)/Max(I.PackUnits) , 2) END 
		END As Price
	From  	ReceiptDetail RD, Item I
	Where   RD.ReceiptInvCode = @ReceiptInvCode AND 
		RD.ICode = I.ICode
	Group By RD.GCode, RD.ICode, RD.Batch, RD.Expiry

	Open Cursor_Items
	Set @Items_Rows = @@Cursor_Rows
	IF @Items_Rows > 0 
	Begin
		Fetch Next From Cursor_Items
		Into @Gcode, @icode, @Batch, @Expiry, @givenqty, @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice, @price
		While @@Fetch_Status = 0 AND @continue >= 0
		Begin
			Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
			Begin
				Set @continue  = -1
			End
			Else
			Begin
				Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @utn OutPut
				IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
				Begin
					Set @continue  = -1															
				End 									
				Set @packunits = Case When @packunits Is Null Then 1 When @packunits = 0 Then 1 Else @packunits End

				Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemStockAll @ICode, @TotStock OutPut
				IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
				Begin
					Set @continue  = -1															
				End

				IF @UpdateAvgPrice = 'Y'
				BEGIN
					SET	@NewAvgPrice = ISNULL((SELECT ROUND(( (@TotStock * @hold_avgprice) + (@givenqty * @price)) / (@givenqty + @TotStock), 5) ), 0)
					Execute @rt_code = sp_UpdateItemAvgPrice @ICode, @NewAvgPrice
					IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
					Begin
						Set @continue  = -1															
					End
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @NewAvgPrice = @hold_avgprice
				END

				IF @continue <> -1
				BEGIN
					Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @currqty Output
					IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
					Begin
						Set @continue  = -1																	
					End 
					Else
					Begin
						Set @newqty = @currqty + @givenqty	
						Execute @rt_code = sp_UpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty
						IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
						Begin
							Set @continue  = -1								
						End
					End
				END
			End
			Fetch Next From Cursor_Items
			Into @gcode, @icode, @Batch, @Expiry, @givenqty , @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice, @price
		End
	End
	Close Cursor_Items
	Deallocate Cursor_Items

	IF @continue = 0

		WHERE ReceiptInvCode = @ReceiptInvCode
	END
END

IF @continue <> 0 
Begin
	Return -1
End
Else
Begin 
	Return 0
End

	END

	BEGIN
		RaisError('Unable to Generate Doctor share based Purchase of Service for Service Invoice Code = %d' , 16 , 1, @ServiceInvCode)

	END

	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Unable to Generate Service Purchase Template for Service Invoice Code = %d' , 16 , 1, @ServiceInvCode)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @ai_list = @ai_list + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@ServiceInvCode,10))) + ','
	SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
END

IF Right(@ai_list,1) = ','
	SET @ai_list = LEFT(@ai_list, LEN(@ai_list) - 1)

EXECUTE @rt_code = DBO.SP_CreateAutoTriggerSMS @ai_list, @PatientModule, 'Posting'
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Unable to Create Auto Trigger SMS on Service Posting' , 16 , 1)
	RETURN -1
END

RETURN 0

Set @rt_code = (Select count(*) From AdjBufferHeader Where AdjBufferCode = @adjbuffercode And Posted = 'Y')
IF @rt_code > 0 
	Return 0
Set @continue  = 0
Set @gcode = ( Select GCode From AdjBufferHeader Where AdjBufferCode = @adjbuffercode )
Set @module = ( Select module From Module Where Name = 'Adjustment' )
Set @defaultbatch = DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'defaultbatch' )
Set @defaultexpiry = DBO.Fn_Get_DateTime_Preference( 'defaultexpiry' )
SET @UpdateAvgPrice = DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'UpdAvgPriceInAdjInc' )

Declare Cursor_AdjInc_Items Cursor Forward_Only Static
For Select AdjBufferDetail.icode, (stockonshelf - stockinhand) As GivenQty, packunits, purprice, saleprice, recentpurprice, AlternateCustomICode
      From AdjBufferDetail Inner Join Item On AdjBufferDetail.icode = Item.icode
      Where AdjBufferCode = @adjbuffercode AND
                (stockonshelf - stockinhand) > 0
      Order by rowid

Open Cursor_AdjInc_Items
Set @AdjInc_Items_Rows = @@Cursor_Rows
IF @AdjInc_Items_Rows > 0 
Begin
	Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'AdjHeader' , @adjIncCode Output
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	Begin
		Set @continue  = -1
	End
	Else
	Begin
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno , @module,  @headerinvno Output 
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
		Else
		Begin
			Insert Into AdjHeader (AdjCode, AdjCatCode, UserCode, Remarks, Date, ModifiedDate, ModifiedBy, Posted, PostedDate, PostedBy, HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo)
			Values (@adjIncCode, 1, @usercode, 			@remarks, @serverdate, @serverdate, Null, 'Y', @serverdate, @usercode, @headerno, @headerinvno)
			Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
			IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
			Begin 
				RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Adjustment Increase Header for Stock Adjustment : %d' ,16,1,  @AdjBufferCode  )
				Set @continue  = -1
			End 
			Else
			Begin
				Fetch Next From Cursor_AdjInc_Items
				Into @icode, @givenqty, @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice, @AlternateCustomICode
				While @@Fetch_Status = 0 AND @continue >= 0
				Begin
					Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
					IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
					Begin
						Set @continue  = -1
					End
					Else
					Begin
						Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @adjutn OutPut
						IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
						Begin
							Set @continue  = -1															
						End 									
						
						Set @packunits = Case When @packunits Is Null Then 1 When @packunits = 0 Then 1 Else @packunits End
						IF @hold_avgprice Is Null Or @hold_avgprice = 0 
							Set @price = @purprice / @packunits
						Else
							Set @price = Cast( @hold_avgprice As Numeric(8,2) )

						Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemStockAll @ICode, @TotStock OutPut
						IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
						Begin
							Set @continue  = -1															
						End

						IF @UpdateAvgPrice = 'Y'
						BEGIN
							SET	@NewAvgPrice = ISNULL((SELECT ROUND(((@TotStock * @hold_avgprice) + (@givenqty * @price)) / (@givenqty + @TotStock), 5) ), 0)
							Execute @rt_code = sp_UpdateItemAvgPrice @ICode, @NewAvgPrice
							IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
							Begin
								Set @continue  = -1															
							End
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @NewAvgPrice = @hold_avgprice
						END

						IF @continue <> -1
						BEGIN
							Insert Into AdjDetail (AdjCode, GCode, ICode, Batch, Expiry, Looseqty, Priority, Price, AvgPrice, PackUnits, SalePrice, PurPrice, RecentPurPrice, AdjUtn, UpdateAvgPrice, NewAvgPrice, CurrStock , AlternateCustomICode)
							Values(@adjIncCode, @GCode, @ICode, @defaultbatch, @defaultexpiry, @givenqty, 0, @price,  @hold_avgprice, @packunits, @saleprice, @purprice, @recentpurprice, @adjutn, @UpdateAvgPrice, @NewAvgPrice, @TotStock, @AlternateCustomICode)
	
							Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
							IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
							Begin 
								RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Adjustment Increase Detail for Stock Adjustment : %d' ,16,1,  @AdjBufferCode  )
								Set @continue  = -1
							End 							
							Else
							Begin
								Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @defaultbatch, @defaultexpiry, @currqty Output
								IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
								Begin
									Set @continue  = -1																	
								End 
								Else
								Begin
									Set @newqty = @currqty + @givenqty	
									Execute @rt_code = sp_UpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @defaultbatch, @defaultexpiry, @newqty
									IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
									Begin
										Set @continue  = -1								
									End
								End
							End
						END
					End
					Fetch Next From Cursor_AdjInc_Items
					Into @icode, @givenqty, @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice, @AlternateCustomICode
				End
			End
		End
	End	
End

Close Cursor_AdjInc_Items
Deallocate Cursor_AdjInc_Items
IF @continue <> 0 
Begin
	Return -1
End
Else
Begin
	Set @continue  = 0
	Declare Cursor_AdjDec_Items Cursor Forward_Only Static
	For Select AdjBufferDetail.icode, ABS(stockonshelf - stockinhand) As GivenQty, packunits, purprice, saleprice, recentpurprice, AlternateCustomICode
	      From AdjBufferDetail Inner Join Item On AdjBufferDetail.icode = Item.icode
	      Where AdjBufferCode = @adjbuffercode AND
		    stockonshelf <> stockinhand AND	
                    (stockonshelf - stockinhand) <= 0
	      Order by rowid
	
	Open Cursor_AdjDec_Items
	Set @AdjDec_Items_Rows = @@Cursor_Rows
	IF @AdjDec_Items_Rows > 0 
	Begin
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'AdjHeader' , @adjDecCode Output
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
		Else
		Begin
			Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno , @module,  @headerinvno Output 
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
			Begin
				Set @continue  = -1
			End
			Else
			Begin
				Insert Into AdjHeader (AdjCode, AdjCatCode, UserCode, Remarks, Date, ModifiedDate, ModifiedBy, Posted, PostedDate, PostedBy, HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo)
				Values (@adjDecCode, 2, @usercode, @remarks, @serverdate, @serverdate, Null, 'Y', @serverdate, @usercode, @headerno, @headerinvno)
				Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
				IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
				Begin 
					RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Adjustment Decrease for Stock Adjustment : %d' ,16,1,  @AdjBufferCode  )
					Set @continue  = -1
				End 
				Else
				Begin
					Fetch Next From Cursor_AdjDec_Items
					Into @icode, @givenqty, @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice, @AlternateCustomICode
					While @@Fetch_Status = 0 AND @continue >= 0
					Begin
						Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
						IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
						Begin
							Set @continue  = -1
						End
						Else
						Begin
							Set @packunits = Case When @packunits Is Null Then 1 When @packunits = 0 Then 1 Else @packunits End
							Set @totalqty = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and godowndetail.icode = @icode  )
							IF @totalqty >= @givenqty 
							Begin 
								Set @reqqty = @givenqty
								Declare ItemBatch_Cursor Cursor Static Forward_Only
								For 	Select  batch, expiry, Currqty 
									From    godowndetail 
									Where  godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and
										    godowndetail.icode = @icode 
									Order by priority, expiry, Currqty
	
								Open ItemBatch_Cursor
								Set @totalrows = @@Cursor_Rows
								Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
								Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
								Set @counter = 1	
								While @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @counter <= @totalrows AND @reqqty > 0
								Begin
									Set @batchqty = @currqty
									IF @batchqty >= @ReqQty 
										Set @delqty = @reqqty
									Else
										Set @delqty = @batchqty
									Set @reqqty = @reqqty - @delqty

									Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @adjutn Output
									IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
									Begin
										Set @continue  = -1															
									End 									

									Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemStockAll @ICode, @TotStock OUTPUT
									IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
									Begin
										Set @continue  = -1															
									End
			
									SET @NewAvgPrice = @hold_avgprice

									Insert Into AdjDetail (AdjCode, GCode, ICode, Batch, Expiry, Looseqty, Priority, Price, AvgPrice, PackUnits, SalePrice, PurPrice, RecentPurPrice, AdjUtn, UpdateAvgPrice, NewAvgPrice, CurrStock, AlternateCustomICode)
									Values(@adjDecCode, @GCode, @ICode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty, 0, @hold_avgprice, @hold_avgprice, @packunits, @saleprice, @purprice, @recentpurprice, @adjutn, @UpdateAvgPrice, @NewAvgPrice, @TotStock, @AlternateCustomICode)
									Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
									IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
									Begin 
										RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Adjustment Decrease Detail for Stock Adjustment : %d' ,16,1, @AdjBufferCode  )
										Set @continue  = -1
									End 							
									Else
									Begin
										Set @newqty = @currqty - @delqty
										IF @newqty > 0
											Execute @rt_code = sp_SaleUpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty , @currqty
										Else
											Execute @rt_code = sp_DeleteItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty
										IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
										Begin
											Set @continue  = -1								
										End
									End
									Set @counter = @counter + 1
									Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
									Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
								End
								Close ItemBatch_Cursor
								Deallocate ItemBatch_Cursor
							End
							Else
							Begin
								Set @itemname = (Select name from item where icode = @icode )	
								RaisError( 'Not enough stock for item (%s) to decrease for Stock Adjusment : %d' , 16 , 1, @itemname, @AdjBufferCode  )
								Set @continue  = -1								
							End
						End
						Fetch Next From Cursor_AdjDec_Items
						Into @icode, @givenqty, @packunits, @purprice, @saleprice, @recentpurprice, @AlternateCustomICode
					End
				End
			End
		End	
	End

	Close Cursor_AdjDec_Items
	Deallocate Cursor_AdjDec_Items
	IF @continue <> 0 
	Begin
		Return -1
	End
	Else
	Begin 
		Update AdjBufferHeader
		Set Posted = 'Y' , PostedBy = @usercode, PostedDate = GetDate(), AdjIncCode = Case When @AdjInc_Items_Rows > 0 Then @AdjIncCode Else Null End , AdjDecCode = Case When @AdjDec_Items_Rows > 0 Then @adjdecCode Else Null End
		Where AdjBufferCode = @AdjBufferCode
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @@RowCount = 0 
		Begin
			RaisError('Posting fail for Stock Adjustment (%d) due to updation problem.' , 16 , 1 , @AdjBufferCode)
			Return -1
		End
		IF @adjIncCode > 0
		BEGIN
			IF (SELECT A=DBO.Fn_GetPreference('IncAdjInActMonitor')) = 'Y'
			BEGIN
				Execute @rt_code = SP_UpdateActivityMonitor 'AI', @adjIncCode
				IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
				BEGIN
					RaisError('Posting fail for Stock Adjustment (%d) due to activity monitor updation problem.' , 16 , 1 , @AdjBufferCode)
					Return -1
				END
			END
		END

		IF @adjdecCode > 0
		BEGIN
			IF (SELECT A=DBO.Fn_GetPreference('IncAdjInActMonitor')) = 'Y'
			BEGIN
				Execute @rt_code = SP_UpdateActivityMonitor 'AD', @adjdecCode
				IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
				BEGIN
					RaisError('Posting fail for Stock Adjustment (%d) due to activity monitor updation problem.' , 16 , 1 , @AdjBufferCode)
					Return -1
				END
			END
		END

		Return 0
	End
End

-- SP_PostStudentFeeSheet
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_PostStudentFeeSheet
	@ai_Code integer, 
	@ai_UserCode integer
AS
DECLARE @RowID INT, @TotRows INT, @rt_code INT, @ServiceInvCode INT, @ClassCode INT, @StudentCode INT, @RollNo VARCHAR(40), @ServiceCode INT
DECLARE @Remarks VARCHAR(100), @Fee NUMERIC(15,2), @FlatDisc NUMERIC(15,2), @DiscPerc NUMERIC(5,2), @UserCode SMALLINT, @ServiceTemplate INT, @ServiceTemplateCode INT
DECLARE @errcode INT, @end_invcode INT, @FeeDay INT, @Today INT, @DueDate DATETIME, @NewDueDate DATETIME, @NetAmount NUMERIC(15,2)

SET @UserCode = @ai_UserCode

Declare C1 Cursor Forward_Only Static
FOR	
SELECT D.StudentCode, D.ClassCode, D.RollNo, NetAmount=SUM(((D.Fee - D.FlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01))), S.Remarks, D.ServiceTemplateCode, D.DueDate
FROM StudentFeeSheetDetail D, StudentFeeSheet S, Class C, Student ST
WHERE S.StudentFeeSheetCode=@ai_Code AND S.StudentFeeSheetCode=D.StudentFeeSheetCode AND
	D.ClassCode = C.ClassCode AND D.StudentCode = ST.StudentCode AND
	((D.Fee - D.FlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) > 0
GROUP BY D.ClassCode, C.Name, D.RollNo, D.StudentCode, ST.Name, S.Remarks, D.ServiceTemplateCode, D.DueDate
ORDER BY C.Name, D.RollNo, ST.Name

Open C1
Set @TotRows = @@Cursor_Rows
IF @TotRows > 0 
BEGIN
	Fetch Next From C1
	Into @StudentCode, @ClassCode, @RollNo, @NetAmount, @Remarks, @ServiceTemplateCode, @DueDate
	While @@Fetch_Status = 0
	Begin
		SET @NewDueDate = @DueDate

		IF @NewDueDate IS NULL
		BEGIN
			SET @FeeDay = ISNULL((SELECT Class.FeeDueOn FROM Class WHERE Class.ClassCode = @ClassCode), 1)
			SET @Today = (SELECT DAY(GETDATE()))
			IF @Today >= @FeeDay 
			BEGIN
				IF MONTH(GETDATE()) < 12
					SET @DueDate = CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(GETDATE()), 7))) + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(GETDATE()) + 1, 7))) + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@FeeDay, 7))) AS DateTime)
				ELSE
					SET @DueDate = CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(GETDATE()) + 1, 7))) + '-' + '01' + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@FeeDay, 7))) AS DateTime)
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @DueDate = CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(YEAR(GETDATE()), 7))) + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(MONTH(GETDATE()), 7))) + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@FeeDay, 7))) AS DateTime)
			END
		END
		ELSE
			SET @DueDate = @NewDueDate
	
		SET @DueDate = ISNULL(@DueDate, GETDATE())

		SET @errcode = 0
		EXECUTE @errcode = SP_LockTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @ServiceInvCode OUTPUT
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Problem while Fetching ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
		SET @ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode + 1
	
		INSERT INTO ServiceHeader (ServiceInvCode, CustCode, SalesManCode, ServiceCatCode,
			Remarks, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, Date, 
			PostedBy, PostDate, HeaderNo, DiscPerc, 
			FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SaleInvCode, Posted, ReprintingCounter,
			ServiceOCode, CashReceived, CashTendered, CashCharged, CashBack, 
			StudentCode, DueDate)
		SELECT
			@ServiceInvCode, CustCode=S.CustCode, SalesManCode=@UserCode, SerivceCatCode=11,
			Remarks=@Remarks, OriginalDate=GETDATE(), ModifiedBy=Null, Date=GetDate(),
			PostedBy=@UserCode, PostDate=GETDATE(), HeaderNo=1, DiscPerc=0, 
			FlatDisc=0, MiscCharges=0, SaleInvCode=NULL, Posted='Y', ReprintingCounter=0,
			ServiceOCode=Null, CashReceived=0, CashTendered=0, CashCharged=0, CashBack=0,
			StudentCode=S.StudentCode, 
			DueDate = @DueDate
		FROM	
			Student S
		WHERE
			S.StudentCode = @StudentCode
	
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceHeader', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END

		Declare C2 Cursor Forward_Only Static
		FOR	
		SELECT D.ServiceCode, D.Fee, D.FlatDisc, D.DiscPerc, D.RowID
		FROM StudentFeeSheetDetail D, StudentFeeSheet S, Class C, Student ST
		WHERE S.StudentFeeSheetCode=@ai_Code AND S.StudentFeeSheetCode=D.StudentFeeSheetCode AND
			D.StudentCode=@StudentCode AND D.ClassCode=@ClassCode AND D.RollNo = @RollNo AND 
			D.ClassCode = C.ClassCode AND D.StudentCode = ST.StudentCode AND
			((D.Fee - D.FlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) > 0
		ORDER BY D.RowID, ST.Name

		Open C2
		Fetch Next From C2
		Into @ServiceCode, @Fee, @FlatDisc, @DiscPerc, @RowID
		While @@Fetch_Status = 0
		Begin
			INSERT INTO ServiceDetail (ServiceInvCode, ServiceCode, SManCode, Qty, Price, ServiceFlatDisc, DiscPerc, Remarks)
			SELECT @ServiceInvCode, @ServiceCode, SManCode=1, Qty=1, SalePrice=@Fee, ServiceFlatDisc=CASE WHEN ROUND((@Fee - @FlatDisc) * (1 - @DiscPerc * 0.01),2) > 0 THEN @FlatDisc ELSE @Fee END, DiscPerc=@DiscPerc, @Remarks
		
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
			BEGIN
				RaisError('Problem while Inserting Record in ServiceDetail', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END
		
			UPDATE StudentClass
			SET LastServiceInvDate = GETDATE(), ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode
			FROM StudentClass 
			WHERE ClassCode = @ClassCode AND StudentCode = @StudentCode
		
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
			BEGIN
				RaisError('Problem in Updating Student Fee Record', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END

			Fetch Next From C2
			Into @ServiceCode, @Fee, @FlatDisc, @DiscPerc, @RowID
		END
		CLOSE C2
		DEALLOCATE C2

		SET @errcode = 0
		EXECUTE @errcode = SP_UpdateTabMaxkey 'ServiceHeader' , @ServiceInvCode
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Problem while Updating ServiceHeader Key Value', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
	
		UPDATE ServiceHeader 
		SET InvTotal = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(ServiceInvCode), 0)
		WHERE ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode
	
		UPDATE ServiceHeader 
		SET OutStandingAmt = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(ServiceInvCode), 0)
		WHERE ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode

		UPDATE StudentFeeSheetDetail SET ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode
		WHERE StudentFeeSheetCode=@ai_code AND StudentCode=@StudentCode AND ClassCode = @ClassCode AND RollNo = @RollNo

		Fetch Next From C1
		Into @StudentCode, @ClassCode, @RollNo, @NetAmount, @Remarks, @ServiceTemplateCode, @DueDate
	END
	UPDATE StudentFeeSheet SET Posted='Y', PostedBy = @ai_userCode, PostedON=GETDATE()
	WHERE StudentFeeSheetCode = @ai_Code
END
CLOSE C1
DEALLOCATE C1

RETURN 0

UPDATE AdjBufferHeader SET Posted='Y', PostedDate=GetDate(), PostedBy=1 WHERE Posted='N'

Select @errorno = @@error,  @rowsaffected = @@rowcount      
IF @errorno <> 0
BEGIN   
	RAISERROR('Error Posting Some service Invoices.', 16, 1)
	Return @errorno    
END

CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_PostVisit
	@ai_sVisitCode INTEGER,

AS

IF @ai_DoctCode=0 OR @ai_DoctCode IS NULL
BEGIN
	UPDATE VisitAppointment

	WHERE AppointmentCode IN 
		(SELECT DISTINCT AppointmentCode
		FROM Visit

	SET Posted   = 'Y'
	WHERE VisitCode Between @ai_sVisitCode AND @ai_lVisitCode AND

		DoctCode IN 
			(SELECT UAD.DoctCode FROM UserAllowedDoctor UAD 
			WHERE UAD.UserCode = @ai_UserCode)

	UPDATE VisitAppointment

-- SP_PrepareDataMigrationPacket
CREATE   PROCEDURE DBO.SP_PrepareDataMigrationPacket @Svr VARCHAR(255), @DB VARCHAR(255), @PacketFile VARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @PacketName VARCHAR(255), @Path VARCHAR(4000), @Qry VARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @Pos INT, @rtCode INT, @err INT, @RC INT
DECLARE @VersionInfo varchar(4000), @DBVersion VARCHAR(100)

SET @PacketName = REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(),120), ':','') + '-' + @DB + '.PKT'
SET @Path = DBO.fn_GetPreference('outputfilepath') + @PacketName
SET @Pos = CHARINDEX('\', @SVR, 1)
IF @Pos > 0
	SET @Svr = LOWER(LEFT(@Svr, @Pos - 1))
ELSE
	SET @Svr = LOWER(@Svr)
	
-- Set parameter values
EXEC @RC = SP_DBMS_Version @VersionInfo OUTPUT 
IF CHARINDEX('Microsoft SQL Server 2012', @VersionInfo, 1) > 0 
	SET @DBVersion = '2012'
ELSE
	SET @DBVersion = '2000'

IF @DBVersion = '2012'
	SET @Qry = 'BACKUP DATABASE ' + @DB + ' TO DISK = ''' + @Path + ''' WITH INIT'
ELSE
	SET @Qry = 'BACKUP DATABASE ' + @DB + ' TO DISK = ''' + @Path + ''' WITH INIT, MEDIAPASSWORD = ''alcia' + @SVR + ''', PASSWORD = ''alfia' + @SVR + ''''

EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@Error
IF @err <> 0 OR @rtCode <> 0 
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Unable to Generate Data Migration Packet from Database %s, Error Code = %d', 16, 1, @DB, @err)
	RETURN -1
END
SET @PacketFile = @Path
RETURN 0

-- SP_PromoteClass
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_PromoteClass @PromotionCode INT
AS
DECLARE @Promotedstudents INT, @err INT

SET @Promotedstudents = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ClassPromotionDetail WHERE PromotionCode=@PromotionCode AND Promote = 'Y'), 0)
IF @Promotedstudents <= 0
	RETURN 0

DECLARE @StudentList TABLE (PromoteClassFrom INT, PromoteClassTo INT, StudentCode INT, RollNo VARCHAR(40), RowID INT, ThisID INT IDENTITY(1,1))

INSERT INTO @StudentList (PromoteClassFrom, PromoteClassTo, StudentCode, RollNo, RowID)
SELECT C.PromoteClassFrom, PromoteClassTo, D.StudentCode, D.RollNo, D.RowID
FROM 
	ClassPromotion C , ClassPromotionDetail D
WHERE 
	C.PromotionCode=@PromotionCode AND 
	C.PromotionCode = D.PromotionCode AND
	Promote = 'Y'
ORDER BY D.RowID

SET @Promotedstudents = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @StudentList), 0)
IF @Promotedstudents <= 0
	RETURN 0

DECLARE @ThisID INT, @StudentCode INT, @ClassCode INT, @RollNo VARCHAR(40), @RowID INT, @ClassFrom INT
SET @ThisID=1
WHILE @ThisID <= @Promotedstudents
BEGIN
	SET @ClassFrom = (SELECT PromoteClassFrom FROM @StudentList WHERE ThisID = @ThisID)
	SET @ClassCode = (SELECT PromoteClassTo FROM @StudentList WHERE ThisID = @ThisID)
	SET @StudentCode = (SELECT StudentCode FROM @StudentList WHERE ThisID = @ThisID)
	SET @RollNo = (SELECT RollNo FROM @StudentList WHERE ThisID = @ThisID)
	SET @RowID = (SELECT RowID FROM @StudentList WHERE ThisID = @ThisID)

	EXECUTE @err = DBO.SP_Admit_Student @ClassCode, @StudentCode, @RollNo OUTPUT
	IF @err <> 0 OR @@Error <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Can Not Admit student in the specified class', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	UPDATE StudentClass 
	SET PromotionRowID = @RowID
	WHERE ClassCode = @ClassFrom AND StudentCode = @StudentCode
	IF @@RowCount = 0 AND @@Error <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Can Not Update Record for Admitted student in the specified class', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @ThisID = @ThisID + 1
END

UPDATE Class SET Promoted = 'Y' WHERE ClassCode = @ClassFrom

RETURN 0

name: sp_purchase_rate_comparison
definition:
-- sp_purchase_rate_comparison
CREATE  PROCEDURE dbo.sp_purchase_rate_comparison 
@start_date DATETIME, 
@end_date DATETIME, 
@purchase_category CHAR(1), 
@ReportGrouping CHAR(1), 
@GroupList Varchar(8000)
AS
/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of
	purchase rates of items selected depending upon the grouping criteria selected.

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@ar_startdate, @ar_enddate = Determine the period of report
	@purchase_category Determine the Purchase 
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items in report
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
*/

DECLARE @date DATETIME
DECLARE @PurCatCode INT, @Icode INT, @purinvcode INT, @qty int, @packunits int, @flag int
DECLARE @inner_counter INT, @Icode2 INT, @PurinvCode2 INT
DECLARE @CustomIcode VarChar(60), @Item VARCHAR(100), @supplier VARCHAR(100), @GroupName VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @utn BIGINT, @utn2 BIGINT
DECLARE @purprice NUMERIC(15,2), @purprice2 NUMERIC(15,2), @SalePrice NUMERIC(15,2), @SalePrice2 NUMERIC(15,2)
DECLARE @inv1 INT, @price1 NUMERIC(15,2), @inv2 INT, @price2 NUMERIC(15,2)
DECLARE @inv3 INT, @price3 NUMERIC(15,2), @inv4 INT, @price4 NUMERIC(15,2)
DECLARE @Sprice1 NUMERIC(15,2), @Sprice2 NUMERIC(15,2), @Sprice3 NUMERIC(15,2), @Sprice4 NUMERIC(15,2)

DELETE ReportData

DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

DECLARE abc CURSOR FOR  
SELECT
	GroupName=CASE @ReportGrouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
		WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
		WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
		ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,   
	P.Date, P.PurCatCode, P.ICode, I.CustomIcode, Item=I.Name, Supplier=A.Name,
	P.PurInvCode, P.NetRate, Qty=P.Qty+P.Bonus, P.PackUnits, 0, UTN=P.PurUtn, P.SalePrice
FROM   
	(SELECT PL.Date, PL.PurCatCode, PD.Icode, PL.PurInvCode,
		NETRATE=MAX((PD.PurPrice * (PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty) * 
		     (1 - PD.DiscPerc * .01) * ( 1 - PL.discperc * .01 ) +
		     (PD.unitsalestax * ( PD.Looseqty + PD.PackQty + PD.bonusqty )) +
		      Round( PD.PurPrice * (PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty) * (1 - PD.DiscPerc * .01) * 0.01 * PD.gstperc, 2) +
		    ( Round((     Round(       Round(PD.PurPrice * (PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty) * (1 - PD.DiscPerc * .01),2) * (1 -  PL.discperc * 0.01),2) - PL.flatdisc) * 0.01 * PL.invgstperc1 ,2)) ) / (PD.Looseqty + PD.PackQty + PD.bonusqty)), 
		Qty=SUM(PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty), Bonus=SUM(PD.BonusQTY), PL.SuppCode, PD.PackUnits, PurUtn=max(PD.PurUtn),
		SalePrice=PD.SalePriceForItem
	FROM  PurLedger PL, PurDetail PD, (SELECT ICode = Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) TL
	WHERE PL.POSTED = 'Y' AND     
		PL.PurCatCode >= CASE @purchase_category WHEN 'P' THEN 1 WHEN 'L' THEN 3 END AND
		PL.PurCatCode <= CASE @purchase_category WHEN 'P' THEN 2 WHEN 'L' THEN 8 END AND
		PL.DATE BETWEEN @start_date AND @end_date AND
		PL.PurInvCode = PD.PurInvCode AND
		PD.ICode = TL.ICode
	GROUP BY  
		PL.PurInvCode,
		PD.Icode,
		PL.Date,
		PL.PurCatCode,
		PL.SuppCode,
		PD.PurPrice,
		PD.PackUnits,
		PD.SalePriceForItem) P, 
	Item I, Accounts A  
WHERE   P.SuppCode = A.AccCode AND   P.ICode = I.Icode  
ORDER BY   P.Date, P.PurCatCode, P.PurInvCode, I.Name, UTN    

OPEN abc    
FETCH NEXT FROM abc INTO @GroupName, @date, @PurCatCode, @Icode, @CustomIcode, @Item, @supplier, @purinvcode, @purprice, @qty, @packunits, @flag, @utn, @SalePrice
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0  
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (name5, name4, date1, Code1, code2, name1, name2, name3, code3, value1, value2, value3, code4, value4, Value9)
	VALUES (@ReportGrouping, @GroupName, @date, @PurCatCode, @Icode, @CustomIcode, @Item, @supplier, @purinvcode, @purprice, @qty, @packunits, @flag, @utn, @SalePrice)

	SELECT @inv1=NULL, @price1=NULL, @inv2=NULL, @price2=NULL, @inv3=NULL, @price3=NULL, @inv4=NULL, @price4=NULL, @Sprice1 = NULL, @Sprice2 = NULL, @Sprice3 = NULL, @Sprice4 = NULL
	SET ROWCOUNT 4
	SELECT @inner_counter = 0

	DECLARE xyz CURSOR FOR   
	SELECT PD.Icode, PL.PurInvCode, 
		NETRATE=MAX((PD.PurPrice * (PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty) *      (1 - PD.DiscPerc * .01) * ( 1 - PL.discperc * .01 ) +      (PD.unitsalestax * ( PD.Looseqty + PD.PackQty + PD.bonusqty )) +      Round( PD.PurPrice * (PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty) * (1 - PD.DiscPerc * .01) * 0.01 * PD.gstperc, 2) +    ( Round((     Round(       Round(PD.PurPrice * (PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty) *        (1 - PD.DiscPerc * .01),2) *      (1 -  PL.discperc * 0.01),2) - PL.flatdisc) * 0.01 *  PL.invgstperc1 ,2)) ) /     (PD.Looseqty + PD.PackQty + PD.bonusqty)), 
		PD.SalePriceForItem,
		utn=Max(PD.PurUtn)
	FROM  PurLedger PL, PurDetail PD
	WHERE PL.PurInvCode <> @PurInvCode AND PL.POSTED = 'Y' AND
		PL.PurCatCode >= CASE @purchase_category WHEN 'P' THEN 1 WHEN 'L' THEN 3 END AND
		PL.PurCatCode <= CASE @purchase_category WHEN 'P' THEN 2 WHEN 'L' THEN 8 END AND 
		PD.Icode = @icode AND 
		PD.PurUtn < @utn AND 
		PL.PurInvCode = PD.PurInvCode
	GROUP BY
		PL.PurInvCode, PD.Icode, PD.PurPrice, PL.PurCatCode, PD.SalePriceForItem
	ORDER BY utn DESC

	OPEN xyz
	FETCH NEXT FROM xyz INTO @Icode2, @PurinvCode2, @purprice2, @Saleprice2, @utn2
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
	BEGIN
		SELECT @inner_counter = @inner_counter + 1
		IF @inner_counter =1
		BEGIN
			SELECT @inv1=NULL, @price1=NULL, @inv2=NULL, @price2=NULL, @inv3=NULL, @price3=NULL, @inv4=NULL, @price4=NULL, @Sprice1 = NULL, @Sprice2 = NULL, @Sprice3 = NULL, @Sprice4 = NULL
			SELECT @inv1=@PurinvCode2, @price1=@purprice2, @Sprice1 = @Saleprice2
		END
		IF @inner_counter =2
		BEGIN
			SELECT @inv2=@PurinvCode2, @price2=@purprice2, @Sprice2 = @Saleprice2
		END
		IF @inner_counter =3 
		BEGIN 
			SELECT @inv3=@PurinvCode2, @price3=@purprice2, @Sprice3 = @Saleprice2
		END      
		IF @inner_counter =4
		BEGIN     
			SELECT @inv4=@PurinvCode2, @price4=@purprice2, @Sprice4 = @Saleprice2
		END
		SELECT @Icode2=NULL, @PurinvCode2=NULL, @purprice2=NULL, @utn2=NULL, @Saleprice2=null
	
		FETCH NEXT FROM xyz INTO @Icode2, @PurinvCode2, @purprice2, @Saleprice2, @utn2
	END 

	UPDATE REPORTDATA
	SET  CODE5=@inv1, Value5=@price1, CODE6=@inv2, Value6=@price2, CODE7=@inv3, Value7=@price3, CODE8=@inv4, Value8=@price4, Value11 = @Sprice1, Value12 = @Sprice2, Value13 = @Sprice3, Value14 = @Sprice4
	WHERE value4=@utn     

	CLOSE xyz   
	DEALLOCATE xyz     

	SET ROWCOUNT 0   
	FETCH NEXT FROM abc INTO @GroupName, @date, @PurCatCode, @Icode, @CustomIcode, @Item, @supplier, @purinvcode, @purprice, @qty, @packunits, @flag, @utn, @saleprice
END  
CLOSE abc  
DEALLOCATE abc

	SaleRowID INT, DueQty NUMERIC(15, 4), SatisfiedQty NUMERIC(15, 4), 
	Stock NUMERIC(15, 4), SatisfiableQty NUMERIC(15, 4), Selected CHAR(1),
	RowID INT IDENTITY(1, 1)
)

INSERT INTO @temp_table (SaleInvCode, ItemName, ICode, GCode, SaleRowID, 
	DueQty, SatisfiedQty, Stock, SatisfiableQty, Selected)
SELECT 
	SaleInvCode, ItemName, ICode, GCode, SaleRowID, DueQty, SatisfiedQty, 
	Stock, SatisfiableQty = ISNULL(DueQty - SatisfiedQty, 0), Selected='N'
FROM
	(SELECT
		SaleInvCode=SL.SaleInvcode, 
		ItemName=I.Name,
		ICode=SD.ICode, 
		GCode=SD.GCode, 
		SaleRowID=SD.RowId, 
		DueQty=SD.LooseQty,
		SatisfiedQty = ISNULL( 
			(SELECT SUM(dsd.DueSatisfyQty) 
			FROM DueSatisfyHeader dsh, DueSatisfyDetail dsd 
			WHERE dsh.SaleInvCode = sl.SaleInvCode AND
				dsh.DueSatisfyCode = dsd.DueSatisfyCode AND
				dsd.ICode = sd.ICode AND dsd.SaleRowID = sd.RowID ), 0),
		Stock = ISNULL(
			(SELECT SUM(GD.CurrQty) FROM GodownDetail GD 
			WHERE GD.ICode = SD.ICode AND SD.GCode = GD.GCode), 0)
	FROM 
		SaleLedger SL, SaleDetail SD, Item I, 
		(SELECT DISTINCT ICode, GCode FROM DBO.PurDetail WHERE PurInvCode = @PurInvCode) P
	WHERE 
		SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode And  
		SL.Posted = 'Y'  And
		SD.ICode = I.ICode And
		SD.Due = 'D' AND
		SD.ICode = P.ICode AND
		SD.GCode = P.GCode) T
WHERE 
	(T.DueQty - T.SatisfiedQty) > 0 AND 
	T.Stock > 0
ORDER BY 
	T.ItemName,
	T.SaleInvCode

SET @totalrows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @temp_table), 0)
SET @counter = 1
SET @OldICode = -1
WHILE @totalrows > 0 AND @counter <= @totalrows
BEGIN
	SET @ICode = (SELECT ICode FROM @temp_table WHERE RowID=@counter)
	IF @ICode <> @OldICode
	BEGIN
		SET @OldICode = @ICode
		SET @TotStock = ISNULL((SELECT Stock FROM @temp_table WHERE RowID=@counter), 0)
	END

	IF @TotStock > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @SatisfiableQty = (SELECT SatisfiableQty FROM @temp_table WHERE RowID=@counter)
	
		UPDATE @temp_table SET Stock = @TotStock WHERE RowID = @counter
	
		IF @SatisfiableQty <= @TotStock
		BEGIN
			SET @TotStock = @TotStock - @SatisfiableQty
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE @temp_table SET SatisfiableQty = @TotStock WHERE RowID = @counter
			SET @TotStock = 0
		END
	
		UPDATE @temp_table SET Selected='Y' WHERE RowID = @counter
	END

	SET @counter = @counter + 1
END

DELETE @temp_table WHERE Selected='N'

SET @totalrows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @temp_table), 0)

IF @totalrows > 0
BEGIN
	EXECUTE @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'DueAdjHeader' , @DueAdjCode Output
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	BEGIN
		Set @continue  = -1
		RaisError('Unable to Generate New Due Adjustment code' , 16 , 1)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO DueAdjHeader (DueAdjCode, Date, StartDate, EndDate, Remarks, UserCode)
		VALUES (@DueAdjCode, @serverdate, '01-01-1990 00:00:00', GETDATE(), 'Auto Due Satisfied on Purchase Inv. # ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(@PurInvCode, 10))), @usercode)

		INSERT INTO DueAdjDetail (DueAdjCode, SaleInvCode, ICode, GCode, SaleRowId, DueQty, SatisfiedQty, SatisfiableQty, DueDelete)
		SELECT @DueAdjCode, SaleInvCode, ICode, GCode, SaleRowId, DueQty, SatisfiedQty, SatisfiableQty, DueDelete='N'
		FROM @temp_table

		SELECT @Err = @@ERROR, @RowCount = @@ROWCOUNT
		IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
		Begin 
			RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Due Adjustment Detail' ,16,1)
			Set @continue  = -1
		End 							

		IF @continue >= 0
		BEGIN
			EXECUTE @rt_code = sp_SatisfyDueInBulk @DueAdjCode, @UserCode, @ServerDate
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
			BEGIN
				Set @continue  = -1
				RaisError('Unable to Generate New Due Adjustment code' , 16 , 1)
			END
		END
	END
END

SET @DueCode = @DueAdjCode

RETURN @continue

-- SP_ReadDataMigrationPacket
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_ReadDataMigrationPacket @PacketFile VARCHAR(4000), @ServerName VARCHAR(100), @TempDBName VARCHAR(100)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @Qry VARCHAR(4000), @LogicalDatFl VARCHAR(4000), @LogicalLogFl VARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @rtCode INT, @err INT, @RC INT
DECLARE @VersionInfo varchar(4000), @DBVersion VARCHAR(100)

EXEC @RC = SP_DBMS_Version @VersionInfo OUTPUT 
IF CHARINDEX('Microsoft SQL Server 2012', @VersionInfo, 1) > 0 
	SET @DBVersion = '2012'
ELSE
	SET @DBVersion = '2000'

IF @DBVersion = '2012'
	SET @Qry = 'RESTORE FILELISTONLY FROM DISK = ''' + @PacketFile + ''''
ELSE
	SET @Qry = 'RESTORE FILELISTONLY FROM DISK = ''' + @PacketFile + ''' WITH MEDIAPASSWORD = ''alcia' + LOWER(@ServerName) + ''', PASSWORD = ''alfia' + LOWER(@ServerName) + ''''

CREATE TABLE #backupinfo (LogicalFile VARCHAR(500), PhysicalFile VARCHAR(1000), Type CHAR(1), FG VARCHAR(100), Sz BIGINT, MaxSz BIGINT)

INSERT INTO #backupinfo 
EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@Error
IF @err <> 0 OR @rtCode <> 0 
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Failure to Read Logical File Names From Data Migration Packet, Error Code = %d', 16, 1, @err)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @LogicalDatFl = ISNULL((SELECT LogicalFile FROM #backupinfo WHERE Type = 'D'), 'MehmoodDatabase_Data')
SET @LogicalLogFl = ISNULL((SELECT LogicalFile FROM #backupinfo WHERE Type = 'L'), 'MehmoodDatabase_Log')

IF @DBVersion = '2012'
	SET @Qry = 'RESTORE DATABASE ' + @TempDBName + ' FROM DISK = ''' + @PacketFile + ''' WITH RECOVERY, REPLACE, MOVE ''' + @LogicalDatFl + ''' TO ''C:\' + @TempDBName + '_DM.MDF'', MOVE ''' + @LogicalLogFl + ''' TO ''C:\' + @TempDBName + '_DM_Log.LDF'''
ELSE
	SET @Qry = 'RESTORE DATABASE ' + @TempDBName + ' FROM DISK = ''' + @PacketFile + ''' WITH RECOVERY, REPLACE, MEDIAPASSWORD = ''alcia' + LOWER(@ServerName) + ''', PASSWORD = ''alfia' + LOWER(@ServerName) + ''', MOVE ''' + @LogicalDatFl + ''' TO ''C:\' + @TempDBName + '_DM.MDF'', MOVE ''' + @LogicalLogFl + ''' TO ''C:\' + @TempDBName + '_DM_Log.LDF'''

EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@Error
IF @err <> 0 OR @rtCode <> 0 
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Failure to Read Data Migration Packet, Error Code = %d', 16, 1, @err)
	RETURN -1
END

RETURN 0

-- SP_ReGenerateServiceResult
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_ReGenerateServiceResult @ServiceInvCode INT, @UserCode SMALLINT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @tot_services INT, @ServiceResultCode INT, @ServiceCode INT, @PatientCode INT, @GestationCode SMALLINT
DECLARE @Posted CHAR(1), @Expiry DateTime, @Price NUMERIC(12,2)

SET @ServiceResultCode = (SELECT MAX(ServiceResultCode) FROM ServiceResultHeader WHERE ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode)

DECLARE @start_ticket INT, @end_ticket INT, @errcode INT, @RowId INT, @In_RowID INT, @In_Qty INT, @TicketCode INT

DECLARE @service_table TABLE 
	(ServiceCode INT, Qty INT, Expiry DateTime, Price NUMERIC(12,2), Rowid INT IDENTITY(1, 1))

IF @ServiceInvCode IS NULL
	RETURN 0

IF @UserCode IS NULL
	SET @UserCode = 1

SET @Posted = ISNULL((SELECT Posted FROM ServiceHeader WHERE ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode), 'N')
IF @Posted = 'N' OR @Posted IS NULL
	RETURN 0

SET @tot_services = (SELECT servicecount=(SELECT COUNT(SD.ServiceCode) FROM ServiceDetail SD, Service SV WHERE SD.ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode AND SD.ServiceCode = SV.ServiceCode AND SV.ResultRequired='Y')
	FROM DBO.ServiceHeader
	WHERE ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode AND Posted='Y')

IF @tot_services <= 0 OR @tot_services IS NULL
	RETURN 0

SELECT @PatientCode = P.PatientCode , @GestationCode = P.GestationCode
FROM Patient P
WHERE P.PatientCode IN 
	(SELECT PatientCode=SH.PatientCode 
	FROM ServiceHeader SH WHERE SH.ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT PA.PatientCode 
	FROM PatientAdmission PA, ServiceHeader SH 
	WHERE SH.ServiceInvCode=@ServiceInvCode AND SH.AdmissionCode=PA.AdmissionCode)

DELETE ServiceResultDetail WHERE ServiceResultCode = @ServiceResultCode

INSERT INTO ServiceResultDetail (ServiceResultCode, ServiceRowID, RowID, ServiceHead,
	ServiceComponentCode, ServiceComponentUnitCode, TestMachineCode, CostPrice, SalePrice,
	Componentvalue, LowerReferenceValue, UpperReferenceValue, Comments, Remarks, Componentvalue2,
	DeliveryDate, PrintOnReport)
SELECT 
	ServiceResultCode=@ServiceResultCode,
	SrvRowID=D.SrvRowID,
	RowID=SB.ROWID,   
	ServiceHead=SB.ServiceHead,   
	ServiceComponentCode=SB.ServiceComponentCode,   
	ServiceComponentUnitCode= (SELECT S.ServiceComponentUnitCode FROM ServiceComponent S WHERE S.ServiceComponentCode = SB.ServiceComponentCode),
	TestMachineCode=1,
	CostPrice=SB.CostPrice,   
	SalePrice=SB.SalePrice,
	Componentvalue=CASE WHEN S.ServiceResultTemplate IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT MAX(SRD.ComponentValue) FROM ServiceResultDetail SRD WHERE SRD.ServiceResultCode=S.ServiceResultTemplate AND SRD.ServiceComponentCode=SB.ServiceComponentCode) END,
	LowerReferenceValue=CASE WHEN S.ServiceResultTemplate IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT MAX(SRD.LowerReferenceValue) FROM ServiceResultDetail SRD WHERE SRD.ServiceResultCode=S.ServiceResultTemplate AND SRD.ServiceComponentCode=SB.ServiceComponentCode) END,
	UpperReferenceValue=CASE WHEN S.ServiceResultTemplate IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT MAX(SRD.UpperReferenceValue) FROM ServiceResultDetail SRD WHERE SRD.ServiceResultCode=S.ServiceResultTemplate AND SRD.ServiceComponentCode=SB.ServiceComponentCode) END,
	Comments=CASE WHEN S.ServiceResultTemplate IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT MAX(SRD.Comments) FROM ServiceResultDetail SRD WHERE SRD.ServiceResultCode=S.ServiceResultTemplate AND SRD.ServiceComponentCode=SB.ServiceComponentCode) END,
	Remarks=CASE WHEN S.ServiceResultTemplate IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT MAX(SRD.Remarks) FROM ServiceResultDetail SRD WHERE SRD.ServiceResultCode=S.ServiceResultTemplate AND SRD.ServiceComponentCode=SB.ServiceComponentCode) END,
	Componentvalue2=CASE WHEN S.ServiceResultTemplate IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT MAX(SRD.ComponentValue2) FROM ServiceResultDetail SRD WHERE SRD.ServiceResultCode=S.ServiceResultTemplate AND SRD.ServiceComponentCode=SB.ServiceComponentCode) END,
	DeliveryDate=D.DeliveryDate,
	PrintOnReport=SB.PrintOnReport
FROM
	ServiceHeader H,
	ServiceDetail D,
	Service S,
	ServiceBreakUp SB   
WHERE
	H.ServiceInvCode = @ServiceInvCode AND
	H.ServiceInvCode = D.ServiceInvCode AND
	D.ServiceCode = S.ServiceCode AND
	S.ResultRequired='Y' AND
	S.ServiceCode=SB.ServiceCode
ORDER BY 
	D.SrvRowID,
	SB.ServiceHead,
	RowID

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT <= 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Inserting Service Result Detail Rows', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

UPDATE ServiceResultHeader SET Posted='N' WHERE ServiceResultCode=@ServiceResultCode

RETURN 0

-- SP_REGIONAREASALES
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_REGIONAREASALES 
	@ar_regcode INT, 
	@ar_startdate datetime, 
	@ar_enddate datetime, 
	@ReportGrouping CHAR(1), 
	@GroupList Varchar(8000),
	@pricetype INT,
	@includebonus INT AS
/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of
	areas of a region and items selected depending upon the grouping criteria selected.

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@ar_startdate, @ar_enddate = Determine the period of report
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items in report
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
	@PriceType = (1 = Actual Price, 2 = Sale price, 3 = Purchase Price, 4 = Avg. Price)
	@includebonus = (1 = Include bonusqty into sales else ignore it
*/
DELETE ReportData    
DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

DELETE ReportData    
INSERT INTO ReportData (code1, code2, code3, code4, name1, name2, name3, name4, name5, name6, name7, name8, value1, value2)  
SELECT  Code1=S.ICODE,   
	Code2=S.AREACODE,    
	Code3=S.REGIONCODE,    
	Code4=CASE @ReportGrouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN I.MANFCODE
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
		ELSE I.PACKCODE END,   
	Name1=I.NAME,   
	Name2=(SELECT AREA.SHORTNAME FROM AREA WHERE AREACODE = S.AREACODE),   
	Name3=(SELECT NAME FROM REGION WHERE REGIONCODE = S.REGIONCODE),   
	Name4=CASE @ReportGrouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
		WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
		WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
		ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,   
	Name5=I.CUSTOMICODE,   
	Name6=I.PackingDesc,
	Name7=(SELECT AREA.SHORTNAME FROM AREA WHERE AREACODE = S.AREACODE),
	Name8=RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(S.ICODE))), 
	Value1= SUM(QTY),   
	Value2 = ROUND(SUM(
				CASE @pricetype 
				WHEN 1 THEN NETAMT
				WHEN 2 THEN Qty * ROUND(I.SalePrice / CASE I.PackUnits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PackUnits END, 2)
				WHEN 3 THEN Qty * ROUND(I.PurPrice / CASE I.PackUnits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PackUnits END, 2)
				WHEN 4 THEN Qty * I.AvgPrice 
				END), 0)
FROM    
	(SELECT INVNO=-1,
		ICODE=I.ICODE,
		CUSTCODE=-1,
		QTY = 0,
		NETAMT=0,
		A.AREACODE,
		R.REGIONCODE
	FROM
		AREA A,
		REGION R,
		(SELECT ICODE=MIN(code) FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	WHERE
		R.REGIONCODE = @ar_regcode AND
		R.REGIONCODE = A.REGIONCODE
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=-1,
		ICODE=I.ICODE,
		CUSTCODE=-1,
		QTY = 0,
		NETAMT=0,
		A.AREACODE,
		A.REGIONCODE
	FROM
		(SELECT AREACODE=MIN(AREACODE), REGIONCODE FROM AREA WHERE REGIONCODE = @ar_regcode GROUP BY REGIONCODE) A,
		(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=SL.SALEINVCODE,
		SD.ICODE,
		CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
		QTY = ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + CASE WHEN @includebonus = 1 THEN SD.bonusqty ELSE 0 END), 0),
		NETAMT=Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)), 0), 2),
		C.AREACODE,
		R.REGIONCODE
	FROM
		SALELEDGER SL,
		SALEDETAIL SD,
		CUSTOMER C,
		AREA A,
		REGION R, 
		@Tab_ItemList I
	WHERE
		R.REGIONCODE = @ar_regcode AND
		R.REGIONCODE = A.REGIONCODE AND
		A.AREACODE = C.AREACODE AND
		C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND
		SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate AND
		SD.ICODE = I.CODE
	GROUP BY
		SL.SaleInvCode,
		SD.ICODE,
		SL.CustCode,
		R.REGIONCODE,
		C.AREACODE,
		SL.DiscPerc
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=SL.SRINVCODE,
		SD.ICODE,
		CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
		QTY = - ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + CASE WHEN @includebonus = 1 THEN SD.bonusqty ELSE 0 END), 0),
		NETAMT= - Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty * SD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)), 0), 2),
		C.AREACODE,
		R.REGIONCODE
	FROM
		SRLEDGER SL,
		SRDETAIL SD,
		CUSTOMER C,
		AREA A,
		REGION R, 
		@Tab_ItemList I
	WHERE
		R.REGIONCODE = @ar_regcode AND
		R.REGIONCODE = A.REGIONCODE AND
		A.AREACODE = C.AREACODE AND
		C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SRINVCODE = SD.SRINVCODE AND
		SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate AND
		SD.ICODE = I.CODE
	GROUP BY
		SL.SRInvCode,
		SD.ICODE,
		SL.CustCode,
		R.REGIONCODE,
		C.AREACODE,
		SL.DiscPerc) S,
	ITEM I,
	ITEMCATEGORY IC  
WHERE
	S.ICode = I.ICode AND I.ICatCode = IC.ICatCode AND I.ICODE IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
GROUP BY
	S.ICODE,
	S.REGIONCODE,
	S.AREACODE,
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.PackingDesc,
	I.ICatCode,
	I.ICCode,
	I.ManfCode,
	I.PackCode
