-- SP_REGIONWISESALES
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_REGIONWISESALES @ar_startdate datetime, @ar_enddate datetime, @ReportGrouping CHAR(1), @GroupList Varchar(8000), @RegionList Varchar(8000) AS 

/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of
	region and items selected depending upon the grouping criteria selected.

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@ar_startdate, @ar_enddate = Determine the period of report
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items in report
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
	@RegionList = A comma separated list of values of regioncode
*/
DELETE ReportData    
DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_RegionList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_RegionList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@RegionList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

INSERT INTO ReportData (code1, code2, code3, name1, name2, name3, name4, name5, name6, value1, value2)  
SELECT  Code1=S.ICODE,   
	Code2=S.REGIONCODE,    
	Code3=CASE @ReportGrouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN I.MANFCODE
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
		ELSE I.PACKCODE END,   
	Name1=I.NAME,   
	Name2=(SELECT NAME FROM REGION WHERE REGIONCODE = S.REGIONCODE),   
	Name3=CASE @ReportGrouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
		WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
		WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
		ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,   
	Name4=I.CUSTOMICODE,   
	Name5=I.PackingDesc,
	Name6=RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(S.ICODE))), 
	Value1= SUM(QTY),   
	Value2 = ROUND(SUM(NETAMT), 0)
FROM    
	(SELECT INVNO=-1,
		ICODE=I.ICODE,
		CUSTCODE=-1,
		QTY = 0,
		NETAMT=0,
		R.REGIONCODE
	FROM
		(SELECT RegionCode=CODE FROM @Tab_RegionList) R,
		(SELECT ICODE=MIN(code) FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=-1,
		ICODE=I.ICODE,
		CUSTCODE=-1,
		QTY = 0,
		NETAMT=0,
		R.REGIONCODE
	FROM
		(SELECT RegionCode=MIN(CODE) FROM @Tab_RegionList) R,
		(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=SL.SALEINVCODE,
		SD.ICODE,
		CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
		QTY = ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
		NETAMT=Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)), 0), 2),
		R.REGIONCODE
	FROM
		SALELEDGER SL,
		SALEDETAIL SD,
		CUSTOMER C,
		AREA A,
		(SELECT RegionCode=CODE FROM @Tab_RegionList) R,
		@Tab_ItemList I
	WHERE
		R.REGIONCODE = A.REGIONCODE AND
		A.AREACODE = C.AREACODE AND
		C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND
		SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate AND
		SD.ICODE = I.CODE
	GROUP BY
		SL.SaleInvCode,
		SD.ICODE,
		SL.CustCode,
		R.REGIONCODE,
		SL.DiscPerc
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=SL.SRINVCODE,
		SD.ICODE,
		CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
		QTY = - ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
		NETAMT= - Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty * SD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)), 0), 2),
		R.REGIONCODE
	FROM
		SRLEDGER SL,
		SRDETAIL SD,
		CUSTOMER C,
		AREA A,
		(SELECT RegionCode=CODE FROM @Tab_RegionList) R,
		@Tab_ItemList I
	WHERE
		R.REGIONCODE = A.REGIONCODE AND
		A.AREACODE = C.AREACODE AND
		C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SRINVCODE = SD.SRINVCODE AND
		SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate AND
		SD.ICODE = I.CODE
	GROUP BY
		SL.SRInvCode,
		SD.ICODE,
		SL.CustCode,
		R.REGIONCODE,
		SL.DiscPerc) S,
	ITEM I,
	ITEMCATEGORY IC  
WHERE
	S.ICode = I.ICode AND I.ICatCode = IC.ICatCode AND I.ICODE IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
GROUP BY
	S.ICODE,
	S.REGIONCODE,
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.PackingDesc,
	I.ICatCode,
	I.ICCode,
	I.ManfCode,
	I.PackCode

name: SP_Repair_NetRate_RPP
definition:
-- SP_Repair_NetRate_RPP
CREATE   PROCEDURE SP_Repair_NetRate_RPP
	@upd_NetRate_IN_Pur tinyint, @upd_RPP_IN_Pur tinyint, @upd_RPP_IN_Item tinyint
AS 
/*
Author : M. Azhar Inayat
Procedure Description:
	As the name signifies, this procedure will be used to Update 
	'NetRate', 'RecentPurPrice' in purchase invoice each line item
	Moreover it also updates the 'RecentPurPrice' column in 'Item' Table

Parameter Description:
	@upd_NetRate_IN_Pur (1 Stands for Update 'NetRate' column in 'PurDetail' Table)
	@upd_RPP_IN_Pur (1 Stands for Update 'RecentPurPrice' in 'PurDetail' Table)
	@upd_RPP_IN_Item (1 Stands for Update 'RecentPurPrice' in 'Item' Table)
*/

IF @upd_NetRate_IN_Pur = 1
BEGIN
/*
	Fetch NetRate Computations and Update Respective Rows for effective NetRate
	then use the same NetRate and assign it to NetRate column in purdetail 
*/
	UPDATE PurDetail
	SET PurDetail.NetRate = T.NetRate
	FROM
		PurDetail, 
		(SELECT
			PD.PurInvCode, PD.ICode, PD.PurRowID,
			NetRate= ROUND(((PD.ItemValue + ((PD.ItemValue / Pur.GrossValue) * Pur.InvLevelCharges)) / PD.TotQty), 5)
		FROM
			(SELECT
				P.PurInvCode,
				D.ICode,
				D.PurRowID,
				TotQty=(D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty),
				ItemValue= 
					ROUND(
						((D.LooseQty + D.PackQty) * D.PurPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * .01)) + 
						ROUND(D.UnitSalesTax * (D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty), 2) +
						ROUND((D.LooseQty + D.PackQty) * D.PurPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * .01) * D.GSTPERC * 0.01, 2), 2)
			FROM
				PurLedger P, PurDetail D
			WHERE
				P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode) PD,
			(SELECT
				PU.PurInvCode,
				InvLevelCharges=PU.MiscCharges + PU.InvGSTValue - PU.FlatDisc - PU.DiscPercValue,
				PU.GrossValue
			FROM
				(SELECT
					P.PurInvCode, 
					GrossValue= 
						SUM(ROUND(
								((D.LooseQty + D.PackQty) * D.PurPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * .01)) + 
								ROUND(D.UnitSalesTax * (D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty), 2) +
								ROUND((D.LooseQty + D.PackQty) * D.PurPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * .01) * D.GSTPERC * 0.01, 2), 2)),
					DiscPercValue= 
						SUM( 
							((D.LooseQty + D.PackQty) * D.PurPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * .01)) * P.DiscPerc * .01),
					InvGSTValue= 
						ROUND(((Round(
							SUM((D.LooseQty + D.PackQty) * D.PurPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * .01)) * 
								(1 - P.DiscPerc * 0.01), 2)) - P.FlatDisc) * P.InvGSTPERC1 * 0.01, 2),
					P.MiscCharges,
					P.FlatDisc
				FROM
					PurLedger P, PurDetail D
				WHERE
					P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode
				GROUP BY
					P.PurInvCode,
					P.DiscPerc,
					P.FlatDisc,
					P.MiscCharges,
					P.FlatDisc,
					P.InvGSTPerc1) PU) PUR
		WHERE
			PD.PurInvCode = Pur.PurInvCode) T
	WHERE
		T.PurInvCode = PurDetail.PurInvCode AND PurDetail.PurRowID = T.PurRowID
END

IF @upd_RPP_IN_Pur = 1
BEGIN
/* 
	Fetch Latest Row of Pack Purchase for each item before the current purrowid 
	then use the same max of purrowid for each item to get NetRate and
	assign it to RecentPurPrice column in purdetail 
*/
	UPDATE PurDetail
	SET RecentPurPrice = 
		ISNULL(
			CASE WHEN PREV.PREVID IS NULL THEN 0 
			ELSE (SELECT ROUND(PD.NETRATE, 2) FROM PURDETAIL PD WHERE PD.PURROWID = PREV.PREVID) 
			END
		, 0)
	FROM 
		PURDETAIL PDD
		LEFT OUTER JOIN
		(SELECT D.ICode, D.PURRowID,
			PREVID = (SELECT
				PID=MAX(DD.PurRowID)
			FROM
				PurLedger P, PurDetail DD
			WHERE
				DD.ICODE = D.ICODE AND
				DD.PurRowID < D.PurRowID AND
				P.PurInvCode = DD.PurInvCode AND 
				P.PURCATCODE IN (1, 2)
			GROUP BY 
				DD.ICode)
 
		FROM PurDetail D) PREV ON (PDD.PURROWID = PREV.PURROWID)
END

IF @upd_RPP_IN_Item = 1
BEGIN
/* 
	Fetch Latest Row of Pack Purchase for each item in item table
	then use the same max of purrowid for each item to get NetRate and
	assign it to RecentPurPrice column in Item
*/
	UPDATE Item
	SET RecentPurPrice = ISNULL(ROUND(RPP.NetRate, 2), RecentPurPrice)
	FROM 
		Item I,
		(SELECT DD.ICode, DD.NetRate 
		FROM 
			PurDetail DD,
			(SELECT
				D.ICode,
				PID=MAX(D.PurRowID)
			FROM
				PurLedger P, PurDetail D
			WHERE
				P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND 
				P.PURCATCODE IN (1, 2)
			GROUP BY 
				D.ICode) P
		WHERE DD.PurRowID = P.PID) RPP
	
	WHERE
		I.ICode = RPP.ICode
END

-- SP_RepairBatchWiseCorruptedStock
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_RepairBatchWiseCorruptedStock 
AS

DECLARE @Godown TABLE (Code INT, ID INT IDENTITY(1,1))
DECLARE @GCode INT, @RowID INT, @TotRows INT

INSERT INTO @Godown
SELECT GCode FROM Godown

DELETE ReportData

SET @TotRows = ISNULL((SELECT Count(GCode) FROM Godown), 0)

SET @RowID=1

WHILE @RowID <= @TotRows
BEGIN
	SET @GCode = (SELECT Code FROM @Godown WHERE ID = @RowID)

	DELETE ReportData

	INSERT INTO ReportData(Code1, Value1)
	SELECT 
		T.ICode, 
		SUM(CASE WHEN T.Type <> 'ST' THEN T.Net  ELSE 0 END) AS Net 
	FROM
		(SELECT
			ICode, SUM( PackQty * PackUnits + BonusQty * PackUnits ) AS Net, 'PU' AS Type 
		FROM 
			PurDetail, PurLedger
		WHERE 
			PurLedger.PurCatCode IN (1,2) AND 
			PurLedger.PurInvCode = PurDetail.PurInvCode AND 
			Posted = UPPER('Y') AND GCode = @GCode
		GROUP BY 
			ICode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 
			ICode, SUM(LooseQty +  BonusQty  ) AS Net, 'PU' AS Type
		FROM 
			PurDetail, PurLedger
		WHERE 
			PurLedger.PurCatCode IN (3,7,8) AND 
			PurLedger.PurInvCode = PurDetail.PurInvCode AND 
			Posted = UPPER('Y') AND GCode = @GCode
		GROUP BY 
			ICode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 
			ICode, -SUM(LooseQty +  BonusQty) AS Net, 'PR' AS Type
		FROM PRDetail
		WHERE GCode = @GCode
		GROUP BY ICode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 
			ICode, -SUM(LooseQty + BonusQty ) AS Net, 'SL' AS Type
		FROM SaleDetail
		WHERE 
			Due IS NULL AND GCode = @GCode
		GROUP BY 
			ICode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 
			ICode, SUM(LooseQty + BonusQty) AS Net, 'SR' AS Type
		FROM 
			SRDetail
		WHERE 
			GCode = @GCode
		GROUP BY 
			ICode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 
			ICode, -SUM(Qty) AS Net, 'IS' AS Type
		FROM 
			IssueDetail, IssueHeader
		WHERE 
			IssueHeader.IssueInvCode = IssueDetail.IssueInvCode AND 
			GCode = @GCode
		GROUP BY 
			ICode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 
			ICode, -SUM(DueSatisfyQty) AS Net, 'DS' AS Type
		FROM 
			DueSatisfyDetail
		WHERE 
			GCode = @GCode
		GROUP BY 
			ICode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 
			ICode, SUM(Qty) AS Net, 'DS' AS Type
		FROM 
			ReceipTHeader, ReceipTDetail
		WHERE 
			ReceipTHeader.Posted='Y' AND
			ReceipTHeader.ReceiptInvCode = ReceipTDetail.ReceiptInvCode AND 
			GCode = @GCode
		GROUP BY 
			ICode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 
			ICode, SUM(LooseQty) AS Net, 'AI' AS Type
		FROM 
			AdjHeader,AdjDetail
		WHERE 
			AdjHeader.Posted='Y' AND
			AdjHeader.AdjCatCode=1 AND
			AdjHeader.AdjCode=AdjDetail.AdjCode AND 
			AdjDetail.GCode = @GCode
		GROUP BY 
			ICode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 
			ICode, -SUM(LooseQty) AS Net, 'AD' AS Type
		FROM 
			AdjHeader, AdjDetail
		WHERE 
			AdjHeader.Posted='Y' AND
			AdjHeader.AdjCatCode=2 AND
			AdjHeader.AdjCode=AdjDetail.AdjCode AND 
			AdjDetail.GCode = @GCode
		GROUP BY 
			ICode
		UNION ALL
		/* TRANSFER SOURCE GODOWN*/
		SELECT ICode, -SUM(Qty) AS Net, 'TM' AS Type
		FROM 
			THeader, TDetail
		WHERE 
			THeader.Posted='Y' AND
			THeader.SGCode = @GCode AND
			THeader.TransCode=TDetail.TransCode 
		GROUP BY 
			ICode
		/*END*/
		UNION ALL
		/* TRANSFER TARGET GODOWN*/
		SELECT 
			ICode, SUM(Qty) AS Net, 'TN' AS Type
		FROM 
			THeader, TDetail
		WHERE 
			THeader.Posted='Y' AND
			THeader.DGCode = @GCode AND
			THeader.TransCode=TDetail.TransCode 
		GROUP BY 
			ICode
		/*END*/
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 
			ICode, SUM(CurrQty) AS Net, 'ST' AS Type
		FROM 
			GodownDetail
		WHERE
			GCode = @GCode
		GROUP BY 
			ICode) T, Item
	WHERE 
		T.ICode = Item.ICode
	GROUP BY 
		T.ICode, 
		Item.name
	HAVING 	SUM(CASE WHEN T.Type = 'ST' THEN T.Net ELSE 0 END) <> 
		SUM(CASE WHEN T.Type <> 'ST' THEN T.Net ELSE 0 END)
	ORDER BY T.ICode

	UPDATE ReportData
	SET ReportData.Date1=
		ISNULL( 
			(SELECT MIN(D.expiry) FROM GodownDetail D
			WHERE ReportData.Code1=D.ICode AND D.GCode = @GCode), 
		ISNULL((SELECT MIN(Expiry) FROM PurDetail 
		WHERE PurUtn IN 
			(SELECT MAX(purutn) FROM PurDetail P 
			WHERE P.ICode= ReportData.Code1) ), '12/12/2010 00:00:00') )

	DELETE FROM GodownDetail 
	WHERE ICode IN (SELECT Code1 FROM ReportData) AND GCode = @GCode

	UPDATE ReportData SET Code2 = @GCode
	
	INSERT INTO GodownDetail (GCode, ICode, CurrQty, Batch, Expiry, Priority, ManfDate)
	SELECT Code2, Code1, Value1, 
		ISNULL((SELECT Batch FROM PurDetail 
		WHERE PurUtn IN 
			(SELECT MAX(PurUtn) FROM PurDetail P 
			WHERE P.ICode= ReportData.Code1) ), '.'), 
		Date1, 10, Null
	FROM ReportData
	WHERE Value1 > 0

	SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
END

-- SP_RepairDB
CREATE PROC DBO.SP_RepairDB @DB VARCHAR(255), @Option INT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @Qry VARCHAR(1000)

IF @DB IS NULL
	RETURN 0

IF @Option IS NULL
	RETURN 0

SET @Qry = 'dbcc CheckDB(''' + @DB + ''''
IF @Option = 0
	SET @Qry = @Qry + ''
IF @Option = 1
	SET @Qry = @Qry + ', REPAIR_FAST'
IF @Option = 2
	SET @Qry = @Qry + ', REPAIR_REBUILD'
IF @Option = 3
	SET @Qry = @Qry + ', REPAIR_ALLOW_DATA_LOSS'

SET @Qry = @Qry + ') with tableresults, ALL_ERRORMSGS'

TRUNCATE TABLE DBCC_History

INSERT INTO DBCC_History(
ErrorID, LevelID, StateID, MessageText, RepairLevel, StatusID,
DbId, ObjectId, IndId, FileID, PageID, SlotID, RefFileID, 
RefPageID, RefSlotID, AllocationID)
EXEC (@Qry)
IF @@Error <> 0
BEGIN
	RETURN @@Error
END

INSERT INTO DBO.DBRepairLog (Date, RepairLevel, ObjectName)
SELECT Date=GETDATE(), 
	RepairLevel=CASE @Option WHEN 1 THEN 'REPAIR_FAST' WHEN 2 THEN 'REPAIR_REBUILD' WHEN 3 THEN 'REPAIR_ALLOW_DATA_LOSS' ELSE '' END, 
	ObjectName=@DB

RETURN 0

definition:
-- SP_RePrioritizeStockBatches
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_RePrioritizeStockBatches @Method INT
AS

DECLARE @batch VARCHAR(100), @ItemName Varchar(100)
DECLARE @ICode INT, @OldICode INT, @errcode INT, @Priority INT
DECLARE @Expiry DATETIME, @InDate DATETIME

/*
Author : Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Date : May 03, 2011
Purpose : Implement the selected/prefered Stock Allocation Method
*/

IF @Method = 1	/* Shortest Expiry First Method */
BEGIN
	UPDATE GodownDetail SET Priority=10
END


IF @Method = 2	/* FIFO Method*/
BEGIN
	/*
	Step - 1 :- Set Default Priority To Each Batch in Stock
	*/
	UPDATE GodownDetail SET Priority=9
	
	SET @OldICode = NULL
	SET @Priority = 0
	/*
	Step - 2 :- Find Min InDate for each Batch in Stock
	*/
	
	DECLARE cursor1 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT T.ICode, T.Batch, T.Expiry, InDate=MIN(T.InDate)
	FROM
		(SELECT GD.ICode, GD.Batch, GD.Expiry, InDate=MIN(H.PostDate)
		FROM PurDetail D, PurLedger H, GodownDetail GD
		WHERE H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
			H.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND 
			D.ICode = GD.ICode AND
			D.Batch = GD.Batch AND
			D.Expiry = GD.Expiry
		GROUP BY
			GD.ICode,
			GD.Batch, 
			GD.Expiry
		UNION ALL
		SELECT GD.ICode, GD.Batch, GD.Expiry, InDate=MIN(H.PostDate)
		FROM SRDetail D, SRLedger H, GodownDetail GD
		WHERE H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
			H.SRInvCode = D.SRInvCode AND 
			D.ICode = GD.ICode AND
			D.Batch = GD.Batch AND
			D.Expiry = GD.Expiry
		GROUP BY
			GD.ICode,
			GD.Batch, 
			GD.Expiry
		UNION ALL
		SELECT GD.ICode, GD.Batch, GD.Expiry, InDate=MIN(H.PostDate)
		FROM ReceiptDetail D, ReceiptHeader H, GodownDetail GD
		WHERE H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
			H.ReceiptInvCode = D.ReceiptInvCode AND 
			D.ICode = GD.ICode AND
			D.Batch = GD.Batch AND
			D.Expiry = GD.Expiry
		GROUP BY
			GD.ICode,
			GD.Batch, 
			GD.Expiry
		UNION ALL
		SELECT GD.ICode, GD.Batch, GD.Expiry, InDate=MIN(H.Date)
		FROM AdjDetail D, AdjHeader H, GodownDetail GD
		WHERE H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
			AdjCatCode=1 AND
			H.AdjCode = D.AdjCode AND 
			D.ICode = GD.ICode AND
			D.Batch = GD.Batch AND
			D.Expiry = GD.Expiry
		GROUP BY
			GD.ICode,
			GD.Batch, 
			GD.Expiry) T
	GROUP BY
		T.ICode,
		T.Batch, 
		T.Expiry
	ORDER BY
		ICode,
		InDate,
		Expiry,
		Batch
	
	OPEN cursor1

	/* Step 3 Update Priority as it suits */	
	FETCH NEXT FROM cursor1
	INTO @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @InDate
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		IF @ICode = @OldICode
			SET @Priority = @Priority + 1
		ELSE
			SET @Priority = 1
	
		IF @Priority > 8
			SET @Priority = 8
	
		UPDATE GodownDetail SET Priority = @Priority WHERE ICode=@ICode AND Batch = @Batch AND Expiry = @Expiry
	
		SET @OldICode = @ICode
	
		FETCH NEXT FROM cursor1 INTO @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @InDate
	END
	CLOSE cursor1
	DEALLOCATE cursor1
END

IF @Method = 3	/* LIFO Method*/
BEGIN
	/*
	Step - 1 :- Set Default Priority To Each Batch in Stock
	*/
	UPDATE GodownDetail SET Priority=30
	
	SET @OldICode = NULL
	SET @Priority = 10
	/*
	Step - 2 :- Find Lastest InDate for each Batch in Stock
	*/
	
	DECLARE cursor2 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT T.ICode, T.Batch, T.Expiry, InDate=MAX(T.InDate)
	FROM
		(SELECT GD.ICode, GD.Batch, GD.Expiry, InDate=MAX(H.PostDate)
		FROM PurDetail D, PurLedger H, GodownDetail GD
		WHERE H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
			H.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND 
			D.ICode = GD.ICode AND
			D.Batch = GD.Batch AND
			D.Expiry = GD.Expiry
		GROUP BY
			GD.ICode,
			GD.Batch, 
			GD.Expiry
		UNION ALL
		SELECT GD.ICode, GD.Batch, GD.Expiry, InDate=MAX(H.PostDate)
		FROM SRDetail D, SRLedger H, GodownDetail GD
		WHERE H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
			H.SRInvCode = D.SRInvCode AND 
			D.ICode = GD.ICode AND
			D.Batch = GD.Batch AND
			D.Expiry = GD.Expiry
		GROUP BY
			GD.ICode,
			GD.Batch, 
			GD.Expiry
		UNION ALL
		SELECT GD.ICode, GD.Batch, GD.Expiry, InDate=MAX(H.PostDate)
		FROM ReceiptDetail D, ReceiptHeader H, GodownDetail GD
		WHERE H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
			H.ReceiptInvCode = D.ReceiptInvCode AND 
			D.ICode = GD.ICode AND
			D.Batch = GD.Batch AND
			D.Expiry = GD.Expiry
		GROUP BY
			GD.ICode,
			GD.Batch, 
			GD.Expiry
		UNION ALL
		SELECT GD.ICode, GD.Batch, GD.Expiry, InDate=MAX(H.Date)
		FROM AdjDetail D, AdjHeader H, GodownDetail GD
		WHERE H.Posted = 'Y' AND 
			AdjCatCode=1 AND
			H.AdjCode = D.AdjCode AND 
			D.ICode = GD.ICode AND
			D.Batch = GD.Batch AND
			D.Expiry = GD.Expiry
		GROUP BY
			GD.ICode,
			GD.Batch, 
			GD.Expiry) T
	GROUP BY
		T.ICode,
		T.Batch, 
		T.Expiry
	ORDER BY
		ICode,
		InDate DESC,
		Expiry,
		Batch
	
	OPEN cursor2
	
	/* Step 3 Update Priority as it suits */	
	FETCH NEXT FROM cursor2
	INTO @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @InDate
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		IF @ICode = @OldICode
			SET @Priority = @Priority + 1
		ELSE
			SET @Priority = 11
	
		IF @Priority > 29
			SET @Priority = 29
	
		UPDATE GodownDetail SET Priority = @Priority WHERE ICode=@ICode AND Batch = @Batch AND Expiry = @Expiry
	
		SET @OldICode = @ICode
	
		FETCH NEXT FROM cursor2 INTO @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @InDate
	END
	CLOSE cursor2
	DEALLOCATE cursor2
END

name: SP_RequestHttpWebService
definition:
-- SP_RequestHttpWebService
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RequestHttpWebService]
	@Url varchar(1024),
	@HttpMethod varchar(10),
	@ParamsValues varchar(8000),    -- param1=value&param2=value
	@SoapAction varchar(1024) = null
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

if @HttpMethod in ('get','GET') and len(@ParamsValues) > 0
begin
	set @Url = @Url + '?' + @ParamsValues
end

declare @obj int, @response varchar(8000),@status varchar(50),@statusText varchar(1024),@method varchar(10)

SET @method = (case when @HttpMethod in ('soap','SOAP') then 'POST' else @HttpMethod end)

exec sp_OACreate 'MSXML2.ServerXMLHttp', @obj out
exec sp_OAMethod @obj, 'Open', null, @method, @Url, false

if @HttpMethod in ('get','GET')
begin
	exec sp_OAMethod @obj, 'send'
end
else if @HttpMethod in ('post','POST')
begin
	exec sp_OAMethod @obj, 'setRequestHeader', null, 'Content-Type', 'application/json' --'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
	exec sp_OAMethod @obj, 'send', null, @ParamsValues
end
else if @HttpMethod in ('soap','SOAP')
begin
	if @SoapAction is null
		raiserror('@SoapAction is null', 10, 1)

	declare @host varchar(1024)
	SET @host  = @Url
	if @host like 'http://%'
		set @host = right(@host, len(@host) - 7)
	else if @host like 'https://%'
		set @host = right(@host, len(@host) - 8)

	if charindex(':', @host) > 0 and charindex(':', @host) < charindex('/', @host)
		set @host = left(@host, charindex(':', @host) - 1)
	else 
		set @host = left(@host, charindex('/', @host) - 1)

	declare @envelope varchar(8000) 
	SET @envelope = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><soap:Envelope xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/"><soap:Body><{action} xmlns="http://tempuri.org/">{params}</{action}></soap:Body></soap:Envelope>'
	declare @params varchar(8000) 
	SET @params = '' 

	WHILE LEN(@ParamsValues) > 0
	BEGIN
		declare @param varchar(256), @value varchar(256)
		IF charindex('&', @ParamsValues) > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @param = left(@ParamsValues, charindex('&', @ParamsValues) - 1)
			set @value = RIGHT(@param, len(@param) - charindex('=', @param))
			set @param = left(@param, charindex('=', @param) - 1)
			set @params = @params + '<' + @param + '>' + @value + '</'+ @param + '>'
			SET @ParamsValues = right(@ParamsValues, LEN(@ParamsValues) - LEN(@param + '=' + @value + '&'))
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			set @value = RIGHT(@ParamsValues, len(@ParamsValues) - charindex('=', @ParamsValues))
			set @param = left(@ParamsValues, charindex('=', @ParamsValues) - 1)
			
			set @params = @params + '<' + @param + '>' + @value + '</'+ @param + '>'
			SET @ParamsValues = NULL
		END
	END

	set @envelope = replace(@envelope, '{action}', @SoapAction)
	set @envelope = replace(@envelope, '{params}', @params)

	set @SoapAction = 'http://tempuri.org/' + @SoapAction

	print @host
	print @SoapAction
	print @envelope

	exec sp_OAMethod @obj, 'setRequestHeader', null, 'Content-Type', 'text/xml; charset=utf-8'
	exec sp_OAMethod @obj, 'setRequestHeader', null, 'Host', @host
	exec sp_OAMethod @obj, 'setRequestHeader', null, 'SOAPAction', @SoapAction
	exec sp_OAMethod @obj, 'send', null, @envelope
end

exec sp_OAGetProperty @obj, 'responseText', @response out
exec sp_OADestroy @obj

select @status as [status], @statusText as [statusText], @response as [response]

END

-- sp_Salereturninfo
CREATE   PROCEDURE sp_Salereturninfo  @al_code INT AS

create table #lt_pvamts 
(
	name  varchar (60) NOT NULL,
	name1 varchar (100) NOT NULL,
	icode int,
	customicoe varchar(12),
	gcode smallint,
	batch varchar(100),
	expiry datetime,
	saleprice numeric(12,2),
	discperc numeric(5,2),
	looseqty numeric(15,4),
	packunits smallint,
	returnqty numeric(15,4)
)
insert #lt_pvamts

 SELECT dbo.item.name, 
	dbo.item.name + space(70) + str(dbo.item.icode) as name1, 
	dbo.item.icode,
	dbo.item.customicode,
	dbo.saledetail.gcode,
	dbo.saledetail.batch,
	dbo.saledetail.expiry,
	dbo.saledetail.saleprice,
	dbo.saledetail.discperc,
	dbo.saledetail.looseqty,
	dbo.saledetail.packunits,
	ReturnQty = (SELECT IsNull(Sum(srdetail.looseqty), 0)
			FROM   	srledger, srdetail
			WHERE  	srledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.SaleInvCode    and
				srledger.posted      = 'Y'                and
				srledger.srinvcode   = srdetail.SRInvCode and
				srdetail.gcode       = saledetail.GCode and
				srdetail.icode       = item.ICode and
				srdetail.batch       = saledetail.Batch and
				srdetail.expiry      = saledetail.Expiry) 
	
    FROM dbo.item,   
	 dbo.saledetail	

   WHERE ( saledetail.saleinvcode = @al_code )and
	 ( item.icode = saledetail.icode ) and
	( saledetail.due IS NULL)


insert #lt_pvamts
SELECT dbo.item.name, 
	dbo.item.name + space(70) + str(dbo.item.icode), 
	dbo.item.icode,
	max(dbo.item.customicode),
	dbo.Duesatisfydetail.gcode,
	dbo.Duesatisfydetail.batch,
	dbo.Duesatisfydetail.expiry,
	dbo.saledetail.saleprice,
	dbo.saledetail.discperc,
	looseqty = sum(dbo.Duesatisfydetail.duesatisfyqty),
	dbo.saledetail.packunits,
	ReturnQty = (SELECT IsNull(Sum(srdetail.looseqty), 0)
			FROM   	srledger, srdetail
			WHERE  	srledger.saleinvcode = Duesatisfyheader.SaleInvCode    and
				srledger.posted      = 'Y'                and
				srledger.srinvcode   = srdetail.SRInvCode and
				srdetail.gcode       = Duesatisfydetail.GCode and
				srdetail.icode       = Duesatisfydetail.ICode and
				srdetail.batch       = Duesatisfydetail.Batch and
				srdetail.expiry      = Duesatisfydetail.Expiry) 

    FROM dbo.item,   
	dbo.saledetail,
	dbo.duesatisfydetail,
	dbo.Duesatisfyheader
			

   WHERE ( saledetail.saleinvcode = @al_code)and
	( dbo.Duesatisfyheader.saleinvcode = @al_code) and
	( dbo.Duesatisfyheader.duesatisfycode = dbo.duesatisfydetail.duesatisfycode) and
	( item.icode = dbo.duesatisfydetail.icode ) and
	( saledetail.gcode = dbo.duesatisfydetail.gcode) and
	( saledetail.icode = dbo.duesatisfydetail.icode) and 
	( saledetail.due in ('S', 'D', 'X') )



group by item.icode,
	 dbo.item.name,
	duesatisfydetail.icode,
	duesatisfydetail.gcode,
	duesatisfydetail.batch,
	duesatisfydetail.expiry,

	duesatisfyheader.saleinvcode,

	dbo.saledetail.saleprice,
	dbo.saledetail.discperc,
	dbo.saledetail.packunits

select * from #lt_pvamts

purqty=isnull((

                         END)
		from purdetail,purledger

prqtu=isnull((select sum(prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.bonusqty)

		     receiptheader.posted='Y' and
	          receiptheader.receiptinvcode=receiptdetail.receiptinvcode and

from item as A /*,


(
select distinct(purdetail.icode)

where item.icode=A.icode AND

definition:
-- SP_SALESMAN_AREASALES_CROSSTAB
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_SALESMAN_AREASALES_CROSSTAB	
	@Salesmancode INT, 
	@startdate datetime, 
	@enddate datetime, 
	@ReportGrouping CHAR(1), 
	@GroupList VARCHAR(8000), 
	@Pricetype TinyInt, 
	@TotCol Float AS

/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'crosstab_reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of a
	SALESMAN's sales areas and items selected depending upon the grouping criteria selected.

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@SalesmanCode = Salesman for which report is required
	@startdate, @ar_enddate = Determine the period of report
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items in report
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
	@Pricetype = 1 stands for Actual Price, 2 stands for Sale/Trade Price, 3 stands for Purchase price and 4 stands for Average price
	@TotCol = the number of cross tab clolumns for the report (area shortname columns)
*/

DELETE CrossTab_ReportData

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @coltable TABLE (code int, shortname varchar(100), rowid INT identity(1,1))
DECLARE @saleareastable TABLE (code int)
DECLARE @UPD VARCHAR(4000), @Col VARCHAR(10), @RowID INT, @colname VARCHAR(100), @colcode VARCHAR(100), @str_col VARCHAR(10)
DECLARE @totareas FLOAT, @curriter int, @iterations int, @i int, @tot int
DECLARE @ICODE INTEGER, @AREACODE INTEGER, @QTY INT, @VAL NUMERIC(15, 5), @err INT

INSERT INTO @saleareastable
SELECT DISTINCT C.AREACODE 
FROM 
	SALELEDGER S, SALEDETAIL D, CUSTOMER C
WHERE 
	S.SMANCODE = @Salesmancode AND
	S.SALEINVCODE =  D.SALEINVCODE AND
	S.DATE >= @StartDate AND S.DATE <= @EndDate AND
	S.POSTED='Y' AND 
	S.CUSTCODE = C.CUSTCODE

SELECT @totareas = ISNULL((SELECT Count(Code) FROM @saleareastable), 0)

DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

IF @totareas > 0 and @TotCol > 0
BEGIN

	SELECT @tot = (SELECT MIN(A) FROM (SELECT A=@TotCol UNION SELECT A=@TotAreas) T)

	INSERT @coltable
	SELECT Area.AreaCode, Area.ShortName
	FROM @saleareastable A, Area 
	WHERE A.Code = Area.AreaCode
	ORDER BY AREA.ShortName

	SET @iterations = CEILING(@totareas/@TotCol)
	SET @curriter = 1
	SET @RowID = 0
	WHILE @curriter <= @iterations
	BEGIN
		
		INSERT INTO CrossTab_ReportData (Code1, Code2, Code3)
		SELECT Code, @curriter, @SalesmanCode FROM @Tab_ItemList

		SET @i = 1
		WHILE @i <= @tot
		BEGIN
			SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
			SELECT @colname = RTRIM(LTRIM(ISNULL((SELECT shortname FROM @coltable WHERE ROWID = @RowID), '')))
			SELECT @colcode = RTRIM(LTRIM(STR((SELECT CODE FROM @coltable WHERE ROWID = @RowID), 7)))
			IF @colcode IS NULL
			BEGIN
				BREAK
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @str_col = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@i, 7)))
				SELECT @UPD = 	'UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData SET C_Name' + @str_col + 
								' = ''' + @colname + ''', C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colcode +
								' WHERE CODE2 = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@curriter, 7)))
				EXECUTE (@UPD)
				SET @err = @@ERROR
				IF @err <> 0
				BEGIN
					SET @UPD = 'UPDATION ERROR, DETAILS: ' + @UPD
					RAISERROR(@UPD, 16, 1, @UPD)
					RETURN -1
				END 
				SET @i = @i + 1
			END
		END
		SET @curriter = @curriter + 1
	END

	DECLARE C1 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT S.ICODE, QTY = ISNULL(Sum(S.QTY), 0),
		VAL= ROUND(SUM(
			CASE @Pricetype WHEN 1 THEN S.NETAMT 
			WHEN 2 THEN S.QTY * ROUND(I.SALEPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			WHEN 3 THEN S.QTY * ROUND(I.PURPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			ELSE S.QTY * ROUND(I.AVGPRICE, 2) END), 0), 
		S.AREACODE
	FROM
		(SELECT INVNO=SL.SALEINVCODE,
			SD.ICODE,
			CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
			QTY = ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
			NETAMT=Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)), 0), 2),
			C.AREACODE,
			SL.SManCode
		FROM
			SALELEDGER SL,
			SALEDETAIL SD,
			CUSTOMER C,
			AREA A
		WHERE
			SL.SManCode = @SalesManCode AND
			A.AREACODE = C.AREACODE AND
			C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
			SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND
			SL.DATE >= @StartDate AND SL.DATE <= @EndDate
		GROUP BY
			SL.SManCode,
			SL.SaleInvCode,
			SD.ICODE,
			SL.CustCode,
			C.AREACODE,
			SL.DiscPerc
		UNION ALL
		SELECT INVNO=SL.SRINVCODE,
			SD.ICODE,
			CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
			QTY = - ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
			NETAMT= - Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty * SD.SRPrice) *
					(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)), 0), 2),
			C.AREACODE,
			SL.SManCode
		FROM
			SRLEDGER SL,
			SRDETAIL SD,
			CUSTOMER C,
			AREA A
		WHERE
			SL.SManCode = @SalesmanCode AND
			A.AREACODE = C.AREACODE AND
			C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
			SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SRINVCODE = SD.SRINVCODE AND
			SL.DATE >= @StartDate AND SL.DATE <= @EndDate
		GROUP BY
			SL.SManCode,
			SL.SRInvCode,
			SD.ICODE,
			SL.CustCode,
			C.AREACODE,
			SL.DiscPerc) S, ITEM I
	WHERE I.ICODE = S.ICODE AND I.ICODE IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
	GROUP BY 
		S.AREACODE,
		S.ICODE
	ORDER BY S.AREACODE, S.ICODE

	OPEN C1
	FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @ICODE, @QTY, @VAL, @AREACODE
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SET @i = 1
		WHILE @i <= @tot
		BEGIN
			SELECT @colcode = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@ICODE, 7)))
			SELECT @colname = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@AREACODE, 7)))
			SET @str_col = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@i, 7)))

			SELECT @UPD = 	'UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData SET ' + 
							'QTY' + @str_col + ' = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@QTY, 7))) + 
							', VAL' + @str_col + ' = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@VAL, 15, 5))) + 
							', C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colname +
							' WHERE CODE1 = ' + @colcode + ' AND ' + 
							' C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colname
			EXECUTE (@UPD)
			SET @err = @@ERROR
			IF @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @UPD = 'CROSSTAB PLOTING ERROR, DETAILS: ' + @UPD
				RAISERROR(@UPD, 16, 1, @UPD)
				CLOSE C1
				DEALLOCATE C1
				RETURN -1
			END 
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @ICODE, @QTY, @VAL, @AREACODE
	END
	CLOSE C1
	DEALLOCATE C1

	UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData 
	SET NAME1 = I.NAME,
		NAME2 = I.CustomICode,
		Name3 = I.PackingDesc,
		Name4 = (SELECT NAME FROM SALESMAN WHERE SALESMANCODE = @SALESMANCODE),   
		Code5=CASE @ReportGrouping 
			WHEN 'M' THEN I.MANFCODE
			WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
			WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
			ELSE I.PACKCODE END,
		Name5 = CASE @ReportGrouping 
			WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
			WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
			WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
			ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,
		Value1= CASE @Pricetype WHEN 1 THEN ROUND(I.SALEPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			WHEN 2 THEN ROUND(I.SALEPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			WHEN 3 THEN ROUND(I.PURPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			ELSE ROUND(I.AVGPRICE, 2) END
	FROM ITEM I, CrossTab_ReportData C
	WHERE I.ICODE = C.CODE1

	EXECUTE SP_UPDATE_TOTAL_CrossTab_ReportData
END
RETURN 0

-- SP_SalesMan_CollectionPlan
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_SalesMan_CollectionPlan
	@Date DATETIME, 
	@SalesManCode SMALLINT,
	@OverDueDays INT 
AS

EXECUTE SP_VirtualGL 'A'

DECLARE @OldAccCode INT, @AccCode INT, @RowID INT, @DaysOld INT
DECLARE @StartLimit INT, @EndLimit INT, @WeekOfMonth INT, @WeekDay INT
DECLARE @TDate DateTime
DECLARE @Amt Numeric(15,5), @Paid Numeric(15,5), @Pmt Numeric(15,5)

SET @WeekOfMonth = (SELECT DBO.Fn_WeekDayCountInMonth(@Date))  -- Get Week Day Count Of Month 
SET @WeekDay = DATEPART(DW, @Date)

SELECT @WeekOfMonth, @WeekDay

IF @WeekOfMonth IS NULL OR @WeekOfMonth=0 OR @WeekDay IS NULL OR @WeekDay=0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Not A valid Date Selected, Please Select a valid date', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

DELETE REPORTDATA

CREATE TABLE #lt_amt (
	AccCode INT NOT NULL,
	Date DateTime Not Null,
	Amount Numeric(15,5) Not Null Default 0,
	Paid Numeric(15,5) Not Null Default 0,
	RowID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
	DaysOld INT Not Null Default 0
)

CREATE TABLE #lt_cust (
	AccCode INT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE #lt_pmt (
	AccCode INT NOT NULL,
	Amount Numeric(15,5) Not Null Default 0
)

CREATE TABLE #lt_interval (
	IntervalID INT IDENTITY (0,1) NOT NULL,
	LowerLimit INT Not Null Default 0,
	UpperLimit INT Not Null Default 0
)

SELECT @StartLimit = 0
WHILE @StartLimit <= @OverDueDays
BEGIN
	SELECT @EndLimit = @StartLimit + CASE @StartLimit WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE @OverDueDays - 1 END
	SELECT @EndLimit = CASE WHEN @EndLimit > @OverDueDays THEN @OverDueDays ELSE @EndLimit END

	INSERT INTO #lt_interval (LowerLimit, UpperLimit) 
	VALUES (@StartLimit, @EndLimit)

	SELECT @StartLimit = @EndLimit + 1
END

INSERT INTO #lt_interval (LowerLimit, UpperLimit) 
VALUES (@StartLimit, 99999999)

INSERT INTO #lt_cust
SELECT C.CUSTCODE 
FROM CUSTOMER C
WHERE 
	C.SalesManCode = @SalesManCode AND 
	C.CollectionPolicyCode IN 
		(SELECT DISTINCT CP.ContactPolicyCode
		FROM ContactPolicy CP, ContactPolicyDetail CPD
		WHERE 
			CP.ContactPolicyCode = CPD.ContactPolicyCode AND
			CPD.WeekDayCode = @WeekDay AND
			CPD.WeekOfMonth = @WeekOfMonth)

SELECT * FROM #lt_cust

INSERT INTO #lt_amt
SELECT AccCode, Date, Amount=Debit, Paid=0, DaysOld=DATEDIFF(day, date, @date)
FROM VirtualGL 
WHERE
	Date <= @date AND 
	Debit > 0 AND 
	AccCode IN (SELECT AccCode FROM #lt_cust)
ORDER BY AccCode, Date, Debit

INSERT INTO #lt_pmt
SELECT AccCode, Amount=SUM(Credit)
FROM VirtualGL 
WHERE
	Date <= @date AND 
	Credit > 0 AND 
	AccCode IN (SELECT AccCode FROM #lt_cust)
GROUP BY AccCode
ORDER BY AccCode

DECLARE C1 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM #lt_amt
OPEN C1

FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @AccCode, @TDate, @Amt, @Paid, @RowID, @DaysOld
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SELECT @Pmt=ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(Amount, 0) FROM #lt_pmt WHERE AccCode = @AccCode), 0)

	IF @Pmt <> 0
	BEGIN
		UPDATE #lt_amt
		SET Paid = Paid + CASE WHEN @Amt >= @Pmt THEN @Pmt ELSE @Amt END
		WHERE RowID = @RowID
	
		SELECT @Pmt = @Pmt - (SELECT CASE WHEN @Amt >= @Pmt THEN @Pmt ELSE @Amt END)
	
		UPDATE #lt_Pmt
		SET Amount = @Pmt 
		WHERE AccCode = @AccCode
	END

	FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @AccCode, @TDate, @Amt, @Paid, @RowID, @DaysOld

END
CLOSE C1
DEALLOCATE C1

DELETE #lt_amt WHERE Amount - Paid = 0

INSERT INTO ReportData (Code1, Code2, Name1, Name2, Name3, Name4, Name5, Value1, Value2, Value3)
SELECT  
	Code1=Ar.AreaCode,
	Code2=AC.AccCode,
	Name1=Ar.Name,
	Name2=Ac.AliasName,
	Name3=Ac.Name,
	Name4=LTRIM(RTRIM(C.Address1)),
	Name5=(SELECT S.Name FROM SalesMan S WHERE S.SalesmanCode = @salesmancode),
	Value1 = SUM(CASE WHEN l.daysold > @OverDueDays THEN 0 ELSE Amount-Paid END),
	Value2 = SUM(CASE WHEN l.daysold > @OverDueDays THEN Amount - Paid ELSE 0 END),
	Value3 = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(V.Debit - V.Credit) FROM VirtualGL V WHERE V.AccCode = Ac.AccCode AND V.Date <= @Date ), 0)
FROM #lt_amt l, Accounts Ac, Area Ar, Customer C
WHERE
 	l.AccCode = Ac.AccCode AND 
	Ac.AccCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.AreaCode = Ar.AreaCode
GROUP BY
	Ar.AreaCode,
	Ar.Name,
	Ac.AccCode,
	Ac.Name,
	Ac.AliasName,
	C.Address1,
	C.Address2,
	C.Phone
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	Code1=Ar.AreaCode,
	Code2=AC.AccCode,
	Name1=Ar.Name,
	Name2=Ac.AliasName,
	Name3=Ac.Name,
	Name4=LTRIM(RTRIM(C.Address1)),
	Name5=(SELECT S.Name FROM SalesMan S WHERE S.SalesmanCode = @salesmancode),
	Value1 = 0,
	Value2 = 0,
	Value3 = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(V.Debit - V.Credit) FROM VirtualGL V WHERE V.AccCode = Ac.AccCode AND V.Date <= @Date ), 0)
FROM #lt_cust l, Accounts Ac, Area Ar, Customer C
WHERE
	l.AccCode NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT AccCode FROM #lt_amt) AND
 	l.AccCode = Ac.AccCode AND 
	Ac.AccCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.AreaCode = Ar.AreaCode

DROP TABLE #lt_amt
DROP TABLE #lt_pmt
DROP TABLE #lt_cust
DROP TABLE #lt_interval

-- SP_SALESMANWISE_RECEIPTS
CREATE   PROCEDURE SP_SALESMANWISE_RECEIPTS @month int, @year int, @smanlist VARCHAR(8000)
AS
/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of
	salesman and all possible dates during the month and year specified in the parameter list

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@month = Determine the month value
	@year = Determines the year value
	@SmanList = A comma separated list of salesmancode to be used for report
*/
DELETE REPORTDATA

DECLARE @Tab_SManList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO @Tab_SManList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@smanlist, ',')

INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (Name1, Name2, Value1, Code1, Code2)
SELECT 
	Salesman=SM.Name, 
	Date=ISNULL(R.Date, CONVERT(varchar(12), (SELECT MIN(DATE) FROM udf_DaysOfMonthList(@month, @year)), 103) ),
	Amt=SUM(ISNULL(R.Amt, 0)),
	code1=@month,
	code2=@year
FROM 
	(SELECT * FROM salesman 
	WHERE salesmancode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_SManList)) SM
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT 
		C.Salesmancode, 
		Date=CONVERT(varchar(12), h.Date, 103),
		Amt=SUM(D.Credit)
	FROM 
		Customer C, GlDetail D, GlHeader H
	WHERE
		H.VochCatCode IN (2, 4) AND
		H.GlVochCode = D.GlVochCode AND
		D.AccCode = C.CustCode AND
		month(h.date) = @month AND year(h.date) = @year AND
		C.SalesmanCode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_SManList)
	GROUP BY
		C.Salesmancode, 
		h.date
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		SM.SalesManCode, 
		Date=CONVERT(varchar(12), h.Date, 103),
		Amt=0
	FROM 
		udf_DaysOfMonthList(@month, @year) h, 
		(SELECT Salesmancode=MIN(SalesManCode) 
		FROM salesman 
		WHERE salesmancode IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_SManList)) SM) AS R ON (SM.SalesManCode = R.SalesManCode)
GROUP BY
	SM.Name, R.Date

CREATE PROCEDURE SP_SaleUpdateItemStockBatch 
	@GCode integer, 
	@ICode integer, 
	@Batch varchar (100), 
	@Expiry datetime, 
	@NewQty NUMERIC(15, 4), 
	@OldQty NUMERIC(15, 4)
AS

Declare @string_expiry VarChar(25)

Set		CurrQty = @NewQty  
Where
	GodownDetail.GCode  = @GCode and
	GodownDetail.ICode  = @ICode and

Begin

	From Item

	Return -1   
End
Return 0

name: sp_SatisfyDueInBulk
definition:
-- sp_SatisfyDueInBulk
CREATE  Procedure sp_SatisfyDueInBulk 
	@DueAdjCode Int, @usercode Int, @serverdate DateTime
AS
Declare @saleinvcode Int, @duesatisfycode Int, @dueutn BigInt
Declare @icode Int, @gcode SmallInt, @salerowid Int,  @batch VarChar(100), @expiry DateTime
Declare @reqqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @givenqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @totalqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @currqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @delqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @batchqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @newqty NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @satisfiableqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @satisfiedqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @dueqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @total_availablestock NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @hold_avgprice NUMERIC(15,5)
Declare @packunits SmallInt, @price Numeric(12,2), @saleprice Numeric(12,2)
Declare @continue Int, @counter Int, @totalrows Int, @Err Int, @RowCount Int, @rt_code Int, @err_string VarChar(200), @itemname VarChar(100)

Declare Cursor_DueSatisfyInvoices Cursor Forward_Only Static For 
Select saleinvcode From DueAdjDetail
Where  DueAdjCode = @dueadjcode And duedelete = 'N' And SatisfiableQty > 0
Group By saleinvcode
Order By saleinvcode

Open Cursor_DueSatisfyInvoices
Fetch Next From Cursor_DueSatisfyInvoices Into @saleinvcode
Set @continue = 0
While  @@Fetch_Status = 0  And  @continue >= 0 
Begin
	Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'DueSatisfyHeader' , @DueSatisfyCode Output
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	Begin
		Set @continue  = -1
	End
	Else
	Begin
		Insert Into DueSatisfyHeader ( DueSatisfyCode, SaleInvCode, DueSatisfyDate, UserCode, DueAdjCode )
		Values ( @duesatisfycode, @saleinvcode, @serverdate, @usercode, @dueadjcode )

		Declare Cursor_DueSatisfyInvoice_Items Cursor Forward_Only Static For
		Select icode, gcode, salerowid, satisfiableqty From DueAdjDetail Where DueAdjCode = @dueadjcode And saleinvcode = @saleinvcode And duedelete = 'N' And SatisfiableQty > 0
        
		Open Cursor_DueSatisfyInvoice_Items
		Fetch Next From Cursor_DueSatisfyInvoice_Items Into @icode, @gcode, @salerowid, @satisfiableqty
	
		While @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @continue >= 0
		Begin
			IF dbo.Fn_LockSaleDetailRow ( @saleinvcode, @icode, @salerowid ) > 0 
			Begin
				Set @satisfiedqty = dbo.Fn_GetItemDueSatisfiedQty ( @saleinvcode, @icode, @salerowid ) 
				Set @dueqty        = dbo.Fn_GetItemDueQty  ( @saleinvcode, @icode, @salerowid ) 
				IF @dueqty = ( @satisfiedqty + @satisfiableqty )
				Begin
					Execute sp_UpdateSaleDetail @saleinvcode, @gcode, @icode, 'S' , @saleRowId 
					IF @@Error <> 0 
					Begin
						Set @continue = -1
						RaisError('Unable to update Due satisfy status in sale detail for SaleInv: %d' , 16 , 1, @saleinvcode )
					End 
				End 
				Else
				Begin
					IF @dueqty < ( @satisfiedqty + @satisfiableqty )
					Begin
						Set @continue = -1
						RaisError('Unable to update Due satisfy status in sale detail for SaleInv: %d. Reason satisfiable qty exceeds from satisfied qty for Itemcode: %d' , 16 , 1, @saleinvcode, @icode )
					End 				
				End
				IF @continue >= 0 
				Begin
					Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
					IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
					Begin
						Set @continue  = -1
					End
					Else
					Begin
						set @total_availablestock = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.icode = @icode)
						IF @total_availablestock < 0 OR @total_availablestock IS NULL
							SET @total_availablestock=0

						Set @givenqty = @satisfiableqty
						Set @totalqty = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and godowndetail.icode = @icode  )
						IF @totalqty >= @givenqty 
						Begin 
							Select @saleprice = saleprice, @packunits = packunits
							From ITEM
							Where icode = @icode
							IF @packunits = 0 OR @packunits Is Null 
								Set @packunits = 1
							Set @reqqty = @givenqty
							Declare ItemBatch_Cursor Cursor Static Forward_Only
							For 	Select  batch, expiry, Currqty 
							From    godowndetail 
							Where  godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and
								    godowndetail.icode = @icode 
							Order by priority, expiry, Currqty
		
							Open ItemBatch_Cursor
							Set @totalrows = @@Cursor_Rows
							Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
							Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
							Set @counter = 1	
							While @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @counter <= @totalrows AND @reqqty > 0
							Begin
								Set @batchqty = @currqty
								IF @batchqty >= @ReqQty 
									Set @delqty = @reqqty
								Else
									Set @delqty = @batchqty
								Set @reqqty = @reqqty - @delqty
	
								Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @dueutn Output
								IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
								Begin
									Set @continue  = -1															
								End
								SET @total_availablestock = @total_availablestock - @delqty

								Insert Into DueSatisfyDetail (DueSatisfyCode, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, duesatisfyqty, avgprice, duesatisfyutn, packsaleprice, packunits, salerowid, balancestock)
								Values (@duesatisfycode, @icode, @gcode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty, @hold_avgprice, @dueutn, @saleprice, @packunits, @salerowid, @total_availablestock)	

								Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
								IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
								Begin 
									RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Due Sastisfy Detail for Due Satisfy Code : %d' ,16,1, @DueSatisfyCode  )
									Set @continue  = -1
								End 							
								Else
								Begin
									Set @newqty = @currqty - @delqty
									IF @newqty > 0
										Execute @rt_code = sp_SaleUpdateItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @newqty , @currqty
									Else
										Execute @rt_code = sp_DeleteItemStockBatch @gcode, @icode, @batch, @expiry, @delqty
									IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
									Begin
										Set @continue  = -1								
									End
								End
								Set @counter = @counter + 1
								Fetch Next From ItemBatch_Cursor
								Into 	@batch, @expiry, @currqty
							End
							Close ItemBatch_Cursor
							Deallocate ItemBatch_Cursor
						End
						Else
						Begin
							Set @itemname = (Select name from item where icode = @icode )	
							RaisError( 'Not enough stock for item (%s) to decrease for Due Satisfy Code : %d' , 16 , 1, @itemname, @duesatisfycode  )
							Set @continue  = -1								
						End
					End
				End
			End
			Fetch Next From Cursor_DueSatisfyInvoice_Items Into @icode, @gcode, @salerowid, @satisfiableqty
		End
		Close Cursor_DueSatisfyInvoice_Items
		Deallocate Cursor_DueSatisfyInvoice_Items
	End
	Fetch Next From Cursor_DueSatisfyInvoices Into @saleinvcode
End

Close Cursor_DueSatisfyInvoices
Deallocate Cursor_DueSatisfyInvoices

IF @continue >= 0 
Begin
	Declare Cursor_DueDeleteInvoices Cursor Forward_Only Static For 
	Select saleinvcode From DueAdjDetail
	Where  DueAdjCode = @dueadjcode And duedelete = 'Y'
	Group By saleinvcode
	Order By saleinvcode
	
	Open Cursor_DueDeleteInvoices
	Fetch Next From Cursor_DueDeleteInvoices Into @saleinvcode
	Set @continue = 0
	While  @@Fetch_Status = 0  And  @continue >= 0 
	Begin
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'DueSatisfyHeader' , @DueSatisfyCode Output
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
		Else
		Begin
			Insert Into DueSatisfyHeader ( DueSatisfyCode, SaleInvCode, DueSatisfyDate, UserCode, DueAdjCode )
			Values ( @duesatisfycode, @saleinvcode, @serverdate, @usercode, @dueadjcode )
	
			Declare Cursor_DueDeleteInvoice_Items Cursor Forward_Only Static For
			Select icode, gcode, salerowid From DueAdjDetail Where DueAdjCode = @dueadjcode And saleinvcode = @saleinvcode And duedelete = 'Y'
	        
			Open Cursor_DueDeleteInvoice_Items
			Fetch Next From Cursor_DueDeleteInvoice_Items Into @icode, @gcode,  @salerowid
		
			While @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @continue >= 0
			Begin
				IF dbo.Fn_LockSaleDetailRow ( @saleinvcode, @icode, @salerowid ) > 0 
				Begin
					Set @satisfiedqty = dbo.Fn_GetItemDueSatisfiedQty ( @saleinvcode, @icode, @salerowid ) 
					Set @dueqty        = dbo.Fn_GetItemDueQty  ( @saleinvcode, @icode, @salerowid ) 
					IF @dueqty > @satisfiedqty 
					Begin
						Execute sp_UpdateSaleDetail @saleinvcode, @gcode, @icode, 'X' , @saleRowId 
						IF @@Error <> 0 
						Begin
							Set @continue = -1
							RaisError('Unable to update Due delete status in sale detail for SaleInv: %d' , 16 , 1, @saleinvcode )
						End 
					End 
					Else
					Begin
						Set @continue = -1
						RaisError('Unable to update Due delete status in sale detail for SaleInv: %d and Item code : %d. Reason Due qty is already satisfied' , 16 , 1, @saleinvcode, @icode)
					End
					IF @continue >= 0 
					Begin
						Insert Into DueDeleteDetail (DueSatisfyCode, icode, deletedqty, salerowid )
						Values (@duesatisfycode, @icode, ( @dueqty - @satisfiedqty ), @salerowid )	
						Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
						IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
						Begin 
							RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Due Detail Detail for Due Delete Code : %d' ,16,1, @DueSatisfyCode  )
							Set @continue  = -1
						End 							
					End
				End
				Fetch Next From Cursor_DueDeleteInvoice_Items Into @icode, @gcode,  @salerowid
			End
			Close Cursor_DueDeleteInvoice_Items
			Deallocate Cursor_DueDeleteInvoice_Items
		End
		Fetch Next From Cursor_DueDeleteInvoices Into @saleinvcode
	End

	Close Cursor_DueDeleteInvoices
	Deallocate Cursor_DueDeleteInvoices
End

Return @continue

-- sp_setDateForAutoSaleGen
Create Procedure sp_setDateForAutoSaleGen @startdate DateTime, @enddate DateTime, @sinvno Int, @einvno Int
As
Declare @noofdaysforsale Int, @startday Int, @selectedday Int, @startrange Int, @endrange Int, @perdayinv Int
Set @noofdaysforsale = DateDiff ( Day, @startdate, @enddate ) + 1
Set @startday = 1
Set @startrange = @sinvno
Set @perdayinv = ( @einvno - @sinvno ) / @noofdaysforsale
While ( @startday <= @noofdaysforsale )
Begin
	Set @endrange = @startrange + @perdayinv
	Update SaleLedger
	Set originaldate = @startdate, date = @startdate, postdate = @startdate, billingdate = @startdate
	Where SaleInvCode between @startrange AND @endrange
	Set @startrange = @endrange + 1 
	Set @startday = @startday + 1
	Set @startdate = DateAdd ( Day ,  1, @startdate )
End 

Return 0

-- SP_SetGLDetail
CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_SetGLDetail @ai_glvochcode int, @ai_dr_acccode int, @ai_cr_acccode int, @an_amount numeric(15,2), @as_chkno varchar(60), @as_remarks varchar(100), @ai_patientcode int, @ai_guestcode int, @ai_studentcode int, @ai_invoicecode int, @an_outstandingamt numeric(15,2), @an_balance numeric(15,2) AS

Declare @Err As Int , @RowCount As Int
Declare @bal NUMERIC(15,5)
Declare @MaxUtn BIGINT

EXECUTE @err = SP_MaxUtn 2, @MaxUtn OUTPUT
IF @err <> 0 AND @@ERROR <> 0
BEGIN
	RETURN -1			
END

SET @bal = CASE WHEN @an_balance <> 0 THEN @an_balance ELSE ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Debit - Credit) FROM DBO.VirtualGl WHERE AccCode = @ai_dr_acccode), 0) END

-- Insert Debit entry first (as a convention)
INSERT INTO GLDETAIL (glvochcode, acccode, debit, credit, chkno, remarks, glutn, patientcode, guestcode, studentcode, invoicecode, outstandingamt, balance)
VALUES (@ai_glvochcode, @ai_dr_acccode, abs(@an_amount), 0, @as_chkno, @as_remarks, @maxutn, @ai_patientcode, @ai_guestcode, @ai_studentcode, @ai_invoicecode, @an_outstandingamt, @bal)

Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
IF @Err <> 0 OR @rowcount = 0 	
Begin
	RaisError('Debit part of Voucher Insertion Failed in GLDetail' ,16, 1)
	Return -1		
End
ELSE
Begin
	SET @bal = CASE WHEN @an_balance <> 0 THEN @an_balance ELSE ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Debit - Credit) FROM DBO.VirtualGl WHERE AccCode = @ai_cr_acccode), 0) END

	-- Insert Credit entry now (as a convention)
	INSERT INTO GLDETAIL (glvochcode, acccode, debit, credit, chkno, remarks, glutn, patientcode, guestcode, studentcode, invoicecode, outstandingamt, balance)
	VALUES (@ai_glvochcode, @ai_cr_acccode, 0, abs(@an_amount), @as_chkno, @as_remarks, @maxutn+1, @ai_patientcode, @ai_guestcode, @ai_studentcode, @ai_invoicecode, @an_outstandingamt, @bal)
	Select @err = @@Error , @rowcount = @@RowCount
	IF @Err <> 0 OR @rowcount = 0 	
	Begin
		RaisError('Credit part of Voucher Insertion Failed in GLDetail' ,16, 1)
		Return -1		
	End
END
Return 0

-- SP_SetItemActiveStatus
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_SetItemActiveStatus @ICode INT, @Active TINYINT
AS
/*
Author: M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose: 
	This Stored Procedure is used to set the active satus of an item 
	to active or inactive. It takes two parameters 
	i.e. Item Code and Status. 
	This Procedure returns -1
		If item code is not valid
		If status is not valid tinyint
		If it fails to update items' active status
	This Procedure returns 0
		if it sucessfully updates the status passed to this procedure
*/

Declare @err  Int, @rowcount  Int

IF @ICode IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError('Unable to fetch Item Status, Not a Valid Item' , 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

IF @Active IS NULL
BEGIN
	RaisError('Unable to Update Item Active Status Y/N for Item Code = %d, Active status Can not be NULL' , 16, 1, @ICode)
	RETURN -1
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	UPDATE ITEM SET Active = @Active WHERE ICode = @ICode

	SELECT @err = @@ERROR, @rowcount = @@ROWCOUNT
	IF @err = 0 AND @rowcount = 1
		RETURN 0
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Unable to Update Item Active Status Y/N for Item Code = %d' , 16, 1, @ICode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END
RETURN 0

DECLARE @INS NVARCHAR(1000), @SQL NVARCHAR(4000), @QRY NVARCHAR(4000), @TableName NVARCHAR(100), @LIST NVARCHAR(4000), @FROM NVARCHAR(1000)

CREATE PROCEDURE SP_SetVoucherCode_Notes  AS    BEGIN TRANSACTION T1    DECLARE @catcount INT, @counter INT  SET @catcount = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTESCATEGORY)  SET @counter=1    WHILE @counter <= @catcount  BEGIN    CREATE TABLE #lt_table (NoteCode INT NOT NULL, VoucherCode INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL)   INSERT INTO #lt_table   SELECT NoteCode FROM Notes WHERE NOTECatCode = @counter ORDER BY NOTECode      UPDATE NOTES   SET VOUCHERCODE  = #lt_table.VoucherCode   FROM #lt_table, Notes   WHERE Notes.NoteCode = #lt_table.NoteCode     DROP TABLE #lt_table   SET @counter = @counter + 1  END    UPDATE NotesCategory  SET Counter = ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(MAX(VoucherCode), 0) FROM Notes WHERE Notes.NoteCatCode = NotesCategory.NoteCatCode), 0)    COMMIT TRANSACTION T1

-- sp_SingleCustomerBalance
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_SingleCustomerBalance    Script Date: 4/8/02 6:26:06 PM ******/  /****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_SingleCustomerBalance    Script Date: 3/6/02 3:39:37 PM ******/  /****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_SingleCustomerBalance    Script Date: 7/20/01 6:52:02 PM ******/  /****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_SingleCustomerBalance    Script Date: 4/19/00 1:21:26 PM ******/  CREATE PROCEDURE sp_SingleCustomerBalance @ai_custcode smallint, @af_Balance float OUT AS    create table #lt_pvamts   (   custcode numeric (5, 0) NOT NULL,   debit  numeric (15, 2) NOT NULL,   credit numeric (15, 2) NOT NULL  )    DELETE  ReportData     /******************************* Any Credit Sales **********************************/  insert #lt_pvamts  select   saleledger.custcode,    Debit = Isnull(Round(SUM( (saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.Bonusqty) * saledetail.unitsalestax) +     SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *       (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +    Round( (sum( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *       (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) - saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +    Round( sum( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *       (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),    credit = 0.0  from     saleledger, saledetail   where    saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and    saleledger.salecatcode = 2   and    saleledger.Posted = 'Y'   and     saleledger.custcode = @ai_custcode  group by saleledger.saleinvcode,    salecatcode,     saleledger.date,    saleledger.discperc,    saleledger.misccharges,    saleledger.salestax,    saleledger.flatdisc,    saleledger.invgstperc1,    saleledger.custcode/******************************* Credit Sales Returns **********************************/  insert #lt_pvamts select   srledger.custcode,    Debit = 0,    Credit = Isnull(Round(SUM( (srdetail.looseqty + srdetail.bonusqty) * srdetail.unitsalestax) +     SUM(ROUND( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *       (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc)) * srdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +    Round( (sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *       (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) - srledger.flatdisc) * (srledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +    Round( sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *       (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) + srledger.misccharges + srledger.salestax - srledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)  from     srledger, srdetail   where    srledger.Srinvcode = srdetail.Srinvcode and    srledger.srcatcode = 7   and     srledger.Posted = 'Y'   and      srledger.custcode = @ai_custcode group by srledger.srinvcode,    srcatcode,     srledger.date,    srledger.discperc,    srledger.misccharges,    srledger.salestax,    srledger.flatdisc,    srledger.invgstperc1,    srledger.custcode   /******************************* Any Credit Services **********************************/  insert #lt_pvamts  select  serviceheader.custcode,   debit = IsNull( sum(IsNull(servicedetail.price, 0) *    (1 - (.01 * servicedetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * serviceheader.discperc)) +   serviceheader.misccharges - serviceheader.flatdisc,0),   credit= 0.0  from     serviceheader, servicedetail  where    serviceheader.serviceinvcode = servicedetail.serviceinvcode and    serviceheader.servicecatcode = 11     and     serviceheader.posted = 'Y' and    serviceheader.custcode = @ai_custcode  group by serviceheader.serviceinvcode,    serviceheader.servicecatcode,    serviceheader.date,    serviceheader.discperc,    serviceheader.misccharges,    serviceheader.flatdisc,    serviceheader.custcode    /******************************* Any Credit Services Returns ********************************/  insert #lt_pvamts  select  serviceRheader.custcode,   debit = 0.0,   credit= IsNull( sum(IsNull(serviceRdetail.Serviceprice, 0) *    (1 - (.01 * serviceRdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * serviceRheader.discperc)) +   serviceRheader.misccharges - serviceRheader.flatdisc,0)  from     serviceRheader, serviceRdetail  where    serviceRheader.serviceRinvcode = serviceRdetail.serviceRinvcode and    serviceRheader.serviceRcatcode = 14 and     serviceRheader.posted = 'Y' and    serviceRheader.custcode = @ai_custcode  group by serviceRheader.serviceRinvcode,    serviceRheader.serviceRcatcode,    serviceRheader.date,    serviceRheader.discperc,    serviceRheader.misccharges,    serviceRheader.flatdisc,    serviceRheader.custcode      /********************************* Any A/c Vouchers *************************************/  insert #lt_pvamts  select   gldetail.acccode,    case sum(Round(gldetail.debit, 0))    when NULL then 0.0    else sum(Round(gldetail.debit, 0))    end,     case sum(Round(gldetail.credit, 0))    when NULL then 0.0    else sum(Round(gldetail.credit, 0))    end  from     glheader, gldetail   Where glheader.posted = 'Y' and   gldetail.acccode = @ai_custcode and    glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode    GROUP By gldetail.acccode    /******************************* Any Bills Receivables **********************************/  insert #lt_pvamts  select  notes.acccode,   0,    IsNull( sum(notes.amount), 0)  from    notes   Where notes.posted = 'Y' and   notes.notecatcode = 1 and   notes.acccode = @ai_custcode  GROUP BY notes.acccode    /*********************************** Final Report *************************************/  select @af_balance=(select  sum(#lt_pvamts.debit) - sum(#lt_pvamts.credit) from #lt_pvamts  )  /***************************** Final House Keeping *********************************/  drop table #lt_pvamts

-- sp_SLOpeningBalance

/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_SLOpeningBalance    Script Date: 4/23/02 4:29:58 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_SLOpeningBalance    Script Date: 4/8/02 6:26:06 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_SLOpeningBalance    Script Date: 3/6/02 3:39:37 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_SLOpeningBalance    Script Date: 7/20/01 6:52:02 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_SLOpeningBalance    Script Date: 6/28/00 5:23:52 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_SLOpeningBalance    Script Date: 4/24/00 11:19:06 AM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_SLOpeningBalance    Script Date: 4/19/00 1:21:26 PM ******/
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_SLOpeningBalance @al_suppcode numeric(5, 0), @ad_edate datetime, @af_openbalance float out AS 

declare @ln_openbalance numeric(12,2)
create table #lt_pvamts 
(
	debit  numeric (15, 2) NOT NULL,
	credit numeric (15, 2) NOT NULL
)

/*********************************** Packs  Purchases **************************************/
insert #lt_pvamts
select   debit = 0.0,
	 credit= ISNULL(
		 ROUND(SUM(purdetail.packqty * purdetail.purprice * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + 
			purledger.misccharges + purledger.salestax - purledger.flatdisc, 0) +
		 ROUND(SUM((purdetail.packqty + purdetail.bonusqty) * purdetail.unitsalestax)+
			SUM(ROUND(purdetail.packqty * purdetail.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)) * purdetail.gstperc * .01, 2))+
			ROUND((SUM((purdetail.packqty * purdetail.purprice) * 
				(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) - purledger.flatdisc) * 
				(purledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0), 0)

from     purledger, purdetail  
where    purledger.purcatcode in (2,1)    and 
	 purledger.date <= @ad_edate and
	 purledger.posted = 'Y' and 
	 purledger.suppcode = @al_suppcode and
	 purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode 
group by purledger.purinvcode, 
	 purledger.purcatcode, 
	 purledger.date,
	 purledger.discperc,
	 Purledger.misccharges,
	 purledger.salestax,
	 purledger.invgstperc1,
	 purledger.flatdisc

/*********************************** Loose Purchases **************************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select   debit = 0.0,
	 credit= ISNULL(
		 ROUND(sum((purdetail.looseqty * purdetail.purprice) * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + 
			purledger.misccharges + purledger.salestax - purledger.flatdisc, 0) +
		 ROUND(SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty) * purdetail.unitsalestax) +
		 SUM(ROUND(purdetail.looseqty * purdetail.purprice * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)) * purdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
		 ROUND((SUM((purdetail.looseqty * purdetail.purprice) * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) -
			purledger.flatdisc) * (purledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0), 0)

from     purledger, purdetail  

where    purledger.purcatcode in (8,7)    and 
	 purledger.date <= @ad_edate and
	 purledger.posted = 'Y' and 
	 purledger.suppcode = @al_suppcode and
	 purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode 
group by purledger.purinvcode, 
	 purledger.purcatcode, 
	 purledger.date,
	 purledger.discperc,
	 Purledger.misccharges,
	 purledger.salestax,
	 purledger.invgstperc1,
	 purledger.flatdisc

/*********************************** Purchase Returns **************************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select	 debit = ISNULL(
		 ROUND(SUM((prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice) * 
			(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * prledger.discperc)) + 
			prledger.misccharges + prledger.salestax - prledger.flatdisc, 0) +
		 ROUND(SUM((prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.bonusqty) * prdetail.unitsalestax) +
		 SUM(ROUND(prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice * 
			(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc)) * prdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
		 ROUND((SUM((prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice) * 
			(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * prledger.discperc)) -
			prledger.flatdisc) * (prledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0), 0),
	 credit = 0.0
from     prledger, prdetail  
where    prledger.prcatcode in( 5  ,4)    and 
	 prledger.date <= @ad_edate   and
	 prledger.posted = 'Y' and 
	 prledger.suppcode = @al_suppcode and
	 prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode
group by prledger.prinvcode,
	 prledger.prcatcode, 
	 prledger.date,
	 prledger.discperc,
	 prledger.misccharges,
	 prledger.salestax,
	 prledger.invgstperc1,
	 prledger.flatdisc

/*********************************** Any A/C Vouchers **************************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select   case sum(gldetail.debit)
	 when NULL then 0.0
	 else sum(gldetail.debit)
	 end, 
	 case sum(gldetail.credit)
	 when NULL then 0.0
	 else sum(gldetail.credit)
	 end
from     glheader, gldetail  
where    glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode and 
	 glheader.date <= @ad_edate  and
	 glheader.posted = 'Y' and 
	 gldetail.acccode = @al_suppcode

/******************************* Any Bills Payables **********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select   IsNull( sum(notes.amount), 0),
         0
	 
from     notes
where    notes.notecatcode = 2 and
	 notes.posted = 'Y' and
	 notes.postdate <= @ad_edate and
	 notes.acccode = @al_suppcode

/******** Collecting the result and assigning to the relevent reference variable *********/

select @ln_openbalance = ( select sum(debit) - sum(credit)
		 	  from   #lt_pvamts 
			)		

select @af_openbalance =( select convert(float, @ln_openbalance ) )

drop table #lt_pvamts

-- sp_stock_inout
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_stock_inout @s_date datetime,@l_date datetime, @l_code int,@ls_grouping CHAR AS
create table #lt_test
(
	test      numeric (5,  0) NOT NULL
	
)

delete from reportdata
insert into reportdata (code1,value1,value2,value3,value4,value5,value6,value7,value8,value9,value10,value11)


select A.icode ,

saleprice=Round(A.saleprice/A.packunits,2),
purprice=Round(A.purprice/A.packunits,2),


saleqty= /*isnull( isnull((select sum(saledetail.looseqty) from saledetail,saleledger 
		 where saleledger.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		       saleledger.saleinvcode=saledetail.saleinvcode and
		       saledetail.due is null  and
		       saledetail.icode=A.icode),0)
	/*+ isnull((select sum(issuedetail.qty) from issuedetail , issueheader
	   where  issueheader.date between @s_date and @l_date and
	          issueheader.issueinvcode=issuedetail.issueinvcode and 
		  issuedetail.icode=A.icode),0)*/,0)*/

 isnull((select sum(saledetail.looseqty) from saledetail,saleledger 
		 where saleledger.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		       saleledger.saleinvcode=saledetail.saleinvcode and
		       saledetail.due is Null and
		       saledetail.icode=A.icode),0),

saleretqty=isnull((select sum(srdetail.looseqty) from srdetail,srledger 
		  where srledger.date between @s_date and @l_date  and 
			srledger.srinvcode=srdetail.srinvcode and 
			srdetail.icode=A.icode),0),
purqty=isnull(( 
		select sum(Case When purledger.purcatcode IN (3, 7, 8)  THEN
                        	 purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty
			 Else (purdetail.packqty  + purdetail.bonusqty) * purdetail.packunits 
                         END)
		from purdetail,purledger 
		where purledger.postdate between @s_date and @l_date  and 
		           purledger.posted='Y' and
		      purledger.purinvcode=purdetail.purinvcode and
		      purdetail.icode=A.icode
		   ),0),
prqtu=isnull((select sum(prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.bonusqty)
	      from prdetail,prledger 
	      where prledger.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		    prledger.prinvcode=prdetail.prinvcode and
		    prdetail.icode=A.icode),0),
adj=/*isnull((select sum(Case when adjheader.adjcatcode=1 then
			     adjdetail.looseqty 
			ELSE 
			      (-1) * adjdetail.looseqty
			END )
	      from adjdetail,adjheader 
	      where adjheader.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		    adjheader.adjcode=adjdetail.adjcode and
		    adjdetail.icode=A.icode),0),*/
	isnull((select sum(  adjdetail.looseqty )
	      from adjdetail,adjheader 
	      where adjheader.adjcatcode=1 AND
		    adjheader.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		    adjheader.adjcode=adjdetail.adjcode and
		    adjdetail.icode=A.icode),0),

adjdec=isnull((select sum(  adjdetail.looseqty)
	      from adjdetail,adjheader 
	      where adjheader.adjcatcode=2 AND
		    adjheader.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		    adjheader.adjcode=adjdetail.adjcode and
		    adjdetail.icode=A.icode),0),
issue=/*isnull((select sum(issuedetail.qty) from issuedetail , issueheader
	      where  issueheader.date between @s_date and @l_date and
	          issueheader.issueinvcode=issuedetail.issueinvcode and 
		  issuedetail.icode=A.icode),0)
	  - 
	isnull((select sum(receiptdetail.qty) from receiptdetail , receiptheader
	      where  receiptheader.date between @s_date and @l_date and
		     receiptheader.posted='Y' and
	          receiptheader.receiptinvcode=receiptdetail.receiptinvcode and 
		  receiptdetail.icode=A.icode),0)*/
	isnull((select sum(issuedetail.qty) from issuedetail , issueheader
	      where  issueheader.date between @s_date and @l_date and
	          issueheader.issueinvcode=issuedetail.issueinvcode and 
		  issuedetail.icode=A.icode),0),
receipt=isnull((select sum(receiptdetail.qty) from receiptdetail , receiptheader
	      where  receiptheader.date between @s_date and @l_date and
		     receiptheader.posted='Y' and
	          receiptheader.receiptinvcode=receiptdetail.receiptinvcode and 
		  receiptdetail.icode=A.icode),0),
duesatisfy= isnull((select sum(duesatisfydetail.duesatisfyqty) from duesatisfydetail , duesatisfyheader
	   where  	
		  duesatisfyheader.duesatisfydate between @s_date and @l_date and
		  duesatisfyheader.duesatisfycode=duesatisfydetail.duesatisfycode and 
		  duesatisfydetail.icode=A.icode),0)

from item as A 


where   A.active=1 AND (case @ls_grouping when 'M' then A.manfcode
			 		WHEN 'C' THEN A.icatcode
			 		WHEN 'L' THEN A.iccode
					WHEN 'P' THEN A.packcode
       			end) =@l_code
			 
         

drop table  #lt_test
