definition:
-- SP_STOCKLEDGER
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_STOCKLEDGER AS

/* Aquire Table Level Exclusive Lock so that no other user can make read/write operation during the transaction */
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STOCKLEDGER WITH (TABLOCKX)

/* INSERT Purchases into stock ledger table */
INSERT INTO STOCKLEDGER (documentcode, date, documenttype, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, qty,
	bonus, packunits, rate, discperc, invdiscperc, stock, avgprice, newstock, newavgprice, utn, due)
select  documentcode=pl.purinvcode,  
	date=pl.postdate,
	documenttype='PV',
	pd.icode,
	pd.gcode,
	pd.batch,
	pd.expiry,
	qty = isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN packqty * packunits
			when 2 THEN packqty * packunits
			else looseqty
			end, 0),
	bonus = isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN bonusqty * packunits
			when 2 THEN bonusqty * packunits
			else bonusqty
			end, 0),
	pd.packunits, 
	rate=pd.purprice, 
	pd.discperc, 
	invdiscperc=pl.discperc, 
	stock=isnull(pd.currstock, 0),
	avgprice=isnull(pd.avgprice, 0),
	newstock = isnull(pd.currstock, 0) +
		isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN packqty * packunits
			when 2 THEN packqty * packunits
			else looseqty
			end, 0) + isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN bonusqty * packunits
			when 2 THEN bonusqty * packunits
			else bonusqty
			end, 0),
	newavgprice=isnull(pd.newavgprice, 0),
	utn=pd.purutn,
	due=NULL
FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd
WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode and
	NOT EXISTS (select purutn=st.utn from stockledger st where st.documenttype='PV' and pd.purutn=st.utn)

/* INSERT Purchase Returns into stock ledger table */
INSERT INTO STOCKLEDGER (documentcode, date, documenttype, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, qty,
	bonus, packunits, rate, discperc, invdiscperc, stock, avgprice, newstock, newavgprice, utn, due)
select  documentcode=pl.prinvcode,  
	date=pl.date,
	documenttype='PR',
	pd.icode,
	pd.gcode,
	pd.batch,
	pd.expiry, 
	qty = pd.looseqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits,
	bonus = pd.bonusqty,
	pd.packunits, 
	rate=pd.prprice, 
	pd.discperc, 
	invdiscperc=pl.discperc, 
	stock=isnull(pd.balancestock + (pd.looseqty + bonusqty) + (pd.packqty * pd.packunits), 0),
	avgprice=isnull(pd.avgprice, 0),
	newstock = isnull(pd.balancestock, 0),
	newavgprice=isnull(pd.avgprice, 0),
	utn=pd.prutn,
	due=NULL
FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd
WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode and
	NOT EXISTS (select prutn=st.utn from stockledger st where st.documenttype='PR' and pd.prutn = st.utn)

/* Insert sales into stock ledger table */
INSERT INTO STOCKLEDGER (documentcode, date, documenttype, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, qty,
	bonus, packunits, rate, discperc, invdiscperc, stock, avgprice, newstock, newavgprice, utn, due)
select  documentcode=sl.saleinvcode, 
	date = sl.date,
	documenttype='SV',
	sd.icode,
	sd.gcode,
	sd.batch,
	sd.expiry, 
	qty = sd.looseqty + (sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
	bonus = sd.bonusqty,
	sd.packunits, 
	rate=sd.saleprice, 
	discperc=sd.discperc, 
	invdiscperc=sl.discperc, 
	stock=ISNULL(CASE WHEN sd.due IS null THEN sd.balancestock + sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty ELSE sd.balancestock END,0),
	sd.avgprice,
	newstock=isnull(sd.balancestock,0),
	newavgprice=sd.avgprice,
	utn=sd.saleutn,
	due=sd.due
FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and
	NOT EXISTS (select saleutn=st.utn from stockledger st where st.documenttype='SV' and sd.saleutn = st.utn)

/* Insert sales return into stock ledger table */
INSERT INTO STOCKLEDGER (documentcode, date, documenttype, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, qty,
	bonus, packunits, rate, discperc, invdiscperc, stock, avgprice, newstock, newavgprice, utn, due)
select  documentcode=sl.srinvcode, 
	date = sl.postdate,
	documenttype='SR',
	sd.icode,
	sd.gcode,
	sd.batch,
	sd.expiry, 
	qty = sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits,
	bonus = sd.bonusqty,
	sd.packunits, 
	rate=sd.srprice, 
	discperc=sd.discperc, 
	invdiscperc=sl.discperc, 
	stock=ISNULL(sd.currstock, 0),
	sd.avgprice,
	newstock=isnull(sd.currstock + sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + (sd.packqty * sd.packunits),0),
	newavgprice=sd.newavgprice,
	utn=sd.srutn,
	due=NULL
FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode and
	NOT EXISTS (select srutn=st.utn from stockledger st where st.documenttype='SR' AND sd.srutn = st.utn)

/* Insert receipts into stock ledger table */
INSERT INTO STOCKLEDGER (documentcode, date, documenttype, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, qty,
	bonus, packunits, rate, discperc, invdiscperc, stock, avgprice, newstock, newavgprice, utn, due)
select  documentcode=rh.receiptinvcode, 
	date = rh.postdate,
	documenttype='RV',
	rd.icode,
	rd.gcode,
	rd.batch,
	rd.expiry, 
	qty = rd.qty,
	bonus = 0,
	rd.packunits, 
	rate=rd.price, 
	discperc=0, 
	invdiscperc=0, 
	stock=ISNULL(rd.currstock, 0),
	avgprice=rd.avgprice,
	newstock=isnull(rd.currstock + rd.qty,0),
	newavgprice=rd.newavgprice,
	utn=rd.receiptutn,
	due=NULL
FROM receiptheader rh, receiptdetail rd
WHERE rh.posted = 'Y' AND rh.receiptinvcode = rd.receiptinvcode and
	 NOT EXISTS (select receiptutn=st.utn from stockledger st where st.documenttype='RV' and rd.receiptutn=st.utn)

/* Insert Issue into stock ledger table */
INSERT INTO STOCKLEDGER (documentcode, date, documenttype, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, qty,
	bonus, packunits, rate, discperc, invdiscperc, stock, avgprice, newstock, newavgprice, utn, due)
select  documentcode=ih.issueinvcode, 
	date = ih.date,
	documenttype='IV',
	isd.icode,
	isd.gcode,
	isd.batch,
	isd.expiry, 
	qty = isd.qty,
	bonus = 0,
	isd.packunits, 
	rate=isd.saleprice, 
	discperc=0, 
	invdiscperc=0, 
	stock= isnull(isd.balancestock + isd.qty, 0),
	avgprice=isd.avgprice,
	newstock=isnull(isd.balancestock,0),
	newavgprice=isd.avgprice,
	utn=isd.issueutn,
	due=NULL
FROM issueheader ih, issuedetail isd
WHERE ih.posted = 'Y' AND ih.issueinvcode = isd.issueinvcode and
	NOT EXISTS (select issueutn=st.utn from stockledger st where st.documenttype='IV' and isd.issueutn=st.utn)

/* Insert Adjustment Increase into stock ledger table */
INSERT INTO STOCKLEDGER (documentcode, date, documenttype, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, qty,
	bonus, packunits, rate, discperc, invdiscperc, stock, avgprice, newstock, newavgprice, utn, due)
select  documentcode=ah.adjcode, 
	date = ah.posteddate,
	documenttype='AI',
	ad.icode,
	ad.gcode,
	ad.batch,
	ad.expiry, 
	qty = ad.looseqty,
	bonus = 0,
	ad.packunits, 
	rate=ad.price, 
	discperc=0, 
	invdiscperc=0, 
	stock= ISNULL(ad.currstock, 0),
	avgprice=ad.avgprice,
	newstock=isnull(ad.currstock + ad.looseqty,0),
	newavgprice=ad.newavgprice,
	utn=ad.adjutn,
	due=NULL
FROM adjheader ah, adjdetail ad
WHERE ah.adjcatcode = 1 and ah.posted = 'Y' AND ah.adjcode = ad.adjcode and
	NOT EXISTS (select adjutn=st.utn from stockledger st where st.documenttype='AI' AND ad.adjutn=st.utn)

/* Insert Adjustment Decrease into stock ledger table */
INSERT INTO STOCKLEDGER (documentcode, date, documenttype, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, qty,
	bonus, packunits, rate, discperc, invdiscperc, stock, avgprice, newstock, newavgprice, utn, due)
select  documentcode=ah.adjcode, 
	date = ah.posteddate,
	documenttype='AD',
	ad.icode,
	ad.gcode,
	ad.batch,
	ad.expiry, 
	qty = ad.looseqty,
	bonus = 0,
	ad.packunits, 
	rate=ad.price, 
	discperc=0, 
	invdiscperc=0, 
	stock= ISNULL(ad.currstock, 0),
	avgprice=ad.avgprice,
	newstock=isnull(ad.currstock - ad.looseqty,0),
	newavgprice=ad.avgprice,
	utn=ad.adjutn,
	due=NULL
FROM adjheader ah, adjdetail ad
WHERE ah.adjcatcode = 2 and ah.posted = 'Y' AND ah.adjcode = ad.adjcode and
	NOT EXISTS (select adjutn=st.utn from stockledger st where st.documenttype='AD' AND ad.adjutn=st.utn)

/* Insert Due Satisfied into stock ledger table */
INSERT INTO STOCKLEDGER (documentcode, date, documenttype, icode, gcode, batch, expiry, qty,
	bonus, packunits, rate, discperc, invdiscperc, stock, avgprice, newstock, newavgprice, utn, due)
select  documentcode=dh.duesatisfycode, 
	date = dh.duesatisfydate,
	documenttype='DS',
	dsd.icode,
	dsd.gcode,
	dsd.batch,
	dsd.expiry, 
	qty = dsd.duesatisfyqty,
	bonus = 0,
	packunits=1, 
	rate=0, 
	discperc=0, 
	invdiscperc=0, 
	stock= ISNULL(dsd.balancestock + dsd.duesatisfyqty, 0),
	avgprice=dsd.avgprice,
	newstock=isnull(dsd.balancestock, 0),
	newavgprice=dsd.avgprice,
	utn=dsd.duesatisfyutn,
	due=NULL
FROM duesatisfyheader dh, duesatisfydetail dsd
WHERE dh.duesatisfycode = dsd.duesatisfycode and
	NOT EXISTS (select duesatisfyutn=st.utn from stockledger st where st.documenttype='DS' and dsd.duesatisfyutn=st.utn)

CREATE PROCEDURE sp_stockmovementcatwise @s_date datetime,@l_date datetime, @l_catcode int AS



create table #lt_test
(
	test      numeric (5,  0) NOT NULL
	
)

delete from reportdata
insert into reportdata (code1,value1,value2,value3,value4,value5,value6,value7,value8)


select A.icode ,

saleprice=Round(A.saleprice/A.packunits,2),
purprice=Round(A.purprice/A.packunits,2),


saleqty= /*isnull( isnull((select sum(saledetail.looseqty) from saledetail,saleledger 
		 where saleledger.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		       saleledger.saleinvcode=saledetail.saleinvcode and
		       saledetail.due is Null and
		       saledetail.icode=A.icode),0)
	/*+ isnull((select sum(issuedetail.qty) from issuedetail , issueheader
	   where  issueheader.date between @s_date and @l_date and
	          issueheader.issueinvcode=issuedetail.issueinvcode and 
		  issuedetail.icode=A.icode),0)*/,0),*/
isnull( isnull((select sum(saledetail.looseqty) from saledetail,saleledger 
		 where saleledger.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		       saleledger.saleinvcode=saledetail.saleinvcode and
		       saledetail.due is Null and
		       saledetail.icode=A.icode),0)
	+ isnull((select sum(duesatisfydetail.duesatisfyqty) from duesatisfydetail , duesatisfyheader
	   where  duesatisfyheader.duesatisfydate between @s_date and @l_date and
	          duesatisfyheader.duesatisfycode=duesatisfydetail.duesatisfycode and 
		  duesatisfydetail.icode=A.icode),0),0),
saleretqty=isnull((select sum(srdetail.looseqty) from srdetail,srledger 
		  where srledger.date between @s_date and @l_date  and 
			srledger.srinvcode=srdetail.srinvcode and 
			srdetail.icode=A.icode),0),
purqty=isnull(( 
		select sum(Case When purledger.purcatcode IN (3, 7, 8)  THEN
                        	purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty
			   Else (purdetail.packqty  + purdetail.bonusqty) * purdetail.packunits 
                           END)
		from purdetail,purledger 
		where purledger.postdate between @s_date and @l_date  and 
		           purledger.posted='Y' and
		      purledger.purinvcode=purdetail.purinvcode and
		      purdetail.icode=A.icode
		   ),0),
prqtu=isnull((select sum(prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.bonusqty)
	      from prdetail,prledger 
	      where prledger.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		    prledger.prinvcode=prdetail.prinvcode and
		    prdetail.icode=A.icode),0),
adj=isnull((select sum(Case when adjheader.adjcatcode=1 then
			     adjdetail.looseqty 
			ELSE 
			      (-1) * adjdetail.looseqty
			END )
	      from adjdetail,adjheader 
	      where adjheader.date between @s_date and @l_date  and
		    adjheader.adjcode=adjdetail.adjcode and
		    adjdetail.icode=A.icode),0),
issue=isnull((select sum(issuedetail.qty) from issuedetail , issueheader
	      where  issueheader.date between @s_date and @l_date and
	          issueheader.issueinvcode=issuedetail.issueinvcode and 
		  issuedetail.icode=A.icode),0)
	  - 
	isnull((select sum(receiptdetail.qty) from receiptdetail , receiptheader
	      where  receiptheader.date between @s_date and @l_date and
		     receiptheader.posted='Y' and
	          receiptheader.receiptinvcode=receiptdetail.receiptinvcode and 
		  receiptdetail.icode=A.icode),0)
from item as A /*,


(
select distinct(purdetail.icode) 
from purdetail,purledger


where purledger.suppcode= @l_suppcode and
      purledger.porb='Y' and
      purledger.posted='Y' and
      purledger.postdate < @l_date  and
      purledger.purinvcode=purdetail.purinvcode) as A

where item.icode=A.icode AND
          item.active=1*/

where A.icatcode=@l_catcode AND
          A.active=1

/*drop table  #lt_test*/

-- sp_StockRegister

/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_StockRegister    Script Date: 4/23/02 4:29:59 PM ******/
/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_StockRegister    Script Date: 3/6/02 3:39:37 PM ******/
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_StockRegister  as
/*////////////////////////  Purchase /////////////////////////////////// */	
select type = 'PV-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), PL.purinvcode))),
	Postdate = PL.postdate, Due = null, date = PL.postdate, salesman = U.username, 
	title = Case When purcatcode = 1 or purcatcode = 2 or purcatcode = 7 or purcatcode = 8  Then
		     (Select accounts.name
		        From accounts 
		        Where accounts.acccode = PL.suppcode)	
		Else 'Opening Purchase'	
		End,
	qtyIn = Case When PL.purcatcode IN (3,7,8)  THEN
			PD.looseqty + (PD.packqty * PD.packunits) +
			PD.bonusqty
		 Else   PD.looseqty + (PD.packqty * PD.packunits) + 
			(PD.bonusqty * PD.packunits)
		 END,
	qtyOut= 0, batch = PD.batch, PD.avgprice, balqty=0, rate=0.00, 
	itemname = (Select item.name from item where icode = 5412) ,
	toutqty=0, expiry=PD.expiry, reference = '         ',
	price = Case When purcatcode = 3 or purcatcode = 7 or purcatcode = 8 
		Then PD.purprice
		Else PD.purprice / PD.packunits 
		End,
	discount = PD.DiscPerc

from  PurLedger PL, purdetail PD, users U  

where PL.purinvcode = PD.purinvcode and PD.icode = 5412	and PD.GCode = 1 and
 	PL.postdate between '1/1/2000' and '10/10/2000' and
	PL.Posted = 'Y' and PL.salesmancode = U.usercode

UNION	

/*////////////////////////  Purchase Return//////////////////////////// */	
select type = 'PR-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), PL.prinvcode))),
	Postdate = PL.date, Due = null, date = PL.postdate, salesman = U.username ,
	title = Case	 
		When prcatcode = 4 or prcatcode = 5 Then
		(Select accounts.name 
			from accounts 
			where accounts.acccode = PL.suppcode)	
		Else 'Opening Purchase Return'	
		End,
	QtyIn = 0, QtyOut= PD.looseqty + (PD.packqty * PD.packunits) + PD.bonusqty,
	batch = PD.batch, PD.avgprice, balqty=0, rate=0.00, 
	itemname='                                        ',
	toutqty=0, expiry=PD.expiry, reference = '          ',
	price = PD.prprice, discount = PD.DiscPerc

from    prledger PL, prdetail PD, users U

where   PL.prinvcode = PD.prinvcode and	
	PD.icode = 5412		and 	
	PD.GCode = 1 and
	PL.postdate between '1/1/2000' and '10/10/2000' 	and
	PL.posted = 'Y' and
	PL.salesmancode = U.usercode

UNION

/*////////////////////////  sale Return////////////////////////////////// */	
select  type = Case  SL.srcatcode	
		When 8 Then 'RR-'	
		Else        'WR-'		
		End	
		 + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), SL.srinvcode))),
	Postdate = SL.postdate, Due=null, date = SL.postdate,
	salesman = U.username,
	
	title= Case 	
		When srcatcode = 6 or srcatcode = 7 Then (Select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode = SL.custcode)	
		Else 'Retail Sale Return Cash'	
		End,
	
	qtyIn = SD.looseqty, QtyOut= 0, batch = SD.batch, SD.avgprice, balqty=0, 
	rate=0.00, itemname='                                        ', toutqty=0, 
	expiry=SD.expiry, reference = '                ', price = SD.srprice, 
	discount = SD.DiscPerc

from   srledger SL, srdetail SD, users U

where  SL.srinvcode = SD.srinvcode and	
		 SD.icode = 5412		and 
		 SD.GCode = 1 and	
		 SL.postdate between '1/1/2000' and '10/10/2000' and
		 SL.posted = 'Y' and
		 SL.salesmancode = U.usercode

union

/*////////////////////////  DUE Satisfied ////////////////////////////////// */	
select  type = 'SN-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode))),
	Postdate = DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyDate, Due = 'A', date = DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyDate, 
	salesman = U.username ,
	Title = Case 	
		When (Select SL.salecatcode from saleledger SL
			 Where SL.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode) = 1 
			or(Select SL.salecatcode from saleledger SL
				 Where SL.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode) = 2 
		Then (Select accounts.name from accounts, saleledger SL
			where SL.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode  and 
			accounts.acccode = SL.custcode)	
		Else 'Retail Sale Cash'	
	End,

	qtyIn = 0,
	QtyOut= DueSatisfyDetail.DueSatisfyqty,
	batch = DueSatisfyDetail.batch,
	avgprice=0,
	balqty=0,
	rate=0.00,
	itemname='                                        ',
	toutqty=0,
	expiry=DueSatisfyDetail.expiry,
	reference = '         ' ,
	price = (select saleprice 
			from saledetail SD
			where SD.saleinvcode = duesatisfyheader.saleinvcode and 
					SD.icode = 5412
       
			group by icode, saleprice),
	discount = (select DiscPerc 
			from saledetail SD
			where SD.saleinvcode = duesatisfyheader.saleinvcode and 
				SD.icode = 5412
			group by icode, DiscPerc)
		
from    DueSatisfyHeader,
	DueSatisfydetail,
	users U  	

where   DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyCode = DueSatisfyDetail.DueSatisfyCode and	
	DueSatisfyDetail.icode = 5412			and 	
	DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfydate between '1/1/2000' and '10/10/2000' and
	DueSatisfyHeader.usercode = U.usercode and DueSatisfyDetail.gcode = 1

union

/*////////////////////////  DUE Deleted ////////////////////////////////// */	
select type = 'DN-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6),
	DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode))),
	Postdate = DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyDate,
	Due = 'B',
	date = DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyDate,
	salesman = U.username ,
	Title= Case 	
		When (Select SL.salecatcode from saleledger SL
			Where SL.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode) = 1 
			or(Select SL.salecatcode from saleledger SL
			 Where SL.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode) = 2 
		Then (Select accounts.name from accounts,
			saleledger SL
			where SL.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode  and 
			accounts.acccode = SL.custcode)	
		Else 'Retail Sale Cash'	
		End,
	qtyIn = 0,
	QtyOut= DueDeleteDetail.deletedqty,
	batch = '',
	avgprice=0,
	balqty=0,
	rate=0.00,
	itemname='                                        ',
	toutqty=0,
	expiry=null,
	reference = '         ',
	price = (select saleprice 
			from saledetail SD
			where SD.saleinvcode = duesatisfyheader.saleinvcode and 
				SD.icode = 5412
			group by icode, saleprice),

	discount = (select DiscPerc
			from saledetail SD
			where SD.saleinvcode = duesatisfyheader.saleinvcode and 
				SD.icode = 5412
			group by icode,	DiscPerc)
		
from    DueSatisfyHeader,
	DueDeletedetail,
	users U  	

where   DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyCode = DueDeleteDetail.DueSatisfyCode and	
	DueDeleteDetail.icode = 5412			and 	
	DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfydate between '1/1/2000' and '10/10/2000' and
	DueSatisfyHeader.usercode = U.usercode

Union

/*////////////////////////  Stock Adjustment ////////////////////////////////// */	
select type = 'AI-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), AdjHeader.AdjCode))),
	Postdate = AdjHeader.posteddate,
	Due = 'z',
	date = AdjHeader.date,
	salesman = U.username ,
	title=  'Stock Adjustment-' + 
		CASE 
		WHEN (AdjHeader.AdjCatCode = 1) THEN 'Increase'
		ELSE 'Decrease'
		END,
	qtyIn = CASE 
		WHEN (AdjHeader.AdjCatCode = 1) THEN AdjDetail.Looseqty
		ELSE 0
		END,
	QtyOut= CASE 
		WHEN (AdjHeader.AdjCatCode = 1) THEN 0
		ELSE AdjDetail.Looseqty
		END,
	batch = AdjDetail.batch,
	avprice=0,
	balqty=0,
	rate=0.00,
	itemname='                                        ',
	toutqty=0,
	expiry=AdjDetail.expiry,
	reference = '         ',
	price = 0,
	discount = 0

from    AdjHeader,
        AdjDetail,
        users U  	

where   AdjHeader.AdjCode = AdjDetail.AdjCode and	
	AdjDetail.GCode = 1 and		
	AdjDetail.icode = 5412 and 	
	AdjHeader.AdjCatCode = 1 and
	AdjHeader.Posteddate between '1/1/2000' and '10/10/2000' and
	AdjHeader.UserCode = U.usercode

Union

/*////////////////////////  Transfers  ////////////////////////////////// */	
select  type = 'TO-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), THeader.TransCode))),
	Postdate = THeader.postdate,
	Due = 'z',
	date = THeader.date,
	salesman = U.username ,
	Title = CASE 
		WHEN (THeader.SGCode = 1) THEN 'Transfer Out'
		ELSE 'Transfer In'
		END,
	qtyIn = CASE 
		WHEN (THeader.SGCode = 1) THEN 0
		ELSE TDetail.qty
		END,
	QtyOut= CASE 
		WHEN (THeader.DGCode = 1) THEN TDetail.qty
		ELSE 0
		END,
	batch = TDetail.batch,
	avgprice=0,
	balqty=0,
	rate=0.00,
	itemname='                                        ',
	toutqty=0,
	expiry=TDetail.expiry,
	reference = '         ',
	price = 0,
	discount = 0

from    THeader,
        TDetail,
        users U  	

where   THeader.TransCode = TDetail.TransCode and	
	(THeader.SGCode = 1 or THeader.DGCode = 1) and		
	TDetail.icode = 5412 and 	
	THeader.date between '1/1/2000' and '10/10/2000' and
	THeader.Salesmancode = U.usercode

Union
       
select  type = 'II-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6),
	IssueHeader.IssueInvCode))),
	Postdate = IssueHeader.postdate,
	Due = 'z',
	date = IssueHeader.date,
	salesman = U.username ,
	Title='Receipt',
	qtyIn = 0,
	QtyOut= IssueDetail.qty,
	batch = IssueDetail.batch,
	avgprice=0,
	balqty=0,
	rate=0.00,
	itemname='                                        '				,
	toutqty=0,
	expiry=IssueDetail.expiry,
	reference = '         ',
	price = IssueDetail.SalePrice,
	discount = 0

from    IssueHeader,
        IssueDetail,
        users U  	

where   IssueHeader.IssueInvCode = IssueDetail.IssueInvCode and	
	IssueDetail.icode = 5412 and 	
	IssueDetail.GCode = 1 and	
	IssueHeader.date between '1/1/2000' and '10/10/2000' and
	IssueHeader.Salesmancode = U.usercode

Union

select  type = 'II-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6),
	ReceiptHeader.ReceiptInvCode))),
	Postdate = ReceiptHeader.postdate,
	Due = 'z',
	date = ReceiptHeader.date,
	salesman = U.username ,
	title='Receipt',
	qtyIn = ReceiptDetail.qty,
	QtyOut= 0,
	batch = ReceiptDetail.batch,
	avgprice=0,
	balqty=0,
	rate=0.00,
	itemname='                                        '				,
	toutqty=0,
	expiry=ReceiptDetail.expiry,
	reference = '         ',
	price = ReceiptDetail.SalePrice,
	discount = 0

from    ReceiptHeader,
        ReceiptDetail,
        users U

where   ReceiptHeader.ReceiptInvCode = ReceiptDetail.ReceiptInvCode and	
	ReceiptDetail.icode = 5412 and
	ReceiptDetail.GCode = 1 and 	
	ReceiptHeader.postdate between '1/1/2000' and '10/10/2000' and
	ReceiptHeader.Salesmancode = U.usercode

union

/*////////////////////////  Sale///////////////////////////////////////// */	
select  type = Case  SL.salecatcode	
		   When  1 Then 'WS-'	
		   When  2 Then 'WS-'	 
		   When  3 Then 'RS-'	 
  		   When  4 Then 'CS-'		
		   Else  'UK-'		
		End	
		 +
		 RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), SL.saleinvcode))),

	Postdate = SL.postdate, Due = SD.Due, date = SL.date, salesman = U.username ,
	title= 	Case 	
		When salecatcode = 1 or salecatcode = 2 Then 
			(Select accounts.name from accounts 
				where accounts.acccode = SL.custcode)
		Else 'Retail Sale Cash'
		End,

	 qtyIn = 0, QtyOut= SD.looseqty, batch = SD.batch, SD.avgprice, balqty=0, 
	 rate=0.00, itemname='                                        ', toutqty=0, 
	 expiry=SD.expiry, reference = SL.CustRefNo, price = SD.saleprice, discount = SD.DiscPerc
		
from   saleledger SL, saledetail SD, users U
where  SL.saleinvcode = SD.saleinvcode and	
	 SD.icode = 5412		and
	 SD.GCode = 1 and 	
	 SL.date Between  '1/1/2000' and '10/10/2000' and
	 SL.salesmancode = U.usercode
       
Order By date, batch, expiry

-- SP_StockReport
CREATE  PROCEDURE dbo.SP_StockReport @DailyReportDays INTEGER, @ArchiveReportDays INTEGER AS

/* 
	First Delete Reports Older than @DailyReportDays passed as first argument 
	to this script. But Don't Delete Reports for 1st, 10th and 20th day of month.
*/
/**** Deletion Stopped C/O Rashid/Shakil/Azhar 05-JUN-2023  ****/
--DELETE StockReport WHERE DATE <= GETDATE() - @DailyReportDays AND DATEPART(dy, DATE) NOT IN (1, 10, 20)

/* 
	Now Delete Reports Older than @ArchiveReportDays passed as 2nd argument 
	to this script. This will Delete Reports for 1st, 10th and 20th day of month
	as well.
*/
/**** Deletion Stopped C/O Rashid/Shakil/Azhar 05-JUN-2023  ****/
--DELETE StockReport WHERE DATE <= GETDATE() - @ArchiveReportDays

/*
	Now check whether the today's report is submitted/saved or not. If yes than no 
	need to save it again else store it.
*/
INSERT INTO StockReport (Date, GCode, ICode, Stock, PurchasePrice, SalePrice, 
	AvgPrice, RecentPurchasePrice, PackUnits)
SELECT
	Date=GETDATE(),
	Gcode=Gd.GCode,
	ICode=Gd.ICode,
	Stock=SUM(Gd.CurrQty),
	PurchasePrice=I.PurPrice,
	SalePrice=I.SalePrice,
	AvPrice=I.AvgPrice,
	RecentPurchasePrice=I.RecentPurPrice,
	PackUnits=I.PackUnits
FROM
	GodownDetail Gd,
	Item I
WHERE
	Gd.ICode = I.ICode AND
	CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), GETDATE(), 101) NOT IN
	(SELECT DISTINCT CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), Date, 101) FROM STOCKREPORT)

GROUP BY
	Gd.GCode,
	Gd.ICode,
	I.PurPrice,
	I.SalePrice,
	I.AvgPrice,
	I.RecentPurPrice,
	I.PackUnits

-- sp_StudentOpeningBalance
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_StudentOpeningBalance @al_StudentCode INT, @ad_edate datetime, @af_openbalance NUMERIC(15,5) OUT AS 
/*
	Two Parameters:-
		1)	ad_edate datetime 	(date upto which the balance is required)
		2)	af_openbalance float 	(output variable returns the balance to caller)
*/
/******** Collecting the result and assigning to the relevent reference variable *********/
select @af_openbalance = isnull( 
(select sum(V.debit) - sum(V.credit)
from VirtualGL V
WHERE V.StudentCode = @al_StudentCode AND 
	V.AccCode IN 
		(SELECT CustCode 
		FROM Student
		WHERE StudentCode = @al_StudentCode) AND
	V.Date < @ad_edate), 0)

definition:
-- SP_SUBAREASALES
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_SUBAREASALES @ar_startdate datetime, @ar_enddate datetime, @ReportGrouping CHAR(1), @GroupList Varchar(8000), @SubAreaList Varchar(8000) AS    
/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of a
	subarea areas and items selected depending upon the grouping criteria selected.

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@ar_startdate, @ar_enddate = Determine the period of report
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items in report
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
	@SubAreaList = A comma separated list of values of subareacode
*/
DELETE ReportData    

DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_SubAreaList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_SubAreaList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@SubAreaList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

INSERT INTO ReportData (code1, code2, code3, code4, name1, name2, name3, name4, name5, name6, name7, value1, value2)  
SELECT  
	Code1=S.ICODE,
	Code2=S.SUBAREACODE,
	Code3=CASE @ReportGrouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN I.MANFCODE
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
		ELSE I.PACKCODE END,
	Code4=0,
	Name1=I.NAME,
	Name2=(SELECT SUBAREA.NAME FROM SUBAREA WHERE SUBAREA.SUBAREACODE = S.SUBAREACODE),
	Name3=CASE @ReportGrouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
		WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
		WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
		ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,
	Name4=I.CUSTOMICODE,
	Name5=I.PackingDesc,
	Name6=RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(S.ICODE))),
	Name7='',
	Value1= SUM(QTY),
	Value2 = ROUND(SUM(NETAMT), 0)
FROM
	(SELECT INVNO=-1,
		ICODE=I.ICODE,
		CUSTCODE=-1,
		QTY = 0,
		NETAMT=0,
		A.SUBAREACODE
	FROM
		(SELECT SubAreaCode=CODE FROM @Tab_SubAreaList) A,
		(SELECT ICODE=MIN(code) FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=-1,
		ICODE=I.ICODE,
		CUSTCODE=-1,
		QTY = 0,
		NETAMT=0,
		A.SUBAREACODE
	FROM
		(SELECT SubAreaCode=min(CODE) FROM @Tab_SubAreaList) A,
		(SELECT ICODE=Code FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=SL.SALEINVCODE,
		SD.ICODE,
		CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
		QTY = ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
		NETAMT=Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)), 0), 2),
		SA.SUBAREACODE
	FROM
		SALELEDGER SL,
		SALEDETAIL SD,
		CUSTOMER C,
		(SELECT SubAreaCode=CODE FROM @Tab_SubAreaList) SA
	WHERE
		C.SUBAREACODE = SA.SUBAREACODE AND
		C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND 
		SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND
		SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
	GROUP BY
		SL.SaleInvCode,
		SD.ICODE,
		SL.CustCode,
		SA.SUBAREACODE,
		SL.DiscPerc
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=SL.SRINVCODE,
		SD.ICODE,
		CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
		QTY = - ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
		NETAMT= - Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty * SD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)), 0), 2),
		SA.SUBAREACODE
	FROM
		SRLEDGER SL,
		SRDETAIL SD,
		CUSTOMER C,
		(SELECT SubAreaCode=CODE FROM @Tab_SubAreaList) SA
	WHERE
		SA.SUBAREACODE = C.SUBAREACODE AND
		C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SRINVCODE = SD.SRINVCODE AND
		SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
	GROUP BY
		SL.SRInvCode,
		SD.ICODE,
		SL.CustCode,
		SA.SUBAREACODE,
		SL.DiscPerc) S,
	ITEM I
WHERE
	S.ICode = I.ICode AND I.ICODE IN (SELECT Code FROM @Tab_ItemList)
GROUP BY
	S.SUBAREACODE,
	S.ICODE,
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.PackingDesc,
	I.ICatCode,
	I.ICCode,
	I.ManfCode,
	I.PackCode

name: SP_SUBAREASALES_CROSSTAB
definition:
-- SP_SUBAREASALES_CROSSTAB
CREATE   PROCEDURE SP_SUBAREASALES_CROSSTAB
	@startdate datetime, 
	@enddate datetime, 
	@ReportGrouping CHAR(1), 
	@GroupList VARCHAR(8000), 
	@Pricetype TinyInt, 
	@TotCol Float,
	@SubAreaList Varchar(8000) ,
	@onlysalearea CHAR(1),
	@MergeBonus TINYINT AS

/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'crosstab_reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of an
	Area's sales in all aits subareas and items selected depending upon the grouping criteria selected.

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@startdate, @ar_enddate = Determine the period of report
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items in report
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
	@Pricetype = 1 stands for Actual Price, 2 stands for Sale/Trade Price, 3 stands for Purchase price and 4 stands for Average price
	@TotCol = the number of cross tab clolumns for the report (area shortname columns)
	@SubAreaList = A comma separated SubArea List of values to be filtered for which report is required,
	@MergeBonus = Bonus qty should be merged into sale qty or not (1 = Yes, 0 = No)
*/



DELETE CrossTab_ReportData

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @coltable TABLE (code int, shortname varchar(100), rowid INT identity(1,1))
DECLARE @saleareastable TABLE (code int)
DECLARE @UPD VARCHAR(4000), @Col VARCHAR(10), @RowID INT, @colname VARCHAR(100), @colcode VARCHAR(100), @str_col VARCHAR(10)
DECLARE @totareas FLOAT, @curriter int, @iterations int, @i int, @tot int
DECLARE @ICODE INTEGER, @SUBAREACODE INTEGER, @QTY NUMERIC(15, 4), @Bonus NUMERIC(15, 4), @VAL NUMERIC(15, 5), @err INT

INSERT INTO @saleareastable 
SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@SubAreaList, ',')

DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

IF @onlysalearea='Y' 
	delete from @saleareastable 
	where code not in 
		(select distinct(customer.Subareacode)
		from saleledger,customer,item,saledetail
		where 	posted='Y' and 
			saleledger.date>=@startdate and 
			saleledger.date<=@enddate and 
			saleledger.custcode=customer.custcode and
			saleledger.saleinvcode=saledetail.saleinvcode and
			saledetail.icode=item.icode and
			CASE @ReportGrouping 
				WHEN 'M' THEN item.MANFCODE 
				WHEN 'C' THEN item.ICatCode 
				WHEN 'L' THEN item.ICCode 
				ELSE item.PACKCODE END IN (select code from @Tab_GroupList)
		union
		select distinct(customer.Subareacode)
		from srledger,customer,srdetail,item
		where 	posted='Y' and 
			srledger.date>=@startdate and 
			srledger.date<=@enddate and 
			srledger.custcode=customer.custcode and
			srledger.srinvcode=srdetail.srinvcode and
			srdetail.icode=item.icode and
			CASE @ReportGrouping 
				WHEN 'M' THEN item.MANFCODE 
				WHEN 'C' THEN item.ICatCode 
				WHEN 'L' THEN item.ICCode 
				ELSE item.PACKCODE END IN (select code from @Tab_GroupList))

SELECT @totareas = ISNULL((SELECT Count(Code) FROM @saleareastable), 0)

IF @totareas > 0 and @TotCol > 0
BEGIN

	SELECT @tot = (SELECT MIN(A) FROM (SELECT A=@TotCol UNION SELECT A=@TotAreas) T)

	INSERT @coltable
	SELECT S.SubAreaCode, S.Name
	FROM @saleareastable A, SubArea S
	WHERE A.Code = S.SubAreaCode
	ORDER BY S.Name

	SET @iterations = CEILING(@totareas/@TotCol)
	SET @curriter = 1
	SET @RowID = 0
	WHILE @curriter <= @iterations
	BEGIN
		
		INSERT INTO CrossTab_ReportData (Code1, Code2, Code3)
		SELECT Code, @curriter, NULL FROM @Tab_ItemList

		SET @i = 1
		WHILE @i <= @tot
		BEGIN
			SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
			SELECT @colname = RTRIM(LTRIM(ISNULL((SELECT shortname FROM @coltable WHERE ROWID = @RowID), '')))
			SELECT @colcode = RTRIM(LTRIM(STR((SELECT CODE FROM @coltable WHERE ROWID = @RowID), 7)))
			IF @colcode IS NULL
			BEGIN
				BREAK
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @str_col = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@i, 7)))
				SELECT @UPD = 	'UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData SET C_Name' + @str_col + 
								' = ''' + @colname + ''', C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colcode +
								' WHERE CODE2 = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@curriter, 7)))
				EXECUTE (@UPD)
				SET @err = @@ERROR
				IF @err <> 0
				BEGIN
					SET @UPD = 'UPDATION ERROR, DETAILS: ' + @UPD
					RAISERROR(@UPD, 16, 1, @UPD)
					RETURN -1
				END 
				SET @i = @i + 1
			END
		END
		SET @curriter = @curriter + 1
	END

	DECLARE C1 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT S.ICODE, QTY = ISNULL(Sum(S.QTY), 0), Bonus = ISNULL(Sum(S.Bonus), 0),
		VAL= ROUND(SUM(
			CASE @Pricetype WHEN 1 THEN S.NETAMT 
			WHEN 2 THEN S.QTY * ROUND(I.SALEPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			WHEN 3 THEN S.QTY * ROUND(I.PURPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			ELSE S.QTY * ROUND(I.AVGPRICE, 2) END), 0), 
		S.SUBAREACODE
	FROM
		(SELECT INVNO=SL.SALEINVCODE,
			SD.ICODE,
			CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
			QTY = ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + CASE WHEN @MergeBonus = 1 THEN SD.bonusqty ELSE 0 END), 0),
			Bonus = ISNULL(Sum(CASE WHEN @MergeBonus = 1 THEN 0 ELSE SD.bonusqty END), 0),
			NETAMT=Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)), 0), 2),
			C.SUBAREACODE
		FROM
			SALELEDGER SL,
			SALEDETAIL SD,
			CUSTOMER C
		WHERE
			C.SubAreaCode in (SELECT CODE FROM @saleareastable) AND
			C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
			SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND
			SL.DATE >= @StartDate AND SL.DATE <= @EndDate
		GROUP BY
			SL.SaleInvCode,
			SD.ICODE,
			SL.CustCode,
			C.SUBAREACODE,
			SL.DiscPerc
		UNION ALL
		SELECT INVNO=SL.SRINVCODE,
			SD.ICODE,
			CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
			QTY = - ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + CASE WHEN @MergeBonus = 1 THEN SD.bonusqty ELSE 0 END), 0),
			Bonus = - ISNULL(Sum(CASE WHEN @MergeBonus = 0 THEN SD.bonusqty ELSE 0 END), 0),
			NETAMT= - Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty * SD.SRPrice) *
					(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)), 0), 2),
			C.SUBAREACODE
		FROM
			SRLEDGER SL,
			SRDETAIL SD,
			CUSTOMER C
		WHERE
			C.SubAreaCode in (SELECT CODE FROM @saleareastable) AND
			C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
			SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SRINVCODE = SD.SRINVCODE AND
			SL.DATE >= @StartDate AND SL.DATE <= @EndDate
		GROUP BY
			SL.SRInvCode,
			SD.ICODE,
			SL.CustCode,
			C.SUBAREACODE,
			SL.DiscPerc) S, ITEM I
	WHERE I.ICODE = S.ICODE AND I.ICODE IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)
	GROUP BY 
		S.SUBAREACODE,
		S.ICODE
	ORDER BY S.SUBAREACODE, S.ICODE

	OPEN C1
	FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @ICODE, @QTY, @Bonus, @VAL, @SUBAREACODE
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SET @i = 1
		WHILE @i <= @tot
		BEGIN
			SELECT @colcode = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@ICODE, 7)))
			SELECT @colname = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@SUBAREACODE, 7)))
			SET @str_col = LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@i, 7)))

			SELECT @UPD = 	'UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData SET ' + 
							'QTY' + @str_col + ' = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@QTY, 15,4))) + 
							', Value' + @str_col + ' = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@Bonus, 15,4))) + 
							', VAL' + @str_col + ' = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@VAL, 15, 5))) + 
							', C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colname +
							' WHERE CODE1 = ' + @colcode + ' AND ' + 
							' C_Code' + @str_col + ' = ' + @colname

			EXECUTE (@UPD)
			SET @err = @@ERROR
			IF @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @UPD = 'CROSSTAB PLOTING ERROR, DETAILS: ' + @UPD
				RAISERROR(@UPD, 16, 1, @UPD)
				CLOSE C1
				DEALLOCATE C1
				RETURN -1
			END 
			SET @i = @i + 1
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM C1 INTO @ICODE, @QTY, @Bonus, @VAL, @SUBAREACODE
	END
	CLOSE C1
	DEALLOCATE C1

	UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData 
	SET NAME1 = I.NAME,
		NAME2 = I.CustomICode,
		Name3 = I.PackingDesc,
		Name4 = NULL,   
		Code5=CASE @ReportGrouping 
			WHEN 'M' THEN I.MANFCODE
			WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
			WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
			ELSE I.PACKCODE END,
		Name5 = CASE @ReportGrouping 
			WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
			WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
			WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
			ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,
		Value14 = CASE @Pricetype WHEN 1 THEN ROUND(I.SALEPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			WHEN 2 THEN ROUND(I.SALEPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			WHEN 3 THEN ROUND(I.PURPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
			ELSE ROUND(I.AVGPRICE, 2) END
	FROM ITEM I, CrossTab_ReportData C
	WHERE I.ICODE = C.CODE1

	IF @mergebonus=0
		UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData 
		SET TOTQTY = T.TotQty, Value15 = T.TotBonus,
			TOTVAL = T.TotVAL
		FROM CrossTab_ReportData C, 
			(SELECT 
				CODE1,
				TOTQTY=SUM(ISNULL(QTY1,0) + ISNULL(QTY2,0) + ISNULL(QTY3,0) +
				ISNULL(QTY4,0) + ISNULL(QTY5,0) + ISNULL(QTY6,0) + ISNULL(QTY7,0) +
				ISNULL(QTY8,0) + ISNULL(QTY9,0) + ISNULL(QTY10,0) + ISNULL(QTY11,0) +
				ISNULL(QTY12,0) + ISNULL(QTY13,0)),
				TotBonus=
				SUM(ISNULL(Value1,0) + ISNULL(Value2,0) + ISNULL(Value3,0) + ISNULL(Value4,0) + 
				ISNULL(Value5,0) + ISNULL(Value6,0) + ISNULL(Value7,0) + ISNULL(Value8,0) + 
				ISNULL(Value9,0) + ISNULL(Value10,0) + ISNULL(Value11,0) + ISNULL(Value12,0) + 
				ISNULL(Value13,0)),
				TOTVAL = SUM(ISNULL(VAL1,0) + ISNULL(VAL2,0) + ISNULL(VAL3,0) + ISNULL(VAL4,0) +
				ISNULL(VAL5,0) + ISNULL(VAL6,0) + ISNULL(VAL7,0) + ISNULL(VAL8,0) +
				ISNULL(VAL9,0) + ISNULL(VAL10,0) + ISNULL(VAL11,0) + ISNULL(VAL12,0) +
				ISNULL(VAL13,0))
			FROM 
				CrossTab_ReportData 
			GROUP BY CODE1) T
		WHERE C.CODE1 = T.CODE1
	ELSE
		UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData 
		SET TOTQTY = T.TotQty, 
			TOTVAL = T.TotVAL
		FROM CrossTab_ReportData C, 
			(SELECT 
				CODE1,
				TOTQTY=SUM(ISNULL(QTY1,0) + ISNULL(QTY2,0) + ISNULL(QTY3,0) +
				ISNULL(QTY4,0) + ISNULL(QTY5,0) + ISNULL(QTY6,0) + ISNULL(QTY7,0) +
				ISNULL(QTY8,0) + ISNULL(QTY9,0) + ISNULL(QTY10,0) + ISNULL(QTY11,0) +
				ISNULL(QTY12,0) + ISNULL(QTY13,0) +
				ISNULL(Value1,0) + ISNULL(Value2,0) + ISNULL(Value3,0) + ISNULL(Value4,0) + 
				ISNULL(Value5,0) + ISNULL(Value6,0) + ISNULL(Value7,0) + ISNULL(Value8,0) + 
				ISNULL(Value9,0) + ISNULL(Value10,0) + ISNULL(Value11,0) + ISNULL(Value12,0) + 
				ISNULL(Value13,0)),
				TOTVAL = SUM(ISNULL(VAL1,0) + ISNULL(VAL2,0) + ISNULL(VAL3,0) + ISNULL(VAL4,0) +
				ISNULL(VAL5,0) + ISNULL(VAL6,0) + ISNULL(VAL7,0) + ISNULL(VAL8,0) +
				ISNULL(VAL9,0) + ISNULL(VAL10,0) + ISNULL(VAL11,0) + ISNULL(VAL12,0) +
				ISNULL(VAL13,0))
			FROM 
				CrossTab_ReportData 
			GROUP BY CODE1) T
		WHERE C.CODE1 = T.CODE1
END

RETURN 0

-- SP_Supervise_CashierActivity
CREATE    PROCEDURE SP_Supervise_CashierActivity 
@RowID INT, @ModuleID SMALLINT, @DocCode INT, @CatCode SMALLINT, @AccCode SMALLINT, @CashAccCode SMALLINT, 
@CashTendered NUMERIC(15,2), @CashCharged NUMERIC(15,2), @CashBack NUMERIC(15,2), @Remarks VARCHAR(100),
@CashierJobCode INT, @Printed CHAR(1)
AS

DECLARE @rowsaffected INTEGER, @Count INT
DECLARE @err INTEGER
DECLARE @Posted CHAR(1)

SET @Count = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CashierActivity WHERE RowID = @RowID AND SuperVised='N'), 0)
IF @Count <= 0 OR @Count IS NULL
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Unable to Supervise because the document is already supervised, Document #: %d' , 16 , 1, @DocCode)
	RETURN -1
END

IF @ModuleID = 10 OR @ModuleID=11 -- Sales (10=Cash, 11=Credit)
BEGIN
	UPDATE SaleLedger 
	SET 
		SaleCatCode = CASE @CatCode WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END,
		CustCode = @AccCode,
		CashAccCode = @CashAccCode,
		CashTendered = @CashTendered, 
		CashCharged = @CashCharged, 
		CashBack = @CashBack,
		Posted = 'Y',
		PostDate = GETDATE(),
		PostedBy = (SELECT JobOwner FROM CashierJob WHERE CashierJobCode = @CashierJobCode),
		OutStandingAmt = CASE WHEN OutStandingAmt - @CashCharged >= 0 THEN OutStandingAmt - @CashCharged ELSE 0.00 END
	WHERE SaleInvCode = @DocCode
	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Changes Made to Sale Inv #: %d' , 16 , 1, @DocCode)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @Posted = (SELECT Posted FROM SaleLedger WHERE SaleInvCode=@DocCode)

	IF @Posted = 'Y'
	BEGIN
		DELETE VirtualGl WHERE DocumentType = 'SV' AND DocumentCode=@DocCode 
	END
END

IF @ModuleID = 22 OR @ModuleID=23 -- Service Sales (22=Cash, 23=Credit)
BEGIN
	UPDATE ServiceHeader
	SET 
		ServiceCatCode = CASE @CatCode WHEN 1 THEN 10 ELSE 11 END,
		CustCode = @AccCode,
		CashAccCode = @CashAccCode,
		CashTendered = @CashTendered, 
		CashCharged = @CashCharged, 
		CashBack = @CashBack,
		Posted = 'Y',
		PostDate = GETDATE(),
		PostedBy = (SELECT JobOwner FROM CashierJob WHERE CashierJobCode = @CashierJobCode),
		OutStandingAmt = CASE WHEN OutStandingAmt - @CashCharged >= 0 THEN OutStandingAmt - @CashCharged ELSE 0.00 END
	WHERE ServiceInvCode = @DocCode
	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Changes Made to Service Inv #: %d' , 16 , 1, @DocCode)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @Posted = (SELECT Posted FROM ServiceHeader WHERE ServiceInvCode=@DocCode)

	IF @Posted = 'Y'
	BEGIN
		DELETE VirtualGl WHERE DocumentType = 'RS' AND DocumentCode=@DocCode 
	END
END

IF @ModuleID = 31 OR @ModuleID=32 -- Sales Returns (31=Cash, 32=Credit)
BEGIN
	UPDATE SRLedger 
	SET 
		SRCatCode = CASE @CatCode WHEN 1 THEN 8 ELSE 7 END,
		CustCode = @AccCode,
		CashAccCode = @CashAccCode,
		CashTendered = @CashTendered, 
		CashCharged = @CashCharged, 
		CashBack = @CashBack,
		Posted = 'Y',
		PostDate = GETDATE(),
		PostedBy = (SELECT JobOwner FROM CashierJob WHERE CashierJobCode = @CashierJobCode),
		OutStandingAmt = CASE WHEN OutStandingAmt - @CashCharged >= 0 THEN OutStandingAmt - @CashCharged ELSE 0.00 END
	WHERE SRInvCode = @DocCode
	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Changes Made to S/R Inv #: %d' , 16 , 1, @DocCode)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @Posted = (SELECT Posted FROM SRLedger WHERE SRInvCode=@DocCode)

	IF @Posted = 'Y'
	BEGIN
		DELETE VirtualGl WHERE DocumentType = 'SR' AND DocumentCode=@DocCode 
	END
END

IF @ModuleID = 102
BEGIN
	UPDATE SaleLedger
	SET OutStandingAmt = CASE WHEN OutStandingAmt - @CashCharged >= 0 THEN OutStandingAmt - @CashCharged ELSE 0.00 END
	WHERE SaleInvCode = @DocCode
END

IF @ModuleID = 104
BEGIN
	UPDATE PurLedger
	SET OutStandingAmt = CASE WHEN OutStandingAmt - @CashCharged >= 0 THEN OutStandingAmt - @CashCharged ELSE 0.00 END
	WHERE PurInvCode = @DocCode
END

IF @ModuleID IN (10,11,22,23,31,32) -- Sales/S. Returns
	UPDATE DBO.CashierActivity 
	SET 
	CatCode = @CatCode, AccCode = @AccCode, CashAccCode = @CashAccCode, Remarks = @Remarks,
	CashTendered = @CashTendered, CashCharged = @CashCharged, CashBack = @CashBack,
	CashierJobCode = @CashierJobCode, Printed=@Printed, Supervised='Y', SupervisedOn=GETDATE(),
	Category = CASE @CatCode WHEN 1 THEN 'Cash' ELSE 'Credit' END + ' ' + CASE WHEN @ModuleID IN (10,11) THEN 'Sale' WHEN @ModuleID IN (22,23) THEN 'Service' ELSE 'S/Return' END
	WHERE RowID = @RowID
ELSE
	UPDATE DBO.CashierActivity 
	SET Supervised='Y', SupervisedOn=GETDATE()
	WHERE RowID = @RowID

SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Unable to Update Cashier Activity' , 16 , 1)
	RETURN -1
END

RETURN 0

CREATE PROCEDURE sp_SuppliersBalance AS

create table #lt_pvamts 
(
	suppcode numeric (5, 0) NOT NULL,
	debit  numeric (15, 2) NOT NULL,
	credit numeric (15, 2) NOT NULL
)


DELETE  ReportData	

/********************************** packs  Purchase ***************************************/
insert #lt_pvamts
select   supplier.suppcode,
	 debit = 0.0,
	 credit= ISNULL(
		 ROUND(SUM(purdetail.packqty * purdetail.purprice * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + 
			purledger.misccharges + purledger.salestax - purledger.flatdisc, 0) +
		 ROUND(SUM((purdetail.packqty + purdetail.bonusqty) * purdetail.unitsalestax)+
			SUM(ROUND(purdetail.packqty * purdetail.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)) * purdetail.gstperc * .01, 2))+
			ROUND((SUM((purdetail.packqty * purdetail.purprice) * 
				(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) - purledger.flatdisc) * 
				(purledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0), 0)

from     purledger, purdetail, supplier

where    purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and
	 purledger.purcatcode in(1, 2 ) and 
	 purledger.Posted = 'Y'   and 
	 purledger.suppcode = supplier.suppcode

group by purledger.purinvcode, 
	 purledger.purcatcode, 
	 purledger.date,
	 purledger.discperc,
	 Purledger.misccharges,
	 purledger.salestax,
	 purledger.flatdisc,
	 purledger.invgstperc1,
	 supplier.suppcode


/********************************** Loose Purchaes ***************************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select   supplier.suppcode,
	 debit = 0.0,
	 credit= ISNULL(
		 ROUND(sum((purdetail.looseqty * purdetail.purprice) * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + 
			purledger.misccharges + purledger.salestax - purledger.flatdisc, 0) +
		 ROUND(SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty) * purdetail.unitsalestax) +
		 SUM(ROUND(purdetail.looseqty * purdetail.purprice * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)) * purdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
		 ROUND((SUM((purdetail.looseqty * purdetail.purprice) * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) -
			purledger.flatdisc) * (purledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0), 0)

from     purledger, purdetail, supplier  

where    purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and
	 purledger.purcatcode IN(7, 8) and 
	 purledger.Posted = 'Y'   and 
	 purledger.suppcode = supplier.suppcode

group by purledger.purinvcode, 
	 purledger.purcatcode, 
	 purledger.date,
	 purledger.discperc,
	 Purledger.misccharges,
	 purledger.salestax,
	 purledger.flatdisc,
	 purledger.invgstperc1,
	 supplier.suppcode

/*********************************** Purchase Returns ***************************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select   supplier.suppcode,
	 debit = ISNULL(
		 ROUND(SUM((prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice) * 
			(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * prledger.discperc)) + 
			prledger.misccharges + prledger.salestax - prledger.flatdisc, 0) +
		 ROUND(SUM((prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.bonusqty) * prdetail.unitsalestax) +
		 SUM(ROUND(prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice * 
			(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc)) * prdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
		 ROUND((SUM((prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice) * 
			(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * prledger.discperc)) -
			prledger.flatdisc) * (prledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0), 0),
	 credit = 0.0
from     prledger, prdetail, supplier  
where    prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode and
	 prledger.prcatcode IN(4, 5)      and 
	 prledger.Posted = 'Y'   and 
	 prledger.suppcode = supplier.suppcode
group by prledger.prinvcode,
	 prledger.prcatcode, 
	 prledger.date,
	 prledger.discperc,
	 prledger.misccharges,
	 prledger.salestax,
	 prledger.flatdisc,
	 prledger.invgstperc1,
	 supplier.suppcode

/*********************************** Any A/c Vouchers *************************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select   supplier.suppcode,

	 case sum(Round(gldetail.debit, 0))
	 when NULL then 0.0	 else sum(Round(gldetail.debit, 0))
	 end, 

	 case sum(Round(gldetail.credit,0))
	 when NULL then 0.0
	 else sum(Round(gldetail.credit,0))
	 end

from     glheader, gldetail , supplier 

Where	 glheader.posted = 'Y' and 
	 gldetail.acccode = supplier.suppcode and
	 glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode

group by supplier.suppcode

/********************************* Any Bills Payables ************************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select  supplier.suppcode,
	IsNull( sum(notes.amount), 0),
	0
from    notes , supplier
Where	notes.posted = 'Y' and
	notes.notecatcode = 2 and
	notes.acccode = supplier.suppcode

group by supplier.suppcode

/*********************************** Final Report *************************************/
/****************************** Final House Keeping ***********************************/

INSERT ReportData(code1, name1, value1)

select   accounts.acccode,
	 accounts.name,
         sum(#lt_pvamts.debit) - sum(#lt_pvamts.credit) 
	
from     #lt_pvamts, accounts

where    #lt_pvamts.suppcode = accounts.acccode

Group by accounts.acccode,
	 accounts.name

order by accounts.name
drop table #lt_pvamts

(
	debit  numeric (15, 2) NOT NULL,

/*********************************** Packs  Purchases **************************************/

		 ROUND(SUM(purdetail.packqty * purdetail.purprice * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + 
			purledger.misccharges + purledger.salestax - purledger.flatdisc, 0) +

 	 purledger.flatdisc

/*********************************** Loose Purchases **************************************/

insert #lt_pvamts

		 ROUND(sum((purdetail.looseqty * purdetail.purprice) * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + 
			purledger.misccharges + purledger.salestax - purledger.flatdisc, 0) +
		 ROUND(SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty) * purdetail.unitsalestax) +
		 SUM(ROUND(purdetail.looseqty * purdetail.purprice * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)) * purdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
		 ROUND((SUM((purdetail.looseqty * purdetail.purprice) * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) -
			purledger.flatdisc) * (purledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0), 0),
         code=purledger.suppcode,
       	 name=(select name from accounts where acccode=purledger.suppcode)

from     purledger, purdetail,supplier  

where    purledger.purcatcode in (8,7)    and 
	 purledger.date < @ad_sdate and
	 purledger.posted = 'Y' and 
	 purledger.suppcode = supplier.suppcode and
	 purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode 
group by purledger.purinvcode, 
	 purledger.purcatcode, 
	 purledger.suppcode,
	 purledger.date,
	 purledger.discperc,
	 Purledger.misccharges,
	 purledger.salestax,
	 purledger.invgstperc1,
	 purledger.flatdisc

/*********************************** Purchase Returns **************************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select	 debit = ISNULL(
		 ROUND(SUM((prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice) * 
			(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * prledger.discperc)) + 
			prledger.misccharges + prledger.salestax - prledger.flatdisc, 0) +
		 ROUND(SUM((prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.bonusqty) * prdetail.unitsalestax) +
		 SUM(ROUND(prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice * 
			(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc)) * prdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
		 ROUND((SUM((prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice) * 
			(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * prledger.discperc)) -
			prledger.flatdisc) * (prledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0), 0),
	 credit = 0.0,
         code=prledger.suppcode,
         name=(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=prledger.suppcode)

from     prledger, prdetail ,supplier 
where    prledger.prcatcode IN( 5 ,4)     and 
	 prledger.date < @ad_sdate   and
	 prledger.posted = 'Y' and 
	 prledger.suppcode = supplier.suppcode and
	 prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode
group by prledger.prinvcode,
	 prledger.prcatcode, 
	 prledger.suppcode,
	 prledger.date,
	 prledger.discperc,
	 prledger.misccharges,
	 prledger.salestax,
	 prledger.invgstperc1,
	 prledger.flatdisc

/*********************************** Any A/C Vouchers **************************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select   case sum(gldetail.debit)
	 when NULL then 0.0
	 else sum(gldetail.debit)
	 end, 
	 case sum(gldetail.credit)
	 when NULL then 0.0
	 else sum(gldetail.credit)
	 end,
   	 code=gldetail.acccode,
	 name=(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=gldetail.acccode)
from     glheader, gldetail ,supplier 
where    glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode and 
	 glheader.date < @ad_sdate  and
	 glheader.posted = 'Y' and 
	 gldetail.acccode = supplier.suppcode

GROUP BY gldetail.acccode
/******************************* Any Bills Payables **********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select   IsNull( sum(notes.amount), 0),
         0,
	 code=notes.acccode,
   	 name=(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=notes.acccode)
	 
from     notes,supplier
where    notes.notecatcode = 2 and
	 notes.posted = 'Y' and
	 notes.postdate < @ad_sdate and
	 notes.acccode = supplier.suppcode

GROUP BY notes.acccode

/******** Collecting the result and assigning to the relevent reference variable *********/

delete from reportdata

insert into reportdata(code1,name1,value1,value2,value3)
 ( select code,name,sum(debit) - sum(credit),0,0
   from   #lt_pvamts 
   GROUP BY code,name)		


insert into reportdata(code1,value1,value2,value3)
select supplier.suppcode,0,0,0

from  supplier

where 
	 supplier.suppcode Not IN (select code1 from reportdata) 


update 	reportdata
set 	name1=accounts.name
from 	accounts,reportdata
where	reportdata.name1=Null and
	reportdata.code1=accounts.acccode



delete from #lt_pvamts





/*-----------------------------For Transactions Within The Period----------------*/
/*===============================================================================*/



/*********************************** Packs  Purchases **************************************/
insert #lt_pvamts
select   debit = 0.0,
	 credit= ISNULL(
		 ROUND(SUM(purdetail.packqty * purdetail.purprice * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + 
			purledger.misccharges + purledger.salestax - purledger.flatdisc, 0) +
		 ROUND(SUM((purdetail.packqty + purdetail.bonusqty) * purdetail.unitsalestax)+
			SUM(ROUND(purdetail.packqty * purdetail.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)) * purdetail.gstperc * .01, 2))+
			ROUND((SUM((purdetail.packqty * purdetail.purprice) * 
				(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) - purledger.flatdisc) * 
				(purledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0), 0),
	 suppcode=purledger.suppcode,
	 name=(select name from accounts where acccode=purledger.suppcode)

from     purledger, purdetail,supplier  

where    
	 purledger.purcatcode in (2,1)    and 
	 purledger.date >= @ad_sdate and
         purledger.date <= @ad_edate and
	 purledger.posted = 'Y'  and
	 purledger.suppcode=supplier.suppcode and
	 purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode 
group by purledger.purinvcode, 
	 purledger.purcatcode, 
         purledger.suppcode,
	 purledger.date,
	 purledger.discperc,
	 Purledger.misccharges,
	 purledger.salestax,
	 purledger.invgstperc1,
	 purledger.flatdisc

/*********************************** Loose Purchases **************************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select   debit = 0.0,
	 credit= ISNULL(
		 ROUND(sum((purdetail.looseqty * purdetail.purprice) * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + 
			purledger.misccharges + purledger.salestax - purledger.flatdisc, 0) +
		 ROUND(SUM((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty) * purdetail.unitsalestax) +
		 SUM(ROUND(purdetail.looseqty * purdetail.purprice * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc)) * purdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
		 ROUND((SUM((purdetail.looseqty * purdetail.purprice) * 
			(1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) -
			purledger.flatdisc) * (purledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0), 0),
         code=purledger.suppcode,
       	 name=(select name from accounts where acccode=purledger.suppcode)

from     purledger, purdetail,supplier  

where    purledger.purcatcode in (8,7)    and 
	 purledger.date >= @ad_sdate and
	 purledger.date <= @ad_edate and
	 purledger.posted = 'Y' and 
	 purledger.suppcode = supplier.suppcode and
	 purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode 
group by purledger.purinvcode, 
	 purledger.purcatcode, 
	 purledger.suppcode,
	 purledger.date,
	 purledger.discperc,
	 Purledger.misccharges,
	 purledger.salestax,
	 purledger.invgstperc1,
	 purledger.flatdisc

/*********************************** Purchase Returns **************************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select	 debit = ISNULL(
		 ROUND(SUM((prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice) * 
			(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * prledger.discperc)) + 
			prledger.misccharges + prledger.salestax - prledger.flatdisc, 0) +
		 ROUND(SUM((prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.bonusqty) * prdetail.unitsalestax) +
		 SUM(ROUND(prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice * 
			(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc)) * prdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
		 ROUND((SUM((prdetail.looseqty * prdetail.prprice) * 
			(1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * prledger.discperc)) -
			prledger.flatdisc) * (prledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0), 0),
	 credit = 0.0,
         code=prledger.suppcode,
         name=(select name from accounts where acccode=prledger.suppcode)

from     prledger, prdetail ,supplier 
where    prledger.prcatcode IN( 5 ,4)     and
 	 prledger.date >= @ad_sdate   and 
	 prledger.date <= @ad_edate   and
	 prledger.posted = 'Y' and 
	 prledger.suppcode = supplier.suppcode and
	 prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode
group by prledger.prinvcode,
	 prledger.prcatcode, 
	 prledger.suppcode,
	 prledger.date,
	 prledger.discperc,
	 prledger.misccharges,
	 prledger.salestax,
	 prledger.invgstperc1,
	 prledger.flatdisc

/*********************************** Any A/C Vouchers **************************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select   case sum(gldetail.debit)
	 when NULL then 0.0
	 else sum(gldetail.debit)
	 end, 
	 case sum(gldetail.credit)
	 when NULL then 0.0
	 else sum(gldetail.credit)
	 end,
   	 code=gldetail.acccode,
	 name=(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=gldetail.acccode)
from     glheader, gldetail ,supplier 
where    glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode and 
	 glheader.date >= @ad_sdate  and
	 glheader.date <= @ad_edate  and
	 glheader.posted = 'Y' and 
	 gldetail.acccode = supplier.suppcode

GROUP BY gldetail.acccode
/******************************* Any Bills Payables **********************************/

insert #lt_pvamts
select   IsNull( sum(notes.amount), 0),
         0,
	 code=notes.acccode,
   	 name=(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=notes.acccode)
	 
from     notes,supplier
where    notes.notecatcode = 2 and
	 notes.posted = 'Y' and
	 notes.postdate >= @ad_sdate and
	 notes.postdate <= @ad_edate and
	 notes.acccode = supplier.suppcode
GROUP BY notes.acccode

/******** Collecting the result and assigning to the relevent reference variable *********/

/*insert into reportdata(code1,name1,value1,value2,value3)
 ( select code,name,sum(debit) , sum(credit)
   from   #lt_pvamts 
   GROUP BY code,name)		*/


update reportdata

set value2=A.ddebit,value3=A.dcredit

from

(select code,name,ddebit=IsNull(sum(debit) ,0),dcredit=IsNull(sum(credit),0)
	from   #lt_pvamts 
	group by code,
                 name) as A


where reportdata.code1=A.code

drop table #lt_pvamts
