definition:
-- SP_SyncBasicData_On_Remote
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_SyncBasicData_On_Remote @SRV VARCHAR(50), @DB VARCHAR(50), @OWNER VARCHAR(20)
AS
SET XACT_ABORT ON
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

/*Variables to be used in delete, update and insert processes*/
DECLARE @LastDateTime DATETIME, @LastSynced DATETIME
DECLARE @TableName NVARCHAR(50), @full_table_name NVARCHAR(255), @CON NVARCHAR(50), @RemoteRef NVARCHAR(1000)
DECLARE @ColName VARCHAR(255), @WHR VARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @FROM NVARCHAR(1000), @PKCOND NVARCHAR(1000), @NOTIN NVARCHAR(50), @IN NVARCHAR(50), @ENDD NVARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @MAXCOL NVARCHAR(255), @TABMAXSQL NVARCHAR(3000), @SQL NVARCHAR(4000), @LIST NVARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @AutoInsert CHAR(1), @AutoUpdate Char(1), @AutoDelete Char(1), @UPDMaxKey Char(1)
DECLARE @table_id INT, @err INT, @SourceCount INT, @TargetCount INT
DECLARE @Priority SMALLINT, @KeySeq SMALLINT, @Position SMALLINT
/*Variables to be used in delete process*/
DECLARE @DEL NVARCHAR(1000), @DEL_QRY NVARCHAR(4000)
/*Variables to be used in Insert process*/
DECLARE @INS NVARCHAR(1000), @INS_QRY NVARCHAR(4000)

/*Variables to be used in Update process*/
DECLARE @UPD NVARCHAR(1000), @SETPART NVARCHAR(4000), @UPD_PKCOND NVARCHAR(1000), @UPD_QRY NVARCHAR(4000), @Qry NVARCHAR(4000)

/*'FROM' clause of SQL used in INSERT/DELETE*/
IF LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) = ''
	SET @FROM = N' FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.'
ELSE
	SET @FROM = N' FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.'

IF LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) = ''
	SET @RemoteRef = N'' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.'
ELSE
	SET @RemoteRef = N'' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.'

SET @NOTIN = N' NOT IN (SELECT '
SET @CON = N'CONVERT(VarChar(10),'
SET @SQL = N'SELECT '
SET @IN = N' IN (SELECT '
SET @WHR = N'WHERE '
SET @ENDD = N' AS T WHERE '
SET @LastDateTime = ISNULL((SELECT ServerDataTime FROM DataTransferDate), '1900-01-01 00:00:00')
SET @LastSynced = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(LogDate) - 1 FROM DataImportLog WHERE ImportType='Data Sync.'), '1900-01-01 00:00:00')
/*BasicData Deletion Variables (initializing variables)*/
SET @DEL = N'DELETE '

/*BasicData Updation Variables (initializing variables)*/
SET @UPD = N'UPDATE '
SET @SETPART = N'SET '

/*BasicData Updation Variables (initializing variables)*/
SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO '

DECLARE TmpCrs1 CURSOR FOR
SELECT TABLENAME=LTRIM(RTRIM(TABLENAME)), PRIORITY, AUTOINSERT, AUTOUPDATE, AUTODELETE, UPDATETABMAXKEY
FROM TransferableData 
WHERE Enable='Y'
ORDER BY Priority

OPEN TmpCrs1

FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs1 INTO @TableName, @Priority, @AutoInsert, @AutoUpdate, @AutoDelete, @UPDMaxKey
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @full_table_name = LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.' + @TableName
	SET @table_id = OBJECT_ID(@full_table_name)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0 OR @table_id IS NULL
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Data Updation: Invalid Object Refered: Name = %s', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
		CLOSE TmpCrs1
		DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
		RETURN -1
	END

	DELETE REPORTDATA

	SET @Qry = N'INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (Code1) SELECT Count(*) FROM ' + @TableName
	EXECUTE (@Qry)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Error Fetching Source Count for %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
		CLOSE TmpCrs1
		DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
		RETURN -1
	END 
	SET @SourceCount = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Code1) FROM ReportData), 0)

	DELETE REPORTDATA

	SET @Qry = N'INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (Code1) SELECT Count(*) FROM ' + @RemoteRef + @TableName
	EXECUTE (@Qry)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Error Fetching Target Count for %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
		CLOSE TmpCrs1
		DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
		RETURN -1
	END 

	SET @TargetCount = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Code1) FROM ReportData), 0)

	--PRINT @TableName + ', SOURCE = ' + STR(@SourceCount,10) + ', Target = ' + STR(@TargetCount,10)

	IF @SourceCount <> @TargetCount OR @TableName = 'Item'
	BEGIN

		SELECT @PKCOND = '', @MAXCOL = '', @UPD_PKCOND = ''
	
		DECLARE TmpCrs2 CURSOR FOR
		SELECT 	COLNAME = CONVERT(sysname,c.name),
			KEYSEQ =
				CASE
					when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  1) then convert (smallint,1)
					when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  2) then convert (smallint,2)
					when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  3) then convert (smallint,3)
					when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  4) then convert (smallint,4)
					when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  5) then convert (smallint,5)
					when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  6) then convert (smallint,6)
					when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  7) then convert (smallint,7)
					when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  8) then convert (smallint,8)
					when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  9) then convert (smallint,9)
					when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 10) then convert (smallint,10)
					when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 11) then convert (smallint,11)
					when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 12) then convert (smallint,12)
					when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 13) then convert (smallint,13)
					when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 14) then convert (smallint,14)
					when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 15) then convert (smallint,15)
					when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 16) then convert (smallint,16)
				end
		from
			sysindexes i, syscolumns c, sysobjects o
		where
			o.id = @table_id
			and o.id = c.id
			and o.id = i.id
			and (i.status & 0x800) = 0x800
			and (c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  1) or
			     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  2) or
			     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  3) or
			     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  4) or
			     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  5) or
			     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  6) or
			     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  7) or
			     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  8) or
			     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  9) or
			     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 10) or
			     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 11) or
			     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 12) or
			     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 13) or
			     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 14) or
			     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 15) or
			     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 16)
			    )
		order by 2
	
		OPEN TmpCrs2
		
		FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs2 INTO @ColName, @KeySeq
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			IF @KeySeq <> 1
			BEGIN
				SET @PKCOND = @PKCOND  + ' + '
				SET @UPD_PKCOND = @UPD_PKCOND + ' AND '
			END
	
			SET @PKCOND = @PKCOND + ' ' + @CON + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + ')'
			SET @UPD_PKCOND = @UPD_PKCOND + ' T.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + '=' + @TableName + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName))
	
			SET @MAXCOL = 'MAX(' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@ColName)) + ')'	
			FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs2 INTO @ColName, @KeySeq
		END
		CLOSE TmpCrs2
		DEALLOCATE TmpCrs2	
	
		IF @AutoDelete='Y'
		BEGIN
			
			SET @DEL_QRY = @DEL + 'FROM OPENQUERY(' + @srv + ',''SELECT ' + @PKCOND + ' FROM ' +@TableName + ''')'
--			PRINT @DEL_QRY
			EXECUTE (@DEL_QRY)
			SET @err = @@ERROR
			IF @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Data Deletion: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
				CLOSE TmpCrs1
				DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
				RETURN -1
			END 
		END
	
		IF @AutoUpdate='Y'
		BEGIN
			SET @SETPART = N'SET '
		
			DECLARE TmpCrs3 CURSOR FOR
			SELECT
				COLUMNNAME = convert(sysname,c.name),
				POSITION = convert(int,
						   (
							select count(*)
							from syscolumns sc
							where sc.id     =  c.id
							  AND sc.number =  c.number
							  AND sc.colid  <= c.colid
						    ))
			FROM
				sysobjects o,
				syscolumns c
			WHERE
				o.id = @table_id AND c.id = o.id
			ORDER BY 2
		
			OPEN TmpCrs3
		
			FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs3 INTO @ColName, @Position
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN
				IF ColumnProperty (@table_id, @ColName, 'IsIdentity') <> 1
				BEGIN
					IF @ColName = (SELECT columnname FROM TransferableData_RestrictedColumns WHERE columnname = @ColName and tablename = @TableName)
					BEGIN
						SET @ColName = @ColName
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						IF @SETPART <> 'SET '
						BEGIN
							SET @SETPART = @SETPART + ','
						END
				
						SET @SETPART = @SETPART + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + '=' + 'T.' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName))
					END
				END
				
				FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs3 INTO @ColName, @Position
			END
			CLOSE TmpCrs3
			DEALLOCATE TmpCrs3
		
			IF @SETPART <> 'SET '
			BEGIN
				IF @TableName = 'Item'
					SET @UPD_QRY = @UPD + @RemoteRef + @TableName + ' ' + @SETPART + ' FROM ' + @TableName + ' AS T, ' + @RemoteRef + @TableName + ' AS ' + @TableName + ' WHERE ' + @UPD_PKCOND + ' AND T.LastUpdate >= ' + '''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @LastSynced, 121) + ''''
				ELSE
					SET @UPD_QRY = @UPD + @RemoteRef + @TableName + ' ' + @SETPART + ' FROM ' + @TableName + ' AS T, ' + @RemoteRef + @TableName + ' AS ' + @TableName + ' WHERE ' + @UPD_PKCOND
				
--				PRINT @UPD_QRY
				EXECUTE (@UPD_QRY)
				SET @err = @@ERROR
				IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
				BEGIN
					RAISERROR('Data Updation: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
					CLOSE TmpCrs1
					DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
					RETURN -1
				END 
			END
		END 
	
		IF @AutoInsert='Y' AND @TableName <> 'Rights' 
		BEGIN
			SET @SQL = N' SELECT '
			SET @LIST=''
			EXECUTE @err = SP_COLUMNLIST @OWNER, @TableName, @LIST OUTPUT
			SET @err = @@ERROR
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				CLOSE TmpCrs1
				DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
				RETURN -1
			END
			IF @TableName = 'GroupRights'
				SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @RemoteRef + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + ' FROM ' + @TableName + @ENDD + @PKCOND + @NOTIN + @PKCOND + ' FROM ' + @RemoteRef + @TableName + ')  AND RightCode IN (SELECT RightCode FROM ' + @RemoteRef + ' Rights)'
			ELSE
				SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @RemoteRef + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + ' FROM ' + @TableName + @ENDD + @PKCOND + @NOTIN + @PKCOND + ' FROM ' + @RemoteRef + @TableName + ')'
	
--			PRINT @INS_QRY
			EXECUTE (@INS_QRY)
			SET @err = @@ERROR
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
				CLOSE TmpCrs1
				DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
				RETURN -1
			END 
		END
/*	
		IF @UPDMaxKey = 'Y' 
		BEGIN
			SET @TABMAXSQL = ''
			SET @TABMAXSQL = 'UPDATE ' + @RemoteRef + '_tabmaxkey SET TABMAXKEY = ' + ' ISNULL((SELECT ' + @MAXCOL + ' FROM  ' + @RemoteRef + @TableName + '), 0) ' + 'WHERE TABNAME = ''' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@TableName)) + ''''
			EXECUTE (@TABMAXSQL)
			SET @err = @@ERROR
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Error While Updating the TABMAXKEY of %s ', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
				CLOSE TmpCrs1
				DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
				RETURN -1
			END 
		END
*/
	END
	FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs1 INTO @TableName, @Priority, @AutoInsert, @AutoUpdate, @AutoDelete, @UPDMaxKey
END
CLOSE TmpCrs1
DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1

DELETE DataTransferDate

IF LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) = ''
	SET @INS_QRY = 'INSERT INTO DataTransferDate (ServerDataTime) SELECT ServerDataTime = ISNULL((SELECT GETDATE() - 0.042 FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '._UTN)' + ', GETDATE())'
ELSE
	SET @INS_QRY = 'INSERT INTO DataTransferDate (ServerDataTime) SELECT ServerDataTime = ISNULL((SELECT GETDATE() - 0.042 FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '._UTN)' + ', GETDATE())'

--PRINT @INS_QRY
EXECUTE (@INS_QRY)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Data Transfer: Error While recoridng data transfer date', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

INSERT INTO DataImportLog (LogDate, ImportedBy, ImportType, Remarks)
VALUES (GetDate(), 1, 'Data Sync.', @SRV + ' DB:' + @DB)

RETURN 0

name: SP_SyncImportedData
definition:
-- SP_SyncImportedData
CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_SyncImportedData 
AS

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

/*Variables to be used in delete, update and insert processes*/
DECLARE @TableName NVARCHAR(100), @full_table_name NVARCHAR(255), @CON NVARCHAR(50), @Imp_TableName NVARCHAR(255)
DECLARE @ColName VARCHAR(255), @WHR VARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @FROM NVARCHAR(1000), @PKCOND NVARCHAR(1000), @NOTIN NVARCHAR(50), @ENDD NVARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @MAXCOL NVARCHAR(255), @TABMAXSQL NVARCHAR(3000), @SQL NVARCHAR(4000), @LIST NVARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @AutoInsert CHAR(1), @AutoUpdate Char(1), @AutoDelete Char(1), @UPDMaxKey Char(1)
DECLARE @table_id INT, @err INT, @rt_code INT
DECLARE @Priority SMALLINT, @KeySeq SMALLINT, @Position SMALLINT, @SyncStock CHAR(1)
/*Variables to be used in delete process*/
DECLARE @DEL NVARCHAR(1000), @DEL_QRY NVARCHAR(4000)
/*Variables to be used in Insert process*/
DECLARE @INS NVARCHAR(1000), @INS_QRY NVARCHAR(4000)

/*Variables to be used in Update process*/
DECLARE @UPD NVARCHAR(1000), @SETPART NVARCHAR(4000), @UPD_PKCOND NVARCHAR(1000), @UPD_QRY NVARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @dt DATETIME

SET @SyncStock = ISNULL((SELECT dbo.Fn_GetPreference('syncstockfromparentserver')), 'N')
IF LTRIM(RTRIM(@SyncStock)) = '' OR @SyncStock IS NULL
	SET @SyncStock = 'N'

/*'FROM' clause of SQL used in INSERT/DELETE*/
SET @FROM = N' FROM '
SET @NOTIN = N' NOT IN (SELECT '
SET @CON = N'CONVERT(VarChar(100),'
SET @SQL = N'SELECT '
SET @WHR = N'WHERE '
SET @ENDD = N' AS T WHERE '

/*BasicData Deletion Variables (initializing variables)*/
SET @DEL = N'DELETE '

/*BasicData Updation Variables (initializing variables)*/
SET @UPD = N'UPDATE '
SET @SETPART = N'SET '

/*BasicData Updation Variables (initializing variables)*/
SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO '

DECLARE TmpCrs1 CURSOR FOR
SELECT TABLENAME=LTRIM(RTRIM(TABLENAME)), PRIORITY, AUTOINSERT, AUTOUPDATE, AUTODELETE, UPDATETABMAXKEY
FROM TransferableData
WHERE Enable='Y' 
ORDER BY Priority

OPEN TmpCrs1

FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs1 INTO @TableName, @Priority, @AutoInsert, @AutoUpdate, @AutoDelete, @UPDMaxKey
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @Imp_TableName = 'DBO.Import_' + @TableName
	SET @full_table_name = 'DBO.' + @TableName
	SET @table_id = OBJECT_ID(@full_table_name)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0 OR @table_id IS NULL
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Data Updation: Invalid Object Refered: Name = %s', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
		CLOSE TmpCrs1
		DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
		RETURN -1
	END 

	SELECT @PKCOND = '', @MAXCOL = '', @UPD_PKCOND = ''

	DECLARE TmpCrs2 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT 	COLNAME = CONVERT(sysname,c.name),
		KEYSEQ =
			CASE
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  1) then convert (smallint,1)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  2) then convert (smallint,2)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  3) then convert (smallint,3)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  4) then convert (smallint,4)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  5) then convert (smallint,5)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  6) then convert (smallint,6)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  7) then convert (smallint,7)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  8) then convert (smallint,8)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  9) then convert (smallint,9)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 10) then convert (smallint,10)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 11) then convert (smallint,11)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 12) then convert (smallint,12)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 13) then convert (smallint,13)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 14) then convert (smallint,14)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 15) then convert (smallint,15)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 16) then convert (smallint,16)
			end
	from
		sysindexes i, syscolumns c, sysobjects o
	where
		o.id = @table_id
		and o.id = c.id
		and o.id = i.id
		and (i.status & 0x800) = 0x800
		and (c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  1) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  2) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  3) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  4) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  5) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  6) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  7) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  8) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  9) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 10) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 11) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 12) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 13) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 14) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 15) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 16)
		    )
	order by 2

	OPEN TmpCrs2
	
	FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs2 INTO @ColName, @KeySeq
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		IF @KeySeq <> 1
		BEGIN
			SET @PKCOND = @PKCOND  + ' + '
			SET @UPD_PKCOND = @UPD_PKCOND + ' AND '
		END

		SET @PKCOND = @PKCOND + ' ' + @CON + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + ')'
		SET @UPD_PKCOND = @UPD_PKCOND + ' T.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + ' = ' + @TableName + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName))

		SET @MAXCOL = 'MAX(' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@ColName)) + ')'	
		FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs2 INTO @ColName, @KeySeq
	END
	CLOSE TmpCrs2
	DEALLOCATE TmpCrs2	

	IF @AutoDelete='Y' AND @TableName <> 'Rights' 
	BEGIN
		SET @DEL_QRY = @DEL + @TableName + ' ' + @WHR + @PKCOND + @NOTIN + @PKCOND + @FROM + @Imp_TableName + ')'
		EXECUTE (@DEL_QRY)
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Data Deletion: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
			CLOSE TmpCrs1
			DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	IF @AutoUpdate='Y'
	BEGIN
		SET @SETPART = N'SET '
	
		DECLARE TmpCrs3 CURSOR FOR
		SELECT
			COLUMNNAME = convert(sysname,c.name),
			POSITION = convert(int,
					   (
						select count(*)
						from syscolumns sc
						where sc.id     =  c.id
						  AND sc.number =  c.number
						  AND sc.colid  <= c.colid
					    ))
		FROM
			sysobjects o,
			syscolumns c
		WHERE
			o.id = @table_id AND c.id = o.id
		ORDER BY 2
	
		OPEN TmpCrs3
	
		FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs3 INTO @ColName, @Position
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			IF ColumnProperty (@table_id, @ColName, 'IsIdentity') <> 1
			BEGIN
				IF @ColName = (SELECT columnname FROM TransferableData_RestrictedColumns WHERE columnname = @ColName and tablename = @TableName)
				BEGIN
					SET @ColName = @ColName
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF @SETPART <> 'SET '
					BEGIN
						SET @SETPART = @SETPART + ','
					END
			
					SET @SETPART = @SETPART + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + '=' + 'T.' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName))
				END
			END
			
			FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs3 INTO @ColName, @Position
		END
		CLOSE TmpCrs3
		DEALLOCATE TmpCrs3
	
		IF @SETPART <> 'SET '
		BEGIN
			SET @UPD_QRY = @UPD + @TableName + ' ' + @SETPART + ' ' + @FROM + @Imp_TableName + @ENDD + ' ' + @UPD_PKCOND

			EXECUTE (@UPD_QRY)
			SET @err = @@ERROR
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Data Updation: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
				CLOSE TmpCrs1
				DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
				RETURN -1
			END 
		END
	END 

	IF @AutoInsert='Y' AND @TableName <> 'Rights' 
	BEGIN
		SET @SQL = N' SELECT '
		SET @LIST=''
		EXECUTE @err = SP_COLUMNLIST 'DBO', @TableName, @LIST OUTPUT
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			CLOSE TmpCrs1
			DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
			RETURN -1
		END
	
		IF @TableName = 'GroupRights'
			SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @FROM + @Imp_TableName + @ENDD + @PKCOND + @NOTIN + @PKCOND + ' FROM ' + @TableName + ')  AND RightCode IN (SELECT RightCode FROM Rights)'
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @TableName = 'Item'
			BEGIN
				SET @List = REPLACE(@List,'UserCode,','')
				SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @FROM + @Imp_TableName + @ENDD + @PKCOND + @NOTIN + @PKCOND + ' FROM ' + @TableName + ')'
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @FROM + @Imp_TableName + @ENDD + @PKCOND + @NOTIN + @PKCOND + ' FROM ' + @TableName + ')'
			END
		END

		EXECUTE (@INS_QRY)
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
			CLOSE TmpCrs1
			DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	IF @UPDMaxKey = 'Y' 
	BEGIN
		SET @TABMAXSQL = ''
		SET @TABMAXSQL = 'UPDATE _tabmaxkey SET TABMAXKEY = ' + ' ISNULL((SELECT ' + @MAXCOL + ' FROM  ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@TableName)) + '), 0) ' + 'WHERE TABNAME = ''' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@TableName)) + ''''
		EXECUTE (@TABMAXSQL)
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Error While Updating the TABMAXKEY of %s ', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
			CLOSE TmpCrs1
			DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs1 INTO @TableName, @Priority, @AutoInsert, @AutoUpdate, @AutoDelete, @UPDMaxKey
END
CLOSE TmpCrs1
DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1

IF @SyncStock = 'Y'
BEGIN

VALUES (GetDate(), 1, 'Data Synchronization', 'Data Synchronization')

RETURN 0

INTO @RowID, @TableName, @Synchronize, @ParentTable, @ParentPK, @UpdateParent, @Posted
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @QRY = N''
	DELETE REPORTDATA
	IF @ParentTable IS NULL
		IF @Posted = 'Y'
			SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (Code1) SELECT ISNULL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM ' + @TableName + ' WHERE Posted = ''Y'' AND Synced = ''N''' 
		ELSE
			SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (Code1) SELECT ISNULL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM ' + @TableName + ' WHERE Synced = ''N''' 
	ELSE
		IF @Posted = 'Y'
			SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (Code1) SELECT ISNULL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM ' + @TableName + ' WHERE ' + @ParentPK + ' IN (SELECT ' + @ParentPK + ' FROM ' + @ParentTable + ' WHERE Posted = ''Y'' AND Synced = ''N'')' 
		ELSE
			SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO REPORTDATA (Code1) SELECT ISNULL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM ' + @TableName + ' WHERE ' + @ParentPK + ' IN (SELECT ' + @ParentPK + ' FROM ' + @ParentTable + ' WHERE Synced = ''N'')' 
--	PRINT @QRY
	EXECUTE (@QRY)
	SET @SyncableRows = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Code1) FROM REPORTDATA), 0)

	IF @Synchronize='Y' AND @SyncableRows > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @QRY = N''
		SET @SQL = N' SELECT '
		SET @LIST=''
		EXECUTE @err = SP_COLUMNLIST @OWNER, @TableName, @LIST OUTPUT
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			CLOSE C1
			DEALLOCATE C1
			RETURN -1
		END
	
		IF @ParentTable IS NULL
		BEGIN
			IF @Posted='Y'
				IF LEFT(@TableName,10) = 'SaleLedger'
				BEGIN
					SET @List2 = @List
					SET @List2 = REPLACE(@List2, 'SRBufferInvCode', 'NULL') 
					SET @List2 = REPLACE(@List2, 'SaleOrderCode', 'NULL')
					SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO ' + @RemoteRef + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List2 + @Frm + @TableName + ' WHERE Posted = ''Y'' AND Synced = ''N''' 
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO ' + @RemoteRef + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @Frm + @TableName + ' WHERE Posted = ''Y'' AND Synced = ''N''' 
				END
			ELSE
				SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO ' + @RemoteRef + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @Frm + @TableName + ' WHERE Synced = ''N''' 
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @Posted='Y'
				SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO ' + @RemoteRef + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @Frm + @TableName + ' WHERE ' + @ParentPK + ' IN (SELECT ' + @ParentPK + ' FROM ' + @ParentTable + ' WHERE Posted = ''Y'' AND Synced = ''N'')' 
			ELSE
				SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO ' + @RemoteRef + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @Frm + @TableName + ' WHERE ' + @ParentPK + ' IN (SELECT ' + @ParentPK + ' FROM ' + @ParentTable + ' WHERE Synced = ''N'')' 
		END
		
		IF LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Qry))) > 0
		BEGIN
			print @Qry
			EXECUTE (@Qry)
			SET @err = @@ERROR
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @TableName)
				CLOSE C1
				DEALLOCATE C1
				RETURN -1
			END
			IF @UpdateParent = 'Y'
			BEGIN
				IF @Posted='Y'
					SET @Qry = 'UPDATE ' + @ParentTable + ' SET Synced = ''Y'', SyncedOn=GETDATE(), SyncedBy=1 WHERE Posted = ''Y'' AND Synced = ''N'''
				ELSE
					SET @Qry = 'UPDATE ' + @ParentTable + ' SET Synced = ''Y'', SyncedOn=GETDATE(), SyncedBy=1 WHERE Synced = ''N'''

				print @Qry
				EXECUTE (@Qry)
				SET @err = @@ERROR
				IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
				BEGIN
					RAISERROR('Data Updation: Error Updating Sync. Status for %s Data', 16, 1, @ParentTable)
					CLOSE C1
					DEALLOCATE C1
					RETURN -1
				END
			END
		END
	END
	FETCH NEXT FROM C1
	INTO @RowID, @TableName, @Synchronize, @ParentTable, @ParentPK, @UpdateParent, @Posted
END
CLOSE C1
DEALLOCATE C1

SET @QRY = N'DELETE ' + @RemoteRef + 'GodownDetail'
EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Data Truncation Error: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, 'GodownDetail')
	RETURN -1
END 

SET @QRY = N'INSERT INTO ' + @RemoteRef + 'GodownDetail SELECT * FROM GodownDetail'
EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, 'GodownDetail')
	RETURN -1
END 

INSERT INTO DataImportLog (LogDate, ImportedBy, ImportType, Remarks)
VALUES (GetDate(), 1, 'Trans. Synced', 'Data Synced')

RETURN 0

CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_TemplateMarking @Template INT, @Group CHAR(1), @GroupList VARCHAR(8000), @Marked CHAR(1)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
UPDATE SaleTemplateDetail
SET SaleTemplateDetail.Marked = @Marked
FROM
	SaleTemplateDetail,
	(SELECT ICode=Code FROM DBO.udf_selectitems(@Group, @GroupList)) T

	RETURN -1
END
RETURN 0

definition:
-- sp_Test2

/****** Object:  Stored Procedure dbo.sp_Test2    Script Date: 4/23/02 4:29:59 PM ******/
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_Test2 @ad_Date DateTime AS

declare @ln_cashacc numeric(5, 0)
declare @ln_equityacc numeric(5, 0)
declare @ln_freightacc numeric(5, 0)
declare @ln_octroiacc numeric(5, 0)
declare @ln_salestaxacc numeric(5, 0)
declare @ln_inventoryacc numeric(5, 0)
declare @ln_favourableacc numeric(5, 0)
declare @ln_unfavourableacc numeric(5, 0)
declare @ln_avgpurcostacc numeric(5, 0)
declare @ln_salesacc numeric(5, 0)
declare @ln_salesfixdiscacc numeric(5, 0)
declare @ln_miscchargesacc numeric(5, 0)
declare @ln_salesretacc numeric(5, 0)
declare @ln_purchaseacc numeric(5, 0)

select @ln_cashacc      = (Select code from global where name = 'GT_CashACC')
select @ln_equityacc	= (Select code from global where name = 'GT_EquityACC')
select @ln_freightacc	= (Select code from global where name = 'GT_FreightACC')
select @ln_octroiacc	= (Select code from global where name = 'GT_OctroiACC')
select @ln_salestaxacc	= (Select code from global where name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')
select @ln_inventoryacc	= (Select code from global where name = 'GT_InventoryACC')
select @ln_favourableacc= (Select code from global where name = 'GT_FavourableACC')
select @ln_unfavourableacc = (Select code from global where name = 'GT_UnFavourableACC')
/*select @ln_avgpurcostacc = (Select code from global where name = 'GT_AvgPurCostACC'*/
select @ln_salesacc        = (Select code from global where name = 'GT_SalesACC')
select @ln_salesfixdiscacc = (Select code from global where name = 'GT_SalesFixDiscountACC')
select @ln_miscchargesacc  = (Select code from global where name = 'GT_MiscChargesACC')
select @ln_salesretacc     = (Select code from global where name = 'GT_SalesReturnACC')
select @ln_purchaseacc     = (Select code from global where name = 'GT_PurchaseACC')

create table #lt_Accounts
(
	acccode      numeric (5,  0) NOT NULL,
	currbalance  numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL 
)

Insert #lt_Accounts
Select acccode, 0
from   accounts

/**********************************************************************/
/************************** Purchase  *********************************/
/**********************************************************************/

create table #lt_PurchaseSummary
(
	acccode      numeric (5,  0) NOT NULL,
	inventoryAmt numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,    /*Cost of items and disc on total item cost*/
	NetAmt       numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,    /*Net Cost including flat discounts, misc charges*/
	flatdisc     numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,
	misccharges  numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,
	salestax     numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL
)

insert  #lt_PurchaseSummary
select  Case purledger.PurCatCode
		when 1 THEN @ln_cashacc     /* Cash Purchase */
		when 3 THEN @ln_equityacc   /* Opening Purchase  */
		else   purledger.suppcode     /* Credit Purhase    */
	end,

	IsNull( sum(( (purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty * purdetail.packunits) * purdetail.purprice) * (1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)), 0) ,
	IsNull( Round(sum(( (purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty * purdetail.packunits) * purdetail.purprice) * (1 - (.01 * purdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + purledger.misccharges + purledger.salestax - purledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
	purledger.flatdisc,
	purledger.misccharges,
	purledger.salestax 

from     purledger,	 
	 purdetail 

where    purledger.date <= @ad_Date and
	 purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode 

group by purledger.purinvcode,
	 purledger.suppcode, 
	 purledger.purcatcode,
	 purledger.date,
	 purledger.discperc,
	 purledger.misccharges,
	 purledger.salestax,
	 purledger.flatdisc		

/**********************Debit Inventory***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance + (Select IsNull(sum(inventoryamt), 0) from #lt_PurchaseSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_inventoryacc

/**********************credit flatdiscount ***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance - (Select IsNull(sum(flatdisc), 0) from #lt_PurchaseSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_freightacc

/**********************Debit misc charges ***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance + (Select IsNull(sum(misccharges), 0) from #lt_PurchaseSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_octroiacc

/**********************Debit salestax***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance + (Select IsNull(sum(salestax), 0) from #lt_PurchaseSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_salestaxacc

/******************Credit supplier/cash/equity account********************/

Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance - (Select IsNull(sum(#lt_PurchaseSummary.NetAmt), 0) from #lt_PurchaseSummary where #lt_PurchaseSummary.acccode = #lt_accounts.acccode) 
from   #lt_accounts, #lt_PurchaseSummary
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = #lt_PurchaseSummary.acccode 

Drop table #lt_PurchaseSummary

/**********************************************************************/
/*********************** Purchase Return *****************************/
/**********************************************************************/

create table #lt_PurRetSummary
(
	acccode      numeric (5,  0) NOT NULL,
	inventoryAmt numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,    /*Cost of items and disc on total item cost*/
	NetAmt       numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,    /*Net Cost including flat discounts, misc charges*/
	flatdisc     numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,
	misccharges  numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,
	salestax     numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL
)

insert  #lt_PurRetSummary
select  Case prledger.PRCatCode
		when 4 THEN @ln_cashacc     /* Cash Purchase */
		when 6 THEN @ln_equityacc   /* Opening Purchase  */
		else   prledger.suppcode     /* Credit Purhase    */
	end,

	IsNull(sum((( prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.packqty * prdetail.packunits) * prdetail.prprice) * (1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * prledger.discperc)), 0),
	IsNull(Round(sum((( prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.packqty * prdetail.packunits) * prdetail.prprice) * (1 - (.01 * prdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * prledger.discperc)) + prledger.misccharges + prledger.salestax - prledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
	prledger.flatdisc,
	prledger.misccharges,
	prledger.salestax

from     prledger,	 
	 prdetail		

where    prledger.date <= @ad_Date and
	 prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode

group by prledger.prinvcode,
	 prledger.suppcode, 
	 prledger.prcatcode,
	 prledger.date,
	 prledger.discperc,
	 prledger.misccharges,
	 prledger.salestax,
	 prledger.flatdisc		

/***************************Credit Inventory****************************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance - (Select IsNull(sum(inventoryAmt), 0) from #lt_PurRetSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_inventoryacc

/**********************Debit flatdiscount ***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance + (Select IsNull(sum(flatdisc), 0) from #lt_PurRetSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_freightacc

/**********************Credit misc charges ***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance - (Select IsNull(sum(misccharges), 0) from #lt_PurRetSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_octroiacc

/**********************Credit salestax***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance - (Select IsNull(sum(salestax), 0) from #lt_PurRetSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_salestaxacc

/******************Debit supplier/cash/equity account********************/

Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance + (Select IsNull(sum(#lt_PurRetSummary.netAmt), 0) from #lt_PurRetSummary where #lt_PurRetSummary.acccode = #lt_accounts.acccode) 
from   #lt_accounts, #lt_PurRetSummary
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = #lt_PurRetSummary.acccode 

Drop table #lt_PurRetSummary

/**********************************************************************/
/**************************** Sale ***********************************/
/**********************************************************************/

create table #lt_SaleSummary
(
	acccode      numeric (5,  0) NOT NULL,
	InventoryAmt numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,    /*Average cost of goods*/
	NetAmt       numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,    /*Net sale price including flat discounts, misc charges etc*/
	flatdisc     numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,
	misccharges  numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,
	salestax     numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL
)

insert  #lt_SaleSummary
select  Case saleledger.saleCatCode
		when 1 THEN @ln_cashacc     /* Cash Sale */
		when 3 THEN @ln_cashacc     /* Cash Sale */
		else   saleledger.custcode     /* Credit Sale */
	end,
	IsNull(sum( (saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.packqty * saledetail.packunits) * saledetail.avgprice), 0),
	IsNull(Round(sum(( (saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.packqty * saledetail.packunits) * saledetail.saleprice) * (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
	saleledger.flatdisc,
	saleledger.misccharges,
	saleledger.salestax

from     saleledger,	 
	 saledetail		

where    saleledger.date <= @ad_Date and
	 saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode 

group by saleledger.saleinvcode,
	 saleledger.custcode, 
	 saleledger.salecatcode,
	 saleledger.date,
	 saleledger.discperc,
	 saleledger.misccharges,
	 saleledger.salestax,
	 saleledger.flatdisc		

/**********************Credit Inventory***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance - (Select IsNull(sum(InventoryAmt), 0) from #lt_SaleSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_inventoryacc

/**********************Debit Average Purchase Cost***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance + (Select IsNull(sum(InventoryAmt), 0) from #lt_SaleSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_purchaseacc

/**********************Debit flatdiscount ***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance + (Select IsNull(sum(flatdisc), 0) from #lt_SaleSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_salesfixdiscacc

/**********************Credit misc charges ***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance - (Select IsNull(sum(misccharges), 0) from #lt_SaleSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_miscchargesacc

/**********************Credit salestax***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance - (Select IsNull(sum(salestax), 0) from #lt_SaleSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_salestaxacc

/**********************Credit Sales***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance - (Select IsNull(sum(NetAmt - salestax + FlatDisc - MiscCharges), 0) from #lt_SaleSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_salesacc

/******************Debit customer/cash/equity account********************/

Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance + (Select IsNull(sum(#lt_SaleSummary.NetAmt), 0) from #lt_SaleSummary where #lt_SaleSummary.acccode = #lt_accounts.acccode) 
from   #lt_accounts, #lt_SaleSummary
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = #lt_SaleSummary.acccode 

Drop table #lt_SaleSummary

/**********************************************************************/
/**************************** Sale Return ********************************/
/**********************************************************************/

create table #lt_SaleRetSummary
(
	acccode      numeric (5,  0) NOT NULL,
	InventoryAmt numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,    /*Average cost of goods*/
	NetAmt       numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,    /*Sale price of items and disc on total item sale price*/
	flatdisc     numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,
	misccharges  numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL,
	salestax     numeric (11, 2) NOT NULL
)

insert  #lt_SaleRetSummary
select  Case srledger.srCatCode
		when 6 THEN @ln_cashacc     /* Cash Sale Return*/
		when 8 THEN @ln_cashacc     /* Cash Sale Return*/
		else   srledger.custcode     /* Credit Sale Return*/
	end,

	IsNull( sum(((srdetail.looseqty + srdetail.packqty * srdetail.packunits) * srdetail.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)), 0),
	IsNull(Round(sum(((srdetail.looseqty + srdetail.packqty * srdetail.packunits) * srdetail.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) + srledger.misccharges + srledger.salestax - srledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
	srledger.flatdisc,
	srledger.misccharges,
	srledger.salestax

from     srledger,	 
	 srdetail		

where    srledger.date <= @ad_Date and
	 srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode 

group by srledger.srinvcode,
	 srledger.custcode, 
	 srledger.srcatcode,
	 srledger.date,
	 srledger.discperc,
	 srledger.misccharges,
	 srledger.salestax,
	 srledger.flatdisc		

/**********************Debit Inventory***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance + (Select IsNull(sum(InventoryAmt), 0) from #lt_SaleRetSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_inventoryacc

/**********************Credit Purchase ***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance - (Select IsNull(sum(InventoryAmt), 0) from #lt_SaleRetSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_purchaseacc

/**********************Credit flatdiscount ***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance - (Select IsNull(sum(flatdisc), 0) from #lt_SaleRetSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_salesfixdiscacc

/**********************Debit misc charges ***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance + (Select IsNull(sum(misccharges), 0) from #lt_SaleRetSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_miscchargesacc

/**********************Debit salestax***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance + (Select IsNull(sum(salestax), 0) from #lt_SaleRetSummary)
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_salestaxacc

/**********************Debit Sales Return ***********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance + (Select IsNull(sum(inventoryamt), 0) from #lt_SaleRetSummary) 
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = @ln_salesretacc

/******************credit customer/cash/equity account********************/
Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance - (Select IsNull(sum(NetAmt), 0) from #lt_SaleRetSummary)
from   #lt_accounts, #lt_SaleRetSummary
where  #lt_accounts.acccode = #lt_SaleRetSummary.acccode 

Drop table #lt_SaleRetSummary

/**********************************************************************/
/**************************** Accounting Vouchers ************************/
/**********************************************************************/

Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance + (Select IsNull(sum(gldetail.debit - gldetail.credit), 0) from glheader, gldetail where glheader.date <= @ad_Date and glheader.glvochcode =  gldetail.glvochcode and gldetail.acccode = #lt_accounts.acccode  ) 
from   #lt_accounts
where  #lt_accounts.acccode IN (Select distinct acccode from gldetail) 


/**********************************************************************/
/********************* Bills Receivables/Payables **********************/
/**********************************************************************/

Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance + (Select IsNull(sum(Case NoteCatCode When 1 Then Amount * -1 Else Notes.Amount      End), 0) from Notes where Notes.issuedate <= @ad_Date and Notes.acccode = #lt_accounts.acccode ) 
from   #lt_accounts
where  #lt_accounts.acccode IN (Select distinct acccode from Notes ) 

Update #lt_accounts
set    #lt_accounts.currbalance = #lt_accounts.currbalance + (Select IsNull(sum(Case NoteCatCode When 1 Then Amount    Else Notes.Amount * -1   End), 0) from Notes where Notes.issuedate <= @ad_Date and Notes.bankacccode = #lt_accounts.acccode ) 
from   #lt_accounts
where  #lt_accounts.acccode IN (Select distinct bankacccode from Notes ) 

/**************************Final Housing Keeping *********************/

	Select accounts.name, subaccounts.name, #lt_Accounts.currbalance, accounts.acccode
	From   	accounts, #lt_Accounts, subaccounts
	Where  	accounts.acccode = #lt_Accounts.acccode and
		accounts.subcode = subaccounts.subacccode

-- SP_TransferAccountingVoucher
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_TransferAccountingVoucher
	@SRV VARCHAR(50), 
	@DB VARCHAR(50), 
	@OWNER VARCHAR(20), 
	@USERCODE SMALLINT, 
	@LOGID INT OUTPUT
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

DECLARE @srcupd NVARCHAR(1000), @full_table_name NVARCHAR(255), @AccountName Varchar(100)
DECLARE @sqlheader NVARCHAR(1000), @sqldetail NVARCHAR(1000), @sql NVARCHAR(3000), @list NVARCHAR(3000)
DECLARE @table_id INT, @headercount INT, @TabMaxKey INT, @VoucherCode INT
DECLARE @OldGLVochCode INT, @VochCatCode INT, @AccCode INT, @ThisCount INT, @RetCode INT, @ImportCount INT
DECLARE @GLRowID INT, @errcode INT
DECLARE @DetailCount BIGINT, @MaxUtn BIGINT, @LastUTN BIGINT
DECLARE @Expiry DATETIME
DECLARE @ChangeVochType NVARCHAR(4000)

SET @sqlheader = N'SELECT T.*, OLDGLVochCode=T.GLVochCode INTO GLHTEMP FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.GLHeader AS T WHERE T.Transferable = ''Y'' and T.Transfered = ''N'' '
SET @sqldetail = N'SELECT T.*, OLDGLVochCode=T.GLVochCode INTO GLDTEMP FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.GLDetail AS T WHERE T.GLVochCode IN (SELECT GLVochCode FROM GLHTEMP)'
SET @srcupd = N'UPDATE ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.GLHeader SET TRANSFERED=''Y'', TRANSFEREDON = GETDATE(), TRANSFEREDBY = ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@USERCODE))) + ' WHERE GLVochCode IN (SELECT GLVochCode=OLDGLVochCode FROM GLHTEMP WHERE GLVochCode >= 0)'

EXECUTE (@sqlheader)
SET @errcode = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Error Fetching The Required Accounting Vouchers From Source/Parent Database', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @headercount = ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM GLHTEMP), 0)
SET @errcode = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0 OR @headercount <= 0
BEGIN
	RETURN 0
END

EXECUTE (@sqldetail)
SET @errcode = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in fetching Accounting Vouchers Detail', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @detailcount = ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM GLDTEMP), 0)
SET @errcode = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0 OR @detailcount <= 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in fetching Accounting Vouchers Detail', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

-- Transform Invoice based Vouchers to a/c based vouchers header
SET @ChangeVochType = ' UPDATE GLHTEMP SET VochCatCode = CASE WHEN VochCatCode <= 5 THEN VochCatCode WHEN VochCatCode = 12 THEN 2 WHEN VochCatCode = 13 THEN 4 WHEN VochCatCode = 15 THEN 1 WHEN VochCatCode = 16 THEN 3 ELSE 5 END  '
EXECUTE (@ChangeVochType)
SET @errcode = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in transformation of a/c vouchers from invoice based to a/c based', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

-- Transform Invoice based Vouchers to a/c based vouchers detail
SET @ChangeVochType = ' UPDATE GLDTEMP SET InvoiceCode=NULL, OutStandingAmt=0, Balance=0  '
EXECUTE (@ChangeVochType)
SET @errcode = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in transformation of a/c vouchers from invoice based to a/c based', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

EXECUTE @errcode = SP_GetTabMaxkey 'datatransferlog' , @LOGID Output
SET @errcode = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in generating data transfer log', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

EXECUTE @errcode = SP_MaxUtn @detailcount, @MaxUtn OUTPUT
IF @errcode <> 0 AND @@ERROR <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem in generating GL UTN', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1			
END

SET @errcode = 0
SET @LastUTN = @MaxUtn - @detailcount

DECLARE GL1 CURSOR FOR
SELECT GLVochCode, VochCatCode
FROM GLHTEMP
ORDER BY GLVochCode

OPEN GL1

FETCH NEXT FROM GL1 INTO @OldGLVochCode, @VochCatCode
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @ThisCount = 0

	UPDATE GLDTemp SET GLVochCode=-1000 WHERE OLDGLVochCode = @OldGLVochCode
	SET @ThisCount = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(OLDGLVochCode) FROM GLDTemp WHERE OLDGLVochCode = @OldGLVochCode), 0)

	IF @ThisCount = 0 
	BEGIN
		UPDATE GLHTEMP
		SET GLVochCode = -1000 WHERE OldGLVochCode = @OldGLVochCode
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		/* Generate TabMaxKey for GL Voucher Code for current voucher */
		EXECUTE @errcode = SP_GetTabMaxkey 'glheader', @TABMAXKEY Output
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
		BEGIN
			CLOSE GL1
			DEALLOCATE GL1
			RETURN -1
		END
		/* Generate Voucher Code for current voucher category */
		EXECUTE @errcode = SP_GetVoucherCode @VochCatCode, @VoucherCode Output
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
		BEGIN
			RaisError('Voucher Code Generation Problem' ,16, 1)
			CLOSE GL1
			DEALLOCATE GL1
			RETURN -1
		END

		UPDATE GLHTEMP
		SET GLVochCode = @TabMaxKey, VoucherCode = @VoucherCode, SalesmanCode = @USERCODE, 
			ModifiedBy = NULL, POSTED='N', POSTEDBY=NULL, TRANSFERABLE='N', TRANSFERED='N', 
			TRANSFEREDBY=NULL, TRANSFEREDON=NULL, IMPORTED='Y', IMPORTEDBY=@UserCode
		WHERE OLDGLVochCode = @OldGLVochCode

		UPDATE GLDTEMP
		SET GLVochCode = @TabMaxKey
		WHERE OLDGLVochCode = @OldGLVochCode
	END
	FETCH NEXT FROM GL1 INTO @OldGLVochCode, @VochCatCode
END
CLOSE GL1
DEALLOCATE GL1

SET @ImportCount = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GLHTEMP WHERE GLHTEMP.GLVochCode >= 0), 0)

IF @ImportCount > 0
BEGIN
	SET XACT_ABORT ON
	EXECUTE (@SRCUPD)
	SET @errcode = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Unable To update the transfer status at source/parent database', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET XACT_ABORT OFF

	SET @LIST=''
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_COLUMNLIST @OWNER, 'GLHeader', @LIST OUTPUT
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Unable To update accounting voucher header', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @SQL = N'INSERT INTO DBO.GLHeader ( ' + @LIST + ' ) ' + 'SELECT ' + 
		@LIST +	' FROM GLHTEMP WHERE GLHTEMP.GLVochCode >= 0'
	
	EXECUTE (@SQL)
	SET @errcode = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Unable To update accounting voucher header', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @LIST=''
	EXECUTE @errcode = SP_COLUMNLIST @OWNER, 'GLDetail', @LIST OUTPUT
	SET @errcode = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Unable To update accounting voucher detail', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @SQL = N'INSERT INTO DBO.GLDETAIL ( ' + @LIST + ' ) ' + 'SELECT ' + 
		@LIST +	' FROM GLDTEMP WHERE GLDTEMP.GLVochCode >= 0'

	EXECUTE (@SQL)
	SET @errcode = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @errcode <> 0
	BEGIN
		RaisError('Unable To update accounting voucher detail', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @@ERROR = 0 AND @errcode = 0
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DataTransferLog (TRANSFERLOGID, LOGDATE, TRANSFEREDBY, INVOICECODE, INVOICETYPE, DATE, ACCCODE, SGCODE, DGCODE, STATUS)
	SELECT  @LOGID, LOGDATE=GETDATE(), TRANSFEREDBY=@UserCode, INVOICECODE=OLDGLVochCode, 
		INVOICETYPE=0, DATE=GETDATE(), ACCCODE=ACCCODE, NULL, NULL,
		STATUS = CASE GLVochCode WHEN -1000 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
	FROM GLHTEMP

	INSERT INTO DataTransferLogDetail 
		(TRANSFERLOGID, INVOICECODE, INVOICETYPE, ICode, GCODE, BATCH, 
		EXPIRY, QTY, BONUSQTY, PRICE, STATUS)
	SELECT @LOGID, INVOICECODE=OLDGLVochCode, INVOICETYPE=0, ICode=AccCode, GCODE=NULL, BATCH=NULL, 
		EXPIRY=NULL, QTY= Debit - Credit, BonusQty=0, PurPrice=1, STATUS = CASE GLVochCode WHEN -1000 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
	FROM GLDTEMP
END

DROP TABLE GLHTEMP
DROP TABLE GLDTEMP

IF @@ERROR = 0 AND @errcode = 0
	RETURN 0
ELSE
	RaisError('Unable To successfully transfer accounting voucher', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1

name: SP_TransferBasicData
definition:
-- SP_TransferBasicData
CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_TransferBasicData @SRV VARCHAR(50), @DB VARCHAR(50), @OWNER VARCHAR(20)
AS

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

/*Variables to be used in delete, update and insert processes*/
DECLARE @LastDateTime DATETIME
DECLARE @TableName NVARCHAR(50), @full_table_name NVARCHAR(255), @CON NVARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @ColName VARCHAR(255), @WHR VARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @FROM NVARCHAR(1000), @PKCOND NVARCHAR(1000), @NOTIN NVARCHAR(50), @IN NVARCHAR(50), @ENDD NVARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @MAXCOL NVARCHAR(255), @TABMAXSQL NVARCHAR(3000), @SQL NVARCHAR(4000), @LIST NVARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @AutoInsert CHAR(1), @AutoUpdate Char(1), @AutoDelete Char(1), @UPDMaxKey Char(1)
DECLARE @table_id INT, @err INT
DECLARE @Priority SMALLINT, @KeySeq SMALLINT, @Position SMALLINT
/*Variables to be used in delete process*/
DECLARE @DEL NVARCHAR(1000), @DEL_QRY NVARCHAR(4000)
/*Variables to be used in Insert process*/
DECLARE @INS NVARCHAR(1000), @INS_QRY NVARCHAR(4000)

/*Variables to be used in Update process*/
DECLARE @UPD NVARCHAR(1000), @SETPART NVARCHAR(4000), @UPD_PKCOND NVARCHAR(1000), @UPD_QRY NVARCHAR(4000)

/*'FROM' clause of SQL used in INSERT/DELETE*/
IF LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) = ''
	SET @FROM = N' FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.'
ELSE
	SET @FROM = N' FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.'

SET @NOTIN = N' NOT IN (SELECT '
SET @CON = N'CONVERT(VarChar(10),'
SET @SQL = N'SELECT '
SET @IN = N' IN (SELECT '
SET @WHR = N'WHERE '
SET @ENDD = N' AS T WHERE '
SET @LastDateTime = ISNULL((SELECT ServerDataTime FROM DataTransferDate), '1900-01-01 00:00:00')

/*BasicData Deletion Variables (initializing variables)*/
SET @DEL = N'DELETE '

/*BasicData Updation Variables (initializing variables)*/
SET @UPD = N'UPDATE '
SET @SETPART = N'SET '

/*BasicData Updation Variables (initializing variables)*/
SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO '

DECLARE TmpCrs1 CURSOR FOR
SELECT TABLENAME=LTRIM(RTRIM(TABLENAME)), PRIORITY, AUTOINSERT, AUTOUPDATE, AUTODELETE, UPDATETABMAXKEY
FROM TransferableData 
WHERE Enable='Y'
ORDER BY Priority

OPEN TmpCrs1

FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs1 INTO @TableName, @Priority, @AutoInsert, @AutoUpdate, @AutoDelete, @UPDMaxKey
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @full_table_name = LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.' + @TableName
	SET @table_id = OBJECT_ID(@full_table_name)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0 OR @table_id IS NULL
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Data Updation: Invalid Object Refered: Name = %s', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
		CLOSE TmpCrs1
		DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
		RETURN -1
	END 

	SELECT @PKCOND = '', @MAXCOL = '', @UPD_PKCOND = ''

	DECLARE TmpCrs2 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT 	COLNAME = CONVERT(sysname,c.name),
		KEYSEQ =
			CASE
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  1) then convert (smallint,1)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  2) then convert (smallint,2)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  3) then convert (smallint,3)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  4) then convert (smallint,4)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  5) then convert (smallint,5)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  6) then convert (smallint,6)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  7) then convert (smallint,7)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  8) then convert (smallint,8)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  9) then convert (smallint,9)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 10) then convert (smallint,10)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 11) then convert (smallint,11)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 12) then convert (smallint,12)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 13) then convert (smallint,13)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 14) then convert (smallint,14)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 15) then convert (smallint,15)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 16) then convert (smallint,16)
			end
	from
		sysindexes i, syscolumns c, sysobjects o
	where
		o.id = @table_id
		and o.id = c.id
		and o.id = i.id
		and (i.status & 0x800) = 0x800
		and (c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  1) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  2) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  3) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  4) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  5) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  6) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  7) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  8) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  9) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 10) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 11) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 12) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 13) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 14) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 15) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 16)
		    )
	order by 2

	OPEN TmpCrs2
	
	FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs2 INTO @ColName, @KeySeq
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		IF @KeySeq <> 1
		BEGIN
			SET @PKCOND = @PKCOND  + ' + '
			SET @UPD_PKCOND = @UPD_PKCOND + ' AND '
		END

		SET @PKCOND = @PKCOND + ' ' + @CON + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + ')'
		SET @UPD_PKCOND = @UPD_PKCOND + ' T.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + ' = ' + @TableName + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName))

		SET @MAXCOL = 'MAX(' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@ColName)) + ')'	
		FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs2 INTO @ColName, @KeySeq
	END
	CLOSE TmpCrs2
	DEALLOCATE TmpCrs2	

	IF @AutoDelete='Y'
	BEGIN
		SET @DEL_QRY = @DEL + @TableName + ' ' + @WHR + @PKCOND + @NOTIN + @PKCOND + @FROM + @TableName + ')'
		EXECUTE (@DEL_QRY)
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Data Deletion: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
			CLOSE TmpCrs1
			DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	IF @AutoUpdate='Y'
	BEGIN
		SET @SETPART = N'SET '
	
		DECLARE TmpCrs3 CURSOR FOR
		SELECT
			COLUMNNAME = convert(sysname,c.name),
			POSITION = convert(int,
					   (
						select count(*)
						from syscolumns sc
						where sc.id     =  c.id
						  AND sc.number =  c.number
						  AND sc.colid  <= c.colid
					    ))
		FROM
			sysobjects o,
			syscolumns c
		WHERE
			o.id = @table_id AND c.id = o.id
		ORDER BY 2
	
		OPEN TmpCrs3
	
		FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs3 INTO @ColName, @Position
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			IF ColumnProperty (@table_id, @ColName, 'IsIdentity') <> 1
			BEGIN
				IF @ColName = (SELECT columnname FROM TransferableData_RestrictedColumns WHERE columnname = @ColName and tablename = @TableName)
				BEGIN
					SET @ColName = @ColName
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF @SETPART <> 'SET '
					BEGIN
						SET @SETPART = @SETPART + ','
					END
			
					SET @SETPART = @SETPART + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + '=' + 'T.' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName))
				END
			END
			
			FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs3 INTO @ColName, @Position
		END
		CLOSE TmpCrs3
		DEALLOCATE TmpCrs3
	
		IF @SETPART <> 'SET '
		BEGIN
			SET @UPD_QRY = @UPD + @TableName + ' ' + @SETPART + ' ' + @FROM + @TableName + @ENDD + ' ' + @UPD_PKCOND
			EXECUTE (@UPD_QRY)
			SET @err = @@ERROR
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Data Updation: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
				CLOSE TmpCrs1
				DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
				RETURN -1
			END 
		END
	END 

	IF @AutoInsert='Y' AND @TableName <> 'Rights' 
	BEGIN
		SET @SQL = N' SELECT '
		SET @LIST=''
		EXECUTE @err = SP_COLUMNLIST @OWNER, @TableName, @LIST OUTPUT
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			CLOSE TmpCrs1
			DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
			RETURN -1
		END
		IF @TableName = 'GroupRights'
			SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @FROM + @TableName + @ENDD + @PKCOND + @NOTIN + @PKCOND + ' FROM ' + @TableName + ')  AND RightCode IN (SELECT RightCode FROM Rights)'
		ELSE
			SET @INS_QRY = @INS + @TableName + ' (' + @List + ' )  ' + @SQL + @List + @FROM + @TableName + @ENDD + @PKCOND + @NOTIN + @PKCOND + ' FROM ' + @TableName + ')'

		EXECUTE (@INS_QRY)
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
			CLOSE TmpCrs1
			DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	IF @UPDMaxKey = 'Y' 
	BEGIN
		SET @TABMAXSQL = ''
		SET @TABMAXSQL = 'UPDATE _tabmaxkey SET TABMAXKEY = ' + ' ISNULL((SELECT ' + @MAXCOL + ' FROM  ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@TableName)) + '), 0) ' + 'WHERE TABNAME = ''' + RTRIM(LTRIM(@TableName)) + ''''
		EXECUTE (@TABMAXSQL)
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Data Insertion: Error While Updating the TABMAXKEY of %s ', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
			CLOSE TmpCrs1
			DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	FETCH NEXT FROM TmpCrs1 INTO @TableName, @Priority, @AutoInsert, @AutoUpdate, @AutoDelete, @UPDMaxKey
END
CLOSE TmpCrs1
DEALLOCATE TmpCrs1

DELETE DataTransferDate

IF LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) = ''
	SET @INS_QRY = 'INSERT INTO DataTransferDate (ServerDataTime) SELECT ServerDataTime = ISNULL((SELECT GETDATE() - 0.042 FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '._UTN)' + ', GETDATE())'
ELSE
	SET @INS_QRY = 'INSERT INTO DataTransferDate (ServerDataTime) SELECT ServerDataTime = ISNULL((SELECT GETDATE() - 0.042 FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '._UTN)' + ', GETDATE())'

EXECUTE (@INS_QRY)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Data Transfer: Error While recoridng data transfer date', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

INSERT INTO DataImportLog (LogDate, ImportedBy, ImportType, Remarks)
VALUES (GetDate(), 1, 'Data Synchronization', @SRV + ' DB:' + @DB)

RETURN 0

name: SP_TransferInterGodownTransfers
