-- sp_Translate_ChildeServer_SaleReturn
CREATE   PROCEDURE sp_Translate_ChildeServer_SaleReturn
	@childserver VarChar(100), 
	@advsaleinvcode Int, 
	@usercode Int,
	@refund NUMERIC(10, 2),
	@SRInvCode Int OUTPUT
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

DECLARE @Sale NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @Headerno Int, @GCode INT, @curr_rowid INT
Declare @module Int, @custcode Int, @saletypecode SmallInt, @srcatcode Int, @headerinvno Int, @continue Int, @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @totalrows Int, @rowcount Int, @invcounter Int, @counter Int
Declare @satisfiableqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @item_in_inv_exist Int
Declare @srprice Numeric(12,2), @rate Numeric(12,2), @discperc Numeric(5,2), @itemflatdisc Numeric(15,2), @unitsalestax Numeric(12,2), @gstperc1 Numeric(6,2), @gstperc2 Numeric(6,2), @hold_avgprice Numeric(15,5)
Declare @icode Int, @anyitem_exist Int, @packunits Int
Declare @totalqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @givenqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @reqqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @batchqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @delqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @currqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @newqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @totalstock NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @batch VarChar(100), @itemname VarChar(60), @expiry DateTime, @serverdate DateTime
Declare @saleutn BigInt, @firsttime Bit
Declare @advsale_rowcount Int, @rowgroup Int, @lineitems_rowcount Int, @innercounter Int
Set @firsttime = 0
Set @custcode = 19
Set @srcatcode = 8 
Set @saletypecode = 2
Set @module = ( Select module from module where name = 'SALES RETURN' )
Set @serverdate = GETDATE()

Create Table #salereturn ( 
	id int not null identity(1,1), 
	icode Int, 
	gcode int, 
	batch VARCHAR(100), 
	satisfiableqty NUMERIC(15, 4), 
	SalePrice  Numeric(12,2), 
	rate Numeric(12,2), 
	packunits smallint not null, 
	DiscPerc Numeric(8,2), 
	ItemFlatDisc Numeric(12,2), 
	UnitSalesTax Numeric(12,2), 
	GstPerc Numeric(6,2) )

Insert Into #salereturn 
	( icode, gcode, batch, satisfiableqty, saleprice, rate, packunits, discperc, 
	itemflatdisc, unitsalestax, gstperc )
Select icode, gcode, batch, SUM(ABS(looseqty)), saleprice, rate, packunits, discperc, 
	itemflatdisc, unitsalestax, gstperc
From IMP_AdvSaleDetail
Where ChildServer = @childserver AND AdvSaleInvCode = @AdvSaleInvCode AND LooseQty < 0
GROUP BY icode, gcode, batch, saleprice, rate, packunits, discperc, itemflatdisc, unitsalestax, gstperc
Order By ICode

SET @Sale = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(LooseQty) FROM IMP_AdvSaleDetail Where ChildServer = @childserver AND AdvSaleInvCode = @AdvSaleInvCode AND LooseQty > 0), 0)
Set @advsale_rowcount = ISNULL((Select count(*) from IMP_AdvSaleDetail where ChildServer = @childserver AND AdvSaleInvCode = @advsaleinvcode), 0)
Set @anyitem_exist  = ( Select Sum(ABS(Satisfiableqty)) from #salereturn )
Set @Headerno = ( Select HeaderNo from IMP_AdvSaleLedger WHERE ChildServer = @childserver AND AdvSaleInvCode = @advsaleinvcode)
Set @continue = 0
Set @invcounter = 1
Set @rowgroup = 0

While @anyitem_exist > 0 And @continue >= 0
Begin
	Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'SRledger' , @SRInvCode Output
	Set @rowgroup = 0
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	Begin
		Set @continue  = -1
	End
	Else
	Begin
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno, @module,  @headerinvno Output 
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
		Else
		Begin
			Set @Err = 0 
			Set @RowCount = 1
			Insert Into SRLedger (SRInvCode, SaleInvCode, Date, SRCatCode, CustCode, SalesmanCode, 
				DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, Posted, PostDate, Remarks, SalesTax, 
				OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, HeaderNo, InvGSTPerc1, Smancode, 
				CustRefno, CustRefno2, CustRefno3, CustRefno4, PatientCode, MachineName, 
				HeaderInvNo, AdmissionCode, InvTotal, AccountFor, PaymentMode, PaymentAccCode, 
				Amt, AmtBY, AmtDate, AmtReference, OutstandingAmt, Marked, PageSize, ReprintingCounter, DoctCode, ConsiderInPO)
			SELECT  @SRInvCode, SaleInvCode=NULL, Date, 
				SRCatCode = CASE invtype WHEN 1 THEN @srcatcode ELSE 7 END, CustCode, SalesManCode, 
				Discperc, Flatdisc= CASE WHEN @Sale = 0 THEN Flatdisc ELSE 0 END, MiscCharges=CASE WHEN @Sale = 0 THEN MiscCharges ELSE 0 END + ISNULL(@Refund, 0), Posted='Y', PostDate=GETDATE(), Remarks, SalesTax=0, 
				OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy=@usercode, @HeaderNo, InvGSTPerc1, Smancode, 
				CustRefno, CustRefno2, CustRefno3, CustRefno4, PatientCode, MachineName, 
				@HeaderInvNo, AdmissionCode=NULL, InvTotal=0, AccountFor='Y', PaymentMode, PaymentAccCode, 
				Amt, AmtBY, AmtDate, AmtReference, OutstandingAmt, Marked='N', InvoiceSize, ReprintingCounter=0, DoctCode, ConsiderInPO='Y'
			FROM IMP_AdvSaleLedger
			WHERE ChildServer = @childserver AND AdvSaleInvCode = @AdvSaleInvCode

			Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
			IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
			Begin 
				RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Return Ledger : %d' ,16,1,  @SRInvCode  )
				Set @continue  = -1
			End 
			Else
			Begin
				Set	@curr_rowid = 1
				Set @anyitem_exist  = ( Select Sum(Satisfiableqty) from #salereturn )
				Set @lineitems_rowcount =  @advsale_rowcount
				Set @innercounter = 1
				While ( @advsale_rowcount > 0 )  AND ( @anyitem_exist > 0 ) AND ( @innercounter <= @lineitems_rowcount ) AND ( @continue >= 0 )
				Begin
					Select @icode = icode , @Gcode = GCode, 
						@batch = ISNULL((select DBO.Fn_GetPreference('defaultbatch')), '.'), 
						@expiry = CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), (SELECT GETDATE() + (SELECT DBO.FN_Get_INT_Preference('expiry'))), 106)), 
						@satisfiableqty = satisfiableqty, @srprice = saleprice, 
						@rate = rate, @packunits = packunits, @discperc = discperc,  
						@itemflatdisc = itemflatdisc, @unitsalestax = unitsalestax, @gstperc1 = gstperc
					From #salereturn
			        Where id = @curr_rowid

					Select @RowCount = @@RowCount
					IF ( @RowCount = 1 ) AND  ( @satisfiableqty > 0 )
					Begin
						Set @givenqty = @satisfiableqty
						Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
						IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
						Begin
							Set @continue  = -1
						End
						Else
						Begin
							Set @totalstock = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.icode = @icode  )
							Set @totalqty = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and godowndetail.icode = @icode  )
							Set @rowgroup = @rowgroup + 1
							IF @packunits = 0 OR @packunits Is Null 
							BEGIN
								Set @packunits = 1
							END

							IF @givenqty > 0
							Begin 
								Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @saleutn Output
								IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
								Begin
									Set @continue  = -1
								End

								Insert Into SRDetail 
									(SRInvcode, Icode, Gcode, Batch, Expiry, PackQty, LooseQty, PackUnits, SRPrice, 
									DiscPerc, SalesTax, AvgPrice, UnitSalesTax, GSTPerc, SRUtn, BonusQty, SalePrice, SaleRowId, CurrStock)
								SELECT @SRInvCode, @icode, @gcode, @batch, @expiry, 0, @givenqty, @packunits, (@srprice - @itemflatdisc), 
									@discperc, 0, @hold_avgprice, @unitsalestax, @gstperc1, @saleutn, 0, (@SRPrice - @itemflatdisc), NULL, @totalstock

								Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
								IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
								Begin 
									RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Return Detail for Sale Return No. : %d' ,16,1, @SRInvCode  )
									Set @continue  = -1
								End 															Else
								Begin
									Set @currqty = 0
									Execute @rt_code = SP_GetItemStockBatch @GCode, @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @currqty output
									IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
									Begin
										RaisError( 'Error occured in checking Batch details of some items during processing of Sale Return No. : %d' ,16,1, @SRInvCode  )
										Set @continue  = -1								
									End

									Set @newqty = ISNULL(@currqty, 0) + ISNULL(@givenqty, 0)
									SELECT Row=@curr_rowid, Gcode=@GCode, Icode=@ICode, Batch=@Batch, Expiry=@Expiry, Qty=@CurrQty, thisqty = @givenqty, newqty=@newqty
									IF @newqty > 0
									BEGIN
										Execute @rt_code = SP_UpdateItemStockBatch  @GCode, @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @NewQty, Null
										IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
										Begin
											RaisError( 'Error occured in updation of Batch details of some items during processing of Sale Return No. : %d' ,16,1, @SRInvCode  )
											Set @continue  = -1								
										End
									END
								End
								Set @counter = @counter + 1
							End
						End
					End	
					UPDATE #salereturn SET Satisfiableqty = 0 WHERE ID = @curr_rowid
					Set	@curr_rowid = @curr_rowid + 1
					Set @innercounter = @innercounter + 1
					Set @anyitem_exist  = ( Select Sum(Satisfiableqty) from #salereturn )
				End
			End
		End	
	End
	Set @anyitem_exist  = ( Select Sum(Satisfiableqty) from #salereturn )
End

Drop Table #salereturn

IF ( @continue >= 0 )
Begin
	IF @SRInvCode > 0
	BEGIN
		Update DBO.SRledger 
		Set InvTotal = ISNULL(dbo.fn_getSRInvTotal (SRLedger.SRInvCode), 0)
		Where SRInvCode = @SRInvCode
	
		Select @Err = @@Error, @Rowcount = @@RowCount
		IF  @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0
		Begin
			RaisError( 'Unable to update Sale Return Invoices for Inv. total' , 16 , 1 )
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
	END
End

Return @continue

name: sp_Translate_ChildeServer_SReturn
definition:
-- sp_Translate_ChildeServer_SReturn
CREATE  PROCEDURE sp_Translate_ChildeServer_SReturn
	@childserver VarChar(100), 
	@OldSRInvCode Int, 
	@usercode Int,
	@SRInvCode Int OUTPUT
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

DECLARE @Sale NUMERIC(15, 4)
Declare @Headerno Int, @GCode INT, @curr_rowid INT
Declare @module Int, @custcode Int, @saletypecode SmallInt, @srcatcode Int, @headerinvno Int, @continue Int, @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @totalrows Int, @rowcount Int, @invcounter Int, @counter Int
Declare @looseqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @bonusqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @item_in_inv_exist Int
Declare @srprice Numeric(12,2), @rate Numeric(12,2), @discperc Numeric(5,2), @itemflatdisc Numeric(15,2), @unitsalestax Numeric(12,2), @gstperc1 Numeric(6,2), @gstperc2 Numeric(6,2), @hold_avgprice Numeric(15,5)
Declare @icode Int, @anyitem_exist Int, @packunits Int
Declare @totalqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @givenqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @reqqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @batchqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @delqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @currqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @newqty NUMERIC(15, 4), @totalstock NUMERIC(15, 4), @ItemAdvanceTaxPerc NUMERIC(5,2)
Declare @batch VarChar(100), @returndesc VarChar(100), @itemname VarChar(60), @expiry DateTime, @serverdate DateTime
Declare @saleutn BigInt, @firsttime Bit, @keepinvno CHAR(1), @updateRefno1 CHAR(1)
Declare @advsale_rowcount Int, @rowgroup Int, @lineitems_rowcount Int, @innercounter Int, @updateloyaltypoints CHAR(1)
Set @keepinvno = ISNULL((SELECT DBO.fn_GetPreference('KeepChildServerInvoiceNoIntact')),'N')
Set @updateRefno1 = ISNULL((SELECT DBO.fn_GetPreference('CopyChildServerInvoiceNoInRef1')),'N')

Set @firsttime = 0
Set @custcode = 19
Set @srcatcode = 8 
Set @saletypecode = 2
Set @module = ( Select module from module where name = 'SALES RETURN' )
Set @serverdate = GETDATE()
Set @updateloyaltypoints = ISNULL((SELECT DBO.fn_GetPreference('ApplyLoyaltypolicyonsaleposting')),'N')

Create Table #salereturn ( 
	id int not null identity(1,1), 
	icode Int, 
	gcode int, 
	batch VARCHAR(100), 
	expiry datetime,
	looseqty NUMERIC(15, 4), 
	bonusqty NUMERIC(15, 4), 
	SRPrice  Numeric(12,2), 
	packunits smallint not null, 
	DiscPerc Numeric(8,2), 
	UnitSalesTax Numeric(12,2), 
	GstPerc Numeric(6,2),
	returndesc varchar(100),
	ItemAdvanceTaxPerc NUMERIC(5,2))

Insert Into #salereturn 
	( icode, gcode, batch, expiry, looseqty, bonusqty, srprice, packunits, discperc, unitsalestax, gstperc, returndesc, ItemAdvanceTaxPerc)
Select icode, gcode, batch, expiry, SUM(ABS(looseqty)), bonusqty=sum(ABS(bonusqty)), srprice, packunits, discperc, unitsalestax, gstperc, returnitemdescription, ItemAdvanceTaxPerc
From IMP_SRDetail
Where ChildServer = @childserver AND SRInvCode = @OldSRInvCode
GROUP BY icode, gcode, batch, expiry, srprice, packunits, discperc, unitsalestax, gstperc, returnitemdescription, ItemAdvanceTaxPerc
Order By ICODE

SET @Sale = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(LooseQty) FROM IMP_SRDetail Where ChildServer = @childserver AND SRInvCode = @OldSRInvCode AND LooseQty > 0), 0)
Set @advsale_rowcount = ISNULL((Select count(*) from IMP_SRDetail where ChildServer = @childserver AND SRInvCode = @OldSRInvCode), 0)
Set @anyitem_exist  = ( Select Sum(ABS(looseqty)) from #salereturn )
Set @Headerno = ( Select HeaderNo from IMP_SRLedger WHERE ChildServer = @childserver AND SRInvCode = @OldSRInvCode)
Set @headerinvno = ( Select headerinvno from IMP_SRLedger WHERE ChildServer = @childserver AND SRInvCode = @OldSRInvCode)
Set @continue = 0
Set @invcounter = 1
Set @rowgroup = 0

While @anyitem_exist > 0 And @continue >= 0
Begin
	IF @keepinvno='N'
		Execute @rt_code = sp_GetTabMaxkey 'SRledger' , @SRInvCode Output
	ELSE
		SET @SRInvCode = @OldSRInvCode

	Set @rowgroup = 0
	IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
	Begin
		Set @continue  = -1
	End
	Else
	Begin
		IF @keepinvno='N'
			Execute @rt_code = sp_GetHeaderTabMaxkey @Headerno, @module,  @headerinvno Output 
		ELSE
			SET @headerinvno = @headerinvno
		
		IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
		Begin
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
		Else
		Begin
			Set @Err = 0 
			Set @RowCount = 1
			Insert Into SRLedger (SRInvCode, SaleInvCode, Date, SRCatCode, CustCode, SalesmanCode, 
				DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, Posted, PostDate, Remarks, SalesTax, 
				OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, HeaderNo, InvGSTPerc1, Smancode, 
				CustRefno, CustRefno2, CustRefno3, CustRefno4, PatientCode, MachineName, 
				HeaderInvNo, AdmissionCode, InvTotal, AccountFor, PaymentMode, PaymentAccCode, 
				Amt, AmtBY, AmtDate, AmtReference, OutstandingAmt, Marked, PageSize, ReprintingCounter, DoctCode, ConsiderInPO,
				CashAccCode,CashTendered,CashCharged,CashBack,RetViaBillSummary,CRS_Transfered,CRS_TransferedOn,GuestCode,
				GuestCheckInCode,StudentCode,Synced,SyncedOn,SyncedBy,CurrencyCode,ConversionRate,Fiscalized,
				FiscalizedOn,FiscalInvoiceNo,Transmit,Transmited,AdvanceTax,AdvanceTaxAmt,FBRPOSFee)
			SELECT  @SRInvCode, SaleInvCode=NULL, Date, SRCatCode, CustCode, SalesManCode, 
				Discperc, Flatdisc, MiscCharges, Posted='Y', PostDate=GETDATE(), Remarks, SalesTax=0, 
				OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy=@usercode, @HeaderNo, InvGSTPerc1, Smancode, 
				CustRefNo=CASE WHEN @updateRefno1 = 'Y' THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@SRInvCode))) ELSE CustRefNo END, CustRefno2, CustRefno3, CustRefno4=CustRefNo, PatientCode, MachineName, 
				@HeaderInvNo, AdmissionCode=NULL, InvTotal, AccountFor, PaymentMode, PaymentAccCode, 
				Amt, AmtBY, AmtDate, AmtReference, OutstandingAmt, Marked='N', PageSize, ReprintingCounter, DoctCode, ConsiderInPO,
				CashAccCode,CashTendered,CashCharged,CashBack,RetViaBillSummary,CRS_Transfered,CRS_TransferedOn,GuestCode,
				GuestCheckInCode,StudentCode,Synced,SyncedOn,SyncedBy,CurrencyCode,ConversionRate,Fiscalized,
				FiscalizedOn,FiscalInvoiceNo,Transmit='N',Transmited='N',AdvanceTax,AdvanceTaxAmt,FBRPOSFee 
			FROM IMP_SRLedger
			WHERE ChildServer = @childserver AND SRInvCode = @OldSRInvCode

			Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
			IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
			Begin 
				RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Return Ledger : %d' ,16,1,  @SRInvCode)
				Set @continue  = -1
			End 
			Else
			Begin
				Set	@curr_rowid = 1
				Set @anyitem_exist  = ( Select Sum(looseqty + bonusqty) from #salereturn )
				Set @lineitems_rowcount =  @advsale_rowcount
				Set @innercounter = 1
				While ( @advsale_rowcount > 0 )  AND ( @anyitem_exist > 0 ) AND ( @innercounter <= @lineitems_rowcount ) AND ( @continue >= 0 )
				Begin
					Select @icode = icode , @Gcode = GCode, 
						@batch = Batch, 
						@expiry = EXPIRY, 
						@looseqty = looseqty, @bonusqty=bonusqty, @srprice = srprice, 
						@packunits = packunits, @discperc = discperc,  
						@unitsalestax = unitsalestax, @gstperc1 = gstperc, @returndesc=returndesc,
						@ItemAdvanceTaxPerc=ItemAdvanceTaxPerc
					From #salereturn
			        	Where id = @curr_rowid

					Select @RowCount = @@RowCount
					IF ( @RowCount = 1 ) AND  ( @looseqty > 0 )
					Begin
						Set @givenqty = @looseqty + @bonusqty
						Execute @rt_code = sp_GetItemAvgPrice @icode, @hold_avgprice OutPut
						IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
						Begin
							Set @continue  = -1
						End
						Else
						Begin
							set @totalstock  = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.icode = @icode  )
							Set @totalqty = (Select IsNull(Sum(currqty),0) From godowndetail where godowndetail.gcode = @gcode and godowndetail.icode = @icode  )
							Set @rowgroup = @rowgroup + 1
							IF @packunits = 0 OR @packunits Is Null 
							BEGIN
								Set @packunits = 1
							END

							IF @givenqty > 0
							Begin 
								Execute @rt_code = sp_maxutn 1, @saleutn Output
								IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
								Begin
									Set @continue  = -1
								End

								Insert Into SRDetail 
									(SRInvcode, Icode, Gcode, Batch, Expiry, PackQty, LooseQty, PackUnits, SRPrice, 
									DiscPerc, SalesTax, AvgPrice, UnitSalesTax, GSTPerc, SRUtn, BonusQty, SalePrice, SaleRowId, ReturnItemDescription,ItemAdvanceTaxPerc, currstock)
								SELECT @SRInvCode, @icode, @gcode, @batch, @expiry, 0, @looseqty, @packunits, @srprice, 
									@discperc, 0, @hold_avgprice, @unitsalestax, @gstperc1, @saleutn, @bonusqty, @SRPrice, NULL, @returndesc, @ItemAdvanceTaxPerc, @totalstock

								Select @Err = @@Error, @RowCount = @@RowCount
								IF @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0 
								Begin 
									RaisError( 'Error occured in inserting record into Sale Return Detail for Sale Return No. : %d' ,16,1, @SRInvCode  )
									Set @continue  = -1
								End 															Else
								Begin
									Set @currqty = 0
									Execute @rt_code = SP_GetItemStockBatch @GCode, @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @currqty output
									IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
									Begin
										RaisError( 'Error occured in checking Batch details of some items during processing of Sale Return No. : %d' ,16,1, @SRInvCode  )
										Set @continue  = -1								
									End

									Set @newqty = ISNULL(@currqty, 0) + ISNULL(@givenqty, 0)
									SELECT Row=@curr_rowid, Gcode=@GCode, Icode=@ICode, Batch=@Batch, Expiry=@Expiry, Qty=@CurrQty, thisqty = @givenqty, newqty=@newqty
									IF @newqty > 0
									BEGIN
										Execute @rt_code = SP_UpdateItemStockBatch  @GCode, @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @NewQty, Null
										IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
										Begin
											RaisError( 'Error occured in updation of Batch details of some items during processing of Sale Return No. : %d' ,16,1, @SRInvCode  )
											Set @continue  = -1								
										End
									END
								End
								Set @counter = @counter + 1
							End
						End
					End	
					UPDATE #salereturn SET looseqty = 0, BonusQty=0 WHERE ID = @curr_rowid
					Set	@curr_rowid = @curr_rowid + 1
					Set @innercounter = @innercounter + 1
					Set @anyitem_exist  = ( Select Sum(looseqty + bonusqty) from #salereturn )
				End
			End
		End	
	End
	Set @anyitem_exist  = ( Select Sum(looseqty + bonusqty) from #salereturn )
End

Drop Table #salereturn

IF ( @continue >= 0 )
Begin
	IF @SRInvCode > 0
	BEGIN
		Update DBO.SRledger 
		Set InvTotal = ISNULL(dbo.fn_getSRInvTotal (SRLedger.SRInvCode), 0)
		Where SRInvCode = @SRInvCode
	
		Select @Err = @@Error, @Rowcount = @@RowCount
		IF  @Err <> 0 OR @RowCount = 0
		Begin
			RaisError( 'Unable to update Sale Return Invoices for Inv. total' , 16 , 1 )
			Set @continue  = -1
		End
		IF @updateloyaltypoints = 'Y'
		Begin
			Execute @rt_code = SP_ManageLoyaltyPoints 'SR', @SRInvCode
			IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
			Begin
				RaisError( 'Unable to update loyalty points On S/R Invoice : %d' ,16,1, @SRInvCode)
				Set @continue  = -1															
			End
		End
	END
End

Return @continue

name: SP_Transmit_ChildServerSales
definition:
-- SP_Transmit_ChildServerSales
CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.SP_Transmit_ChildServerSales
	@CustCode INT,
	@StartDate DATETIME,
	@EndDate DATETIME,
	@SRV VARCHAR(255), 
	@PARENTSRV VARCHAR(255), 
	@DB VARCHAR(50), 
	@OWNER VARCHAR(20),
	@SaleType INT
AS

SET XACT_ABORT ON
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

/* Variables to be used in import process */
DECLARE @INS VARCHAR(4000), @SQL VARCHAR(4000), @WHR VARCHAR(4000), @WHR_Cln VARCHAR(4000), @Query VARCHAR(4000), @stdate VARCHAR(100), @edate VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @err INT, @rt_code INT
DECLARE @dt DATETIME

SET @stdate = (SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @StartDate, 110) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @StartDate, 114))
SET @edate  = (SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @EndDate, 110)   + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @EndDate  , 114))

IF @SaleType = 1
BEGIN
	SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@PARENTSRV)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.IMP_SaleLedger '
	SET @SQL = N' SELECT ServerName=' + '''' + @SRV + ''', TransDate=GETDATE(), InvType = 1, SaleInvCode, SaleCatCode , CustCode , SalesmanCode, date, DiscPerc, FlatDisc, MiscCharges, SalesTax, Posted, PostDate, Remarks, CustRefNo, headerno, headerinvno, OriginalDate, ModifiedBy, PostedBy, SPrice, QuotationNo, DoctCode, PatientCode, RePrintingCounter, CashReceived, InvGSTPerc1, PrintWaranty, PrintBatch, MessageCode, SManCode, InvoiceSize, CustRefno2, CustRefno3, CustRefno4, GSTNO, InvTotal, MachineName, ModifyCounter, itemdiscpercno, RelationCode, DiseaseCode, WardCode, AdmissionCode, ReturnCounter, Paid, BillingDate, UnReceivedBalance, TotalOfSaleReturns, ListOfSrInvoices, printbalance, AccountFor, PaymentMode, PaymentAccCode, Amt, AmtBY, AmtDate, AmtReference, OutstandingAmt, Marked, Transferable, Transfered, TransferedOn, TransferedBy, Imported, ImportedBy, deliveredby, SaleTypeCode, Balance, PptCustCode, DELETED, PresCode, ImpactInventory, SaleOrderCode, SaleComments1, SaleComments2, AlterSaleInvCode, RecurringInvoice, RecurringPeriod, LastRecurringInvCode, RecurringAgainst, ConsiderInPO, VisitCode, DueDate, SRBufferInvCode, CustRefNo5, GCCode, GRN, SuppInvCode,  Vehicle, ShipTo, GuaranteePersonCode, CashTendered, CashCharged, CashBack, CashAccCode, CustLicNo, CustLicExpiry, ModuleId, DocCode=SaleInvCode, SaleTypeInvNo, CRS_Transfered, CRS_TransferedOn, GuestCode, GuestCheckInCode, StudentCode, CustSiteCode, Transmit, Transmited, Fiscalized, FiscalizedOn, FiscalInvoiceNo, AdvanceTax, ISNULL(AdvanceTaxAmt, 0), FBRPOSFee FROM SaleLedger '
END
IF @SaleType = 2
BEGIN
	SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@PARENTSRV)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.IMP_AdvSaleLedger '
	SET @SQL = N' SELECT ServerName=' + '''' + @SRV + ''', TransDate=GETDATE(), InvType = 2, * FROM AdvSaleLedger '
END
IF @SaleType = 3
BEGIN
	SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@PARENTSRV)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.IMP_SRLedger '
	SET @SQL = N' SELECT ServerName=' + '''' + @SRV + ''', TransDate=GETDATE(), InvType = 3, SRInvCode,SaleInvCode,Date,SRCatCode,CustCode,SalesmanCode,DiscPerc,FlatDisc,MiscCharges,Posted,PostDate,Remarks,SalesTax,OriginalDate,ModifiedBy,PostedBy,HeaderNo,InvGSTPerc1,Smancode,CustRefno,CustRefno2,CustRefno3,CustRefno4,PatientCode,MachineName,HeaderInvNo,AdmissionCode,invtotal,AccountFor,PaymentMode,PaymentAccCode,Amt,AmtBY,AmtDate,AmtReference,OutstandingAmt,Marked,PageSize,ReprintingCounter,DoctCode,ConsiderInPO,CashAccCode,CashTendered,CashCharged,CashBack,RetViaBillSummary,CRS_Transfered,CRS_TransferedOn,GuestCode,GuestCheckInCode,StudentCode,Synced,SyncedOn,SyncedBy,CurrencyCode,ConversionRate,Fiscalized,FiscalizedOn,FiscalInvoiceNo,Transmit,Transmited,AdvanceTax,AdvanceTaxAmt,FBRPOSFee FROM SRLedger '
END

IF @CustCode IS NULL
BEGIN
	SET @WHR = N' WHERE Transmit = ' + CHAR(39) + 'Y' + CHAR(39) + ' AND Transmited = ' + CHAR(39) + 'N' + CHAR(39) + ' AND DATE BETWEEN ' + CHAR(39) + @stdate+ CHAR(39) + ' AND ' + CHAR(39) + @edate + CHAR(39)
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SET @WHR = N' WHERE CustCode = ' + (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@CustCode, 8)))) + ' AND Transmit = ' + CHAR(39) + 'Y' + CHAR(39) + ' AND Transmited = ' + CHAR(39) + 'N' + CHAR(39) + ' AND DATE BETWEEN ' + CHAR(39) + @stdate+ CHAR(39) + ' AND ' + CHAR(39) + @edate + CHAR(39)
END
SET @WHR_Cln = @WHR
SET @Query = @INS + @SQL + @WHR
EXECUTE (@Query)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Transmit Sales Data Problem: Error Transfering Sales Data From Server (%s) TO Server (%s) ', 16, 1, @SRV, @PARENTSRV)
	RETURN -1
END 
ELSE
BEGIN
	IF @SaleType = 1
	BEGIN
		SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@PARENTSRV)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.IMP_SaleDetail '
		SET @SQL = N'SELECT ServerName=' + '''' + @SRV + ''', SaleInvcode, ICode, GCode, Batch, Expiry, PackQty, LooseQty, PackUnits, SalePrice, AvgPrice, Rate, DiscPerc, SalesTax, RowID, Due, SatisfiedDate, itemflatdisc, SaleItemDescription, PackPrice, UnitSalesTax, GSTPerc, SaleUtn, bonusqty, claimable, balancestock, RowGroup, ClaimableDiscPerc, ManfDate, PackQtyForSale, BonusPackQtyForSale, SaleOrderRowID, DescICode, SourceSaleInvCode=SaleInvCode, SaleRowID=NULL, IssueRowID=NULL, PurUnitRate, RPPUnitRate, TotalPieces, PiecesInHand, PackSalePrice, RefusalSaleRowID=NULL, AlternatePurPrice, CommissionPerUnit, CommissionPerc, AlternateCustomICode, BatchCost, ISNULL(ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,0) FROM SaleDetail WHERE SaleInvCode IN (SELECT SaleInvCode FROM SaleLedger '
	END
	IF @SaleType = 2
	BEGIN
		SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@PARENTSRV)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.IMP_AdvSaleDetail '
		SET @SQL = N'SELECT ServerName=' + '''' + @SRV + ''', * FROM AdvSaleDetail WHERE AdvSaleInvCode IN (SELECT AdvSaleInvCode FROM AdvSaleLedger '
	END
	IF @SaleType = 3
	BEGIN
		SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@PARENTSRV)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.IMP_SRDetail (ChildServer,SRInvcode,Icode,Gcode,Batch,Expiry,PackQty,LooseQty,PackUnits,SRPrice,DiscPerc,SalesTax,AvgPrice,UnitSalesTax,GSTPerc,SRUtn,BonusQty,SalePrice,SaleRowId,ReturnItemDescription,TotalPieces,PiecesInHand,AlternatePurPrice,CommissionPerUnit,CommissionPerc,AlternateCustomICode,NewAvgPrice,Claimable,ClaimableDiscPerc,ItemAdvanceTaxPerc) '
		SET @SQL = N'SELECT ServerName=' + '''' + @SRV + ''',SRInvcode,Icode,Gcode,Batch,Expiry,PackQty,LooseQty,PackUnits,SRPrice,DiscPerc,SalesTax,AvgPrice,UnitSalesTax,GSTPerc,SRUtn,BonusQty,SalePrice,SaleRowId,ReturnItemDescription=LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SRUTN))),TotalPieces,PiecesInHand,AlternatePurPrice,CommissionPerUnit,CommissionPerc,AlternateCustomICode,NewAvgPrice,Claimable,ClaimableDiscPerc,ISNULL(ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,0) FROM SRDetail WHERE SRInvCode IN (SELECT SRInvCode FROM SRLedger '
	END

	IF @CustCode IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SET @WHR = N' WHERE Transmit = ' + CHAR(39) + 'Y' + CHAR(39) + ' AND Transmited = ' + CHAR(39) + 'N' + CHAR(39) + ' AND DATE BETWEEN ' + CHAR(39) + @stdate+ CHAR(39) + ' AND ' + CHAR(39) + @edate + CHAR(39) + ')'
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @WHR = N' WHERE CustCode = ' + (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@CustCode, 8)))) + ' AND Transmit = ' + CHAR(39) + 'Y' + CHAR(39) + ' AND Transmited = ' + CHAR(39) + 'N' + CHAR(39) + ' AND DATE BETWEEN ' + CHAR(39) + @stdate+ CHAR(39) + ' AND ' + CHAR(39) + @edate + CHAR(39) + ')'
	END
	SET @Query = @INS + @SQL + @WHR
	EXECUTE (@Query)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Transmit Sales Data Detail Problem: Error Transfering Sales Data Detail From Server (%s) TO Server (%s) ', 16, 1, @SRV, @PARENTSRV)
		RETURN -1
	END 
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF @SaleType = 1
		BEGIN
			SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@PARENTSRV)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.IMP_CashierWindow SELECT ChildServer=' + CHAR(39) + @SRV + CHAR(39) + ', CW.* FROM CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode IN (SELECT SaleInvCode FROM SaleLedger '
		END
		IF @SaleType = 3
		BEGIN
			SET @INS = N'INSERT INTO ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@PARENTSRV)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.IMP_MasterCashWin SELECT ChildServer=' + CHAR(39) + @SRV + CHAR(39) + ', CW.* FROM MasterCashWin CW WHERE CW.DocumentType = ' + CHAR(39) + 'SR' + CHAR(39) + ' AND DocumentCode IN (SELECT SRInvCode FROM SRLedger '
		END
		SET @Query = @INS + @WHR
		EXECUTE (@Query)
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Transmit Sales Data Problem: Error Updating Master Cashier Window Related Data (%d)', 16, 1, @SaleType)
			RETURN -1
		END 

		IF @SaleType = 1
		BEGIN
			SET @Query = 'UPDATE SaleLedger SET Transmited = ' + CHAR(39) + 'Y' + CHAR(39) + @WHR_Cln
		END
		IF @SaleType = 2
		BEGIN
			SET @Query = 'UPDATE AdvSaleLedger SET Transmited = ' + CHAR(39) + 'Y' + CHAR(39) + @WHR_Cln
		END
		IF @SaleType = 3
		BEGIN
			SET @Query = 'UPDATE SRLedger SET Transmited = ' + CHAR(39) + 'Y' + CHAR(39) + @WHR_Cln
		END
		
		EXECUTE (@Query)
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Transmit Sales Data Problem: Error Updating Sales Regarding Transmit Status', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END
END

SET @dt = GETDATE()
Execute @rt_code = SP_Set_DateTime_Preference 'LastSaleTransmited', @dt
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0 
Begin
	RaisError( 'Unable to Record Last Sale Transmit Information in Software Preferences' , 16 , 1)
	RETURN -1								
End

RETURN 0

CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_Update_ItemHistoricalCost_In_Sale_And_Return @DBName VARCHAR(255)
AS
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

DECLARE @Qry NVARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @err INT, @rt_code INT

SET @Qry = N'UPDATE ' + @DBName + '.DBO.SaleDetail SET AvgPrice = ISNULL((SELECT DBO.Fn_GetItemCostHistory(D.ICode, S.Date)), AvgPrice) FROM ' + @DBName + '.DBO.SaleLedger S, ' + @DBName + '.DBO.SaleDetail D WHERE S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode '
EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Updation of Historical Cost in Sales Data Failed.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

SET @Qry = N'UPDATE ' + @DBName + '.DBO.SRDetail SET AvgPrice = ISNULL((SELECT DBO.Fn_GetItemCostHistory(D.ICode, S.Date)), AvgPrice) FROM ' + @DBName + '.DBO.SRLedger S, ' + @DBName + '.DBO.SRDetail D WHERE S.SRInvCode = D.SRInvCode '
EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Updation of Historical Cost in Sales Return Data Failed.', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 
RETURN 0

-- SP_Update_Supplier_Item_Info
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_Update_Supplier_Item_Info 
	@SuppCode SMALLINT, 
	@ICode INT, 
	@Rate NUMERIC(15,2), 
	@DiscPerc NUMERIC(6,2), 
	@SaleQty INT, 
	@BonusQty INT, 
	@Days INT
AS
DECLARE @rowcount INT, @err INT
SET @rowcount = ISNULL((SELECT c=Count(*) FROM ItemSuppliers WHERE SuppCode = @SuppCode AND ICode = @ICode), 0)
IF @rowcount = 0
	INSERT INTO ItemSuppliers (ICode, SuppCode, Priority, Rate, DiscPerc, SaleQty, BonusQty, Days)
	SELECT  @ICode, @SuppCode, 
		Priority=ISNULL((SELECT MAX(Priority) FROM ItemSuppliers WHERE ICode = @ICode), 0) + 1,
		@Rate, @DiscPerc, @SaleQty, @BonusQty, @Days
ELSE
	UPDATE ItemSuppliers 
	SET	ICode = @ICode, 
		SuppCode=@SuppCode, 
		Rate=@Rate, DiscPerc=@DiscPerc, SaleQty=@SaleQty, BonusQty=@BonusQty, Days=@Days
	WHERE SuppCode = @SuppCode AND ICode = @ICode

CREATE TABLE #temp (SuppCode SMALLINT, ICode INT, Rate NUMERIC(15,2), ROWID INT IDENTITY(1,1))

INSERT INTO #temp (SuppCode, ICode)
SELECT SuppCode, ICode
FROM ItemSuppliers
WHERE ICode = @ICode
ORDER BY Rate ASC

UPDATE ItemSuppliers
SET Priority = (SELECT T.RowID FROM #temp T WHERE T.ICode = ItemSuppliers.ICode AND T.SuppCode = ItemSuppliers.SuppCode)
WHERE ICode = @Icode

-- SP_UPDATE_TOTAL_CrossTab_ReportData
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_UPDATE_TOTAL_CrossTab_ReportData
AS
/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To update the crosstab totals fields 'totqty' and 'totval'.
*/

UPDATE CrossTab_ReportData 
SET TOTQTY = T.TotQty,
	TOTVAL = T.TotVAL
FROM CrossTab_ReportData C, 
	(SELECT 
		CODE1,
		TOTQTY=SUM(ISNULL(QTY1,0) + ISNULL(QTY2,0) + ISNULL(QTY3,0) +
		ISNULL(QTY4,0) + ISNULL(QTY5,0) + ISNULL(QTY6,0) + ISNULL(QTY7,0) +
		ISNULL(QTY8,0) + ISNULL(QTY9,0) + ISNULL(QTY10,0) + ISNULL(QTY11,0) +
		ISNULL(QTY12,0) + ISNULL(QTY13,0)),
		TOTVAL = SUM(ISNULL(VAL1,0) + ISNULL(VAL2,0) + ISNULL(VAL3,0) + ISNULL(VAL4,0) +
		ISNULL(VAL5,0) + ISNULL(VAL6,0) + ISNULL(VAL7,0) + ISNULL(VAL8,0) +
		ISNULL(VAL9,0) + ISNULL(VAL10,0) + ISNULL(VAL11,0) + ISNULL(VAL12,0) +
		ISNULL(VAL13,0))
	FROM 
		CrossTab_ReportData 
	GROUP BY CODE1) T
WHERE C.CODE1 = T.CODE1

-- SP_UpdateActivityMonitor
CREATE    PROCEDURE SP_UpdateActivityMonitor @DocumentType CHAR(2), @DocumentCode INT
AS

DECLARE @rowsaffected INTEGER
DECLARE @err INTEGER

IF @DocumentType IS NULL OR @DocumentCode IS NULL
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Error Calling Activity Monitor' , 16 , 1)
	Return -1
END

IF @DocumentType <> 'SV' 
BEGIN
	DELETE DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	WHERE DocumentType = @DocumentType AND 
		DocumentCode = @DocumentCode
END

IF @DocumentType = 'SV' -- Sales 
BEGIN
	DELETE DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	WHERE DocumentCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		DocumentType IN ('ST','SC')

	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=CASE WHEN SaleCatCode <= 2 THEN 'ST' ELSE 'SC' END, DocCatCode=SaleCatCode, 
		Category = CASE WHEN SaleCatCode <= 2 THEN 'Credit Sale' ELSE 'Cash Sale' END,
		Date=Date, PartyType='C', PartyCode=CustCode, UserCode=SalesManCode, 
		Amount = ISNULL(InvTotal, 0), Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName, HeaderNo, ISNULL(HeaderInvNo, @DocumentCode)
	FROM SaleLedger
	WHERE SaleInvCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		SaleInvCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=CASE WHEN SaleCatCode <= 2 THEN 'ST' ELSE 'SC' END AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for Sale Invoice No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'SR' -- Sales Returns
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=SRCatCode, 
		Category = CASE WHEN SRCatCode <= 7 THEN 'Credit S/Return' ELSE 'Cash S/Return' END,
		Date=Date, PartyType='C', PartyCode=CustCode, UserCode=SalesManCode, 
		Amount = InvTotal, Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName, HeaderNo, ISNULL(HeaderInvNo, @DocumentCode)
	FROM SRLedger
	WHERE SRInvCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		SRInvCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for Sale Return No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'PV' -- Purchases
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=PurCatCode, 
		Category = CASE WHEN PurCatCode <= 2 THEN 'Pack Purchase' WHEN PurCatCode = 3 THEN 'Open Purchase' ELSE 'Loose Purchase' END,
		Date=Date, PartyType='S', PartyCode=SuppCode, UserCode=SalesManCode, 
		Amount = InvTotal, Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName=NULL, 
		HeaderNo, ISNULL(HeaderInvNo, @DocumentCode)
	FROM PurLedger
	WHERE PurInvCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		PurInvCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for Purchase Invoice No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'PR' -- Purchase Return
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=PRCatCode, 
		Category = 'Purchase Return',
		Date=Date, PartyType='S', PartyCode=SuppCode, UserCode=SalesManCode, 
		Amount = InvTotal, Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName=NULL, 
		HeaderNo, ISNULL(HeaderInvNo, @DocumentCode)
	FROM PRLedger
	WHERE PRInvCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		PRInvCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for Purchase Return Invoice No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'SO' -- Sales Order
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=1, 
		Category = 'Sale Order', Date=Date, PartyType='C', PartyCode=CustCode, 
		UserCode=UserCode, Amount = InvTotal, Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', 
		MachineName, HeaderNo, ISNULL(HeaderInvNo, @DocumentCode)
	FROM SaleOrderHeader
	WHERE SaleOrderCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		SaleOrderCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for Sale Order No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'IV' -- Issues
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=ISNULL(IssueTypeCode, 1), 
		Category = ISNULL((SELECT IssueType.Name FROM IssueType WHERE IssueType.IssueTypeCode = IssueHeader.IssueTypeCode), 'Issue'), 
		Date=Date, PartyType=CASE RecipientCode WHEN 1 THEN 'D' WHEN 2 THEN 'C' WHEN 3 THEN 'S' WHEN 4 THEN 'P' ELSE 'A' END, 
		PartyCode=CASE RecipientCode WHEN 1 THEN DeptCode WHEN 2 THEN AccCode WHEN 3 THEN AccCode WHEN 4 THEN RecipientSalesman ELSE AccCode END, 
		UserCode=SalesManCode, 
		Amount = ROUND((SELECT SUM(D.Qty * D.Price) 
			FROM IssueDetail D 
			WHERE D.IssueInvCode = IssueHeader.IssueInvCode), 0), 
		Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName=NULL, HeaderNo, ISNULL(HeaderInvNo, @DocumentCode)
	FROM IssueHeader
	WHERE IssueInvCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		IssueInvCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for Issue Invoice No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'RC' -- Receipts
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=1, 
		Category = 'Receipt', 
		Date=Date, PartyType=CASE RecipientCode WHEN 1 THEN 'D' WHEN 2 THEN 'C' WHEN 3 THEN 'S' WHEN 4 THEN 'P' ELSE 'A' END, 
		PartyCode=CASE RecipientCode WHEN 1 THEN DeptCode WHEN 2 THEN AccCode WHEN 3 THEN AccCode WHEN 4 THEN RecipientSalesman ELSE AccCode END, 
		UserCode=SalesManCode, 
		Amount = ROUND((SELECT SUM(D.Qty * D.Price) 
			FROM ReceiptDetail D 
			WHERE D.ReceiptInvCode = ReceiptHeader.ReceiptInvCode), 0), 
		Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName=NULL, HeaderNo, ISNULL(HeaderInvNo, @DocumentCode)
	FROM ReceiptHeader
	WHERE ReceiptInvCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		ReceiptInvCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for Receipt Invoice No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'AI' -- Adjustment Increase
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=AdjCatCode, 
		Category = 'Adj. Increase', Date=Date, PartyType='O', PartyCode=AdjCatCode, UserCode=UserCode, 
		Amount = ROUND((SELECT SUM(D.LooseQty * D.Price) 
			FROM AdjDetail D 
			WHERE D.AdjCode = AdjHeader.AdjCode), 0), 
		Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName=NULL, HeaderNo, ISNULL(HeaderInvNo, @DocumentCode)
	FROM AdjHeader
	WHERE AdjCode = @DocumentCode AND AdjCatCode = 1 AND
		AdjCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for Stock Adjustment Increase No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'AD' -- Adjustment Decrease
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=AdjCatCode, 
		Category = 'Adj. Decrease', Date=Date, PartyType='O', PartyCode=AdjCatCode, UserCode=UserCode, 
		Amount = ROUND((SELECT SUM(D.LooseQty * D.Price) 
			FROM AdjDetail D 
			WHERE D.AdjCode = AdjHeader.AdjCode), 0), 
		Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName=NULL, HeaderNo, ISNULL(HeaderInvNo, @DocumentCode)
	FROM AdjHeader
	WHERE AdjCode = @DocumentCode AND AdjCatCode = 2 AND
		AdjCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for Stock Adjustment Decrease No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'QU' -- Quotation
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=1, 
		Category = 'Quotation',
		Date=Date, PartyType='C', PartyCode=CustCode, UserCode=SalesManCode, 
		Amount = ROUND((SELECT SUM(D.Qty * D.SalePrice) 
			FROM QuotationDetail D 
			WHERE D.QuotationCode = QuotationHeader.QuotationCode), 0), 
		Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName=NULL, HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo=@DocumentCode
	FROM QuotationHeader
	WHERE QuotationCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		QuotationCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for Quotation No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'PO' -- Purchase Order
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=PurOrderCatCode, 
		Category = 'Purchase Order', Date=Date, PartyType='S', PartyCode=SuppCode, UserCode=SalesManCode, 
		Amount = ROUND((SELECT SUM(D.Qty * D.Rate * (1 - D.Discperc)) FROM PurOrderDetail D WHERE D.POCode = PurOrderHeader.POCode), 0), 
		Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName=NULL, 
		HeaderNo=1, HeaderInvNo=@DocumentCode
	FROM PurOrderHeader
	WHERE POCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		POCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for Purchase Order No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'GT' -- Inter-Godown Transfers
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=TTCode, 
		Category = 'Inter Godown Transfer', Date=Date, PartyType='G', PartyCode=SGCode, 
		UserCode=SalesManCode, 
		Amount = ROUND((SELECT SUM(D.Qty * (D.SalePrice / CASE WHEN D.PackUnits < 1 THEN 1 ELSE D.PackUnits END)) FROM TDetail D WHERE D.TransCode = THeader.TransCode), 0), 
		Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName=NULL, 
		HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo=@DocumentCode
	FROM THeader
	WHERE TransCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		TransCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for Inter Godown Transfer No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'VV' -- A/c Vouchers
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=VochCatCode, 
		Category = (SELECT VC.Name FROM VocherCategory VC WHERE VC.VochCatCode = GLHeader.VochCatCode), 
		Date=Date, PartyType='A', PartyCode=AccCode, 
		UserCode=SalesManCode, 
		Amount = ROUND((SELECT SUM(D.DEBIT) FROM GLDetail D WHERE D.GLVochCode = GLHeader.GLVochCode), 0), 
		Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName=NULL, 
		HeaderNo=VochCatCode, HeaderInvNo=VoucherCode
	FROM GLHeader
	WHERE GLVochCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		GLVochCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for GL Voucher Code = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'NN' -- Notes Receivables and Payables
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=NoteCatCode, 
		Category = (SELECT NC.Name FROM NotesCategory NC WHERE NC.NoteCatCode = Notes.NoteCatCode), 
		Date=IssueDate, PartyType='A', PartyCode=AccCode, 
		UserCode=SalesManCode, 
		Amount = Amount, 
		Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName=NULL, 
		HeaderNo=NoteCatCode, HeaderInvNo=VoucherCode
	FROM Notes
	WHERE NoteCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		NoteCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR

IF @DocumentType = 'RS' -- Service Sales

	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=ServiceCatCode, 
		Category = CASE WHEN ServiceCatCode = 11 THEN 'Credit Service' ELSE 'Cash Service' END,
		Date=Date, PartyType='C', PartyCode=CustCode, UserCode=SalesManCode, 
		Amount = ROUND(ISNULL(
			(SELECT 
				SUM(D.Qty * (ISNULL(D.Price - D.ServiceFlatDisc, 0)) * (1 - (0.01 * ISNULL(D.DiscPerc, 0) ))) * 
				(1 - (0.01 * ISNULL(ServiceHeader.DiscPerc, 0))) + 
				ISNULL(ServiceHeader.misccharges, 0) - 
				ISNULL(ServiceHeader.flatdisc, 0)
			FROM ServiceDetail D 
			WHERE D.ServiceInvCode = @DocumentCode), 0),0), 
		Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName=NULL, HeaderNo, @DocumentCode
	FROM ServiceHeader
	WHERE ServiceInvCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		ServiceInvCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for Service Sale Invoice No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'RR' -- Service Sales Returns
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=ServiceRCatCode, 
		Category = CASE WHEN ServiceRCatCode = 14 THEN 'Credit Service Return' ELSE 'Cash Service Return' END,
		Date=Date, PartyType='C', PartyCode=CustCode, UserCode=SalesManCode, 
		Amount = ROUND(ISNULL(
			(SELECT 
				SUM(D.Qty * (ISNULL(D.ServicePrice - D.ServiceFlatDisc, 0)) * (1 - (0.01 * ISNULL(D.DiscPerc, 0) ))) * 
				(1 - (0.01 * ISNULL(ServiceRHeader.DiscPerc, 0))) + 
				ISNULL(ServiceRHeader.misccharges, 0) - 
				ISNULL(ServiceRHeader.flatdisc, 0)
			FROM ServiceRDetail D 
			WHERE D.ServiceRInvCode = @DocumentCode), 0), 0),
		Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName=NULL, HeaderNo, @DocumentCode
	FROM ServiceRHeader
	WHERE ServiceRInvCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		ServiceRInvCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for Service Sale Return Invoice No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'VO' -- Service Order
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=1, 
		Category = CASE WHEN AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN 'Service Order' ELSE 'In-Patient Service Order' END,
		Date=Date, PartyType='C', PartyCode=CustCode, UserCode=SalesManCode, 
		Amount = ISNULL(
			(SELECT 
				SUM(D.Qty * (ISNULL(D.Price - D.ServiceFlatDisc, 0)) * (1 - (0.01 * ISNULL(D.DiscPerc, 0) ))) * 
				(1 - (0.01 * ISNULL(ServiceOHeader.DiscPerc, 0))) + 
				ISNULL(ServiceOHeader.misccharges, 0) - 
				ISNULL(ServiceOHeader.flatdisc, 0)
			FROM ServiceODetail D 
			WHERE D.ServiceOCode = @DocumentCode), 0), 
		Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName=NULL, HeaderNo, @DocumentCode
	FROM ServiceOHeader
	WHERE ServiceOCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		ServiceOCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for Service Order No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'SP' -- Purcahse Of Services
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=1, 
		Category = 'Purchase Of Service',
		Date=Date, PartyType='S', PartyCode=SuppCode, UserCode=UserCode, 
		Amount = ROUND(ISNULL(
			(SELECT 
				SUM(D.Qty * (ISNULL(D.Price - D.ServiceFlatDisc, 0)) * (1 - (0.01 * ISNULL(D.DiscPerc, 0) ))) * 
				(1 - (0.01 * ISNULL(ServicePurHeader.DiscPerc, 0))) + 
				ISNULL(ServicePurHeader.misccharges, 0) - 
				ISNULL(ServicePurHeader.flatdisc, 0)
			FROM ServicePurDetail D 
			WHERE D.ServicePurInvCode = @DocumentCode), 0), 0),
		Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName=NULL, HeaderNo, @DocumentCode
	FROM ServicePurHeader
	WHERE ServicePurInvCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		ServicePurInvCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for Purchase Of Service No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'RP' -- Purcahse RETURN Of Services
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=1, 
		Category = 'P/R Of Service',
		Date=Date, PartyType='S', PartyCode=SuppCode, UserCode=UserCode, 
		Amount = ROUND(ISNULL(
			(SELECT 
				SUM(D.Qty * (ISNULL(D.Price - D.ServiceFlatDisc, 0)) * (1 - (0.01 * ISNULL(D.DiscPerc, 0) ))) * 
				(1 - (0.01 * ISNULL(ServicePrHeader.DiscPerc, 0))) + 
				ISNULL(ServicePrHeader.misccharges, 0) - 
				ISNULL(ServicePrHeader.flatdisc, 0)
			FROM ServicePrDetail D 
			WHERE D.ServicePrInvCode = @DocumentCode), 0), 0),
		Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName=NULL, HeaderNo, @DocumentCode
	FROM ServicePrHeader
	WHERE ServicePrInvCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		ServicePrInvCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for P/R Of Service No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @DocumentType = 'PD' -- Production
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO DBO.ActivityMonitor 
	SELECT DocumentCode=@DocumentCode, DocumentType=@DocumentType, DocCatCode=1, 
		Category = 'Production',
		Date=Date, PartyType='G', PartyCode=ReceiptGCode, UserCode=CASE WHEN ModifiedBy IS NULL THEN CreatedBy ELSE ModifiedBy END, 
		Amount = ROUND(ISNULL(
			(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(D.Qty * I.SalePrice), 0)
			FROM ProdDetail D, Item I
			WHERE D.ProdCode = @DocumentCode AND D.ICode = I.ICode), 0), 0),
		Remarks = Remarks, Printed='N', MachineName=NULL, HeaderNo=1, @DocumentCode
	FROM ProdHeader
	WHERE ProdCode = @DocumentCode AND 
		ProdCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
			FROM ActivityMonitor 
			WHERE DocumentType=@DocumentType AND DocumentCode = @DocumentCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Activity Monitor for Production No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocumentCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

RETURN 0

-- SP_UpdateBasicData
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_UpdateBasicData] @SRV VARCHAR(50), @DB VARCHAR(50), @OWNER VARCHAR(20) AS

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

DECLARE @UPD NVARCHAR(1000), @SQL NVARCHAR(1000), @QRY NVARCHAR(4000), @SETPART NVARCHAR(4000), @ColName VARCHAR(255)
DECLARE @ENDD NVARCHAR(50), @TableName NVARCHAR(50), @PKCOND NVARCHAR(1000), @full_table_name NVARCHAR(255)
DECLARE @Priority SMALLINT, @KeySeq SMALLINT, @Position SMALLINT
DECLARE @table_id INT, @err INT, @rt_code INT

SET @UPD = N'UPDATE '
SET @SETPART = N'SET '
SET @SQL = N' FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.'
SET @ENDD = N' AS T WHERE '

DECLARE Upd1 CURSOR FOR
SELECT TABLENAME=LTRIM(RTRIM(TABLENAME)), PRIORITY 
FROM TransferableData 
WHERE Enable='Y' AND AutoUpdate = 'Y'
ORDER BY Priority

OPEN Upd1

FETCH NEXT FROM Upd1 INTO @TableName, @Priority
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @PKCOND = N''
	SET @SETPART = N'SET '
	SET @full_table_name = LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.' + @TableName
	SET @table_id = OBJECT_ID(@full_table_name)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0 OR @table_id IS NULL
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Data Updation: Invalid Object Refered: Name = %s', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
		CLOSE Upd1
		DEALLOCATE Upd1
		RETURN -1
	END 

	DECLARE Upd2 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT 	COLNAME = CONVERT(sysname,c.name),
		KEYSEQ =
			CASE
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  1) then convert (smallint,1)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  2) then convert (smallint,2)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  3) then convert (smallint,3)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  4) then convert (smallint,4)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  5) then convert (smallint,5)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  6) then convert (smallint,6)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  7) then convert (smallint,7)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  8) then convert (smallint,8)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid,  9) then convert (smallint,9)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 10) then convert (smallint,10)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 11) then convert (smallint,11)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 12) then convert (smallint,12)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 13) then convert (smallint,13)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 14) then convert (smallint,14)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 15) then convert (smallint,15)
				when c.name = index_col(@full_table_name, i.indid, 16) then convert (smallint,16)
			end
	from
		sysindexes i, syscolumns c, sysobjects o
	where
		o.id = @table_id
		and o.id = c.id
		and o.id = i.id
		and (i.status & 0x800) = 0x800
		and (c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  1) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  2) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  3) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  4) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  5) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  6) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  7) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  8) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid,  9) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 10) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 11) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 12) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 13) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 14) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 15) or
		     c.name = index_col (@full_table_name, i.indid, 16)
		    )
	order by 2

	OPEN Upd2
	
	FETCH NEXT FROM Upd2 INTO @ColName, @KeySeq
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		IF @KeySeq <> 1
		BEGIN
			SET @PKCOND = @PKCOND + ' AND '
		END

		SET @PKCOND = @PKCOND + ' T.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + ' = ' + @TableName + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName))

		FETCH NEXT FROM Upd2 INTO @ColName, @KeySeq
	END
	CLOSE Upd2
	DEALLOCATE Upd2	

	DECLARE Upd3 CURSOR FOR
	SELECT
		COLUMNNAME = convert(sysname,c.name),
		POSITION = convert(int,
				   (
					select count(*)
					from syscolumns sc
					where sc.id     =  c.id
					  AND sc.number =  c.number
					  AND sc.colid  <= c.colid
				    ))
	FROM
		sysobjects o,
		syscolumns c
	WHERE
		o.id = @table_id AND c.id = o.id
	ORDER BY 2

	OPEN Upd3

	FETCH NEXT FROM Upd3 INTO @ColName, @Position
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN

		IF ColumnProperty (@table_id, @ColName, 'IsIdentity') <> 1
		BEGIN
			IF @ColName = (SELECT columnname FROM TransferableData_RestrictedColumns WHERE columnname = @ColName and tablename = @TableName)
			BEGIN
				SET @ColName = @ColName
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF @SETPART <> 'SET '
				BEGIN
					SET @SETPART = @SETPART + ','
				END
--				SET @SETPART = @SETPART + @TableName + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + '=' + 'T.' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName))
				IF LOWER(@TableName) = 'item'
				BEGIN
					IF lower(@ColName) = 'changereason' OR lower(@ColName) = 'module'
						SET @SETPART = @SETPART + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + '=' + '''Data Transfer'''
					ELSE
						SET @SETPART = @SETPART + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + '=' + 'T.' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName))
				END
				ELSE
					SET @SETPART = @SETPART + LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName)) + '=' + 'T.' +  LTRIM(RTRIM(@ColName))
			END
		END
		
		FETCH NEXT FROM Upd3 INTO @ColName, @Position
	END
	CLOSE Upd3
	DEALLOCATE Upd3

	IF @SETPART <> 'SET '
	BEGIN
		IF LOWER(@TableName) = 'item'
		BEGIN
			SET @QRY = 'SELECT * INTO #TempItem ' + @SQL + LOWER(@TableName) + '         '
			SET @QRY = @QRY + @UPD + @TableName + ' ' + @SETPART + ' FROM #TempItem ' + @ENDD + ' ' + @PKCOND
		END
		ELSE
			SET @QRY = @UPD + @TableName + ' ' + @SETPART + ' ' + @SQL + @TableName + @ENDD + ' ' + @PKCOND

--		PRINT @QRY
		EXECUTE (@QRY)
		SET @err = @@ERROR
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Data Updation: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
			CLOSE Upd1
			DEALLOCATE Upd1
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END
	IF LOWER(@TableName) = 'item'
	BEGIN
		Execute @err = SP_UpdateItems_CategoryWise @SRV, @DB, @OWNER
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Data Updation: Item Category Wise Updation Error', 16, 1)
			CLOSE Upd1
			DEALLOCATE Upd1
			RETURN -1
		END 
	END

	FETCH NEXT FROM Upd1 INTO @TableName, @Priority
END
CLOSE Upd1
DEALLOCATE Upd1

RETURN 0

-- SP_UpdateCashierActivity
CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_UpdateCashierActivity @ModuleID SMALLINT, @DocCode INT
AS

DECLARE @rowsaffected INTEGER
DECLARE @err INTEGER
DECLARE @AutoFillCashCharged CHAR(1)

SET @AutoFillCashCharged = DBO.Fn_GetPreference('AutoFillCashCharged')

IF @ModuleID IS NULL OR @DocCode IS NULL
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Error Calling Cashier Activity Monitor' , 16 , 1)
	Return -1
END

IF @ModuleID = 1 -- Sales 
BEGIN
	DELETE DBO.CashierActivity WHERE ModuleID IN (10,11) AND DocCode = @DocCode

	INSERT INTO DBO.CashierActivity
	SELECT Date=Date, ModuleID = CASE WHEN SaleCatCode <= 2 THEN 11 ELSE 10 END, 
		DocCode=@DocCode, CatCode= CASE WHEN SaleCatCode <= 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, 
		Category = CASE WHEN SaleCatCode <= 2 THEN 'Credit Sale' ELSE 'Cash Sale' END,
		AccCode=CustCode, UserCode=SalesManCode, MachineName, 
		HeaderNo, ISNULL(HeaderInvNo, @DocCode),
		Amount = ISNULL(InvTotal, 0), CashAccCode=CashAccCode,
		CashTendered=CashTendered, 
		CashCharged= CASE WHEN SaleCatCode <= 2 THEN CashCharged ELSE CASE WHEN CashCharged > 0 THEN CashCharged ELSE CASE WHEN @AutoFillCashCharged = 'N' THEN CashCharged ELSE ISNULL(InvTotal, 0) END END END, 
		CashBack= CASE WHEN SaleCatCode <= 2 THEN CashBack ELSE CASE WHEN CashCharged > 0 THEN CashBack ELSE CASE WHEN @AutoFillCashCharged = 'N' THEN CashBack ELSE 0.00 END END END,
		Remarks = Remarks, CashierJobCode=NULL, Printed='N', Supervised='N', SupervisedOn=NULL, GLVochCode=NULL
	FROM SaleLedger
	WHERE SaleInvCode = @DocCode AND 
		SaleInvCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocCode 
			FROM CashierActivity 
			WHERE ModuleID IN (10,11) AND DocCode = @DocCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Cashier Activity for Sale Invoice No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @ModuleID = 2 -- Sales Returns
BEGIN
	DELETE DBO.CashierActivity WHERE ModuleID IN (31,32) AND DocCode = @DocCode

	INSERT INTO DBO.CashierActivity
	SELECT Date=Date, ModuleID = CASE WHEN SRCatCode <= 7 THEN 32 ELSE 31 END, 
		DocCode=@DocCode, 
		CatCode=CASE WHEN SRCatCode <= 7 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, 
		Category = CASE WHEN SRCatCode <= 7 THEN 'Credit S/Return' ELSE 'Cash S/Return' END,
		AccCode=CustCode, UserCode=SalesManCode, MachineName, 
		HeaderNo, ISNULL(HeaderInvNo, @DocCode),
		Amount = ISNULL(InvTotal, 0), CashAccCode=CashAccCode,
		CashTendered=CashTendered, CashCharged=CashCharged, CashBack=CashBack,
		Remarks = Remarks, CashierJobCode=NULL, Printed='N', Supervised='N', SupervisedOn=NULL, GLVochCode=NULL
	FROM SRLedger
	WHERE SRInvCode = @DocCode AND 
		SRInvCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocCode 
			FROM CashierActivity 
			WHERE ModuleID IN (31,32)  AND DocCode = @DocCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Cashier Activity for Sale Return No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF @ModuleID = 22 OR @ModuleID = 23 -- Service Sales 
BEGIN
	DELETE DBO.CashierActivity WHERE ModuleID IN (22,23) AND DocCode = @DocCode

	INSERT INTO DBO.CashierActivity
	SELECT Date=Date, ModuleID = CASE WHEN ServiceCatCode = 15 THEN 23 ELSE 22 END,
		DocCode=@DocCode, CatCode= CASE WHEN ServiceCatCode = 15 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, 
		Category = CASE WHEN ServiceCatCode = 15 THEN 'Credit Service' ELSE 'Cash Service' END,
		AccCode=CustCode, UserCode=SalesManCode, MachineName=NULL, 
		HeaderNo, HeaderInvNo=ServiceInvCode, 
		Amount = ISNULL(InvTotal, 0), CashAccCode=CashAccCode,
		CashTendered=CashTendered, 
		CashCharged= CASE WHEN ServiceCatCode = 15 THEN CashCharged ELSE CASE WHEN CashCharged > 0 THEN CashCharged ELSE CASE WHEN @AutoFillCashCharged = 'N' THEN CashCharged ELSE ISNULL(InvTotal, 0) END END END, 
		CashBack= CASE WHEN ServiceCatCode = 15 THEN CashBack ELSE CASE WHEN CashCharged > 0 THEN CashBack ELSE CASE WHEN @AutoFillCashCharged = 'N' THEN CashBack ELSE 0.00 END END END,
		Remarks = Remarks, CashierJobCode=NULL, Printed='N', Supervised='N', SupervisedOn=NULL, GLVochCode=NULL
	FROM ServiceHeader 
	WHERE ServiceInvCode = @DocCode AND 
		ServiceInvCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT DocCode 
			FROM CashierActivity 
			WHERE ModuleID IN (22,23) AND DocCode = @DocCode)

	SELECT @rowsaffected = @@ROWCOUNT, @err = @@ERROR
	IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unable to Update Cashier Activity for Service Invoice No. = (%d)' , 16 , 1 , @DocCode)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

RETURN 0

-- sp_UpdateGodownDetail
CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_UpdateGodownDetail 
	@GCode integer, 
	@ICode integer, 
	@Batch varchar (100), 
	@Expiry datetime, 
	@QTY NUMERIC(15, 4) 
AS    
/*
Date : Sep 07,2015
Author : Muhammad Azhar Inayat
@Method = 1 -- Equal Priority / Shortest expiry First
@Method = 2 -- FIFO
@Method = 3 -- LIFO
*/

Declare @itemname VarChar(60)  
Declare @string_expiry VarChar(25)  
Declare @rowsaffected Integer  
Declare @err Integer    

Update	GodownDetail  
Set     CurrQty = CurrQty + @qty  
Where   GodownDetail.GCode  = @GCode and    
		GodownDetail.ICode  = @ICode and     
		GodownDetail.Batch  = @Batch and    
		GodownDetail.Expiry = @Expiry    

Select @rowsaffected = @@RowCount , @err = @@Error    

IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
Begin
	DECLARE @Priority TINYINT, @Method TINYINT
	SET @Method = (SELECT DBO.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('InventoryMovementMethod'))
	IF @Method=1
	BEGIN 
		SET @Priority = 10
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		IF @Method=3
		BEGIN
			SET @Priority = ISNULL((SELECT MIN(Priority) FROM GodownDetail WHERE ICode = @ICode), 10)
			IF (@Priority - 1) <= 0
			BEGIN
				UPDATE GodownDetail SET Priority = CASE WHEN Priority >= 255 THEN 255 ELSE Priority + 1 END WHERE ICode = @ICode
				SET @Priority = ISNULL((SELECT MIN(Priority) FROM GodownDetail WHERE ICode = @ICode), 10)
				IF (@Priority - 1) <= 0
					SET @Priority = 0
				ELSE
					SET @Priority = @Priority - 1
			END
			ELSE
				SET @Priority = @Priority - 1
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @Method=2
			BEGIN
				SET @Priority = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(Priority) FROM GodownDetail WHERE ICode = @ICode), 10)
				IF (@Priority + 1) >= 255
				BEGIN
					UPDATE GodownDetail SET Priority = CASE WHEN Priority >= 255 THEN 255 WHEN Priority <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE Priority - 1 END WHERE ICode = @ICode
					SET @Priority = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(Priority) FROM GodownDetail WHERE ICode = @ICode), 10)
					IF (@Priority + 1) >= 255
						SET @Priority = 255
					ELSE
						SET @Priority = @Priority + 1
				END
				ELSE
					SET @Priority = @Priority + 1
			END
		END
	END
	Insert GodownDetail (Gcode, Icode, Batch, Expiry, CurrQty, Priority)
	Values (@GCode, @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @Qty, @Priority)

	IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 OR @@Error <> 0
	Begin
		Select @itemname = name
		From Item
		Where Icode = @icode    
	
		Set @string_expiry = CONVERT ( VarChar(25) , @expiry , 103 )
		RAISERROR  ('Unable to insert stock for the item (%s) in batch no. (%s) with expiry (%s)' , 16 , 1,  @itemname , @batch , @string_expiry  )
	Return -1   
	End  
End
ELSE
IF @rowsaffected <> 1 OR @err <> 0
Begin
	Select @itemname = name From Item Where Icode = @icode
	Set @string_expiry = CONVERT ( VarChar(25) , @expiry , 103 )
	RAISERROR  ('Not enough stock available for the item (%s) in batch no. (%s) with expiry (%s)' , 16 , 1,  @itemname , @batch , @string_expiry  )
	Return -1   
End    
Return 0

-- SP_UpdateItemMeter
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_UpdateItemMeter @List VARCHAR(8000)
AS
SET NOCount On
DECLARE @Rows INT, @RowID INT, @SaleInvCode INT
DECLARE @Showitemmeter CHAR(1)
DECLARE @Sale TABLE (Code INT, ROWID INT IDENTITY(1,1))
SET @Showitemmeter = (SELECT A=DBO.fn_GetPreference('ShowItemMeterInSale'))

IF @Showitemmeter = 'N' RETURN 0

INSERT INTO @Sale (Code)
SELECT Code FROM DBO.udf_StringToTabl(@List,',')
ORDER BY Code

SET @Rows = ISNULL((SELECT Count(*) FROM @Sale), 0)
IF @Rows > 0
BEGIN
	SET @RowID = 1
	WHILE @RowID <= @Rows
	BEGIN
		SET @SaleInvCode = (SELECT Code FROM @Sale WHERE RowID = @RowID)

		UPDATE SaleDetail SET MeterReading = ISNULL(IM.CurrentReading, 0)
		FROM SaleDetail SD, ItemMeter IM
		WHERE SD.SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode AND SD.ItemMeterCode = IM.ItemMeterCode
 
		UPDATE ItemMeter SET CurrentReading = ISNULL(CurrentReading, 0) + SD.LooseQty
		FROM SaleDetail SD, ItemMeter IM
		WHERE SD.SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode AND SD.ItemMeterCode = IM.ItemMeterCode AND
			SD.MeterReading = IM.CurrentReading

		SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
	END
END
RETURN 0

-- SP_UpdateItems_CategoryWise
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_UpdateItems_CategoryWise @SRV VARCHAR(50), @DB VARCHAR(50), @OWNER VARCHAR(20) AS

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON

DECLARE @UPD NVARCHAR(1000), @SQL NVARCHAR(1000), @QRY NVARCHAR(4000), @SETPART NVARCHAR(4000), @ColName VARCHAR(255), @QRY_ItemCat NVARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @ENDD NVARCHAR(50), @TableName NVARCHAR(50), @PKCOND NVARCHAR(1000), @full_table_name NVARCHAR(255)
DECLARE @Priority SMALLINT, @KeySeq SMALLINT, @Position SMALLINT
DECLARE @table_id INT, @err INT
DECLARE @ICatCode SMALLINT, @UpdatePurPrice CHAR(1), @UpdateSalePrice CHAR(1), @UpdateSalePrice2 CHAR(1), @UpdateSalePrice3 CHAR(1), @UpdateSalePrice4 CHAR(1), @UpdateSalePrice5 CHAR(1), @UpdateSaleDiscPerc CHAR(1), @UpdateSaleDiscPerc2 CHAR(1), @UpdateSaleDiscPerc3 CHAR(1), @UpdateSaleDiscPerc4 CHAR(1), @UpdateSaleDiscPerc5 CHAR(1)

SET @UPD = N'UPDATE '
SET @SETPART = N'SET '
SET @SQL = N' FROM ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.'
SET @ENDD = N' AS T WHERE '
SET @TableName = 'Item'
SET @PKCOND = ' T.ICode = Item.ICode AND Item.ICatCode = '
DECLARE IC1 CURSOR FOR
SELECT ICatCode, UpdatePurPrice, UpdateSalePrice, UpdateSalePrice2, UpdateSalePrice3, UpdateSalePrice4, UpdateSalePrice5, UpdateSaleDiscPerc, UpdateSaleDiscPerc2, UpdateSaleDiscPerc3, UpdateSaleDiscPerc4, UpdateSaleDiscPerc5
FROM ItemCategoryWiseUpdation
WHERE UpdatePurPrice='Y' OR UpdateSalePrice='Y' OR UpdateSalePrice2='Y' OR UpdateSalePrice3='Y' OR UpdateSalePrice4='Y' OR UpdateSalePrice5='Y' OR UpdateSaleDiscPerc='Y' OR UpdateSaleDiscPerc2='Y' OR UpdateSaleDiscPerc3='Y' OR UpdateSaleDiscPerc4='Y' OR UpdateSaleDiscPerc5='Y'

OPEN IC1

FETCH NEXT FROM IC1 INTO @ICatCode, @UpdatePurPrice, @UpdateSalePrice, @UpdateSalePrice2, @UpdateSalePrice3, @UpdateSalePrice4, @UpdateSalePrice5, @UpdateSaleDiscPerc, @UpdateSaleDiscPerc2, @UpdateSaleDiscPerc3, @UpdateSaleDiscPerc4, @UpdateSaleDiscPerc5
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @SETPART = N'SET '
	IF @UpdatePurPrice = 'Y'
		SET @SETPART = @SETPART + 'PurPrice=T.PurPrice,'
	IF @UpdateSalePrice = 'Y'
		SET @SETPART = @SETPART + 'SalePrice=T.SalePrice,'
	IF @UpdateSalePrice2 = 'Y'
		SET @SETPART = @SETPART + 'SalePrice2=T.SalePrice2,'
	IF @UpdateSalePrice3 = 'Y'
		SET @SETPART = @SETPART + 'SalePrice3=T.SalePrice3,'
	IF @UpdateSalePrice4 = 'Y'
		SET @SETPART = @SETPART + 'SalePrice4=T.SalePrice4,'
	IF @UpdateSalePrice5 = 'Y'
		SET @SETPART = @SETPART + 'SalePrice5=T.SalePrice5,'
	IF @UpdateSaleDiscPerc = 'Y'
		SET @SETPART = @SETPART + 'SaleDiscPerc=T.SaleDiscPerc,'
	IF @UpdateSaleDiscPerc2 = 'Y'
		SET @SETPART = @SETPART + 'SaleDiscPerc2=T.SaleDiscPerc2,'
	IF @UpdateSaleDiscPerc3 = 'Y'
		SET @SETPART = @SETPART + 'SaleDiscPerc3=T.SaleDiscPerc3,'
	IF @UpdateSaleDiscPerc4 = 'Y'
		SET @SETPART = @SETPART + 'SaleDiscPerc4=T.SaleDiscPerc4,'
	IF @UpdateSaleDiscPerc5 = 'Y'
		SET @SETPART = @SETPART + 'SaleDiscPerc5=T.SaleDiscPerc5'
	
	IF Right(@SETPART, 1) = ','
		SET @SETPART = LEFT(@SETPART, LEN(@SETPART) - 1)

	SET @QRY = @UPD + @TableName + ' ' + @SETPART + ' ' + @SQL + @TableName + @ENDD + ' ' + @PKCOND + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@ICatCode)))

	EXECUTE (@QRY)
	SET @err = @@ERROR
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Data Updation: Error Transfering %s Data', 16, 1, @full_table_name)
		CLOSE IC1
		DEALLOCATE IC1
		RETURN -1
	END 
	FETCH NEXT FROM IC1 INTO @ICatCode, @UpdatePurPrice, @UpdateSalePrice, @UpdateSalePrice2, @UpdateSalePrice3, @UpdateSalePrice4, @UpdateSalePrice5, @UpdateSaleDiscPerc, @UpdateSaleDiscPerc2, @UpdateSaleDiscPerc3, @UpdateSaleDiscPerc4, @UpdateSaleDiscPerc5
END
CLOSE IC1
DEALLOCATE IC1

RETURN 0
