-- sp_UpdateItemStockBatch
CREATE  PROCEDURE SP_UpdateItemStockBatch 
	@GCode Integer, 
	@ICode Integer, 
	@Batch VarChar (100), 
	@Expiry DateTime, 
	@NewQty NUMERIC(15, 4), 
	@manfdate DateTime = Null  
AS   
/*
Date : Sep 07,2015
Author : Muhammad Azhar Inayat
@Method = 1 -- Equal Priority / Shortest expiry First
@Method = 2 -- FIFO
@Method = 3 -- LIFO
*/

Declare @itemname VarChar(60)  
Declare @string_expiry VarChar(25)  
Declare @rowsaffected Integer  
Declare @err Integer   

Update	GodownDetail  
Set	CurrQty = @NewQty  
Where	GodownDetail.GCode  = @GCode and
	GodownDetail.ICode  = @ICode and
	GodownDetail.Batch  = @Batch and
	GodownDetail.Expiry = @Expiry

Select @rowsaffected = @@RowCount , @err = @@Error    

IF @rowsaffected = 0 AND @err = 0   
Begin   
	DECLARE @Priority TINYINT, @Method TINYINT
	SET @Method = (SELECT DBO.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('InventoryMovementMethod'))
	IF @Method=1
	BEGIN 
		SET @Priority = 10
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		IF @Method=3
		BEGIN
			SET @Priority = ISNULL((SELECT MIN(Priority) FROM GodownDetail WHERE ICode = @ICode), 10)
			IF (@Priority - 1) <= 0
			BEGIN
				UPDATE GodownDetail SET Priority = CASE WHEN Priority >= 255 THEN 255 ELSE Priority + 1 END WHERE ICode = @ICode
				SET @Priority = ISNULL((SELECT MIN(Priority) FROM GodownDetail WHERE ICode = @ICode), 10)
				IF (@Priority - 1) <= 0
					SET @Priority = 0
				ELSE
					SET @Priority = @Priority - 1
			END
			ELSE
				SET @Priority = @Priority - 1
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @Method=2
			BEGIN
				SET @Priority = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(Priority) FROM GodownDetail WHERE ICode = @ICode), 10)
				IF (@Priority + 1) >= 255
				BEGIN
					UPDATE GodownDetail SET Priority = CASE WHEN Priority >= 255 THEN 255 WHEN Priority <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE Priority - 1 END WHERE ICode = @ICode
					SET @Priority = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(Priority) FROM GodownDetail WHERE ICode = @ICode), 10)
					IF (@Priority + 1) >= 255
						SET @Priority = 255
					ELSE
						SET @Priority = @Priority + 1
				END
				ELSE
					SET @Priority = @Priority + 1
			END
		END
	END
	Insert GodownDetail (Gcode, Icode, Batch, Expiry, CurrQty, manfdate, Priority)
	Values (@GCode, @ICode, @Batch, @Expiry, @NewQty, @manfdate, @Priority)

	IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 OR @@Error <> 0    
	Begin    
		Select @itemname = name     From Item    
		Where Icode = @icode    
		Set @string_expiry = CONVERT ( VarChar(25) , @expiry , 103 )    
		RAISERROR  ('Unable to insert stock for the item (%s) in batch no. (%s) with expiry (%s)' , 16 , 1,  @itemname , @batch , @string_expiry  )    Return -1   End  End    ELSE     IF @rowsaffected <> 1 OR @err <> 0     Begin    Select @itemname = name     From Item    Where Icode = @icode    Set @string_expiry = CONVERT ( VarChar(25) , @expiry , 103 )    RAISERROR  ('Not enough stock available for the item (%s) in batch no. (%s) with expiry (%s)' , 16 , 1,  @itemname , @batch , @string_expiry  )    
		Return -1   
	End    
Return 0

name: SP_UpdateItemStockLedger
definition:
-- SP_UpdateItemStockLedger
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_UpdateItemStockLedger @ICode INT, @UpdateBaseTable CHAR(1)
AS

Declare @RowID INT, @Items_Rows Int, @Counter Int, @TotalRows Int, @continue Int, @Err Int, @rt_code Int, @documentcode int
Declare @documenttype varchar(10), @qty NUMERIC(15, 4), @bonus NUMERIC(15, 4), @stock NUMERIC(15, 4), @newstock NUMERIC(15, 4), @utn BIGINT, @due CHAR(1), @PrevStock NUMERIC(15, 4)
SET NOCOUNT ON
Set @continue = 0
IF @UpdateBaseTable IS NULL OR @UpdateBaseTable=''
	SET @UpdateBaseTable='N'

Declare CStock Cursor Static Forward_Only
For 
Select documentcode, documenttype, qty, bonus, stock, newstock, utn, due
From StockLedger
Where icode = @icode 
Order by UTN

Open CStock
Set @totalrows = @@Cursor_Rows
Fetch Next From CStock
Into @documentcode, @documenttype, @qty, @bonus, @stock, @newstock, @utn, @due
Set @counter = 1	
While @@Fetch_Status = 0 And @counter <= @totalrows
Begin
	IF @counter=1 AND (@documenttype='PV' OR @documenttype='RV' OR @documenttype='SR' OR @documenttype='AI')
		SET @PrevStock = @newstock

	SET @PrevStock = ISNULL(@PrevStock, 0)

	IF @documenttype='PR' OR @documenttype='SV' OR @documenttype='IV' OR @documenttype='DS' OR @documenttype='AD'
	BEGIN
		IF @documenttype='SV'
		BEGIN
			UPDATE StockLedger
			SET Stock=@PrevStock, NewStock=CASE WHEN DUE IS NULL THEN @PrevStock - @Qty - @BONUS ELSE @PrevStock END
			WHERE ICode=@ICode AND UTN = @UTN 

			IF @UpdateBaseTable='Y'
				UPDATE SaleDetail SET BalanceStock =  CASE WHEN DUE IS NULL THEN @PrevStock - @Qty - @BONUS ELSE @PrevStock END WHERE SaleInvcode=@documentcode AND SaleUtn=@UTN

			SET @PrevStock = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(NewStock) FROM StockLedger WHERE ICode=@ICode AND UTN = @UTN), 0)
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @documenttype='PR' AND @UpdateBaseTable='Y'
				UPDATE PRdetail SET BalanceStock =  @PrevStock - @Qty - @BONUS WHERE PRInvCode=@documentcode AND PrUtn=@UTN
			IF @documenttype='IV' AND @UpdateBaseTable='Y'
				UPDATE IssueDetail SET BalanceStock =  @PrevStock - @Qty - @BONUS WHERE IssueInvcode=@documentcode AND IssueUtn=@UTN
			IF @documenttype='DS' AND @UpdateBaseTable='Y'
				UPDATE DueSatisfyDetail SET BalanceStock =  @PrevStock - @Qty - @BONUS WHERE DueSatisfyCode=@documentcode AND DueSatisfyUtn=@UTN
			IF @documenttype='AD' AND @UpdateBaseTable='Y'
				UPDATE AdjDetail SET CurrStock =  @PrevStock - @Qty - @BONUS WHERE AdjCode=@documentcode AND AdjUtn=@UTN
	
			SET @PrevStock = @PrevStock - @Qty - @Bonus
		END
	END

	IF @counter <> 1 AND (@documenttype='PV' OR @documenttype='RV' OR @documenttype='SR' OR @documenttype='AI')
	BEGIN
		UPDATE StockLedger
		SET Stock=@PrevStock, NewStock=@PrevStock + @Qty + @BONUS
		WHERE ICode=@ICode AND UTN = @UTN 

		IF @documenttype='PV' AND @UpdateBaseTable='Y'
			UPDATE PurDetail SET CurrStock =  @PrevStock WHERE PurInvCode=@documentcode AND PurUtn=@UTN
		IF @documenttype='RV' AND @UpdateBaseTable='Y'
			UPDATE ReceiptDetail SET CurrStock =  @PrevStock WHERE ReceiptInvCode=@documentcode AND ReceiptUtn=@UTN
		IF @documenttype='SR' AND @UpdateBaseTable='Y'
			UPDATE SRDetail SET CurrStock =  @PrevStock WHERE SRInvcode=@documentcode AND SRUtn=@UTN
		IF @documenttype='AI' AND @UpdateBaseTable='Y'
			UPDATE AdjDetail SET CurrStock =  @PrevStock WHERE AdjCode=@documentcode AND AdjUtn=@UTN

		SET @PrevStock = @PrevStock + @Qty + @Bonus
	END

	Set @counter = @counter + 1
	Fetch Next From CStock
	Into @documentcode, @documenttype, @qty, @bonus, @stock, @newstock, @utn, @due
End
Close CStock
Deallocate CStock

name: SP_UpdateItemTotalPiecesInHand
definition:
-- SP_UpdateItemTotalPiecesInHand
CREATE PROCEDURE SP_UpdateItemTotalPiecesInHand
	@ICode integer, 
	@IncDec INTEGER,
	@TotalPieces INT
AS

-- @IncDec is either 1 or -1 to set the direction of total pieces in hand
DECLARE @TotalPieces_to_Update INT, @CurrentTotalPieces INT
DECLARE @ItemName VARCHAR(100)

SET @ItemName = (SELECT Name FROM Item WHERE ICode = @ICode)
SET @CurrentTotalPieces = ISNULL((SELECT TotalPieces FROM Item WHERE ICode = @ICode),0)

SET @TotalPieces_to_Update = @TotalPieces * @IncDec

-- if direction is -ve and to enough stock available
IF @IncDec < 0 AND @CurrentTotalPieces < @TotalPieces
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Not Enough pieces available to issue/decrease for the item %s', 16, 1, @ItemName)
	RETURN -1
END

UPDATE Item 
SET TotalPieces = TotalPieces + @TotalPieces_to_Update
WHERE ICode = @ICode

IF @@Error <> 0 
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Unable to update total pieces for the item %s', 16, 1, @ItemName)
	RETURN -1
END

RETURN 0

CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_UpdateStockLedger @PurgeStockLedger CHAR(1), @UpdateBaseTable CHAR(1) 
AS
/*
Author : Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Purpose: This Stored Procedure is used to update stock ledger
*/

Declare @ICode Int, @RowID INT, @Items_Rows Int, @Counter Int
SET NOCOUNT ON
IF @PurgeStockLedger IS NULL OR @PurgeStockLedger=''
	SET @PurgeStockLedger='N'

IF @UpdateBaseTable IS NULL OR @UpdateBaseTable=''
	SET @UpdateBaseTable = 'N'

IF @PurgeStockLedger='Y'
BEGIN
	TRUNCATE TABLE StockLedger
END

EXEC SP_StockLedger

DECLARE @CItems TABLE (ICode INT, RowID INT IDENTITY(1,1))
INSERT INTO @CItems (ICode)
SELECT ICode 
FROM Item 
WHERE ICode IN (SELECT DISTINCT ICode FROM StockLedger)
ORDER BY ICode

Set @Items_Rows = @@RowCount
SET @RowID=1
Print 'Total Rows = ' + STR(@Items_Rows)

While @RowID <= @Items_Rows
Begin
	Print 'Row ID = ' + STR(@RowID)
	SET @ICode = (SELECT ICode FROM @CItems WHERE RowID=@RowID)
	EXECUTE DBO.UpdateItemStockLedger @ICode, @UpdateBaseTable
	SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
End

Return 0

-- sp_UpdateTransitStock
CREATE  Procedure SP_UpdateTransitStock
	@mode TinyInt, 
	@icode Int, 
	@qty NUMERIC(15, 4)
As
/*
Author: Muhammad Usman
Version: 1.1
Arguments Detail: 
@mode: 	Possible values are 0 or 1 where 0 means to increase transit stock value in item basic data ( Calling this SP from PurOrder Posting module )
	and 1 means to decrease transit stock value in item basic data ( Calling this SP from Adv.Purchase, Purchase and Goods Receiving Posting module )
@icode: This variable holds ItemCode whose transitstock attribute is going to update.
@qty:   This variable holds NetQty which includes (looseqty + bonusqty)
*/
Declare @itemname VarChar(60), @autoupdate Char(1)
Set @autoupdate = (Select a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'AutoUpdateTransitStock' ))
IF Upper(@autoupdate) = 'Y'
Begin
	IF @mode < 0 OR @mode > 1 
	Begin
		RaisError ( 'UnRecognized Mode argument passed to StoredProcedure (sp_UpdateTransitStock) ',16,1)
		Return -1	
	End
	
	Update Item
	Set    TransitStock = Case @mode When 0 Then (TransitStock + @qty) When 1 Then Case When (TransitStock - @qty) < 0 Then 0 Else (TransitStock - @qty) End  End
	Where  icode = @icode
	IF @@RowCount = 0 OR @@Error <> 0 
	Begin
		Set @itemname = ( Select name From Item Where icode = @icode )	
		RaisError ( 'Unable to update TransitStock for Item: ',16,1, @itemname )
		Return -1
	End
End

Return 0

-- SP_ValidateServiceTicket
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_ValidateServiceTicket 
	@ServiceTicketCode INT,
	@Date DATETIME OUTPUT, 
	@ServiceInvCode INT OUTPUT, 
	@ServiceCode INT OUTPUT, 
	@ServiceCatCode SMALLINT OUTPUT, 
	@TicketUsed CHAR(1) OUTPUT, 
	@TicketUsedON DATETIME OUTPUT, 
	@UserCode SMALLINT OUTPUT, 
	@ExpiresOn DATETIME OUTPUT, 
	@Price NUMERIC(12,2) OUTPUT,
	@ErrorText VARCHAR(255) OUTPUT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @TotRows INT, @errcode INT
DECLARE @ticket_table TABLE 
(	Date DATETIME, 
	ServiceInvCode INT, 
	ServiceCode INT, 
	ServiceCatCode SMALLINT, 
	TicketUsed CHAR(1), 
	TicketUsedON DATETIME, 
	UserCode SMALLINT, 
	ExpiresOn DATETIME, 
	Price NUMERIC(12,2)
)

IF @ServiceTicketCode IS NULL OR @ServiceTicketCode <= 0
	RETURN 0

INSERT INTO @ticket_table
SELECT 
	Date, 
	ServiceInvCode, 
	ServiceCode, 
	ServiceCatCode=(SELECT S.ServiceCatCode FROM Service S WHERE S.ServiceCode = ServiceTicket.ServiceCode),
	TicketUsed, 
	TicketUsedON, 
	UserCode,
	ExpiresOn,
	Price
FROM ServiceTicket
WHERE ServiceTicketCode = @ServiceTicketCode
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
BEGIN
	SET @ErrorText = 'Problem while Fetching Service Ticket Information....'
	RaisError(@ErrorText, 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @TotRows = ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @ticket_table), 0)
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @TotRows = 0
BEGIN
	SET @ErrorText = 'Service Ticket No. ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@ServiceTicketCode,10))) + ' doese not exists, Please enter some other ticket no.'
	RaisError(@ErrorText, 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @Date = (SELECT Date FROM @ticket_table)
SET @ServiceInvCode  = (SELECT ServiceInvCode  FROM @ticket_table)
SET @ServiceCode = (SELECT ServiceCode FROM @ticket_table)
SET @ServiceCatCode = (SELECT ServiceCatCode FROM @ticket_table)
SET @TicketUsed = ISNULL((SELECT TicketUsed FROM @ticket_table), 'N')
SET @TicketUsedON = (SELECT TicketUsedON FROM @ticket_table)
SET @UserCode = (SELECT UserCode FROM @ticket_table)
SET @ExpiresOn = (SELECT ExpiresOn FROM @ticket_table)
SET @Price = ISNULL((SELECT Price FROM @ticket_table), 0)

IF @TicketUsed = 'Y'
BEGIN
	SET @ErrorText = 'Service Ticket No. ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@ServiceTicketCode,10))) + ' is Already Used, Please enter some other ticket no.'
	RETURN 1
END

IF @ExpiresOn < GETDATE()
BEGIN
	SET @ErrorText = 'Service Ticket No. ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@ServiceTicketCode,10))) + ' is Already Expired, Please enter some other ticket no.'
	RETURN 2
END

UPDATE ServiceTicket 
SET TicketUsed = 'Y', TicketUsedOn = GETDATE()
WHERE ServiceTicketCode = @ServiceTicketCode AND
	TicketUsed = 'N' AND
	ExpiresOn >= GETDATE()

IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
BEGIN
	SET @ErrorText = 'Problem while updating Record for Service Ticket No. ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(@ServiceTicketCode,10))) + ', Please enter some other ticket no.'
	RaisError(@ErrorText , 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

RETURN 0

-- SP_VerifyDataMigrationPacket
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VerifyDataMigrationPacket @PacketFile VARCHAR(4000), @TempDBName VARCHAR(255), @Svr VARCHAR(255)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @Qry VARCHAR(4000), @LogicalDatFl VARCHAR(4000), @LogicalLogFl VARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @Pos INT, @rtCode INT, @err INT, @RC INT
DECLARE @VersionInfo varchar(4000), @DBVersion VARCHAR(100)

-- Set parameter values
EXEC @RC = SP_DBMS_Version @VersionInfo OUTPUT 
IF CHARINDEX('Microsoft SQL Server 2012', @VersionInfo, 1) > 0 
	SET @DBVersion = '2012'
ELSE
	SET @DBVersion = '2000'

IF @DBVersion = '2012'
	SET @Qry = 'RESTORE FILELISTONLY FROM DISK = ''' + @PacketFile + ''''
ELSE
	SET @Qry = 'RESTORE FILELISTONLY FROM DISK = ''' + @PacketFile + ''' WITH MEDIAPASSWORD = ''alcia' + LOWER(@Svr) + ''', PASSWORD = ''alfia' + LOWER(@Svr) + ''''

CREATE TABLE #backupinfo (LogicalFile VARCHAR(500), PhysicalFile VARCHAR(1000), Type CHAR(1), FG VARCHAR(100), Sz BIGINT, MaxSz BIGINT)

INSERT INTO #backupinfo 
EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@Error
IF @err <> 0 OR @rtCode <> 0 
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Failure to Read Logical File Names From Data Migration Packet, Error Code = %d', 16, 1, @err)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @LogicalDatFl = ISNULL((SELECT LogicalFile FROM #backupinfo WHERE Type = 'D'), 'MehmoodDatabase_Data')
SET @LogicalLogFl = ISNULL((SELECT LogicalFile FROM #backupinfo WHERE Type = 'L'), 'MehmoodDatabase_Log')

SET @Pos = CHARINDEX('\', @SVR, 1)
IF @Pos > 0
	SET @Svr = LOWER(LEFT(@Svr, @Pos - 1))
ELSE
	SET @Svr = LOWER(@Svr)

IF @DBVersion = '2012'
	SET @Qry = 'RESTORE DATABASE ' + @TempDBName + ' FROM DISK = ''' + @PacketFile + ''' WITH RECOVERY, REPLACE, MOVE ''' + @LogicalDatFl + ''' TO ''C:\' + @TempDBName + '_DM.MDF'', MOVE ''' + @LogicalLogFl + ''' TO ''C:\' + @TempDBName + '_DM_Log.LDF'''
ELSE
	SET @Qry = 'RESTORE DATABASE ' + @TempDBName + ' FROM DISK = ''' + @PacketFile + ''' WITH RECOVERY, REPLACE, MEDIAPASSWORD = ''alcia' + LOWER(@SVR) + ''', PASSWORD = ''alfia' + LOWER(@SVR) + ''', MOVE ''' + @LogicalDatFl + ''' TO ''C:\' + @TempDBName + '_DM.MDF'', MOVE ''' + @LogicalLogFl + ''' TO ''C:\' + @TempDBName + '_DM_Log.LDF'''

EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@Error
IF @err <> 0 OR @rtCode <> 0 
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Failure To Verify Data Migration Packet, Error Code = %d', 16, 1, @err)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @Qry = 'DROP DATABASE ' + @TempDBName
EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@Error
IF @err <> 0 OR @rtCode <> 0 
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Failure To Drop Data Migration Packet, Error Code = %d', 16, 1, @err)
	RETURN -1
END
RETURN 0

-- sp_VirtualGL
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VirtualGL @ac_type CHAR(1)
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON
TRUNCATE TABLE VirtualGLTemp
DECLARE @rc int
SET @rc = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VirtualGL (TABLOCKX))

IF UPPER(@ac_type) IS NULL 
	SET @ac_type = 'A'

IF UPPER(@ac_type) <> 'S' AND UPPER(@ac_type) <> 'A' 
	SET @ac_type = 'A'

DECLARE @goodsacc smallint, @goodsissueacc smallint, @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), 
	@ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_invacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cgs NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxonsvc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_AdvIncomeTaxPur NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_AdvIncomeTaxSale NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_fbrposfeeacc NUMERIC(5,0)
DECLARE @InvSys CHAR(1), @AutoPurgeVirtualGL CHAR(1)

SET @goodsacc = ISNULL((SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_GoodsReceiptAcc'), 31)
SET @goodsissueacc = ISNULL((SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_GoodsIssuedAcc'), 31)
SET @InvSys = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'InventorySystemUsed')), 'P')
SET @ln_invacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_InventoryAcc')
SET @ln_cgs = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CostOfGoodsSoldAcc')
SET @ln_purchaseacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseAccount')
SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_equityacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_EquityACC')
SET @ln_salesacc    = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesACC')
SET @ln_salesretacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesReturnACC')
SET @ln_purchaseretacc  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseReturnsAccount')
SET @ln_revfromservice  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_RevenueFromServices')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')
SET @ln_salestaxonsvc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesTaxPayableOnServices')
SET @ln_AdvIncomeTaxPur = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvIncomeTaxPur')
SET @ln_AdvIncomeTaxSale = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvIncomeTaxSale')
SET @ln_fbrposfeeacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_FBRPOSFeeAcc')

SET @AutoPurgeVirtualGL = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'AutoPurgeVirtualGL')), 'N')


BEGIN TRANSACTION T1

IF @AutoPurgeVirtualGL = 'Y'
BEGIN
	TRUNCATE TABLE VirtualGL
	COMMIT TRANSACTION T1
	RETURN
END

IF @ac_type <> 'C'
BEGIN
	EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Purchase
	EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_PurchaseReturn
	EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_PurchaseServices
END

IF @ac_type <> 'S'
BEGIN
	EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Sales
	EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_SalesReturn
	EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Services
	EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_SaleOrder
END

EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Receipt
EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Issue
EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Adjustment
EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Guest
EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Patient
EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Vouchers
EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Notes
EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_TransactionWindow
EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Payroll
EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Products
EXECUTE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_CashierShift

INSERT INTO VirtualGL
	(DocumentCode, DocumentType, CatCode, AccCode, AlternateAccCode, date, Debit, Credit, Remarks, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate)
SELECT
	DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	dr_AccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = CASE WHEN dr_AccCode IN (SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) THEN AlternateAccCode ELSE NULL END,
	date, 
	Debit = CASE
		WHEN dr_AccCode IN 
			(SELECT acccode FROM accounts 
			WHERE acccode IN 
				(@ln_invacc, @goodsacc, @goodsissueacc, @ln_purchaseacc, @ln_salesacc, @ln_salesretacc, 
				@ln_purchaseretacc, @ln_revfromservice)) THEN Gross - ISNULL(AdvIncomeTax, 0) - ISNULL(FBRPosFee, 0)
		ELSE ISNULL(Gross, 0) + ISNULL(SaleTax, 0)
		END, 
	Credit = 0, Dr_Remarks, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, 
	OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow=0, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From VirtualGLTemp
UNION ALL /*Credit part of all transactions*/
SELECT
	DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	cr_AccCode, 
	AlternateAccCode = CASE WHEN cr_AccCode IN (SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) THEN AlternateAccCode ELSE NULL END,
	date, 
	Debit = 0, 
	Credit = CASE WHEN cr_AccCode IN
		(SELECT acccode FROM accounts 
			WHERE acccode IN (@ln_invacc, @goodsacc, @goodsissueacc, @ln_purchaseacc, @ln_salesacc, @ln_salesretacc, @ln_purchaseretacc, @ln_revfromservice)) THEN Gross - ISNULL(AdvIncomeTax, 0) - ISNULL(FBRPosFee, 0)
		ELSE ISNULL(Gross, 0) + ISNULL(SaleTax, 0) END, 
	Cr_Remarks, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, 
	OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow=1, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From VirtualGLTemp
UNION ALL /*  Sales Tax For all the transactions either debit or credit */
SELECT 	DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	AccCode = CASE WHEN DocumentType = 'RS' OR DocumentType = 'RR' THEN @ln_salestaxonsvc ELSE @ln_salestaxacc END, 
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	date, 
	Debit = CASE DocumentType WHEN 'PV' THEN SaleTax WHEN 'SR' THEN SaleTax WHEN 'RR' THEN SaleTax ELSE 0 END, 
	Credit= CASE DocumentType WHEN 'SV' THEN SaleTax WHEN 'PR' THEN SaleTax WHEN 'RS' THEN SaleTax ELSE 0 END, 
	SaleTax_Remarks, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, 
	OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow=2, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From VirtualGLTemp
WHERE 	SaleTax <> 0
UNION ALL /*  Advance Income Tax For all the transactions either debit or credit */
SELECT 	DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	AccCode = CASE WHEN DocumentType = 'SV' OR DocumentType = 'SR' THEN @ln_AdvIncomeTaxSale ELSE @ln_AdvIncomeTaxPur END, 
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	date, 
	Debit = CASE DocumentType WHEN 'PV' THEN AdvIncomeTax WHEN 'SR' THEN AdvIncomeTax ELSE 0 END, 
	Credit= CASE DocumentType WHEN 'SV' THEN AdvIncomeTax WHEN 'PR' THEN AdvIncomeTax ELSE 0 END, 
	SaleTax_Remarks='Adv. Income Tax ' + CASE WHEN DocumentType = 'SR' OR DocumentType = 'PR' THEN 'Reversed' ELSE 'Accounted For' END, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, 
	OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow=2, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From VirtualGLTemp
WHERE 	(DocumentType = 'SV' OR DocumentType = 'SR' OR DocumentType = 'PV' OR DocumentType = 'PR') AND AdvIncomeTax <> 0
UNION ALL /*  FBR POS FEE For all the transactions either debit or credit */
SELECT 	DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	AccCode = CASE WHEN DocumentType = 'SV' OR DocumentType = 'SR' THEN @ln_fbrposfeeacc ELSE @ln_fbrposfeeacc END, 
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	date, 
	Debit = CASE DocumentType WHEN 'SR' THEN ISNULL(FBRPosFee, 0) ELSE 0 END, 
	Credit= CASE DocumentType WHEN 'SV' THEN ISNULL(FBRPosFee, 0) ELSE 0 END, 
	SaleTax_Remarks='FBR POS Service Fee ' + CASE DocumentType WHEN 'SR' THEN 'Reversed' ELSE 'Accounted For' END, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, 
	OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow=2, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From VirtualGLTemp
WHERE 	(DocumentType = 'SV' OR DocumentType = 'SR') AND ISNULL(FBRPosFee, 0) <> 0
UNION ALL /*  Accounting Treatement for Amount Received/Paid during the transactions  First Debit Part of amount received/paid */
SELECT 	DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	DrAmtAccCode, 
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	AmtDate, 
	Debit = Amt, 
	Credit= 0, 
	Remarks=CASE DocumentType WHEN 'PV' THEN 'Paid during pur. inv. no.' 
		WHEN 'PR' THEN 	'Received during p/return no.' 
		WHEN 'SV' THEN 	'Received during sale inv. no.' 
		WHEN 'SR' THEN 	'Paid during s/return no.' ELSE DR_Remarks END+ ':'+ LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(INVOICECODE))) + ' (' + ISNULL((SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(A.Name)) FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = VirtualGLTemp.dr_acccode), '') + ')' , 
	CheckNo=AmtRef, AmtBy, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, OutstandingAmt, 
	Balance, VROW=3, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From VirtualGLTemp
WHERE 	Amt > 0
UNION ALL  /* Now Credit Part of amount received/paid during invoice */
SELECT 	DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	CrAmtAccCode, 
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	AmtDate, 
	Debit = 0, 
	Credit= Amt, 
	Remarks=CASE DocumentType WHEN 'PV' THEN 'Paid during pur. inv. no.' 
		WHEN 'PR' THEN 'Received during p/return no.' 
		WHEN 'SV' THEN 'Received during sale inv. no.' 
		WHEN 'SR' THEN 'Paid during s/return no.' ELSE CR_Remarks END + ':'+ LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(INVOICECODE))) + ' (' + ISNULL((SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(A.Name)) FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = VirtualGLTemp.dr_acccode), '') + ')' , 
	CheckNo=AmtRef, AmtBy, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, OutstandingAmt, 
	Balance, VRow=4, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From VirtualGLTemp
WHERE 	Amt > 0
UNION ALL /*When Perpetual Inv. System then cgs vouchers are used*/
SELECT
	DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	dr_AccCode=CASE WHEN DocumentType ='SV' THEN @ln_cgs ELSE @ln_invacc END,
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	date, 
	Debit = CGS, 
	Credit = 0, Remarks=CASE WHEN DocumentType ='SV' THEN 'Cost of Sale charged for Sale Inv. #' ELSE 'Inventory Accounted for S/R  Inv. #' END + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(DocumentCode))), 
	CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, 
	OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow=0, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From VirtualGLTemp
WHERE @InvSys <> 'P' AND DocumentType IN ('SV', 'SR') AND CGS <> 0
UNION ALL /*When Perpetual Inv. System then cgs vouchers are used*/
SELECT
	DocumentCode,
	DocumentType, 
	CatCode,
	dr_AccCode=CASE WHEN DocumentType ='SV' THEN @ln_invacc ELSE @ln_cgs END,
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	date, 
	Debit = 0, 
	Credit = CGS, Remarks=CASE WHEN DocumentType ='SV' THEN 'Inventory Accounted for Sale Inv. #' ELSE 'Cost of Sale Reversed for S/R Inv. #' END + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(DocumentCode))), 
	CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, 
	OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow=0, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate
From VirtualGLTemp
WHERE @InvSys <> 'P' AND DocumentType IN ('SV', 'SR') AND CGS <> 0

COMMIT TRANSACTION T1
TRUNCATE TABLE VirtualGLTemp

-- SP_VirtualGL_Adjustment
CREATE   PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Adjustment
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_invacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cgs NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @SRemks CHAR(1), @InvSys CHAR(1)
SET @InvSys = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'InventorySystemUsed')), 'P')

SET @ln_invacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_InventoryAcc')
SET @ln_cgs = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CostOfGoodsSoldAcc')
SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_salesacc    = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesACC')
SET @ln_salesretacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesReturnACC')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')

CREATE TABLE #lsl (code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lsl
SELECT AdjCode FROM AdjHeader
WHERE Posted = 'Y' AND
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode FROM VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType IN ('AI','AD') AND V.DocumentCode = AdjHeader.AdjCode)

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for */
SELECT  documentcode = A.AdjCode, documenttype    = CASE A.AdjCatCode WHEN 1 THEN 'AI' ELSE 'AD' END, catcode = A.AdjCatCode,

CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_CashierShift

FROM CashierShift
WHERE ShiftStatus = 'C' AND
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode FROM VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType IN ('CSHIFT') AND V.DocumentCode = CashierShift.CashierShiftCode)

INSERT INTO VirtualGL
	(DocumentCode, DocumentType, CatCode, AccCode, AlternateAccCode, date, Debit, Credit, Remarks, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate)
SELECT
	DocumentCode = CashierShiftCode, 
	DocumentType = 'CSHIFT', 
	CatCode=1,
	AccCode=AmtTransferedTo,
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	Date=ClosedOn, 
	Debit = AmtTransfered, 
	Credit = 0.00, 
	Remarks=CASE WHEN LEN(Remarks) > 0 THEN Remarks ELSE 'Amt Transfered From Cashier Shift # ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(CashierShiftCode))) + '(' + ISNULL((SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode = ShiftOwner),'') +')' END,

	OutstandingAmt=0, Balance=0, VRow=0, PatientCode=NULL, GRN=NULL, GCCode=NULL,
	Vehicle= NULL, ShipTo= NULL, GuestCode= NULL, StudentCode= NULL, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL
FROM 
	CashierShift
WHERE ShiftStatus = 'C' AND CashierShiftCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl) AND AmtTransfered > 0 AND AmtTransferedTo IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
	DocumentCode = CashierShiftCode, 
	DocumentType = 'CSHIFT', 
	CatCode=1,
	AccCode=CashAccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	Date=ClosedOn, 
	Debit = 0.00, 
	Credit = AmtTransfered, 
	Remarks=CASE WHEN LEN(Remarks) > 0 THEN Remarks ELSE 'Amt Transfered From Cashier Shift # ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(CashierShiftCode))) + '(' + ISNULL((SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode = ShiftOwner),'') +')' END,

	OutstandingAmt=0, Balance=0, VRow=0, PatientCode=NULL, GRN=NULL, GCCode=NULL,
	Vehicle= NULL, ShipTo= NULL, GuestCode= NULL, StudentCode= NULL, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL
FROM 
	CashierShift
WHERE ShiftStatus = 'C' AND CashierShiftCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl) AND AmtTransfered > 0 AND AmtTransferedTo IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
	DocumentCode = CashierShiftCode, 
	DocumentType = 'CSHIFT', 
	CatCode=1,
	AccCode=CashAccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	Date=ClosedOn, 
	Debit = ABS(DiffAmt), 
	Credit = 0.00, 
	Remarks='Excess Cash From Cashier Shift # ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(CashierShiftCode))) + '(' + ISNULL((SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode = ShiftOwner),'') + ')',

	Vehicle= NULL, ShipTo= NULL, GuestCode= NULL, StudentCode= NULL, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL
FROM 
	CashierShift
WHERE ShiftStatus = 'C' AND CashierShiftCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl) AND DiffAmt > 0 AND DiffTransferedTo IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT

	AccCode=DiffTransferedTo,
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	Date=ClosedOn,

	Vehicle= NULL, ShipTo= NULL, GuestCode= NULL, StudentCode= NULL, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL
FROM 
	CashierShift
WHERE ShiftStatus = 'C' AND CashierShiftCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl) AND DiffAmt > 0 AND DiffTransferedTo IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
	DocumentCode = CashierShiftCode, 
	DocumentType = 'CSHIFT', 
	CatCode=1,
	AccCode=DiffTransferedTo,
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	Date=ClosedOn,

	CheckNo=NULL, ShiftOwner, VoucherCode=CashierShiftCode, InvoiceCode=NULL, InvoiceType=NULL,

	Date=ClosedOn,

	Vehicle= NULL, ShipTo= NULL, GuestCode= NULL, StudentCode= NULL, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL
FROM

WHERE ShiftStatus = 'C' AND CashierShiftCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl) AND DiffAmt < 0 AND DiffTransferedTo IS NOT NULL

-- SP_VirtualGL_Issue
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Issue AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @invacc smallint, @goodsacc smallint
DECLARE @InvSys CHAR(1), @SRemks CHAR(1)
SET @InvSys = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'InventorySystemUsed')), 'P')
SET @invacc = ISNULL((SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_InventoryAcc'), 7)
SET @goodsacc = ISNULL((SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_GoodsIssuedAcc'), 30)
SET @SRemks = (SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'ShowIssueRemarksinledger' ))

CREATE TABLE #lsl (code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lsl
SELECT IssueInvCode FROM IssueHeader
WHERE Posted = 'Y' AND
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode FROM VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType IN ('ISU') AND V.DocumentCode=IssueHeader.IssueInvCode)

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for */
SELECT  documentcode = A.IssueInvCode, documenttype = 'ISU', catcode = A.IssueCategoryCode,
	dr_acccode = A.DrAccCode,
	cr_acccode = CASE WHEN @InvSys <> 'P' THEN @invacc ELSE @goodsacc END,
	AlternateAccCode = Null,
	Date    = A.date,
	SaleTax=0,
	Gross=Round(SUM(D.qty * D.Price), 0),
	dr_remarks = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN A.Remarks ELSE CASE WHEN A.Remarks is null THEN 'Goods Issue against Issue Inv #' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(A.IssueInvCode))) ELSE A.Remarks END END,
	cr_remarks = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN A.Remarks ELSE CASE WHEN A.Remarks is null THEN 'Goods Issue against Issue Inv #' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(A.IssueInvCode))) ELSE A.Remarks END END,
	saletax_remarks= '',	CheckNo = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(A.ReferenceNo)),20) ELSE NULL END, 
	UserCode= A.SalesmanCode, vouchercode= A.IssueCode, invoicecode= A.IssueInvCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0,
	DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, 
	AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL, AmtRef = NULL, 
	OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM IssueHeader A, IssueDetail D
WHERE A.AccountFor = 'Y' AND A.DrAccCode IS NOT NULL AND A.IssueInvCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl) AND
	A.IssueInvCode = D.IssueInvCode
GROUP BY A.IssueInvCode, A.IssueCode, A.DrAccCode, A.IssueCategoryCode, A.Date, A.SalesmanCode, A.Remarks, A.ReferenceNo

-- SP_VirtualGL_Notes
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Notes
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0)

SET @ln_purchaseacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseAccount')
SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_equityacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_EquityACC')
SET @ln_purchaseretacc  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseReturnsAccount')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')

CREATE TABLE #lt_notes (code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lt_notes
SELECT  NoteCode 
FROM    Notes
WHERE   NOT EXISTS 
	(SELECT DISTINCT V.DocumentCode FROM VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType IN ('NR','NP') AND V.DocumentCode=Notes.NoteCode) AND Notes.Posted='Y'

/* Create Accounting Vouchers from Notes Receivables/PAyables that are entered by user But not accounted for yet (depending on VIRTUALGL Table). That is the posted Notes Receivables/PAyables Vouchers not in VIRTUALGL but in Notes table */
INSERT INTO VirtualGL
	(DocumentCode, DocumentType, CatCode, AccCode, AlternateAccCode, date, Debit, Credit, Remarks, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate)
Select  DocumentCode = Notes.NoteCode, 
	DocumentType = Case Notes.NoteCatCode When 1 Then 'NR' Else 'NP' End, 
	catcode = Notes.NoteCatCode,
	acccode= Notes.Bankacccode, 
	AlternateAccCode = NULL, 
	Date    = Notes.PostDate, 
	debit   = Case Notes.NoteCatCode When 1 Then Notes.Amount Else 0 End,
	credit  = Case Notes.NoteCatCode When 2 Then Notes.Amount Else 0 End,
	remarks = notes.remarks, CheckNo = LEFT(notes.DocumentNumber, 20),
	UserCode=notes.Salesmancode, VoucherCode = Notes.VoucherCode, 
	InvoiceCode = NULL, InvoiceType=NULL, OutstandingAmt=0, Balance=0,
	VRow = Case Notes.NoteCatCode When 1 Then 0 Else 1 End,
	PatientCode=NULL, GRN=NULL, GCCode=NULL, Vehicle=NULL, ShipTo=NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL
from    Notes
where 	Notes.NoteCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_notes)
UNION ALL
Select  DocumentCode = Notes.NoteCode, 
	DocumentType = Case Notes.NoteCatCode When 1 Then 'NR' Else 'NP' End,
	catcode = Notes.NoteCatCode,
	acccode= Notes.acccode, 
	AlternateAccCode = NULL, 
	Date   = Notes.PostDate, 
	debit  = Case Notes.NoteCatCode When 2 Then Notes.Amount Else 0 End,
	credit = Case Notes.NoteCatCode When 1 Then Notes.Amount Else 0 End,
	remarks= notes.remarks, CheckNo = LEFT(notes.DocumentNumber, 20),
	UserCode=notes.Salesmancode, VoucherCode = Notes.VoucherCode, InvoiceCode = NULL, 
	InvoiceType=NULL, OutstandingAmt=0, Balance=0,
	VRow = Case Notes.NoteCatCode When 1 Then 0 Else 1 End,
	PatientCode=NULL, GRN=NULL, GCCode=NULL, Vehicle=NULL, ShipTo=NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL
from    Notes
where	Notes.NoteCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_notes)

TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_notes

-- SP_VirtualGL_Patient
CREATE   PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Patient
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

CREATE TABLE #lt_patient (code INT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO #lt_patient
SELECT P.PatientCode 
FROM Patient P
WHERE 
	NOT EXISTS 
		(SELECT DISTINCT V.DocumentCode FROM VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType = 'PG' AND V.DocumentCode = P.PatientCode) AND 
	(P.CashCharged > 0 OR P.PatientCode = (SELECT DISTINCT MCW.DocumentCode FROM MasterCashWin MCW WHERE MCW.DocumentCode = P.PatientCode AND MCW.DocumentType = 'PG'))

CREATE TABLE #lt_admission (code INT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO #lt_admission
SELECT P.AdmissionCode 
FROM PatientAdmission P
WHERE 
	NOT EXISTS 
		(SELECT DISTINCT V.DocumentCode FROM VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType = 'PA' AND V.DocumentCode = P.AdmissionCode) AND 
	(P.CashCharged > 0 OR P.AdmissionCode = (SELECT DISTINCT MCW.DocumentCode FROM MasterCashWin MCW WHERE MCW.DocumentCode = P.AdmissionCode AND MCW.DocumentType = 'PA'))

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for cash received via master cash window during patient registration*/
SELECT  documentcode = S.PatientCode, documenttype    = 'PG', catcode = 1,
	dr_acccode = S.CashAccCode,
	cr_acccode = S.CustCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = S.CashCharged,
	dr_remarks = 'Cash Received during Patient Reg.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.PatientCode, 10))), 
	cr_remarks = 'Cash Received during Patient Reg.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.PatientCode, 10))),
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.usercode, vouchercode= S.PatientCode, invoicecode= S.PatientCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=S.PatientCode,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM Patient S
WHERE S.CashCharged > 0 AND 
	S.PatientCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_patient)
UNION ALL
SELECT  documentcode = S.PatientCode, documenttype    = 'PG', catcode = 1,
	dr_acccode = D.AccCode,
	cr_acccode = S.CustCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = Amount,
	dr_remarks = D.Remarks, cr_remarks = D.Remarks,
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.usercode, vouchercode= S.PatientCode, invoicecode= S.PatientCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=S.PatientCode,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM Patient S, MasterCashWin D
WHERE S.PatientCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_patient) AND D.DocumentType = 'PG' AND S.PatientCode = D.documentcode 

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for cash received via master cash window during patient admission*/
SELECT  documentcode = S.AdmissionCode, documenttype    = 'PA', catcode = 1,
	dr_acccode = S.CashAccCode,
	cr_acccode = P.CustCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = S.CashCharged,
	dr_remarks = 'Cash Received during Patient Admission ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.AdmissionCode, 10))), 
	cr_remarks = 'Cash Received during Patient Admission ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.AdmissionCode, 10))),
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.usercode, vouchercode= S.AdmissionCode, invoicecode= S.AdmissionCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=S.PatientCode,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM PatientAdmission S, Patient P
WHERE S.CashCharged > 0 AND 
	S.PatientCode = P.PatientCode AND
	S.AdmissionCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_admission)
UNION ALL
SELECT  documentcode = S.AdmissionCode, documenttype    = 'PA', catcode = 1,
	dr_acccode = D.AccCode,
	cr_acccode = P.CustCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = Amount,
	dr_remarks = D.Remarks, cr_remarks = D.Remarks,
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.usercode, vouchercode= S.AdmissionCode, invoicecode= S.AdmissionCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=S.PatientCode,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM PatientAdmission S, MasterCashWin D, Patient P
WHERE 
	D.DocumentType = 'PA' AND 
	S.AdmissionCode = D.documentcode AND
	S.PatientCode = P.PatientCode AND 
	S.AdmissionCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_admission)

TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_patient

-- SP_VirtualGL_Payroll
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Payroll
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_payrollpayable NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @SRemks CHAR(1), @payrollbookon CHAR(1)
SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_payrollpayable	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PayrollPayableAcc')
SET @payrollbookon = (SELECT A=DBO.Fn_GetPreference('bookingdateinpayroll'))

CREATE TABLE #lsl (code INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE #lsl2 (code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lsl
SELECT PayrollCode
FROM EMP_Payroll
WHERE Posted = 'Y' AND
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode FROM VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType IN ('PAY') AND V.DocumentCode = EMP_Payroll.PayrollCode)

INSERT INTO #lsl2
SELECT PayrollCode
FROM EMP_Payroll
WHERE Posted = 'Y' AND Paid = 'Y' AND
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode FROM VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType IN ('PAYD') AND V.DocumentCode = EMP_Payroll.PayrollCode)

INSERT INTO VirtualGL
	(DocumentCode, DocumentType, CatCode, AccCode, AlternateAccCode, date, Debit, Credit, Remarks, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate)
SELECT
	DocumentCode = EP.PayrollCode, 
	DocumentType = 'PAY', 
	CatCode=1,
	AccCode=E.AccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	Date=CASE @payrollbookon WHEN 'P' THEN EP.PostDate ELSE EP.Date END, 
	Debit = EP.BasicPay + EP.overtime + EP.bonuspay + EP.specialpay + EP.additionalpay + EP.otherpay - EP.fine - EP.penalty - EP.othercharge +
		ISNULL(SUM(Round((EP.BasicPay * EPA.Percentage * 0.01) + EPA.FlatAmount, 2)), 0), 
	Credit = 0, EP.Remarks, CheckNo=NULL, EP.PostedBy, VoucherCode=EP.PayrollCode, InvoiceCode=NULL, InvoiceType=NULL, 
	OutstandingAmt=0, Balance=0, VRow=0, PatientCode=NULL, GRN=NULL, GCCode=NULL,
	Vehicle= NULL, ShipTo= NULL, GuestCode= NULL, StudentCode= NULL, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL
FROM 
	EMP_Payroll EP
	LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_PayrollAllowances EPA ON (EPA.PayrollCode = EP.PayrollCode),
	EMP_Employee E
WHERE EP.Posted='Y' AND EP.PayrollCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl) AND EP.EmpCode = E.EMPCode
GROUP BY EP.PayrollCode, E.AccCode, EP.Date, EP.PostDate, EP.Remarks, EP.PostedBy, EP.BasicPay, EP.overtime, EP.bonuspay, EP.specialpay, EP.additionalpay, EP.otherpay, EP.fine, EP.penalty, EP.othercharge
UNION ALL
SELECT
	DocumentCode = EP.PayrollCode, 
	DocumentType = 'PAY', 
	CatCode=1,
	AccCode=E.AdvAccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	Date=CASE @payrollbookon WHEN 'P' THEN EP.PostDate ELSE EP.Date END, 
	Debit = 0, 
	Credit = EP.Advance, EP.Remarks, CheckNo=NULL, EP.PostedBy, VoucherCode=EP.PayrollCode, InvoiceCode=NULL, InvoiceType=NULL, 
	OutstandingAmt=0, Balance=0, VRow=1, PatientCode=NULL, GRN=NULL, GCCode=NULL,
	Vehicle= NULL, ShipTo= NULL, GuestCode= NULL, StudentCode= NULL, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL
FROM EMP_Payroll EP, EMP_Employee E
WHERE EP.Posted='Y' AND EP.PayrollCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl) AND EP.EmpCode = E.EMPCode AND EP.Advance > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT
	DocumentCode = EP.PayrollCode, 
	DocumentType = 'PAY', 
	CatCode=1,
	AccCode=A.AccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	Date=CASE @payrollbookon WHEN 'P' THEN EP.PostDate ELSE EP.Date END, 
	Debit = 0, 
	Credit = Round((EP.BasicPay * EPD.Percentage * 0.01) + EPD.FlatAmount,2),
	EP.Remarks, CheckNo=NULL, EP.PostedBy, VoucherCode=EP.PayrollCode, InvoiceCode=NULL, InvoiceType=NULL, 
	OutstandingAmt=0, Balance=0, VRow=2, PatientCode=NULL, GRN=NULL, GCCode=NULL,
	Vehicle= NULL, ShipTo= NULL, GuestCode= NULL, StudentCode= NULL, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL
FROM EMP_Payroll EP, EMP_Employee E, EMP_PayrollDeductions EPD, Accounts A
WHERE EP.Posted='Y' AND EP.PayrollCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl) AND EP.EmpCode = E.EMPCode AND
	EP.PayrollCode = EPD.PayrollCode AND EPD.DeductionCode = A.AccCode
UNION ALL
SELECT
	DocumentCode = EP.PayrollCode, 
	DocumentType = 'PAY', 
	CatCode=1,
	AccCode=@ln_payrollpayable,
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	Date=CASE @payrollbookon WHEN 'P' THEN EP.PostDate ELSE EP.Date END, 
	Debit  = 0, 
	Credit = EP.NetPayable, 
	EP.Remarks, CheckNo=NULL, EP.PostedBy, VoucherCode=EP.PayrollCode, InvoiceCode=NULL, InvoiceType=NULL, 
	OutstandingAmt=0, Balance=0, VRow=3, PatientCode=NULL, GRN=NULL, GCCode=NULL,
	Vehicle= NULL, ShipTo= NULL, GuestCode= NULL, StudentCode= NULL, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL
FROM 
	EMP_Payroll EP
WHERE EP.Posted='Y' AND EP.PayrollCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl)
UNION ALL
SELECT
	DocumentCode = EP.PayrollCode, 
	DocumentType = 'PAYD', 
	CatCode=1,
	AccCode=@ln_payrollpayable,
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	EP.PaymentDate, 
	Debit  = EP.NetPayable,  
	Credit = 0.00, 
	EP.PaymentRemarks, CheckNo=PaymentRefNo, ISNULL(EP.PaidBy, 1), VoucherCode=EP.PayrollCode, InvoiceCode=NULL, InvoiceType=NULL, 
	OutstandingAmt=0, Balance=0, VRow=0, PatientCode=NULL, GRN=NULL, GCCode=NULL,
	Vehicle= NULL, ShipTo= NULL, GuestCode= NULL, StudentCode= NULL, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL
FROM 
	EMP_Payroll EP
WHERE EP.Posted='Y' AND EP.Paid='Y' AND EP.PayrollCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl2)
UNION ALL
SELECT
	DocumentCode = EP.PayrollCode, 
	DocumentType = 'PAYD', 
	CatCode=1,
	AccCode=EP.PaidVia,
	AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	EP.PaymentDate, 
	Debit  = 0.00, 
	Credit = EP.NetPayable,  
	EP.PaymentRemarks, CheckNo=PaymentRefNo, ISNULL(EP.PaidBy, 1), VoucherCode=EP.PayrollCode, InvoiceCode=NULL, InvoiceType=NULL, 
	OutstandingAmt=0, Balance=0, VRow=1, PatientCode=NULL, GRN=NULL, GCCode=NULL,
	Vehicle= NULL, ShipTo= NULL, GuestCode= NULL, StudentCode= NULL, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL
FROM 
	EMP_Payroll EP
WHERE EP.Posted='Y' AND EP.Paid='Y' AND EP.PayrollCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl2)

TRUNCATE TABLE #lsl
TRUNCATE TABLE #lsl2

-- SP_VirtualGL_Purchase
CREATE   PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Purchase
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_invacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purexpacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_AdvIncomeTaxPur NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @PRemks CHAR(1), @ReportPurOnPostDate CHAR(1), @InvSys CHAR(1), @RoundUpTo TINYINT, @AdvIncomeTax CHAR(1)

SET @AdvIncomeTax = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference('ApplyAdvanceIncomeTaxInPur')), 'N')
SET @RoundUpTo = (SELECT A=dbo.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('roundpurinvon'))
SET @InvSys = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'InventorySystemUsed')), 'P')
SET @ln_invacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_InventoryAcc')
SET @ln_purchaseacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseAccount')
SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_equityacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_EquityACC')
SET @ln_purchaseretacc  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseReturnsAccount')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')
SET @ln_purexpacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurExpPayableAcc')
SET @ln_AdvIncomeTaxPur = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvIncomeTaxPur')
SET @PRemks = (SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'ShowPurRemarksInLedger' ))
SET @ReportPurOnPostDate = (SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'reportpurchaseonpostingdate' ))

IF @ReportPurOnPostDate IS NULL
	SET @ReportPurOnPostDate = 'Y'

CREATE TABLE #lt_pur (code INT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO #lt_pur
SELECT  PurInvCode FROM PurLedger P 
WHERE P.Posted = 'Y' and P.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode FROM VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType = 'PV' AND V.DocumentCode = P.PurInvCode)

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp 	/*accounting for purchases*/ 
SELECT  documentcode = P.purinvcode, documenttype='PV', catcode = P.PurCatCode,
	dr_acccode = CASE WHEN @InvSys = 'P' THEN @ln_purchaseacc ELSE @ln_invacc END,
	cr_acccode = CASE P.PurCatCode
		WHEN 3 THEN @ln_equityacc /*Opening Purchase*/ ELSE CASE WHEN P.CustCode > 0 THEN P.CustCode ELSE P.suppcode END /*Credit Purhase*/ END,
	AlternateAccCode = Null,
	date    = CASE @ReportPurOnPostDate WHEN 'Y' THEN P.postdate ELSE P.Date END,
	SaleTax=CASE P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
		WHEN  'N' THEN 
			ROUND(
			SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice) * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) - P.flatdisc) * 
				(P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpTo) 
		ELSE 0.00 END,
	Gross=  CASE P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
			WHEN 'N' THEN
				ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + 
				P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, @RoundUpTo)
			ELSE
				ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + 
				P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, @RoundUpTo) + 
				ROUND(
				SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) +
				SUM(ROUND((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
					(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				ROUND((SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice) * 
					(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) - P.flatdisc) * 
					(P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpTo) 
			END,
	dr_remarks = 'Stock accounted for ' + CASE P.PurCatCode
				WHEN 3 THEN 'open.' WHEN 7 THEN 'loose' WHEN 8 THEN 'loose'
				ELSE 'pack' END + ' pur. #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.purinvcode))),
	cr_remarks = 
			CASE @PRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN P.Remarks
			ELSE CASE P.suppinvcode WHEN NULL THEN 
				CASE P.PurCatCode
				WHEN 3 THEN 'Opening Purchase #: '
				WHEN 7 THEN 'Payable on loose purchase #: '
				WHEN 8 THEN 'Payable on loose purchase #: '
				ELSE 	    'Payable on pack purchase #: ' END +
				RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.purinvcode))) ELSE 'Supp. Inv. # : ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(P.suppinvcode)) + ', Date : ' + LTRIM(RTRIM( convert(varchar(12), P.suppinvdate, 103))) END
			END,
	saletax_remarks= 'S.Tax payable on ' + 
			CASE P.PurCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'open' WHEN 7 THEN 'loose' WHEN 8 THEN 'loose'
			ELSE 'pack' END + ' pur. #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.purinvcode))),	CheckNo = NULL,
	usercode= P.salesmancode, vouchercode= P.purinvcode, invoicecode= P.purinvcode,
	invoicetype = 2 /*2 stands for purchase*/,
	Amt = P.Amt, DrAmtAccCode = P.suppcode, CrAmtAccCode = P.PaymentAccCode,
	AmtBy = P.AmtBy, AmtDate = P.AmtDate, AmtRef = P.AmtReference,
	OutstandingAmt = P.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0, PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = P.GRN, GCCode = P.GCCode, Vehicle = P.Vehicle, ShipTo = P.ShipTo, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, P.CurrencyCode, P.ConversionFactor,
	AdvIncomeTax = CASE WHEN @AdvIncomeTax = 'Y' THEN ISNULL(P.AdvanceTaxAmt,0) ELSE 0 END, FBRPosFee=0.0
FROM purledger P, purdetail D
WHERE P.purinvcode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_pur) AND
	 P.purinvcode = D.purinvcode 
GROUP BY P.purinvcode, P.suppcode, P.CustCode, P.purcatcode, P.Date, P.postdate, P.discperc, P.misccharges,
	P.salestax, P.flatdisc, P.InvGSTPerc1, P.salesmancode, P.Amt, P.PaymentAccCode,
	P.AmtBy, P.AmtDate, P.AmtReference, P.OutstandingAmt, P.suppinvcode, P.suppinvdate, P.Remarks,
	P.GRN, P.GCCode, P.Vehicle, P.ShipTo, P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate, P.CurrencyCode, P.ConversionFactor, P.AdvanceTaxAmt
UNION ALL				/* ImpactInventory = 'N' i.e. Accounted For Proforma Purcahses  */
SELECT  documentcode = P.purinvcode, documenttype='PV', catcode = P.PurCatCode,
	dr_acccode = CASE WHEN @InvSys = 'P' THEN @ln_purchaseacc ELSE @ln_invacc END, 
	cr_acccode = CASE P.PurCatCode
		WHEN 3 THEN @ln_equityacc   /*Opening Purchase*/ ELSE CASE WHEN P.CustCode > 0 THEN P.CustCode ELSE P.suppcode END /*Credit Purhase*/ END,
	AlternateAccCode = Null,
	date    = CASE @ReportPurOnPostDate WHEN 'Y' THEN P.postdate ELSE P.Date END,
	SaleTax=CASE P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
		WHEN  'N' THEN 
			ROUND(
			SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice) * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) - P.flatdisc) * 
				(P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpTo) 
		ELSE 0.00 END,
	Gross=  CASE P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
			WHEN 'N' THEN
				ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + 
				P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, @RoundUpTo)
			ELSE
				ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + 
				P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, @RoundUpTo) + 
				ROUND(
				SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) +
				SUM(ROUND((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
					(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				ROUND((SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice) * 
					(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) - P.flatdisc) * 
					(P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpTo) 
			END,
	dr_remarks = 'Stock accounted for ' + CASE P.PurCatCode
				WHEN 3 THEN 'open.' WHEN 7 THEN 'loose' WHEN 8 THEN 'loose'
				ELSE 'pack' END + ' pur. #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.purinvcode))),
	cr_remarks = 
			CASE @PRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN P.Remarks
			ELSE CASE P.suppinvcode WHEN NULL THEN 
				CASE P.PurCatCode
				WHEN 3 THEN 'Opening Purchase #: '
				WHEN 7 THEN 'Payable on loose purchase #: '
				WHEN 8 THEN 'Payable on loose purchase #: '
				ELSE 	    'Payable on pack purchase #: ' END +
				RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.purinvcode))) ELSE 'Supp. Inv. # : ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(P.suppinvcode)) + ', Date : ' + LTRIM(RTRIM( convert(varchar(12), P.suppinvdate, 103))) END
			END,
	saletax_remarks= 'S.Tax payable on ' + 
			CASE P.PurCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'open' WHEN 7 THEN 'loose' WHEN 8 THEN 'loose'
			ELSE 'pack' END + ' pur. #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.purinvcode))),	CheckNo = NULL,
	usercode= P.salesmancode, vouchercode= P.purinvcode, invoicecode= P.purinvcode,

-- SP_VirtualGL_PurchaseReturn
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_PurchaseReturn
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_invacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0)
DECLARE @PRRemks CHAR(1), @InvSys CHAR(1), @RoundUpTo TINYINT

SET @RoundUpTo = (SELECT A=dbo.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('roundpurinvon'))
SET @InvSys = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'InventorySystemUsed')), 'P')

SET @ln_invacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_InventoryAcc')
SET @ln_purchaseacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseAccount')
SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_equityacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_EquityACC')
SET @ln_purchaseretacc  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseReturnsAccount')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')

SET @PRRemks = (SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'ShowPRetRemarksInLedger' ))

CREATE TABLE #lt_pret (code INT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO #lt_pret
SELECT  PRInvCode FROM PRLedger P
WHERE P.posted = 'Y' and P.accountfor = 'Y' AND 
	NOT EXISTS 
	(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
	FROM VirtualGL V 
	WHERE V.DocumentType = 'PR' AND V.DocumentCode = P.PRInvCode)

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp		/*accounting for purchase returns*/ 
SELECT  documentcode = P.prinvcode, documenttype    = 'PR', catcode = P.PRCatCode,
		dr_acccode = CASE P.PRCatCode
		WHEN 6 THEN @ln_equityacc /* Opening P/RETURN */ ELSE CASE WHEN P.CustCode > 0 THEN P.CustCode ELSE P.suppcode END /* Cash/Credit P/RETURN */ END,
 	cr_acccode = CASE WHEN @InvSys = 'P' THEN @ln_purchaseretacc ELSE @ln_invacc END,
	AlternateAccCode = Null,
 	date    = P.date,
	SaleTax= CASE P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
		WHEN  'N' THEN 
			ROUND(
			SUM((D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND(D.looseqty * D.prprice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM((D.looseqty * D.prprice) * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) -
				P.flatdisc) * (P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpTo)
		ELSE 0.00 END,
	Gross=  CASE P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
		WHEN  'N' THEN 
			ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty * D.prprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + 
				P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, @RoundUpTo)
		ELSE
			ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty * D.prprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + 
				P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, @RoundUpTo) +
			ROUND(
			SUM((D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND(D.looseqty * D.prprice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM((D.looseqty * D.prprice) * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) -
				P.flatdisc) * (P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpTo)
		END,
	dr_remarks = CASE @PRRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN P.Remarks
			ELSE CASE P.PrCatCode
				WHEN 6 THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Receivable on ' END + ' pur. return #: ' +
				RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.prinvcode))) 
			END,
	cr_remarks = 'Stock returned on ' + CASE P.PrCatCode WHEN 6 THEN 'open' ELSE '' END +
		' pur. return #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.prinvcode))),
	saletax_remarks= 'S.Tax receivable on ' + 
			CASE P.PrCatCode WHEN 6 THEN 'open' ELSE ':' END + 
			' pur. return #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), P.prinvcode))),	CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode = P.salesmancode, vouchercode=P.prinvcode, invoicecode=P.prinvcode,
	invoicetype = 4 /*4 stands for purchase return*/,
	Amt = P.Amt, DrAmtAccCode = P.PaymentAccCode, CrAmtAccCode = P.suppcode,
	AmtBy = P.AmtBy, AmtDate = P.AmtDate, AmtRef = P.AmtReference,
	OutstandingAmt = P.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0, PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax = 0.00, FBRPosFee=0.0
FROM  prledger P, prdetail DWHERE P.prinvcode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_pret) AND P.prinvcode = D.prinvcode
GROUP BY P.prinvcode, P.suppcode, P.CustCode, P.prcatcode, P.date, P.discperc, P.misccharges, 
	P.salestax, P.flatdisc, P.invgstperc1, P.salesmancode, P.Amt, P.PaymentAccCode, 
	P.AmtBy, P.AmtDate, P.AmtReference, P.OutstandingAmt, P.Remarks, P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate

TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_pret

-- SP_VirtualGL_PurchaseServices
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_PurchaseServices
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_exponsvc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0)

SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_exponsvc  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_ExpensesOnServices')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')

CREATE TABLE #lt_service (code INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE #lt_servicePR (code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lt_service
SELECT  ServicePurInvCode FROM ServicePurHeader
WHERE   Posted = 'Y' AND 
	NOT EXISTS 
	(SELECT DISTINCT V.DocumentCode 
	FROM VirtualGL V 
	WHERE V.DocumentType = 'SP' AND V.DocumentCode = ServicePurHeader.ServicePurInvCode)

INSERT INTO #lt_servicePR
SELECT  ServicePrInvCode FROM ServicePrHeader
WHERE   Posted = 'Y' AND 
	NOT EXISTS 
	(SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode 
	FROM VirtualGL V 
	WHERE V.DocumentType = 'RP' AND V.DocumentCode = ServicePrHeader.ServicePrInvCode)

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for Purchase of services*/
select  DocumentCode = h.ServicePurInvCode, DocumentType = 'SP', catcode = 1,
	dr_acccode = h.ExpAccCode, cr_acccode = h.SuppCode, AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	Date = h.date, SaleTax = 0,
	Gross = IsNull(Round(sum( (d.qty * isnull(d.price - d.serviceflatdisc, 0)) * 
		(1 - (.01 * isnull(d.discperc, 0)))) * 
		(1 - (.01 * ISNULL(h.discperc, 0))) + isnull(h.misccharges,0) - 
		isnull(h.flatdisc, 0), 0), 0),
	dr_remarks = 'Purchased Services Against Inv. #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), h.ServicePurInvCode))),
	cr_remarks = 'Payable On Services Purchased Against Inv. #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), h.ServicePurInvCode))),
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, UserCode=ISNULL(h.UserCode, 0), 
	vouchercode = h.ServicePurInvCode, invoicecode= h.ServicePurInvCode,
	invoicetype = 6, Amt =  0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL,
	AmtDate = NULL, AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = h.OutStandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=NULL, GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, 
	GuestCode = NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax = 0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
from servicepurheader h, servicepurdetail d
where h.ServicePurInvCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_service) AND
	  h.ServicePurInvCode = d.ServicePurInvCode
GROUP BY h.ServicePurInvCode, h.suppcode, h.ExpAccCode, h.date, h.discperc, h.misccharges, h.flatdisc, h.usercode,
	 h.OutStandingAmt, h.remarks

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for cash Paid via master cash window during service sales*/
SELECT  documentcode = S.ServicePurInvCode , documenttype    = 'SP', catcode = 1,
	dr_acccode = S.SuppCode,
	cr_acccode = S.CashAccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = S.CashCharged,
	dr_remarks = 'Cash Paid for Services Purchased on Inv. #: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.ServicePurInvCode, 10))), 
	cr_remarks = 'Cash Paid for Services Purchased on Inv. #: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.ServicePurInvCode, 10))), 
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.UserCode, vouchercode= S.ServicePurInvCode, invoicecode= S.ServicePurInvCode,
	invoicetype = 6,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = S.OutStandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=NULL, GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, 
	GuestCode = NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax = 0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM ServicePurHeader S
WHERE S.CashCharged > 0 AND S.ServicePurInvCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_service)
UNION ALL
SELECT  documentcode = S.ServicePurInvCode, documenttype = 'SP', catcode = 1,
	dr_acccode = S.SuppCode, cr_acccode = D.AccCode, AlternateAccCode = Null, 
	Date = S.date, SaleTax= 0, Gross = Amount, dr_remarks = D.Remarks, cr_remarks = D.Remarks,
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, UserCode= S.UserCode, 
	vouchercode= S.ServicePurInvCode, invoicecode= S.ServicePurInvCode,
	invoicetype = 6, Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, 
	AmtDate = NULL, AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = S.OutStandingAmt, Balance = 0, PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax = 0.00, FBRPosFee=0.0
FROM servicePurheader S, MasterCashWin D
WHERE S.ServicePurInvCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_service) AND D.DocumentType = 'SP' AND S.ServicePurInvCode = D.documentcode 

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for Purchase of services*/
select  DocumentCode = h.ServicePrInvCode, DocumentType = 'RP', catcode = 1,
	dr_acccode = h.SuppCode, cr_acccode = @ln_exponsvc, AlternateAccCode = NULL,
	Date = h.date, SaleTax = 0,
	Gross = IsNull(Round(sum( (d.qty * isnull(d.price - d.serviceflatdisc, 0)) * 
		(1 - (.01 * isnull(d.discperc, 0)))) * 
		(1 - (.01 * ISNULL(h.discperc, 0))) + isnull(h.misccharges,0) - 
		isnull(h.flatdisc, 0), 0), 0),
	dr_remarks = 'Services P/R Inv. #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), h.ServicePrInvCode))) + CASE WHEN h.ServicePurInvCode > 0 THEN ', Against Pur. # :' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), h.ServicePurInvCode))) ELSE '' END,
	cr_remarks = 'Services P/R Inv. #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), h.ServicePrInvCode))) + CASE WHEN h.ServicePurInvCode > 0 THEN ', Against Pur. # :' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), h.ServicePurInvCode))) ELSE '' END,
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, UserCode=ISNULL(h.UserCode, 0), 
	vouchercode = h.ServicePrInvCode, invoicecode= h.ServicePrInvCode,
	invoicetype = 8, Amt =  0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL,
	AmtDate = NULL, AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = h.OutStandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=NULL, GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, 
	GuestCode = NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax = 0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
from serviceprheader h, serviceprdetail d
where h.ServicePrInvCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_servicePR) AND
	  h.ServicePrInvCode = d.ServicePrInvCode
GROUP BY h.ServicePrInvCode, h.ServicePurInvCode, h.suppcode, h.date, h.discperc, h.misccharges, h.flatdisc, h.usercode, h.OutStandingAmt, h.remarks

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for cash received via master cash window during service sales*/
SELECT  documentcode = S.ServicePrInvCode , documenttype    = 'RP', catcode = 1,
	dr_acccode = S.CashAccCode,
	cr_acccode = S.SuppCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = S.CashCharged,
	dr_remarks = 'Cash Received for Services P/R Inv. #: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.ServicePrInvCode, 10))) + CASE WHEN S.ServicePurInvCode > 0 THEN ', Ref. Pur. # :' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.ServicePurInvCode))) ELSE '' END, 
	cr_remarks = 'Cash Received for Services P/R Inv. #: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.ServicePrInvCode, 10))) + CASE WHEN S.ServicePurInvCode > 0 THEN ', Ref. Pur. # :' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.ServicePurInvCode))) ELSE '' END, 
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.UserCode, vouchercode= S.ServicePrInvCode, invoicecode= S.ServicePrInvCode,
	invoicetype = 8,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = S.OutStandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=NULL, GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, 
	GuestCode = NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax = 0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM ServicePrHeader S
WHERE S.CashCharged > 0 AND S.ServicePrInvCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_servicePR)
UNION ALL
SELECT  documentcode = S.ServicePrInvCode, documenttype = 'RP', catcode = 1,
	dr_acccode = D.AccCode, cr_acccode = S.SuppCode, AlternateAccCode = Null, 
	Date = S.date, SaleTax= 0, Gross = Amount, dr_remarks = D.Remarks, cr_remarks = D.Remarks,
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, UserCode= S.UserCode, 
	vouchercode= S.ServicePrInvCode, invoicecode= S.ServicePrInvCode,
	invoicetype = 8, Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, 
	AmtDate = NULL, AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = S.OutStandingAmt, Balance = 0, PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax = 0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM servicePrheader S, MasterCashWin D
WHERE S.ServicePrInvCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_servicePR) AND D.DocumentType = 'RP' AND S.ServicePrInvCode = D.documentcode 

TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_service
TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_servicePR

-- SP_VirtualGL_Receipt
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Receipt AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @invacc smallint, @goodsacc smallint, @receiptexppayableacc smallint
DECLARE @InvSys CHAR(1), @SRemks CHAR(1)
SET @InvSys = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'InventorySystemUsed')), 'P')
SET @invacc = ISNULL((SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_InventoryAcc'), 7)
SET @goodsacc = ISNULL((SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_GoodsReceiptAcc'), 31)
SET @receiptexppayableacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_ReceiptExpPayableAcc')
SET @SRemks = (SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'ShowReceiptRemarksinledger' ))

CREATE TABLE #lsl (code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lsl
SELECT ReceiptInvCode FROM ReceiptHeader
WHERE Posted = 'Y' AND
	NOT EXISTS 
	(SELECT DISTINCT V.DocumentCode 
	FROM VirtualGL V 
	WHERE V.DocumentType IN ('RCT') AND V.DocumentCode = ReceiptHeader.ReceiptInvCode)

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for */
SELECT  documentcode = A.ReceiptInvCode, documenttype = 'RCT', catcode = A.ReceiptCategoryCode,
	dr_acccode = CASE WHEN @InvSys <> 'P' THEN @invacc ELSE @goodsacc END,
	cr_acccode = A.CrAccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null,
	Date    = A.postdate,
	SaleTax=0,
	Gross=Round(SUM(D.qty * D.Price), 0),
	dr_remarks = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN A.Remarks ELSE CASE WHEN A.remarks is null THEN 'Goods Receipt against Receipt Inv #' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(A.ReceiptInvCode))) ELSE A.remarks END END,
	cr_remarks = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN A.Remarks ELSE CASE WHEN A.remarks is null THEN 'Goods Receipt against Receipt Inv #' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(A.ReceiptInvCode))) ELSE A.remarks END END,
	saletax_remarks= '',	CheckNo = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(A.ReferenceNo)),20) ELSE NULL END, 
	UserCode= A.SalesmanCode, vouchercode= A.ReceiptCode, invoicecode= A.ReceiptInvCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0,
	DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, 
	AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL, AmtRef = NULL, 
	OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM ReceiptHeader A, ReceiptDetail D
WHERE A.AccountFor = 'Y' AND A.crAccCode IS NOT NULL AND A.ReceiptInvCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl) AND
	A.ReceiptInvCode = D.ReceiptInvCode
GROUP BY A.ReceiptInvCode, A.ReceiptCode, A.CrAccCode, A.ReceiptCategoryCode, A.PostDate, A.SalesmanCode, A.Remarks, A.ReferenceNo
UNION ALL     /* item receipt expenses */
SELECT  documentcode = A.ReceiptInvCode, documenttype = 'RCT', catcode = A.ReceiptCategoryCode,
	dr_acccode = A.QE1_AccCode,
	cr_acccode = A.QExp1_CrAccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null,
	Date    = A.postdate,
	SaleTax=0,
	Gross= ISNULL(Round(SUM(D.QE1 * D.Qty), 2), 0), 
	dr_remarks = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN A.Remarks ELSE CASE WHEN A.remarks is null THEN 'Item Receipt Exp. on Inv #: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(A.ReceiptInvCode))) ELSE A.remarks END END,
	cr_remarks = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN A.Remarks ELSE CASE WHEN A.remarks is null THEN 'Item Receipt Exp. payable on Inv #: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(A.ReceiptInvCode))) ELSE A.remarks END END,
	saletax_remarks= '',	CheckNo = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(A.ReferenceNo)),20) ELSE NULL END, 
	UserCode= A.SalesmanCode, vouchercode= A.ReceiptCode, invoicecode= A.ReceiptInvCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0,
	DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, 
	AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL, AmtRef = NULL, 
	OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM ReceiptHeader A, ReceiptDetail D
WHERE A.AccountFor = 'Y' AND A.crAccCode IS NOT NULL AND A.ReceiptInvCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl) AND
	A.ReceiptInvCode = D.ReceiptInvCode AND D.QE1 > 0 AND A.QE1_AccCode > 0
GROUP BY A.ReceiptInvCode, A.ReceiptCode, A.CrAccCode, A.ReceiptCategoryCode, A.PostDate, A.SalesmanCode, A.Remarks, A.QE1_AccCode, A.QExp1_CrAccCode, A.ReferenceNo 
UNION ALL     /* item receipt expenses */
SELECT  documentcode = A.ReceiptInvCode, documenttype = 'RCT', catcode = A.ReceiptCategoryCode,
	dr_acccode = A.QE2_AccCode,
	cr_acccode = A.QExp2_CrAccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null,
	Date    = A.postdate,
	SaleTax=0,
	Gross= ISNULL(Round(SUM(D.QE2 * D.Qty), 2), 0), 	dr_remarks = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN A.Remarks ELSE CASE WHEN A.remarks is null THEN 'Item Receipt Exp. on Inv #: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(A.ReceiptInvCode))) ELSE A.remarks END END,
	cr_remarks = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN A.Remarks ELSE CASE WHEN A.remarks is null THEN 'Item Receipt Exp. payable on Inv #: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(A.ReceiptInvCode))) ELSE A.remarks END END,
	saletax_remarks= '',	CheckNo = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(A.ReferenceNo)),20) ELSE NULL END, 
	UserCode= A.SalesmanCode, vouchercode= A.ReceiptCode, invoicecode= A.ReceiptInvCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0,
	DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, 
	AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL, AmtRef = NULL, 
	OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM ReceiptHeader A, ReceiptDetail D
WHERE A.AccountFor = 'Y' AND A.crAccCode IS NOT NULL AND A.ReceiptInvCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl) AND
	A.ReceiptInvCode = D.ReceiptInvCode AND D.QE2 > 0 AND A.QE2_AccCode > 0
GROUP BY A.ReceiptInvCode, A.ReceiptCode, A.CrAccCode, A.ReceiptCategoryCode, A.PostDate, A.SalesmanCode, A.Remarks, A.QE2_AccCode, A.QExp2_CrAccCode, A.ReferenceNo
UNION ALL     /* item receipt expenses */
SELECT  documentcode = A.ReceiptInvCode, documenttype = 'RCT', catcode = A.ReceiptCategoryCode,
	dr_acccode = A.QE3_AccCode,
	cr_acccode = A.QExp3_CrAccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null,
	Date    = A.postdate,
	SaleTax=0,
	Gross= ISNULL(Round(SUM(D.QE3 * D.Qty), 2), 0), 
	dr_remarks = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN A.Remarks ELSE CASE WHEN A.remarks is null THEN 'Item Receipt Exp. on Inv #: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(A.ReceiptInvCode))) ELSE A.remarks END END, 
	cr_remarks = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN A.Remarks ELSE CASE WHEN A.remarks is null THEN 'Item Receipt Exp. payable on Inv #: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(A.ReceiptInvCode))) ELSE A.remarks END END,
	saletax_remarks= '',	CheckNo = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(A.ReferenceNo)),20) ELSE NULL END, 
	UserCode= A.SalesmanCode, vouchercode= A.ReceiptCode, invoicecode= A.ReceiptInvCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0,
	DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, 
	AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL, AmtRef = NULL, 
	OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM ReceiptHeader A, ReceiptDetail D
WHERE A.AccountFor = 'Y' AND A.crAccCode IS NOT NULL AND A.ReceiptInvCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl) AND
	A.ReceiptInvCode = D.ReceiptInvCode AND D.QE3 > 0 AND A.QE3_AccCode > 0
GROUP BY A.ReceiptInvCode, A.ReceiptCode, A.CrAccCode, A.ReceiptCategoryCode, A.PostDate, A.SalesmanCode, A.Remarks, A.QE3_AccCode, A.QExp3_CrAccCode, A.ReferenceNo
UNION ALL     /* item receipt expenses */
SELECT  documentcode = A.ReceiptInvCode, documenttype = 'RCT', catcode = A.ReceiptCategoryCode,
	dr_acccode = A.QE4_AccCode,
	cr_acccode = A.QExp4_CrAccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null,
	Date    = A.postdate,
	SaleTax=0,
	Gross= ISNULL(Round(SUM(D.QE4 * D.Qty), 2), 0), 
	dr_remarks = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN A.Remarks ELSE CASE WHEN A.remarks is null THEN 'Item Receipt Exp. on Inv #: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(A.ReceiptInvCode))) ELSE A.remarks END END,
	cr_remarks = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN A.Remarks ELSE CASE WHEN A.remarks is null THEN 'Item Receipt Exp. payable on Inv #: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(A.ReceiptInvCode))) ELSE A.remarks END END,
	saletax_remarks= '',	CheckNo = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(A.ReferenceNo)),20) ELSE NULL END, 
	UserCode= A.SalesmanCode, vouchercode= A.ReceiptCode, invoicecode= A.ReceiptInvCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0,
	DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, 
	AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL, AmtRef = NULL, 
	OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=NULL,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM ReceiptHeader A, ReceiptDetail D
