-- SP_VirtualGL_SaleOrder
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_SaleOrder
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0)

SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_salesacc    = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesACC')
SET @ln_salesretacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesReturnACC')
SET @ln_revfromservice  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_RevenueFromServices')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')

CREATE TABLE #lt_saleorder (code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lt_saleorder 
SELECT SaleOrderCode FROM SaleOrderHeader
WHERE Posted = 'Y' AND
	NOT EXISTS 
	(SELECT DISTINCT V.DocumentCode 
	FROM VirtualGL V 
	WHERE V.DocumentType IN ('SO') AND V.DocumentCode = SaleOrderHeader.SaleOrderCode)

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*Accounting Advance on Sales Order */
SELECT  documentcode = S.saleordercode, documenttype    = 'SO', catcode = 1,
	dr_acccode = S.PaymentAccCode, cr_acccode = S.custcode, AlternateAccCode = Null,
	Date    = S.AmtDate, SaleTax= 0, 
	Gross= S.Amt,
	dr_remarks = 'Advance received on sale order #: ' + 
		RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleordercode))),
	cr_remarks = 'Advance received on sale order #: ' + 
		RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleordercode))),
	saletax_remarks= NULL, CheckNo = S.AmtReference, UserCode= S.AmtBy, vouchercode= S.SaleOrdercode,
	invoicecode= S.SaleOrderCode, invoicetype = NULL, Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL,
	CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL, AmtRef = NULL, 
	OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0, PatientCode= S.PatientCode,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, Guestcode=NuLL, Studentcode=NuLL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM    SaleOrderHeader S
WHERE   S.SaleOrderCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_saleorder) AND
	S.Amt > 0 AND S.AmtDate IS NOT NULL

TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_saleorder

-- SP_VirtualGL_Sales
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Sales
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_invacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cgs NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_AdvIncomeTaxSale NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_fbrposfeeacc NUMERIC(5,0)
DECLARE @SRemks CHAR(1), @InvSys CHAR(1), @RoundUpYo TINYINT, @AdvIncomeTax CHAR(1)

SET @AdvIncomeTax = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference('ApplyAdvanceIncomeTaxInSale')), 'N')
SET @RoundUpYo = (SELECT A=dbo.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('roundsaleinvon'))
SET @InvSys = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'InventorySystemUsed')), 'P')
SET @ln_invacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_InventoryAcc')
SET @ln_cgs = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CostOfGoodsSoldAcc')
SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_salesacc    = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesACC')
SET @ln_salesretacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesReturnACC')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')
SET @ln_AdvIncomeTaxSale = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvIncomeTaxSale')
SET @ln_fbrposfeeacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_FBRPOSFeeAcc')

SET @SRemks = (SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'ShowSaleRemarksInLedger' ))

CREATE TABLE #lsl (code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lsl
SELECT  SaleInvCode FROM SaleLedger S
WHERE S.Posted = 'Y'	 and S.AccountFor = 'Y' AND 
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT DocumentCode FROM VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType = 'SV' AND V.DocumentCode = S.SaleInvCode)

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for sales*/
SELECT  documentcode = S.saleinvcode, documenttype    = 'SV', catcode = S.SaleCatCode,
	dr_acccode = CASE S.saleCatCode	WHEN 1 THEN S.CashAccCode /* Cash Sale */
		WHEN 3 THEN S.CashAccCode /* Cash Sale */ ELSE S.custcode /* Credit Sale */ END,
	cr_acccode = @ln_salesacc,
	AlternateAccCode = CASE S.saleCatCode WHEN 1 THEN S.custcode  /* Cash Sale */
		WHEN 3 THEN S.custcode  /* Cash Sale */ ELSE Null END,
	Date    = S.date,
	SaleTax=CASE S.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
		WHEN  'N' THEN
			Round(
			SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * S.discperc)) -
				S.flatdisc) * (S.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpYo)
		ELSE 0.00 END,
	Gross=CASE S.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
		WHEN  'N' THEN
			Round(
				SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * S.discperc)) + 
					S.misccharges + S.salestax - S.flatdisc, @RoundUpYo)
		ELSE 
			Round(
				SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * S.discperc)) + 
					S.misccharges + S.salestax - S.flatdisc, @RoundUpYo) +
			Round(
			SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * S.discperc)) -
				S.flatdisc) * (S.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpYo)
		END,
	dr_remarks = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN S.Remarks
			ELSE CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'Cash receipt on sale #: '
				WHEN 1 THEN 'Cash receipt on sale #: ' 
				ELSE 'Receivable on cr. sale #: ' END +
				RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))) 
			END,
	cr_remarks = 'Revenue from ' + CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'cash' 
			WHEN 1 THEN 'cash' ELSE 'cr.' END + ' sale #: ' + 
			RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))),
	saletax_remarks= 'S.Tax ' + CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'received' 
		WHEN 1 THEN 'received' ELSE 'receivable' END + ' on ' + 
		CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'cash' WHEN 1 THEN 'cash'
		ELSE 'cr.' END + ' sale #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))),	CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.salesmancode, vouchercode= S.saleinvcode, invoicecode= S.saleinvcode,
	invoicetype = 1 /*1 stands for sales*/,
	Amt = CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 2 THEN S.Amt ELSE 0 END,
	DrAmtAccCode = S.PaymentAccCode, CrAmtAccCode = S.Custcode, 
	AmtBy = S.AmtBy, AmtDate = S.AmtDate, AmtRef = S.AmtReference, 
	OutstandingAmt = S.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
					CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
					ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
					END
				ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = S.GRN, GCCode = S.GCCode, Vehicle = S.Vehicle, ShipTo = S.ShipTo, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, CGS=ISNULL(SUM((D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.AvgPrice), 0),
	S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate,
	AdvIncomeTax = CASE WHEN @AdvIncomeTax = 'Y' THEN ISNULL(S.AdvanceTaxAmt,0) ELSE 0 END, S.FBRPosFee
FROM saleledger S, saledetail D
WHERE S.saleinvcode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl) AND
	S.saleinvcode = D.saleinvcode 
GROUP BY S.saleinvcode, S.custcode, S.salecatcode, S.date, S.discperc, S.misccharges, 
	S.salestax, S.flatdisc, S.invgstperc1, S.salesmancode, S.Amt, S.PaymentAccCode,
	S.AmtBy, S.AmtDate, S.AmtReference, S.OutstandingAmt, S.patientcode, S.admissioncode, S.Remarks,
	S.GRN, S.GCCode, S.Vehicle, S.ShipTo, S.CashAccCode, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, S.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate, S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate, S.AdvanceTaxAmt, S.FBRPosFee

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for sales having impactinventory='Y' and account for ='Y'*/
SELECT  documentcode = S.saleinvcode, documenttype    = 'SV', catcode = S.SaleCatCode,
	dr_acccode = CASE S.saleCatCode	WHEN 1 THEN S.CashAccCode /* Cash Sale */ 
		WHEN 3 THEN S.CashAccCode /* Cash Sale */ ELSE S.custcode /* Credit Sale */ END,
	cr_acccode = @ln_salesacc,
	AlternateAccCode = CASE S.saleCatCode WHEN 1 THEN S.custcode /* Cash Sale */
		WHEN 3 THEN S.custcode  /* Cash Sale */ ELSE Null END,
	Date    = S.date,
	SaleTax=CASE S.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
		WHEN  'N' THEN
			Round(
			SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * S.discperc)) -
				S.flatdisc) * (S.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpYo)
		ELSE 0.00 END,
	Gross=CASE S.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
		WHEN  'N' THEN
			Round(
			SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *	(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * S.discperc)) + 
				S.misccharges + S.salestax - S.flatdisc, @RoundUpYo)
		ELSE 
			Round(
			SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *	(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * S.discperc)) + 
				S.misccharges + S.salestax - S.flatdisc, @RoundUpYo) + 
			Round(
			SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * S.discperc)) -
				S.flatdisc) * (S.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpYo)
		END,
	dr_remarks = CASE @SRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN S.Remarks
		ELSE CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'Cash receipt on sale #: '
			WHEN 1 THEN 'Cash receipt on sale #: ' ELSE 'Receivable on cr. sale #: ' END +
			RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))) 
		END,
	cr_remarks = 'Revenue from ' + CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'cash' 
		WHEN 1 THEN 'cash' ELSE 'cr.' END + ' sale #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))),
	saletax_remarks= 'S.Tax ' + CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'received'
		WHEN 1 THEN 'received' ELSE 'receivable' END + ' on ' + 
		CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 3 THEN 'cash' WHEN 1 THEN 'cash' ELSE 'cr.' END + ' sale #: ' + 
		RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))),	CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.salesmancode, vouchercode= S.saleinvcode, invoicecode= S.saleinvcode,
	invoicetype = 1 /*1 stands for sales*/,
	Amt = CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 2 THEN S.Amt ELSE 0 END,
	DrAmtAccCode = S.PaymentAccCode, CrAmtAccCode = S.Custcode,
	AmtBy = S.AmtBy, AmtDate = S.AmtDate, AmtRef = S.AmtReference,
	OutstandingAmt = S.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
					CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
					ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
					END
				ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = S.GRN, GCCode = S.GCCode, Vehicle = S.Vehicle, ShipTo = S.ShipTo, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, CGS=0,
	S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate,
	AdvIncomeTax = CASE WHEN @AdvIncomeTax = 'Y' THEN ISNULL(S.AdvanceTaxAmt,0) ELSE 0 END, S.FBRPosFee
FROM saleledger S, saleinvdetail D
WHERE S.saleinvcode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl) AND S.saleinvcode = D.saleinvcode 
GROUP BY S.saleinvcode, S.custcode, S.salecatcode, S.date, S.discperc, S.misccharges,
	S.salestax, S.flatdisc, S.invgstperc1, S.salesmancode, S.Amt, S.PaymentAccCode,
	S.AmtBy, S.AmtDate, S.AmtReference, S.OutstandingAmt, S.patientcode, S.admissioncode, S.Remarks,
	S.GRN, S.GCCode, S.Vehicle, S.ShipTo, S.CashAccCode, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, S.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate, S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate, S.AdvanceTaxAmt, S.FBRPosFee

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for sales receivable Adjustments made at the time of invoicing*/
SELECT  documentcode = S.saleinvcode, documenttype    = 'SV', catcode = S.SaleCatCode,
	dr_acccode = CASE WHEN D.Debit > 0 THEN AccCode ELSE S.CustCode END,
	cr_acccode = CASE WHEN D.Debit > 0 THEN S.CustCode ELSE AccCode END,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = CASE WHEN D.Debit > 0 THEN D.Debit ELSE D.Credit END,
	dr_remarks = D.Remarks, cr_remarks = D.Remarks,
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = D.CheckNo, 
	UserCode= S.salesmancode, vouchercode= S.saleinvcode, invoicecode= S.saleinvcode,
	invoicetype = 1 /*1 stands for sales*/,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = S.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
					CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
					ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
					END
				ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = S.GRN, GCCode = S.GCCode, Vehicle = S.Vehicle, ShipTo = S.ShipTo, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, CGS=0, S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate,
	AdvIncomeTax = 0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM saleledger S, SaleReceivableAdj D
WHERE S.saleinvcode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl) AND S.saleinvcode = D.saleinvcode 

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for cash received via master cash window during sales*/
SELECT  documentcode = S.saleinvcode, documenttype    = 'SV', catcode = S.SaleCatCode,
	dr_acccode = S.CashAccCode,
	cr_acccode = S.CustCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = S.CashCharged,
	dr_remarks = 'Cash Received on Sale Inv. No.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.SaleInvCode, 10))), 
	cr_remarks = 'Cash Received on Sale Inv. No.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.SaleInvCode, 10))),
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.salesmancode, vouchercode= S.saleinvcode, invoicecode= S.saleinvcode,
	invoicetype = 1 /*1 stands for sales*/,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = S.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
					CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
					ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
					END
				ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = S.GRN, GCCode = S.GCCode, Vehicle = S.Vehicle, ShipTo = S.ShipTo, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, CGS=0, S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate,
	AdvIncomeTax = 0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM saleledger S
WHERE S.SaleCatCode NOT IN (1, 3) AND S.CashCharged > 0 AND 
	S.saleinvcode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl)
UNION ALL
SELECT  documentcode = S.saleinvcode, documenttype    = 'SV', catcode = S.SaleCatCode,
	dr_acccode = D.AccCode,
	cr_acccode = S.CustCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = Amount,
	dr_remarks = D.Remarks, cr_remarks = D.Remarks,
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.salesmancode, vouchercode= S.saleinvcode, invoicecode= S.saleinvcode,
	invoicetype = 1 /*1 stands for sales*/,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = S.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
					CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
					ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
					END
				ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = S.GRN, GCCode = S.GCCode, Vehicle = S.Vehicle, ShipTo = S.ShipTo, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, CGS=0, S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate,
	AdvIncomeTax = 0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM saleledger S, CashierWindow D
WHERE S.saleinvcode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lsl) AND S.saleinvcode = D.saleinvcode 

TRUNCATE TABLE #lsl

-- SP_VirtualGL_SalesReturn
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_SalesReturn
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_invacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cgs NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0)

DECLARE @SRRemks CHAR(1), @InvSys CHAR(1), @RoundUpYo TINYINT

SET @RoundUpYo = (SELECT A=dbo.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('roundsalereturninvon'))
SET @InvSys = ISNULL((SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'InventorySystemUsed')), 'P')

SET @ln_invacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_InventoryAcc')
SET @ln_cgs = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CostOfGoodsSoldAcc')
SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_salesacc    = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesACC')
SET @ln_salesretacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_SalesReturnACC')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')

SET @SRRemks = (SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'ShowSRetRemarksInLedger' ))

CREATE TABLE #lt_sret (code INT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO #lt_sret
SELECT  SRInvCode FROM SRLedger S
WHERE S.posted = 'Y'	 and S.accountfor = 'Y' AND
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT V.DocumentCode FROM VirtualGL V WHERE V.DocumentType = 'SR' AND V.DocumentCode = S.SRInvCode)

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for sales return*/
SELECT  documentcode = S.srinvcode, documenttype = 'SR', catcode = S.SRCatCode,
	dr_acccode = @ln_salesretacc,
	cr_acccode = CASE S.srCatCode WHEN 6 THEN S.CashAccCode /* Cash S/Return*/ 
		WHEN 8 THEN S.CashAccCode /* Cash S/Return*/ ELSE S.custcode /* Credit S/Return*/ END,
	AlternateAccCode = CASE S.srCatCode WHEN 6 THEN S.custcode /* Cash S/Return*/
		WHEN 8 THEN S.custcode /* Cash S/Return*/ ELSE NULL /* Credit S/Return*/ END,
	Date    = S.date,
	SaleTax=CASE S.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
		WHEN  'N' THEN
			ROUND(
			SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (D.looseqty * D.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (sum( (D.looseqty * D.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * S.discperc)) - S.flatdisc) * (S.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpYo)
		ELSE 0.00 END,
	Gross= CASE S.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate 
		WHEN  'N' THEN
			Round( sum( (D.looseqty * D.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
			    (1- (.01 * S.discperc)) + S.misccharges + S.salestax - S.flatdisc, @RoundUpYo)
		ELSE
			Round( sum( (D.looseqty * D.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
			    (1- (.01 * S.discperc)) + S.misccharges + S.salestax - S.flatdisc, @RoundUpYo) + 
			ROUND(
			SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (D.looseqty * D.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (sum( (D.looseqty * D.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * S.discperc)) - S.flatdisc) * (S.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), @RoundUpYo)
		END,
	dr_remarks = 'Revenue (reversal) on ' + CASE S.SRCatCode WHEN 6 THEN 'cash'
		WHEN 8 THEN 'cash' ELSE 'cr.' END + ' sale ret. #: ' + 
		RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.srinvcode))) + 
		CASE WHEN S.saleinvcode is null Then '' 
		     ELSE ', Sale #:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))) END,
	cr_remarks = CASE @SRRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN S.Remarks
		ELSE CASE S.SRCatCode WHEN 6 THEN 'Cash paid on sale ret.#: '
			WHEN 8 THEN 'Cash paid on sale ret.#: ' ELSE 'Payable on cr. sale ret.#: ' END +
			RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.srinvcode))) + 
			CASE WHEN S.saleinvcode is null Then '' 
			     ELSE ', Sale #:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))) END
		END,
	saletax_remarks= 'S.Tax ' + 
		CASE S.SRCatCode WHEN 6 THEN 'Paid' WHEN 8 THEN 'Paid' ELSE 'Payable' END + 
		' on sale ret. #: ' +  RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.srinvcode)))+ 
		CASE WHEN S.saleinvcode is null Then '' 
		     ELSE ', sale #:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.saleinvcode))) END,	CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= ISNULL(S.salesmancode, 0), vouchercode= S.srinvcode, invoicecode= S.srinvcode,
	invoicetype = 3 /*3 stands for sales return*/,
	Amt =  CASE S.SRCatCode WHEN 8 THEN 0 ELSE S.Amt END,
	DrAmtAccCode = S.Custcode, CrAmtAccCode = S.PaymentAccCode, AmtBy = S.AmtBy,
	AmtDate = S.AmtDate, AmtRef = S.AmtReference,
	OutstandingAmt = S.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
			CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
			ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
			END
		ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode,
	CGS=ISNULL(SUM((D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * CASE WHEN S.SaleInvCode > 0 THEN D.AvgPrice ELSE (D.SRPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - S.DiscPerc * 0.01)) END),0),
	S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate, AdvIncomeTax=ISNULL(S.AdvanceTaxAmt,0), FBRPosFee= ISNULL(S.FBRPosFee,0)
FROM srledger S, srdetail D
WHERE S.srinvcode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_sret) AND S.srinvcode = D.srinvcode 
GROUP BY S.srinvcode, S.custcode, S.srcatcode, S.CashAccCode, S.date, S.discperc, S.misccharges,
	 S.salestax, S.flatdisc, S.invgstperc1, S.salesmancode, S.saleinvcode, S.Amt,
	 S.PaymentAccCode, S.AmtBy, S.AmtDate, S.AmtReference, S.OutstandingAmt,
	 S.PatientCode, S.AdmissionCode, S.CashAccCode, S.Remarks,
	 S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, S.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate, S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate, S.AdvanceTaxAmt, S.FBRPosFee

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for cash received via master cash window during sales*/
SELECT  documentcode = S.srinvcode, documenttype = 'SR', catcode = S.SRCatCode,
	dr_acccode = S.CustCode,
	cr_acccode = S.CashAccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = S.CashCharged,
	dr_remarks = 'Cash Paid on S/R No.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.SRInvCode, 10))), 
	cr_remarks = 'Cash Paid on S/R No.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.SRInvCode, 10))),
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.salesmancode, vouchercode= S.srinvcode, invoicecode= S.srinvcode,
	invoicetype = 3 /*3 stands for sale return*/,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = S.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
					CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
					ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
					END
				ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, CGS=0,
	S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate, AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM srledger S
WHERE S.SRCatCode NOT IN (6, 8) AND S.CashCharged > 0 AND 
	S.srinvcode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_sret)
UNION ALL
SELECT  documentcode = S.srinvcode, documenttype    = 'SR', catcode = S.SRCatCode,
	dr_acccode = S.CustCode,
	cr_acccode = D.AccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = Amount,
	dr_remarks = D.Remarks, cr_remarks = D.Remarks,
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.salesmancode, vouchercode= S.srinvcode, invoicecode= S.srinvcode,
	invoicetype = 3 /*3 stands for sales Return*/,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = S.OutstandingAmt, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
					CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
					ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
					END
				ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, S.GuestCode, S.StudentCode, CGS=0,
	S.CurrencyCode, S.ConversionRate,AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM srledger S, MasterCashWin D
WHERE S.srinvcode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_sret) AND S.srinvcode = D.DocumentCode AND D.DocumentType = 'SR'

TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_sret

-- SP_VirtualGL_Services
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Services
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @revfromservice INT
DECLARE @SvcRemks CHAR(1), @SvcRRemks CHAR(1)

SET @revfromservice  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_RevenueFromServices')

SET @SvcRemks = (SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'ShowSvcRemarksInLedger' ))
SET @SvcRRemks = (SELECT a=DBO.Fn_GetPreference( 'ShowSvcRetRemarksInLedger' ))

CREATE TABLE #lt_service (code INT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO #lt_service
SELECT  ServiceInvCode FROM ServiceHeader S
WHERE   NOT EXISTS 
	(SELECT DISTINCT V.DocumentCode 
	FROM VirtualGL V 
	WHERE V.DocumentType = 'RS' AND V.DocumentCode = S.ServiceInvCode) AND S.posted = 'Y'

CREATE TABLE #lt_serviceret (code INT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO #lt_serviceret
SELECT  ServiceRInvCode FROM ServiceRHeader S
WHERE   
	NOT EXISTS 
	(SELECT DISTINCT V.DocumentCode 
	FROM VirtualGL V 
	WHERE V.DocumentType = 'RR' AND V.DocumentCode = S.ServiceRInvCode ) AND S.posted = 'Y'

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for sales of services*/
select  DocumentCode = h.serviceinvcode, 
	DocumentType = 'RS',
	catcode = h.ServiceCatCode,
	dr_acccode = h.custcode,
	cr_acccode = @revfromservice,
	AlternateAccCode = CASE WHEN h.ServiceCatCode = 10 THEN h.custcode WHEN h.ServiceCatCode = 12 THEN h.custcode ELSE NULL END,
	Date = h.date, 
	SaleTax = Round(
		ISNULL(Sum((D.qty * (D.Price - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - D.discperc * 0.01)) * 0.01 * D.servicegstPerc), 0) +
		ISNULL(Sum(D.qty * D.serviceflattax), 0) +
		ISNULL(Round((Sum(D.qty * (D.Price - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - D.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - H.discperc * 0.01)) - H.flatdisc ) * 0.01 * H.serviceinvgstperc, 2),0)
		,0),
	Gross = IsNull(Round(sum( (d.qty * isnull(d.price - d.serviceflatdisc, 0)) * 
		(1 - (.01 * isnull(d.discperc, 0)))) * 
		(1 - (.01 * ISNULL(h.discperc, 0))) + isnull(h.misccharges,0) - 
		isnull(h.flatdisc, 0), 0), 0),
	dr_remarks = CASE @SvcRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN h.Remarks
		ELSE CASE h.ServiceCatCode WHEN 10 THEN 'Sale of Service on Inv. #: '
			WHEN 12 THEN 'Sale of Service on Inv. #: '
			ELSE 'Receivable on cr. service #: ' END +
			RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), h.serviceinvcode)))+ 
			CASE WHEN h.saleinvcode is null Then '' 
			     ELSE ', sale #:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), h.saleinvcode))) END
		END,
	cr_remarks = CASE h.ServiceCatCode
			WHEN 10 THEN 'Revenue from cash service #: '
			ELSE 'Revenue from credit service #: ' END +
			RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), h.serviceinvcode))),
	saletax_remarks= 'Sales Tax Payable on Service Inv. #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), h.serviceinvcode))),	CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode=ISNULL(h.salesmancode, 0), vouchercode = h.serviceinvcode, invoicecode= h.serviceinvcode,
	invoicetype = 5 /* Service sales */,
	Amt =  0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL,
	AmtDate = NULL, AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN h.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
			CASE WHEN h.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
			ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE h.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
			END
		ELSE h.PatientCode END,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode = H.GuestCode, StudentCode=H.StudentCode, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
from serviceheader h, servicedetail d
where h.serviceinvcode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_service) AND
	  h.serviceinvcode = d.serviceinvcode 
GROUP BY h.serviceinvcode, h.custcode, h.ServiceCatCode, h.cashacccode,
	 h.date, h.discperc, h.misccharges, h.flatdisc, h.serviceinvgstperc, h.salesmancode,
	 h.saleinvcode, h.patientcode, h.admissioncode, h.remarks, H.GuestCode, H.StudentCode

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for cash received via master cash window during service sales*/
SELECT  documentcode = S.serviceinvcode, documenttype    = 'RS', catcode = S.ServiceCatCode,
	dr_acccode = S.CashAccCode,
	cr_acccode = S.CustCode,
	AlternateAccCode = NULL, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross =	CASE WHEN S.CashCharged > 0 THEN S.CashCharged ELSE 0 END,
	dr_remarks = 'Cash Received on Service Inv. No.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.ServiceInvCode, 10))), 
	cr_remarks = 'Cash Received on Service Inv. No.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.ServiceInvCode, 10))),
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.salesmancode, vouchercode= S.serviceinvcode, invoicecode= S.serviceinvcode,
	invoicetype = 5,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
					CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
					ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
					END
				ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode = S.GuestCode, StudentCode=S.StudentCode, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM serviceheader S
WHERE S.CashCharged > 0 AND S.serviceinvcode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_service)
UNION ALL
SELECT  documentcode = S.serviceinvcode, documenttype    = 'RS', catcode = S.serviceCatCode,
	dr_acccode = D.AccCode,
	cr_acccode = S.CustCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = D.Amount,
	dr_remarks = D.Remarks, cr_remarks = D.Remarks,
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.salesmancode, vouchercode= S.serviceinvcode, invoicecode= S.serviceinvcode,
	invoicetype = 5,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
					CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
					ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
					END
				ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=S.GuestCode, StudentCode=S.StudentCode, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM serviceheader S, MasterCashWin D
WHERE S.serviceinvcode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_service) AND D.DocumentType = 'RS' AND S.serviceinvcode = D.documentcode 

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for sales returns of services*/
select  DocumentCode = h.serviceRinvcode, 
	DocumentType = 'RR',
	catcode = h.ServiceRCatCode,
	dr_acccode = @revfromservice,
	cr_acccode = h.custcode,
	AlternateAccCode = Case h.ServiceRCatCode when 13 THEN h.custcode when 15 THEN h.custcode else NULL End,
	Date    = h.date, 
	SaleTax = 
		Round(
		ISNULL(Sum((D.qty * (D.serviceprice - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - D.discperc * 0.01)) * 0.01 * D.servicegstPerc), 0) +
		ISNULL(Sum(D.qty * D.serviceflattax), 0) +
		ISNULL(Round((Sum(D.qty * (D.serviceprice - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - D.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - H.discperc * 0.01)) - H.flatdisc ) * 0.01 * H.serviceinvgstperc, 2),0)
		,0),
	Gross   = IsNull(Round(sum( d.qty * (isnull(d.ServicePrice - d.serviceflatdisc, 0)) * (1 - (.01 * isnull(d.discperc, 0)))) * 
		  (1- (.01 * h.discperc)) + isnull(h.misccharges,0) - isnull(h.flatdisc, 0), 0), 0),
	dr_remarks = 'Revenue (reversal) for ' + CASE h.ServiceRCatCode
		WHEN 13 THEN 'cash' WHEN 15 THEN 'cash' ELSE 'cr.' END + 
		' service return #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), h.serviceRinvcode))) + 
		CASE WHEN h.serviceinvcode is null Then '' 
		     ELSE ', service #:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), h.serviceinvcode))) END,
	cr_remarks = CASE @SvcRRemks WHEN 'Y' THEN h.Remarks
			ELSE CASE h.ServiceRCatCode WHEN 13 THEN 'cash paid on'
				WHEN 15 THEN 'cash paid on' ELSE 'Payable on cr.' END + 
				' service return #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), h.serviceRinvcode))) + 
				CASE WHEN h.serviceinvcode is null Then '' 
				     ELSE ', service #:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), h.serviceinvcode))) END
			END,
	saletax_remarks= 'Sales Tax Payable (Reveral) on Service Ret Inv. #: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), h.serviceRinvcode))),	CheckNo = NULL, UserCode=h.salesmancode, vouchercode = h.serviceRinvcode,
	invoicecode= h.serviceRinvcode, invoicetype = 7 /* Service Return */,
	Amt =  0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL, 
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN h.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
			CASE WHEN h.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
			ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE h.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
			END
		ELSE h.PatientCode END,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode = H.GuestCode, StudentCode=H.StudentCode, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
from serviceRheader h, serviceRdetail d
where h.serviceRinvcode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_serviceret) AND
	 h.serviceRinvcode = d.serviceRinvcode 
GROUP BY h.serviceRinvcode, h.custcode, h.ServiceRCatCode, h.cashacccode, h.date, h.discperc, h.misccharges, 
	h.flatdisc, H.serviceinvgstperc, h.salesmancode, h.serviceinvcode, h.patientcode, h.admissioncode, h.Remarks, H.GuestCode, H.StudentCode

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/*accounting for cash received via master cash window during service return */
SELECT  documentcode = S.serviceRinvcode, documenttype    = 'RR', catcode = S.ServiceRCatCode,
	dr_acccode = S.CustCode,
	cr_acccode = S.CashAccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = CASE WHEN S.CashCharged > 0 THEN S.CashCharged ELSE 0 END,
	dr_remarks = 'Cash paid on Service Ret. No.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.ServiceRInvCode, 10))), 
	cr_remarks = 'Cash paid on Service Ret. No.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.ServiceRInvCode, 10))),
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.salesmancode, vouchercode= S.servicerinvcode, invoicecode= S.serviceRinvcode,
	invoicetype = 7,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
					CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
					ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
					END
				ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode = S.GuestCode, StudentCode=S.StudentCode, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM servicerheader S
WHERE S.CashCharged > 0 AND S.serviceRinvcode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_serviceret)
UNION ALL
SELECT  documentcode = S.serviceRinvcode, documenttype    = 'RR', catcode = S.serviceRCatCode,
	dr_acccode = S.CustCode,
	cr_acccode = D.AccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = S.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = D.Amount,
	dr_remarks = D.Remarks, cr_remarks = D.Remarks,
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= S.salesmancode, vouchercode= S.serviceRinvcode, invoicecode= S.serviceRinvcode,
	invoicetype = 7,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=CASE WHEN S.PatientCode IS NULL THEN 
					CASE WHEN S.AdmissionCode IS NULL THEN NULL
					ELSE (SELECT A.Patientcode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE S.AdmissionCode = A.AdmissionCode)
					END
				ELSE S.PatientCode END,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode = S.GuestCode, StudentCode=S.StudentCode, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM serviceRheader S, MasterCashWin D
WHERE S.serviceRinvcode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_serviceret) AND D.DocumentType = 'RR' AND S.serviceRinvcode = D.documentcode

DELETE VirtualGLTemp WHERE Gross = 0 AND Amt = 0 AND SaleTax=0 AND AdvIncomeTax=0.00

TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_service
TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_serviceret

-- SP_VirtualGL_TransactionWindow
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_TransactionWindow
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

CREATE TABLE #lt_transaction (code INT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO #lt_transaction
SELECT T.DocumentCode
FROM TransactionHeader T
WHERE NOT EXISTS 
	(SELECT DISTINCT V.DocumentCode 
	FROM VirtualGL V 
	WHERE V.DocumentType IN (SELECT ShortName FROM TransactionType) AND V.DocumentCode = T.DocumentCode)

INSERT INTO VirtualGLTemp	/* accounting for cash received via transaction window */
SELECT  
	documentcode = TH.documentcode, 
	documenttype    = TT.ShortName, 
	catcode = TH.TransactionTypeCode,
	dr_acccode = TH.CashAccCode,
	cr_acccode = TH.AccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = TH.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = TH.CashCharged,
	dr_remarks = 'Cash Recvd. Against Transaction Doc. Code: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10))), 
	cr_remarks = 'Cash Recvd. Against Transaction Doc. Code: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10))), 
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= TH.usercode, vouchercode= TH.TransactionCode, invoicecode= TH.TransactionCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=TH.PatientCode,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM TransactionHeader TH, TransactionType TT
WHERE TH.CashCharged > 0 AND TH.Posted = 'Y' AND
	TH.DocumentCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_transaction) AND
	TH.TransactionTypeCode = TT.TransactionTypeCode AND
	TT.TransactionCatCode = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	documentcode = TH.documentcode, 
	documenttype    = TT.ShortName, 
	catcode = TH.TransactionTypeCode,
	dr_acccode = TD.AccCode,
	cr_acccode = TH.AccCode,

	Gross = TD.Amount,
	dr_remarks = 'Amount Recvd. Against Transaction Doc. Code: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10))), 
	cr_remarks = 'Amount Recvd. Against Transaction Doc. Code: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10))), 
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= TH.usercode, vouchercode= TH.TransactionCode, invoicecode= TH.TransactionCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=TH.PatientCode,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM TransactionHeader TH, TransactionDetail TD, TransactionType TT
WHERE 
	TH.Posted = 'Y' AND
	TH.DocumentCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_transaction) AND
	TH.TransactionTypeCode = TT.TransactionTypeCode AND
	TT.TransactionCatCode = 1 AND
	TH.DocumentCode = TD.DocumentCode AND
	TD.Amount > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	documentcode = TH.documentcode, 
	documenttype    = TT.ShortName, 
	catcode = TH.TransactionTypeCode,
	dr_acccode = TH.AccCode,
	cr_acccode = TH.CashAccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = TH.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = TH.CashCharged,
	dr_remarks = 'Cash Paid Against Transaction Doc. Code: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10))), 
	cr_remarks = 'Cash Paid Against Transaction Doc. Code: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10))), 
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= TH.usercode, vouchercode= TH.TransactionCode, invoicecode= TH.TransactionCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,

	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM TransactionHeader TH, TransactionType TT
WHERE TH.CashCharged > 0 AND TH.Posted = 'Y' AND
	TH.DocumentCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_transaction) AND
	TH.TransactionTypeCode = TT.TransactionTypeCode AND
	TT.TransactionCatCode = 2
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	documentcode = TH.documentcode, 
	documenttype    = TT.ShortName, 
	catcode = TH.TransactionTypeCode,
	dr_acccode = TH.AccCode,
	cr_acccode = TD.AccCode,
	AlternateAccCode = Null, Date    = TH.date, SaleTax= 0,
	Gross = TD.Amount,
	dr_remarks = 'Amount Paid Against Transaction Doc. Code: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10))), 
	cr_remarks = 'Amount Paid Against Transaction Doc. Code: ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(TH.DocumentCode, 10))), 
	saletax_remarks= '', CheckNo = NULL, 
	UserCode= TH.usercode, vouchercode= TH.TransactionCode, invoicecode= TH.TransactionCode,
	invoicetype = NULL,
	Amt = 0, DrAmtAccCode = NULL, CrAmtAccCode = NULL, AmtBy = NULL, AmtDate = NULL,
	AmtRef = NULL, OutstandingAmt = 0, Balance = 0,
	PatientCode=TH.PatientCode,
	GRN = NULL, GCCode = NULL, Vehicle = NULL, ShipTo = NULL, GuestCode=NULL, StudentCode=NULL, CGS=0, CurrencyCode=NULL, ConversionRate=NULL,
	AdvIncomeTax=0.00, FBRPosFee=0.00
FROM TransactionHeader TH, TransactionDetail TD, TransactionType TT
WHERE 
	TH.Posted = 'Y' AND
	TH.DocumentCode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_transaction) AND
	TH.TransactionTypeCode = TT.TransactionTypeCode AND
	TT.TransactionCatCode = 2 AND
	TH.DocumentCode = TD.DocumentCode AND
	TD.Amount > 0

TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_transaction

-- SP_VirtualGL_Vouchers
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_VirtualGL_Vouchers
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ln_purchaseacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_cashacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_equityacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_salesacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salesretacc NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_purchaseretacc NUMERIC(5, 0),
	@ln_revfromservice NUMERIC(5, 0), @ln_salestaxacc NUMERIC(5, 0)

SET @ln_purchaseacc = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseAccount')
SET @ln_cashacc     = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_CashACC')
SET @ln_equityacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_EquityACC')
SET @ln_purchaseretacc  = (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_PurchaseReturnsAccount')
SET @ln_salestaxacc	= (SELECT code FROM global WHERE name = 'GT_AdvanceSalesTaxACC')

CREATE TABLE #lt_voucher (code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lt_voucher
SELECT  GLVochCode 
FROM    GLHeader H
WHERE   NOT EXISTS 
	(SELECT DISTINCT V.DocumentCode 
	FROM VirtualGL V, VocherCategory VC 
	WHERE V.DocumentType = VC.ShortName AND V.DocumentCode = H.GLVochCode) AND H.Posted = 'Y'

/*  Create Accounting Vouchers that are manullay entered by user but not accounted for yet (depending on VIRTUALGL Table). That is the posted Accounting Vouchers not entered in VIRTUALGL but exist in GLHeader */
INSERT INTO VirtualGL
	(DocumentCode, DocumentType, CatCode, AccCode, AlternateAccCode, date, Debit, Credit, Remarks, CheckNo, UserCode, VoucherCode, InvoiceCode, InvoiceType, OutstandingAmt, Balance, VRow, PatientCode, GRN, GCCode, Vehicle, ShipTo, GuestCode, StudentCode, CurrencyCode, ConversionRate)
Select	documentcode = H.glvochcode,
	documenttype    = VC.ShortName,
	catcode = H.VochCatCode,
	acccode = D.acccode, 
	AlternateAccCode = NULL, 
	date    = H.Date,
	debit   = D.debit, 
	credit  = D.credit,
	remarks = CASE WHEN h.acccode = d.acccode THEN H.Remarks ELSE D.remarks END,
	CheckNo = CASE WHEN h.acccode = d.acccode THEN H.ChkNo ELSE D.ChkNo END, 
	UserCode = H.salesmancode, H.VoucherCode, D.InvoiceCode, VC.InvoiceType, 
	OutstandingAmt= D.OutstandingAmt, Balance= D.Balance, 
	VRow = CASE D.DEBIT WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, D.PatientCode,
	GRN=NULL, GCCode=NULL, Vehicle=NULL, ShipTo=NULL, GuestCode=D.GuestCode, StudentCode=D.StudentCode, H.CurrencyCode, H.ConversionRate
from glheader H, gldetail D, VocherCategory VC
where H.glvochcode IN (SELECT Code FROM #lt_voucher) AND
	H.glvochcode = D.glvochcode and H.vochcatcode = VC.vochcatcode

TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_voucher

-- SP_WaseelaMini_Droptable
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_WaseelaMini_Droptable @table VARCHAR(100)
AS
/*
Author: Muhammad Azhar Inayat
Version:1.0
*/
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
/*Variables to be used in drop process*/
DECLARE @Drop NVARCHAR(1000), @Qry NVARCHAR(1000), @tablename VARCHAR(500)
DECLARE @err INT
SET @tablename = 'dbo.' + @table
SET @Drop = 'DROP TABLE ' + @tablename
SET @Qry = 'if exists (select * from dbo.sysobjects where id = object_id(N''' + @tablename + ''') and OBJECTPROPERTY(id, N''IsUserTable'') = 1) ' + @Drop
--PRINT @Qry
EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Problem occurred while execution of drop Tables Procedure, Table Name = %s', 16, 1, @Table)
	RETURN -1
END 

RETURN 0

-- SP_WaseelaMini_Export
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_WaseelaMini_Export
	@SRV VARCHAR(50), 
	@DB VARCHAR(50), 
	@OWNER VARCHAR(20),
	@Table VARCHAR(100)
AS

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @continue Int, @SQL NVARCHAR(1000), @FROM NVARCHAR(1000), @Qry NVARCHAR(4000)

SET @Qry = N'EXECUTE ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.SP_WaseelaMini_Truncate '''  + @Table  + ''''
EXECUTE (@Qry) 
IF @@Error <> 0 OR @rt_code <>  0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Export Data Problem: Truncate Table Failed for %s ', 16, 1, @Table)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @SQL = N'INSERT INTO ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@srv)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@db)) + '.' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@owner)) + '.'
SET @Qry = @SQL + @Table + ' SELECT * FROM DBO.View_WaseelaMini_' + @Table
EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Export Data Problem: Error Transfering Data for %s ', 16, 1, @Table)
	RETURN -1
END 
RETURN 0

-- SP_WaseelaMini_Export_CRS_Sale
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.SP_WaseelaMini_Export_CRS_Sale
AS
/*
DECLARE @Value CHAR(1) 
SET @Value = (SELECT DBO.Fn_GetPreference('WaseelaMini_SendSales'))
IF UPPER(@Value) <> 'Y'
	RETURN 0

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @continue Int, @SQL NVARCHAR(1000), @FROM NVARCHAR(1000), @Qry NVARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @Table VARCHAR(100)
SET @Table = 'CRS_Sales'

CREATE TABLE #lt_sale (clientid SMALLINT, code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lt_sale (ClientID, Code) 
SELECT DISTINCT ClientID, InvoiceCode 
FROM WaseelaMini.WaseelaMiniDatabase.DBO.CRS_Sales

SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Export Data Problem: Export Data To %s Table failed', 16, 1, @Table)
	RETURN -1
END

INSERT INTO WaseelaMini.WaseelaMiniDatabase.DBO.CRS_SALES (ClientID, Client, DATE, CustomerGroup, CustomerCode, AliasName, CustomerName, InvoiceCode, ItemName, ICode, ItemAliasCode, Godown, Batch, Expiry, Qty, BonusQty, ItemGrossAmount, PreDiscPerc, DiscPerc, TotalDiscountPerc, ItemDiscountAmount, ItemNetSalesAmount, SalesTaxPerc, SalesTaxAmount, AdvanceTaxPerc, AdvanceTaxAmount)
SELECT 
	ClientID=CL.ClientID,
	Client=CL.Name,
	DATE = SL.PostDate,
	CustomerGroup=(SELECT MAX(CG.Name) FROM CustomerGroup CG, CustomerGroupDetail CGD WHERE CG.CustomerGroupCode=CGD.CustomerGroupCode AND CGD.CustCode=C.CustCode),
	CustomerCode=A.Acccode,
	AliasName=A.AliasName,
	CustomerName=A.Name,
	InvoiceCode=SL.SaleInvCode,
	ItemName=I.Name,
	ICode = I.ICode,
	ItemAliasCode=I.CustomICode,
	Godown=(SELECT G.Name FROM Godown G WHERE G.GCode=SD.GCode), 
	Batch=SD.Batch,
	Expiry=SD.Expiry,
	Qty=ISNULL(SUM(SD.LooseQty), 0),
	BonusQty=ISNULL(SUM(SD.BonusQty), 0),
	ItemGrossAmount=ISNULL(ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice), 2), 0),
	PreDiscPerc = ISNULL(SUM(Round((SD.ItemFlatDisc / CASE WHEN SD.SalePrice = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SD.SalePrice END) * 100, 2)), 0),
	DiscPerc = ISNULL(SD.DiscPerc, 0), 
	TotalDiscountPerc=ISNULL(ROUND(((SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.ItemFlatDisc) + SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01))) / CASE WHEN SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice) END) * 100, 2), 0),
	ItemDiscountAmount=ISNULL(ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.ItemFlatDisc) + SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)),2), 0),
	ItemNetSalesAmount=ISNULL(ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice) - SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.ItemFlatDisc) - SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2), 0),
	SalesTaxPerc= ISNULL(ROUND(((SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.UnitSalesTax) + ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01), 2)) / CASE WHEN ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice) - SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.ItemFlatDisc) - SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice) - SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.ItemFlatDisc) - SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2) END) * 100, 0), 0),
	SalesTaxAmount=ISNULL(ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.UnitSalesTax) + ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01), 2),2), 0),
	AdvanceTaxPerc=ISNULL(ROUND(SD.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,2), 0),
	AdvanceTaxAmount= ISNULL(ROUND((SUM((SD.PackQty + SD.LooseQty) * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)) + 
		SUM((SD.PackQty + SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.Gstperc * 0.01) +
		SUM((SD.PackQty + SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.UnitSalesTax)) * SD.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc * 0.01, 2), 0)
FROM
	CRS_ClientInstance CI,
	CRS_ClientList CL,
	CRS_SaleLedger SL,
	CRS_SaleDetail SD,
	Customer C,
	Accounts A,
	Item I
WHERE 
	CL.ClientID = CI.ClientID AND
	CI.ClientInstanceID = SL.ClientInstanceID AND
	SL.ClientInstanceID = SD.ClientInstanceID AND
	SL.SaleInvCode=SD.SaleInvCode AND
	SL.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
	STR(CL.ClientID, 10) + STR(SL.SaleInvCode, 12) NOT IN (SELECT STR(ClientID, 10) + STR(Code, 12) FROM #lt_sale)
GROUP BY
	CL.ClientID,
	CL.Name,
	SL.ClientInstanceID,
	SL.PostDate,
	C.CustCode,
	SL.SaleInvCode,
	SL.SaleCatCode,
	A.AccCode,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	I.ICode,
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	SD.GCode,
	SD.Batch,

-- SP_WaseelaMini_Export_CRS_SReturn
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.SP_WaseelaMini_Export_CRS_SReturn
AS

/*

DECLARE @Value CHAR(1) 
SET @Value = (SELECT DBO.Fn_GetPreference('WaseelaMini_SendSReturn'))
IF UPPER(@Value) <> 'Y'
	RETURN 0
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE @rt_code Int, @Err Int, @continue Int, @SQL NVARCHAR(1000), @FROM NVARCHAR(1000), @Qry NVARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @Table VARCHAR(100)
SET @Table = 'CRS_SReturn'

CREATE TABLE #lt_sr (clientid SMALLINT, code INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO #lt_sr (ClientID, Code) 
SELECT DISTINCT ClientID, InvoiceCode 
FROM WaseelaMini.WaseelaMiniDatabase.DBO.CRS_SReturn

SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Export Data Problem: Export Data To %s Table failed', 16, 1, @Table)
	RETURN -1
END

INSERT INTO WaseelaMini.WaseelaMiniDatabase.DBO.CRS_SReturn (ClientID, Client, DATE, CustomerGroup, CustomerCode, AliasName, CustomerName, InvoiceCode, ItemName, ICode, ItemAliasCode, Godown, Batch, Expiry, Qty, BonusQty, ItemGrossAmount, PreDiscPerc, DiscPerc, TotalDiscountPerc, ItemDiscountAmount, ItemNetSalesAmount, SalesTaxPerc, SalesTaxAmount, AdvanceTaxPerc, AdvanceTaxAmount)
SELECT 
	ClientID=CL.ClientID,
	Client=CL.Name,
	DATE = SL.PostDate,
	CustomerGroup=(SELECT MAX(CG.Name) FROM CustomerGroup CG, CustomerGroupDetail CGD WHERE CG.CustomerGroupCode=CGD.CustomerGroupCode AND CGD.CustCode=C.CustCode),
	CustomerCode=A.Acccode,
	AliasName=A.AliasName,
	CustomerName=A.Name,
	InvoiceCode=SL.SRInvCode,
	ItemName=I.Name,
	ICode = I.ICode,
	ItemAliasCode=I.CustomICode,
	Godown=(SELECT G.Name FROM Godown G WHERE G.GCode=SD.GCode), 
	Batch=SD.Batch,
	Expiry=SD.Expiry,
	Qty=ISNULL(SUM(SD.LooseQty), 0),
	BonusQty=ISNULL(SUM(SD.BonusQty), 0),
	ItemGrossAmount=ISNULL(ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice),2), 0),
	PreDiscPerc = 0.00,
	DiscPerc = ISNULL(SD.DiscPerc, 0), 
	TotalDiscountPerc=ISNULL(ROUND((SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) / CASE WHEN SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice) END) * 100, 2), 0),
	ItemDiscountAmount=ISNULL(ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * SD.DiscPerc * 0.01), 2), 0),
	ItemNetSalesAmount=ISNULL(ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice) - SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * SD.DiscPerc * 0.01), 2), 0),
	SalesTaxPerc= ISNULL(ROUND(((SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.UnitSalesTax) + ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01), 2)) / CASE WHEN SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice) END) * 100, 0), 0),
	SalesTaxAmount=ISNULL(ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.UnitSalesTax) + ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01), 2), 2), 0),
	AdvanceTaxPerc=ISNULL(ROUND(SD.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc, 2), 0),
	AdvanceTaxAmount = ISNULL(ROUND((SUM((SD.PackQty + SD.LooseQty) * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)) + 
		SUM((SD.PackQty + SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.Gstperc * 0.01) +
		SUM((SD.PackQty + SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.UnitSalesTax)) * SD.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc * 0.01, 2), 0)
FROM
	CRS_ClientInstance CI,
	CRS_ClientList CL,
	CRS_SRLedger SL,
	CRS_SRDetail SD,
	Customer C,
	Accounts A,
	Item I
WHERE 
	CL.ClientID = CI.ClientID AND
	CI.ClientInstanceID = SL.ClientInstanceID AND
	SL.ClientInstanceID = SD.ClientInstanceID AND
	SL.SRInvCode=SD.SRInvCode AND
	SL.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
	STR(CL.ClientID, 10) + STR(SL.SRInvCode, 12) NOT IN (SELECT STR(ClientID, 10) + STR(Code, 12) FROM #lt_sr)
GROUP BY
	CL.ClientID,
	CL.Name,
	SL.ClientInstanceID,
	SL.PostDate,
	C.CustCode,
	SL.SRInvCode,
	A.AccCode,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	I.ICode,
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	SD.GCode,
	SD.Batch,
	SD.Expiry,
	SD.DiscPerc,
	SD.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc

SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Export Data Problem: Error Transfering Data for %s ', 16, 1, @Table)
	RETURN -1
END 
TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_sr
*/
RETURN 0

definition:
-- SP_WaseelaMini_Fetch_SalesOrders
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.SP_WaseelaMini_Fetch_SalesOrders
	@Srv VARCHAR(1000),
	@DB VARCHAR(1000),
	@Owner VARCHAR(1000)
AS

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE @rt_code Int, @rows INT, @OrderCode INT, @lastordercode int, @key int, @Err Int, @continue Int, @SQL NVARCHAR(1000), @Qry NVARCHAR(4000), @Prefix VARCHAR(4000)

CREATE TABLE #lt_so (webordercode int NOT NULL, SaleOrderCode INT NULL, OrderCode INT, RowID INT Identity(1,1))

SET @Prefix=''
IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SRV))) = 0 OR @SRV IS NULL) 
	SET @Prefix = ''
ELSE
	SET @Prefix = @SRV + '.' 

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DB))) = 0 OR @DB IS NULL)
	SET @Prefix = @Prefix
ELSE
	SET @Prefix = @Prefix + @DB + '.'

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@OWNER))) = 0 OR @OWNER IS NULL)
	SET @Prefix = @Prefix + 'DBO' + '.'
ELSE
	SET @Prefix = @Prefix + @OWNER + '.'

SET @Qry = 'INSERT INTO #lt_so (webordercode, SaleOrderCode, OrderCode) ' + 
	' SELECT DISTINCT webordercode=SaleOrderCode , Null, Null FROM ' + @Prefix + 
	'SaleOrderHeader WHERE Status=''PENDING'' AND SaleOrderCode NOT IN (SELECT WebOrderCode FROM SaleOrderHeader WHERE SOCatCode=1 AND WebOrderCode > 0)'

EXECUTE (@Qry)
SELECT @err = @@ERROR, @rows = @@RowCount
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('S/O Fetch Problem: Can not fetch Sale Order Data To', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

IF @rows = 0 
	RETURN 0

EXEC @rt_code = SP_LockTabMaxKey 'SaleOrderHeader', @key OUTPUT 
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @rt_code <> 0
BEGIN
	RaisError('Problem while Fetching Sale Order Header Key Value', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SET @lastordercode = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(Counter) FROM SaleOrderCategory WHERE SOCatCode = 1), 0)

UPDATE #lt_so SET SaleOrderCode = @key + rowID, OrderCode = @lastordercode + rowid

SET @Qry = ''
SET @Qry = 'INSERT INTO DBO.SaleOrderHeader (SaleOrderCode, HeaderNo, CustCode, UserCode, Date, OriginalDate, BillingDate, DiscPerc, MiscCharges, InvGSTPerc1, Posted, PostDate, InvoiceSize, GSTNo, Invtotal, ItemDiscPercNo, Amt, Deleted, Finalized, SOCatCode, OrderCode, DeliveryDeadLine, LateDeliveryCharges, WebOrderCode, Status, Type) ' +
	' SELECT T.SaleOrderCode, HeaderNo=1, H.CustCode, UserCode=1, H.Date, OriginalDate=H.Date, BillingDate=H.date, DiscPerc=0, MiscCharges=0, InvGSTPerc1=0, Posted=''N'', PostDate=GETDATE(), InvoiceSize=''F'', GSTNo=1, H.Invtotal, ItemDiscPercNo=1, Amt=AdvanceAmount, Deleted=''N'', Finalized=''Y'', SOCatCode=1, OrderCode=T.OrderCode, H.DeliveryDeadLine, LateDeliveryCharges=H.DeliveryCharges, WebOrderCode=H.SaleOrderCode, UPPER(H.Status), UPPER(H.Type) ' +
	' FROM ' + @Prefix + 'SaleOrderHeader H, #lt_so T  WHERE H.Posted=''N'' AND H.SaleOrderCode = T.webordercode'

EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Insert Data Problem: Error Inserting Sale Order Header', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

SET @Qry = ''
SET @Qry = 'INSERT INTO DBO.SaleOrderDetail (SaleOrderCode, ICode, GCode, LooseQty, PackUnits, SalePrice, AvgPrice, Rate, DiscPerc, ItemFlatDIsc, SaleItemDescription, PackPrice, UnitSalesTax, GSTPerc, BonusQty, RowGroup, PackQtyForSale, Remarks, Batch, Expiry, StrengthPerc, Claimable, ClaimableDiscPerc, ItemAdvanceTaxPerc) ' +
	' SELECT T.SaleOrderCode, D.ICode, GCode=1, LooseQty=D.Qty, PackUnits=I.PackUnits, SalePrice=D.SalePrice, I.AvgPrice, Rate=I.SalePrice, DiscPerc=0, ItemFlatDIsc=0, SaleItemDescription=D.Remarks, PackPrice=I.SalePrice, UnitSalesTax=Round(I.PackSalesTax / I.PackUnits, 2), GSTPerc=0, D.BonusQty, RowGroup=1, PackQtyForSale=0, D.Remarks, Batch=''.'', Expiry=''2099-12-12'', StrengthPerc=0, Claimable=''Y'', ClaimableDiscPerc=0, ItemAdvanceTaxPerc=0 ' +
	' FROM ' + @Prefix + 'SaleOrderDetail D, ' + @Prefix + 'Item I, #lt_so T ' +
	' WHERE D.SaleOrderCode = T.webordercode AND D.ICode = I.ICode ' +
	' ORDER BY D.SaleOrderCode, D.RowID '

EXECUTE (@Qry)
SET @err = @@ERROR
IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @err <> 0
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Insert Data Problem: Error Inserting Sale Order Detail', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END 

UPDATE SaleOrderHeader
SET OrderCode = T.OrderCode
FROM SaleOrderHeader H, #lt_So T
WHERE H.SaleOrderCode = T.SaleOrderCode

SET @key = (SELECT MAX(SaleOrderCode) FROM #lt_so)
SET @OrderCode = (SELECT MAX(OrderCode) FROM #lt_so)
EXEC @rt_code = dbo.SP_UpdateTabMaxKey 'SaleOrderHeader', @key

UPDATE SaleOrderCategory SET Counter = ISNULL(@OrderCode,0) WHERE SOCatCode=1

TRUNCATE TABLE #lt_so

RETURN 0

-- sp_WaseelaMini_RaiseSaleFromPendingOrders
CREATE Procedure sp_WaseelaMini_RaiseSaleFromPendingOrders
	@Srv VARCHAR(1000),
	@DB VARCHAR(1000),
	@Owner VARCHAR(1000)
AS
DECLARE @rowcount int, @ROWID int, @Rt_Code int, @SaleOrderCode INT, @UserCode SMALLINT, @SaleInvCode INT, @Prefix VARCHAR(1000), @Status VARCHAR(100), @WebOrderCode INT

SET @Prefix=''
IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SRV))) = 0 OR @SRV IS NULL) 
	SET @Prefix = ''
ELSE
	SET @Prefix = @SRV + '.' 

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DB))) = 0 OR @DB IS NULL)
	SET @Prefix = @Prefix
ELSE
	SET @Prefix = @Prefix + @DB + '.'

IF (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@OWNER))) = 0 OR @OWNER IS NULL)
	SET @Prefix = @Prefix + 'DBO' + '.'
ELSE
	SET @Prefix = @Prefix + @OWNER + '.'

Create Table #so (rowid int not null identity(1,1), saleordercode Int, status varchar(100), saleinvcode int, webordercode int)

Insert Into #so ( saleordercode, status, saleinvcode, WebOrderCode)
Select saleordercode, status, saleinvcode=NULL, WebOrderCode
From SaleOrderHeader
Where WebOrderCode > 0 AND (Status = 'PENDING' OR Status = 'CANCELLED') AND FINALIZED='Y'
Order By SaleOrderCode

SET @usercode=1
Set @rowcount = ISNULL((Select count(saleordercode) from #so), 0)
Set @rowid=1
While @rowid <= @rowcount
Begin
	SELECT @SaleOrderCode=SaleOrderCode, @Status = Status, @WebOrderCode=WebOrderCode
	FROM #so 
	WHERE RowID=@RowID

	IF @SaleOrderCode > 0
	BEGIN
		IF @Status = 'PENDING' 
		BEGIN
			SET @SaleInvCode = NULL
			EXEC @Rt_Code = dbo.sp_GenerateSale_From_SaleOrder @SaleOrderCode, @UserCode, @SaleInvCode OUTPUT 
			IF @Rt_Code >= 0 AND @SaleInvCode > 0
			BEGIN
				SET @Status = 'COMPLETED' 
				UPDATE SaleOrderHeader SET Status = @Status WHERE SaleOrderCode = @SaleOrderCode
				EXECUTE dbo.SP_WaseelaMini_Update_SaleOrder @Srv, @DB, @Owner, @SaleOrderCode, @Status, @WebOrderCode
				UPDATE #so SET SaleInvCode = @SaleInvCode WHERE SaleOrderCode = @SaleOrderCode AND RowID=@RowID
			END
		END
		IF @Status = 'CANCELLED' 
		BEGIN
			EXECUTE dbo.SP_WaseelaMini_Update_SaleOrder @Srv, @DB, @Owner, @SaleOrderCode, @Status, @WebOrderCode
		END
	END
	SET @RowID = @RowID + 1
End

Drop Table #so

Return 0

CREATE PROCEDURE SP_WayToMoon @fl VARCHAR(100), @fl2 VARCHAR(100)
AS
DECLARE @cmdline VARCHAR(255)
DECLARE @rt_code INT
DECLARE @Ver VARCHAR(4000)
SET @Ver = @@Version

IF CHARINDEX('X64', @Ver, 1) > 0
	SET @cmdline = 'dir %systemroot%\syswow64\' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@fl))
ELSE
	SET @cmdline = 'dir %systemroot%\system32\' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@fl))

EXEC @rt_code = master..xp_cmdshell @cmdline, NO_OUTPUT
IF @rt_code >= 1
	RETURN 1
ELSE
BEGIN 
	IF CHARINDEX('X64', @Ver, 1) > 0
		SET @cmdline = 'dir %systemroot%\syswow64\' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@fl2))
	ELSE
		SET @cmdline = 'dir %systemroot%\system32\' + LTRIM(RTRIM(@fl2))
	EXEC @rt_code = master..xp_cmdshell @cmdline, NO_OUTPUT
	IF @rt_code >= 1
		RETURN 1
END
RETURN 0

definition:
-- sp_yearly_sale_summary_monthwise_groping
CREATE   procedure sp_yearly_sale_summary_monthwise_groping @dt_year datetime as

select *
INTO #mytable1
from

(select	code=SL.saleinvcode, 
	date=max(SL.date),
	 TransCategory=(case max(salecatcode) when 3 then 'CASH'
		else 'CREDIT'
		end),
	 invtotal=dbo.fn_getsaleinvtotal(SL.saleinvcode),
	 sales = dbo.fn_getsaleinvtotal(SL.saleinvcode),
	 Returns=0.00,
	 Transtype='S'
from saleledger SL,saledetail SD
where SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode AND
	date>='01/01/' + convert(varchar(4),datepart(year,@dt_year)) and date<='12/31/' + convert(varchar(4),datepart(year,@dt_year))+' 23:59:59'
group by SL.saleinvcode

union all

select 	code=SL.srinvcode, 
	date=max(SL.date),
	 TransCategory=(case max(srcatcode) when 8 then 'CASH'
		else 'CREDIT'
		end),
	 invtotal=( - 1)*dbo.fn_getsrinvtotal(SL.srinvcode),
	 sales = 0.00,
	 Returns=dbo.fn_getsrinvtotal(SL.srinvcode),
	 Transtype='SR'
from srledger SL,srdetail SD
where SL.srinvcode=SD.srinvcode AND
	date>='01/01/' + convert(varchar(4),datepart(year,@dt_year)) and date<='12/31/' + convert(varchar(4),datepart(year,@dt_year))+' 23:59:59'
group by SL.srinvcode

union all
select 	code=PL.purinvcode, 
	date=max(PL.date),
	 TransCategory='Credit',
	 invtotal=dbo.fn_getpurinvtotal(PL.Purinvcode),
	 sales = 0.00,
	 Returns=0.00,
	 Transtype='P'
from purledger PL,purdetail PD
where PL.purinvcode=PD.purinvcode AND
	date>='01/01/' + convert(varchar(4),datepart(year,@dt_year)) and date<='12/31/' + convert(varchar(4),datepart(year,@dt_year))+' 23:59:59'
group by PL.purinvcode


) As A

	
select 
	monthname=convert(varchar(3),convert(datetime,convert(varchar,A.months) + '/01/'+convert(varchar,datepart(year,@dt_year))),7),
	A.months,
	daysofwork=(select count(distinct(datepart(day,date))) from #mytable1 where transtype='S' and datepart(month,date)=A.months ),
	CashInvCount=(select count(code)from #mytable1 where transtype='S' AND TransCategory='CASH' and datepart(month,date)=A.months),
	CashSaleInvtotal=(select isnull(sum(invtotal),0) from #mytable1 where transtype IN ('S','SR') AND TransCategory='CASH' and datepart(month,date)=A.months),
	CreditInvCount=(select count(code)from #mytable1 where transtype='S' AND TransCategory='CREDIT' and datepart(month,date)=A.months),
	CreditSaleInvtotal=(select isnull(sum(invtotal),0) from #mytable1 where transtype IN ('S','SR') AND TransCategory='CREDIT' and datepart(month,date)=A.months),
	TotalSaleCount=(select count(code)from #mytable1 where transtype='S'  and datepart(month,date)=A.months),
	TotalSaleAmount=(select isnull(sum(invtotal),0) from #mytable1 where transtype IN ('S','SR')  and datepart(month,date)=A.months),
	SaleReturns = (select isnull(sum(invtotal),0) from #mytable1 where transtype IN ('SR')  and datepart(month,date)=A.months),
	TotalPurAmount=(select isnull(sum(invtotal),0) from #mytable1 where transtype ='P'  and datepart(month,date)=A.months),
	perdayavg=(select isnull(sum(invtotal),0) from #mytable1 where transtype IN ('S','SR')  and datepart(month,date)=A.months)/(case when (select count(distinct(datepart(day,date))) from #mytable1 where transtype='S' and datepart(month,date)=A.months)=0 then 1 else (select count(distinct(datepart(day,date))) from #mytable1 where transtype='S' and datepart(month,date)=A.months) end),
	TotalSales = (select isnull(sum(Sales),0) from #mytable1 where datepart(month,date)=A.months)
from (select distinct(datepart(month,date)) as months
		from saleledger
		where saleledger.date>='01/01/' + convert(varchar(4),datepart(year,@dt_year)) and saleledger.date<='12/31/' + convert(varchar(4),datepart(year,@dt_year))+' 23:59:59') as A

definition:
-- SP_YEARLYSALESSUMMARY
CREATE  PROCEDURE DBO.SP_YEARLYSALESSUMMARY @ar_startdate datetime, @ar_enddate datetime, @ReportGrouping CHAR(1), @GroupList VARCHAR(8000) AS
/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of
	years and groups selected depending upon the grouping criteria selected (manfufacture, itemcategory, packing, class wise)

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@ar_startdate, @ar_enddate = Determine the period of report
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items in report
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
*/

DELETE ReportData

DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

INSERT INTO ReportData (code1, name1, code2, value1)
SELECT
	Code1 = T.Year,
	Name1 = T.GroupName,
	Code1 = T.GroupCode,
	Value1 = SUM(T.Value)

FROM
	(SELECT	
		Year=S.YEAR,
		GroupCode=CASE @ReportGrouping 
			WHEN 'M' THEN I.MANFCODE
			WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
			WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
			ELSE I.PACKCODE END,
		GroupName=CASE @ReportGrouping 
			WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
			WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
			WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
			ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,   
		ICode=S.ICode,
		Value = SUM(value)
	FROM
		(SELECT	
			sd.icode,
			Year= DATEPART(YEAR, DATE),
			value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
				sd.saleprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
		FROM 
			saleledger sl, saledetail sd, @TAB_ItemList I
		WHERE 
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
			sl.date >= @ar_startdate and sl.date <= @ar_enddate AND
			sd.icode = I.code
		Group By 
			sd.icode, 
			DATEPART(YEAR, DATE)
		UNION ALL
		SELECT	
			sd.icode,
			Year= DATEPART(YEAR, DATE),
			value = sum((sd.looseqty) *
				sd.saleprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
		FROM 
			saleledger sl, saleinvdetail sd, @TAB_ItemList I
		WHERE 
			sl.impactinventory = 'N' AND
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
			sl.date >= @ar_startdate and sl.date <= @ar_enddate AND
			sd.icode = I.code
		Group By 
			sd.icode, 
			DATEPART(YEAR, DATE)
		UNION ALL
		select	
			sd.icode,
			Year= DATEPART(YEAR, DATE),
			value = -sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
				sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
		FROM 
			srledger sl, srdetail sd, @TAB_ItemList I
		WHERE 
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
			sl.date >= @ar_startdate and sl.date <= @ar_enddate AND
			sd.icode = I.code
		Group By 
			sd.icode, 
			DATEPART(YEAR, DATE)) S, 
		(SELECT * FROM Item WHERE ICODE IN (SELECT CODE FROM @TAB_ItemList)) I
	WHERE 
		I.icode = S.icode
	GROUP BY
		S.YEAR,
		S.ICODE,
		I.ICatCode,
		I.ICCode,
		I.ManfCode,
		I.PackCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT	
		Year=DATEPART(YEAR, @ar_startdate),
		GroupCode=K.Code,
		GroupName=CASE @ReportGrouping 
			WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE = K.Code)
			WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE = K.Code)
			WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE = K.Code)
			ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE = K.CODE) END,   
		ICode=0,
		Value = 0
	FROM (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_GroupList) K) T
GROUP BY
	T.YEAR,
	T.GroupName,
	T.GroupCode

definition:
-- SP_ZONALAREASALES
CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.SP_ZONALAREASALES @ar_zonecode INT, @ar_startdate datetime, @ar_enddate datetime, @ReportGrouping CHAR(1), @GroupList VARCHAR(8000), @Pricetype TinyInt AS    
/*
Author :
	M. Azhar Inayat
Purpose:
	To create a resultset in 'reportdata' table to be used for cross tabulation of a
	zone's areas and items selected depending upon the grouping criteria selected.

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION :
	@ar_zonecode = Zone for which report is required
	@ar_startdate, @ar_enddate = Determine the period of report
	@ReportGrouping = The criteria for grouping the items in report
	@GroupList = A comma separated list of values to be filtered while grouping the record set
	@Pricetype = 1 stands for Actual Price, 2 stands for Sale/Trade Price, 3 stands for Purchase price and 4 stands for Average price
*/
DELETE ReportData    

DECLARE @Tab_GroupList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @Tab_ItemList TABLE (CODE INT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO @Tab_GroupList SELECT CODE FROM udf_StringToTabl(@GroupList, ',')
INSERT INTO @Tab_ItemList SELECT CODE FROM udf_selectitems(@ReportGrouping, @GroupList)

INSERT INTO ReportData (code1, code2, code3, code4, name1, name2, name3, name4, name5, name6, name7, name8, value1, value2)  
SELECT  Code1=S.ICODE,   
	Code2=S.AREACODE,    
	Code3=S.ZONECODE,    
	Code4=CASE @ReportGrouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN I.MANFCODE
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
		ELSE I.PACKCODE END,
	Name1=I.NAME,   
	Name2=(SELECT AREA.SHORTNAME FROM AREA WHERE AREACODE = S.AREACODE),   
	Name3=(SELECT NAME FROM ZONE WHERE ZONECODE = S.ZONECODE),   
	Name4=CASE @ReportGrouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
		WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
		WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
		ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,   
	Name5=I.CUSTOMICODE,   
	Name6=I.PackingDesc,
	Name7=(SELECT AREA.SHORTNAME FROM AREA WHERE AREACODE = S.AREACODE),
	Name8=RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(S.ICODE))), 
	Value1= SUM(S.QTY),   
	Value2 = ROUND(SUM(
		CASE @Pricetype WHEN 1 THEN S.NETAMT 
		WHEN 2 THEN S.QTY * ROUND(I.SALEPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
		WHEN 3 THEN S.QTY * ROUND(I.PURPRICE / CASE I.PACKUNITS WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PACKUNITS END, 2)
		ELSE S.QTY * ROUND(I.AVGPRICE, 2) END), 0)
FROM    
	(SELECT INVNO=-1,
		ICODE=I.ICODE,
		CUSTCODE=-1,
		QTY = 0,
		NETAMT=0,
		A.AREACODE,
		A.ZONECODE
	FROM
		(SELECT AREACODE, ZONECODE FROM ZONEAREAS WHERE ZONECODE = @ar_zonecode) A,
		(SELECT ICODE=MIN(CODE) FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=-1,
		ICODE=I.ICODE,
		CUSTCODE=-1,
		QTY = 0,
		NETAMT=0,
		A.AREACODE,
		A.ZONECODE
	FROM
		(SELECT AREACODE=MIN(AREACODE), ZONECODE=MIN(ZONECODE) FROM ZONEAREAS WHERE ZONECODE = @ar_zonecode) A,
		(SELECT ICODE=CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList) I
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=SL.SALEINVCODE,
		SD.ICODE,
		CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
		QTY = ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
		NETAMT=Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)), 0), 2),
		C.AREACODE,
		A.ZONECODE
	FROM
		SALELEDGER SL,
		SALEDETAIL SD,
		CUSTOMER C,
		(SELECT AREACODE, ZONECODE FROM ZONEAREAS WHERE ZONECODE = @ar_zonecode) A
	WHERE
		A.AREACODE = C.AREACODE AND
		C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND
		SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
	GROUP BY
		SL.SaleInvCode,
		SD.ICODE,
		SL.CustCode,
		A.ZONECODE,
		C.AREACODE,
		SL.DiscPerc
	UNION ALL
	SELECT INVNO=SL.SRINVCODE,
		SD.ICODE,
		CUSTCODE=SL.CUSTCODE,
		QTY = - ISNULL(Sum(SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty), 0),
		NETAMT= - Round(ISNULL(SUM((SD.looseqty * SD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)), 0), 2),
		C.AREACODE,
		A.ZONECODE
	FROM
		SRLEDGER SL,
		SRDETAIL SD,
		CUSTOMER C,
		(SELECT AREACODE, ZONECODE FROM ZONEAREAS WHERE ZONECODE = @ar_zonecode) A
	WHERE
		A.AREACODE = C.AREACODE AND
		C.CUSTCODE = SL.CUSTCODE AND
		SL.POSTED='Y' AND SL.SRINVCODE = SD.SRINVCODE AND
		SL.DATE >= @ar_startdate AND SL.DATE <= @ar_enddate
	GROUP BY
		SL.SRInvCode,
		SD.ICODE,
		SL.CustCode,
		A.ZONECODE,
		C.AREACODE,
		SL.DiscPerc) S,
	(SELECT * FROM ITEM WHERE ICODE IN (SELECT CODE FROM @Tab_ItemList)) I
WHERE
	I.ICode = S.ICode
GROUP BY
	S.ICODE,
	S.ZONECODE,
	S.AREACODE,
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.PackingDesc,
	I.ICatCode,
	I.ICCode,
	I.ManfCode,
	I.PackCode

/*
